text: A stone pit. Fractured stones are covering the hill. There are two excavators on the right on top of the hill digging the pile of stones. There are more than 10 workers with red hard hats scattered on the slope.

text:
Five pieces of construction equipment are working on a construction site. Two excavators are digging and loading the trucks. 
There are three dump trucks in total in the image. A person is standing on the right of the image. There are several building at the far end of the image.
zh: 五台施工设备正在建筑工地上作业。两台挖掘机正在挖掘并将物料装载到卡车上。图像中总共有三台泵车。一个人站在图像的右侧。图像远端有几栋建筑物。

text:
Many bundles of rebars are on the ground. Some portion of the rebars is covered with blue cloth. 
A worker with a yellow hard hat and a safety vest at the left is processing rebars with a machine. There is a shed in the image. 
There are two other workers with yellow hard hats and safety vest on the right of the image. There is an unfinished concrete building at the background.
zh:
地面上有许多钢筋。部分钢筋被蓝色布料覆盖。
左侧有一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在用机器加工钢筋。图中有一盏灯。
图像右侧有另外两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人。背景中有一栋未完工的混凝土建筑。

err.en: There is a shed in the image.

text: The image shows a busy construction site. There are about 30 workers with red or yellow hard hats and safety vests. They are standing on a rebar framework on top of a concrete foundation. There are two excavators on the hill in the background. A tower crane is lifting a bundle of rebars for the workers. On the right, there is a red pile driver in the background. There are some wood boards and rebars scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个繁忙的建筑施工现场。大约有三十名工人戴着红色或黄色安全帽和穿着安全背心。他们站在混凝土基础上的方的钢框架上。背景中有两台挖掘机在土丘上。一台塔式起重机正在吊运一捆绑钢筋给工人。在右侧，背景中有一辆红色卡车。现场周围散落着一些木板和钢筋。

text: Embankment on the left does not use edge protection.
zh: 左侧的嵌入未使用边缘保护。

text: There are two workers, one of them with a yellow hard hat is leveling a concrete platform, while the one with a red hard hat is standing in the background. There is also a tower crane. Some broken bricks are in the foreground. There also also some barrels and wood boards at the right.
zh: 有两名工人，其中一名戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在混凝土平台上，另一名戴红色安全帽的工人站在背景中。现场还有一台塔式起重机。前景处有一些破碎的砖块。右侧还有一些油桶和木板。

text: A construction site is divided into two by scaffoldings. For the closer construction site, there are piles of dimensional lumber at the left and metal rebars at the right. For the farther site, there are piles of tied and untied dimensional lumber all across the site, and stirrups at the left. at the left of the construction site, there are five rolls of coiled rebars and white blocks. There are about 13 workers with yellow or red hard hats at the site.
zh: 施工现场分为两个脚手架区域。靠近的施工现场，左侧堆放着成堆的方木料，右侧堆放着成堆的钢筋。远处的，整个场地上堆放着成堆的有结的和无结的方木料，左侧堆放着成堆的搅拌器。靠近的施工现场，左侧堆放着五卷的成堆的钢筋和白色块。现场大约有13名戴着黄色或红色安全帽的工人。

text: Five workers with yellow or red hard hats are working at a tunnel-like unfinished structure. A worker is welding.
zh: 五名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人正在类似隧道的完工结构中内作业。一名工人正在进行焊接。

text:
Eight workers with yellow hard hats are working at the bottom of an excavated site. Some workers are working with rebars 
and stirrups, there are some stirrups placed ground on the right of the image.

text: Three workers with red hard hats are standing on the metal scaffolding of the factory. A worker is observing next to a gas cylinder on the ground.

text: An excavator is in the middle of the image. There are three workers next to the excavator, two of them are wearing hard hats. In the background, there are some black pipes and concrete pipes. On the left of the image, two SUVs, and a dump truck can be seen. On the right of the image, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 画面中央有一台挖掘机。挖掘机前方有三名工人，其中两人戴着安全帽。背景中有一些黑色管道和混凝土管道。画面左侧有两辆SUV，还能看到一辆自卸卡车。画面右侧有两台塔式起重机。

text: A worker crane and a mobile crane with a boom extended in the middle of the image. In the foreground, there are piles of rectangular metal tubes and orange plastic tubes. On the left, the jib of a tower crane can be seen. Next to the mobile crane are three workers with yellow or red hard hats. On the left of the image, there is building surrounded by scaffoldings. Three workers with hard hats are working on top of the porch.
zh: 画面中央，一台塔式起重机和一台移动式起重机正在吊装一根钢管。前景处堆放着成堆的矩形金属管和橙色塑料管。左侧可以看到一座塔式起重机的架的缆索。紧挨着移动起重机的的是三名戴着黄色或红色安全帽的工人。画面左侧，有一栋建筑被脚手架包围着。三名戴着安全帽的工人正在门廊顶部作业。

err.en: a worker crane and a mobile crane with a
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机和一台移动式起重机正在吊装一根钢管

err.en: the jib of a tower crane
err.zh: 一座塔式起重机的架的缆索

text: There are three people with white or yellow hard hats in the center of the image. In the upper right corner, the body of another person is visible. On the ground, there are at least nine stacks of metal tubes that can be used as scaffolding. There are also six piles of dimensional lumber. There is a scaffold in the upper left of the image. In the middle of the image, there is a rebar structure and the worker with a yellow hard hat is standing on top of it.

err.zh: 有一个工人戴着黄色安全帽站在上面

text: Five workers with yellow hard hats are at a construction site. There are multiple stacks of rebars of different shapes in the image. In the upper right, there is a tower crane.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于一处建筑工地。图中有多个不同形状的的重物的堆。右上方有一台塔式起重机。

text: Two excavators and three workers are at the construction site. Two workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are in a brick well. The dirt at the site are covered with blue fabrics.
zh: 两名挖掘机和三名工人在施工现场。两名戴黄色安全帽和穿安全背心的的工人在砖井中。现场的泥土被蓝色布料覆盖。

text: Two workers with red or blue hard hats are spraying water onto the rocks in the bucket of the loader. There is an excavator on the lower portion of the image. In the upper part of the image, there is an excavator, a blue light truck and a dump truck.
zh: 两名头戴红色或蓝色安全帽的工人正在向装载机料斗内喷射水。图像下部有一台挖掘机。图像上部有一台挖掘机、一辆蓝色轻型卡车和一辆泵车。

text: An excavator is in the center of the image sitting on top of a dirt pile. On the right of the image, there is a tower crane. An unfinished building covered with blue fabric is in the background.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机停在一堆泥土料上方。画面右侧，有一台塔式起重机。背景中，有一栋已完工的大楼，覆盖着蓝色布料。

text: There are two workers with yellow hard hats standing in the foreground. One of them is throwing something into the sky. A loader is next to them. On the other side of the loader, another worker is standing next to a well.
zh: 前景中有两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。其中一人正向天空抛掷某物。一台装载机位于他们前方。在装载机的另一侧，另一名工人正站在一台起重机旁。

text: Four excavators are working at a construction site. A worker with a white hard hat and another worker without PPE stand next to the yellow excavator on the left. There is also a drum roller and a loader at the site. A worker with a white hard hat stands next to the loader.
zh: 四名挖掘机手正在一处建筑工地作业。一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在左侧黄色挖掘机的旁，另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在装载机旁。现场还有一台鼓轮机和一台装载机。

err.zh: 另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人

err.en: There is also a drum roller and a loader

text: A pile driver is driving a pile into the side of an excavation pit. A worker with a yellow hard hat is observing the process in the pit, and another worker is next to the pile driver. In the middle of the image, there is an yellow excavator.
zh: 打桩机将桩打入基坑侧壁。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在观察基坑内的作业情况，另一名工人正走向打桩机。画面中部有一台黄色色挖掘机。

err.en: another worker is next to the pile drive
err.zh: 另一名工人正走向打桩机

text: Four workers are pouring concrete onto rocks with a hose hanging from above. Two of them use straps tied to the hose to move it. They are next to a metal scaffolding.
zh: 四名工人用软管将混凝土浇筑到岩石上。其中两人使用绑在软管上的以移动它。他们接下来要搭设一个金属脚手架。

err.en: with a hose hanging from above
err.zh: 用软管将混凝土浇筑到岩石上

err.en: They are next to a metal scaffolding.
err.zh: 他们接下来要搭设一个金属脚手架。

text: 21 workers with yellow or red hard hats are at the bottom of an excavation pit. The site is full of rebar mesh. The base of a tower crane is on the left. The tower crane is lifting a bundle of rebar.
zh: 11名戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人位于一个基坑底部。该场地布满钢筋网。一台塔式起重机的底座位于左侧。该塔式起重机正吊起一捆绑钢筋。

text: Six workers with yellow hard hats are at a construction site with three rows of rebars. They are standing on a concrete slab-on-grade foundation in an excavation pit.
zh: 六名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于一处有三排钢筋的施工现场。他们站在基坑内一块混凝土垫层上，该垫层位于地基等级。

err.zh: 混凝土垫层上，该垫层位于地基等级

text: Three workers with yellow and red hard hats are on a rural road. The worker with a yellow hard hat and long rubber boots are working on a pond of freshly poured concrete.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽、脚穿红色硬靴的工人在乡间公路上。头戴黄色安全帽、脚穿红色硬靴的工人正在新浇筑混凝土的池塘上作业。

text: The worker next to the red dump truck is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 该工人正驶向红色自卸卡车，未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: The worker next to the red dump truck
err.zh: 该工人正驶向红色自卸卡车

text: A worker in the upper left is not wearing a hard hat and a person on the right wearing a red hard hat is wearing a slipper.
zh: 左上方的一名工人未佩戴安全帽，右侧一名人员佩戴红色安全帽，并佩戴测电仪。

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats are standing in the middle of the image. A drum roller is next to them.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在画面中央。一台压路机位于他们前方。

text: Two excavators are at a construction site. There are some concrete pipes on the right of the image.
zh: 两名挖掘机手正在建筑工地上作业。图像右侧有一些混凝土管道。

text: There is a drum roller and a dump truck in the middle of the image. On the left, there are two tower cranes and a mobile crane. Several piles of dimensional lumber and wood boards are near the cranes. In the background, there is an unfinished building surrounded by yellow scaffolding. There are at least eight workers with yellow, blue, or red hard hats working on the scaffold in the front side of the building. In the upper right of the image, there is a person inside the opening.
zh: 画面中央有一台卷扬机和一辆泵车。左侧有两台塔式起重机和一台移动式起重机。起重机附近堆放着几堆规格木材和木板。背景中有一栋已完工的大楼，周围环绕着黄色脚手架。画面右侧建筑正面脚手架上至少有八名头戴黄色、蓝色或红色安全帽的工人正在作业。画面右上方有一人位于敞口内。

One worker with a yellow hard hat is standing on the scaffolding while two other workers with red or yellow hard hats are on the rooftop. There are at least six tower cranes in the background.

text: The image shows a muddy construction site. Four people are in the foreground of the image. Three of them were wearing hard hats. The person in the middle does not have any PPE and is wearing a pair of slippers. In the background on the left, there are two people, several cars and two excavators.
zh: 图片显示一个泥泞的施工现场。前景中有四个人。其中三个人戴着安全帽。中间那个人没有佩戴任何个人防护装备，戴着一双溜冰鞋。背景左侧有两个人、几辆车和两台挖掘机。

text: Eight workers with yellow or red hard hats, some of them with orange jackets, are working at a canal with both sides fenced by concrete short walls and rebars. On the left, some gabions are on top of the hill.
zh: 八名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人，其中一些人身穿橙色工作服，正在一道两侧由混凝土矮墙和栏杆围护的运河边作业。左侧，一些山羊狮位于山丘顶部。

On the left of the background, there is a excavator, and at least five workers. On the right, the is a embankment, there are three workers on top of the embankment fenced by metal tubes and blue fabric.
zh: 前景中有七名工人。有一些金属管、一堆钢筋以及两堆方木。一台锯子放在一张桌子上。背景左侧有一台挖掘机，并且至少有五名工人。右侧有一台起重机，起重机顶部有三名工人，由金属管和蓝色布料围住。

err.en: three workers on top of the embankment
err.zh: 起重机顶部有三名工人

zh: 九名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人位于基坑内。基坑内已完工的结构具有混凝土侧墙和钢筋网基础。四名工人站在混凝土侧墙顶部。在顶部埋设处，至少有一堆木质模板。其他一些建筑材料覆盖着蓝色或条纹布料。

text: One worker in the middle is on the concrete slab of an unfinished tunnel structure. Two workers on the right are working with the rebar walls and formworks. One worker on the left is standing on the bank next to a pile of rebars.
zh: 一名工人位于已完工隧道结构的的中部的混凝土板上。右侧的两名为工人正在与钢筋墙及模板作业。左侧一名工人正站在钢筋堆旁。

text: Five workers with hard hats are working on a steel frame structure. Two workers are standing next to the exterior wall of the structure with a stack of metal tubes next to them. One worker is on the first floor while two other workers are on the second and third floor respectively. The arm of an excavator can be seen.
zh: 五名头戴安全帽的工人正在一个钢架结构上作业。两名工人站在结构内部墙边，旁边堆放着一堆金属管。一名工人位于首层，另外两名工人分别位于第二层和第三层。一台挖掘机的的手臂可见。

text: Four excavators are working at a muddy construction site. In the background, there is a dump truck, a light truck and a person.
zh: 四名挖掘机手正在一处泥泞地施工现场作业。背景中有一辆自卸卡车、一辆轻型卡车和一名人员。

text: Eleven workers are there at a construction site. Five workers are working on a concrete structure on the right of the image. The concrete structure is in a trench with metal tubes on both sides. On the left, there is a pile of metal tubes in the foreground. There are also some concrete pipes and a stack of dimensional lumber.
zh: 施工现场有七名工人。五名工人在图像右侧的一处混凝土结构上作业。该混凝土结构位于一条沟槽内，两侧均设有金属管。左侧前景处有一堆金属管。此外，现场还有一些混凝土管以及一堆方木。

text: A drum roller is in the middle of the image. On the right, two workers are on top of an unfinished structure. On the right of the background, there is a tall unfinished structrue covered by green fabric and a tower crane is next to it. On the left, the boom of an mobile crane is behind the pile of dirt.
zh: 画面中央是一台卷扬机。右侧，两名工人位于一栋已完工建筑的之上。右侧背景中，有一栋已完工的高大建筑，被绿色织物覆盖，其旁是一台塔式起重机。左侧，一台移动式起重机的位于土堆后方。

text: Four workers with safety vests are at a construction site where the ground is covered by rebar meshes and rebar cages. On the left, the base of a tower crane can be seen. There are two stacks of rebars next to the tower crane. On the right, there are two piles of rebars and a pile of metal tubes near the two workers.
zh: 四名穿着安全背心的的工人位于一处建筑工地，该工地的地面被钢筋网和钢筋笼覆盖。在左侧，可以看到一台塔式起重机的器的。在塔式起重机器旁边有两堆钢筋。在右侧，有两堆钢筋和一堆金属管靠近那两名工人。

err.en: the base of a tower crane can be seen
err.zh: 可以看到一台塔式起重机的器的

text: Workers on the right are wearing shorts and slippers.
zh: 右侧的工人穿着短裤和护目镜。

text: Ten workers are working on an unfinished structure whose base is rebar mesh and has two rebar walls in the middle dividing the structure into three sections. In the bottom right of the image, there is a formwork at the edge of the rebar mesh.
zh: 十名工人正在施工于一座基础为钢筋网架的建筑，该建筑中部设有两道钢筋墙，将结构划分为三个区段。在图像右下方，钢筋网架边缘处有一台施工机械。

text: Ttwo workers with long rubber boots are standing on top of a rebar mesh. The third worker is standing on the concrete surface next to the mesh.
zh: 两名穿着长胶靴的工人站在钢筋网架上。第三名名工人站在紧邻钢筋网架的混凝土表面上。

text: Three excavators are digging dirt piles. An excavator bucket is on the right of the image.
zh: 三台挖掘机正在挖掘土堆。一台挖掘机位于图像的右侧。

text: A worker in the foreground is holding a tube and standing on top of a rebar cage sandwiched by formworks. The formwork is supported by metal scaffolds. Another worker with a yellow hard hat is pouring concrete into the rebar cage with the concrete hose. A concrete pump truck on the right is pumping concrete with its outriggers deployed. A person is standing next to the concrete pump truck. On the right, a concrete truck is dumping concrete into the pump truck.
zh: 前景中一名工人手持一根管子，站在由脚手架支撑的钢筋笼上方。脚手架由金属折叠件支撑。另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正通过混凝土软管向钢筋笼内浇筑混凝土。右侧一辆混凝土泵车正通过其已展开的出料口泵送混凝土。混凝土泵车旁站着一人。右侧，一辆混凝土卡车正向泵车内泵送混凝土。

text: A concrete platform is in the middle of the image. There are two openings on the concrete platform. In the foreground, there is a rusty metal scaffolding. On the right, there is a platform with some machines and a distribution kiosk with a steel column as the foundation. On the left, two workers are on the concrete road while a worker with a blue hard hat is behind a pile of dirt. There is a pile of metal tubes in front of the worker with a red hard hat. In the background, there is a truck and a pick-up truck.
zh: 画面中央是一处混凝土平台，平台上设有两个开口。前景处有一副生锈迹斑斑的金属脚手架。右侧是一处平台，上面放置着一些机器，并设有一个以钢柱为基的分配站。左侧有两名工人正站在混凝土路面上，其中一名戴着蓝色安全帽的工人正位于一堆泥土堆后方。在戴红色安全帽的工人前方，有一堆金属管。背景中有一辆卡车和一辆自卸卡车。

text: A concrete truck is in the middle of the image. On the right, there are some concrete pipes and a concrete pump truck. The pump truck has its arms extended and outriggers deployed. A worker with a yellow hard hat is on the right of the concrete pump truck. On the left, there are about eight piles of dimensional lumber. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 一辆混凝土卡车位于画面中央。右侧有一些混凝土管道和一辆混凝土泵车。泵车配备了伸展臂和出料斗。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于混凝土泵车右侧。左侧大约有八堆尺寸木材。背景中有两座塔式起重机。

text: A concrete pump truck is in the middle of the image with its arm extended and outriggers deployed. A person is standing to the left of the pump truck with a stack of wood board to his left. A tower crane is in the background.
zh: 一辆混凝土泵车停在画面中央，其吊臂和触发器已部署。一个人站在泵车左侧，他的左侧有一堆木板。背景中有一台塔式起重机。

text: A concrete pump truck is on the left of the image. There are also five concrete pipes, three black pipes, and some wood boards and wood boards. A bulldozer is on the right of the image. On the right of the image, there are also piles of wood boards and about ten stacks of dimensional lumber. In the background, there is a mobile crane with rebars surrounding it.
zh: 图像左侧有一辆混凝土泵车。此外还有五根混凝土管道、三根黑色管道以及一些木板和木板。图像右侧有一台推土机。图像右侧还有堆木板和大约十堆尺寸木材。背景中有一台带吊杆的移动起重机。

text: The two workers on the formworks and another worker on the earthen road in the background are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 两名工人在Form沃克和另一名工人在厄尔顿路上，背景中均未佩戴安全帽。

text: Three workers are standing on top of the stone wall sandwiched by formworks on two sides. The formwork is supported by metal scaffolds. Two workers are standing on the concrete stairs next to the formwork. Another worker is standing on an embankment on the right. A white concrete pump truck is pumping concrete to the stone wall with a hose.
zh: 三名工人站在石墙顶部，该墙由两名工人支撑。该墙由金属折叠件支撑。两名工人站在混凝土台阶上，位于该墙的另一侧。另一名工人站在右侧的一个凸缘上。一辆白色混凝土泵车正通过一根软管向石墙泵送混凝土。

err.en: sandwiched by formworks on two sides

text: A bulldozer is in the middle of the image. On the left, a person is squatting.
zh: 一台推土机位于画面中央。左侧，一个人正在做深蹲。

text: A construction site with a concrete base covered by rebar mesh. Two workers are at the bottom of the concrete base. There are also ten other workers at the construction site. In the middle of the structure, there are two piles of rebars. Some soil nearby is covered by green fabric. In the bottom right corner, there is the base of a tower crane fenced by yellow fences.
zh: 一处建筑工地，其混凝土基础被钢筋网覆盖。混凝土基础底部有两名工人。该建筑工地还有另外十名工人。结构中部有两堆螺纹钢。附近的一些土壤被绿色织物覆盖。右下角处有一台塔式起重机，被黄色围栏栅围护。

err.en: there is the base of a tower crane fence
err.zh: 有一台塔式起重机，被黄色围栏栅围护

text: A concrete pump truck is in the middle of the image with its arm extended and outriggers deployed. An excavator is on the left. A pile of rebars are on the right.
zh: 一辆混凝土泵车位于画面中央，其吊臂已展开，出料斗已部署。一台挖掘机位于左侧。一堆钢筋棒位于右侧。

text: Nine workers are at a construction site with wooded cases on the ground. In the foreground, there are two piles of rebar rings. On the left, there is a pile of straight rebar. On the left, there is also a stack of dimensional lumber in the background.
zh: 九名工人位于一处地面有树木的施工现场。前景处有两堆钢筋环。左侧有一堆直钢筋。左侧背景处还有一堆方木。

text: There are two piles of orange pipes in the foreground of the image. On the right, there is a drum roller and a bulldozer. On the left, an excavator is lifting a stack of orange pipes. There are also two pile drivers. In the background, there are six tower cranes.
zh: 前景中有两堆橙色管道。右侧有一台鼓式压路机和一台推土机。左侧有一台挖掘机正在吊起一堆橙色管道。此外还有两台压路机。背景中有六座塔式起重机。

text: 13 workers are working on a scaffold. There are two piles of dimensional lumber on top of the scaffold. In the lower left of the image, there are two piles of metal tubes. On the left of the backgrond, there is an unfinished concrete building. On the right of the background, there are multiple piles of construction material.
zh: 13名工人在脚手架上作业。脚手架顶部有两堆方木。在图像的左下方，有两堆金属管。在左后方的地面上，有一栋已完工的具体建筑。在右侧背景中，有多堆建筑材料。

text: On the left, there is a drum roller and a bulldozer. In the middle, there is a bulldozer near a lot of orange pipes. There is another drum roller partially occluded by the orange pipes. An excavator is lifting a stack of orange pipes. On the left, a dump truck is in the foreground. The driver of the truck is passing something to a person next to the truck. In the background, there is a crawler crane.
zh: 左侧有一台鼓轮机和一台推土机。中间有一台推土机靠近许多橙色管道。另一台鼓轮机部分被橙色管遮挡。一台挖掘机正吊起一堆橙色管。左侧前景处有一辆泵车。卡车司机正经过一个人，随后是卡车。背景中有一台履带起重机。

err.en: The driver of the truck is passing somet
err.zh: 卡车司机正经过一个人，随后是卡车。

text: The worker in front of the white dump truck on the right is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 右侧白色自卸卡车前的部的的那名工人未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: The worker in front of the white dump tr
err.zh: 右侧白色自卸卡车前的部的的那名工人

text: A grader, two excavators, and a loader are working at a construction site. Two people are on the right of the image.
zh: 工长、两名挖掘机操作员和一名装载机操作员正在一处建筑工地作业。图片右侧有两个人。

err.en: A grader, two excavators, and a loader
err.zh: 工长、两名挖掘机操作员和一名装载机操作员

text: Two excavators are in the middle of the image. A worker with a red hard hat is in the lower left of the image.
zh: 图像中央有两名挖掘机。图像左下方有一名戴着红色安全帽的工人。

text: An excavator is in the middle of the image. A worker with a hard hat and an umbrella is next to the excavator. There are three stacks of rebars on the ground. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 画面中央有一台挖掘机。一名头戴安全帽、手持雨伞的工人正走向挖掘机。地面上有三堆钢筋。背景中有两座塔吊。

text: The boom of a pile driver. The soil are covered with green fabric.
zh: 司机的一堆。土壤覆盖着绿色织物。

err.en: The boom of a pile driver.

text: Five workers are at the construction site. The structure under construction consists of brick walls and rebar cages.In the background, there are two excavators, a truck, a pile driver, and two tower cranes.
zh: 五名工人正在施工现场。在建结构由砖墙和钢筋笼组成。背景中，有两台挖掘机、一辆卡车、一名司机和两台塔式起重机。

text: Three workers with white hard hats are in an excavation pit. On the left, there is an unfinished structure covered with green fabric.
zh: 三名头戴白色安全帽的工人位于一个基坑内。左侧有一处结构已完工，覆盖着绿色织物。

text: On the left, a worker with a yellow hard hat is walking next to a row of sandbags. On the left, two excavators are digging. On the left of the image, near the left bank of the trench, there is a worker with a yellow hard hat.
zh: 左侧，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正走向一排沙袋。左侧，两名挖掘机手正在挖掘。图像左侧，靠近沟渠的左岸，有一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。

err.zh: 两名挖掘机手正在挖掘

text: Eleven workers with hard hats at on top of a rebar mesh structure on the roof of a tall building. The boom of a mobile crane is on the left.
zh: 七名头戴安全帽的工人站在高层建筑屋顶的钢筋网上方格网架上。移动起重机的位于左侧。

err.en: The boom of a mobile crane is on the lef
err.zh: 移动起重机的位于左侧。

text: The embankment in the middle of the image does not have edge protection.
zh: 图像中部的没有边缘保护。

err.en: The embankment in the middle of the imag

text: A concrete truck and a dump truck are in the middle of the image. On the left, there is a group of five workers standing at the edge of the concrete platform. There is a crane on the left of the trucks and workers.
zh: 一辆混凝土卡车和一辆泵车位于画面中央。左侧有一组五名工人站在混凝土平台边缘。在卡车和工人左侧有一台起重机。

text: An excavator is digging on the embankment. A loader is in the canal.
zh: 挖掘机正在基坑上作业。装载机在运河里。

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats are working in the trench with platforms on both sides. The surface of the sloped walls is covered with rebar mesh. The concrete wall in the lower right of the image is supported by metal scaffolds. In the background, there is a construction site with unfinished piers and platforms. On the left of the image near a pier, there is a pile of dimensional lumber. There are three green dump trucks in the upper portion of the image.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在沟槽内作业，两侧均设有平台。倾斜墙体表面覆盖着钢筋网。图像右下方的混凝土墙由金属脚手架支撑。背景中可见一处已完工的地基墩及平台。图像左侧靠近墩柱处堆放着一堆规格木材。图像上部停着三辆绿色自卸卡车。

text: A messy construction site filled with scaffolds on the right and rebar structures on the left. There are multiple piles of lumber on the ground between the two structures. On the right of the image, there are two workers with red or yellow hard hats standing on the scaffold. There are three stacks of wooden boards beside them. There is also a tower crane next to them. Some piles of dimensional lumber are next to the tower crane. There are three stacks of dimensional lumber on the floor above them. There is an excavator on the hill next to the construction site. On the left of the image, there are several more piles of dimensional lumber and three more workers with yellow or red hard hats. Two additional tower cranes can be seen.
zh: 右侧为搭建脚手架的杂乱施工现场，左侧为重新搭建的结构。地面两结构之间有多堆木材。图像右侧有两名戴红色或黄色安全帽的工人站在脚手架上。他们旁边有三堆木板。他们旁边还有一台塔式起重机。一些尺寸木材堆在塔式起重机旁边。他们上方有三堆尺寸木材。施工地点旁边有一台挖掘机在山上。图像左侧有更多堆尺寸木材和另外三名戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人。可以看到另外两台塔式起重机。

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are in the middle of the image. A pile driver is in the middle of the image. To the right of the pile driver, there are three more workers with safety vests. The soil at the site is covered with blue fabric.
zh: 画面中央有两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人。画面中央有一堆司机。在司机堆的右侧，还有三名身穿安全背心的的工人。工地的泥土被蓝色布料覆盖。

err.en: A pile driver is in the middle of the im

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats and orange coveralls are working next to a confined tunnel under construction.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿橙色防护服的工人正在狭窄隧道内施工。

text: Two mobile cranes, a white one and a yellow one, are next to a steel frame structure. There are some steel beams on the ground next to the structure.
zh: 两台移动起重机、一台白色起重机和一台黄色起重机，正吊向一个钢架结构。地面上有一些钢梁，正吊向该结构。

err.en: are next to a steel frame structure
There are some steel beams on the ground
err.zh: 地面上有一些钢梁，正吊向该结构

text: Six workers with hard hats are standing on top of a rebar cage enclosed by formworks. A worker on the left is pouring concrete into the rebar cage with the concrete hose. In the background, there is a concrete pump truck with outriggers deployed.
zh: 六名头戴安全帽的工人站在钢筋笼顶部，由脚手架围护。左侧的一名工人正通过混凝土软管向钢筋笼内浇筑混凝土。背景中停放着一辆混凝土泵车，其卸料斗已展开。

text: Three concrete trucks are on a road next to a wall on the left. Two tower cranes can be seen in the image.
zh: 三辆混凝土卡车正行驶在一条道路上，前方左侧有一堵墙。图像中可以看到两座塔楼。

text: Two excavators are in the image next to a pond. In the background, there is at least one tower crane visible.
zh: 画面中有两名挖掘机正驶向一片池塘。背景中至少有一台塔式起重机可见。

text: One worker with a yellow hard hat is in the foreground standing on top of a rebar cage enclosed by formworks. A black pipe connects to the rebar cage in the foreground. The formworks are supported by metal scaffolds. In the background, there are four more workers on another platform.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在由脚手架围成的钢筋笼顶部。一根黑色管道连接至前景中的钢筋笼。脚手架由金属折叠件支撑。背景中，在另一平台上还有四名工人。

err.en: The formworks are supported by metal sca
err.zh: 脚手架由金属折叠件支撑

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are standing or sitting on scaffolds next to a rebar cage. There is a tower crane and a river in the background.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正站在或坐在脚手架上，旁边是一台塔式起重机，背景中有一条河流。

text: In the foreground, there are two tower cranes. One of them is in the middle left while the other one is in the upper right corner. In the background, there are two more tower cranes.
zh: 前景中有两座塔楼。其中一座位于中左侧，另一座位于右上角上方。背景中还有另外两座塔楼。

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats are in the excavation pit next to the bank. They are in front of a rebar wall. A stack of straight rebars is leaning on the slope. On top of the bank, there is another pile of rebars. On the left, there is a row of board piles.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在挖掘坑，朝银行方向前进。他们位于一道重墙的前。一堆直条钢筋斜靠在斜坡上。在银行顶部，还有另一堆钢筋。在左侧，有一排板堆。

text: Eleven workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are at a construction site filled with rebar meshes. At the toe of the embankment, there is a pile of wooden boards, two piles of rebars, and some cylinders leaning on the slope.
zh: 七名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在一处堆满钢筋网的片的材的施工现场进行作业。在基坑底部，有一堆木板、两堆钢筋以及一些斜靠在坡面上的倾斜放置的圆柱体。

err.en: construction site filled with rebar mesh
At the toe of the embankment

text: Two workers are at a building under construction. The base of the building is supported by metal scaffolds. On the left of the image, a tower crane is visible.
zh: 两名工人正在一栋在建建筑下方作业。该建筑的基础由金属折叠件支撑。在图像左侧，可见一台塔式起重机。

text: Six workers are at a construction site. Two of them are hidden behind wooden boards on top of a concrete roof. In the middle of the image, there is a rebar structure. In the lower right of the image, there are four bundles of rebars in the image. On the left of the structure, there is a row of board piles. In the background, there are two tower cranes near two unfinished structures on the right and another tower crane on the left.
zh: 六名工人位于一处建筑工地。其中两人隐藏在混凝土屋顶上方的的一块木板后面。图像中部有一台塔式起重机。图像右下方有四组钢筋。图像左侧有一排板材堆。背景中有两台塔式起重机，一台位于右侧，另一台位于左侧。

err.en: Two of them are hidden behind wooden boa
err.zh: 其中两人隐藏在混凝土屋顶上方的的一块木板后面

err.en: two tower cranes near two unfinished str
err.zh: 两台塔式起重机，一台位于右侧，另一台位于左侧

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats are working at a construction site with a rebar mesh base on the ground and another rebar mesh as the side wall. at the far end, there are two excavators, one of them is yellow and one of them is orange.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一处施工现场作业，该工地地面设有钢筋网基础，另一处钢筋网基础作为侧墙。在远端，有两名挖掘机，其中一台为黄色，另一台为橙色。

text: Four excavators are in the middle of the image.
zh: 图像中央有四名挖掘机。

text: Three blue trucks are three workers with yellow hard hats are in the image. The site is full of randomly placed metal tubes and dimensional lumber.
zh: 三辆蓝色卡车，三名戴着黄色安全帽的工人在图像中。该场地堆满了随机摆放放的金属管材和尺寸木材。

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats are in the image near a hill. There are four wells with concrete walls in the middle of the image.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于图像中的山丘附近。图像中央有四个带混凝土墙的体的。

err.en: There are four wells with concrete walls
err.zh: 图像中央有四个带混凝土墙的体的。

text: On the left of the image, there is a white hut. A worker is next to the white hut in front of a steel frame structure. On the right, there are three workers with red hard hats.
zh: 图像左侧有一间白色小屋。一名工人正走向白色小屋前方的一副钢架结构。右侧有三名戴着红色安全帽的工人。

err.en: A worker is next to the white hut in fro
err.zh: 一名工人正走向白色小屋前方的一副钢架结构。

text: Three excavators are working at a muddy construction site.
zh: 三名挖掘机手正在一处泥泞地施工现场作业。

text: In the foreground, there is a fence consisting of tubes and green fabric. A worker with a white hard hat is on the left of the image. In the lower right of the image, there is an excavator. In the background, a concrete pump truck is pouring concrete into an unfinished structure. There are a group of more than ten workers at the site. On the right of the image, a worker with a white hard hat and red jacket is walking next to two piles of construction material.
zh: 前景中有一道由管材和绿色织物组成的围栏。一名戴白色安全帽的工人位于画面左侧。画面右下方有一台挖掘机。背景中一辆混凝土泵车正在向一栋已完工建筑浇筑混凝土。现场有十余名工人。画面右侧一名戴白色安全帽、穿红色夹克的工人正走向两堆建筑材料。

text: A structure under construction is surrounded by metal tubes and green fabric. At the bottom of the image, there are around 14 stacks of rebars and stirrups of different sizes. There is also a pile of dimensional lumber. In the middle of the image, four workers are next to about 10 stacks of rebars and one pile of wooden boards. On the left, two workers are making a rebar cage in front of three piles of dimensional lumber. On the top of the image, there is a tower crane, three workers, six more piles of rebars and two more piles of lumber.
zh: 在建构筑物周围环绕着金属管材和绿色织物。在图像底部，大约有14堆钢筋和不同尺寸的的石料。还有一堆方木。在图像中部，四名工人正走向大约10堆钢筋和一堆木板。在左侧，两名工人正在制作钢筋笼，位于三堆方木的前。在图像顶部，有一台塔式起重机、三名工人、六堆钢筋和两堆方木。

text: A worker with a white hard hat is in the middle of the image. An excavator is also in the middle of the image occluding a roller.
zh: 画面中央有一名头戴白色安全帽的工人。画面中央还有一台挖掘机，带滚筒。

text: The unfinished structure is a tunnel with rebar mesh as the base and walls. A worker with a yellow hard hat is washing the site with a water hose. In the foreground, there is a fence consists of metal tubes and green fabric. A pile of straight rebars, a pile of steel boards, and a pile of stirrups are on the ground. In the background, there is a row of board piles.
zh: 未完工地结构为隧道，以钢筋网作为基础和墙体。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在冲洗现场的水带。前景处有一道由金属管和绿色织物组成的围栏。地面上堆放着一堆直条钢筋、一堆钢板板以及一堆搅拌棒。背景处有一排板堆。

text: A pick-up truck and a light truck are in a yard surrounded by bungalows. In the background, there is an entrance of a tunnel and a bridge under construction.
zh: 一辆皮卡卡车和一辆轻型卡车停在一处院落里，周围是灌木丛。背景中有一个隧道入口和一座正在施工中的桥梁。

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats and yellow safety vests are at a workshop to process rebars. There are some rebars on a scaffold and some rebars on the ground. In the background, two tower cranes are visible.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人正在车间内操作设备。部分设备位于脚手架子上，部分设备位于地面上。背景中可见两台塔式起重机。

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats are next to a rebar mesh structure. In the lower part of the image, there are about ten more piles of rebars of different sizes and shapes.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正走向一张钢筋网架。在图像的下部，大约有十多堆不同尺寸和形状的的重条。

text: Five workers with yellow, white, or blue hard hats are at a construction site. On the left, there are three piles of dimensional lumber and wood boards, and three piles of rebars. In the bottom right corner, there are two hoppers, three stack of wooden boards and three piles of dimensional lumber.
zh: 五名头戴黄色、白色或蓝色安全帽的工人位于建筑工地现场。左侧有三堆方木和木板，以及三堆钢筋。右下角有两顶安全帽、三摞木板和三堆方木。

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats and red jackets are working on an unfinished canal with a rebar mesh as a base and two rebar side walls. In the background, there is a wall made of blue metal boards.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人正在一座已完工的运河上作业，该运河以钢筋网架为基础，并设有两道钢筋侧墙。背景中有一面由蓝色金属板制成的墙体。

text: An excavator is shoveling rocks on top of a pile of rocks. A person is in the background.
zh: 挖掘机位于一堆岩石的顶部。一个人位于背景中。

err.en: An excavator is shoveling rocks on top o
err.zh: 挖掘机位于一堆岩石的顶部。

text: Six workers with yellow or red hard hats are tying rebars in the foreground. A pile of rebar is in the middle of the image. In the background, there is a fence made with yellow tubes and green fabric. Around four workers are in the background. A tower crane can be seen in the background. Two piles of construction material are placed near the tower crane.
zh: 前景中有六名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人正在绑扎钢筋。画面中间有一堆钢筋。背景中有一道由黄色管材和绿色布料制成的的人行。背景中还有四名工人。背景中可以看到一台塔式起重机。塔式起重机附近放置着两堆建筑材料。

err.en: a fence made with yellow tubes and green
err.zh: 由黄色管材和绿色布料制成的的人行

text: Five workers are standing on the scaffold next to a conveyor belt. The factor has some steel frames on the left and two elevated storage tanks on the right.
zh: 五名工人站在脚手架上，旁边是一条传送带。该因素左侧有一些钢架，右侧有两个高架式储液罐。

text: Five workers are at a structure full of rebar cages and scaffolds. There is a pile of dirt and some board piles in front of the structure. In the background, there are two workers squatting in front of the blue metal board wall.
zh: 五名工人正忙于搭建笼子和折叠结构。前方有一堆泥土和一些板材堆。背景中，有两名工人蹲在蓝色金属板墙前。

text: Four workers are on a rocky hill. Three of them are standing on the scaffold with two trolleys. They are loading the trolleys with rocks. In the foreground, there is wooden slide.
zh: 四名工人位于一座岩石山丘上。其中三人站在脚手架上，与两名矿工在一起。他们正用岩石装载矿工。在前景中，有一个木制滑梯道。

text: Two workers are working on a tunnel structure. The structure has rebar walls on two sides. There is a concrete wall in the middle sandwiched by formworks.
zh: 两名工人正在隧道结构内作业。该结构具有两侧钢筋墙。中间有一混凝土墙，由施工方浇筑而成。

text: A grader, a bulldozer, a drum roller and two workers are on a mountain road.
zh: 一台装载机、一台推土机、一台压路机和两名工人在一条山路上。

text: Five workers with red or yellow hard hats are walking on a earthen ramp. at the far end, there is an erected pile driver. Some soil at the site is covered by blue fabric.
zh: 五名头戴红色或黄色安全帽的工人正行走在一条土质路坡上。在坡的远端，有一处竖立的司机堆。现场部分土壤被蓝色织物覆盖。

text: A concrete truck and a concrete pump truck are pumping concrete with the help of some workers. There are six workers near at the construction site. There is an excavator near the two trucks, and another excavator in the background.
zh: 一辆混凝土搅拌车和一辆混凝土泵车正在一些工人的的帮助下浇筑混凝土。施工现场附近有六名工人。两辆挖掘机附近有一台挖掘机，背景中还有另一台挖掘机。

text: Three workers are at a muddy site. The worker with a yellow hard hat is holding a grade rod while the worker with a red hard hat is holding a wooden board.
zh: 三名工人位于一处泥泞地工地。戴黄色安全帽的工人手持一根钢筋，戴红色安全帽的工人手持一块木板。

text: A car is in the foreground of the image. There is a drum roller, a bulldozer, an excavator, a crawler crane, an excavator, and a water truck visible at the construction site. There is a pile of black pipes and a pile of orange pipes on the right. A worker is walking on the right. In the background, there is a tower crane.
zh: 前景中有一辆汽车。施工现场可见一台鼓式破碎机、一台推土机、一台挖掘机、一台履带起重机、一台挖掘机以及一辆水车。右侧有一堆黑色管道和一堆橙色管道。右侧有一名工人正在行走。背景中有一台塔式起重机。

text: On the left, a worker with a red hard hat is holding a shovel while a trolley is next to him. On the right, there is a loader and two workers. In the background, there are several workers.
zh: 左侧，一名头戴红色安全帽的工人手持铁锹，一辆手推车正朝他驶来。右侧，有一台装载机及两名工人。背景中，还有几名工人。

err.en: a trolley is next to him
err.zh: 一辆手推车正朝他驶来

text: A dump truck with its dump box lifted. On the left, there is a pile of dimensional lumber and a pile of metal tubes in the lower left.
zh: 一辆带泵箱的自卸卡车被抬起。左侧有一堆方木料和一堆金属管。

text: Two workers are in front of the unfinished section of a tunnel. The outline of the unfinished structure is created by scaffolds and rebars. In the background, there is the finished portion of the concrete tunnel. On the embankment, there is a drum roller and a worker with a red hard hat. In the background, there are at least three tower cranes.
zh: 两名工人位于隧道已完工段的前方。已完工段的的结构由脚手架和横杆构成。背景中是混凝土隧道的已完工部分。在嵌件上有一台鼓式滚轮和一名戴红色安全帽的工人。背景中至少有三个塔式起重机。

text: 15 workers with yellow or red hard hats and yellow safety vests are in an excavation pit. The unfinished structure in the pit has a concrete base covered with rebar meshes. In the upper right of the image, the is a stack of bricks.
zh: 15名头戴黄色或红色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人位于一个基坑内。基坑内的已完工的结构具有混凝土基础，并覆盖有钢筋网。在图像的右上方，有一堆砖块。

text: A yellow excavator is digging while an orange pile driver on the right is driving a board pile into the ground. A worker with a yellow hard hat is in the excavation pit.
zh: 黄色挖掘机正在挖掘，右侧橙色堆土司机正将一块板桩打入地面。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于基坑内。

text: In the foreground, there are multiple piles of wooden boards and dimensional lumber. On the left, there are several piles of lumber and metal tubes. There are two unfinished structrues surrounded by scaffolds made of metal tubes. Two tower cranes and two mobile cranes can be seen in the image.
zh: 前景中有多堆木板和规格木材。左侧有几堆木材和金属管。有两个已完工的结构，周围是由金属管搭建而成的。图像中可以看到两台塔吊和两台移动吊。

text: Ten workers with yellow hard hats and yellow safety vests are at a construction site. One worker at the top level of the rebar structure is helping stabilize the rebars lifted by a piece of rigging equipment. To the left of the site, some cylinders are leaning on the slope.
zh: 十名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人位于一处建筑工地。一名工人位于顶部水平的结构，有助于稳定由起重设备吊起的的重物。在工地左侧，一些圆柱体倾斜在斜坡上。

err.en: top level of the rebar structure

text: On the left of the image, a concrete hose is hanging from above. On the right, four workers with hard hats are on top of the wooden scaffold. This is an unfinished tunnel structure.
zh: 图像左侧，一根混凝土软管悬挂在上方。右侧，四名头戴安全帽的工人位于木质脚手架顶部。这是一个已完工的结构。

text: The image shows a concrete building under construction. The exterior of the building has multiple scaffolds. Two workers are on the second floor of the building. On the left, a worker with a hard hat is on the ground. Several piles of yellow metal tubes can be seen on the ground. On the roof, there are some pipes and rebars.
zh: 图中显示一栋正在施工中的混凝土建筑。建筑内部有多处脚手架。二层楼上有两名工人。左侧，一名头戴安全帽的工人站在地面上。地面上可以看到几堆黄色金属管。屋顶上有一些管道和钢筋。

text: A concrete pump truck has its arm extended and outriggers deployed. Three workers are on the ground next to the pump truck. In the background, there is a tower crane. On the left, there are four piles of wooden boards. On the right, there are also about four piles of wooden boards.
zh: 混凝土泵车已展开其臂架并部署了外触发器。三名工人正位于泵车的地面上。在背景中，有一台塔式起重机。在左侧，有四堆木板。在右侧，也有大约四堆木板。

text: The edge of the excavation trench is not fenced.
zh: 开挖沟槽的边坡未设置挡土墙。

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats and red jackets are next to a building with a scaffold fenced with blue fences. Three of them are standing on the red staircase while the other one is next to the staircase.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人正走向一栋搭有蓝色护栏脚手架的建筑。其中三人站在红色楼梯上，另一人正走向楼梯。

text: Five workers with yellow or red hard hats are working on an unfinished structure. The worker with a purple shirt is pushing a trolley with a bucket full of bricks. The worker in the middle is standing on top of a scaffold laying bricks. On the left, a worker with a red hard hat is standing on top of a scaffold laying bricks. Another worker is passing bricks to him.
zh: 五名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人正在一栋已完工的结构上作业。穿紫色上衣的工人正在推一辆装满砖块的的手推车。中间的工人正站在脚手架顶部砌砖。左侧一名头戴红色安全帽的工人正站在脚手架顶部砌砖。另一名工人正在向他递送砖块。

text: Two people are on top of a hill of rocks. A person is spraying water on the rocks in the bucket of the loader with a water hose.
zh: 两人位于岩石山顶。一人正用软管向桶内岩石喷水。

err.en: in the bucket of the loader

text: Seven workers with yellow or red hard hats are in an excavation pit. The ground of the pit is covered with rebar meshes. On the embankment, there is a concrete truck and a concrete pump truck. The pump truck is pumping concrete to the construction site with a hose. Two workers are help the hose pouring concrete next to the wooden formwork.
zh: 七名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人位于一个基坑内。基坑底部用钢筋网覆盖。在基坑内，有一辆混凝土搅拌车和一辆混凝土泵车。泵车通过软管向施工现场泵送混凝土。两名工人协助将软管中的混凝土浇筑到木模板中。

err.en: pouring concrete next to the wooden form

text: At the top of the image, three workers are on top of the rebar cage. Three other workers are on the ground. All of them have hard hats. There are a lot of piles of rebars of different shapes and sizes on the ground across the site. Two mobile cranes are in the lower part of the image.
zh: 图像顶部有三名工人站在钢筋笼上方。另外三名工人站在地面上。他们所有人都戴着安全帽。地面上散落着许多不同形状和尺寸的的重物的堆。图像下半部分有两台移动起重机。

text: Two excavators are digging on top of dirt piles.
zh: 两名挖掘机手正在土堆顶部进行挖掘作业。

text: A concrete hose is hanging from above. On the right of the image, there is a tunnel structure under construction. A worker with a yellow hard hat is in the excavation pit near tunnel while two other workers with yellow hard hats are on top of the tunnel. On the embankment, a worker with a yellow hard hat is standing next to a concrete pump truck with its outriggers deployed.
zh: 一根混凝土输送管悬挂于上方。图像右侧，施工隧道下方。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于隧道附近的基坑内，另外两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于隧道顶部。在浇筑作业面上，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站立在一辆混凝土泵车旁，其出料口已展开。

err.en: there is a tunnel structure under constr

text: The edge of the excavation on the right is not fenced.
zh: 右侧开挖边坡未设挡土墙。

text: A concrete pump truck has its red arm extended and outriggers deployed. Three workers are on the ground next to the pump truck. In the background, there is a tower crane. On the left, there are four piles of wooden boards. On the right, there are also about five piles of wooden boards.
zh: 混凝土泵车伸出红色吊臂，并部署了外触发器。三名工人位于泵车的地面上。背景中有一台塔式起重机。左侧有四堆木板。右侧也有大约五堆木板。

err.en: on the ground next to the pump truck

text: The construction site of a tunnel structure. Ten workers are in the foreground of the image. Seven of them are on top of the rebar cage. Two of them are inside the scaffold structure. The last one is on the embankment on the right. There are about eight piles of rebars on the embankment. On the left, there is a pile of lumber. In the background, there are at least six more workers.
zh: 隧道施工现场。前景中有十名工人。其中七名位于钢筋笼顶部。两名位于脚手架结构内部。最后一名位于右侧的钢筋上。钢筋上大约有八堆钢筋。左侧有一堆木材。背景中至少有六名工人。

err.en: on the embankment on the right
There are about eight piles of rebars on
err.zh: 钢筋上大约有八堆钢筋

text: About 20 bundles of board piles are in the middle of the image inside the excavation pit. Three workers, two of them with red hard hats, are near the excavation pit. A pile driver on the left is picking up a board pile.
zh: 图像中部有约20根板桩，位于基坑内。三名工人，其中两人戴着红色安全帽，靠近基坑。左侧的司机正拾起一根板桩。

text: Two excavators are in the image.
zh: 图中有两名挖掘机。

text: A worker with a red hard hat is pouring concrete with the concrete hose. Another worker with a yellow hard hat is observing him on a concrete platform. In the background, there is a concrete truck and a concrete pump truck next to the lake.
zh: 戴红色安全帽的工人正通过混凝土软管浇筑混凝土。另一名戴黄色安全帽的工人在混凝土平台上观察他。背景中有一辆混凝土卡车和一辆混凝土泵车正驶向湖泊。

text: The person next to the pile of concrete pipes is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 下一个走向混凝土管堆的人没有戴硬帽。

err.en: The person next to the pile of concrete
err.zh: 下一个走向混凝土管堆的人

text: An excavator is next to a road. There are eight sections of concrete pipes and a person next to the excavator. In the background, there are two dump trucks at the entrance of a yard. Several other dump trucks are occluded by the wall of the yard.
zh: 一台挖掘机正驶向一条道路。有八节混凝土管道和一个人正驶向该挖掘机。在背景中，有辆自卸卡车在院子的入口处。几辆其他自卸卡车被院子的墙所遮挡。

text: About 20 workers with yellow or red hard hats are at a construction site covered by rebar meshes on the ground. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 约20名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人正站在工地地面上，被钢筋网罩住。背景中可见两台塔吊。

err.en: at a construction site covered by rebar
err.zh: 正站在工地地面上，被钢筋网罩住

text: Two excavators are on the left of the image. Two workers with red or blue hard hats are on the right.
zh: 图像左侧有两名挖掘机。右侧有两名戴着红色或蓝色安全帽的工人。

text: Twelve workers are working on a tunnel structure. Five workers are standing on top of the finished concrete section of the tunnel. The remaining workers are on the rebar mesh in front of the entrance of the tunnel. All workers, except one, are wearing yellow hard hats and red uniforms. On the left, there is a row of board piles.
zh: 十名工人正在隧道结构内作业。五名工人站在已完工混凝土段顶部。其余工人位于隧道入口前方的钢筋网架上。除一名工人外，所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽和红色工作服。左侧有一排板材堆。

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats and red coveralls are sitting on bamboo plotform attached to the rebar cage in front of them. Their safety harnesses are attached to the rebar cage in front of them.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色防护服的工人坐在竹架前，其安全吊带系于他们前方的竹架上。

err.en: bamboo plotform attached to the rebar ca

text: Six workers are at a site full of round rebar cages and rebars on the ground.
zh: 六名工人正在地面上进行一轮完整的的全尺寸检查，并重新检查笼式起重机。

err.en: round rebar cages and rebars on the grou
err.zh: 一轮完整的的全尺寸检查，并重新检查笼式起重机

text: Two workers with red hard hats are in a building under construction. A trolley is to the left of the worker in the foreground.
zh: 两名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在一栋在建建筑下方作业。前景中一名工人的左侧有一辆手推车。

err.zh: 在一栋在建建筑下方作业

text: A mobile crane has its boom extended and outriggers deployed. There are at least 15 piles of rebars on the ground.
zh: 一台移动式起重机已安装其吊臂和触发器。地面上至少有十五堆钢筋。

err.zh: 已安装其吊臂和触发器

text: Two workers with red hard hats and blue coats are standing on top of a concrete platform at the left. Two workers with red hard hats and camouflage uniforms are standing on scaffolding made of metal tubes in the middle of the image. On top of the concrete platform, there are some stirrups and metal tubes on the ground.
zh: 两名头戴红色安全帽、身穿蓝色工装的工人站在画面左侧的混凝土平台上。两名头戴红色安全帽、身穿迷彩服的工人站在画面中部的由金属管搭建的脚手架上。混凝土平台顶部有一些搅拌物和金属管，地面上也有一些搅拌物和金属管。

err.en: On top of the concrete platform, there a
err.zh: 地面上也有一些搅拌物和金属管

text: Three workers with red or yellow hard hats are on at the construction site. The worker in the middle is behind a tripod while the worker on the right is holding a grade rod. In the background, there is an excavator.
zh: 三名头戴红色或黄色安全帽的工人正在建筑工地上作业。中间的工人站在一台三脚架后面，右侧的工人手持一根钢筋。背景中有一台挖掘机。

text: Seven workers are working on a brick building project. One worker with a red hard hat is on the roof of the building. Three workers with red hard hats are standing on top of a metal scaffolding. One worker with a yellow hard hat is crawling across the middle racks of the scaffolding. The jib of a tower crane can be seen at the top of the image.
zh: 七名工人正在砖砌建筑工地上作业。一名戴红色安全帽的工人位于建筑屋顶。三名戴红色安全帽的工人站在金属脚手架顶部。一名戴黄色安全帽的工人正爬行在脚手架中部横杆上。塔式起重机的（塔式起重机）的吊臂可在图像顶部看到。

err.en: The jib of a tower crane
err.zh: 塔式起重机的（塔式起重机）的吊臂

text: Eight tower cranes can be seen in the image. Nine workers are in the excavation pit. There are multiple piles of dimensional lumber in the pit. ON the left, there is an embankment. There are multiple piles of rebars of different size and shapes on the embankment.
zh: 图中可见八座塔吊。九名工人在基坑内。基坑内有多堆方木。左侧有一个围堰。围堰上有多堆不同尺寸和形状的的重条。

text: In the foreground, there is a fence consisting of tubes and green fabric. Four workers with yellow hard hats are working on the unfinished section of the tunnel. There is a concrete wall in the middle of the tunnel and two side walls made of metal tubes and boards. On top of the finished section of the tunnel, there is a pile of dimensional lumber and a pile of wooden boards.
zh: 前景中有一道由钢管和绿色织物构成的围栏。四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在隧道已完工段上作业。隧道中部有一面混凝土墙，两侧各有一面由金属管和板材构成的墙。隧道已完工段顶部有一堆方木和一堆木板。

err.en: working on the unfinished section of the
err.zh: 正在隧道已完工段上作业

text: A blue excavator is digging a trench. In the background, there are some unfinished buildings covered with green fabric. Two tower cranes are next to the buildings.
zh: 蓝色挖掘机正在挖掘沟渠。背景中有一些完工的建筑覆盖着绿色织物。两座塔式起重机位于建筑旁。

text: An excavator is digging on the embankment.
zh: 挖掘机正在基坑上作业。

text: Two excavators in the middle of the image on top of dirt piles. A trench is in the foreground.
zh: 画面中央有两名挖掘机，位于土堆上方。前景处有一条沟槽。

text: On the left, there are four construction vehicles. Three of them are not identifiable while the one behind the orange pipes is a drum roller. There is an excavator lifting a stack of orange pipes. In the middle, there is a crawler crane. A person is next to a dump truck in the middle. There are some black pipes occluded by the dump truck. There is also a water tank truck and an excavator. Some orange pipes are next to the excavator. On the right, a bulldozer is behind two piles of black pipes. There are two tower cranes in the background.
zh: 左侧有四台施工车辆。其中三台无法辨认，橙色管道后方的一台是鼓式压路机。有一台挖掘机吊着一堆橙色管道。中间有一台履带式起重机。一人正走向中间的一台泥浆泵车。有一些黑色管道被泥浆泵车遮挡。还有一台水罐车和一台挖掘机。一些橙色管道位于挖掘机前方。右侧有一台推土机，位于两堆黑色管道后方。背景中有两台塔式起重机。

text: 23 workers with yellow or red hard hats and safety vests are working at a large construction site. On the left, there is a pool structure with a concrete base and rebar meshes and cages on top of it. A tower crane is near the pool. On the left, there are multiple pits with concrete side walls. There are four piles of rebars in the foreground. An excavator is on the right and two excavators are on the left of the image. In the background, there is a pile driver.
zh: 23名头戴黄色或红色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在大型建筑工地上作业。左侧有一个混凝土基础池，上面有钢筋网和笼子。塔式起重机靠近池子。左侧有多个带混凝土侧墙的的地坑。前景中有四堆钢筋。右侧有一台挖掘机，图像左侧有两台挖掘机。背景中有一堆司机。

text: Six workers with yellow hard hats are in an excavation pit with shovels. A concrete tube is hanging from above.
zh: 六名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在使用电钻的基坑内作业。一根混凝土管悬挂于上方。

text: At least twelve workers are working on the project of a tunnel structure. In the lower right of the image, there are two piles of rebars. In the upper left of the image, there is an excavator and two mobile cranes.
zh: 至少十二名工人正在该隧道结构工程项目的上作业。在图像的右下方，有两堆钢筋。在图像左上方，有一台挖掘机和两台移动起重机。

err.en: working on the project of a tunnel struc
err.zh: 正在该隧道结构工程项目的上作业

text: Two excavators are at the muddy construction site. Three dump trucks are on the road on the embankment. There are also some people on the road.
zh: 两名挖掘机手在泥泞地施工现场。三辆自卸卡车在安置工程所在的道路上。道路上还有一些人。

text: Twelve workers with yellow or white hard hats are working on top of a rebar cage structure. There are multiple piles of dimensional lumber on top of the rebar cage. In the background, there are four tower cranes. The worker in the front is standing at the edge of the rebar cage.
zh: 十一名头戴黄色或白色安全帽的工人正在钢筋笼顶部作业。钢筋笼顶部堆放着多堆方木。背景中有四台塔式起重机。前方的一名工人正站在钢筋笼边缘。

text: A blue truck is towing a section of concrete pipe in the middle. Three workers are sitting in the dump box of the truck. On the left of the image, there is a row of five dump trucks. In the middle, there are three dump trucks and the green one is carrying a full load. On the right, there are about four more dump trucks. In the background, the tower crane is lifting a hoper. A section of a concrete pipe is in the right of the image.
zh: 一辆蓝色卡车正在拖运一段混凝土管道，位于画面中央。三名工人坐在卡车的车厢内。在画面左侧，有一排五辆卡车载车。在中央，有三辆卡车载车，其中绿色的一辆满载着货物。在右侧，大约有四辆卡载车。在背景中，塔式起重机正在吊运一名工人。一段混凝土管道位于画面右侧。

text: Nine workers with yellow hard hats and high visibility vests at a construction site full of rebars. Three workers on the left on top of the rebar structure while the other workers are one floor below.
zh: 九名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人在布满钢筋的施工现场。三名工人在左侧，位于钢筋结构的上方，而另一名工人在下方一层。

text: Three excavators are at the construction site. Two workers are in front of the excavator on the left. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 三名挖掘机手正在施工现场作业。两名工人位于挖掘机左侧前方。背景中可见两台塔式起重机。

err.en: in front of the excavator on the left

text: A worker is traversing through a pond of mud. He is holding a prism pole.
zh: 一名工人正穿过一片泥塘。他手里拿着一根棱极。

text: Four workers are in the foreground on top of a cliff. The worker in the front is finishing the ground with a finishing trowel. In the background, there are six more workers.
zh: 前景中，四名工人位于悬崖顶上方。最前面的那名工人正用一根完工杆完成作业。背景中，还有另外六名工人。

text: A mobile crane is in the middle of the image. A blue truck is to the left of the mobile crane. A worker with a white hard hat is inside the box of the blue truck.
zh: 移动式起重机位于图像中央。蓝色卡车位于移动式起重机的器的左侧。一名戴着白色安全帽的工人位于蓝色卡车的箱内。

err.en: to the left of the mobile crane
err.zh: 位于移动式起重机的器的左侧

text: Two excavators are in the middle of the image. On the right, the arm of an excavator is visible.
zh: 图像中央有两名挖掘机。右侧可见一台挖掘机的的手臂。

text: A worker with a red hard hat is holding a grade rod.
zh: 戴红色安全帽的工人手持一根钢筋。

text: Six workers with red or white hard hats and yellow safety vests are at the construction site. A worker with a red hard hat is operating a piece of equipment mounted on top of a tripod. There are three excavators in the image.
zh: 六名头戴红色或白色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人位于建筑工地上。一名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在操作一台安装在三脚架顶部的的一台设备。图像中有三名挖掘机操作员。

text: A total of nine workers are working on an unfinished tunnel structure. A worker is standing on top of a rebar cage. Two workers at the bottom of the image welding the rebar. A worker is walking on the scaffold made up of metal tubes and green fabric that is connected to the top of the rebar cage.
zh: 九名工人正在一座已完工隧道的结构内作业。一名工人站在钢筋笼顶部。图像底部有两名工人正在对钢筋进行焊接作业。一名工人正行走在由金属管与绿色布料搭建、并连接至钢筋笼顶部的的人字架的脚手架道上。

text: Seven workers are at the construction site of a tunnel structure. The structure is in an excavation trench. The tunnel has a base of rebar mesh and two rebar side walls. Some formworks are in the middle of the tunnel. A hose is hanging from above.
zh: 七名工人位于隧道施工现场。该结构处于开挖沟槽中。隧道具有钢筋网基础及两侧钢筋侧墙。部分施工位于隧道中部。一根软管悬挂于上方。

text: The worker on the right in front of the house is close to the excavator and is in the blind spot.
zh: 右侧房屋前的方的工靠近挖掘机，且处于盲区。

err.en: The worker on the right in front of the

text: An excavator is on top of an earthen platform on the right. It is loading a white dump truck. On the left, there are two workers with white hard hats. In the background, there is a water truck.
zh: 一台挖掘机位于右侧一个岩质平台顶部。它正装载着一辆白色自卸卡车。左侧有两名头戴白色安全帽的工人。背景中有一辆水车。

text: The excavation edge on the right is not fenced.
zh: 右侧开挖边坡未设挡土墙。

text: Six people are near a blue tricycle. Three workers with yellow hard hats on the left are shoveling rocks. In the background, there is an excavator.
zh: 六个人靠近一辆蓝色自行车。左侧三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在凿岩。背景中有一台挖掘机。

text: A muddy construction site. A pile driver, an excavator, and three workers with hard hats are working at the site.
zh: 泥泞地施工现场。一名司机、一台挖掘机和三名戴安全帽的工人在现场作业。

text: An excavator is digging an excavation pit. Next to the excavator is a worker with a red hard hat and a dump truck with soil in its box. There are also two workers with red or white hard hats on the right of the image. In the foreground, there is fenced made of metal tubes.
zh: 挖掘机正在挖掘一个土坑。接下来，挖掘机是一台带有红色安全帽的工人和一辆装载着泥土的自卸卡车。在图像的右侧还有两名戴着红色或白色安全帽的工人。在前景中，有由金属管构成的的一道围栏。

err.zh: 有由金属管构成的的一道围栏

text: A concrete pump truck is pumping concrete to a construction site. Four workers are near the concrete hose. An excavator is next to the concrete pump truck.
zh: 混凝土泵车正在向建筑工地泵送混凝土。四名工人靠近混凝土软管。一台挖掘机正驶向混凝土泵车。

err.en: is next to the concrete pump truck

text: The side of the unfinished structure is covered with massive green fabric. On the left, two workers with hard hats are walking on the scaffold. On the right, five workers with yellow hard hats and high visibility vests are on top of two platforms made of rebar meshes. In the lower right corner, there are eight piles of rebars of different sizes and lengths.
zh: 完工结构的外侧覆盖着大面积绿色织物。左侧，两名头戴安全帽的工人正行走在脚手架上。右侧，五名头戴黄色安全帽并穿着高可视性背心的的工人位于由钢筋网制成的的高台之上。在右下角，有八堆不同尺寸和长度的之钢筋。

err.en: two platforms made of rebar meshes
err.zh: 由钢筋网制成的的高台
八堆不同尺寸和长度的之钢筋

text: A drum roller is in the middle. On the left, there is a concrete pump truck in the background. There are also two tower cranes. On the right, there is a structure under construction and four tower cranes can be seen.
zh: 画面中央是一台鼓式滚轴破碎机。左侧背景中有一辆混凝土泵车。此外还有两台塔式起重机。右侧是一处正在施工的建筑，可以看到四台塔式起重机。

text: Five workers with yellow hard hats are on the roof of a building. The roof is covered with square black materials with rebar cages between adjacent black materials. There are a total of six piles of rebars and two piles of dimensional lumber in the image.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一栋建筑的工地上。屋顶覆盖着方形黑色材料，相邻黑色材料之间设有钢筋笼。画面中总共有六堆钢筋和两堆方木。

err.en: on the roof of a building

text: A concrete truck is next to a slope fenced by metal tubes. On the right, there is a pile of dirt. In the background on the left, there are three tower cranes.
zh: 一辆混凝土卡车正驶向一个由金属管围护的斜坡。右侧有一堆泥土。左侧背景中有三台塔式起重机。

err.zh: 正驶向一个由金属管围护的斜坡

text: An asphalt paving vehicle is in the middle. A worker is in front of the vehicle. On the left, there is a fleet of three dump trucks and a worker. On the right, there are four workers and five sections of concrete pipes.
zh: 沥青摊铺车位于画面中央。一名工人位于车辆前方。左侧有一队三辆泵送卡车和一名工人。右侧有四名工人和五段混凝土管道。

text: Three workers with yellow or red hard hats are at a construction site partitioned by rebar walls.
zh: 三名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人位于一处被隔墙分隔开的来的施工场地。

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats are working on a round structure with a big opening and rebars inside. There is a rebar cage on the right of the image next to the opening.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一个圆形结构上有一个大开口且内部有栏杆的物体旁作业。在图像右侧，紧挨着那个开口处，有一个重新加固的笼子。

text: An excavator is digging and has a full bucket of soil in its bucket. A dump truck is occluded by the excavator. Some red brick houses are on the right.
zh: 一台挖掘机正在挖掘，其铲斗内装满了泥土。一辆自卸卡车被挖掘机包含在内。一些红砖房位于右侧。

text: The rooftop of a U-shaped building that is under construction. In the lower left, there are two workers and some rebar cages. On the right, there are two piles of dimensional lumber. At the top of the image, there are at least eight workers with yellow hard hats. More than ten piles of dimensional lumber, at least seven piles of wooden boards, and several piles of rebars can be found. There are some scaffolds made of yellow tubes.
zh: 一栋U形建筑正在施工。在左下方，有两名工人和一些钢筋笼。在右侧，有两堆尺寸木材。在图像顶部，至少有八名戴黄色安全帽的工人。有超过十堆尺寸木材，至少七堆木板，并且可以发现几堆钢筋。有一些由黄色管构成的的人字架。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat and an orange safety vest is processing rebars with a machine under a shed. The place is a rebar processing shop. In the foreground, there are more rebars covered with blue cloth. In the background, there is a loader, two more workers, and six tower cranes.
zh: 戴黄色安全帽、穿橙色安全背心的的工人正在处理一台机器，位于一个棚子下方。该场所是一家加工车间。前景中，有更多用蓝色布料覆盖的加工车间。背景中，有一台装载机、另外两名工人以及六台塔式起重机。

err.en: more rebars covered with blue cloth
err.zh: 更多用蓝色布料覆盖的加工车间

text: A concrete truck is next to a concrete pump truck. In the bottom left corner of the image, there is a pile of rebar on the ground.
zh: 一辆混凝土卡车正驶向一辆混凝土泵车。在图像的左下角的地面上，有一堆螺纹钢。

text: Some steel structural members are encapsulated in the middle of a rebar cage. This is a construction site with more than 16 workers with yellow or red hard hats scattered around. In the foreground, there are two workers squatting next to several piles of rebars and stirrups. On the left of the image, there are eight bundles of metal tubes and one pile of dimensional lumber near a worker. On the other side of the rebar cage, there is another pile of dimensional lumber. In the upper right of the image, there is a pile of wooden boards, about four bundles of rebars.
zh: 部分钢结构构件被封装在钢筋笼中部。这是一个施工工地，有超过十六名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人。在前景中，有两名工人蹲在几堆钢筋和螺纹钢旁边。在图像左侧，有八根金属管材和一堆方木料靠近一名工人。在钢筋笼的另一侧，有另一堆方木料。在图像右上方，有一堆木板，大约四根钢筋。

text: A pile driver is in the middle of the image. In the foreground, there are more than ten barrels of different colors. On the left, there is a wall made of blue metal boards and supported by metal tubes anchored to the ground. On the left, there is a section of a pipe.
zh: 画面中央有一辆卡车。前景处有超过十个不同颜色的的小桶。左侧有一面由蓝色金属板制成、并由金属管锚固于地面的构成的墙体。左侧有一段管道。

text: A concrete truck is next to a concrete pump truck on the right embankment. There are three to four people next to the trucks. The pump truck is pouring concrete in to the excavation pit with its hose. Four workers are pouring concrete with the hose in the pit. On the left embankment, there are five more workers observing.

zh: 两名挖掘机正在挖掘土方。背景中，一台移动式起重机的可见。

text: A drum roller is in the foreground. In the background, a tower crane is behind a tall building.
zh: 前景中有一台鼓式滚轮起重机。背景中，一台塔式起重机位于一栋高大建筑物后方。

text: Eleven workers are on the roof of a building under construction. The roof is covered with rebar meshes. On the right, a worker is hanging up a piece of blue fabric. A mobile crane is on the ground. On the left, a worker stands close to the edge while holding a wooden stick. The base of a tower crane is in the lower left of the image.
zh: 七名工人正在一栋在建建筑的屋顶作业。屋顶覆盖着钢筋网。右侧，一名工人悬挂着一块蓝色布料。一台移动式起重机位于地面上。左侧，一名工人手持木棍站在靠近边缘处。一台塔式起重机的底座位于图像左下方。

text: Two excavators are in the image. Two workers with hard hats are in the foreground.
zh: 图中有两名挖掘机。前景中有两名戴安全帽的工人。

text: An excavator is digging a tree. Two workers are observing on the right. Beside the people, a pole carrying a piece of land surveying equipment is stuck in the ground.
zh: 一台挖掘机正在挖一棵树。两名工人在右侧观察。旁边的人们，一台载有测量设备的的一台设备卡在土里。

err.en: a pole carrying a piece of land surveyin
err.zh: 一台载有测量设备的的一台设备卡在土里

text: An excavator is loading a dump truck in the middle next to some concrete structures.
zh: 一台挖掘机正在装载一辆自卸卡车，准备将其运往某混凝土结构。

err.en: in the middle next to some concrete stru
err.zh: 准备将其运往某混凝土结构

text: Three workers are on top of a rebar cage of a tunnel structure under construction. In the lower left, there are three bundles of rebars and a pile of dimensional lumber.
zh: 三名工人位于隧道结构施工中的钢筋笼顶部。在左下方，有三根钢筋和一堆方木。

text: An excavator is digging in the middle. On the right, a red dump truck is partially occluded by a brick wall.
zh: 一台挖掘机正在中部进行挖掘作业。右侧，一辆红色泵车被砖墙部分遮挡。

text: Two excavators are digging at a muddy site. In the background, there is a person next to a dump truck.
zh: 两名挖掘机手正在泥泞地工地上进行挖掘作业。背景中，有一人正走向一辆自卸卡车。

text: The construction site is divided into two sections. In the excavation pit, there are many pits on the ground with brick side walls. In the foreground, there are ten workers. Some of them are on the ground while others are on the scaffold. There are at least ten piles of metal tubes, two piles of stirrups, and one pile of wood boards on the ground. In the background, there is another construction site with three buildings covered with green fabric under construction. Four workers are in the upper left of the image along with a tower crane.
zh: 该施工现场分为两个区域。在基坑内，地面上有许多砖砌成的侧墙。在前景中，有十名工人。其中一些人在地面上，另一些人则在脚手架上。地面上至少有十堆金属管、两堆搅拌料以及一堆木板。在背景中，有另一处正在施工中的建筑工地，三栋建筑被绿色织物覆盖。四名工人位于图像的左上方，旁边有一台塔式起重机。

err.en: many pits on the ground with brick side
err.zh: 地面上有许多砖砌成的侧墙

text: 12 workers, some of them wearing hard hats, are gathered together in an excavation pit next to a row of sheet piles. An excavator is on top of the excavation pit in the upper right.
zh: 12名工人，其中一些人戴着安全帽，聚集在一个挖掘坑旁，准备排成一列土堆。一台挖掘机位于挖掘坑的右上方。

err.en: next to a row of sheet piles
on top of the excavation pit

text: Three workers, one squatting on the left, one in the middle, the other standing on the hill, are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 三名工人，一人蹲在左侧，一人蹲在中间，另一人站在山上，均未佩戴安全帽。

text: Three pairs of excavators and dump trucks are at a construction site. Excavators are loading dump trucks.
zh: 两台挖掘机和一辆自卸车位于一处建筑工地。挖掘机正在向自卸卡车装载。

err.en: Three pairs of excavators and dump truck
err.zh: 两台挖掘机和一辆自卸车

text: Five workers are working on an unfinished tunnel structure with rebar meshes as its base and two side walls. Two workers with orange uniforms and long rubber boots are holding a concrete hose to pour concrete into the space enclosed by the formwork. They are standing on the wood board placed on top of the formwork wall. Three other workers are observing them.
zh: 五名工人在已完工的结构内作业，以钢筋网片作为其基础，并设有两侧侧墙。两名身着橙色工作服、脚穿长胶靴的工人正持一根混凝土软管，向由模板围成的空间内浇筑混凝土。他们站在置于模板墙体顶部的的一块木板上。另外三名工人正在观察他们。

text: Six workers with green uniforms are among multiple piles of rebars. Three of them on the left are in front of distribution kiosks. On the right, three workers are next to a long bench.
zh: 六名身着绿色制服的工人混杂在多堆钢筋棒之间。其中三人位于左侧，站在分销亭前。右侧，三名工人正走向一张长凳。

err.en: are next to a long bench

text: A yellow excavator is lifting a piece of equipment with a lifting mechanism attached to its bucket. On the left, there are two blue excavators and three dump trucks. In the middle of the background, there is a worker with a yellow hard hat, a dump truck, and another construction vehicle, possibly a bulldozer.
zh: 一台黄色挖掘机是带有提升装置连接其铲斗的设备。左侧有两台蓝色挖掘机和三台自卸卡车。背景中间有一名戴黄色安全帽的工人、一台自卸卡车和另一台施工车辆，可能是一台推土机。

err.en: A yellow excavator is lifting a piece of
err.zh: 一台黄色挖掘机是带有提升装置连接其铲斗的设备。

text: A building is under construction. It is surrounded by a scaffold made up of yellow or red and white metal tubes and green fabric. A worker with a red hard hat is on the scaffold on the right. On the roof, there are eleven workers, two stacks of stirrups, and six piles of metal tubes.
zh: 该建筑正在施工中。其周围由黄色或红色与白色金属管及绿色织物搭建而成的脚手架环绕着。一名头戴红色安全帽的工人位于右侧的脚手架上。在屋顶，有十一名工人、两堆搅拌物以及六堆金属管。

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats are working on a structure with formworks on the side. The formwork consists of red metal boards installed on top of a concrete foundation. It is also supported by metal tubes anchored to the ground.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在结构旁作业。该结构由红色金属板安装于混凝土基础之上。其亦由金属管锚固于地面。

err.en: The formwork consists of red metal board
err.zh: 该结构由红色金属板安装于混凝土基础之上。

text: Four workers are working on a tunnel structure with formworks on two sides. The formwork is mounted on a concrete foundation. The worker in the foreground is holding a metal tube. He is wearing a hard hat, a pair of gloves, and a pair of sunglasses. On the right, there is are several metal tubes in a trolley.
zh: 四名工人正在一条隧道结构内作业，作业面位于两侧。作业平台安装于混凝土基础之上。前景处的的一名工人手持一根金属管。他头戴一顶硬帽，双手各戴一只手套，并佩戴一副太阳镜。右侧，一辆手推车里放着若干根金属管。

err.en: The formwork is mounted on a concrete fo
err.zh: 作业平台安装于混凝土基础之上

text: A dump truck is in the foreground. In the background, three booms are visible. The boom in the middle comes from a mobile crane while the booms from the left and the right may come from pile drivers.
zh: 前景中有一辆自卸卡车。背景中可见三个吊球。中间的吊球来自移动式起重机，而左侧和右侧可能来自司机堆。

text: Three workers are working on a concrete structure with formworks and metal tubes on two sides. Metal tubes are placed across the concrete structure at short intervals in the foreground. In the background, there are huge piles of metal tubes on the concrete structure and the ground to the left. On the left of the background, there is a construction vehicle and a pile of concrete pipes.
zh: 三名工人正在施工，混凝土结构上设有成对布置的金属管。金属管以短间隔横置在前景的混凝土结构上。背景中，混凝土结构左侧有大量成堆的金属管。背景左侧，有一辆施工车辆和一堆混凝土管道。

err.en: with formworks and metal tubes on two si
err.zh: 混凝土结构上设有成对布置的金属管

err.en: and the ground to the left
err.zh: 混凝土结构左侧有大量成堆的金属管

text: Three workers are next to an excavator on an asphalt road. The worker without a hard hat is pointing at something.
zh: 三名工人正走向沥青路上的一台挖掘机。未戴安全帽的工人正指向某处。

text: A dump truck is in the middle of the image next to a well with concrete side walls. There are three wells in a row. A worker with a blue hard hat is in the lower left of the image while the worker with a red hard hat is in the upper right. Next to the truck, there is a worker with a red hard hat next to a stack of metal pipes and an excavator.
zh: 一辆自卸卡车停在画面中央，其右侧紧邻着一堵混凝土侧墙。墙边并排着三个井。画面左下方有一名头戴蓝色安全帽的工人，右上方有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人。在卡车的右侧，有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人，其旁是一堆金属管道和一台挖掘机。

err.en: next to a well with concrete side walls
err.zh: 其右侧紧邻着一堵混凝土侧墙

err.en: There are three wells in a row

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats and red uniforms are standing on a scaffold fenced by blue metal fences. The scaffold surrounds a rebar cage. On the scaffold, three stacks of rebars can be seen. On the left, the base of a tower crane can be seen. Both the structure and the tower crane are on a concrete platform. Another worker is on the ground.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人站在由蓝色金属围栏围成的脚手架架上。脚手架环绕着一座钢筋笼。在脚手架上，可以看到三摞钢筋。在左侧，可以看到一台塔式起重机的器的。该结构和塔式起重机器都位于一个混凝土平台上。另一名工人站在地面上。

err.en: the base of a tower crane
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机的器的

text: Seven workers are working on a tunnel structure. Three workers in the foreground are standing on the unfinished section. The unfinished section is made of metal tubes. A layer of dimensional lumber and then a layer of wood boards are on top of the metal tubes. Two workers are standing on the finished concrete section, a worker is on the soil ground on the left, and a worker is in the trench on the right. The construction site is surrounded by fences made up of black and yellow metal tubes and green fabric.
zh: 七名工人在隧道结构内作业。前景处有三名工人站在已完工区段上。该已完工区段由金属管构成。一层方木料，随后一层木板置于金属管顶部。两名工人站在已完工混凝土区段上，一名工人在左侧地面上，一名工人在右侧沟槽内。施工现场被黑色与黄色金属管及绿色织物制成的围栏所环绕。

err.en: The unfinished section is made of metal
err.zh: 该已完工区段由金属管构成

text: Six workers are on top of the concrete slab of an unfinished structure. Two workers on the right are on the edge of the slab. The structure has a rebar side wall visible in the image. In the bottom left of the image, there is a stack of metal tubes on the left bank. On the right bank, there are two piles of boards next to a wall made of blue metal boards. Two pavilions are in the background.
zh: 六名工人位于一块已完成结构的混凝土板的顶部。右侧两名工人位于该板边缘。该结构中存在一面可见钢筋侧墙。图像左下方，左侧堤岸上有一堆金属管。右侧堤岸上，紧邻一面由蓝色金属板制成的墙壁，有两堆板材。背景中有两只狮子。

err.en: Two pavilions are in the background.

text: An excavator is behind a bundle of rebars, a pile of metal members, a pile of wooden boards, and a pile of concrete pipes. Behind the excavator, there is a tall stack and a short stack of wooden boards. On the left, there is a blue tricycle. In the background, there are seven tower cranes.
zh: 一台挖掘机停在一堆钢筋、一堆金属构件、一堆木板和一堆混凝土管道后面。挖掘机后面还有一摞高摞和一小摞木板。左侧有一辆蓝色自行车。背景中有七座塔式起重机。

text: Two tower cranes are in the image. Nine workers are on the scaffold fenced by blue metal fences. Three workers are on the lower level of the scaffold while the remaining six workers are on the top two levels. On the left, there is the slope of a mountain.
zh: 图中有两台塔式起重机。九名工人位于蓝色金属围栏搭建的高架子上。三名工人在高架子的较低的一层，其余六名工人在高架子上面的两层。在左侧，有一座山的体的。

err.en: there is the slope of a mountain

text: Three workers are gathered together in front of a broken scaffold structure. Some metal tubes are on the ground right behind them. Two workers with yellow hard hats are working on the scaffold in the background. The concrete building above is supported by multiple rows of concrete piers. On the right, there is a blue tricycle and two stacks of dimensional lumber separated by a concrete pier.
zh: 三名工人聚集在一处破损脚手架的前方。一些金属管位于他们右侧的地面上。两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在背景中的脚手架上作业。上方的混凝土建筑由多排混凝土垫块支撑。右侧有一辆蓝色自行车以及两堆尺寸木材，被一根混凝土墩柱隔开。

text: The structure is partitioned into three sections by two walls in the middle. On the left, the finished portion has a concrete slab while on the right, the unfinished portion has rebar meshes on the ground. Each wall has a concrete base and rebars on top of the base. On the right, three workers with yellow hard hats are working at the end of the structure. Two stacks of rebars are next to the workers. In the background, there are two more workers at the toe of the excavation bank.
zh: 该结构被两道位于中间的墙体分隔成三个部分。左侧，已完成的部分有一块混凝土板，而右侧，已完成部分在地面上有钢筋网。每面墙都有一个混凝土基础，并在基础顶部有钢筋。右侧，三名戴着黄色安全帽的工人正在结构末端作业。工人旁边有两堆钢筋。在背景中，在开挖基坑的坡脚处还有另外两名工人。

text: Four workers are on top of a tunnel under construction. The top layer of the slab on top of the structure is red wooden boards. The worker with a yellow hard hat on the right is on the edge of the wooden boards. In the background, there are two pavilions and another worker on a lower level. There is a rebar wall on top of the concrete short wall on the left of the structure. A pile of metal tubes is between the excavation bank and the concrete short wall. On the bank, there is another pile of metal tubes.
zh: 四名工人位于正在施工的隧道顶部。结构顶部的为红色木板。右侧戴黄色安全帽的工人位于木板边缘。背景中有两只狮子和另一名位于较低处的。混凝土短墙顶部有一堵砖墙。金属管堆位于开挖基坑与混凝土短墙之间。基坑上还有另一堆金属管。

text: Two workers are working on a tunnel structure. The structure has rebar walls on two sides. There is a concrete wall in the middle sandwiched by formworks.
zh: 两名工人正在隧道结构内作业。该结构具有两侧钢筋墙。中间有一混凝土墙，由施工方浇筑而成。

text: Two workers with red hard hats and long rubber boots are in the image. The worker on the left is spraying water with a hose. The worker on the right is holding two brooms.
zh: 两名头戴红色安全帽、脚穿长胶靴的工人出现在画面中。左侧的工人正用软管喷水。右侧的工人手持两个水桶。

text: Three workers are working on two walls. The wall on the left has a row of rebars on top of the concrete base sandwiched by formworks on both sides. The right wall is sandwiched by formworks on both sides. On the left, some metal tubes and black pipes are leaning on the slope. On the right bank, there is a stack of rebars on top of a pile of bricks. A worker with a red hard hat and red uniform is next to the stack of rebars. In the upper left corner, there is an excavator and a worker in red.
zh: 三名工人在两面墙上作业。左侧墙面上有一排钢筋位于混凝土基础之上，由脚手架支撑在两侧。右侧墙面由脚手架支撑在两侧。在左侧，一些金属管和黑色管道斜靠在斜坡上。在右侧堤岸上，有一堆钢筋位于一堆砖块之上。一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿红色制服的工人正走向那堆钢筋。在左上角，有一台挖掘机和一名身穿红色衣服的的人。

err.en: is next to the stack of rebars

text: An excavator and a concrete truck are next to each other in an excavation pit.
zh: 一台挖掘机和一辆混凝土卡车正在一个基坑内相互靠近。

text: A mobile crane is next to a blue truck in the middle. A worker is next to the mobile crane. On the left, the box of a truck is visible. On the right, a red truck and two tower cranes can be seen.
zh: 一台移动起重机位于一辆蓝色卡车的中间。一名工人正走向移动起重机。左侧可见一辆卡车的的车厢。右侧可见一辆红色卡车和两台塔式起重机。

err.en: next to a blue truck in the middle
err.zh: 位于一辆蓝色卡车的中间

err.en: is next to the mobile crane

text: A crane is on the left. A worker with a red hard hat is next to the crane. A group of five workers are leaning on the fence of the concrete platform. A dump truck and a concrete truck are parked next to each other.
zh: 左侧有一台起重机。一名戴红色安全帽的工人正走向起重机。五名工人正倚靠在混凝土平台的围栏上。一辆自卸卡车和一辆混凝土卡车并排停放着。

text: Three worker cranes are in the image. At the bottom of the image, a person is next to an SUV. There is also a stack of bricks and two stacks of wooden boards near the person. In the background, there is a building covered with green fabric in the middle and an excavator on the left.
zh: 图中有三名工人。在图片底部，一个人正走向一辆SUV。在人物附近还有一堆砖块和两堆木板。在背景中，中间有一块绿色布料，左侧有一台挖掘机。

err.en: a person is next to an SUV
a building covered with green fabric

text: Four tower cranes are at a construction site. For the leftmost tower crane, only the tip of its boom is visible.
zh: 四台塔式起重机位于一处建筑工地。对于大多数塔式起重机而言，仅其吊臂的顶端是可见。

err.en: only the tip of its boom is visible
err.zh: 仅其吊臂的顶端是可见

text: Two excavators are digging at a muddy site.
zh: 两名挖掘机手正在泥泞地工地上进行挖掘作业。

text: Two green dump trucks are in the foreground of the image. In the background, there are two drum rollers and a pile of orange pipes on the left. In the middle, there is a bulldozer and a crawler crane. On the right, there is an excavator, three piles of black pipes, and two tower cranes.

text: The worker on the left in front of the drum roller is not wearing a hard hat.

err.en: with a person standing next to a black S

text: Six workers are working on a tunnel structure with a concrete wall in the center-left. For the unfinished section in the foreground, there are two side walls with concrete bases and rebars on top of them. Some metal boards are on the ground.
