text: Four workers are bending or squatting on a rebar mesh structure. The rebar mesh and rebar walls on both sides are the unfinished sections of a concrete tunnel. The workers are in front of the entrance of the finished part of the concrete tunnel. The tunnel is in an excavation pit. On the right, an excavator is visible.
zh: 四名工人正弯腰或蹲伏在钢筋网上。钢筋网和钢筋墙位于两侧，是混凝土隧道的完工部分。工人位于混凝土隧道完工部分的入口的前。隧道位于一个开挖坑内。右侧，一台挖掘机可见。

err.en: the unfinished sections of a concrete tu
err.zh: 是混凝土隧道的完工部分

text: Two workers are on the ground. One of them is shoveling mud while the other one is holding a trolley. Two other workers are standing on a rebar leaning on the excavation bank. One of them is spraying shotcrete onto the wall of the excavation bank. On the left, there is a pile of metal tubes on the ground. On the right, a row of sheet piles is next to the scaffold.
zh: 两名工人站在地面上。其中一人正用泥覆盖着，另一人正扶着一辆手推车。另外两名工人站在挡土墙上，倚靠着开挖的基坑边坡。其中一人正往开挖的基坑边坡的墙面喷射混凝土。左侧地面上有一堆金属管。右侧，一排钢板桩紧挨着脚手架。

text: Three workers are walking on the plank of a scaffold fenced by blue metal fences. The scaffold surrounds a rebar cage. There is a pile of rebars and a pile of dimensional lumber on the ground in the foreground. Another worker with a yellow hard hat and safety harness is sitting on a bamboo platform mounted to the rebar cage.
zh: 三名工人正行走在由蓝色金属围栏护架起的的一块脚手架板上。脚手架围绕着一座钢筋笼。前景地面上有一堆钢筋和一堆方木。另一名头戴黄色安全帽、身系安全带的子的工人正坐在一座安装于钢筋笼上的竹制平台上。

err.en: Another worker with a yellow hard hat an
err.zh: 另一名头戴黄色安全帽、身系安全带的子的工人正坐在

text: Three excavators are digging on a slope. They are at three different levels of the slope.
zh: 三名挖掘机手正在斜坡上作业。他们位于斜坡的不同的高度处。

text: An excavator is in the middle to the right of a worker with a white hard hat. A metal container is on the right. On the left, there is a pile of wooden pallets and some other materials covered by tricolor fabric. An embankment is in the background.
zh: 一台挖掘机位于一名头戴白色安全帽的工人右侧中部。一个金属容器位于右侧。左侧有一堆木质托盘板以及一些其他材料，上面覆盖着彩色织物。背景中有一处嵌入物。

err.en: An embankment is in the background.

text: Two workers with yellow hard hats are on the left of the image. They are partially occluded by red metal fences and a formwork made up of wood panels and metal tubes.
zh: 画面左侧有两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。他们部分被红色金属围栏以及由木板和金属管构成的的人形物遮挡。

text: Three workers with white hard hats are in the foreground along with a grader. Dirt piles are on the right of the image. On the left of the background, a worker is next to a loader.
zh: 前景中有三名头戴白色安全帽的工人，旁边还有一位主管。画面右侧是土堆。背景中，一名工人正走向一辆装载机。

text: Six workers with raincoats are standing on a rebar mesh. The worker on the right is pouring concrete into the rebar mesh with a hose. On the left of the foreground, there worker is holding a concrete vibrator. A row of sheet piles are in the background.
zh: 六名工人和一只雨猫站在钢筋网架上。右侧工人正将混凝土倒入钢筋网架，通过一根软管。前景左侧，有一名工人手持混凝土振捣器。背景中有一排钢板桩。

text: Six workers are working at a construction site with a scaffold consisting of metal tubes of different colors. Four workers with yellow hard hats are in the foreground and two stacks of metal tubes are next to them. Two workers are on the left of the background with another pile of metal tubes. The scaffold in the background is made of yellow metal tubes.
zh: 六名工人在一处建筑工地作业，该工地设有一处由不同颜色金属管构成的的人字架。四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于前景，两名工人身旁紧挨着两堆金属管。背景中另有一堆金属管。背景中的脚手架由黄色金属管构成。

err.en: Two workers are on the left of the backg
err.zh: 背景中另有一堆金属管。

text: An excavator is in the middle of the image. In the background, the boom of a pile driver is visible. The ground at the construction site is mostly covered by blue fabric.
zh: 画面中央有一台挖掘机。背景中可见一堆驾驶员的轰鸣声。建筑工地地面大部分被蓝色布料覆盖。

err.en: the boom of a pile driver

text: A rock breaker mounted to an excavator is breaking the base of the canal full of mud. A white house and an abutment of a bridge are in the upper right of the image.
zh: 安装在挖掘机上的岩石破碎机破坏了满是泥浆的运河基础。一座白色房屋和一座桥梁位于图像的右上方。

err.en: A white house and an abutment of a bridg
err.zh: 一座白色房屋和一座桥梁位于图像的右上方。

text: At least 14 workers are working on an unfinished structure with a concrete substructure and a rebar mesh structure on top of it. Two piles of rebars are on the highest concrete platform in the background at the toe of the excavation bank. The top of the excavation bank is enclosed by yellow metal fences. A stack of bricks is behind the metal fences.
zh: 至少14名工人在一处已完工的结构上作业，该结构上方设有钢筋网。两堆钢筋位于背景中开挖堤坝的顶部混凝土平台上。开挖堤坝的顶部由黄色金属围栏围护。金属围栏后方堆放着一堆砖。

err.en: with a concrete substructure and a rebar
err.zh: 该结构上方设有钢筋网

text: A worker is leveling concrete with a trowel attached to a wooden rod in the middle of the image. On the right, there are three workers working with rebars at the toe of the wall. On the left, a roll of coiled rebars are behind the rebar walls.
zh: 一名工人正将混凝土水平地浇筑，一根木杆固定在图像中部。右侧有三名工人正在墙脚处操作钢筋。左侧有一卷钢筋位于钢筋墙后方。

err.en: leveling concrete with a trowel attached
err.zh: 将混凝土水平地浇筑，一根木杆固定在图像中部

text: Four workers with yellow hard hats are on top of a tunnel structure under construction. On the left, concrete has been poured for the structure. The unfinished section in the middle has a rebar wall on top of a concrete short wall. A wooden sheet is on top. On the right, there are several rebar cages. The bottom of the rebar cages is surrounded by metal board frameworks.
zh: 四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于正在施工的隧道顶部。左侧，混凝土已浇筑用于结构。中间的完工部分，顶部有一堵钢筋墙。顶部有一块木板。右侧，有几个钢筋笼。钢筋笼的底部被金属板框架所包围。

err.en: The unfinished section in the middle

text: At the top of the image, a drum roller is in the foreground. In the background, there are some excavators and pile drivers.
zh: 图像前景处有一台鼓式压路机。背景中有一些挖掘机和压路机。

text: Two excavators are in the image in front of a semi-trailer truck. The semi-trailer truck on the left of the image has a tree on the semi-trailer platform. On the right, there are two tower cranes. Only the job of the right tower crane is visible.
zh: 两名挖掘机手位于一辆半挂式卡车的前方的。图像左侧的半挂式卡车上有一棵树位于半挂式平台之上。右侧有两台塔式起重机。只有右侧那台塔式起重机是可见。

err.en: Only the job of the right tower crane is
err.zh: 只有右侧那台塔式起重机是可见

text: Six workers are working on a tunnel structure. The structure has a concrete core and rebar meshes as the shell. Four workers are on top of the structure, one worker is on the left of the structure tying rebars, and another worker carrying a bundle of rebars on his shoulder is walking on a bridge connecting the excavation bank and the top of the tunnel. Some metal boards and two stacks are rebars are in the foreground.
zh: 六名工人在隧道结构内作业。该结构具有混凝土核心和钢筋网壳。四名工人在结构顶部，一名工人在结构左侧系钢筋，另一名工人肩扛着一束钢筋走在连接开挖坝和隧道顶部的的一座桥上。一些金属牌和两个支架钢筋位于前景。

text: An excavator is in the middle. A worker with a white hard hat is standing in front of the excavator. A drumer roller is on the right of the image.
zh: 挖掘机位于画面中央。一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在挖掘机前方。一台钻机轮位于画面右侧。

text: Six workers on the left of the image are working on an unfinished tunnel. The unfinished structure consists of a base made of rebar mesh and two rebar side walls. Two workers are standing on the rebar meshes. Four remaining workers are outside the structure and working on the side walls, two workers on each side. There are some materials such as metal tubes and boards on the rebar base. On the left, there is a row of sheet pipes. On the right, a worker is walking on the excavation bank holding a white bucket. Some rebars are in the lower right of the image.
zh: 图像左侧的六名工人正在一条已完工的地道内作业。该结构由钢筋网片基础及两侧钢筋侧墙组成。两名工人站立在钢筋网片上。其余四名名工人在结构之外，正在侧墙上作业，每侧有两名工人。钢筋基础上有一些诸如金属管和板材的材料。左侧有一排片管道。右侧有一名工人正行走在开挖的堤岸上，手持一只白色桶。图像右下方有一些钢筋。

text: Three excavators, two of them are light blue while the other one is yellow, are digging at a construction site. Four workers are near the excavators.
zh: 三名挖掘机手中有两人穿浅蓝色，另一人穿黄色，正在一处建筑工地进行挖掘作业。四名工人在挖掘机手附近。

err.en: two of them are light blue while the oth
err.zh: 两人穿浅蓝色，另一人穿黄色

err.en: Four workers are near the excavators
err.zh: 四名工人在挖掘机手附近

text: Five workers with yellow hard hats are near a fence made up of metal tubes and green fabric near an excavation pit. Three of them are carrying sandbags. Some more sandbags are next to a pile of dirt in the background.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于由金属管和绿色织物搭建而成的的一道围栏附近，靠近一个基坑。其中三人正搬运沙袋。更多的沙袋正被运往背景中的一堆泥土。

err.en: Some more sandbags are next to a pile of
err.zh: 更多的沙袋正被运往背景中的一堆泥土。

text: A rock breaker mounted to the arm of an excavator is breaking a concrete road. An SUV is next to the excavator.
zh: 安装在挖掘机臂上的岩石破碎机正在破碎一条混凝土道路。一辆SUV正驶向挖掘机驶去。

text: Five excavators are in a muddy canal. Three of them are digging in the mud. Two excavators are on the bank, and two workers are next to the right excavator. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 五台挖掘机在一条泥泞沟中。其中三台正在泥中挖掘。两台挖掘机在岸上，另外两台工人正走向右侧的挖掘机。背景中，有两台塔式起重机。

err.en: are next to the right excavator

text: Five workers with red hard hats are at a construction site next to a river. The worker in the foreground is holding a bundle of wooden sticks in his arms. In the background, it seems a training is passing on top of the embankment.
zh: 五名头戴红色安全帽的工人正走向工地旁的的一条河流。前景中的工人臂中抱着一束木棍。背景中，似乎有一场培训正经过上方的高架。

err.en: are at a construction site next to a riv
err.zh: 正走向工地旁的的一条河流

text: The rear of a mobile crane is in the middle. On the right, there is a pile of round rebar cages.
zh: 汽车后部位于中部。右侧有一堆圆形钢筋笼。

text: More than 25 workers are working in an excavation pit. The structure in the excavation pit has a concrete substructure and rebar meshes on top of it. There are red wood boards scattered across the construction site. On the right, a section of a tower crane is visible.
zh: 二十五名以上工人在基坑内作业。基坑内结构设有混凝土结构和钢筋网，其顶部覆盖有红木板散落在施工现场。右侧可见一台塔式起重机。

err.en: rebar meshes on top of it. There are red
err.zh: 钢筋网，其顶部覆盖有红木板散落在施工现场。

text: Seven workers are in the image. There are two metal rails on the ground and it seems they are conducting an experiment. There is a dump truck and a black SUV near them.
zh: 图中有七名工人。地面上有两条金属栏杆，他们似乎正在进行进行一项实验。他们附近有一辆自卸卡车和一辆黑色SUV。

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats and orange uniforms are working on a tunnel structure. On the right, the finished section has a concrete exterior. On the left, the unfinished section has rebar meshes as the base and walls. The three workers are working between the rebar wall on the far side and a row of sheet piles. On top of the finished section, there is a pile of metal tubes, seven stacks of rebars, and three stacks of metal plates.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿橙色工作服的工人正在隧道结构施工。右侧，已完工区段具有混凝土内衬。左侧，已完工区段以钢筋网片作为基础墙体。三名工人正在远侧钢筋墙与一排钢板桩之间作业。已完工区段顶部，有一堆金属管、七摞钢筋、以及三摞金属板。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat is holding a rebar in the foreground. Another worker is leaning on a wall. They are next to a steel truss.
zh: 戴黄色安全帽的工人在前景手持一根钢筋。另一名工人正倚靠在墙上。他们正走向一座钢桁架。

err.en: They are next to a steel truss.
err.zh: 他们正走向一座钢桁架。

text: An excavator is digging a slope.
zh: 挖掘机正在开挖边坡坡。

text: More than 20 workers are working in an excavation pit. The structure under construction has a concrete substructure and rebar meshes on top of the substructure. A stack of rebar is in the lower right corner of the image. Yellow fences fence the excavation bank. Some construction materials such as dimensional lumber and bricks can be seen behind the fences. In the upper left of the image, the jib of a tower crane is visible.
zh: 二十多名工人在基坑内作业。基坑下方的结构具有混凝土结构和钢筋网，钢筋网位于结构上方。一堆钢筋位于画面右下角。黄色围栏围挡着基坑边坡。一些建筑材料，如方木和砖块，可在围栏后看到。在画面左上，一台塔式起重机的具的吊臂可见。

err.en: the jib of a tower crane
err.zh: 塔式起重机的具的吊臂

text: A tower crane is lifting a hopper in the middle. There are four more tower cranes in the image. Two mobile cranes are also visible on the ground. At the bottom of the image to the right of the right mobile crane, there is a drum roller.
zh: 塔式起重机正吊起位于中部的的一台起重机。图中还有四台塔式起重机。地面上也可见两台移动式起重机。在图像右下方，靠近右侧移动式起重机处，有一台卷扬机。

text: An orange excavator is next to a hill.
zh: 一台橙色挖掘机正驶向一座山丘。

text: The construction site of a viaduct. A concrete truck, two crawler cranes, one tower crane, and an excavator are in the image. A bridge-building machine is on the deck of the viaduct. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a piece of electrical equipment surrounded by green fences.
zh: 图中展示了一个水坝施工现场。画面中有一辆混凝土卡车、两台履带式起重机、一台塔式起重机以及一台挖掘机。水坝的坝顶平台上有一台桥式建筑机械。在图像的右下角，有一件电气设备被绿色围栏网所包围。

text: A mobile crane and a blue truck are next to a steel frame structure under construction. A worker with a red hard hat is on the left of the image while another mobile crane is on the right of the image.
zh: 一台移动起重机和一辆蓝色卡车正驶向一座在建的钢架结构下方。一名戴着红色安全帽的工人位于画面左侧，而另一台移动起重机则位于画面右侧。

err.en: are next to a steel frame structure
err.zh: 正驶向一座在建的钢架结构下方

text: Six workers are on the finished section of the tunnel structure. One worker is sitting in front of the entrance of the unfinished section of the tunnel. The unfinished section is supported by metal tubes. A worker is on the right in the gap between the tunnel and the sheet piles. A worker is on the left walking on a bridge. On top of the tunnel, there are piles of construction materials such as rebars and metal tubes.
zh: 六名工人位于隧道已完工区段。一名工人坐在隧道已完工区段入口前方。已完工区段由金属管支撑。一名工人位于隧道与钢板桩之间的右侧空隙处。一名工人在左侧人行天桥上行走。隧道顶部堆放着钢筋和金属管等建筑材料。

err.en: The unfinished section is supported by m
err.zh: 已完工区段由金属管支撑。

text: Six workers with yellow hard hats and red uniforms are in the opening surrounded by rebar walls. A scaffold fenced by blue metal fences surrounds the structure under construction in the middle. Two workers are on the scaffold on the left, and one stack of rebars is on the scaffold at the bottom of the image. The jib of a tower crane is at the top of the image and is above the building under construction.
zh: 六名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人位于画面左侧的开放区域，周围环绕着红砖墙。画面中部正在施工的建筑下方，由蓝色金属围栏围成的脚手架环绕着。两名工人站在左侧的脚手架上，一摞钢筋放置在画面底部脚手架上。塔式起重机的器的位于画面顶部，处于正在施工建筑上方。

err.en: The jib of a tower crane

text: Three excavators are digging in a dry river bed.
zh: 三名挖掘机手正在干河床中挖掘。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat and a pair of protective gloves is sticking a black hose into the freshly poured concrete enclosed by the metal formwork. He is standing on the flange of the formwork and the planks. To his right, there is a structure consisting of dimensional lumber and metal tubes. A roll of water hose is in front of him.
zh: 头戴黄色安全帽、手戴防护手套的工人，正将黑色软管插入新浇筑混凝土的钢筋笼中。他站在钢筋笼的法兰盘上。他的右侧有一堆由木材和金属管组成的。一根水管位于他前方。

err.en: a structure consisting of dimensional lu
err.zh: 有一堆由木材和金属管组成的

text: Three workers with yellow or white hard hats are in a building with concrete beams and columns. There are scaffolds made of yellow metal tubes both on the left and the right of the image.
zh: 三名头戴黄色或白色安全帽的工人位于一栋带有混凝土梁和柱的建筑内。画面左右两侧均有由黄色金属管构成的的人字架。

err.en: scaffolds made of yellow metal tubes
err.zh: 由黄色金属管构成的的人字架

text: A concrete pump is in the middle with its outriggers deployed. A worker with a yellow hard hat is on the left and squatting next to an outrigger of the truck.
zh: 混凝土泵位于中部，其出水触发器已部署。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正蹲伏在卡车出水触发器旁。

text: Seven workers with yellow hard hats and yellow safety vests are at a construction site with several foundation pits. The pits have brick side walls. Soil piles in the image are largely covered with blue fabric. A pile of grey bricks is on top of the blue fabric in the foreground. On the left of the background, there are two excavators. On the right, there is a concrete platform, a stack of precast concrete piles, and three tower cranes.
zh: 七名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人位于一处设有多个基坑的施工现场。这些基坑具有砖砌侧壁。图像中的土堆大部分被蓝色布料覆盖。前景中蓝色布料上方有一堆灰色砖块。背景左侧有两名挖掘机。右侧有一个混凝土平台、一堆预制混凝土块以及三台塔式起重机。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat and a blue uniform is holding a red brush. He is standing on some rocks near some planks. A black wood board is behind him.
zh: 一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿蓝色制服的工人手持一把红色刷子。他站在一些岩石旁的一些水槽附近。他身后有一块黑色木质板。

text: Eleven workers are working on a concrete pool structure with a concrete substructure and rebar meshes on top of it. Four workers in the upper right corner of the image are erecting a pile of rebars. On the platform beside the swimming pool, there are six stacks of rebars.
zh: 七名工人在混凝土池结构上作业，混凝土结构上方设有钢筋网。图像右上角的四名工人正在搭建一堆钢筋。游泳池旁平台上有六堆钢筋。

text: A tower crane is in the middle of the image. In the lower right corner, the jin of another tower crane is visible.
zh: 塔式起重机位于画面中央。在右下角，另一台塔式起重机的可见。

text: A bulldozer is pushing some tree roots. A person squats on the left edge of the photo.
zh: 一台推土机正在推一些树根。一个人拍在照片的左边缘。

text: A bulldozer is pushing soil in the middle. On the left of the background, there are about seven tower cranes. One of them can only be identified by a section of jib while others are also partially occluded.
zh: 一台推土机正在中部推土。在左侧背景中，大约有七台塔式起重机。其中一台仅能通过一节识别，而另一台也部分被包含。

text: Five workers are at the construction site in an excavation pit. Two workers in the middle of the image are wearing yellow or red hard hats and yellow safety vests. The worker with the yellow hard hat is carrying a yellow metal tube. On the left, a section of a tower crane is visible. On the excavation bank behind the yellow metal fences, there is a stack of bricks.
zh: 五名工人位于施工现场的基坑内。画面中间的两名为工人佩戴黄色或红色安全帽及黄色安全背心。戴黄色安全帽的工人正搬运一根黄色金属管。左侧可见一台塔式起重机的一部分。黄色金属围栏后方的基坑内有一堆砖块。

err.en: On the excavation bank behind the yellow
err.zh: 黄色金属围栏后方的基坑内

text: Six sheet piles are erected in the foreground. Two sheet piles are in front of the erected piles and tied with strings. There is also a huge pile of sheet piles lying on the slope. In the background, there are two rolls of coiled rebars. Two excavators, one blue and one yellow, are behind the coiled rebars.
zh: 前景竖立了六根钢板桩。两根钢板桩位于已竖立的桩的前，并用钢丝绳连接。坡面上还堆放着一大堆钢板桩。背景中有两卷盘卷式钢筋。两根挖掘机，一蓝一黄，位于盘卷式钢筋后方。

text: Two excavators, one yellow and one blue, are digging on wet ground next to a river. They seem to be on the point bar of a meandering river. Two black pipes are on the left. A worker with a hard hat is next to the black pipes.
zh: 两名挖掘机，一黄一蓝，正在湿地上向一条河流挖掘。它们似乎在一条蜿蜒河流的河口处。两根黑色管道在左侧。一名戴着硬帽的工人正靠近黑色管道。

err.en: on the point bar of a meandering river
err.zh: 在一条蜿蜒河流的河口处

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats and red uniforms are working on a black plate on the ground. On the right, a worker is next to a scaffold covered with green fabric. At the top of the image, a worker is on a scaffold with wood plank flooring and metal fences. A red pipeline is on the ground.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人正在黑色地面上作业。右侧，一名工人正走向覆盖着绿色织物的料的的安全梯。画面顶部，一名工人站在铺有木质地板和金属护栏的安全梯上。一根红色管道位于地面上。

err.en: a worker is next to a scaffold
err.zh: 一名工人正走向覆盖着绿色织物的料的的安全梯

err.en: a scaffold covered with green fabric

text: A construction site with a wall in the background and a tower crane on the left. Two workers are next to the tower crane. To the left of the blue shed, There are multiple kinds of construction materials such as rebars and lumber. At the bottom of the image, there are more than ten bundles of rebars. Around ten workers are near the rebars at the bottom of the image.
zh: 背景中有一堵墙，左侧有一台塔式起重机。两名工人正走向塔式起重机。蓝色棚屋的左侧有多种建筑材料，如钢筋和木材。图像底部有超过十根钢筋。图像底部钢筋附近有多名工人。

err.en: more than ten bundles of rebars

text: Five workers are working on a structure with two levels of platforms. Two of them are on the first level, one is standing on the right with a red hard hat while the other one is squatting on the left. Both of them are working on the formwork of the second level. There are some red wooden boards and metal tubes on the first level. The second level is covered with rebar meshes. A worker with a red hard hat is squatting on the left while another worker is sitting in the middle. Another worker is standing on the rebar wall at the far side of the platforms. Behind him is a fence of metal tubes and green fabric.
zh: 五名工人在两层平台上作业。其中两人在第一层，一人站在右侧，戴着红色安全帽，另一人蹲在左侧。两人都在第二层作业。第一层有一些红色木板和金属管。第二层覆盖着钢筋网。一名戴红色安全帽的工人蹲在左侧，另一名工人坐在中间。另一名工人站在平台的远侧的钢筋墙前，他身后是金属管围栏和绿色布料。

err.en: Both of them are working on the formwork
standing on the rebar wall at the far si
err.zh: 站在平台的远侧的钢筋墙前

text: Six workers with red hard hats are in a yard full of rebar cages. On the left, there is a blue shed with some construction materials underneath it.
zh: 六名头戴红色安全帽的工人在堆满钢筋笼的院子里。左边有一件蓝色雨衣，下面放着一些建筑材料。

text: Ten workers are at a construction site of a concrete slab. A worker with a red hard hat is holding a grade rod on the right. Other nine workers with yellow hard hats are leveling concrete with tools such as trowels or bars. In the background, a concrete hose hanging from above is pouring concrete.
zh: 十名工人正在一处混凝土板施工现场作业。一名头戴红色安全帽的工人右手持握着一根钢筋。另外九名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正使用诸如钢筋或钢筋条等工具进行混凝土找平作业。背景中，一根混凝土软管从上方垂下，正在浇筑混凝土。

text: A worker with a red hard hat is holding a white and yellow grade rod next to an excavator. At the bottom of the image, a worker with a yellow hard hat is between two adjacent rebar cages. The structure in the lower right of the image has a rebar mesh as its base and two rebar side walls. A rebar cage is in the center-left. Some metal plates are on the right of the structure.
zh: 戴红色安全帽的工人手持一根黑白黄相间的杆，正走向一台挖掘机。画面底部，一名戴黄色安全帽的工人位于两个相邻的钢筋笼之间。画面右下方，一个钢筋笼以钢筋网为基底，并设有两侧钢筋侧墙。画面左中部有一个钢筋笼。一些金属板位于画面右侧。

err.en: on the right of the structure

text: The person in black in the foreground is not wearing a hard hat and is wearing shorts. Some workers are not wearing hard hats on top of the embankment on the left.
zh: 前景中的黑衣人没有戴硬帽，而是穿着短裤。一些工人没有在左侧的嵌入物上戴硬帽。

text: An excavator is in the middle at the toe of a hill. On the left, there is a white dump truck.
zh: 一台挖掘机位于山丘的尖端中部。左侧有一辆白色自卸卡车。

text: Three workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are working at a construction site with shallow excavation pits. The excavation pits have brick side walls. Two workers in the middle of the image are in two different pits while another worker is walking on the ground level. The site is messy and piled with construction materials, hoppers, and trolleys. In the background, there is an elevated concrete platform with a staircase. On the left, a stack of slate bricks are partially occluded by the staircase.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在一处浅基坑施工现场作业。基坑内设有砖砌侧壁。画面中央有两名工人分别位于两个不同的基坑中，另有一名工人正行走在平地上。现场杂乱，堆放着建筑材料、麻袋及滚筒。背景中有一处抬高的混凝土平台，并配有楼梯。左侧有一堆板岩砖部分被楼梯遮挡。

text: An excavator is next to a turbulent river. A worker is next to a concrete slab in the middle. There are metal tubes and rocks on the concrete slab.
zh: 一台挖掘机正驶向一条湍急的河流。一名工人正位于一块混凝土板的中部。混凝土板上有一些金属管和岩石。

err.en: next to a concrete slab in the middle
err.zh: 位于一块混凝土板的中部

text: Six workers are pouring concrete with a hose hanging from above in an excavation pit. The worker in the middle is holding the concrete hose while the remaining workers are leveling concrete.
zh: 六名工人正在向一个位于上方的挖掘坑内浇筑混凝土，其中一名位于中间的工人手持混凝土软管，其余工人正在找平混凝土。

err.zh: 向一个位于上方的挖掘坑内浇筑混凝土

text: A worker is next to a trolley of red bricks in a steel frame structure with brick walls. On the left, another person is visible in the shade.
zh: 一名工人正将一车红色砖块推入一个带有砖墙的钢架结构。在左侧，另一个人可见于阴影中。

err.en: A worker is next to a trolley of red bri
err.zh: 一名工人正将一车红色砖块推入

text: A bulldozer is in the image. A person is on the right. In the background, there is a road on top of an embankment and a viaduct.
zh: 一台推土机位于图片中。一个人位于右侧。在背景中，有一条道路位于一个基坑和一个漏斗的上方。

text: A concrete truck and a dump truck are in the foreground of the image. The concrete truck is discharging concrete and the yellow dump truck is dumping to the wells with concrete side walls. A worker with a blue hard hat is next to the concrete truck. Another worker with a red hard hat is sitting on a stack of metal pipes next to an excavator. In the background, there is another yellow dump truck.
zh: 前景中有一辆混凝土卡车和一辆抽水泵车。混凝土卡车正在浇筑混凝土，黄色的抽水泵车正向井壁一侧抽送混凝土。一名戴蓝色安全帽的工人位于混凝土卡车旁。另一名戴红色安全帽的工人坐在一堆金属管道旁，靠近一台挖掘机。背景中还有另一辆黄色抽水泵车。

err.en: dumping to the wells with concrete side
err.zh: 向井壁一侧抽送混凝土

text: A drum roller is in the middle of the image and a worker with a white hard hat and a shovel is next to it. On the left, there is an orange excavator. On the right, two workers are next to a yellow excavator.
zh: 画面中央是一台鼓轮式压路机，其右侧有一名头戴白色安全帽、手持铁锹的工人。左侧是一台橙色挖掘机。右侧有两名工人正走向一台黄色挖掘机。

err.en: are next to a yellow excavator
err.zh: 正走向一台黄色挖掘机

text: Three workers with white or red hard hats are on a rebar mesh next to a rebar wall. Behind them is a fence of metal tubes and green fabric.
zh: 三名头戴白色或红色安全帽的工人位于钢筋网架前方，其后方是一堵由金属管与绿色织物构成的

err.en: next to a rebar wall. Behind them is a f
err.zh: 其后方是一堵由金属管与绿色织物构成的

text: 14 workers are at a construction site. The ground has a concrete floor and an embankment at the top of the image. In the upper left of the image, the structure has a rebar mesh as its base and three rebar walls on the sides and the middle. The worker in at the bottom of the image is sweeping the floor.
zh: 14名工人在一处建筑工地。地面有一层混凝土，图像顶部有一处嵌入物。在图像的左上方，结构有一处钢筋网作为其基础，侧面有三处钢筋墙，中间有一处。图像底部的的一名工人正在清扫地面。

text: Six workers are working on a tunnel structure. All of them are wearing hard hats. One worker is in front of the entrance of the finished section of the tunnel with concrete side walls and a concrete roof. The unfinished section has a concrete base and two rebar walls on both sides. A space enclosed by metal plate formwork is in the center-right of the structure. Three workers are in the gap between the plates and the right rebar wall. Two workers are on the excavation bank fenced by yellow and black metal tubes and green fabric.
zh: 六名工人正在隧道结构内作业。他们全都戴着安全帽。一名工人位于隧道已完工段入口前方，该段侧墙为混凝土，顶棚为混凝土。已完工段具有混凝土基础，两侧各设有两根钢筋墙。一个由金属板围成的空间位于结构右侧中心。三名工人位于金属板与右侧钢筋墙之间的间隙处。两名工人位于开挖河堤上，该堤由黄色与黑色金属管以及绿色织物防护。

err.en: two rebar walls on both sides
err.zh: 两侧各设有两根钢筋墙

text: A worker with a hard hat and a safety vest is on the ground. There are about 10 piles of metal tubes, two piles of rebars, and three stacks of black wooden boards on the ground. On the second floor of the structure under construction, there are two workers behind the green fabric. Some more construction materials are behind the green fabric. In the upper right of the image, there are multiple shallow excavation pits.
zh: 一名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人站在地面上。地面上大约有10堆金属管、2堆钢筋以及3摞黑色木板。在下方施工结构的内，绿色布料后方有2名工人。绿色布料后方还有一些其他施工材料。在图像的右上方，有多个浅基坑。

text: An orange excavator is digging on top of an excavation bank. A mobile crane is next to the excavator lifting a stack of metal material with a rigging system. A worker is sitting on top of the truck operating the crane and another worker is next to the rigging system to help the lifting.
zh: 一台橙色挖掘机正在挖掘一座开挖银行的顶部。一台移动式起重机正准备通过吊装索具系统将一堆金属材料吊起。一名工人坐在卡车顶部操作起重机，另一名工人正准备通过吊索具系统协助吊起。

err.en: is next to the excavator lifting
err.zh: 正准备通过吊装索具系统将一堆金属材料吊起

text: Two excavators are in the image. The right one is on a pile of dirt. Two workers are in the foreground. In the background, one mobile crane and four tower cranes can be seen.
zh: 图中有两名挖掘机。右边那台位于一堆泥土上。前景中有两名工人。背景中可以看到一台移动起重机和四台塔式起重机。

zh: 三名工人，其中两人戴着红色安全帽，正走向一个带钢壁的水容器。罐内有一些泥浆液，软管末端浸在液体中。

err.en: are next to a water container
err.zh: 正走向一个带钢壁的水容器

text: Two workers with red or white hard hats are in the foreground. A blue excavator is digging an excavation pit and loading the soil to a truck parked nearby. A worker with a red hard hat and red safety vests are next to the truck. On the right, there is another dump truck.
zh: 前景中有两名头戴红色或白色安全帽的工人。一台蓝色挖掘机正在挖掘一个基坑，并将泥土装载到附近停放的一辆卡车上。卡车旁边有一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿红色安全背心的的工人。右侧还有另一辆泵车。

text: The worker in a white t-shirt in the middle is wearing shorts and slippers.
zh: 一名身穿白色T恤的工人站在中间，穿着短裤，戴着护目镜。

text: Nine workers are gathering together in the middle. In the upper left, there are two excavators.
zh: 九名工人聚集在中间。在左上方，有两名挖掘机操作员。

text: Three workers are on top of a tunnel structure under construction. All of them are wearing hard hats. In the foreground, the structure is covered by rebar meshes. In the gap between the tunnel and the right bank, there are two workers with yellow hard hats. There are also some construction materials such as plates and a hopper on top of the tunnel.
zh: 三名工人位于正在施工中的隧道顶部。他们全都戴着安全帽。前景中，该结构被钢筋网覆盖。在隧道与右侧堤坝之间的，有两名戴着黄色安全帽的工人。隧道顶部还有一些建筑材料，如钢板板和一台起重机。

text: Two workers are working on a structure with a rebar wall. The left worker is applying a type to the ground while the right worker is holding a hammer.
zh: 两名工人正在一面有钢筋墙的的结构上作业。左侧工人正在对地面施加某种类型，而右侧工人正握着一把锤子。

err.en: applying a type to the ground

text: Four workers are leveling concrete in a excavation trench. Two workers are to the left of an excavator on the right bank.
zh: 四名工人在基坑内浇筑混凝土。两名工人在挖掘机右侧，一名工人在右侧银行。

err.en: Two workers are to the left of an excava
err.zh: 两名工人在挖掘机右侧，一名工人在右侧银行。

text: On the left, five workers with yellow hard hats are on top of the concrete platform with a concrete roof. A worker is pouring concrete with a hose hanging from above. On the right, a worker with a red hard hat is standing on top of an outrigger of a concrete pump truck.
zh: 左侧，五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在带混凝土屋顶的混凝土平台上。一名工人正用软管从上方浇筑混凝土。右侧，一名头戴红色安全帽的工人站在混凝土泵车的车斗上。

text: A busy construction site. On the left, there is a drum roller and two more construction vehicles that are partially occluded. There are some orange pipes between them. In the middle of the image, there is a person in the foreground next to a white dump truck. There is an excavator lifting a stack of orange pipes and a crawler crane is behind it. On the right, there are two water tank trucks, a pile of black pipes, an excavator, and a pile of green pipes.
zh: 繁忙的建筑工地上，左侧有一台滚筒机和两台部分被遮挡的建筑车辆，它们之间有一些橙色管道。图像中间，前景处有一人，其后方是一辆白色泵车。那里有一台挖掘机吊着一堆橙色管道，其后方是一台履带起重机。右侧有两辆水罐车、一堆黑色管道、一台挖掘机和一堆绿色管道。

text: Three workers are next to an excavator on an asphalt road.
zh: 三名工人正在一条沥青路上操作一台挖掘机。

err.zh: 正吊运至一栋在建建筑下方

zh: 移动式起重机吊起两个金属部件，其中一件为起重设备。一名工人站在箱内，另一名工人正走向吊钩。左侧还有一名工人，戴着蓝色安全帽。

zh: 左侧，两名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人站在带有混凝土顶棚的混凝土平台上。右侧，一名头戴红色安全帽的工人站在混凝土泵车顶部。

text: Four workers with red uniforms are on top of a tunnel structure. The finished section of the tunnel is made of concrete. The unfinished section has a rebar mesh as its roof and metal plate formworks on both sides reinforced by metal tubes. The interior of the tunnel is supported by metal tubes. text: In the lower right, there is a concrete platform. A stack of metal plates are on the concrete platform. On the excavation bank on the left. There is a white dump truck and a loader. A worker with a yellow hard hat is next to the dump truck. A stockpile of construction materials are to the left of the dump truck.

zh: 画面中央有两名挖掘机停在一堆泥土上。背景中可以看到三台塔式起重机位于画面中央。第四台塔式起重机的位于左侧。此外，还有一台正在施工中的混凝土搅拌站。

zh: 蓝色挖掘机正驶向一条河流。

text: Three workers with red hard hats are working on a rebar cage surrounded by wooden formworks on the ground next to a viaduct structure. Two stacks of metal tubes and two stacks of other construction materials, possibly wooden boards, are underneath the viaduct.
zh: 三名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在一个钢筋笼上作业，该钢筋笼位于地面之上，周围由木质结构支撑。钢筋笼下方有两堆金属管材和两堆其他建筑材料，可能是木质板材。

text: Three workers are pouring concrete into a structure under construction with a concrete hose from the concrete pump truck. A concrete pump truck and a concrete truck are on the right of the background. Another worker is standing next to the concrete truck.
zh: 三名工人正将混凝土从混凝土泵车倒入施工结构下方的混凝土管中。混凝土泵车和混凝土车位于背景右侧。另一名工人站在混凝土车旁。

err.en: pouring concrete into a structure under
err.zh: 将混凝土从混凝土泵车倒入施工结构下方的混凝土管中

text: The construction site with a rebar mesh base is in an excavation pit. Seven workers are on the rebar mesh. A concrete pump truck on the excavation bank extends its hose to pour concrete into the rebar mesh on the ground. Two concrete trucks are next to the pump truck on the excavation bank. At the toe of the retaining wall, there is a scaffold made of yellow metal tubes with some construction materials on top of the scaffold.
zh: 带钢筋网架基础的的建筑工地位于基坑内。七名工人在钢筋网架上。一台混凝土泵车在基坑边坡上，其软管延伸至钢筋网架基础以浇筑混凝土。两台混凝土泵车紧随泵车在基坑边坡上。在挡土墙脚部，有一个由黄色金属管搭建而成的脚手架，其顶部有一些建筑材料。

text: A tower crane is lifting a hopper in the middle of the image. A section of the jib of another tower crane can be seen on the right next to a tall building under construction.
zh: 塔式起重机正吊起画面中央的一台塔式起重机。画面右侧可见另一台塔式起重机，其后方是一栋正在施工中的高层建筑。

err.zh: 吊起画面中央的一台塔式起重机

err.en: A section of the jib of another tower cr

text: An excavator is in the middle. A blue truck is to its left. On the right, a concrete pump truck is behind a stack of concrete pipes. Some construction materials pile up next to the pump truck. In the background, three tower cranes are behind the buildings under construction.
zh: 一台挖掘机位于画面中央。一辆蓝色卡车停在其左侧。右侧，一辆混凝土泵车停在一堆混凝土管道后面。一些建筑材料堆放在泵车前方。背景中，三座塔吊机位于在建建筑物后方。

text: Eight workers are on the roof of a building under construction. Two workers in the foreground are installing a horizontal rebar cage. Behind them is a stack of rebars and a stack of square stirrups. A hopper is on the left. Two more stacks of rebars are on the other side of the roof. In the background, there are at least two steel frame buildings.
zh: 八名工人正在一栋在建建筑的屋顶上作业。前景处有两名工人正在安装水平钢筋笼。他们身后是一堆钢筋和一堆方形钢卷。左侧有一名起重机操作员。屋顶另一侧还有两堆钢筋。背景中至少有两栋钢结构建筑。

err.en: A hopper is on the left.
err.zh: 左侧有一名起重机操作员。

text: On the left, there is a drum roller, a crawler crane, a stack of black pipes, an excavator, and a water truck. In the middle, a dump truck is in the foreground, there is a stack of orange pipes in the background. On the right, there is a dump truck and a stack of black pipes. Three tower cranes are in the background.
zh: 左侧有一台卷扬机、一台履带起重机、一堆黑色管道、一台挖掘机和一辆水罐车。中间有一辆泵车位于前景，背景中有一堆橙色管道。右侧有一辆泵车和一堆黑色管道。背景中有三座塔式起重机。

text: A mobile crane is in the image in front of two buildings under construction. The buildings have rebar cores and are enclosed with blue formworks. Several b undles of rebars on the ground in front of the mobile crane.
zh: 一台移动式起重机位于两栋在建建筑前方。这些建筑具有钢筋混凝土核心，并被蓝色防护网围护。移动式起重机前方地面上有几根钢筋。

text: The worker next to the green truck is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 该工人正驶向绿色卡车，未佩戴安全帽。

text: More than ten workers are near a wall. Some of them are building a brick wall in the middle of the image. A stack of construction material can be seen next to trolley at the toe of the wall along with four workers.
zh: 十多名工人靠近一面墙壁。其中一些人在图像中部建造了一面砖墙。在墙壁旁边可以看到一堆建筑材料，紧挨着四名工人。

err.en: next to trolley at the toe of the wall

text: An excavator is digging on the embankment of a river.
zh: 挖掘机正在河道开挖处进行挖掘作业。

err.en: on the embankment of a river

text: Eleven people are gathered together at a construction site. A row of sheet piles is on the left. Two excavators are in the background.
zh: 七名人员聚集在施工现场。一排钢板桩位于左侧。两名挖掘机手在背景中。

text: A light blue excavator is on the left and a red truck is on the right. In the background, there is a farm. On the left on the abutment of a viaduct, there is another light blue excavator.
zh: 左侧有一台浅蓝色的挖掘机，右侧有一辆红色卡车。背景中有一处农场。左侧有一台浅蓝色挖掘机的。

err.en: On the left on the abutment of a viaduct
err.zh: 左侧有一台浅蓝色挖掘机的。

text: A person standing in the background and a person with a cigarette on his ear in the middle of the group of people are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 一名男子站在背景中，一名男子将香烟夹在耳中，该人群中的人未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: a person with a cigarette on his ear in

text: Seven workers are surrounding a building under construction. The building has some rebar side walls and is next to a concrete platform. There are two rows of sheet piles in the background.
zh: 七名工人正围绕一栋在建建筑。该建筑有一些挡土墙，其下方是一个混凝土平台。背景中有两排钢板桩。

err.en: is next to a concrete platform
err.zh: 其下方是一个混凝土平台

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer. The bulldozer is on a dirt track with its blade in contact with the ground, suggesting it may be engaged in grading or moving earth. In the background, there is a river and a bridge.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，有一台黄色色推土机。推土机位于泥土质地的轨道上，其刀片与地面接触，表明其可能正在进行场地平整或土方搬运作业。背景中有一条河流及一座桥梁。

text: The image shows a construction site with an orange excavator in the center. The excavator is on top of a dirt pile and is digging earth. There is a large puddle of water in the foreground. In the background, there is a concrete structure with visible scaffolds inside. The roof of the concrete structure is fenced by green fabric and metal tubes.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台橙色挖掘机。挖掘机位于一堆泥土上方，正在挖掘泥土。前景处有一大滩水洼。背景中可见一栋混凝土结构，其内部有折叠。混凝土结构的顶部由绿色织物和金属管围护。

text: Six workers with red coveralls and yellow hard hats are on a structure under construction. On the left, one worker is standing on a metal beam with a safety harness. On the right, there are five workers and one of them is on the other side of the structure and is occluded by the rebar wall. They are surrounded by a blue metal fence. There is a big opening with concrete walls in the middle of the structure.
zh: 六名头戴红色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人位于施工结构下方。左侧，一名工人站在金属梁上，佩戴安全吊带。右侧，有五名工人，其中一名位于结构的另一侧，被钢筋墙遮挡。他们被蓝色金属围栏包围。结构中间有一处混凝土墙上的大开口。

err.en: red coveralls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 红色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: Two workers wearing yellow are kneeling on a structure under construction. The structure is supported by metal tubes in the inner core. A layer of dimensional lumber and then a layer of plywood sheets are on top of the metal tubes. On the left, there is the edge of a concrete platform.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在建筑下方。该结构由金属管支撑着内部核心。一层尺寸木材以及随后一层胶合板位于金属管顶部。在左侧，是混凝土平台的边缘。

err.en: kneeling on a structure under constructi
The structure is supported by metal tube
err.zh: 该结构由金属管支撑着内部核心

text: The image shows a total of four tower cranes.  For the tower crane on the bottom, only its jib and tower peak are visible.
zh: 图像显示共有四台塔式起重机。对于底部的那台，仅其吊钩和塔顶可见。

text: The image shows a construction site where a large group of workers is in an excavation pit. There are 21 workers visible in the image with red or yellow hard hats, and high-visibility vests. The workers are standing on the concrete substructure with multiple layers of rebar meshes on top of it. There are some red plywood sheets scattered around the site. On the corner of the excavation site, there are two stacks of rebars and a stack of plywood. A pile of cylinders is leaning onto the wall of the excavation pit. There are orange metal fences with concrete bases at ground level. There are some lumber and red plywood sheets stockpiles behind the fences.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一大群工人位于一个基坑内。图像中可见11名工人，戴着红色或黄色安全帽，穿着高能见度背心。工人站在混凝土结构上，其顶部有多层钢筋网。现场周围散落着一些红色胶合板。在基坑的角落，有两堆钢筋和一堆胶合板。一堆圆柱体斜靠在基坑的墙壁上。在地面高度，有一些橙色金属围栏，带有混凝土基础。在围栏后面，有一些木材和红色胶合板堆。

text: The image shows a construction site where a large group of workers is engaged in activities related to reinforcing steel (rebar) work. There are more than 30 workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats. They are spread out across a grid of rebar, with some bending or tying the rebar, and others carrying materials or tools. In the background, there is a retaining wall and a green construction fence. On the left of the image, the base of a tower crane can be seen.
zh: 图片显示的是一个建筑工地，一大群工人正在进行钢筋（钢筋）作业。画面中可见超过三十名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽。他们分散在钢筋网格中，部分人正在弯曲或绑扎钢筋，另一些人则搬运材料或工具。背景中有一堵挡土墙和一道绿色施工围栏。在画面左侧，可以看到一台塔式起重机的。

err.en: the base of a tower crane

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain and standing water. A tunnel-like structure with a square opening is placed in the excavation trench. In the center, there is a stack of metal plates, a pile of bricks, and a stack of wooden planks in front of the opening of the tunnel. On the left, there are two workers visible on top of the excavation bank, and one of them is wearing a red hard hat. On the right, there is another worker with a red hard hat. A large yellow hose runs across the foreground.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地形泥泞湿，有积水。一个类似隧道的方形开口放置在挖掘沟中。在中心，有一堆金属板、一堆砖块和一摞木托盘，位于隧道开口的前部。在左侧，有两名工人可见于挖掘沟顶部，其中一人戴着一顶红色安全帽。在右侧，有另一名工人，戴着红色安全帽。一根粗大的黄色软管横穿前景。

text: The image shows a construction site with an unfinished multi-story building. There is one worker with a red hard hat visible on the scaffolding in the foreground. In the foreground, there is a large pile of bamboo scaffolding materials. In the background, there are three more workers with yellow hard hats on the scaffold next to the building. There are two trolleys between the two groups of workers.
zh: 图中显示一处建筑工地，有一栋已完工的多层建筑。前景中有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人站在脚手架上。前景处有一大堆竹制脚手架材料。背景中，在建筑旁的还有三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在脚手架上。两组工人之间有两辆手推车。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple levels of scaffolds. The second floor is full of rebar cages. There are five workers with red or yellow hard hats on ground level in the foreground. In the background, there are at least six tower cranes. There are numerous construction materials, including rebars, rebar rolls, stirrups scattered across the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多层脚手架。第二层地面铺满了钢筋笼。前景地面上有五个戴着红色或黄色安全帽的工人。背景中至少有六台塔式起重机。现场散布着大量建筑材料，包括钢筋、钢筋卷、搅拌机等。

text: A bulldozer and a dump truck are in the foreground. Two individuals are visible in the background on the right. They are next to a parked pickup truck.
zh: 一台推土机和一辆自卸卡车位于前景。右侧背景中有两个人影可见。他们正走向一辆停放的皮卡卡车。

err.en: They are next to a parked pickup truck.
err.zh: 他们正走向一辆停放的皮卡卡车。

text: A worker with a yellow hard hat is in the middle of the image. The worker is surrounded by construction materials, including two bundles of yellow pipes on the right, and stacks of wood planks in the middle. There is a scaffold made of yellow tubes on the left. There is a fence made of green fabric in the background.
zh: 画面中央有一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。工人周围堆放着建筑材料，右侧有两卷黄色管道，中间堆着木托盘。左侧有由黄色管材搭建的脚手架。背景中有一道由绿色织物制成的的人行横道。

err.en: a fence made of green fabric

text: The image shows a construction site with a large steel structure in the process of being erected. A yellow mobile crane in the middle is lifting a steel beam from the red flatbed truck on the left. Another mobile crane with a red boom is occluded by the yellow crane. There are two workers with red hard hats on the truck and two more workers with red hard hats on the right of the image. The ground is muddy with puddles of water. There is a tower crane on the right of the background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，其中大型钢结构正在被建造。中间的一台黄色移动式起重机正从左侧的红色平板卡车上吊起一根钢梁。另一台移动式起重机吊着一根红色钢梁，被黄色起重机所包含。卡车上有两个戴红色安全帽的工人，图像右侧还有另外两个戴红色安全帽的工人。地面是泥泞的，带有水坑。背景右侧有一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red hard hat and light-colored uniform, watering a black geotextile fabric that covers the ground with a water hose. In the background, there is a large expanse of open land.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿浅色制服，正用一根黑色胶管状水管向地面浇水。背景中有一大片开阔的空旷的土地。

err.en: black geotextile fabric that covers the

text: The arm and the bucket of an excavator are in the middle. A worker is partially occluded by the excavator's arm and only has his legs visible. A dirt hill is in the background.
zh: 挖掘机的臂和斗篷位于中间。一名工人被挖掘机的臂部分遮挡，仅腿部可见。背景中有一座土丘。

text: The image shows a construction site with at least six workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests. There is a shed in the middle of the image. In the foreground, there are some yellow and black steel beams on the ground. Two tower cranes are present in the background. The construction site in the background has at least one excavator on the right. And the site is covered with blue fabric.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，至少有六名工人可见，均佩戴黄色安全帽并穿着高能见度背心。图像中部有一台塔式起重机。前景地面上有一些黄黑相间的钢梁。背景中有两座塔式起重机。背景中的建筑工地右侧至少有一台挖掘机。并且该工地被蓝色布料覆盖。

err.en: There is a shed in the middle of the ima
err.zh: 图像中部有一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with four individuals standing in the foreground, observing the site. There are three dump trucks in the middle ground; one is actively dumping soil on the left while the other two are stationary with full loads in the middle. A bulldozer is on the right. The ground appears muddy and uneven, with piles of soil scattered throughout the site. In the background, there are buildings and electrical pylons.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有四个人站立着，正在观察工地现场。中景处有三辆自卸卡车；其中一辆正在左侧进行卸土作业，另外两辆则满载着货物停在中景处。右侧有一台推土机。地面看起来泥泞滑且平整，整个工地现场散落着土堆。背景中，有建筑物和电气绝缘子。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the foreground. The bulldozer is positioned on a mound of earth, with its blade full of soil. In the background, there are around five workers scattered across the site on the left. The terrain appears to be uneven and in the process of being graded. The sky is overcast, and the visibility is slightly hazy. There are power transmission towers and a white truck visible on the right of the background.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景有一台黄色色推土机。推土机停在一堆土上，其刀片上满是泥土。背景中，左侧工地上散布着大约五名工人。地形看起来是平整的，并处于整平过程中。天空是阴沉着的，能见度略微朦胧。背景中可见输电塔和一辆白色卡车。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard hats. They are spread out across the site, with some standing and one crouching near large grids of rebar laid out on the ground. The excavation site is surrounded by a retaining wall with sheet piling, and there is a concrete slab in the foreground. The background features a blue fence and a building.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽。他们分散在工地上，有些站着，有一个蹲在铺在地面上的的一大钢筋网格旁。挖掘工地被一道带钢板板的挡土墙围住，前景有一块混凝土板。背景有蓝色围栏和一座建筑物。

err.en: wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: The image shows a loaded red dump truck parked on a concrete path. Three workers are on top of the load on the truck. In the background, two workers are visible. The ground around the truck is uneven and is with various materials scattered around, including a manhole cover, concrete slabs, and a metal grate.
zh: 图像显示一辆装载着红色货物的的卡车停放在一条混凝土路面上。三名工人位于卡车货物上方。在背景中，可以看到两名工人。卡车周围的地面平整，并且散落着各种材料，包括一个孔洞盖板、混凝土试块以及一个金属格栅。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow tower crane in the middle. In the foreground, there are four workers wearing yellow or red hard hats visible. There is a blue shed with white characters on it on the right of the image. In the background, there is another construction site with materials covered with blue fabric. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面中展示了一个建筑工地，中间有一台大型黄色塔式起重机。前景中有四名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人清晰可见。画面右侧有一件蓝色外套，上面有白色字样。背景中还有另一个被蓝色布料覆盖的工地。天空呈现灰白色。

err.en: a blue shed with white characters on it
err.zh: 一件蓝色外套，上面有白色字样

err.en: with materials covered with blue fabric
err.zh: 被蓝色布料覆盖的工地

text: The image shows a top-down view of a construction site with several workers and construction materials. There are seven workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests. Five workers are standing on scaffolding on the right of the image and others are on the ground level on the upper left corner. In the center of the image, there is a pile of construction materials, including rebars and stirrups.
zh: 图像展示了一个自上而下的视角下的建筑工地，现场有多名工人和建筑材料。画面中可见七名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽并穿着安全背心。五名工人站立于画面右侧的脚手架上，其余工人则位于画面左上方的的高处。画面中央堆放着一堆建筑材料，其中包括钢筋和搅拌设备。

err.en: on the ground level on the upper left co
err.zh: 位于画面左上方的的高处

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain in the foreground. There are three red dump trucks visible in the image. In the background, there are several high-rise buildings under construction, with scaffolding visible in the exteriors.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，前景是泥泞土地。画面中可见三辆红色自卸卡车。背景中，有几栋正在建设中的高层建筑，内部可见脚手架。

text: The worker on the left is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 左侧的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with two excavators in operation. On the left, a yellow excavator is digging, and there are two dump trucks to its right. On the right, another excavator is working on a different section of the site along with another dump truck. The terrain is uneven with mounds of earth, and the background features a clear sky and some greenery in the distance. A tall structure with a blue and white pattern can be seen in the background.
zh: 图中显示一个大型土方方施工现场，有两台挖掘机正在作业。左侧，一台黄色挖掘机正在挖掘，其右侧有两辆自卸卡车。右侧，另一台挖掘机正在工地的段作业，并伴随另一辆自卸卡车。地形是平坦的，带有泥土块，背景特征是晴朗的天空和远处的一些绿色植物。背景中可以看到一个蓝色和白色图案的高结构。

err.en: a different section of the site

text: In the image, there are seven individuals with red or white hard hats or straw hats on a construction site. In the foreground, three individuals are crouched down inspecting or working metal rails on the ground. there is a dump truck in the middle of the image. Vehicles, including a blue water truck and a few cars, are visible in the background. The terrain is a cleared dirt area, with dirt slopes on two sides..
zh: 画面中有七名头戴红色、白色安全帽或草帽的人员位于建筑工地上。前景处，三名人员正蹲在地上检查或操作金属栏杆。画面中部有一辆泵车。背景中可见车辆，包括一辆蓝色水罐车以及几辆汽车。地形为一片开阔的泥土地地区，两侧带有泥土质斜坡。

text: The image shows two construction workers with yellow hard hats on top of a structure under construction. The structure has a core made of metal tube scaffolds and has a layer of dimensional lumber and a layer of red plywood sheets on top. Both workers are wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility clothing. Both of them are crouching on top of the plywood sheets and working on the lumber. There are two rebar walls on two sides of the structure. On the left, there is the edge of a concrete platform.
zh: 图像显示两名建筑工人，头戴黄色安全帽，位于建筑下方。该结构由金属管脚手架、一层木板以及顶层红色胶合板组成。两名工人均身着黄色安全帽和高能见度服装。他们两人均在胶合板上方，并在木板上作业。结构两侧有两堵砖墙。左侧有一处混凝土平台边缘。

err.en: on top of a structure under construction

text: A worker in green is not wearing a hard hat on the left.
zh: 绿衣工未戴左侧硬帽

err.en: is not wearing a hard hat

text: The image shows a construction site with around 20 workers. In the foreground, there are two workers wearing red or blue hard hats and safety vests standing on a concrete slab. To the left of them, the base of a tower crane is fenced by orange metal fences. Behind the two workers, there are more than ten workers gathered on the right and at the edge of a concrete platform. Two workers are walking on the stairs fenced by green safety nets on the concrete platform. On the left, there are five workers scattered around the site with one of them standing next to an excavator. In the background, there is one more excavator far away. There are multiple shallow openings with concrete side walls on the ground. The soil in the background is covered with blue tarps.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，周围有大约20名工人。在前景中，有两名工人戴着红色或蓝色安全帽和安全背心，站在混凝土板上。在他们左侧，一台塔式起重机的器的被橙色金属围栏围住。在两名工人后面，有超过十名工人聚集在右边以及在一个混凝土平台边缘。两名工人在混凝土平台上沿着绿色安全网围栏的楼梯上行走。在左边，有五名工人散布在工地周围，其中一名站在挖掘机旁边。在背景中，有一台更远的处的离开的着的的一台挖掘机。在地面上有多个浅开口，带有混凝土侧墙。在背景中的土壤被蓝色覆盖物覆盖着。

err.en: the base of a tower crane is fenced by o
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机的器的被橙色金属围栏围住

err.en: there is one more excavator far away
err.zh: 有一台更远的处的离开的着的的一台挖掘机

text: The image shows a large excavation area with two excavators in operation, digging and moving earth. In the background, the boom of a mobile crane is visible. One individual can be seen standing at the edge of the excavation area on the right side.
zh: 图像显示一个大型挖掘区域，两名挖掘机正在进行作业，挖掘并搬运泥土。背景中可见一台移动吊车的轰鸣声。一个人站在挖掘区域右侧边缘处可见。

err.en: the boom of a mobile crane

text: The image shows a construction site with two green dump trucks. The foreground features one dump truck with a full load, while another is visible in the background. In the background, there is a tower crane, with some trees further back. The ground appears to be wet and muddy, with tire tracks indicating recent activity.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有两辆绿色泵车。前景中有一辆满载货的泵车，另一辆在背景中可见。背景里有一台塔式起重机，更远处有一些树木。地面看起来潮湿且泥泞，带有轮胎印迹，表明近期有活动。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with red-brown soil. There are three excavators visible. A yellow one is in the background, while the other two, one yellow and one blue, are located in the midground on top of a dirt hill. In the background, power lines and vegetation are visible under a hazy sky.
zh: 图像显示一个大型挖掘工地，土壤呈红褐色。可见三名挖掘工。其中一名黄色工位于背景中，另外两名，一名黄色和一名蓝色，位于土丘顶部。背景中可见电线和植被，天空朦胧。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a blue uniform and a red hard hat, holding a hose, and working amidst a muddy construction site under a large structure with steel beams. The ground is uneven and covered with puddles of water and mud. There are hoses running across the ground.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿蓝色制服，头戴红色安全帽，手持软管，正在一处大型钢结构建筑下方的泥泞地施工现场作业。地面平整，覆盖着水坑和泥浆。地面上横着软管。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, one worker with a yellow hard hat is bending over and holding the yellow tube on the left. To the right, there are three more workers. There are two stacks of metal tubes and two stacks of dimensional lumber on the ground. On the right of the background, there is a pile of plywood sheets and more stacks of dimensional lumber and metal tubes. In the background, several other workers are scattered across the site, with three of them in the middle and four of them on the left. A tower crane is erected in the center. Farther in the background, there are urban buildings with two more tower cranes in the middle.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在进行各种作业。前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正弯腰，左手持一根黄色管。其右侧还有三名工人。地面上有两堆金属管和两堆方木。右侧背景处有一堆胶合板以及更多堆放的方木和金属管。背景中，另有几名工人散布在工地各处，其中三人位于中间，四人位于左侧。画面中央竖立着一台塔式起重机。更远处的背景中，可见城市建筑，其中两栋塔式起重机位于中间。

text: The image shows an excavation operation at a construction site. There is a yellow excavator in the process of digging or moving earth. The truck is parked to the left of the excavator in the image with a pile of rocks in front of it on the asphalt road. The operator is visible inside the excavator's cabin. The background features a steep, bare earth slope with some vegetation at the top.
zh: 图像显示一处建筑工地上的挖掘作业。有一台黄色挖掘机正在挖掘或搬运泥土。卡车停在图像中挖掘机的器的左侧，沥青路前有一堆岩石。操作手可见于挖掘机器舱内。背景特征为陡峭的、裸露土坡，顶部有一些植被。

err.en: with a pile of rocks in front of it on t

text: The image shows a construction site where a trench has been dug for pipe installation. There are three workers visible, two of them are wearing yellow or red hard hats and are in the trench to lay bricks. The fourth worker is on the left bank of the excavation trench and can be seen only from the legs. The trench walls are composed of soil and rock. The is a pile of fractured rocks on top of the concrete pipe.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，其中挖掘了一条沟渠用于管道安装。可以看到三名工人，其中两人戴着黄色或红色安全帽，正在沟渠内铺设砖块。第四名工人位于挖掘沟渠的左侧边缘，仅从腿部可见。沟渠壁由土壤和岩石构成。混凝土管道上方有一堆破碎岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers visible. One worker is standing on the ground to the left of a yellow dump truck and two other workers are sitting in the box of the dump truck. To the left, there is a yellow excavator and a pile of plates. The ground is muddy with tire tracks. In the background, there is a white and blue building.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，可见三名工人。一名工人站在黄色泵车的左侧的地面上，另外两名工人坐在泵车的车厢内。左侧有一台黄色挖掘机和一堆钢板板。地面泥泞湿，带有轮胎印痕。背景中有一栋白色和蓝色的建筑。

text: The image shows a large construction site. There is a total of three tower cranes visible, one in the middle and two on the right. The two tower cranes are only partially visible. An excavator is positioned in the middle to the right of a mound of earth. There are multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including wooden planks on the left and right of the image, yellow sheets in the central area, and a large pile of white bricks to the right. There are also two stacks of black materials in the middle and one stack on the right, next to a black pipe. The ground is covered with rebar meshes in the middle near the tower crane.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地。画面中可见三台塔式起重机，其中一台位于中间，另外两台位于右侧。这两台塔式起重机仅部分可见。一台挖掘机位于一堆土方方的中间偏右位置。画面左侧和右侧有多堆建筑材料，包括左侧的木托盘和中央区域的黄色的板材，以及右侧一大堆白色砖块。中间还有两堆黑色材料，右侧有一堆，紧邻一根黑色管道。塔式起重机附近的地面覆盖着钢筋网。

err.en: There are multiple stockpiles of constru
err.zh: 画面左侧和右侧有多堆建筑材料，包括左侧的木托盘

text: The image shows a single excavator positioned on an elevated mound of earth within an excavation site. In the background, two tower cranes are visible, extending across the top portion of the image. The sky appears overcast, and there are several birds in flight. The terrain is uneven, and the soil is reddish-brown.
zh: 图像显示一台挖掘机停在一处位于挖掘场地内的的高土堆上。背景中可见两台塔式起重机横跨图像上部。天空呈现灰白色，并且有几只鸟在飞行。地形是平坦的，土壤是红棕色的。

text: The image shows a construction site with approximately 17 workers, most of them are wearing red hard hats, and a few are with yellow ones. Some workers are congregated in the center while others are dispersed around the site, handling materials or working on the structure. Two workers with yellow hard hats are handling an orange pipe in the middle. There is a large, curved concrete formwork structure supported by scaffolding on the right side of the image. On the left, there is a pile of orange pipes and a stack of metal panels. The background features a large concrete wall with openings, and the overall terrain appears rocky and uneven.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大约有十七名工人，其中大多数戴着红色安全帽，少数戴着黄色安全帽。部分工人在场地中央聚集，其余分散在场地周围，处理材料或进行施工作业。两名戴黄色安全帽的工人在中间搬运一根橙色管道。图像右侧有一个大型弧形混凝土结构，由脚手架支撑。左侧有一堆橙色管道和一堆金属板。背景是一面带有开口的的大型混凝土墙，整体地形看起来崎岖岩且平坦。

text: The image shows more than 20 workers, all wearing red or yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests, distributed across the site. Some are standing or walking on the steel rebar framework that covers much of the ground, while others are gathered in small groups. The rebar framework is on top of a concrete foundation. Red plywood sheets are scattered on the rebar grid. In the background, there is a large yellow tower crane, and the site is surrounded by blue tarps covering mounds of earth. A red pile driver is visible in the far right background. There are multiple pits with concrete side walls on the right of the image. There is an excavator on the right of the image and two more excavators on the left.
zh: 画面中显示有二十多名工人，均佩戴红色或黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度反光背心，分布于整个工地现场。部分人员站立或行走在覆盖大部分地面的区域的上方的钢筋框架上，而另一些人员则聚集在小群体中。钢筋框架位于混凝土基础之上。红色胶合板散落在钢筋网格上。背景中有一台大型黄色塔式起重机，且该工地现场被蓝色防尘网覆盖物所环绕。红色渣土车在画面右侧远处可见。画面右侧存在多个带有混凝土侧壁的的水坑。画面右侧有一台挖掘机，左侧还有另外两台挖掘机。

err.en: blue tarps covering mounds of earth

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible in the foreground. The worker is wearing an orange jumpsuit and a yellow hard hat and is kneeling to work on a small object. The worker is next to a vertical column. Next to the worker, there is a scaffolding structure with metal poles. A rebar wall is behind the worker. In the background, there is a fence made of green fabric.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景中可见一名工人。该工人身穿橙色连体服，头戴黄色安全帽，正跪着对一件小物件进行作业。工人前方是一根竖直立柱。紧挨着工人，有一处脚手架结构，带有金属杆。工人身后是一堵红砖墙。背景中有一道由绿色织物制成的的人行。

text: The image shows an excavation site with uneven terrain and scattered debris. In the center, there is a blue excavator on a hill behind a red truck. The excavator is loading the truck with dirt. A worker is seen on the right side of the image. The background features a partially cloudy sky and some transmission infrastructures in the far distance.
zh: 图像显示一个地形平坦、散落着碎石的挖掘现场。在中心，有一台蓝色挖掘机位于一座小山丘后面，在一辆红色卡车后面。挖掘机正用泥土装载着卡车。在图像的右侧可以看到一名工人。背景特征为部分多云的天空和远处的一些输电结构。

text: The image shows a construction site where a concrete foundation with protruding rebar is visible. There are seven workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests in the image. They are distributed across the site, with some bending over the rebar and others standing. Two workers in the middle are holding a cable. The background features a steep, exposed earth embankment with a blue tarp partially covering it.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，其中可见混凝土基础，带有外露的钢筋。画面中有七名工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度背心，分散在工地各处，有的弯身越过钢筋，有的站立。中间有两名工人正握着一根电缆线。背景中有一处陡峭的、裸露出的土的方的，部分被蓝色防水布覆盖。

err.zh: 陡峭的、裸露出的土的方的

text: The image shows a construction site in a trench or channel with steep rocky sides. There are eleven workers visible; three are standing at the top edge of the trench. In the trench, eight workers are attending to what appears to be a formwork structure of concrete, made of wooden boards and metal tubes. The environment is rocky and barren with pebbles on the ground on the left slope and vegetation on the upper slopes on the right. On the left, there is a river.
zh: 图像显示一个位于沟槽或渠道中的施工现场，两侧为陡峭岩壁。可见有十一名工人；其中三名站在沟槽顶部边缘。在沟槽内，八名工人正在从事看似混凝土成型作业，由木板和金属管构成。环境为岩石质且荒芜凉，左侧斜坡面上有鹅卵石，右侧斜坡面上有植被。在左侧，有一条河流。

text: The image shows a construction site of a tunnel-like structure in an excavation pit. The structure is supported by metal tube scaffolding and has layers wood plank above. There are four workers visible in the foreground, one is walking on the red plywood, and two are working on the right side. The unfinished section of the tunnel has concrete short wall foundations with rebars protruding. A fifth worker with a yellow hard hat is standing there. Construction debris and materials are scattered around the site. In the background, the excavation site is fenced with green nets.
zh: 图像显示一个类似隧道结构的在开挖基坑中的施工现场。该结构由金属管状脚手架支撑，上方有层木板。前景中有四名工人可见，一人走在红色木板上，两人在右侧作业。隧道的完工段有混凝土短墙基础，带有钢筋突出。一名戴黄色安全帽的工人站在那里。施工废料和材料散落在场地周围。背景中，开挖场地用绿色网围护。

err.en: The unfinished section of the tunnel

text: The image shows a visible excavator in the center, which is a KATO HD820 model. A tripod is next to the excavator. On the left, there is a drum roller. In the background, there is a wheel loader. The ground appears to be uneven and consists of exposed soil. The background is hazy, and there are buildings and trees that can be seen in the distance.
zh: 画面中央可见一台挖掘机，该机型为卡特HD820型号。挖掘机前方有一台三脚架。左侧有一台鼓轮。背景中有一台轮式装载机。地面看起来平整，由裸露出的土构成。背景杂乱，远处可见建筑物和树木。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing red hard hats. Two workers on the left are standing on the ground near a pile of sand and next to the entrance of the building, another is in the lower right of the image handling wooden planks. There are bags of cement stacked at the entrance of the building in the upper left of the image. A hole of with a pond of water and two black pipes are in front of the building with a steel framing.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着红色安全帽。左侧的两名单工人站在地面上，靠近一堆沙子，再往建筑物入口处，另一人在画面右下方搬运着木托盘。建筑物入口处在画面左上方堆着几袋水泥。一个带有水塘的孔和两根黑色管道位于带有钢架的建筑物前方。

err.en: Two workers on the left are standing on
err.zh: 左侧的两名单工人站在地面上

text: The image shows a construction site with three yellow excavators in operation, positioned in a line from the foreground to the background. The excavator in the foreground is digging into a mound of earth. There are piles of dirt and construction materials scattered throughout the site. In the background, there are several large concrete pipes lying on the ground. The terrain is uneven and muddy.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三台黄色挖掘机正在作业，从前景到背景呈一线排列。前景的挖掘机正在挖掘一堆泥土。工地上散落着成堆的泥土和建筑材料。背景中，地面上放置着几根大型混凝土管道。地形平坦且泥泞滑。

err.en: The terrain is uneven and muddy.

text: The image shows a group of five workers at a construction site. Four of them are wearing red or yellow hard hats. One individual is holding a piece of paper that might be a plan or a report. The terrain is uneven with exposed earth and a pit on the left. In the background, there is a large building with a distinctive facade, and a lamppost is visible to the left.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地现场，共有五名工人。其中四人戴着红色或黄色的安全帽。一个人手里拿着一张纸，可能是一份施工方案或报告。地面较为平整，左侧有一处裸露土和一个坑洼。背景中有一栋大型建筑，其立面颇具特色，左侧可见一片草坡。

err.en: a lamppost is visible to the left

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers. One worker is walking away from the camera, wearing a red hard hat and dark clothing. The other worker is standing on the right, wearing a camouflage jacket and dark pants. There are multiple lengths of black cables laid out on the ground in parallel lines, with white tubes coiled on and around the black cables. The ground is uneven with rocks and soil, and there is an excavated area with vertical earth retention walls in the background.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人。一名工人正背对镜头走去，头戴红色安全帽，身穿深色衣物。另一名工人站在右侧，身穿迷彩服和深色长裤。地面上平行铺设着多条黑色电缆线，白色管材卷曲在黑色电缆线周围。地面平整，夹杂着岩石和泥土，背景中有一处开挖区域，带有垂直土挡墙。

err.en: The ground is uneven with rocks and soil
err.zh: 地面平整，夹杂着岩石和泥土

text: The person in the middle is not wearing a hard hat and is wearing slippers.
zh: 中间那个人没有戴硬帽，而是戴着护目镜。

text: The image shows a large mobile crane positioned on a wet road surface. The crane is yellow and red. It is situated under an overpass with traffic lights showing red, indicating a stop signal for vehicles. A black car is parked to the right of the crane, and the environment appears overcast.
zh: 图像显示一辆大型移动起重机停在一处潮湿滑的路面上。起重机呈黄色和红色。它位于一座立交桥下方，交通信号灯显示红色，向车辆发出停车信号。一辆黑色轿车停在起重机的右侧，且环境显得被投射下。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site. In the center, there is a mobile crane with a green boom. There are multiple bundles of black rebar organized in rows on the ground to the left of the truck in the middle of the image. To the left and bottom of the image, there are white and yellow metal beams and some more rebars. The ground is mostly dirt with some concrete areas on the top, and there is a blue tarp partially covering some items in the bottom right corner.

One worker is adjusting or inspecting the rebar on the ground level, while another is standing on the ground observing or directing. Two additional workers are on the upper right side. A sixth worker is walking across the site in the upper right corner of the image. The site is filled with extensive rebar frameworks, wooden planks, and formwork. Yellow hard hats are worn by all visible workers.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，前景中有五名工人。一名工人站在横跨钢筋框架的木跳板上。另一名工人正在地面高度处调整或检查钢筋，还有一名工人站在地面上观察或指挥。另外两名工人位于画面右上方。该工地布满了大量钢筋框架、木跳板以及成型作业。所有可见工人都戴着黄色安全帽。

text: The image shows a single bulldozer in the center, actively engaged in earthmoving activities on a construction site with muddy terrain. To the left, there is a pile of debris consisting mainly of branches and earth. A small body of water is visible on the right.
zh: 画面中央是一台单斗轮挖掘机，正在一处泥泞土地质的地的形的建筑工地上积极从事土方作业。左侧有一堆主要由树枝和泥土构成的  的杂物。右侧可见一小股水。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the center, actively engaged in earthmoving work, with a pile of soil in the foreground. The terrain appears to be uneven and muddy. The background features a flat landscape, and the sky is overcast.

There are at least three tower cranes visible in the background, with one crane's arm extending over the building in the middle. The ground appears to be uneven and muddy, with scattered debris and construction materials. There are three workers with red hard hats in the background next to the building in the middle. An excavator is on the right of the image.
zh: 图中展示了一个正在施工的的建筑工地的场景，多栋在建建筑均被绿色篷布和黄色脚手架覆盖。前景处有一辆平板卡车，装载着一棵树，该树被一块彩色防水布覆盖。背景中至少可见三台塔式起重机，其中一台起重机的臂架横跨中间的建筑上方。地面看起来平坦且泥泞滑，散落着碎屑和建筑材料。背景中，有三名戴红色硬帽的工人，位于中间建筑附近。一台挖掘机位于图像右侧。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven and mudd
err.zh: 地面看起来平坦且泥泞滑

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. In the background, there is a bridge with arches. The ground is uneven with various mounds of dirt.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台推土机正在作业，背景中有一座带拱形桥洞的桥梁。地面平整，分布着不同堆状的泥土。

text: The image shows a construction site with one visible excavator in the foreground, which is turquoise in color. The excavator is carrying a sheet in its bucket. In the background, to the left, there are two pile-driving machines standing vertically. A small structure and some construction materials are also visible in the far background on the right. The ground is uneven and muddy.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台挖掘机，呈青绿色。该挖掘机铲斗内装载着一块板材。背景中，左侧有两台垂直放置的压路机。远处右侧背景中还可见一些小型结构及建筑材料。地面平整且泥泞滑。

text: A yellow excavator in the center, engaged in digging soil. The ground is uneven and muddy with a large pit on the right with some standing water. The background is bordered by a wall and vegetation.
zh: 一台黄色挖掘机位于场地中央，正在进行挖掘泥土。地面平坦且泥泞湿，右侧有一个大坑，坑内积存着一些积水。背景由围墙和植被环绕界。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator in the process of digging or moving earth, with its bucket raised and filled with white bags. There is a driver inside the excavator's cabin. To the right of the excavator, there are two individuals standing and observing the work. The ground is uneven with patches of grass, and there are sandbags near the workers and two teal hoses visible on the ground.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土，其铲斗已抬起并装满白色袋子。挖掘机驾驶室内有一名司机。在挖掘机的右侧，有两个人站立并观察着工作。地面是平整的，带有草的斑块，并且在工人附近有一些沙袋，地面上可见两条青色软管子。

text: The image shows a construction site with three visible workers: one on the upper level wearing a yellow hard hat and bending over. Two other workers are below and inside the concrete tunnel, one of whom is wearing a red hard hat. The site is cluttered with construction materials, including piles of wooden planks on the roof of the concrete tunnel and metal rebars on the left excavation bank. The side wall of the concrete tunnel is fenced with metal plates while the unfinished section is fenced with rebar walls. There is a river and a bridge in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三名可见工人：一名在上方，戴着黄色安全帽，弯腰俯身。另外两名工人在下方，位于混凝土隧道内，其中一人戴着红色安全帽。工地杂乱，堆放着建筑材料，包括混凝土隧道屋顶上的成堆的木托盘，以及左侧开挖河岸上的金属钢筋。混凝土隧道的侧墙用金属板围护，而完工部分用钢筋墙围护。背景中有一条河流和一座桥梁。

text: The image shows a worker with a white hard hat standing in front of a teal excavation in the middle. There are two pile drivers in the background with booms extended vertically.

err.zh: 背景中有两堆垂直堆放的轮胎

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers visible. The workers are wearing red hard hats, and are crouching on the top level of the scaffold while working on the installation or inspection of vertical metal studs that are part of a wall framework. The environment includes concrete structural elements above and to the sides, and there is a network of scaffolding below the worker. The site is enclosed with a translucent green mesh.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人可见。工人戴着红色安全帽，在脚手架顶部大声呼喊，同时正在安装或检查作为墙体框架一部分垂直金属杆。环境包括上方和侧面的混凝土结构元素，工人下方有一张脚手架网络。该场地被一层半透明的绿色网罩围住。

text: The image shows a construction site with various heavy machinery. In the foreground, there is a pile of earth. Moving towards the middle ground, there is a pile driver with a yellow body and red boom on the left. In the middle, there are three mobile cranes while the left one is occluded by a pile of rebar cages. On the right, there is another pile driver in front of a stack of orange pipes. In the background, there are at least five arms extended to the ground, some of them belong to mobile cranes while some of them belong to pile drivers. In the far background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，有各种重型机械。前景处有一堆泥土。靠近中间地面处，有一辆黄色车身、红色车斗的卡车。中间有三台移动起重机，其中左侧一台被一堆钢筋笼遮挡。右侧，在几根橙色管道前，还有另一辆卡车。背景中，至少有五台臂架伸向地面，其中一些属于移动起重机，另一些属于卡车。远处背景中有两台塔式起重机。

A blue crawler crane is visible in the midground on the left. To the right of the crawler crane, there is another construction vehicle and an excavator. Next to the excavator are a water truck, a stack of black pipes, and a stack of green pipes. In the background, there is a construction area with two tower cranes. The ground is uneven and covered with dirt, and there are some scattered debris and construction materials.

The terrain appears to be dry and uneven, with various piles of dirt around. In the background, there are power lines and utility poles against a cloudy sky on an embankment.

There are two people visible in the background, standing to the left side and right side of the roller respectively with orange hard hats. The site is scattered with construction materials, including two stacks of dimensional lumber and two stacks of metal tubes. On the edge of the construction site, there is a fence made of green fabric and yellow tubes. The background features a concrete wall and red fences on top.

The site is abundant with construction materials, including piles of white bricks, wooden planks, rebar rolls, and straight rebars. There is a van in the middle of the site next to a pit.
