All workers are wearing yellow hard hats and red uniforms, one is working on the edge of a structure, the second one is standing on the ground, and the third one is near a rebar wall in the upper portion of the image. There is construction material scattered around, including rebars and a red toolbox. The ground shows signs of wear or stains.
zh: 图像显示的是一个建筑工地的俯瞰视角，画面中可见三名工人。所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽和红色工作服，其中一人在结构边缘作业，第二人站在地面上，第三人位于画面上部靠近一面红砖墙。周围散落着建筑材料，包括钢筋和一件红色工具。地面显示出磨损或污渍的痕迹。

text: The image shows an excavator in the center, with its bucket raised and positioned over a dug-up area of earth. There is a driver visible inside the excavator's cabin. The ground around the excavator appears muddy and uneven. In the background, a tower crane can be seen in the upper left corner of the image.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起并悬于挖掘区域上方。挖掘机驾驶室内可见一名司机。挖掘机周围的地面显得泥泞滑且平坦。背景中，图像左上角可见一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a complex framework of brown metal beams. At least six workers are visible, all wearing yellow hard hats; one in red is perched atop the structure, while others are distributed at the lower level of the scaffolding. In the background, there is dense green foliage, and the site is bordered by a blue fence on the left side. There is a pile of materials or debris, and a red pile driver on the ground to the right.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，具有复杂的棕色金属梁框架。至少可见六名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽；其中一人骑在结构上方，其余人员分布在脚手架较低处。背景中有茂密的绿色植被，工地左侧由蓝色围栏界定。有一堆材料或碎屑，以及右侧地面上有一堆红色渣土。

text: The image shows a large construction site with extensive rebar frameworks laid out across the area. The structures are in an excavation pit. There is one worker visible in the center of the image, wearing a yellow hard hat and crouching on top of a platform covered with rebar grids. Surrounding the construction area are retaining walls with green netting at the top. On the farther side of the structure, there are four stacks of red plates and some wooden planks. In the background, there is a row of sheet piles on the left.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，钢筋框架广泛铺设在区域内。结构位于一个基坑内。图像中心可见一名工人，头戴黄色安全帽，站在覆盖着钢筋网的架的平台上。周围是带有绿色防护网的架的挡土墙。在结构的远侧，有四个红色托盘架和一些木托盘。在背景中，左侧有一排钢板桩。

err.en: crouching on top of a platform
err.zh: 站在覆盖着钢筋网的架的平台上

text: The image shows a construction site where a concrete foundation has been laid, with a large area covered by two layers of rebars. There are three rebar walls on the left, right, and the middle of the rebar mesh on the ground. There are eleven workers visible, all wearing yellow or white hard hats, with one wearing a red pair of pants. Some workers are walking across the site, while others are bending or crouching as they work on the rebar. In the background, there is a mound of earth and some trees. Power lines are visible in the upper right corner, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，其中混凝土基础已铺设，大面积被两层钢筋覆盖。左侧、右侧以及钢筋网片的中下部各有三道钢筋墙。可见十一名工人，均佩戴黄色或白色安全帽，其中一人穿着红色裤子。部分工人在工地上行走，而另一些工人则弯腰或蹲伏着，在钢筋上作业。背景中有一堆泥土和一些树木。右上角可见电力线，天空呈现阴沉云状。

err.en: There are three rebar walls on the left,
err.zh: 左侧、右侧以及钢筋网片的中下部各有三道钢筋墙。

text: The image shows a construction worker in a crouched position working on a concrete surface. The worker is wearing a white striped shirt, pants with a camouflage pattern, and a red hard hat. There is visible dust around the area where the worker is using a power tool. Electrical cords are strewn across the ground, and one power tool is lying idle next to the worker on the left. In the background, there is a pile of rubble and debris, and to the right, there is a bundle of construction cables or wires.
zh: 画面中，一名建筑工人正蹲伏着身子，在一处混凝土表面上作业。该工人身穿一件白色条纹衫，一条迷彩图案长裤，头戴一顶红色硬帽。在工人使用电动工具的区域周围，可见有灰尘。一根电线横跨地面延伸，另一根电动工具则闲置置于工人左侧。背景中，有一堆碎石与碎屑，而在右侧，则有一束建筑电缆或电线。

err.en: Electrical cords are strewn across the g
err.zh: 一根电线横跨地面延伸

err.en: one power tool is lying idle next to the
err.zh: 另一根电动工具则闲置置于工人左侧

text: The image shows an active excavation site with an orange excavator positioned on a raised mound of earth, engaged in digging. Adjacent to the excavator is a white and green dump truck. There is a canal in the middle sandwiched by a dry and cracked white surface and an inclined earthen embankment. There is another water body and some trees visible in the background.
zh: 图中显示一个正在作业的的施工场地，一台橙色挖掘机停在一堆隆起的土堆上，正在进行挖掘作业。挖掘机旁边是一辆白绿相的泵送卡车。中间有一条水渠，被干燥开裂的白色地表层和倾斜的岸线所包围。背景中可见另一处水体和一些树木。

text: The image shows an excavation site with a Hyundai excavator on the left side of the image. In the center, there is a large concrete pipe in the excavated trench. At the turning point of the pipe, there is a formwork structure made of red boards and dimensional lumber. Some wooden boards are on the concrete pipe on the left. In the foreground, there is a row of sheet piles. The background features a perimeter fence and power lines.
zh: 图像显示一个挖掘现场，左侧有一台日立建挖掘机。中心位置有一个大型混凝土管道位于挖掘沟槽内。在管道的转弯处，有一个由红板和尺寸木材构成的模板。一些木板位于混凝土管左侧。前景处有一排钢板桩。背景特征为周边围栏和电力线。

text: The image shows a construction site where a large area is covered with a grid of rebar. There are around 20 workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats. They are spread out across the rebar grid, and engaged in various activities such as bending over to work on the rebar or standing and observing the area. In the foreground, there is a stack of rebars. In the middle, some workers are around three openings on the ground with yellow poles inside.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，其中一大片区域被钢筋网格覆盖。周围可见大约20名工人，全都戴着黄色安全帽。他们分散在钢筋网格周围，从事着各种活动，例如弯折钢筋或在钢筋上作业，或站立观察该区域。前景处有一堆钢筋。中部有一些工人在三个地面开口处，里面有着黄色极。

text: A worker is operating a theodolite or total station, mounted on a tripod. The worker is located on top of a retaining wall slope. Above the retaining wall and behind the worker, there is a railway track with gravel bedding and a utility pole with multiple cross arms and wires. The background is filled with dense greenery from trees.
zh: 一名工人正在操作一台道砟或全站仪，该设备架设在三脚架上。工人位于挡土墙边坡坡的顶部。在挡土墙上方及工人后方，设有一条铁路轨道，铺设有道砟垫层，并设有一台带多个横臂及电线的杆的电力杆。背景填充有茂密的绿植丛，源自树木。

err.en: a utility pole with multiple cross arms
err.zh: 一台带多个横臂及电线的杆的电力杆

text: The image shows a bulldozer on a construction site. The surrounding area is characterized by uneven terrain with various piles of dirt and debris. In the background, there is a flat landscape with some water bodies and some greenery.
zh: 图中展示了一台推土机位于建筑工地上。周围区域的特点是地势平坦，伴有各种土堆和碎石。背景中有一些水体和一些绿色植物。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers engaged in activities related to concrete work. There is a long stretch of formwork with vertical rebar in place. There are rocks between the formworks. The formworks are made of panels and reinforced by metal poles. One worker is in the foreground on the top of the formwork, holding onto a concrete hose hanging from above to pour concrete into the rock pile enclosed by the formwork. The other is on the lower level. The ground is uneven and covered with loose rocks and gravel.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人正在进行与混凝土作业相关的的工作。有一根长条状模板，上面竖立着一根钢筋。模板之间夹杂着岩石。模板由面板构成，并由金属杆加固。一名工人位于模板顶部的前景处，手持一根混凝土软管，从上方向模板内的浇筑混凝土，混凝土堆被模板所包围。另一名工人位于较低处。地面平整，覆盖着松散的岩石和碎石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a dirt road leading through it. On the left side of the road, there is one worker wearing a white hard hat. On the right side, there are two trucks; one is a dump truck facing the camera, and the other is a flatbed truck. There are two workers near the trucks on the right. There are large concrete pipes in the background. Moreover, there are buildings and power lines in the distance. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，一条土路从中穿过。道路左侧有一名工人戴着白色安全帽。右侧有两辆卡车；其中一辆是面向镜头的泵车，另一辆是平板床卡车。右侧卡车附近有两名工人。背景中有大型混凝土管道。此外，远处有建筑物和电线。天空阴沉。

text: The image shows a construction site with a tunnel under construction. There are eight workers visible; most are wearing yellow hard hats. They are scattered across the site, and engaged in various activities such as walking and bending over the work areas. The left concrete roof is filled with construction materials, including a pile of wooden planks, and several piles of rebars. The unfinished tunnel has rebar walls on the side, and plywood boards as a temporary roof.
zh: 图中显示一个正在施工的中的隧道工地。可见八名工人；大多数人都戴着黄色安全帽。他们分散在工地各处，并从事各种活动，例如步行和弯曲越过工作区域。左侧混凝土屋顶铺满了建筑材料，包括一堆木托盘，以及几堆钢筋。完工隧道在侧面有钢筋墙，并且胶合板作为临时屋顶。

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers with hard hats in the foreground. They are standing on uneven, muddy ground with patches of grass. In the background, there is an excavator at work on a raised area of dirt. The background also features a row of trees and some buildings.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有四名头戴安全帽的工人。他们站在平坦的泥地上，地上长着一些草。背景中有一台挖掘机正在一处隆起的的高地上作业。背景中还有一排树木和一些建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being leveled. There are five workers visible, all with yellow safety helmets. Four of them are using long-handled tools to spread and smooth the concrete on a large surface. One of them is pouring concrete with a concrete hose hanging from above. The area is surrounded by vertical steel rebar structures. Formwork is visible around the perimeter of the concrete area, and the background shows a soil embankment with a row of sheet piles.
zh: 图中显示一处正在进行混凝土整平的的建筑施工现场。可见五名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽。其中四人正使用长柄工具将混凝土摊铺平并抹光于一大面积。另一人正通过一根悬吊于上方的混凝土软管进行混凝土浇筑。该区域四周由竖向钢制结构包围。在混凝土区域周边可见施工，背景中显示一排土体支护与一排钢板桩。

err.en: Formwork is visible around the perimeter
err.zh: 在混凝土区域周边可见施工

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators, one is orange and the other is yellow. A drum roller is in the middle to the right of the yellow excavator. There is a single individual visible on the right side of the image. The ground is cleared and leveled. In the background, there is a row of fences, beyond which residential buildings are visible.
zh: 图中展示了一个施工现场，有两名挖掘机，一台是橙色的，另一台是黄色。一台鼓轮式压路机位于黄色挖掘机的右侧中间。画面右侧可见一名单独的人员。地面平整且水平。背景中有一排围栏，围栏外可见住宅建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large mobile crane in the center, featuring a red telescopic boom and a yellow carrier. The crane's hook block is visible, hanging near the ground. The ground appears muddy with puddles.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台大型移动式起重机，配备红色伸缩臂和黄色吊臂。起重机的钩块清晰可见，悬挂在地面附近。地面看起来泥泞滑，带有水坑。

text: The image shows a group of nine workers at a construction site engaged in a discussion. They are all wearing white or yellow or blue hard hats. One person in the middle is holding a piece of paper and the person on the left is holding a blue binder. The ground is uneven and scattered with debris, including bricks and rubble. In the background, there are temporary site offices made of white and blue buildings.
zh: 图中显示，九名工人在建筑工地现场正围在一起讨论。他们全都戴着白色或黄色或蓝色安全帽。中间一人手里拿着一张纸，左边一人手里拿着一本蓝色文件夹。地面平整，散落着碎屑，包括砖块和碎石。背景中，有由白色和蓝色建筑搭建的临时工地办公室。

text: The image shows a construction site with two pieces of heavy equipment. On the left, there is a yellow bulldozer positioned on a mound of earth. To the right, an excavator is in the midst of digging, with its bucket in the soil. The background features a metal fence with greenery behind it, and there are power lines running across the top of the image. A tree is visible on the right side, outside the fenced area. The ground appears uneven with patches of vegetation and exposed soil.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，有两台重型型设备。左侧，一台黄色推土机停在一堆土上。右侧，一台挖掘机正在挖掘中，其铲斗位于泥土中。背景中有一道金属围栏，其后方有绿色植物，并且有电力线横跨图像顶部。右侧可见一棵树，位于围栏外。地面显得平整，带有植被斑块和裸露出的土壤。

text: The image shows a construction site where a foundation is being prepared. There are four workers visible; three of them are wearing orange overalls and one is wearing a white shirt with dark pants. All workers are wearing yellow safety helmets. They are working on rebars that are laid out in a grid pattern. Behind them is a retaining wall made of metal sheet piles. The side wall of the structure is made of panels supported by metal poles from both the outside and inside.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，正在准备基础。可见有四名工人；其中三人穿着橙色工作服，一人穿着白色衬衫配深色裤子。所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽。他们正在处理钢筋，这些钢筋以网格状排列。他们身后是一堵由金属板堆砌成的挡土墙。该侧墙由金属板支撑，从外侧和内侧两侧均可见。

err.en: The side wall of the structure is made o
err.zh: 该侧墙由金属板支撑，从外侧和内侧两侧均可见。

text: The image shows an excavation site with a single yellow mini excavator in the center, actively digging into a mound of earth. The excavator is positioned on a pile of dirt, with its arm extended and bucket engaged in the soil. In the background, there is a residential or industrial area. The ground around the excavator appears uneven and dug up.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，中央有一台黄色色小型挖掘机正在向一堆泥土中挖掘。挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其臂和铲斗正接触着土壤。背景中有一处住宅或工业区域。挖掘机周围的地面显得平整且被挖起。

text: The image shows a construction site with a teal excavator in the foreground. The excavator's arm is extended, and its bucket is in a raised position. In the background, there are two pile driving machines. The ground appears to be uneven and dug up. In the foreground, there is a pile of dirt.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景中有一台青绿色的挖掘机。挖掘机的的手臂伸展，其铲斗处于抬起位置。背景中有两台压路机。地面看起来平整且被挖起。前景中有一堆泥土。

text: The image shows a construction site of a rebar framework. The site is surrounded by a fence made of yellow scaffolding and green fabric on the right, and there is a construction crane in the background on the left side. There are eight workers visible, all wearing hard hats. Six of the workers are crouching in the foreground on the rebar mesh. Two workers are in the background, one of them is on the left near the tower crane, and another is next to the fence. There is a stack of rebars in the foreground and a pile of other material in the upper left corner near the tower crane. The environment looks overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个正在建设中的钢筋框架工地。工地右侧被黄色脚手架和绿色布料围住，左侧背景中有一台施工吊车。画面中可见八名工人，全都戴着安全帽。其中六名工人在前景的钢筋网上聚集着。两名工人在背景中，其中一人位于左侧靠近塔吊的位置，另一人则靠近围栏边。前景处有一堆钢筋，左上角靠近塔吊处还有一堆其他材料。环境显得杂乱无章。

text: The image shows a construction site with at least eight workers and construction equipment. All workers are wearing hard hats and green jackets. In the foreground, two workers are near a machine that is applied to the freshly poured concrete. In the background, other workers are engaged in various activities, with one on the left holding a concrete hose to pour concrete. There is a large concrete pump truck with its boom extended towards the left side of the image. Yellow scaffolding and green safety nets surround the perimeter of the construction area, and the construction site is enclosed by concrete walls. There are three tower cranes in the background on the right next to buildings under construction.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，至少有八名工人和施工设备。所有工人都戴着安全帽和穿着绿色工作服。在前景中，两名工人靠近一台用于新浇筑混凝土的机器。在背景中，其他工人正从事各种活动，其中左侧一人拿着一根混凝土软管用于浇筑混凝土。有一辆大型混凝土泵车，其车头朝向图片左侧延伸展开。黄色脚手架和绿色安全网环绕着施工区域的周边，并且该建筑工地被混凝土墙围起来。在背景右侧有三台塔式起重机，紧邻正在施工中的建筑物。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with an excavator positioned on a dry, cracked water bed near a puddle on the right. There is an excavated area next to the puddle. The excavator is situated in the middle of the image. A dirt road runs parallel to the river on the left.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的航拍视角，一台挖掘机位于干燥、开裂的河床附近，右侧有一处水坑。挖掘机前方是待挖掘区域。挖掘机位于图像中央。一条土路在左侧与河流平行延伸。

err.en: There is an excavated area next to the p
err.zh: 挖掘机前方是待挖掘区域

text: The image shows a construction site with eight workers visible working on a canal structure. Five workers are in the canal structure enclosed by rebar walls and metal panels on the sides. Two workers in the foreground are climbing up the hill of the excavation bank. There is a significant amount of construction debris and materials scattered on the excavation bank in the foreground, including wooden planks and rebar. In the background, there is a structure with blue fences in the upper right behind a worker with a red hard hat.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，有八名工人正在一条运河结构上作业。五名工人在运河结构内，被围在侧面的由钢筋墙和金属板。前景中的两名工人正在攀爬挖掘堤岸的山丘。前景中的挖掘堤岸上散落着大量的施工废料和材料，包括木托盘和钢筋。在背景中，在一名戴红色安全帽的工人身后，有蓝色围栏的结构。

text: The image shows two tower cranes in the background. There is a large construction area behind a yellow safety barrier in the foreground. The middle ground is covered with blue tarps. Two piles of precast concrete piles are near the blue tarps. A concrete platform is behind the concrete piles. On the left, there is a concrete platform. A construction area enclosed by yellow fences is positioned on top of the platform. In the background, the construction area is fenced by white fences.
zh: 背景中可见两台塔式起重机。前景处有一大片大型施工区域，被一道黄色安全屏障遮挡。中间地面覆盖着蓝色防水布。蓝色防水布附近有两堆预拌混凝土料堆。混凝土料堆后方是一个混凝土平台。左侧有一个混凝土平台。平台顶部设有一处由黄色围栏围合的施工区域。背景中，施工区域被白色围栏围合。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and red uniforms. One worker is kneeling on the ground in the foreground, three are standing against a wall, and the fifth one is standing behind a yellow scaffolding. The site is cluttered with various construction materials, including numerous wooden planks and a mix of different metal tubes scattered across the ground. There are two stacks of rebars on the ground in the foreground. There is a concrete wall in the background, and a blue sign with white characters is partially visible in the upper right corner.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有五名工人戴着黄色安全帽和红色工作服。一名工人跪在前景的地面上，三名靠着一面墙站着，第五名站在黄色脚手架后面。工地杂乱地堆放着各种建筑材料，包括许多木托盘和散落在地面不同金属管的。前景地面上有两堆钢筋。背景中有一面混凝土墙，右上角部分可见一块带有白色字符的蓝色标志。

err.en: a mix of different metal tubes scattered
err.zh: 散落在地面不同金属管的

text: The image shows a construction site with a white dump truck in the foreground, its bed raised as it unloads soil onto a large pile. In the background, there is a white van parked on a higher level of terrain. The ground appears muddy, and there are construction materials scattered around in the lower left corner of the image, including some metal beams and wooden planks. The sky is overcast, suggesting cloudy weather conditions.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一辆白色自卸卡车，其车斗正在将泥土卸载到一大堆上。背景中，有一辆白色面包车停放在地势较高的处。地面显得泥泞滑，且图像左下角散布着一些建筑材料，包括一些金属梁和木托盘。天空阴沉，暗示着多云天气状况。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in operation. On the left, a yellow Komatsu excavator is digging into the ground. In the center and right of the image, a blue excavator is loading soil into the bed of a dump truck. There are three dump trucks in total on the scene; one is being loaded, and the other two, are waiting on the right. The operators are inside the cabs of the excavators and dump trucks. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and piles of soil. Trees and a fence can be seen in the background.
zh: 画面显示一个施工场地，有两名挖掘机正在作业。左侧一台黄色的小松挖掘机正在向地面挖掘。画面中央偏右位置，一台蓝色的挖掘机正在将泥土装载到一辆自卸卡车上。场景中总共有三辆自卸卡车；其中一辆正在装载，另外两辆停靠在右侧。操作员位于挖掘机和自卸卡车的驾驶室内。地面平整，可见车辙和土堆。背景中可以看到树木和围栏。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers visible. In the foreground, a large area is covered with a grid of rebar. To the left, a jacket is hung on the vertical rebar. In the center, four workers wearing yellow hard hats are inspecting or measuring rebars. Three of them are crouching while one is standing. To the right, two additional workers are engaged in tasks near the rebar wall. In the background, there is a sloped concrete structure with a row of trees on top of it.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见六名工人。前景处有一大片区域被钢筋网格覆盖。左侧，一件夹克衫挂在竖直钢筋上。中央，四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在检查或测量钢筋。其中三人正在呼喊，另一人站立着。右侧，另外两名工人正在钢筋墙附近从事作业。背景中，有一处倾斜的混凝土结构，其顶部有一排树木。

text: The image shows a large construction site with at least ten workers visible, wearing safety vests and hard hats. Some are working on the ground, while others are on an elevated concrete platform on the right. The site is scattered with construction materials, including rebars and protective tarps. There are multiple foundation pits in the foreground. There is an excavator in the middle distance on a mound of dirt near the tarps. In the middle, a stack of precast concrete piles are to the left of the concrete platform. Seven tower cranes are erected in the background. Buildings and cranes can be seen in the far background.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，至少有十名工人可见，他们穿着安全背心和硬帽子。一些人在地面上工作，而另一些人在右侧一个抬高的混凝土平台上。工地散布着建筑资料，包括钢筋和保护性塔普斯。前景中有多个基础坑。在中间距离处，一台挖掘机在一个土丘上靠近塔普斯。在中间，一堆预制混凝土堆在混凝土平台的左侧。七座塔楼在背景中竖立。建筑和塔楼可在远处背景中看见。

text: The image shows two individuals at a construction site under a shelter. On the left, a person wearing a red hard hat and light blue shirt is standing facing towards the right side of the image where the second person is located. The second individual, also wearing a red hard hat along with a dark shirt, is operating a rebar bending machine. There are multiple bundles of straight and bent rebars on the ground around them. A blue banner with Chinese characters is visible in the background. TA puddle of water is on the left.
zh: 图像显示两名工人在一处工地的遮阳棚下。左侧一名工人戴着红色安全帽，身穿浅蓝色衬衫，正面向图像右侧，即第二名工人所在的一侧站立。第二名工人同样戴着红色安全帽，身穿深色衬衫，正在操作一台钢筋弯曲机。他们周围地面上散落着多根笔直的和弯曲的钢筋。背景中可见一面印有汉字的样的式的蓝色横幅。左侧有一摊水。

err.en: A blue banner with Chinese characters
err.zh: 一面印有汉字的样的式的蓝色横幅

text: The image shows a construction site with some mobile cranes in the center, with two booms with different colors extended upwards. In the background, the jib of a tower crane is visible. A white car is parked in the foreground. On the left, the bed of truck can be seen next to a mobile crane.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中心位置有一些移动缆索，还有两台不同颜色的吊臂向上延伸。背景中可以看到一台塔式起重机的。前景处停着一辆白色汽车。左侧可以看到一辆卡车的，紧挨着一台移动起重机。

err.en: the jib of a tower crane

text: The image shows a construction site. There are five heavy construction vehicles in the center of the image: two articulated dump trucks in the foreground, one with a white cab and the other with a green cab, a drum roller, and a bulldozer. In the background, to the right, there is another dump truck driving. On the left, there is a building under construction covered by scaffolding and green netting. There is also an excavator behind a dump truck on the left. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and mounds of dirt. The background features a large white structure and a crane in the far distance. The sky is clear with a few clouds.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地。画面中央共有五台重型型施工车辆：前景处有两辆自卸式泵车，其中一辆为白色驾驶室，另一辆为绿色驾驶室；一台鼓式压路机；以及一台推土机。背景右侧，还有一辆自卸式泵车正在行驶。左侧，有一栋正在施工中的建筑物，被脚手架和绿色网罩覆盖。左侧自卸式泵车后方还有一台挖掘机。地面平整，可见车辙和泥土堆。背景中有一栋大型白色结构物和远处的一台起重机。天空晴朗，有几朵云。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a white hard hat and a black jacket, standing with their back to the camera, operating surveying equipment on a construction site. The surveying equipment is a receiver mounted on a pole. In the background, there is an excavator and a loader. The ground is uneven and covered with rocks and red soil.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴白色安全帽，身穿黑色夹克，背对镜头站在建筑工地上，操作测量设备。该测量设备是一台安装在杆子上的接收机。背景中有一台挖掘机和一台装载机。地面平整，覆盖着岩石和红土。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers visible, all wearing safety vests and hard hats. In the foreground, one worker is handling bricks near a partially constructed structure, while two others are standing. In the background, two workers are near a large pile of sand partially covered by blue tarps. On the right, the worker with a white hard hat is next to an excavator. In the background, two more excavators can be identified with their arms.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见六名工人，均佩戴安全帽并穿着反光背心。前景中，一名工人正搬运砖块，靠近一处部分建成的结构，另有两名工人站立。背景中，两名工人靠近一大堆沙堆，部分被蓝色防水布覆盖。右侧，一名戴白色安全帽的工人正走向一台挖掘机。背景中，可辨认出另外两台挖掘机，其臂部特征明显。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators visible; one is positioned in the foreground, and the other is on a mound of earth in the background. There is one worker standing on the mound of earth near the excavator in the background. A large pile of excavated soil is present in the center of the image. In the background, there is a building with a dark facade. A utility pole with wires is also visible in the foreground. There is a body of water at the bottom right of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有两台挖掘机可见；其中一台位于前景，另一台位于背景中的土堆上。背景中土堆附近有一台挖掘机旁站着一名工人。图像中央有一大堆挖掘出的泥土。背景中有一栋深色外墙面的建筑。前景中还可见一根带电线杆的电线杆。图像右下角有一处水洼。

err.zh: 一根带电线杆的电线杆

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow SANY road roller in the foreground and a Hitachi excavator in the background on the left. There are three workers visible, one is in the foreground on the right, wearing a white hard hat and clearing the ground with a shovel. The other two workers are in the background. There are piles of earth scattered around the site, and some construction debris is visible on the ground. Trees and lampposts can be seen in the far background. A fallen tree is next to the lampposts.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景有一台黄色压路滚轮，左侧背景中有一台日立挖掘机。可见三名工人，其中一人位于前景右侧，头戴白色安全帽，手持铁锹清理地面。另外两名工人位于背景中。工地周围散落着土堆，地面上可见一些建筑废料。远处背景中可见树木和草皮。一棵倒下的树位于草皮旁边。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers in the middle ground next to the embankment. A survey equipment mounted on a yellow tripod is on the left in the foreground. Two excavators are operating on the right. The ground appears muddy with some standing water. A bridge is visible in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，两名工人正在进行基坑开挖作业。前景左侧有一台架设在黄色三脚架上的测量设备。右侧有两名挖掘机正在作业。地面显得泥泞湿，有积水。远处背景中可见一座桥梁。

err.en: two workers in the middle ground next to
err.zh: 两名工人正在进行基坑开挖作业

text: The image shows a construction site with two pieces of heavy machinery. On the left, there is an excavator, and on the right, there is a mobile crane with its boom and jib stowed. The ground is uneven and covered with gravel and dirt. In the background, there are trees with yellow leaves and a construction fence, behind which various construction-related materials and structures can be partially seen. A tower crane is visible in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，有两台重型型机械。左侧是一台挖掘机，右侧是一台移动式起重机，其吊臂和吊钩清晰可见。地面平整，覆盖着碎石和泥土。背景中有一些树木，长着黄叶，以及一道施工围栏，其后可部分看到各种施工相关材料和结构。远处背景中可见一台塔式起重机。

err.en: with its boom and jib stowed
err.zh: 其吊臂和吊钩清晰可见

text: The image shows a construction site with a large mobile crane in the center, its boom extended upwards. In the foreground, there are two trucks; the one on the left ise a dump truck, and the one on the right is a blue cargo truck. There are two workers with yellow hard hats visible; one is walking on the right carrying a roll of black rope, and the other is standing close to the crane. There is a stack of metal panels and a stack of gray bricks on the right. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台大型移动式起重机，其吊臂向上延伸。前景处有两辆卡车；左侧那辆是混凝土搅拌车，右侧那辆是一辆蓝色货车。可见两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人；其中一人正向右行走，肩扛着一卷黑色绳索，另一人则站在起重机附近。右侧堆放着一摞金属板材和一摞灰色砖块。天空呈灰白色。

err.en: carrying a roll of black rope

text: The image shows a construction site. A pile driver is in the foreground with its boom raised. There is a blue excavator to the right of the pile driver. A tower crane can be seen in the background.
zh: 图片显示的是一个建筑工地。前景中有一堆钢筋，其吊斗已升起。钢筋堆右侧有一台蓝色挖掘机。背景中可以看到一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers in the foreground. They are standing on formworks made of metal panels and supported by metal poles.The two workers on the right are holding an orange hose together. Behind them is a large pond with fractured rocks inside with several protruding metal rods. Two suspended red platforms are near the concrete wall in the background. The ground is uneven with visible water accumulation and scattered debris, including rocks and broken concrete.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有三名工人。他们站在由金属板制成的并受金属杆支撑的脚手架上。右侧的两名为工人正握着一根橙色软管。他们身后是一个大池塘，里面有破碎的岩石，并伸出几根金属杆。靠近混凝土墙处悬挂着两个红色平台。地面平整，可见积水积聚，散落着碎屑，包括岩石和破碎的混凝土。

text: The image shows a construction site with various heavy machinery and equipment. In the foreground, there is a large pile of earth and a single worker standing near the machinery. A crawler crane with a blue boom is positioned on the left side of the image, while a yellow excavator is located in front of it, lifting a pile of red pipes with its arm. There are more red pipes next to the excavator. To the right of the excavator, there is a yellow bulldozer, an excavator, and a stack of green pipes. In the middle of the image, there is a bulldozer and a drumroller in the front, a water truck, and a stack of corrugated black pipes behind them. On the right, there is a green dump truck in the foreground, and a stack of black pipes in the background along with a person. In the far background, residential buildings under construction can be seen, with two tower cranes visible.
zh: 画面展示了一个施工现场，现场分布着各种重型机械和设备。前景处有一大堆泥土，一名工人正站在机械旁。一台蓝色吊臂的履带式起重机位于画面左侧，一台黄色挖掘机正位于其前方，用其吊臂吊起一堆红色管道。挖掘机旁边还有更多红色管道。挖掘机右侧有一台黄色推土机、一台挖掘机，以及一堆绿色管道。画面中部有一台推土机和一台鼓轮车位于其前方，一辆水车，以及一堆带锈迹的黑色管道位于其后方。右侧前景处有一辆绿色泵车，以及一堆黑色管道位于背景中，旁边还有一个人。远处背景中可以看到正在施工中的住宅建筑，其中两座塔吊臂清晰可见。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being poured by the worker with striped clothes on the right. There are five workers visible in total, four of them are on top of the structure covered with rebar grids. A concrete pump hose is in the center of the image delivering concrete to the site. The workers are spread out across the area. In the background, there is a blue barrier surrounding the site, and vegetation can be seen beyond the barrier.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，右侧一名身穿条纹衫的工人正在浇筑混凝土。画面中总共可见五名工人，其中四名位于上方，被钢筋网覆盖。画面中央有一根混凝土泵管，正在向工地输送混凝土。工人们在区域内分散开来。背景中，工地周围有一道蓝色围挡，挡墙之外可见植被。

err.en: four of them are on top of the structure
err.zh: 其中四名位于上方，被钢筋网覆盖

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing yellow hard hats. Both workers are holding tools. There is an yellow excavator parked on the site. The ground is uneven with scattered debris and rocks.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。两名工人均手持工具。现场停放着一台黄色挖掘机。地面平整，散落着碎石和岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a group of workers engaged in various activities. There are at least ten workers visible, most of them wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility clothing. Some workers are standing on the foundation structure made of metal poles, handling materials or tools, while others are walking along the site. The construction site has a large amount of rebar framework in place on two sides and the floor. The environment is hazy and the ground appears wet and muddy. There are construction materials scattered around, such as metal plates and rebar.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一组工人正在进行各种作业。画面中至少可见十名工人，其中大多数头戴黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度工作服。部分工人站在由金属杆、管材或工具构成的的高台上，而另一些工人则在工地内行走。工地两侧设有大量钢筋框架，地面铺设有楼板。环境显得杂乱，地面看起来潮湿且泥泞滑。周围散落着建筑材料，例如金属板和钢筋。

err.en: foundation structure made of metal poles
err.zh: 由金属杆、管材或工具构成的的高台

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator on the right side and a dump truck on the left side. The background features an open field with a water body, and the ground in the foreground is uneven with visible gravel and dirt.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，右侧有一台挖掘机，左侧有一辆自卸卡车。背景是一片开阔的场地，带水体的，前景地面平整，可见碎石和泥土。

err.en: the ground in the foreground is uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with three tower cranes and scaffolding structures. The scaffolding is extensive, with numerous vertical and horizontal poles creating a grid-like framework around an unfinished building.
zh: 图中展示了一个建筑工地，现场有三台塔式起重机和脚手架结构。脚手架规模庞大，由众多垂直和水平杆件构成一个围绕已完工建筑的的网络状框架。

text: The image shows a teal-colored Kobelco excavator on a raised dirt platform, in the process of loading soil into the bed of a red dump truck. The background is relatively barren with some sparse vegetation. A yellow flag is waving in the upper left corner of the image.
zh: 一台青绿色的凯贝尔（Kobel）挖掘机停在一处抬高的土台上，正在将泥土装载到一辆红色自卸卡车的车斗中。背景相对荒芜凉，有一些稀疏的植被。一面黄色旗在图像的左上角处飘扬。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the foreground, positioned on a dirt track. In the background, there is a large scaffolding structure with green netting. There is a concrete foundation visible at the base of the scaffolding. To the left of the bulldozer, partially out of view, there is an orange excavator.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台黄色压路机停在一处土质轨道上。背景中有一个大型脚手架结构，上面覆盖着绿色防护网。在脚手架的底部可见一处混凝土基础。在压路机的左侧，部分被遮挡，有一台橙色挖掘机。

text: The image shows two mobile cranes parked on a wet construction site. Both of them have a yellow body and a red boom. One of them is on the left of the foreground while the other is in the middle and partially occluded by the left one. There is a blue truck on the right. In the background, there is an overpass and a stationary tower crane. The foreground features a set of metal plates lying on the ground. A row of yellow metal fences is in the middle of the image next to the vehicles.
zh: 图像显示两台移动起重机停放在潮湿的建筑工地上。它们都有黄色的车身和红色吊臂。其中一台位于前景左侧，另一台位于中间，并被左侧那台部分遮挡。右侧有一辆蓝色卡车。背景中有一辆过路车辆和一台静止的塔式起重机。前景地面上放着一组金属板。车辆前方有一排黄色金属围栏。

err.en: in the middle of the image next to the v

text: The image shows an unfinished canal structure in a deep excavation pit. There are around ten workers visible, wearing hard hats and high-visibility clothing, engaged in various activities such as bending over to workers on rebar frameworks, walking across the site, and standing while observing or performing tasks. On the left, the finished section has a concrete base and concrete side walls with rebars protruding from the walls. A worker is bending over to handle the metal plates on the ground. The unfinished section features a large rebar framework laid out on the ground with rebar side walls. A row of sheet piles acts as a retaining wall. The surrounding area is bordered by a blue fence, and there is a pile of bricks in front of the blue fence. The background features some greenery and overcast skies.
zh: 图像显示一个位于深基坑中的已完工运河结构。周围可见约十名工人，头戴安全帽，身穿高能见度工作服，正从事各种活动，例如跨越钢筋框架、在场地间行走，以及站立观察或执行任务。左侧，已完工部分具有混凝土基础和混凝土侧墙，钢筋从墙体中伸出。一名工人正跨越地面上的的一块金属板。已完工部分特征为大型钢筋框架铺设在地面上，带有钢筋侧墙。一排钢板桩作为挡土墙。周边区域由蓝色围栏界定，蓝色围栏前方有一堆砖块。背景中有一些绿植类和晴朗的天空。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large tower crane in the center, its boom extending across the frame. Below the crane, there are multiple workers scattered across the site, all wearing hard hats and engaged in various activities on the rooftop, which is filled with construction materials and formwork. In the background, there are high-rise buildings, and the overall atmosphere appears to be overcast or hazy.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面框架。起重机下方，有多名工人散布在工地各处，均佩戴安全帽，并在屋顶从事各项作业，屋顶堆满建筑材料，形成作业面。背景中可见高层建筑，整体氛围显得阴沉郁或朦胧雾。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the foreground, which is not currently in operation as the bucket is resting on the ground. There is a pile driver in the background, standing idle. The ground appears to be muddy with some tracks visible. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台挖掘机，其桶斗目前静置于地面上。背景中有一台钻机，处于闲置状态。地面看起来泥泞湿，可见一些车辙印迹。天空笼罩于上方。

text: The image shows a close-up of a yellow construction bulldozer with the brand "SHANTUI" on the back, positioned on muddy terrain. The bulldozer's tracks are caked with mud. To the left, there is a partially visible dump truck, also covered in mud. In the background, several motorcycles park in the background with a viaduct in the far background. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面特写了一台黄色施工推土机，其品牌标识“shantui”位于机身身后方，停放在泥泞地地形上。推土机的履带沾满了泥浆。左侧，有一辆部分可见自卸卡车，同样被泥覆盖。背景中，几辆摩托车停放着，远处背景中有一辆拖拉机。天空阴沉云密布。

text: The image shows an orange Hitachi excavator in the center, actively engaged in earthmoving work at a construction site. The excavator is positioned on a flat, cleared area of reddish-brown soil, with its bucket in the process of shoveling the soil. In the background, there is a large, sloped embankment of similar reddish-brown soil.
zh: 画面中央是一台橙色的日立挖掘机，正在一处建筑工地上进行土方作业。挖掘机停在一块平坦、开阔的红褐色土地区域上，其铲斗正在铲起泥土。背景中有一大片大型、倾斜的类似红褐色土的方的。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers. The worker in the foreground is wearing a red hard hat with a headlamp attached to it, and a dust mask, and is holding a tool. The second worker, in the background, is wearing camouflage clothing and a red hard hat. The third worker is standing on top of the concrete platform on the right. There is a power tool on the concrete platform near the second worker, and the hose runs across the concrete surface towards this tool. There is an exposed earth embankment on the left side. The two workers with red hard hats are in the space between the embankment and the concrete platform.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人。前景中的工人戴着一顶红色安全帽，上面装有头灯，并戴着防尘口罩，手里拿着一件工具。背景中的第二名工人穿着迷彩服，戴着一顶红色安全帽。第三名工人站在右侧混凝土平台上方。混凝土平台靠近第二名工人的处有一件电力工具，软管子横跨混凝土表面伸向这件工具。左侧有一处外露出的土埋设。两名戴红色安全帽的工人位于埋设和混凝土平台之间的。

err.en: between the embankment and the concrete
err.zh: 位于埋设和混凝土平台之间的

text: The image shows a construction site with ten workers wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard hats. On the left, seven workers are on a concrete slab with steel rebars laid out in a grid pattern. The rebar grid is in the middle of the concrete slab. One worker in the foreground is pulling a long rebar. In the center, a row of rebars is erected vertically. On the right, two workers are interacting with a truck-mounted crane that is lifting a stack of rebars, while another worker stands nearby. Bundles of rebars are visible on the ground next to the crane. The construction site is bordered by a retaining wall made of a row of sheet piles on the left.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有十名工人戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽。在左侧，七名工人在一块混凝土板上，钢条钢筋被布置成网格状。钢筋网格位于混凝土板的的中部。前景中有一名工人正在拉一根长钢筋。在中心，一排钢筋被垂直竖立起来。在右侧，两名工人正在与一辆卡车吊机互动，该吊机正吊起一摞钢筋，同时另一名工人站在附近。一摞钢筋可见于吊机旁边的地面上。该建筑工地被一道由一排钢板桩构成的挡土墙所包围，位于左侧。

err.en: wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: The image shows a yellow excavator on the left, actively digging dirt, with its bucket filled with dirt in a raised position. A yellow dump truck is positioned in the middle of the image and to the right of the excavator. The ground surrounding the excavator and the truck is uneven and muddy. On the right, there is a stack of sandbags with a distribution box on top of it. In the background, there is a second excavator on a mound of dirt in the excavation trench. An orange machine covered with translucent fabric is in the foreground in the lower left corner of the image.
zh: 图像左侧有一台黄色挖掘机，正在积极挖掘泥土，其铲斗内装满泥土，处于抬起位置。一台黄色自卸卡车位于图像中部，在挖掘机的右侧。挖掘机和卡车周围的地面平坦且泥泞滑。右侧有一堆沙袋，其顶部有一个分配箱。背景中，在挖掘沟内有一台第二台挖掘机，位于土堆上。前景左下角有一台橙色机器，覆盖着半透明织物。

text: The image shows a site with a yellow excavator in the center, actively digging earth, and its bucket is full of earth. A worker with a red hard hat is in the lower left corner near a green hose. The background features a white fence with some vegetation growing in front of it, and beyond the fence, there are utility poles and wires. In the foreground, a green hose traverses across the ground, and there is a patch of water in the lowe rleft. The overall terrain is uneven.
zh: 画面中央有一台黄色挖掘机正在挖掘泥土，其铲斗内装满泥土。左下角有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人，靠近一根绿色水管。背景中有一排白色围栏，其前方生长着一些植被，围栏外还有电线杆和电线。前景中一根绿色水管横穿地面，左下角有一滩水洼。整体地形平坦。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large tower crane in the background. There are at least ten workers visible, all wearing orange safety gear and hard hats. Four workers are on the roof of the tunnel in the middle, while others are on the ground level. On the left of the image, the entrance of the tunnel is visible with concrete short walls and metal poles inside. Metal plates reinforced with metal poles cover the surface of the tunnel structure. A worker in the foreground is working on the metal pole. In the foreground, there is construction debris and materials scattered around, including wooden planks and rebar. There is also a trolley with two pieces of wooded board. On the right, there are two piles of rebars.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，背景中有一台大型塔式起重机。画面中至少可见十名工人，均佩戴橙色安全帽和硬质安全帽。四名工人位于隧道中段的顶部，其余工人则处于地面层。在图像左侧，可见隧道入口，配有混凝土短墙和内部金属杆。金属板加固着金属杆，覆盖着隧道结构。前景中一名工人正在操作金属杆。在前景中，周围散落着建筑废料和材料，包括木托盘和钢筋。此外还有一台手推车，载有两块木质板材。在右侧，有两堆钢筋。

err.en: orange safety gear and hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽和硬质安全帽

err.en: Metal plates reinforced with metal poles
err.zh: 金属板加固着金属杆，覆盖着隧道结构

text: The image shows a construction site where six workers are poured and leveled concrete. Four of the workers are leveling concrete, two of them are using a long piece of wood and two others are using hoes. One worker is sitting in the lower right corner. The sixth worker on the left is holding a concrete hose hanging from above. The concrete hose with a red boom is delivering concrete to the site. The background features a large dirt pile.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，六名工人正在浇筑并找平混凝土。其中四名工人在找平混凝土，两人使用长木块，另外两人使用锤子。一名工人坐在右下角。左侧的第六名工人正持着一根混凝土软管，从上方垂下。带有红色喇叭的混凝土管正在向工地输送混凝土。背景中有一大堆泥土。

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively engaged in land clearing or grading work. To the right of the bulldozer, there is a large pile of brush and debris. In the background, two individuals can be seen at a distance from the machinery. The terrain appears to be uneven and recently disturbed.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台推土机，正在进行清土或整地作业。推土机右侧有一大堆碎屑和渣土。背景中，远处可见两名人员位于机械旁。地形看起来平整且近期受到扰动。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the center, wearing a blue shirt and a white hard hat, kneeling and working on a gravel-covered area. To the left, there is a large, displaced concrete pipe lying on the ground. An excavator's arm and bucket are visible on the right side of the image. The ground appears muddy with visible tire tracks, and there are piles of earth in the background. The surrounding area has some vegetation, and there is a blue structure in the far background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，画面中央有一名工人，身穿蓝色衬衫，头戴白色安全帽，正跪坐在铺满碎石的地面上作业。左侧地面上横放着一根粗大的混凝土管道。画面右侧可见挖掘机的的手臂和料斗。地面显得泥泞污，带有明显的轮胎印迹，背景中还有成堆的泥土。周边区域长有一些植被，远处背景中可见一座蓝色建筑。

err.zh: 挖掘机的的手臂和料斗

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers visible. In the foreground, a worker in an orange jumpsuit and yellow hard hat is walking away from the camera. In the middle ground, six workers in yellow hard hats are working on a large rebar framework, with some bending over and two standing on the ground level on the left. On the right, another worker is welding the rebar, with visible sparks. The site is surrounded by excavated earth, and construction materials are scattered around, including metal plates and metal tubes. In the background, there is a concrete structure which is the finished section of the rebar framework.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见七名工人。前景中，一名身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正背对镜头走去。中景处，六名头戴黄安全帽的工人在大型钢筋框架上作业，其中一些钢筋弯曲横跨架，另有两人站在左侧地面上。右侧，另一名工人正在焊接钢筋，可见火花飞溅。工地周围是挖掘出的泥土，施工材料散落四周，包括金属板和金属管。背景中，有一处混凝土结构，是钢筋框架的完工部分。

err.zh: 其中一些钢筋弯曲横跨架

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow Hyundai excavator on the left, positioned next to a pile of mixed debris. On the right, there is an orange dump truck loaded with debris. The background shows a temple structure behind some blue fences. The ground is uneven and littered with construction debris.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左侧停着一台黄色的现代挖掘机，紧挨着一堆混合建筑垃圾。右侧是一辆装载着建筑垃圾的橙色自卸卡车。背景中，一些蓝色围栏子后面隐约可见一座寺庙。地面平整，散落着建筑垃圾。

text: The image shows a construction site with large mounds of earth. On the left, there is a red dump truck positioned atop one of the mounds, and on the right, a yellow bulldozer is visible on another mound. The background is relatively barren with a few sparse trees and an overcast sky.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，堆着大土堆。左侧，一辆红色自卸卡车停在一堆土堆上方，右侧，一台黄色推土机在另一堆土堆上可见。背景相对荒芜凉，有几棵稀疏的树和一片阴沉郁的天空。

text: The image shows a construction site with complex scaffolding. There are three workers standing on the scaffolding with the head of another worker visible at a lower level. The scaffolding is made of numerous metal poles, supporting the formwork made of metal plates. Fractured rocks are contained between the formworks. Construction debris, including small pieces of wood and concrete, is scattered around the site. The environment around the construction area is rocky and barren, and a black cable runs across the foreground rocks.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，设有复杂的脚手架。有三名工人站在脚手架上，另一名工人的头部在较低处可见。脚手架由众多金属杆构成，支撑结构由金属板制成。风化岩包含在结构之间。建筑废料，包括小木块和混凝土，散落在场地周围。施工区域周围的环境是岩石和荒芜凉，一根黑色电缆横穿前景岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with two large yellow excavators positioned towards the center of the frame. The ground is uneven and covered with dirt and debris. There is a white wall with posters on the left side. Blue fences are visible in the background. The shadow of the person taking the photo is visible in the foreground. There are buildings and trees in the background. On the left, a surveillance camera is attached to a post.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，两台大型黄色挖掘机位于画面中央。地面平整，覆盖着泥土和碎石。左侧有一面白色墙壁，上面贴着海报。背景中可见蓝色围栏。前景中可见拍摄者的的人的阴影。背景中有建筑物和树木。左侧，一个监控摄像头安装在柱子上。

err.en: The shadow of the person taking the phot

text: The image shows two workers inside a partially constructed structure with black waterproofing material on the walls and floor. The worker on the left, wearing a yellow hard hat, is standing and holding something in his hand. The worker on the right, wearing a white hard hat, is observing or inspecting the work. There are concrete blocks stacked at the top of the structure. A stack of dimensional lumber and a stack of rebars can be seen in the upper right corner. The ground outside the structure is uneven and consists of exposed earth.
zh: 图像显示两名工人在一处部分建成的结构内，墙面和地面铺设有防水材料。左侧的工人头戴黄色安全帽，站立着，手中拿着某物。右侧的工人头戴白色安全帽，正在观察或检查作业。结构顶部堆叠着混凝土砌块。右上角上方可见一堆尺寸木材和一堆钢筋。结构外的地面平整，由裸露土构成。

err.en: The ground outside the structure is unev

text: The image shows a construction site with two large yellow excavators positioned towards the center of the frame. In the foreground, there are two workers wearing red or yellow hard hats, engaged in manual labor with shovels in hand. The ground is uneven and dug up, with piles of dirt and tracks visible. Some corrugated black pipes are in the lower right corner. In the background, there are high-rise buildings, a fence, and some trees. On the right of the background, two more people can be seen.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，两台大型黄色挖掘机位于画面中央。前景处有两名头戴红色或黄色安全帽的工人，正从事着手持铁锹的体力劳动。地面平整且被挖掘，可见土堆和车辙印。一些波纹状黑色管道位于右下角。背景处有高层建筑、一道围栏和一些树木。在背景右侧，可以看到另外两个人。

err.en: The ground is uneven and dug up

text: The image shows a road construction scene with at least tent workers visible. Eight workers in the foreground surrounding the asphalt paving machine are manually spreading asphalt with rakes and shovels. The workers on the ground are wearing straw hats. The asphalt paving machine is in the middle of the image with two operators seated on it. To the right, there is a yellow road roller. The background features a clear sky and a partially visible mountainous landscape.
zh: 画面呈现一处道路施工场景，至少可见十名工人。前景中，八名工人围绕沥青摊铺路机，正使用耙子和铁锹人工摊铺撒沥青。地面上的的一名工人头戴草帽。沥青摊铺路机位于画面中央，有两名操作人员坐在上面。右侧，有一台黄色道路滚压机。背景中，可见一片晴朗天空和部分显露出的山状景观。

err.en: The workers on the ground are wearing st
err.zh: 地面上的的一名工人头戴草帽

text: The worker shoveling asphalt in the middle is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 工人在沥青中间没有戴硬帽。

err.en: The worker shoveling asphalt in the midd

text: The image shows an excavation site. Two dump trucks, one yellow and one red, are in the middle of the image. A yellow excavator is behind them and loading them with dirt. The box of a third dump truck can be seen on the right. A is near the dump truck on the right and is walking towards the left. The ground is muddy with visible tire tracks. In the background, industrial or construction structures are faintly visible, along with a cell tower. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场。两辆自卸卡车，一辆黄色和一辆红色，位于图像中央。一台黄色挖掘机位于它们后方，正用泥土装载它们。第三辆自卸卡车的箱体可在右侧看到。A位于右侧自卸卡车附近，正朝左边走。地面泥泞着，可见轮胎痕迹。背景中，工业或建筑构造隐约可见，沿着一座蜂窝塔。天空被投射。

text: The image shows three individuals and a Hyundai 210W-7 excavator at a rocky construction site. One person is standing on the excavator, another is working on the ground near the excavator's bucket, and the third is on the left of the image at the rear of the excavator. There are some buckets and tools on the ground near the individuals. Some pebbles are surrounding the bucket of the excavator. The background features a mountainous terrain with vegetation.
zh: 图像显示了三个人和一台日立建210W-7挖掘机，位于岩石施工现场。一个人站在挖掘机上，另一个人在挖掘机附近的地面上工作，第三个人在图像左侧、挖掘机后方。地面上有一些斗和工具，靠近个人。挖掘机斗周围有一些鹅卵石。背景是带有植被的山地地形。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site. A pink excavator is located near the center, a loader is on the right, and there are two civilian vehicles parked nearby. The ground is uneven with areas of exposed earth, and there is a large pile of gravel or crushed stone in the lower central part of the image. A green tree and a small white structure are visible at the top right corner.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的俯瞰视角。一台粉色挖掘机位于画面中央附近，一台装载机位于右侧，附近停放着两辆民用车辆。地面平整，有大片裸露的泥土地区，图像中下部有一大堆碎石或压碎石。右上角可见一棵绿树和一处小型白色构筑物体。

text: The image shows a construction site with three large pieces of heavy machinery: a yellow SANY drum roller in the foreground and a red excavator in the background on the right. The arm of another excavator can be seen on the left of the image. There are two visible workers in the background, one with a yellow hard hat and one with a red one, standing near a trench on the right. The ground is uneven. There are piles of dirt and a small stack of bricks on the right side of the image. The background features some vegetation.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三台大型重型机械：前景处有一台黄色色的滚筒压路机，右侧背景中有一台红色挖掘机。图像左侧可见另一台挖掘机的的手臂。背景中有两名可见工人，一人戴黄色安全帽，另一人戴红色安全帽，站在右侧一处沟槽附近。地面平整。图像右侧有土堆和一小堆砖块。背景中有一些植被。

err.zh: 另一台挖掘机的的手臂

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing hard hats and safety vests. One worker in a red hard hat is walking towards the left side of the frame, while another in a yellow hard hat is following him. Two other workers are working on a foundation pit enclosed by concrete walls in the upper right corner One worker is in the pit while the other is at the edge of the pit. In the upper portion of the image, there is a row of 3 pits while the left one is covered with a concrete slab. The ground is uneven with exposed soil and rocks, and there is a whiteboard lying on the ground in the foreground. A slope is in the foreground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人戴着安全帽和穿着安全背心。一名戴着红色安全帽的工人正朝画面左侧行走，另一名戴着黄色安全帽的工人正跟随他。另外两名工人正在一个由混凝土墙围成的基坑内作业，其中一名工人在坑内，另一名在坑边。在图像的上部，有一排三个基坑，而左侧的一个被一块混凝土板覆盖着。地面是平整的，带有裸露的泥土和岩石，并且有一个白色板子躺在前景的地面上。一个斜坡在前景。

text: The image shows a single worker wearing a red hard hat and light-colored clothing, who is engaged in construction work on a steel structure. The worker is kneeling on a steel beam and leaning forward to weld. The structure has multiple steel beams and columns, with some featuring rust or corrosion. In the background, there is an unfinished building with a similar steel frame. The ground beneath the structure is littered with debris and construction materials.
zh: 画面中一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿浅色工作服，正在钢结构上进行施工作业。该工人跪在钢梁上，身体前倾进行焊接。结构上有多根钢梁和立柱，部分带有锈蚀迹或腐蚀。背景中有一栋已完工建筑，具有类似的钢框架。结构下方的地面散落有碎屑和施工材料。

text: The image shows an excavation operation at a construction site. A yellow excavator is positioned on a mound of earth to the right, with its bucket raised above a white dump truck that is parked to the left. The excavator is dumping some dirt into the box of the dump truck with its bucket. There is one visible operator inside the excavator's cabin. In the foreground, there is a paved asphalt road, and behind the excavation equipment, a sloped, cleared area of dirt with some vegetation on the top. A small pile of gravel is also present in the middle ground, between the excavator and the camera's viewpoint.
zh: 图像显示一处建筑工地上的挖掘作业。一台黄色挖掘机位于右侧的一堆泥土上，其铲斗斗被举高于一辆停靠在左侧的白色自卸卡车之上。挖掘机正将一些泥土倾倒进自卸卡车的箱内，其铲斗斗。在挖掘机的驾驶室内可见一名操作员。在前景中，有一条铺砌的沥青道路，而在挖掘设备之后，是一片倾斜的、清理过的的一片泥地，上面长着一些植被。在中间地面上，在挖掘机与摄像机视角之间，也存在着一个小堆的砾石。

err.en: a sloped, cleared area of dirt
err.zh: 一片倾斜的、清理过的的一片泥地

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers wearing yellow or red hard hats and high-visibility vests. They are spread across the site, with some engaged in in shoveling soil. On the left side of the image, there are two stacks of rebars, a stack of red scaffolding, and a blue garbage bin. A green mesh tarp partially covers the ground in the lower part of the image. The ground appears to be uneven and dug up in places.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人佩戴黄色或红色安全帽，身穿高能见度反光背心。他们分散在工地各处，其中一些工人正在铲土。在画面左侧，有两堆钢筋、一摞红色脚手架以及一个蓝色垃圾斗。一块绿色铁丝网部分覆盖着画面下方的区域。地面看起来是平整的，并且在某些地方被挖了起来。

text: The image shows a single yellow excavator positioned in the center on a mound of earth at a construction site. The background features a hazy skyline with blurred high-rise buildings. There are also some trees in the background. The ground appears to be uneven with various mounds of dug-up earth.
zh: 画面中央的土堆上停放着一台黄色挖掘机。背景中可见一片朦胧的天际线，模糊的高层建筑。背景中还有一些树木。地面看起来平坦，带有各种挖掘出的泥土堆。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: The image shows an interior space of an unfinished concrete building with two workers wearing hard hats and safety vests. One worker, wearing a yellow hard hat, is standing and looking towards the ground, while the other, with a red hard hat, is holding some wood bars. The floor is littered with various construction debris, including pieces of wood, cables, and small trash. The concrete walls and columns of the structure are exposed.
zh: 图像展示了一栋已完工混凝土建筑的内部空间，有两名工人佩戴安全帽和反光背心。其中一名工人戴着黄色安全帽，站立并望向地面，而另一名戴着红色安全帽的工人正持握着一根木条。地面散落着各种建筑废料，包括木块、电缆线和小垃圾。混凝土墙体和立柱处于裸露状态。

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers visible. Two workers in the foreground are wearing orange coveralls, yellow safety helmets, and holding shovels. In the background, five additional workers can be seen. There is a concrete pump with a hose extended towards the elevated worker and the worker is pouring concrete with the hose. The site is surrounded by a wall with framed pictures or posters. There are multiple rebars arranged vertically and horizontally, forming a grid-like structure. The structure is reinforced with horizontal and diagonal metal poles. The ground is uneven with puddles of water, and construction debris is scattered around. On the left, some piles of rebars are next to the worker with a blue uniform. A white concrete pump truck is behind the worker.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见七名工人。前景中的两名工人身穿橙色工作服，头戴黄色安全帽，手持铁锹。背景中可见另外五名工人。有一台混凝土泵，其软管延伸至高处工人，该工人正用软管浇筑混凝土。工地四周被一堵挂有相框画或海报的墙所环绕。有多根钢筋竖直及水平排列，形成类似网格的结构。结构被水平及斜向金属杆所加固。地面平整，有积水坑，施工废料散落散在周围。左侧有一些钢筋堆，紧邻穿蓝色制服的工人。一辆白色混凝土泵车停在工人身后。

err.en: The ground is uneven with puddles of wat

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth or clearing debris. There are two individuals visible, both are in the upper left of the image. The ground is uneven with tracks from construction vehicles.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台推土机正在作业，积极进行土方方或清除碎石。可见两人，均位于画面左上方。地面平整，留有施工车辆留下的车辙。

err.zh: 进行土方方或清除碎石

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow excavator in operation, positioned on a mound of dirt and actively engaged in digging soil. On the left, there is a building under construction. The building has rebars and scaffolding surrounding it. The ground is piled with black wet soil and is uneven. In the background, there is a fenced-off area.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一台黄色挖掘机正在土堆上作业，积极挖掘泥土。左侧有一栋在建的建筑物。该建筑物周围设有栏杆和脚手架。地面铺满黑色湿土，且平整。背景中有一片围栏网隔离区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with several heavy vehicles. In the foreground, there is a muddy terrain with tire tracks. On the left, a line of trucks is present, with the closest being a white dump truck facing the camera. In the middle, a white dump truck is parked with its side facing the camera. Behind the middle dump truck, a waterbody can be seen in the excavation pit. On the right, two dump trucks are being loaded by an excavator. Overhead, there are power lines running parallel to the road. The weather appears overcast. There are greenery around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有多辆重型车辆。前景是一片泥泞地，带有轮胎印痕。左侧有一排卡车，最靠近镜头的是一辆白色泵车，车头朝向镜头。中间有一辆白色泵车停放着，侧面朝向镜头。中间泵车后面，可以看到一个水体在挖掘坑中。右侧有两辆泵车正在被一台挖掘机装载。上方有电力线平行于道路延伸。天气呈现为阴天。场地周围有植被。

text: The image shows a single yellow drum roller parked on a flat dirt surface. The background features a cleared area with a sloped terrain. Some vegetation is on the slope. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一台黄色滚筒机停放在平坦的泥土地面上。背景中有一片开阔区域，地形呈倾斜状。斜坡上生长着一些植被。天空笼罩于上方。

text: The image shows a large blue excavator in the process of digging, with its bucket raised and a cloud of dust being generated as it works. In the background, there are two pile drivers with vertical booms. The ground is uneven.
zh: 图中显示一台大型蓝色挖掘机正在进行挖掘作业，其铲斗扬起，作业时扬起一片尘土云。背景中，有两堆司机，带有垂直的boom。地面是平整的。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single excavator positioned to the left a makeshift road composed of laid out metal sheets. The site is surrounded by uneven terrain with patches of vegetation and debris. On the left of the background, there is a bridge and a water body. Two people are on the bridge. To the right in the background, there is one individual and a bulldozer.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，一台挖掘机位于左侧，旁边是一条由铺设的金属板构成的的人行便道。该场地被平坦地形以及植被和碎屑斑块所环绕。在左侧背景中，有一座桥和一个水体。两个人在桥上。在右侧背景中，有一个个体和一台推土机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of heavy machinery and equipment. In the foreground, there is a dump truck to the right of a person. To the left, an excavator is lifting a stack of red pipes with its bucket. Some more orange pipes are on the ground next to the excavator. There are also two bulldozers and a drum roller clearly visible on the left. A large crawler crane is in the center, with its boom extended upwards. There are several stockpiles of materials, including orange pipes, green pipes, and large black pipes to the right. There are two water trucks, an excavator, and a bulldozer on the right. In the background, residential buildings and two tower cranes can be seen.
zh: 画面展示了一个施工现场，现场分布着各类重型机械与设备。前景处，一辆自卸卡车位于一名人员的右侧。左侧，一台挖掘机正用其铲斗吊起一摞红色管道。地面上还散落着几根橙色管道，紧邻挖掘机右侧。此外，左侧清晰可见两台推土机以及一台鼓轮压路机。画面中央，一台大型履带起重机，其吊臂向上伸展。右侧堆积着几堆材料，包括橙色管道、绿色管道以及大型黑色管道。右侧还停放着两辆自卸卡车、一台挖掘机以及一台推土机。背景处，可见住宅建筑以及两台塔式起重机。

text: The worker next to the dump truck in the middle is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 该工人正走向中间的自卸卡车，未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: next to the dump truck in the middle
err.zh: 正走向中间的自卸卡车

text: The image shows a white cement mixer truck driving on a dirt road, causing a cloud of dust. The terrain is an open area with a dirt road, and there are mounds of earth and rocky outcrops in the background.
zh: 一辆白色水泥搅拌车行驶在土路上，扬起一片尘土。地形为开阔区域，有一条土路，背景中有山丘和岩石作物。

text: The image shows a construction site with a group of five workers wearing red hard hats gathered near the center, standing next to a concrete foundation with rebar fences. A white concrete mixer truck and a yellow dump truck with its box tilted are positioned to the right of the workers and on the earthen road. To the left, there is a yellow crane. In the background, there is a large pile of rocks. The environment appears to be rocky and uneven.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，五名头戴红色安全帽的工人聚集在中心附近，站在带钢筋围栏的混凝土基础旁。一辆白色混凝土搅拌车以及一辆黄色泵车，其箱体呈倾斜状态，位于工人的右侧及在土路上。左侧有一台黄色起重机。背景中有一大堆岩石。环境显得岩石遍布且平坦。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with muddy conditions. There are five workers visible, three are at the bottom of the excavation wearing orange helmets and handling a hose or cable. The fourth worker is holding an umbrella and is at the lowest level of the excavator. While the fifth, wearing a white helmet, is walking along the excavated slope. Two yellow excavators are actively engaged in earthmoving operations, with one positioned at the edge of the excavation and the other in the pit. There are piles of covered materials in the background, and a structure with a white surface is also visible in the distance. The weather seems overcast, and the ground appears wet. Some trees are in the background. Transmission cables and lampposts are in the upper right.
zh: 图像显示一个大型土方方开挖现场，条件泥泞滑。可见五名工人，其中三名位于开挖底部，佩戴橙色安全帽，并处理一根软管或电缆。第四名工人手持一把雨伞，位于开挖器的最低层。而第五名，佩戴白色安全帽，沿开挖斜坡行走。两台黄色开挖器正积极从事土方移动作业，其中一台位于开挖边缘，另一台位于坑内。背景中有一堆覆盖材料，远处还可见一台具有白色表面的。天气似乎阴沉，地面显得潮湿。背景中有一些树木。输电电缆和灯杆位于右上方。

err.zh: 一个大型土方方开挖现场

err.en: a structure with a white surface

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation area. In the center, there is a yellow excavator loading a yellow dump truck, and a pile of excavated earth is underneath it. To the right of the excavator, there is one worker. On the right of the image, there are three individuals standing and appearing to be in a discussion. On the left side of the image, there is a large mound of earth. In the background, there are power lines and vegetation. The ground shows signs of heavy vehicle movement, indicated by the tread marks.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一大片大型开挖区域。在中心，有一台黄色挖掘机正在装载一辆黄色自卸卡车，其下方有一堆开挖的土方。在挖掘机的右侧，有一名工人。在图像的右侧，有三个人站立，似乎在进行讨论。在图像左侧，有一大堆土。在背景中，有电力线和植被。地面显示出重型型车辆移动的迹象，由轮胎痕迹表明。

text: The image shows a construction site with four tower cranes towering over an unfinished building that is covered with green safety netting and scaffoldings.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，四台塔式起重机矗立于一栋已完工建筑之上，该建筑覆盖着绿色安全防护网和脚手架。

text: The image shows five individuals walking through a construction site. All of them are wearing white hard hats while four of them are wearing high-visibility vests. They appear to be inspecting the site. The ground is uneven and muddy, with some rocks and debris scattered around. In the background, there is a green fence.
zh: 图中显示五个人正穿过一处建筑工地。他们全都戴着白色安全帽，其中四个人穿着高能见度背心。他们似乎正在检查工地。地面平坦且泥泞滑，周围散落着一些岩石和碎屑。背景中有一道绿色围栏。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators. The two excavators are positioned on a mound of dirt. The ground appears to be recently moved earth, with tire tracks. There are some concrete pipes near the road on the left. The background is hazy.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有两台挖掘机。两台挖掘机停在一堆土堆上。地面看起来像是最近翻动过的，带有轮胎痕迹。道路左侧有一些混凝土管道。背景杂乱。

text: The image shows a white excavator in the center, engaged in digging at a construction site. There is one individual visible, standing on a bridge in the background, observing the site. The excavator is positioned on an uneven dirt surface, with piles of excavated soil around it. The bridge in the background spans over the excavation area, and there are power lines and structures visible in the far background.
zh: 画面中央是一台白色挖掘机，正在一处建筑工地上进行挖掘作业。背景中可见一名人员，站在一座桥梁上，正在观察工地现场。挖掘机停在一块平整的泥土地面上，周围堆放着挖掘出的的一堆堆土。背景中的桥梁横跨在开挖区域上方，远处背景中可见电力线路及建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow excavator in the foreground, positioned near a pile of brick rubbles. On the right, a person is standing on a concrete slab. A stack of black pipes is behind the excavator. In the background, there are several tower cranes visible on the right. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台黄色挖掘机，停在一堆砖块旁。右侧，一人站在混凝土板上。挖掘机后方有一堆黑色管道。背景中，右侧可见几座塔楼。天空呈现灰白色。

text: In the image, there is one worker standing on the ground near the center, observing a concrete pump truck with its boom extended towards the right. The construction site has a muddy terrain with some puddles of water and scattered construction materials. In the background, there are two buildings under construction with scaffolding on their exteriors and green safety netting covering the building. Two stacks of wooden boards are in the lower left of the image while two more stacks are in the lower right. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面中有一名工人站在地面上，靠近画面中央，正观察着一辆混凝土泵车，其车斗朝向右侧延伸。施工现场地面泥泞滑，有一些水洼和散落的着的建筑材料。背景中，有两栋正在施工的建筑，其外立面搭着脚手架，绿色安全网覆盖着建筑。画面左下方有两堆木板，而右下方还有两堆更多。天空笼罩着。

text: The image shows a construction site with four green dump trucks in the process of moving earth. In the foreground, one truck is dumping soil, with its bed tilted at a steep angle. Behind it, there are at least three other trucks lined up, waiting for dumping, with the right truck's bed full of soil. A worker is to the right of the dump truck on the right. In the background, two mobile cranes can be seen. Some yellow machinery, a teal excavator, and some concrete pipes can be seen on the right. The ground is uneven and covered with mounds of the same reddish-brown soil.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，有四辆绿色自卸卡车正在进行土方作业。前景中，一辆卡车正在卸土，其车斗以陡峭角度倾斜。在它后面，至少还有三辆其他卡车排成一排，等待卸，右侧那辆卡车的斗装满了土。一名工人位于卸卡车右侧。背景中，可以看到两台移动起重机。一些黄色机械，一台青色挖掘机，以及一些混凝土管道可以在右侧看到。地面是平整的，覆盖着同样红褐色土壤。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator positioned on the right, and its bucket resting on the ground.  In the background, there is a pile of debris and a perimeter fence. The site has uneven terrain and exposed soil in the foreground. The arm of another excavator can be seen on the left beyond the perimeter fence.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，一台挖掘机位于右侧，其铲斗停放在地面上。背景中有一堆渣土和一道围栏。场地地势平坦，前景处有裸露的土壤。在围栏外左侧，可以看到另一台挖掘机的的手臂。

err.zh: 另一台挖掘机的的手臂

text: The image shows two individuals at a quarry with large limestone blocks in the background. Both are wearing white hard hats. The person on the left is crouching and using a densimeter on the ground, while the person on the right is standing and holding a clipboard. The environment is dusty, and the ground is uneven with scattered debris.
zh: 图像显示，在一处采石场，背景中有大块石灰岩。两人都戴着白色安全帽。左边的人蹲在地上，使用密度计，而右边的人站着，拿着写字板。环境是尘土飞扬的，地面是平坦的，散落着碎石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow excavator positioned in the center. To the right of the excavator, there is a worker wearing a white hard hat and dark clothing, standing on the ground and looking towards the excavator. In the background, there are blurred structures that resemble buildings. The ground appears to be uneven with visible tire tracks. The sky is clear.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心位置有一台大型黄色挖掘机。在挖掘机的右侧，有一名工人戴着白色安全帽和深色衣服，站在地面上，面向挖掘机。在背景中，有一些模糊的结构，类似建筑物。地面看起来是平整的，带有可见轮胎痕迹。天空是晴朗的。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebars laid out in a grid pattern. There are seven workers visible: one standing in the foreground wearing a yellow hard hat and casual clothing, observing the site, and two actively working on the rebar grid on the right, both wearing yellow hard hats. The rest are in the middle of the image. In the background, there are multiple high-rise buildings. A construction sign with the number "2" is prominently displayed on a tower crane. Yellow scaffolding structures with green safety netting can be seen surrounding the site. There are also stacks of construction materials such as multiple stacks of wooden planks, wooden boards on the left of the image, and three stacks of rebars in the foreground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大面积的钢筋以网格状排列。可见七名工人：一名站在前景，头戴黄色安全帽，身着便服装，正在观察工地；两名在右侧积极作业于钢筋网格，均头戴黄色安全帽。其余人员位于画面中部。背景中有多栋高层建筑。一台塔式起重机上醒目地显示着数字“2”。黄色脚手架结构及绿色安全防护网可见于工地周围。此外，画面左侧还有多堆建筑材料，如多堆木托盘、木板材，以及前景处有三堆钢筋。

err.en: multiple stacks of wooden planks, wooden

text: The image shows a construction site with excavation work in progress. There are two orange Hitachi excavators and a teal excavator on the right. A black roll of rebar is to the left of the teal excavator. The deep trench uses sheet piles as retaining walls to prevent soil collapse in the center. In the background, there are trees and a partially obscured multi-story building. The ground shows tracks from construction vehicles.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，土方开挖工作正在进行进行。有两台橙色的日立挖掘机和一台青色挖掘机在右侧。黑色钢筋卷位于绿色挖掘机的左侧。深沟使用钢板桩作为挡土墙以防止土壤在中心坍塌。在背景中，有树木和一栋部分被遮挡的多层建筑。地面显示来自施工车辆的的车道。

err.zh: 土方开挖工作正在进行进行
来自施工车辆的的车道

text: The image shows a construction site with four excavators in the middle ground, each a different color (red, green, and yellow), engaged in earthmoving activities. A wheeled loader is to the right of the excavators. There are at least three individuals visible on the right of the site. In the background, there are multistory residential buildings. The foreground is characterized by an expanse of bare earth. A section of a black corrugated pipe is on the right.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面中部有四名挖掘机，各自颜色不同（红色、绿色和黄色），正在进行土方作业。挖掘机右侧有一台轮式装载机。画面右侧至少可见三个人。背景中有多栋历史住宅建筑。前景以大片裸露土为特征。右侧有一段黑色波纹管。

text: The image shows an excavator in the center, its bucket holding a full load of soil. The ground is uneven with visible trenches and mounds of dirt. Scattered debris, including wooden planks and bricks, are present across the site. In the background, there is a green field, and further back, some structures are faintly visible.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其铲斗内装满了泥土。地面平整，可见沟槽和土堆。散落的着碎屑，包括木块和砖块，遍布整个场地。背景中有一片绿色的田野，更远处有一些结构隐约可见。

text: The image shows a large construction site with extensive yellow scaffolding in the foreground. There are three tower cranes in the image, two of them are in the foreground. The boom of a mobile crane can also be seen. In the background, there is a high-rise building under construction with another tower crane on top. The sky is overcast, and there are piles of earth visible in the distance. Near the pile of earth on the right, there is a concrete mixer truck and a pile driver. There is a blue barrier at the bottom of the image.
zh: 画面显示一个大型建筑工地，前景中有大面积黄色脚手架。图中有三台塔式起重机，其中两台位于前景。还能看到一台移动式起重机的。背景中有一栋正在施工的高层建筑，其顶部还有另一台塔式起重机。天空阴沉，远处可见成堆的土方堆。右侧土堆附近有一辆混凝土搅拌车及一名司机。画面底部有一道蓝色屏障。

err.en: The boom of a mobile crane

text: The image shows an active construction site with an excavator in the center, positioned on a mound of earth. The excavator's bucket is shoveling earth on the ground. To the right of the excavator, there is a dump truck. The truck is covered with a layer of dirt, consistent with the construction environment. The ground is muddy with tire tracks. In the background, there are additional piles of earth and some parked cars. The sky is overcast, providing diffuse lighting to the scene.
zh: 画面显示一处正在施工的的建筑工地的施工现场，一台挖掘机位于画面中央，停在一堆泥土上。挖掘机的铲斗内盛有泥土。在挖掘机右侧，有一辆自卸卡车。卡车覆盖着一层泥土，与施工环境相一致。地面泥泞滑，带有轮胎痕迹。在背景中，有额外的土堆和一些停放的汽车。天空阴沉，为场景提供漫射光。

err.en: The excavator's bucket is shoveling eart
err.zh: 挖掘机的铲斗内盛有泥土。

err.en: The ground is muddy with tire tracks.
err.zh: 地面泥泞滑，带有轮胎痕迹。

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive rebar work. There are rebar meshes on the ground and multiple vertical rebars forming walls separating the site. There are nine workers visible and all of them are wearing hard hats. The workers in orange are standing within the rebar structure, while the worker with a grey jacket is standing on top of a rebar wall in the foreground. There are wooden planks, metal poles, and metal plates scattered around.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，正在进行大规模的钢筋作业。地面上有钢筋网，多根垂直钢筋形成墙体，将工地分隔开。可见有九名工人，他们都戴着安全帽。穿橙色衣服的工人站在钢筋结构内，而穿灰色夹克的工人站在前景的钢筋墙内。周围散落着木托盘、金属杆和金属板。

err.en: standing on top of a rebar wall

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing yellow hard hats and orange safety vests. They are working on rebars for a tunnel structure. The interior of the structure is supported by metal poles while the exterior is covered with rebar grids and wooden planks. The rebars are positioned on top of a concrete short wall. The workers are positioned along the length of the rebar assembly and standing on the ground. There is standing water on the ground. Construction materials, including wooden planks and additional rebars, are scattered around the area. In the background, there is a pile of debris and vegetation, and a black metal fence.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着黄色安全帽和橙色安全背心。他们正在钢筋上作业，用于隧道结构。内部由金属支柱支撑，内部覆盖着钢筋网格和木模板。钢筋位于混凝土短墙顶部。工人沿着钢筋组装的长度站立在地面上。地面上有积水。建筑材料，包括木模板和额外的钢筋，散落在区域周围。背景中有一堆碎石和植被，以及一道黑色金属围栏。

err.en: while the exterior is covered with rebar
err.zh: 内部覆盖着钢筋网格和木模板

text: The image shows a quarry with four workers visible. One worker is standing on scaffolding made of metal poles. Other workers are standing on the ground near the scaffolding, they are standing on the rocky terrain. The ground is uneven and covered with a large number of rocks and boulders of various sizes. There is standing water visible beneath the scaffolding.
zh: 图中显示一处采石场，可见四名工人。一名工人站在由金属杆搭建的高架子上。另外几名工人站在靠近高架子的地面的，他们站在岩石地形上。地面平整，覆盖着大量大小不一的岩石和碎屑。架子下方可见积水。

text: The image shows an excavator with a teal and black color scheme, branded "KOBELCO," positioned on an elevated dirt platform. The excavator's arm is extended with the bucket in the air. There is one operator visible inside the cab of the excavator. In the foreground, there is a surveying tripod set up on the ground. The background features a hazy sky and some buildings, with two construction cranes visible in the far distance.
zh: 画面中展示了一台采用青绿色与黑色配色方案的、标有“KOBEL CO.”字样的式的挖掘机的，其位置处于抬高的泥土质平台上。该挖掘机的臂部延伸着，其铲斗在空中。有一操作员可见于驾驶室内。在前景中，有一台测量三脚架设置于地面上。背景特征为朦胧的天空和一些建筑物，带有两台建筑起重机可见于远处。

err.zh: 标有“KOBEL CO.”字样的式的挖掘机的

err.en: The excavator's arm is extended with the
err.zh: 该挖掘机的臂部延伸着，其铲斗在空中。

text: The image shows a construction site with four tower cranes in the background. In the foreground, there are some corrugated black pipes. A green dump truck with its bed lifting can be seen on the left and a black mobile crane is on the right next to the tower crane and the building. There is an unfinished building structure with scaffolding on the right side. A worker with a white hard hat is on the left. The environment is overcast.
zh: 背景中可见四台塔式起重机。前景处有一些带弯头的部的黑色管道。左侧可见一辆绿色泵车，其吊斗升起。右侧有一台黑色移动式起重机，位于塔式起重机与建筑物之间。右侧有一栋已完工建筑物，其侧面带有脚手架。左侧有一名工人，头戴白色硬帽。环境被覆盖。

err.en: green dump truck with its bed lifting

text: The image shows a light blue excavator positioned on a muddy terrain with visible tracks in the soil. The excavator's arm is extended, and the bucket is in contact with the ground. There is a body of water in the background, and the overall environment appears to be a large, open outdoor area. The ground is uneven and covered with what looks like a mixture of soil and vegetation debris.
zh: 图像显示一台浅蓝色的挖掘机停放在泥泞土地上，泥土中可见车辙印。挖掘臂伸展，铲斗与地面接触。背景中有一片水域，整体环境看起来像一个大型、开放的户外区域。地面平坦，覆盖着类似土壤与植被碎屑的混合物。

text: The image shows a group of five individuals at a construction site with excavated earth and a water-filled trench. Two individuals are wearing red hard hats, two other workers are not wearing hard hats, and a fifth person is occluded by the person in the middle. The individual on the right is holding a cell phone. In the background, there is a yellow excavator on the left. On the right of the background, two tower cranes are visible next to buildings under construction. The terrain appears to be uneven with exposed red soil, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 图片显示，在一个施工现场，有挖掘的泥土和一条注满水的沟渠的五个人。两个人戴着红色安全帽，另外两个工人没有戴安全帽，第五个人被中间的人遮挡。右边的人拿着手机。背景中，左边有一台黄色挖掘机。背景中，右边可见两台塔吊，在建设中的建筑物旁边。地形看起来是平坦的，有裸露出的红土，天空是阴天的。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a large yellow tower crane against a cloudy sky. The crane's horizontal jib extends across the frame, and there is a counter-jib on the opposite side.
zh: 画面中，一台大型黄色塔式起重机矗立在多云的天空下。起重机的架横跨整个画面，而在另一侧则有一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing safety vests and hard hats on the left. There is an extensive rebar framework laid out on the ground with rebar meshes on the ground and vertical rebars. A large concrete structure with a waterproofing membrane is visible in the background, and a yellow tower crane stands to the right. There are blue tarps covering some materials, with three bundles of rebars on top of the tarp. A stack of wooden planks is on the left behind the workers.
zh: 画面左侧显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人穿着安全背心和硬帽子。地面上铺设着一个广泛的的重框架，地面上有重网格，垂直重条。背景中可见一个大型混凝土结构，带有防水膜，右侧立着一台黄色塔起重机。有一些蓝色塔普覆盖着一些材料，塔普顶部有三束重条。工人身后左侧有一堆木托盘。

text: The leftmost and rightmost people are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 绝大多数人没有佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow dump truck in the center, positioned on an uneven dirt road. In the background, a crane is situated on the right side of the image, with its boom extended upwards. The site is surrounded by a rocky landscape, and there are piles of rusty pipes scattered in the foreground.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一辆黄色渣土车停在画面中央，位于一条平坦的土路上。背景中，一台起重机位于画面右侧，其吊臂向上延伸。工地被一片岩石地貌所环绕，前景处散落着几堆生锈迹斑斑的管道。

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard hats. Six of them are working within a trench lined with vertical rebars. The finished section of the structure is a finished tunnel. Some workers are positioned on the trench's edge, while others are inside, engaged in various activities such as handling materials or tools. There is standing water at the bottom of the trench, and construction debris and materials such as metal plates and metal poles are scattered around the site. To the left, a worker is on the higher level behind a table. The environment appears to be muddy and wet, and the site is surrounded by a natural landscape with trees in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有七名工人戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽。其中六名工人在一条用竖直钢筋围成的沟槽内作业。完工的部分是一个完工的隧道。一些工人站在沟槽边缘，而另一些人在内部，从事各种活动，例如搬运材料或使用工具。沟槽底部有积水，施工现场周围散落着建筑废料和材料，如金属板和金属杆。左侧，一名工人站在较高的位置，位于一张桌子后面。环境看起来泥泞湿，且该场地被一片带有树木的自然风景所环绕。

err.en: wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: The image shows four individuals at a construction site, with three wearing red hard hats and one wearing a white hard hat. They are engaged in a discussion, with one individual holding a document. The terrain is uneven and excavated, with visible red soil and construction materials such as rebar cages and concrete structures.
zh: 图像显示四名个体位于一处建筑工地，其中三人佩戴红色安全帽，一人佩戴白色安全帽。他们正在进行讨论，其中一人手持一份文件。地形平坦且经过开挖，可见红色土壤以及钢筋笼和混凝土结构等建筑材料。

err.en: The terrain is uneven and excavated

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebars laid out in a grid pattern. There are at least four workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats. The workers are dispersed across the site, and engaged in various activities related to construction work. At the bottom of the image, there are wooden planks and construction materials scattered around.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大量钢筋以网格状排列铺设。画面中至少可见四名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽。这些工人分散在工地各处，正从事与施工相关的作业。在图像底部，散落着木托盘及建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with one yellow excavator in the center. There are two individuals visible on the right side of the image, standing near the excavated trench. The ground appears to be muddy and uneven, with piles of dug-up soil around the site. There is some vegetation in the foreground. In the background, there are various dump trucks on the right behind the brick wall.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台黄色挖掘机。画面右侧有两个人影，站在挖掘的沟槽附近。地面看起来泥泞且平整，工地周围堆着挖出的来的的一堆堆土。前景有一些植被。背景中，砖墙后面停着几辆自卸卡车。

err.zh: 挖出的来的的一堆堆土

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers visible in the foreground. One worker in an orange jacket and yellow hard hat is seated on the left side, working on the edge of a concrete short wall. Three workers in orange jackets and yellow hard hats are standing further along the same structure by the entrance of the tunnel. The site is lined with rebars and black metal plates. There are scattered construction materials on both sides of the structure, including wooden planks, metal poles, and metal plates. The terrain around the construction area is uneven and dug up.  A body of water is visible in the background on the left. Some buildings with black roofs can be seen on the right.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景中有四名工人。其中一名身穿橙色夹克、头戴黄色安全帽的工人坐在左侧，正在混凝土短墙边缘作业。另外三名身穿橙色夹克、头戴黄安全帽的工人站在同一结构旁，靠近隧道入口处。该结构处设有钢筋和黑色金属板。结构两侧散落着施工材料，包括木方板、金属杆和金属板。施工区域周围地势平坦且被挖起。左侧背景中可见一汪水。右侧可见一些黑顶建筑。

err.en: The terrain around the construction area
err.zh: 施工区域周围地势平坦且被挖起。

text: The image shows a construction site. In the foreground, there is an excavator on the left and a drum roller on the right, both with the brand "SANY" visible. In the middle of the image, a loader can be seen. There are at least two workers in the middle ground, both of them are wearing hard hats and to the left of the excavator. The background features a row of multi-story residential buildings. The ground is uneven with tire tracks. On the right, some concrete pipes can be seen.
zh: 图片显示的是一个建筑工地。在前景中，左侧有一台挖掘机，右侧有一台鼓式压路机，两者上均可见“Sany”品牌标识。在画面中部，可以看到一台装载机。在地面上，至少有两名工人，他们均佩戴安全帽，且位于挖掘机的左侧。背景中有一排多层住宅建筑。地面平整，带有轮胎痕迹。在右侧，可以看到一些混凝土管道。

err.en: The ground is uneven with tire tracks.
err.zh: 地面平整，带有轮胎痕迹。

text: The image shows a rear view of a large, yellow, wheeled bulldozer parked on a dirt surface. To the left of the bulldozer, there is a pile of wooden planks and wooden sheets on the ground. On the right, there is a white metal barrier. Some trees are in the background.
zh: 图片显示了一台大型黄色轮式压路机的器的停放在泥土地面上的。压路机器的左侧地面上有一堆木托盘和木板。右侧有一道白色金属护栏。背景中有一些树木。

err.zh: 的器的停放在泥土地面上的

text: The image shows an excavation site with a single excavator positioned on a mound of earth, actively digging into the ground. The terrain is uneven with visible tire tracks. Behind the excavator, there is a steep incline with exposed rock, soil, and some vegetation. The sky is clear.
zh: 图中显示一个开挖现场，一台挖掘机位于土堆上，正在向地面积极挖掘。地形平坦，可见轮胎痕迹。挖掘机后方有一处陡峭的斜坡，露出岩石、土壤及部分植被。天空晴朗。

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor at a construction site. The compactor is positioned on a dirt surface. In the background, there is a concrete wall with protruding rebar and two tower cranes visible in the distance. On the left of the background, there is a building with yellow scaffolding and safety netting.
zh: 画面中有一名身着黄色工装服的建筑工人，正站在工地的泥土地面上。背景中有一面混凝土墙，上面伸出着钢筋，远处可见两台塔吊。在背景的左侧，有一栋建筑，上面搭着黄色脚手架和安全网。

err.zh: 身着黄色工装服的建筑工人

err.en: The compactor is positioned on a dirt su
err.zh: 正站在工地的泥土地面上
