text: The image shows a construction site with two workers in the middle distance, both wearing yellow hard hats and bending over in the water. In the foreground, there is a pile of wooden planks on the left. The background features a high concrete wall. The ground appears muddy and there are tire tracks.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中景处有两名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽，正弯腰在水边作业。前景左侧有一堆木方木。背景为一堵高耸的混凝土墙。地面显得泥泞污，并留有轮胎印痕。

text: The image shows a construction site with two tower cranes in the background, one on the left and another on the right side of the frame. In the foreground, there is a large, multi-level concrete structure with extensive scaffolding and numerous vertical rebar rods protruding from the top. Some scaffolding frameworks can be seen around the base of the tower crane in the middle.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，背景中有两台塔式起重机，一台位于画面左侧，另一台位于画面右侧框架内。前景中有一处大型多层混凝土结构，顶部伸出大量脚手架以及众多垂直钢筋。部分脚手架框架可见于画面中塔式起重机的基周围。

err.zh: 顶部伸出大量脚手架以及众多垂直钢筋

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer in the center, actively engaged in earthmoving activities, with its blade partially raised and loaded with soil. An operator is in the bulldozer. In the background, there are trees. The ground in the foreground is uneven with mounds of soil.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色色推土机，正在进行土方作业，其刀片部略微抬起并装载有泥土。一名操作员位于推土机内。背景中有树木。前景地面平整，伴有土堆。

err.en: The ground in the foreground is uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, teal-colored excavator (Kobelco SK 250) on the right, operated by a person wearing a short-sleeved shirt. The excavator is positioned on a mound of dirt and is in the process of digging earth. Another teal excavator, whose track is raised and loses contact with the ground, is next to the excavator in the foreground and partially occluded. In the center, there is a yellow dump truck and a red dump truck. Another yellow dump truck with its box full of soil is partially occluded by the other dump trucks. The background features a clear sky and a flat landscape with some construction and electrical infrastructure visible.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，右侧有一台大型青绿色挖掘机（Kobelco SK 250），由一名身穿短袖衬衫的人员操作。该挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，正在进行进行挖土作业。另一台青绿色挖掘机，其履带被抬起并失去与地面的接触，位于前景处，部分被遮挡。画面中央有一辆黄色泵送卡车和一辆红色泵送卡车。另一辆黄色泵送卡车，其箱体装满泥土，部分被另一辆泵送卡车遮挡。背景呈现晴朗天空以及平坦景观貌，可见一些施工和电力基础设施。

err.en: is in the process of digging earth
err.zh: 正在进行进行挖土作业

text: The image shows a construction worker wearing a yellow hard hat and green jacket, working at a wooden table with various tools and materials on it, including a circular saw. The worker is holding a hammer. In the foreground, there are two traffic cones, a yellow hard hat, and a green cloth on the ground. There is another worker visible and partially occluded by the worker in the front. The site is in a wooded area with trees and blue fencing. The ground is uneven and wet.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿绿色夹克，正在一张木桌旁作业，桌上摆放着各种工具和材料，其中包括一把圆锯。该工人手持一把锤子。前景地面上放有两个交通锥、一顶黄色安全帽以及一件绿色衣物。画面中还能看到另一名工人，其身体被前方工人部分遮挡。现场位于一片树林区域，周围有树木和蓝色围栏网。地面平整且潮湿。

err.en: The ground is uneven and wet.

text: The image shows two workers in orange raincoats and red hard hats standing in a body of water, engaged in an activity that involves a large striped tarp. The worker on the left is pulling the tarp towards the shore, while the worker on the right is holding onto the tarp further out in the water. There are broken bricks and debris along the water's edge on the left, and an excavated dirt slope on the right.
zh: 画面中两名工人身穿橙色雨衣、头戴红色安全帽，站在积水中，正从事一项涉及大型条纹状防水布的作业的活动。左侧的工人正将防水布拉向岸边拖拽，而右侧的工人则正将防水布进一步拖入水中。左侧水边沿岸边散落着破碎的砖块与杂物，右侧则呈现一道开挖过的泥土质的斜坡面。

err.en: holding onto the tarp further out in the
err.zh: 正将防水布进一步拖入水中

text: The image shows a group of six construction workers on a site where rebar reinforcement has been laid out.  The structure is surrounded by formworks. There is a pile of debris in the background, and a fence made of metal poles is also in the background. All workers are wearing yellow safety helmets and raincoats. One worker on the left appears to be handling a hose or pipe to pour concrete into the rebar structure. There are two power tools on the ground. The environment looks muddy and overcast.
zh: 画面显示六名建筑工人正在一处施工现场作业，该处已铺设钢筋。结构被模板包围。背景中有一堆建筑垃圾废料，背景中还有一道由金属杆制成的围栏。所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽和雨衣。左侧一名工人似乎正在拿着一根软管或管道，将混凝土浇筑入钢筋结构中。地面上有两把电力工具。环境显得泥泞污且潮湿。

text: The image shows a construction site with various activities in progress. On the left, there is a drum roller behind a red scooter. A bulldozer is partially occluded by the drum roller. An excavator is lifting a stack of orange pipes with its bucket. On the right, there is one worker walking towards the foreground, and a water truck is driving away from the viewer. Behind the water truck, a stack of corrugated pipes and a stack of green pipes can be seen on the ground. In the center, a large crawler crane is positioned with its boom extended upwards and the hook lowered near the ground. In the background, there are buildings and trees, slightly obscured by haze or dust in the air.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，各项作业正在推进。左侧，一台红色叉车停在一台压路机后方。一台推土机被压路机部分遮挡。一台挖掘机正用其铲斗吊起一摞橙色管道。右侧，一名工人正朝前景方向行走，而一辆水罐车正驶离观察者。在水罐车后方，可见一摞波纹状管道和一摞绿色管道置于地面之上。中央，一台大型履带起重机正以其吊臂向上伸展，吊钩降至接近地面处。背景中，有建筑物和树木，因薄雾或尘埃而略显模糊。

text: The image shows a white dump truck parked on the left side in the foreground. Behind the dump truck, an excavator is digging earth to load the dump truck. In the middle, another excavator is loading a dump truck. Another excavator is visible in the background on the right. The ground is uneven and consists of exposed earth. A utility pole is on the left of the image with some electricity cable in the upper right.
zh: 画面左侧前景处停放着一辆白色自卸卡车。自卸卡车后方，一台挖掘机正在挖掘泥土以装载自卸卡车。画面中部，另一台挖掘机正在向自卸卡车装载土。画面右侧背景中可见另一台挖掘机。地面平整，由裸露出的泥土构成。画面左上方有一根电力电缆，右上方也有一根电力电缆。

err.en: A utility pole is on the left of the ima
err.zh: 画面左上方有一根电力电缆，右上方也有一根电力电缆。

text: The image shows a construction site where five workers, some of them in orange jackets and yellow hard hats are working on a large grid of rebar that is laid out on top of a formwork structure. On the left, one worker is bending down, possibly tying the rebar, while another is walking next to the rebar grid. The other three workers are in the middle. The worker with a red hard hat is bending while another worker with an orange jacket is occluded. Beneath the rebar grid, there is a supportive structure made of metal poles and wooden planks. In the background, there is a green mesh fence and some blurred structures.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，五名工人，其中一些穿着橙色夹克和黄色安全帽，正在一个大型钢筋网格上工作，该网格平铺在结构上方。在左侧，一名工人正弯腰，可能在绑扎钢筋，而另一名工人正走向钢筋网格。另外三名工人位于中间。戴红色安全帽的工人正在弯腰，而另一名穿着橙色夹克的工人被包含在内。在钢筋网格下方，有一个由金属杆和木托盘构成的支撑结构。在背景中，有一道绿色网状围栏和一些模糊化的结构。

text: The image shows a construction site with approximately 16 workers engaged in various activities. Most workers are wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests, and they are spread out across the site working on a dense network of rebars on top of a concrete structure. Some workers are bending over, possibly tying rebars together, while others are standing and observing or directing the work. In the center, there is a worker welding, as indicated by the visible sparks and smoke. Behind the workers, a large concrete wall is visible, and above the site, there are orange construction barriers and stockpiles of wooden planks and rebars.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，约有16名工人正在从事各种作业。大多数工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿安全背心，分散在整个场地上方的钢梁的密集网架上作业。部分工人弯腰俯身，可能正在绑扎钢筋，而另一些工人则站立着，或在观察或指挥作业。在中心，有一名工人正在焊接，由可见火花与烟雾所指示。在该工人身后，可见一堵大型混凝土墙体，而在工地上方，则有橙色施工围挡与成堆的木托盘及钢筋。

err.en: a dense network of rebars on top of a co
err.zh: 整个场地上方的钢梁的密集网架上

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation area. There are approximately five workers visible, some wearing orange coveralls and all wearing yellow hard hats. Four workers are standing on a formwork structure with steel reinforcement bars protruding vertically, while one other is on the finished concrete platform. There are piles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden boards on the concrete platform on the left. A stack of metal poles and a stack of rebars are in the foreground. To the right, a formwork structure enclosing dense rebar grids and vertical wooden planks is visible. The excavation site has steep dirt walls, and there is vegetation at the top edge of the excavation.
zh: 图像显示一个大型土方方开挖的施工现场。大约有五名工人可见，部分人戴着橙色安全帽，所有人都戴着黄色安全帽。四名工人站在带有垂直突出钢筋的模板结构上，而另一名工人站在已完成的混凝土平台上。混凝土平台左侧有一堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木板。前景处有一堆金属杆和一堆钢筋。右侧，一个模板结构内可见密集的钢筋网格和垂直木板。开挖场地有陡峭的土墙，开挖顶部边缘有植被。

err.zh: 部分人戴着橙色安全帽

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing orange coveralls and red hard hats. They are standing on and around a large striped tarp, which is spread out on the ground and covering construction materials or debris. The site is surrounded by greenery, and there are some scattered bricks and rubble in the foreground.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着橙色安全帽和红色安全帽。他们站在并围绕着一块大型条纹状防水布，该防水布铺展在地面上，覆盖着建筑材料或碎屑。工地周围环绕着绿植，前景处有一些散落的着的砖块和碎石。

err.en: wearing orange coveralls and red hard ha
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和红色安全帽

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete pump truck in the foreground, its outriggers are extended and its boom is extended upwards and across the frame. In the background, there is a multi-story building under construction, covered with green scaffolding netting. Two tower cranes are visible behind the building.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一辆大型混凝土泵车，其出料口向外延伸，其料斗向上并横跨整个画面。背景中有一栋多层建筑正在施工，覆盖着绿色脚手架网。建筑后方可见两台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the center, equipped with a front blade, actively moving earth. The ground is uneven and muddy with visible tire tracks. A pile of tree debris are next to the bulldozer and in the lower right of the image.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台单斗轮挖掘机，配备前铲刀，正在进行土方作业。地面平整且泥泞湿，可见轮胎印痕。在单斗轮挖掘机的旁、画面右下方，有一堆树木残枝。

text: The two people on the right are not wearing hard hats. None of the workers wears a high-visibility vest when working night shift.
zh: 右侧的两人均未佩戴安全帽。其中一名工人在夜间作业时穿着高能见度背心。

err.en: None of the workers wears a high-visibil
err.zh: 其中一名工人在夜间作业时穿着高能见度背心

text: The worker on the right of the image next to the dump truck is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 图像右侧的工人正走向自卸卡车，未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain. In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator with the label "KATO", digging the muddy ground. To the right, there are three other excavators partially visible. In the background, another excavator and two dump trucks are on the right. The background also features buildings in the distance, with a hazy sky overhead.
zh: 画面显示一处泥泞土地质的建筑工地。前景中有一台黄色挖掘机，标有“Kato”字样，正在挖掘泥泞地。右侧还有三台部分可见挖掘机。背景中另有一台挖掘机和两辆泵车位于右侧。远处背景还有建筑物，上方是朦胧的天空。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with a single yellow Hyundai excavator positioned on top of a mound of earth in the center. The ground is uneven with various mounds of excavated soil. A pink string line is visible in the foreground. The background features a clear sky and a row of electricity pylons with cables stretching across the horizon.
zh: 图中显示一个大型土方开挖现场，一台黄色的现代挖掘机位于中央土堆的顶部。地面平整，周围散布着各种开挖出的土的堆。前景中可见一条粉红色的警戒线。背景中天空晴朗，一排电力塔架及线缆横跨地平线延伸。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large tower crane in the center, its jib extending across the frame with a hook and lifting accessory dangling from its cable. The tower crane is lifting a stack of rebars. On the left, the rigging system of another tower crane is lifting a hopper. The body of the other tower crane is in the upper right of the image. Several workers are visible at the bottom of the image. In the foreground, a white hard hat is in the lower right. The background includes a concrete platform with some workers standing on top and nearby. In the lower-left corner, there are four more tower cranes. The sky is overcast, and the sun is visible through the haze.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨画面，吊臂末端通过缆绳悬挂着吊钩及起重具。该塔式起重机正吊运着一摞钢筋。左侧，另一台塔式起重机的正在吊运一台塔顶。另一台塔式起重机的机身身位于画面右上方。画面底部可见几名工人。前景中，一顶白色安全帽位于右下方。背景包含一个混凝土平台，几名工人站在顶部及附近。左下角处，还有四台塔式起重机。天空呈现阴霾云密布，太阳透过薄雾隐约可见。

err.en: the rigging system of another tower cran
err.zh: 另一台塔式起重机的正在吊运一台塔顶

err.en: The body of the other tower crane
err.zh: 另一台塔式起重机的机身身

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive groundwork in progress. There are four workers visible; three are standing on the ground within the construction framework, and the fourth one is standing dirt platform to the left. All workers are wearing hard hats and work attire. The site is filled with formworks made of red plywood sheets and wooden planks, rebar structures are enclosed in the middle of the formworks. In the foreground, a concrete hose is hanging from above and pouring concrete into a formwork. In the background, there is a crane with its boom extended into the sky on the left. There are also two dirt piles partially covered with green tarps and utility poles on top. The ground is muddy.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地基土工程进展显著。可见四名工人；其中三人站立在地面上，位于施工框架内，第四人则站在左侧的泥土台上。所有工人都戴着安全帽并穿着工作服。现场由红色胶合板和木方板搭建而成，钢筋结构被围在模板中央。前景中，一根混凝土管从上方垂下，将混凝土注入模板。背景中，一台起重机将其吊臂伸向左侧的天空。此外，还有两堆泥土部分被绿色篷布和电线杆覆盖在顶部。地面泥泞滑。

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers visible. They are walking on top of a wall made of interleaved black bricks that appear to be the side wall of a canal. A Hyundai excavator is operating in the background to the left. Large black corrugated pipes are laid out across the site. The background features urban buildings behind a fence.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，可见四名工人。他们正行走在由交错排列的黑色砖砌成的墙顶上方，这堵墙似乎是某运河的侧壁。一台现代挖掘机正在背景左侧作业。粗大的黑色波纹状管道横铺在整个工地上。背景中可见围栏后方的形城市建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, its bucket raised and full of muddy soil. There is a pile of sheet piles in the foreground. A black Lexus SUV is to the left and next to a utility pole. In the background, there are various vehicles on the left. On the right, some buildings with white facades and blue roofs are behind a blue fence. The ground is muddy.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，其铲斗扬起且装满了泥泞土。前景处有一排钢板桩。左侧有一辆黑色雷克萨斯SUV，紧挨着一辆越野车。背景中，左侧有一些车辆。右侧，一些白色立面、蓝色屋顶的建筑位于一道蓝色围栏后。地面是泥泞的。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers and a yellow crane truck. One worker is operating the crane from the truck bed, another is standing by the cabin of the truck. The third is on the left near a large steel pole section that is being hoisted by the crane. Two more workers are standing or crouching in front of the orange light truck in the background. In the background, there are power lines, a few buildings.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有五名工人和一辆黄色吊车卡车。一名工人正在从卡车驾驶室操作吊车，另一名站在卡车驾驶室旁。第三名在左侧，靠近一个大型钢梁截面，该钢梁正被吊车吊起。另外两名工人站在橙色轻型卡车前，或蹲着。背景中，有电线、几栋建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, excavated pit. There is a concrete slab in the excavation with a sparse rebar grid above it. There are seven workers visible; three are walking along a concrete pathway, one is crouching on a rebar grid structure, and three are standing near the edge of the excavation. The workers are wearing yellow hard hats, and some have safety vests. On the right side of the image, there is an excavator. Various construction materials, such as wooden planks and rebar, are scattered on the right. The background features white buildings and trees behind a blue fence.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一个大型开挖基坑。基坑内有一块混凝土板，其上方铺设着稀疏的钢筋网格。画面中可见七名工人；其中三人正沿着一条混凝土通道行走，一人在钢筋网格上弯腰作业，另外三人站在开挖基坑边缘附近。这些工人头戴黄色安全帽，部分人穿着安全背心。画面右侧有一台挖掘机。右侧散落着各种建筑材料，如木托盘和钢筋。背景中可见白色建筑物和树木，位于一道蓝色围栏后方。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers wearing safety vests and hard hats. Three workers are in the background walking or standing near a large blue tarp covering materials or earth. In the middle ground, a worker with a red hard hat is next to the surveying equipment, while the worker with a yellow hard hat is standing behind a hopper full of soil. In the foreground, a worker is in a foundation pit. There are multiple foundation pits with concrete side walls at the site. In the upper right of the image, there is a stack of precast concrete piles.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人穿着安全背心和硬帽子。三名工人在背景行走或站在大型蓝色覆盖材料或地球附近。在中间地面，一名工人戴着红色硬帽，接下来是调查设备，而戴着黄色硬帽的工人站在装满土壤的搅拌器后面。在前景，一名工人在基础坑中。在工地现场有多个带有混凝土侧墙的基础坑。在图像的右上角，有一堆预铸混凝土堆。

text: The image shows a Hyundai crawler excavator positioned on a muddy construction site. The excavator is holding some sheets. The ground appears to be wet and there are tracks. Overhead, there are electrical lines running across the image. In the background, there are some cell towers.
zh: 图中显示一台现代挖掘机停放在泥泞滑的建筑工地上。挖掘机正持有一些纸片。地面看起来是潮湿的，并且有轨道。在前景中，有电线横跨整个图像。在背景中，有一些电塔。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing yellow hard hats and casual clothing. Both workers are holding shovels in their hands. The site is characterized by excavated earth, with several rebar structures protruding from the ground. There's visible water accumulation around the site, and the ground is uneven with loose soil and rocks.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人戴着黄色安全帽，穿着便服装。两名工人都用手拿着铁锹。该工地的特征为挖掘的泥土，地面有几处钢筋结构突出。工地周围可见积水积聚，地面平整，伴有松散的土壤和岩石。

text: The image shows an indoor construction site with one worker visible. The worker is wearing a red hard hat and is engaged in welding, as indicated by the visible sparks. A large corrugated pipe is leaning against the worker. In the foreground, there are construction materials and garbage, including cardboard boxes, red pipe clamps, and metal rods. The structure has a high ceiling with metal beams and large windows allowing natural light to enter. The floor is concrete.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，可见一名工人。该工人头戴红色安全帽，正在进行焊接作业，从可见火花判断。一根大型波纹状管道斜靠在工人身旁。前景处有建筑材料和垃圾，包括纸箱、红色管状灯具以及金属杆。该结构具有高高的天花板，带有金属梁和大窗户，允许自然光进入。地面为混凝土材质。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible, wearing a white hard hat and casual clothing, walking on the left. In the center, there is a yellow drum roller with the brand "XCMG" on it. The ground appears to be muddy with some puddles, and there are scattered construction materials and debris. In the background, there are trees and some buildings. Electricity wires stretch across the top of the image.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一名工人清晰可见，头戴白色安全帽，身着便服装，正从左侧走过。画面中央有一台黄色色滚筒压路机，上面印有“XCM G”品牌标识。地面看起来泥泞污不堪，有些水坑，并且散落着施工材料和碎屑。背景中有一些树木和建筑物。电线横跨画面顶部。

text: The image shows a group of eight men gathered during daylight, with an overpass in the background. They appear to be engaged in a discussion. There is a red car on the left. The traffic light is red on the overpass.
zh: 图像显示，八名男子在白天聚集在一起，背景中有一辆过路车。他们似乎正在参与一场讨论。左侧有一辆红色汽车。过路车上的交通信号灯是红色的。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers standing near a yellow excavator that is positioned in the center. The worker on the left is wearing a red hard hat, while the worker on the right is wearing a white hard hat. The ground appears to be muddy with some gravel spread in the area immediately surrounding the excavator. In the background, there is an expanse of dug-up earth.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，两名工人站在位于画面中央的一台黄色挖掘机旁。左侧的工人戴着一顶红色安全帽，而右侧的工人则戴着一顶白色安全帽。地面看起来泥泞湿，且挖掘机周围散布着一些碎石。背景中有一大片被挖开的的大面积。

err.zh: 一大片被挖开的的大面积

text: The image shows a single yellow excavator in the center, positioned on an elevated mound of dirt, with its bucket in the soil. The track of the excavator is inclined. In the background, there is a hazy skyline with buildings. The ground appears to be dry and uneven, with tracks from construction vehicles.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色挖掘机，停在一堆高起的土堆上，其铲斗插入泥土中。挖掘机的履带倾斜。背景中有一片朦胧的天际线，带有建筑物。地面看起来干燥且平坦，带有施工车辆的履带。

text: Two people on the right of the group of people are not wearing hard hats. The rightmost person is wearing shorts. The leftmost worker is wearing slippers.
zh: 该群体右侧的两人未佩戴安全帽。最右侧的人穿着短裤。最左侧工人戴着太阳镜。

text: The image shows a single yellow excavator positioned in the center, with a bucket full of soil. An operator can be seen in the cabin of the excavator. The excavator is situated on a muddy terrain with visible tire tracks around it. In the background, there are cleared areas with piles of felled trees and brush. The background also features blurred structures.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色挖掘机，车斗内装满泥土。驾驶室内可见一名操作人员。挖掘机停放在泥泞地上，周围可见轮胎印迹。背景中有清晰区域，堆放着成堆的树木和刷子。背景中还还有模糊化的结构。

err.en: The background also features blurred str
err.zh: 背景中还还有模糊化的结构。

text: The image shows a construction worker in orange coveralls and a red hard hat inside a curved, rebar-reinforced concrete structure. The worker appears to be inspecting or working on the rebar framework. The structure has wooden formwork in the middle and metal poles supporting the formwork. Other individuals are partially visible on the left edge of the photo, standing on a wooden platform. The construction area has visible rust and concrete stains.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿红色硬壳的施工人员，身处一个弯曲的、钢筋加强的化的混凝土结构内部。该工人似乎正在检查或操作该钢筋框架。结构具有木质形式作业位于中部，以及金属极支撑形式作业。照片左边缘部分可见另一人，站在木质平台上。施工区域可见锈蚀迹与混凝土污渍。

err.en: orange coveralls and a red hard hat
err.zh: 橙色安全帽、身穿红色硬壳
钢筋加强的化的混凝土结构

text: The image shows a large excavation site with one worker visible in the foreground. In the center, there is a yellow telescopic crane and a wheeled loader with a bucket full of gravel. The crane is hoisting a hose whose end is immersed in the waterbody. The ground is muddy with puddles of water. In the background, there are elevated dirt walls and additional workers can be seen at various points around the site. There is also an orange excavator.
zh: 图像显示一个大型土方方工地，前景中可见一名工人。画面中央有一台黄色履带式起重机和一辆装载满碎石料的的车斗。起重机吊着一根软管，其末端浸在水中。地面泥泞滑，带有水坑。背景中可见高耸的土墙，以及可在工地各处看到的其他工人。此外还有一台橙色挖掘机。

err.en: wheeled loader with a bucket full of gra
err.zh: 装载满碎石料的的车斗

err.en: The ground is muddy with puddles of wate

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow excavator in the foreground, its bucket raised. In the background, there are at least four tower cranes. In the background, there are multiple buildings under construction surrounded by yellow scaffolding and green safety netting. Construction materials, such as wood and metal rods, are scattered around the site. The ground appears muddy and a fallen tree is next to the excavator. To the right of the excavator, there is a scaffolding framework.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台黄色色挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起。背景中至少有四座塔式起重机。背景中有多栋正在施工的建筑，周围环绕着黄色脚手架和绿色安全防护网。建筑材料，如木材和金属杆，散落在工地周围。地面显得泥泞滑，一台挖掘机旁有一棵倒下的树。在挖掘机右侧，有一个脚手架框架。

err.en: a fallen tree is next to the excavator
err.zh: 一台挖掘机旁有一棵倒下的树

text: The image shows a large excavation site. There are two excavators in operation, one in the center and one on the left, both with extended arms and buckets. A dump truck is positioned near the central excavator. Two dump trucks are located next to the left excavator. There are large piles of excavated soil throughout the site. In the background, there is a white and blue storage tank. The terrain is uneven with visible tracks from construction vehicles, and the site is surrounded by a flat landscape with some vegetation and structures in the far distance.
zh: 图像显示一个大型开挖场地。现场有两台挖掘机正在作业，一台位于中央，另一台位于左侧，两者均配备长臂和铲斗。一台自卸车停靠在中央挖掘机附近。两台自卸车位于左侧挖掘机的旁。整个场地散布着大堆的开挖土方。背景中可见一个白色和蓝色的储槽。地形平坦，带有施工车辆留下的可见轨迹，场地被一片平坦的景观貌所环绕，远处有一些植被和结构。

text: The image shows a construction site with two green dump trucks in the foreground, the left one is tipping its bed while the right one is carrying a full load of soil. In the background, there are three tower cranes and high-rise buildings under construction. To the right, an excavator is operating near a stockpile of large concrete pipes. On the left, there is an excavator, a water truck, and a pickup truck. There are also multiple piles of pipes including black ones and orange ones, throughout the area.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景有两辆绿色自卸卡车，左边一辆正在倾倒其车斗，右边一辆满载着一车泥土。背景中有三座塔式起重机和正在施工的高层建筑。右侧，一台挖掘机正在靠近一堆大型混凝土管道作业。左侧，有一台挖掘机、一辆自卸卡车和一辆皮卡卡车。整个区域还散布着多堆管道，包括黑色的和橙色的。

text: The image shows a large, open construction site with earthmoving activities. In the foreground, there are construction materials, including white pipes, laid out on the ground. Two workers wearing yellow hard hats are visible in the bottom right corner. Several pieces of heavy construction equipment are distributed across the site, including a yellow excavator in the center, a bulldozer in the middle ground, two other excavators, and dump trucks to the right. There are two civilian vehicles parked in the middle ground, a black SUV in the middle, and a white van on the right. The background features a green landscape with trees and a hilly terrain. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个大型露天施工现场，正在进行土方作业。前景地面上摆放着建筑材料，包括白色管道。画面右下角可见两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。现场分布着多件重型型施工设备，包括位于中央的一台黄色挖掘机、中部的一台推土机、另外两台挖掘机以及右侧的一辆泵车。中部地面上停放着两辆民用车辆，中间是一辆黑色SUV，右侧是一辆白色厢式货车。背景为绿色景观，带有树木和丘陵地形。天空呈灰白色。

text: One worker on the left and two workers sitting on the right are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 左侧的一名工人和右侧的两名为“hard hats”的工人均未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: two workers sitting on the right
err.zh: 右侧的两名为“hard hats”的工人

text: The image shows a construction site with three excavators in the foreground, the yellow one is digging into a mound of earth. There are four workers grouped together. In the foreground, there is a large green pipe and a pile of metal pipes to the left. The ground appears muddy and uneven. In the background, there is a large building with a steel frame facade, and further back, there are white and blue structures and a power line tower. The sky is clear.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有三名挖掘机，其中黄色的那台正在向一堆泥土中挖掘。有四名工人聚在一起。前景处有一根大型绿色管道以及左侧一堆金属管。地面显得泥泞且平坦。背景中有一栋大型建筑，带有钢制框架立面，更远处有黑白相间的结构以及一座电力线塔。天空晴朗。

text: The image shows a construction site with three prominent pieces of heavy machinery. In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator with its bucket in the air. A drum roller is to the left of the excavator. In the background, a large crawler crane with a lattice boom is visible. There is a pile of orange pipes in the foreground between the drum roller and the excavator. A stack of green pipes is on the right.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有三台显眼的大型机械。前景中有一台黄色挖掘机，其铲斗在空中。鼓式压路机位于挖掘机的左侧。背景中可见一台大型履带起重机，带有格状吊斗。前景中，在鼓式压路机和挖掘机之间有一堆橙色管道。右侧有一堆绿色管道。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in operation. The excavator on the left is orange and appears to be digging or moving earth, while the yellow Komatsu excavator on the right is positioned on a mound of dirt. The site is bordered by a white fence, and there are power lines running across the background. The ground appears uneven with patches of grass and exposed soil.
zh: 图中显示一个施工场地，有两名挖掘机正在作业。左侧的挖掘机为橙色，似乎正在挖掘或搬运泥土，而右侧黄色的小松挖掘机则停在一堆泥土上。该场地由白色围栏网围，背景中有电力线横跨。地面看起来平整，夹杂着草皮和裸露的土壤。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebars laid out in a grid pattern. There are four workers visible: one on the left side of the image is bending down, possibly tying rebar or inspecting the work; two workers are near the center. One more worker is in the upper right. All workers are wearing safety helmets, and there is an inclined formwork on the right side.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大量钢筋以网格状排列铺设。可见四名工人：一名位于画面左侧，正弯腰，可能在绑扎钢筋或检查作业；两名工人靠近画面中央。另一名工人位于右上方。所有工人都佩戴着安全帽，右侧有一处倾斜的脚手架。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow dump truck in the process of tipping its bed to unload material. There is a bulldozer with tracks positioned directly behind the dump truck. A worker wearing a red jacket and a helmet is standing next to the bulldozer, observing the operation. The surrounding area includes a fenced-off section with metal barriers, and there are buildings with yellow doors in the background. The ground is covered with sand and gravels.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，一辆黄色自卸卡车正在卸其车斗以卸载材料。有一台带轨道的推土机直接位于自卸卡车后方。一名身穿红色夹克并戴安全帽的工人站在推土机旁，观察着操作。周围区域包括一个围栏离部分带有金属屏障，并且背景中有黄色门的建筑物。地面覆盖着沙子和砾石。

err.en: a fenced-off section with metal barriers
err.zh: 一个围栏离部分带有金属屏障

text: The image shows a construction site with earthmoving activities. There are two construction workers visible; both of them are on the left of the image. To the left, there is a bulldozer partially visible. In the middle, there is a drum roller. The ground is uneven with multiple dirt piles. In the background, some power lines can be seen on top of an embankment.
zh: 图像显示一个正在进行土方方施工的建筑工地的。画面中可见两名建筑工人；他们两人都在图像的左侧。在左侧，有一台部分可见的推土机。在中间，有一台压路机。地面平整，有多处土堆。在背景中，可以看到一些电力线位于一个基坑上方。

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers visible. One worker is on the ground near the center, wearing a yellow hard hat. Another worker is standing on a scaffolding structure, also wearing a yellow hard hat, and seems to be working on the concrete. Two other workers are crouching on top of the scaffolding structure. There is a blue Kobelco excavator in the foreground on the right, with its arm extended towards the formwork. The excavator is lifting an assembly of red plywood sheets with its arm. In the foreground, a stack of metal plates is on the ground with some water bottles and buckets on top of it. In the background, residential buildings can be seen.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，可见四名工人。一名工人站在地面上，靠近中心位置，头戴黄色安全帽。另一名工人站在脚手架结构上，同样头戴黄色安全帽，似乎正在混凝土上作业。另外两名工人聚集在脚手架顶部。前景右侧有一台蓝色挖掘机，其臂部伸向该工人。挖掘机正用其臂部抬起一叠红色胶合板。前景处有一堆金属板，地面上放着一些水瓶和桶，位于其顶部。背景中可见住宅建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large mobile crane in the center, positioned on an embankment fenced by metal poles. The crane's boom is extended towards the upper side of the image. There is one visible worker standing near the base of the crane to the left. The worker is standing on the top of a temporary staircase. In the background, there are multiple scaffolding structures covered with green safety netting, and a tower crane is visible in the distance. The ground appears to be muddy, and there is a stack of steel rebars on the ground in the foreground.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型移动式起重机，其吊臂架设在金属杆上。起重机的臂向画面上方延伸。可见一名工人站在起重机基左侧附近。该工人站在临时楼梯顶部。背景中有多处脚手架结构，覆盖着绿色安全网，远处可见一台塔式起重机。地面看起来是泥泞地，前景地面上有一堆钢筋。

err.en: positioned on an embankment fenced by me
err.zh: 其吊臂架设在金属杆上

text: The image shows a pile driver in the center, positioned on a construction site with muddy ground. Some metal rings are next to the pile driver. In the background, there is a large mound of earth with blue-green tarps in place. The boom of a mobile crane can be seen at the toe of the large mound of earth.
zh: 画面中央有一堆司机，位于泥泞地施工现场上。一些金属环位于司机堆的旁边。背景中有一个巨大的土堆，上面有蓝绿色的碎片状物。大型土堆的底部可以看到一台移动起重机。

err.en: The boom of a mobile crane

text: The image shows a construction site with various heavy vehicles. In the foreground, there is a yellow JAC dump truck on the left and a pile of rubble. In the middle, there are two red JAC dump trucks parked side by side, and an orange dump truck is positioned on the left. Behind these vehicles, there is a yellow excavator. On the right, there is an embankment with transmission cables on top.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，有多辆重型车辆。前景左侧有一辆黄色混凝土搅拌运输车和一堆碎石。中间有两辆红色混凝土搅拌运输车并排停放，左侧还有一辆橙色搅拌运输车。这些车辆后方有一台黄色挖掘机。右侧有一个基坑，顶部放着输电电缆。

text: The image shows an excavator in the process of loading soil into the back of a dump truck. The excavator is positioned to the left of the truck and on top of a mound of dirt, with its bucket raised and containing soil. The terrain is uneven with mounds of soil. In the background, there is a road with a barrier on the far side.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正在将泥土装载到一辆自卸卡车的后部。挖掘机位于卡车的左侧，并停在一堆土堆的上方，其铲斗已抬起且装有泥土。地形平坦，伴有土堆。在背景中，有一条道路，其远侧设有护栏。

err.en: The terrain is uneven with mounds of soi

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom to pour concrete into a foundation area. A white concrete mixer truck and an orange excavator are next to the concrete pump truck. There are at least nine workers visible, with some directly involved in the concrete pouring process and others scattered around the site. The site has multiple sections partitioned by concrete foundations with reinforcement bars sticking out. In the background, there is a transmission substation with electrical transmission towers visible.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一辆混凝土泵车正将其混凝土泵送其料斗倒入基础区域。一辆白色混凝土搅拌车及一台橙色挖掘机位于混凝土泵车旁。现场至少有九名工人可见，其中部分直接参与混凝土浇筑过程，其余人员散布于工地周围。该工地由混凝土基础及外露出的钢筋条分隔成多个区段。背景中可见一座输电变电站所，带有电力传输塔。

err.en: extending its boom to pour concrete into
err.zh: 正将其混凝土泵送其料斗倒入基础区域

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers. One worker in an orange jacket and a red hard hat is crouching on the left, working on a wire fence. In the middle distance, another worker in an orange jacket is standing and engaged in a similar task with the fence. A third worker in a blue hard hat is further back, walking along the fence line. The ground is uneven and dug up, with some green vegetation on the left. In the background, there is a road.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人。左侧一名身穿橙色夹克、头戴红色安全帽的工人正蹲着，在铁丝网围栏上作业。中景处，另一名身穿橙色夹克的工人站立着，正从事与围栏相关的类似的任务。第三名头戴蓝色安全帽的工人位于更靠后的方，正沿着围栏线行走。地面平整且被挖掘过，左侧有一些绿色植被。背景中有一条道路。

err.en: The ground is uneven and dug up

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator on the left. There is one individual visible, standing in front of the excavator with a black helmet. The ground is uneven with mounds of dirt. In the background, there are constructed buildings with exposed brickwork.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左侧有一台挖掘机。可见一名工人站在挖掘机前方，头戴黑色安全帽。地面平整，周围堆着泥土。背景中可见正在施工的建筑，露出砖砌工程。

text: The image shows a construction site with nine workers engaged in various activities. All wearing yellow hard hats. On the right, some workers are spreading or compacting material on the ground, which is a foundation for construction covered with a grid of rebars. Two concrete walls are visible. On the left, there is a large formwork structure made of red plywood sheets with scaffolding, and behind it, a blue fence is partially visible. The ground is uneven and littered with construction debris.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有九名工人正在从事各种活动。所有人都戴着黄色安全帽。右侧，一些工人正在地面铺设或堆叠材料，地面是用于建筑的基础，覆盖着由钢筋组成的网格。两面混凝土墙可见。左侧，有一个大型结构，由红色胶合板制成，带有脚手架，其后方，一道蓝色围栏部分可见。地面平整，散落着建筑碎屑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, rebar grid structure structure surrounded by scaffolds. The scaffolds are fenced by blue metal fences. There are at least eight workers visible, all wearing red coveralls and yellow hard hats. Some workers are on the fenced scaffold, some are on temporary scaffoldings attached to the rebar structure, and one worker is on the ground level beneath the scaffold. There are also several stockpiles of construction materials, including blue scaffolding components on the right of the image. The background features a body of water.
zh: 图像显示一个大型钢筋混凝土结构，周围环绕着脚手架。脚手架由蓝色金属围栏网围护。可见至少八名工人，全都穿着红色防护衣和黄色安全帽。一些工人在围栏网式脚手架上，一些在附着于结构的上的临时脚手架上，还有一名工人在脚手架下方的地面层上。此外还有几堆建筑材料，包括图像右侧的蓝色脚手架组件。背景中有一处水体。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with three excavators. The excavator in the foreground has a visible operator inside the cabin. The ground around is uneven and covered in mud. In the background, there are buildings that appear to be part of a residential area. The weather seems overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个泥泞地施工现场，有三台挖掘机。前景中的挖掘机驾驶室内可见一名操作员。周围地面平整且被泥浆覆盖。背景中有一些建筑物，看起来属于住宅区。天气似乎阴沉。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, one worker is bending over near a pile of wooden planks, while another worker is standing and welding a metal rod with a tool that is emitting sparks. The worker between them is standing on a lower level. All workers are wearing hard hats. There are several stockpiles of construction materials, including wooden planks, wooden sheets, and scaffolding poles in the foreground and to the right. In the background, there are additional workers scattered across the site, a tower crane, and the outlines of buildings and cranes in the distant skyline.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种活动。在前景中，一名工人正弯腰靠近一堆木托盘，而另一名工人站立着，正用一把工具焊接一根金属杆，该工具正迸出火花。他们之间的一名工人站立在较低的位置。所有工人都戴着安全帽。有几堆建筑材料，包括木托盘、木板以及脚手架杆，位于前景和右侧。在背景中，有额外的工人散布在工地各处，一台塔式起重机，以及远处天际线中建筑物的和缆索的轮廓。

text: The image shows a construction site with two yellow excavators in earthmoving activities. There is excavated earth piled up around the area. The ground is muddy with some puddles of water, and there are warning signs and a traffic cone in the foreground. In the background, there is a large factory building and power lines. A yellow flag is in the middle of the image on an asphalt pavement.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有两名黄色挖掘机正在进行土方作业。周围堆着挖掘出的来的泥土。地面泥泞湿，有些水坑，并且有警示标志和前景处的一个交通锥。背景中有一栋大型厂房建筑和电力线。图像中部沥青路面上有一面黄色旗。

text: The image shows a construction site with one bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. There is one operator visible inside the bulldozer's cabin. Some tree debris are next to the bulldozer. To the left of the image, there is one individual crouching on the ground. The background features a large expanse of cleared land with some plastic sheeting on the ground and a few structures in the far distance.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台推土机正在作业，其内可见一名操作人员。推土机旁有一些树木碎屑。画面左侧，地面上有一名正在哭泣的人。背景呈现一大片开阔的空地，地面上有一些塑料板材，远处有一些结构。

text: The image shows a blue Kobelco excavator in the center, digging muddy soil in an open area. The bucket of the excavator is full of mud. In the background, there are various structures, including a green bus and a perimeter fence, with buildings further in the distance. The ground is uneven and covered with patches of vegetation, and there are puddles of water.
zh: 画面中央是一台蓝色的科贝尔挖掘机，正在一片开阔区域挖掘泥泞土。挖掘机的料斗内满是泥浆。背景中可见多种结构，包括一辆绿色公交车和周边围栏，远处还有建筑物。地面平整，覆盖着植被斑块，并且有水洼。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing hard hats and red safety vests. They are in the upper right portion of the image with exposed earth. On the left, there are two piles of rebars and one pile of red metal poles. A fence made of metal rods separates the left and the right of the image. A blue garbage bin in on the top of the image.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，五名工人头戴安全帽，身穿红色安全背心。他们位于画面右上方，背景中露出泥土。左侧有两堆钢筋和一堆红色金属杆。一道由金属杆构成的的人行道将画面左右分隔开。画面顶部有一个蓝色垃圾箱。

err.en: A fence made of metal rods
err.zh: 一道由金属杆构成的的人行道

text: The person in the foreground is not wearing a hard hat. Two people in the background besides the dump truck are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 前景中的人未佩戴安全帽。背景中除那辆自卸卡车外的两个人外，另外两人也未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: Two people in the background besides the
err.zh: 背景中除那辆自卸卡车外的两个人外，另外两人也未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a group of seven workers on the left, all wearing safety vests and hard hats. In the middle, there is a yellow loader and an excavator on a hillside. In the foreground, a jackhammer is resting on the ground. The background features a bridge and a natural, hilly landscape. The ground appears to be muddy and uneven.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左侧有一组七名工人，均身着安全背心、头戴安全帽。中部有一台黄色装载机和一台挖掘机停在一侧。前景处一把铁锤放置于地面。背景呈现一座桥梁和自然、丘陵地貌。地面看似泥泞滑且不平整。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. Approximately nine workers wearing orange and yellow hard hats are visible, with some bending over and handling rebar. There are large stockpiles of construction materials, including one pile of rebars, one pile of wooden planks, a pile of tarps, and three piles of metal poles on the concrete platform in the foreground. In the foreground, a worker is bending and a trolley is also visible. The background features an excavated area with retaining walls.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种活动。大约可以看到九名头戴橙色和黄色安全帽的工人，其中一些工人正在弯曲并处理钢筋。现场有大型建筑材料堆，包括一堆钢筋、一堆木托盘、一堆模板以及前景混凝土平台上三堆金属杆。在前景中，一名工人正在弯曲，同时一辆手推车也清晰可见。背景中有一处开挖区域，并带有挡土墙。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers engaged in various activities. In the center, three workers wearing yellow or blue hard hats are operating a machine to process rebars. To the right, a worker in grey is bending over. In the foreground, there are multiple bundles of rebars. There are also loose rebars in the background. The ground is covered with green tarps.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，五名工人正在从事各种活动。在中心，三名戴着黄色或蓝色安全帽的工人正在操作一台机器以加工钢筋。在右侧，一名穿灰色衣服的的人正弯腰。在前景，有多束钢筋。背景中也有散落的着的的一些钢筋。地面覆盖着绿色植被。

text: The image shows a construction site with an orange Hyundai excavator positioned near a body of water on the left side. There is a dirt path leading away from the excavator, and the ground appears to be uneven with tire tracks and a white mark. In the background, traditional-style buildings and modern street lamps can be seen.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一台橙色现代挖掘机停靠在左侧的水体旁。有一条土路从挖掘机延伸出去，地面看起来平整，带有轮胎痕迹和白色标记。背景中可以看到传统风格建筑和现代路灯。

err.en: the ground appears to be uneven

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site where a large area is covered with rebars laid out in a grid pattern. There are approximately 17 workers visible, most of whom are wearing safety vests and hard hats, scattered across the site, and engaged in various activities related to the construction work. There are multiple red wooden boards placed irregularly on top of the rebars, and a green tarp is partially covering the concrete platform on the right. Two more stacks of rebars are in the lower right of the image.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的俯瞰视角，其中一大片区域被钢筋覆盖，钢筋以网格状排列。画面中可见约17名工人，其中大多数佩戴着安全帽和穿着安全背心，分散在工地各处，从事与建筑施工相关的的工作。多块红色木板规则地放置在钢筋顶部，一块绿色防水布部分覆盖着右侧的混凝土平台。画面右下方还有两堆钢筋。

text: In the image, there is one worker in the foreground using a jackhammer to break up concrete debris near a steel column base. The worker is wearing a camouflage jacket. There is a pile of broken concrete and brick pieces around the worker. In the background, there is a large steel framework structure. The ground is muddy with puddles of water, and there is a pile of steel beams next to the worker. Some concrete piles are in the upper right of the image.
zh: 前景中有一名工人，正用一把大锤敲击钢柱基附近的破碎的混凝土碎块。该工人身穿迷彩服。工人周围堆着破碎的混凝土和砖块。背景中有一个大型钢架结构。地面泥泞着，带有水坑，工人旁边有一堆钢梁。图像右上方有一些混凝土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site where foundation work is in progress. In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a high-visibility vest is crouching inside a foundation pit while laying concrete blocks or bricks. Two other workers, also in yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests, are standing in the midground. The ground is covered with a blue tarp, and there are piles of concrete blocks, bricks, and wooden planks scattered around the site. In the background, an excavator is visible, and there are additional tarps and construction debris. The head of another worker wearing a yellow hard hat can be seen in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，基础工程正在进行施工中。前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人正蹲在基坑内铺设混凝土块或砖块。另外两名同样头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人站在中景处。地面覆盖着蓝色防水布，现场周围散落着混凝土块、砖块和木托盘。背景中可见一台挖掘机，还有额外的土堆和建筑废料。背景中另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人的头部可见。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers visible. In the foreground, there is a large area covered with horizontal and vertical rebars creating a grid pattern on the ground. Two workers in the middle are standing on the rebar grid, with one of them wearing an orange vest and a white hard hat, and the other in casual clothing. To the left, two workers in yellow hard hats can be seen. In the midground, two workers are on the scaffold. One is climbing the scaffolding, another is bending on top of the scaffolding. In the background, there is an embankment behind a green mesh fence. On the left, there is a concrete tunnel.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，可见六名工人。前景中有一大片由横向和纵向钢筋构成的网格状地面的。中间有两名工人站在钢筋网格上，其中一人穿着橙色背心和白色安全帽，另一人穿着便服。左侧可见两名戴着黄色安全帽的工人。中景处有两名工人在脚手架上。一人正在攀爬脚手架，另一人弯着身子站在脚手架顶部。背景中有一处被绿色网状围栏遮挡的建筑物。左侧有一处混凝土隧道。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with standing water at the bottom. On the left side, there is a yellow excavator positioned on the edge of the site. The surrounding area is relatively barren with some vegetation and power lines in the background. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图中显示一处大型基坑，底部有积水。左侧有一台黄色挖掘机停靠在场地边缘。周边区域相对荒芜凉，有一些植被，背景中有电力线。天空阴沉。

text: In the image, an excavator is positioned on a mound of earth on the right, loading dirt into the bed of a dump truck on the left. The truck is parked on an uneven surface, partially filled with dirt. The background shows a steep, excavated hillside with some vegetation on top of it. The foreground features a paved road in the lower part of the frame. There is a small pile of gravel near the excavator.
zh: 图中，一台挖掘机停放在右侧的一堆土堆上，正在将泥土装入左侧的一辆自卸卡车的车厢内。该卡车停放在一片平整的地面上，部分装载着泥土。背景中可见一座陡峭的、经过开挖的山坡，其顶部生长着一些植被。前景下部展现出一条铺装好的路面的。在挖掘机附近有一小堆碎石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of rebars laid out in a grid pattern. There are five workers visible, all wearing hard hats. A worker with a yellow hard hat is standing near the center. Four other workers are in front of the perimeter fence made of yellow metal poles and green safety nets. Three of them are crouching and tying rebars. There are black boards in the grid created by rebars. Multiple bundles of rebars are scattered across the site. There are blue and white buildings in the background on the right, and there is a road with trees on both sides on the left.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大量钢筋以网格状排列。可见五名工人，均佩戴安全帽。一名佩戴黄色安全帽的工人站在中心位置。另外四名工人位于由黄色金属杆和绿色安全网构成的围栏的前。其中三人正在搬运并捆绑钢筋。网格中存在黑色板材，由钢筋构成。多束钢筋散落在工地各处。右侧背景中有蓝色和白色建筑，左侧两侧均有带树木的道路。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible. The worker is wearing a blue hard hat and is standing at the bottom right, throwing fractured rocks into the gabion basket. In the center and left of the image, there are multiple gabion baskets filled with rocks, which are secured with metal wire mesh and supported by scaffolding. The ground is uneven with loose soil and rocks scattered around.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，可见一名工人。该工人头戴蓝色安全帽，站在画面右下方，正将破碎的岩石投入盖土筐中。在画面中央及左侧，有多个装满岩石的盖土筐，这些筐由金属丝网加固，并得到脚手架的支撑。地面平整，周围散落着松散的泥土块与碎石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large expanse of disturbed earth. In the upper right, there is a bulldozer pushing soil. To the left of the bulldozer, there is one visible worker. There are multiple tracks in the soil. In the foreground, there is an elevated well with brick side walls and a green flag marker. A concrete pile is near the green flag. Electrical lines run horizontally across the image.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一大片大面积的扰动土。右上方有一台推土机正在推土。推土机左侧可见一名工人。土中有多条履带。前景处有一口高架高的砖墙和一面绿色旗帜标记。绿色旗帜附近有一堆混凝土。电线横穿整个图像。

err.en: an elevated well with brick side walls

text: The image shows a construction site with a partially completed structure featuring steel columns and beams supporting a metal roof. There are at least six workers visible, all wearing red hard hats. Four workers are gathered together, two of them are holding a long rod to reach the beam on the top. Two more workers are crouching on the right. In the background, there is another multi-level structure with similar steel construction. The exterior of the upper level is protected by green safety netting.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，其部分结构已完工，设有钢柱和梁支撑着金属屋顶。可见至少有六名工人，全都戴着红色安全帽。四名工人聚在一起，其中两人正持着一根长杆，以够到顶部的梁上。另外两名工人在右侧蹲着。背景中还有另一个多层结构，具有类似的钢制建造。上部内层由绿色安全防护网保护。

err.en: The exterior of the upper level

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, equipped with a blade, and operating on a dirt surface with visible tracks. The ground is uneven with various piles of soil and debris scattered around, including some vegetation and branches in the foreground on the right side.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中央有一台推土机，配备刀片具，在可见轨道的地面上作业。地面平整，周围散落着各种土堆和碎屑，包括前景右侧的一些植被和树枝。

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven, muddy terrain marked by tire tracks. In the foreground, there is a blue flatbed truck with some concrete slabs on its bed. To the right of the truck, one worker is visible walking near an opening with walls. In the background, there is a yellow dump truck to the right, a pile of dirt, and a pile of bricks in the middle. The head of another person is visible to the left of the pile of dirt.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面平坦泥泞湿，布满轮胎印痕。前景处有一辆蓝色平板卡车，车斗上载有一些混凝土试块。卡车右侧，一名工人正行走在敞口附近，旁边有墙体。背景处，右侧有一辆黄色泵车，旁边有一堆泥土，中间有一堆砖。另一人头部可见于泥堆左侧。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete pump truck with its arm extended vertically in the center. On the left, a cement mixer truck is parked on a platform, and three workers are visible around it. There are wooden staircases leading down to a lower level where rebar mesh is laid out. The arm of the concrete pump truck descends from the sky and the concrete hose is pouring concrete into the rebar mesh. In the background, two tower cranes are visible on the right, and there's a structure covered with green safety netting.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一辆大型混凝土泵车位于画面中央，其吊臂垂直向下延伸。左侧，一辆水泥搅拌车停放在平台上，周围可见三名工人。有木质脚手架向下延伸至较低处，那里铺设着钢筋网。混凝土泵车的吊臂从天空垂下，混凝土软管将混凝土注入钢筋网。背景中，右侧可见两台塔式起重机，并且覆盖着绿色安全防护网。

err.en: there's a structure covered with green s
err.zh: 并且覆盖着绿色安全防护网

text: The image shows a construction site with a large tower crane in the center, its boom extending across the frame. In the foreground, there is a red truck parked on the left side, partially visible. The truck is on a dirt platform fenced by metal poles. A red banner with white Chinese characters is hanging on the fence. In the background, there are multiple multi-level buildings under construction. The buildings have scaffolding covered with metal poles and green safety nets.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面。前景左侧停着一辆红色卡车，部分可见。卡车停在一处由金属杆围成的土质平台上。围栏上悬挂着一条印有白色汉字的样的式的红色横幅幅。背景中有多栋多层建筑正在施工。建筑外覆盖着由金属杆和绿色安全网组成的。

err.en: A red banner with white Chinese characte
err.zh: 围栏上悬挂着一条印有白色汉字的样的式的红色横幅幅。

err.en: The buildings have scaffolding covered w
err.zh: 建筑外覆盖着由金属杆和绿色安全网组成的。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers among rebars. The rebars are arranged in a grid pattern on the ground. One worker, wearing a yellow hard hat, is positioned on the left side of the image and is holding a welding tool. Two workers in the middle of the image are holding and raising a rebar roll together. The background shows an orange excavator on top of a mound of dirt. A concrete retaining wall is behind the excavator. The background also features a worker with a blue hard hat on the right.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有五个工人在钢筋之间。钢筋排列在地面上的呈网格状。一名工人，戴着黄色安全帽，位于图像的左侧，手持焊接工具。中间的两名为工人，手持并抬起一根钢筋。背景显示一台橙色挖掘机位于一堆泥土上方。混凝土挡土墙位于挖掘机后方。背景中还有一名戴着蓝色安全帽的工人位于右侧。

err.en: Two workers in the middle of the image a
err.zh: 中间的两名为工人，手持并抬起一根钢筋。

text: The image shows a construction site with an orange excavator in the center, actively loading soil into the bed of a blue dump truck. In the background, there are high-rise buildings. A yellow tower crane can be seen on the left. The arm of a concrete pump truck is visible to the right of the tower crane.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台橙色挖掘机，正将泥土装入一辆蓝色自卸卡车的货厢。背景中可见高层建筑。左侧可见一台黄色塔式起重机。塔式起重机的臂位于右侧。

err.en: The arm of a concrete pump truck is visi
err.zh: 塔式起重机的臂位于右侧。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on bare soil. The excavator's boom is extended and raised. The background features a cut earth section.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在裸露的土壤上。挖掘机的的前部突出且被抬起。背景中可见一个开挖的土体剖面。

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center foreground, which appears to be engaged in earthmoving activities. There is one individual visible in the background, walking on the cleared land. The area around the bulldozer is uneven and has piles of dirt and debris, including uprooted trees and branches. The background features a partially excavated or cleared field with water bodies visible in the distance. A building made of bricks is visible to the left.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景中央有一台推土机，似乎正在进行土方作业。背景中可见一人，正行走在平整地上。推土机周围地面平整，并堆有泥土和碎石，包括被连根树枝。背景中有一处部分开挖或平整的场地，远处可见水体。左侧可见一栋砖砌建筑。

err.en: The area around the bulldozer is uneven

text: The image shows a construction worker wearing an orange jacket and a red hard hat, who appears to be working on a manhole. The worker is standing at the edge of the manhole, which is lined with bricks and has a dark interior. A bucket full of mortar with a trowel on top is positioned at the edge of the manhole next to the worker. The ground around the manhole is uneven and covered with dirt and fractured bricks. Two more trowels are in the upper right corner.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人身穿橙色夹克，头戴红色安全帽，似乎正在一个孔洞上作业。工人站在孔洞边缘，该边缘用砖砌砌，内部昏暗。一个装满砂浆的桶，顶部放着一把梯子，位于孔洞边缘，紧挨着工人。孔洞周围地面平整，覆盖着泥土和破碎的砖块。另外两把梯子位于右上角上方。

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven terrain and several mounds of black or brown earth. On the left, there is a yellow dump truck, and on the right, a red dump truck is visible. In the middle, a teal excavator is operating, loading another red dump truck. A group of at least seven individuals is standing to the right of the excavator, observing or waiting. The ground appears muddy with puddles of water. In the background, there is some vegetation. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个施工场地，地势平坦，有几堆黑色或棕色的泥土。左侧有一辆黄色自卸卡车，右侧可见一辆红色自卸卡车。中间有一台青绿色挖掘机正在作业，装载着另一辆红色自卸卡车。挖掘机右侧站着一群至少七个人，正在观察或等待。地面显得泥泞，有水坑。背景中有一些植被。天空阴沉。

text: The image shows a large excavation with an extensive rebar framework in place. The rebar framework is enclosed by formworks made of red metal plates. There are three workers visible and are within the rebar structure. All workers are wearing yellow hard hats. The workers appear to be inspecting or measuring, as the left one is holding a clipboard or plans. In the foreground, there are two buckets placed on the ground, and there is standing water along the edge of the excavation. Construction debris and soil are piled around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个大型基坑，内部设有密集的支撑框架。支撑框架由红色金属板构成。可见三名工人位于支撑框架内。所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽。工人似乎在进行检查或测量，其中左侧一人手持写字板或图纸。前景处有两个水桶放置于地面，且基坑边缘有积水。建筑废料和泥土堆放在场地周围。

err.en: formworks made of red metal plates

text: The image shows a yellow Komatsu excavator positioned in a river, with its arm extended into the water. The excavator is shoveling rubble. The river water appears muddy.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色小松挖掘机位于河道中，其臂伸入水中。挖掘机覆盖着碎石。河水显得浑浊。

text: The image shows a construction worker in the foreground, wearing a yellow hard hat, an orange safety vest, and gloves, using an angle grinder on a steel column. The column is surrounded by rebar grids. The worker is surrounded by yellow metal poles. In the background, there are multiple stacks of wooden planks, wooden boards, and metal poles. There is another rebar framework in the background on the right with some workers on top.
zh: 画面前景中有一名建筑工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身穿橙色安全背心，手戴手套，正使用角磨机对一根钢柱进行打磨。该钢柱周围环绕着钢筋网格。工人四周被黄色金属杆包围。背景中可见多堆木托盘、木板以及金属杆。背景右侧还有另一处钢筋框架，其上方有若干工人。

text: The image shows a construction site where a large group of workers, approximately 20 individuals, are engaged in various activities. Most of them are wearing yellow hard hats and are spread across the site, which is equipped with a dense grid of rebar on the ground. Some workers are crouching, tying rebars together, or positioning them, while others are standing and observing or directing the work. In the background, a retaining wall is visible, there are high-rise buildings under construction.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，约有二十名工人正在从事各种活动。他们中的大多数人头戴黄色安全帽，分散在场地上，该场地配备有密集网格的钢筋。一些工人正在呼喊、捆绑钢筋或摆放弄它们，而另一些人则站立着观察或指挥工作。在背景中，可见一道挡土墙，有正在施工的高层建筑。

text: The image shows a single construction worker wearing a yellow hard hat, an orange high-visibility vest, and a pair of long rubber boots. The worker is bending over and working on a section of a formwork structure for pouring concrete made of black metal plates. The worker is holding a tool and pokes it into the gap between the two metal plates. There is a rebar wall next to the worker. The background reveals an excavated area with exposed earth.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身穿橙色高能见度背心，脚穿一双长胶靴。工人正弯腰作业，在一块黑色金属板面上施工，该结构为浇筑混凝土。工人手持一把工具，正将其插入两块金属板之间的。工人前方有一堵钢筋墙。背景呈现一片开挖区域，露出泥土体。

err.en: into the gap between the two metal plate
err.zh: 插入两块金属板之间的

err.en: a rebar wall next to the worker
err.zh: 工人前方有一堵钢筋墙

text: In the image, there is one construction worker wearing an orange jumpsuit and a yellow hard hat, who appears to be working on the formwork. The worker is crouching beside a dark-colored formwork and on top of a rebar grid, with a blue bucket positioned nearby. There is exposed earth in the background.
zh: 画面中有一名建筑工人，身穿橙色连体服，头戴黄色安全帽，似乎正在进行土方工作业。该工人蹲在一台深色施工机械旁，上方有一张钢筋网格，附近放着一个蓝色桶。背景中可见裸露出的土。

err.en: on top of a rebar grid

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers engaged in activities related to rebars. The vertical and horizontal rebars form a grid structure. In the foreground, there are two bundles of rebars with different colors on the ground, along with some wooden planks. The workers are wearing yellow hard hats and are spread out across the site, with one crouching on the left, and others standing or walking around the area. In the background, there is a retaining wall made of stones with vegetation above it. Three stacks of rebars are below the retaining wall.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人正在从事与钢筋相关的工作。竖直和水平钢筋构成网格结构。前景中，地面上有两束不同颜色的钢筋，旁边还有一些木托盘。工人戴着黄色安全帽，分散在工地各处，其中一人在左侧喊叫，其他人站立或在该区域周围走动。背景中有一堵由石头砌成的挡土墙，其上方有植被。挡土墙下方有三堆钢筋。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, partially completed tunnel-like structure supported by extensive scaffolding. In the foreground, the formwork structure is made of two lines of metal plates. The metal plate formwork is supported by metal pole scaffolding in the interior. It is fenced by rebar walls on the exterior. A finished section of the tunnel is in the midground. There is one visible worker wearing a yellow hard hat working on the scaffolding at the entrance of the tunnel. The surrounding area is muddy with some vegetation in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一个大型、部分完工的隧道状结构，由大量脚手架支撑。前景中，该结构由两块金属板构成。金属板结构由内部金属极脚手架支撑。其外围由钢筋墙在内部。隧道的完工部分位于地面中部。可见一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，在隧道入口处的脚手架上作业。周围区域泥泞地，背景中有一些植被。

err.en: It is fenced by rebar walls on the exter
err.zh: 其外围由钢筋墙在内部

text: The image shows a construction site with two primary vehicles: a green dump truck filled with dirt and a water tank truck in the center. There is a sedan parked on the right side of the frame. The ground is uneven and scattered with debris, including bricks and wood. A piece of white fabric is to the left of the black sedan. On the left, another yellow construction vehicle can be seen. The background is hazy.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有两辆主要车辆：一辆装满泥土的绿色自卸卡车和一辆位于画面中央的水罐卡车。画面右侧停着一辆轿车。地面平整，散落着碎屑，包括砖块和木头。黑色轿车左侧有一块白色布料。左侧还能看到另一辆黄色色建筑车辆。背景杂乱。

err.zh: 另一辆黄色色建筑车辆

text: The image shows a construction site with two large yellow excavators in the center, one of which has "Hybrid" written on its side and the other is branded KATO. In the foreground, two workers wearing hard hats are engaged in activities with shovels. Some corrugated pipes are near the workers. The ground appears muddy and uneven, with tracks from construction vehicles visible. In the background, there is a fence at the perimeter of the site, and high-rise buildings can be seen in the distant background.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，中心有两台大型黄色挖掘机，其中一台侧面写有“Hybrid”字样，另一台品牌为Kato。前景中，两名头戴安全帽的工人正从事与铲车相关的作业。工人附近有一些波纹状管道。地面显得泥泞滑且不平整，可见施工车辆留下的车辙印。背景中，工地周边设有围栏，远处背景可见高层建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow or white hard hats. Four of them are in the background, while the fifth one with a white hard hat is partially visible in the foreground. There are multiple stacks of construction materials, including two stacks of wooden planks on the left, and rebars in the foreground. Multiple construction elements such as rebar cages and formworks made of black plywood sheets are in the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有五名工人戴着黄色或白色安全帽。其中四人在背景中，而第五人戴着白色安全帽在前景中部分可见。有多堆建筑材料，包括左侧两堆木托盘，以及前景中的钢筋。图像中还有多种建筑元素，如钢筋笼和由黑色胶合板制成的模板。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single worker visible, operating a yellow wheel loader, which is moving a bucket-full of earth. There are several stockpiles of earth scattered across the site. In the background, there is a tower crane and another crane with a lattice boom. The ground is partially covered with green mesh tiles. Some construction materials are covered with a white tarp on the right next to the granite fence. There are buildings and street lamps in the far background. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，可见一名工人正在操作一台黄色轮式装载机，装载机铲斗内装满泥土。工地上散落着几堆土堆。背景中有一台塔式起重机，另一台起重机上带有格构式吊斗。地面部分覆盖着绿色网格状地砖。一些建筑材料覆盖着右侧紧邻花岗岩质围栏的一道白色防水布。远处背景中有建筑物和路灯。天空呈现灰白色。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible. The worker is wearing a yellow hard hat and is standing on a yellow concrete pump truck, involved in the maintenance or operation of the machinery. The concrete pump has its boom extended upwards and to the left. Outriggers of the concrete pump truck are deployed. In the background, there is another similar concrete pump with its boom extended vertically. A white concrete mixer truck is next to the concrete pump truck in the background. The ground is uneven and scattered with construction debris.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，可见一名工人。该工人头戴黄色安全帽，站在黄色混凝土泵车上，参与机械设备的维护或作业。混凝土泵车的泵体向上并向左侧延伸。混凝土泵车周围布设着桁架。背景中还有另一台类似的混凝土泵车，其泵体垂直向上延伸。一台白色混凝土搅拌车位于混凝土泵车后方的。地面平整，散落着施工碎屑。

err.en: Outriggers of the concrete pump truck ar
err.zh: 混凝土泵车周围布设着桁架

text: The image shows a large construction site with various activities in progress. In the foreground, there is an excavation area with green netting along the retaining wall and two workers visible inside a pit. In the center of the embankment, there are two excavators on the right and one black pickup truck on the left. In the second excavation pit, there is a mobile crane with its boom extended vertically. In the background, there are several buildings, with one large white building prominently visible. On the right of the background, a building block is visible along with three mobile crane booms.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，各项活动正在进行推进。前景中有一处开挖区域，沿挡土墙设有绿色网，坑内可见两名工人。开挖区域中央，右侧有两名挖掘机，左侧有一辆黑色皮卡卡车。第二处开挖坑中，有一台移动式起重机，其吊臂垂直伸展。背景中可见多栋建筑，其中一栋大型白色建筑尤为醒目。背景右侧，有一栋建筑块，旁边可见三台移动式起重机吊臂。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible, who is crouching on a curved section of paved road that cuts through an area of disturbed soil. The worker is wearing a yellow hard hat and is engaged in a task on the ground. There is a shadow of another person, likely the photographer, visible in the center of the foreground.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，可见一名工人正在一条穿过一片翻动土区域的、铺有路面的的一段弯曲路段上哭泣。该工人头戴黄色安全帽，正从事地面作业。前景中央可见另一人的影，很可能是摄影师。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers and various activities in progress. There are at least nine workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests. There are multiple foundation pits with concrete blocks and bricks as side walls. Two workers in the foreground are working inside two different foundation pits. Some workers are engaged in tasks on the ground level, such as handling materials or working near a concrete platform. The concrete platform is present on the right, with a staircase that leads up to the top. The site is scattered with construction materials, including concrete blocks, piles of bricks, and protective tarps. In the background, there are two tower cranes, and the construction of a building covered with green safety netting is underway. The background also features a giant stack of precast concrete piles.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人和多项活动正在进行进行。至少可以看到九名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽和高能见度背心。现场有多个基坑，内有混凝土砌块和砖块作为侧墙。前景中有两名工人正在两个不同的基坑内作业。部分工人在地面层从事任务，例如搬运材料或在混凝土平台附近作业。混凝土平台位于右侧，并设有楼梯通往顶部。工地现场散落着建筑材料，包括混凝土砌块、砖堆以及防护网。背景中可见两台塔式起重机，以及一栋建筑被绿色安全网覆盖的施工正在进行。背景中还还有一堆巨大的预制混凝土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a prominent yellow tower crane in the center, equipped with a counterbalance and a hook. A Chinese flag is waving on top of the tower crane. The background features a landscape with earth hills with some woods behind the hills. In the lower right, two rebar rolls and some wooden boards can be seen. The arm of an excavator is in the lower left.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央矗立着一台显眼的黄色塔式起重机，配有平衡重锤和吊钩。塔式起重机顶部飘扬着一面中国国旗。背景为丘陵地貌，丘陵后方可见部分林木。右下方可见两卷钢筋及若干块木板。左下方有一台挖掘机的。

err.en: The arm of an excavator is in the lower
err.zh: 左下方有一台挖掘机的。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers wearing orange suits and yellow hard hats. They are spread across a large area with extensive rebar work laid out on an uneven concrete platform. The rebar mats are arranged in a grid pattern, covering a significant portion of the visible area in the foreground. On the right, some construction materials, including red plywood sheets are on top of the concrete platform without rebars. Some workers are walking on the rebar, and two of them are bending down and holding a rebar together. In the foreground, a concrete slab foundation can be seen with a trough next to it. The construction site is bordered by concrete retaining walls, and there is a blue fence visible in the background.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽。他们分散在一个宽阔的区域，大量钢筋平铺在平整的混凝土平台上。钢筋呈网格状排列，覆盖了前景中相当大的一部分区域。右侧有一些建筑材料，包括红色胶合板，放置在混凝土平台上，没有钢筋。一些工人在钢筋上行走，其中两人弯腰并一起拿着一根钢筋。前景中可以看到一块混凝土基础板，旁边有一个凹槽。工地被混凝土挡土墙围住，背景中可见一道蓝色围栏。

text: There are two workers visible; one in the middle wearing a blue jacket and a red hard hat, and another on the right with the same attire. They appear to be inspecting or working on the foundation structures. Multiple formworks made of red plywood sheets and reinforced with wooden planks are erected, outlining the foundation of a future building. There is a bundle of long rebars laid horizontally in the foreground next to the worker. The site is surrounded by a large dirt embankment, and there are precast concrete piles in the background. Some trees can be seen in the background.
zh: 可见有两名工人；其中一名位于中间，身穿蓝色夹克，头戴红色安全帽，另一名位于右侧，着装相同。他们似乎正在检查或施工于基础结构。多组由红色胶合板及木质垫块构成的，被竖立起来，勾勒出一栋未来建筑的基础。在工人前方，有一组长钢筋水平铺设于前景。该场地被一大片泥土堆所环绕，背景中可见有预制混凝土堆。背景中可见有一些树木。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow tower crane in the center. There are at least seven workers visible on the top of a brick structure or on the scaffold next to the structure, all wearing hard hats and some with high-visibility vests. They are laying bricks and applying mortar to the wall. Scaffolding surrounds the brick structure, indicating ongoing work. The sky is clear.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型黄色色塔式起重机。砖墙或脚手架顶部至少可见七名工人，均佩戴安全帽，部分人员穿着高能见度反光背心。他们正在砌砖并向墙面涂抹抹灰浆。脚手架环绕着砖墙结构，表明施工正在进行进行中。天空晴朗。

err.zh: 大型黄色色塔式起重机
表明施工正在进行进行中

text: The image shows a construction site with a focus on a large, tunnel-like structure with rebars installed on both sides. There are four workers visible, all wearing orange uniforms and yellow hard hats. One worker is standing on the top right of the structure, another is at the entrance of the tunnel on the left, and two are working on the lower right, handling black formwork panels. The site is surrounded by green safety netting, and there are various construction materials scattered around, including more formwork panels.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，重点在于一个大型隧道状结构，两侧均设有钢筋。可见四名工人，均身着橙色制服服并佩戴黄色安全帽。一名工人站立于结构右上方，另一名位于隧道左侧入口处，还有两名正在右侧下方处理黑色形式的工作面板。该场地被绿色安全网围护，周围散落着各种施工材料，其中包括更多形式的工作面板。

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of heavy machinery and equipment. In the center, a dump truck has its box tilted. A single worker is visible on foot near a water truck on the left. There are two excavators, two water trucks, and one blue crawler crane on the left. Large black pipes are laid out on the ground. A stack of green pipes is also visible. To the right, there is an orange bulldozer. In the background, there are two tower cranes visible against the skyline of residential buildings under construction. The ground is uneven with piles of dirt in the foreground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，现场有各种重型机械和设备。画面中央，一辆自卸卡车的车厢呈倾斜状态。左侧近处可见一名工人赤脚站立在一辆水车旁。现场有两台挖掘机、两辆水卡车，以及左侧有一台蓝色履带式起重机。地面上铺设着粗大的黑色管道。此外，还能看到一堆绿色管道。右侧，有一台橙色推土机。背景中，可见两台塔式起重机矗立在正在建设中的住宅建筑天际线之下。地面平整，前景处有土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with three individuals and various equipment. In the foreground, one person is walking towards the camera, while two others are standing near an excavator in the middle ground. The excavator is positioned next to a pile of earth in the middle. An orange dump truck is parked to the left of the excavator. The ground is uneven and littered with debris, including bricks and wood. In the background, there is an embankment and beyond it, some vegetation and power lines are visible
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三个人和多种设备。前景中，一个人正朝相机方向走来，另外两个人站在中景的挖掘机附近。挖掘机位于中景的一堆泥土旁边。一辆橙色自卸卡车停在挖掘机左侧。地面平整，散落着碎屑，包括砖块和木头。背景中有一个基坑，再往远处可见一些植被和电线。

text: On the left, there is a yellow Hyundai excavator parked on a dirt surface. To the right of the excavator, there are stacks of white and blue metal sheets. A concrete column stands in the mid-right section, and there is a pile of blue sheets and precast concrete debris to the right of the column. There are trees and greenery in the background. The ground is uneven and covered with dirt.
zh: 左侧有一台黄色的现代挖掘机停放在泥土地面上。在挖掘机的右侧，有一些白色和蓝色的金属板堆叠在一起。在右中部，有一个混凝土柱，在柱的右侧，有一堆蓝色板材和预浇混凝土碎屑。背景中有树木和灌木丛。地面是平整的，并覆盖着泥土。

text: One worker on the left and two workers near the dump truck and excavators are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 左侧的一名工人以及靠近自卸卡车和挖掘机的器的附近的的两名为工人未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible. The worker is on top of a yellow and orange mobile concrete pump truck, wearing a blue shirt and a yellow hard hat, engaged in an activity related to the machinery. The outriggers of the truck are deployed and the tires of the truck are lifted to the air. The concrete pump truck has a long boom extended vertically into the air with a hose attached. In the background, there are two more pump trucks with booms. The sky is overcast, and the ground appears to be made of dirt.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见一名工人。该工人位于一辆黄橙色混凝土泵车顶部，身穿蓝色衬衫，头戴黄色安全帽，正从事与机械相关的的工作。卡车的排气管已展开，卡车的轮胎悬于空中。混凝土泵车具有一根长管，垂直伸向空中，并附有一根软管。背景中还有两辆带泡沫的泵车。天空呈灰白色，地面似乎由泥土构成。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site on a concrete foundation. There are seven workers visible, all wearing safety vests and hard hats, spread across the site engaged in various activities related to laying and tying rebar. The rebar grid is extensive and covers the majority of the visible area. The rebar grid is placed in a pool with a concrete platform surrounding it. Around the perimeter, there are pink plywood sheets, some of which are stacked and others are laid out. There is a green tarp covering the right of the site's edge.
zh: 图像展示了一个建在混凝土基础上的施工场地的空景。有七名工人可见，均穿着安全背心和硬帽，分散在现场从事与铺设和系钢筋相关的活动。钢筋网格广泛且覆盖可见区域的大部分。钢筋网格被放置在一个池内，混凝土平台环绕其周围。在周边，有一些粉红色胶合板，其中一些被堆叠，另一些被平铺。有一块绿色防水布覆盖在场地右边缘。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground, wearing a yellow hard hat and operating a power trowel on a concrete surface. There are vertical rebar structures scattered throughout the site, and a pile of covered materials is visible to the right. There is also a scaffolding made of metal poles on the right. In the background, two tower cranes are erected, and high-rise buildings can be seen in the distance. The ground is wet and covered with newly poured concrete.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，正在混凝土表面上操作一台打桩机。工地各处散布着竖向钢筋结构，右侧可见一堆覆盖材料。右侧还有一组由金属杆搭建而成的的高架。背景中，两座塔式起重机正在被竖立，远处可见高层建筑。地面潮湿，覆盖着新浇筑的混凝土。

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive earthmoving activities. In the foreground, there is a yellow soil compactor with a single drum roller. The ground appears muddy with tire tracks A person is standing to the left of the compactor. Another worker with a white hard hat is standing on a mound of earth on the right. There are two tower cranes on the left. Below the tower cranes, there is a partially constructed building with scaffolding. Multiple dump trucks are visible in the middle ground while two excavators are loading them with soil. The sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，正在进行大规模的土方方作业。前景中有一台黄色土方的机械，配备单鼓式滚轮。地面显得泥泞滑，带有轮胎痕迹。一人站在机械左侧。另一名工人戴着白色硬帽，站在右侧的一堆土上。左侧有两台塔式起重机。在塔式起重机下方，有一栋部分已建成的建筑，带有脚手架。多台泵车可见于中间地面，同时两台挖掘机正在装载它们，带有土。天空笼罩在上方。

text: The image shows a group of approximately eight individuals at a construction site. In the foreground, two men are walking across the site, one carrying a survey rod. Several other people are scattered across the middle ground, some wearing hard hats and others not. There is a row of parked cars on the left side, and a white car with its door open on the right. In the background, approximately ten tower cranes are visible. The ground is uneven and tire tracks visible.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，约有八个人。前景中，两名男子正横穿工地，其中一人扛着一根测量杆。另外几个人分散在中景区域，部分人戴着安全帽，另一些人则没有。左侧有一排停放的汽车，右侧有一辆白色轿车，车门处于打开状态。背景中，大约可见十座塔式起重机。地面平整，可见轮胎痕迹。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the foreground. There is a pile of tree branches behind the bulldozer next to the track of the bulldozer. There is a large pile of branches and debris in the midground, and debris is burning with smoke rising from it. In the background, three mobile cranes are visible on the left, and the booms of two borehole drilling machines are on the right. At least three tower cranes are further in the background. The ground is uneven and covered with dirt.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景有一台单斗挖掘机。在单斗挖掘机后方，有一堆树枝。在单斗挖掘机轨道前方，有一大堆树枝和碎屑，并且碎屑正在燃烧，有烟雾从中升起。在背景中，左侧可见三台移动起重机，右侧有两台钻孔钻机。在更远的处的，至少有三台塔式起重机。地面是平整的，并且覆盖着泥土。

err.en: next to the track of the bulldozer
err.zh: 在单斗挖掘机轨道前方

text: The image shows a large excavation site with an orange excavator actively engaged in digging the earth in the middle. The excavator on the left has its bucket raised and is positioned at the edge of the excavation. An operator is visible inside the excavators' cabin in the middle. The surrounding area is characterized by mounds of excavated soil, and in the background, there is a partially visible building structure on the upper level of the terrain.
zh: 图中显示一处大型土方方开挖现场，一台橙色挖掘机正在中部积极挖掘土方。左侧的挖掘机其铲斗已升起，并位于开挖的边缘。一名操作员可见于挖掘机驾驶室内部中部。周围区域以堆起的之土为特征，并且背景中，在地形上部有一栋部分可见建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible. The worker is wearing a yellow hard hat, and standing on the bed of a concrete pump truck while holding a long rod. The concrete pump truck has a long, articulated boom extended upwards, with the concrete hopper visible at the rear of the truck. The outriggers of the truck are deployed and the front two axles of the truck are lifted. The construction site has muddy ground with some puddles. A stack of construction materials is on the right of the image. In the background, there is the boom of another concrete pump truck. A white concrete mixer truck is also in the background.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见一名工人。该工人头戴黄色安全帽，站在混凝土泵车车斗上，手持一根长杆。混凝土泵车有一根长管，向上延伸，在卡车后部可见混凝土搅拌器。卡车的的前两根轴被抬起。工地地面有泥泞地，带一些水坑。画面右侧有一堆建筑材料。背景中还有另一辆混凝土泵车的。背景中还有一辆白色混凝土搅拌车。

err.en: The outriggers of the truck are deployed
err.zh: 卡车的的前两根轴被抬起。

err.en: the boom of another concrete pump truck

text: The image shows a construction site with a excavator positioned on the right side, engaged in digging. There is a dump truck parked on the left side of the image, and the ground is scattered with debris, predominantly consisting of broken bricks and some waste materials. The background is hazy, limiting visibility. There are some structures and trees in the far background, and a body of water can be seen on the left side of the image.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一台挖掘机位于画面右侧，正在进行挖掘作业。画面左侧停放着一辆渣土车，地面散落着碎屑，主要由碎砖块和一些废料构成。背景杂乱，能见度受限。远处背景中有一些建筑物和树木，画面左侧可见一处积水。

text: The image shows a bulldozer in the center, actively engaged in earthmoving activities on a construction site with uneven and rough terrain. The ground is covered with a mixture of soil and scattered debris, including a pile of branches and twigs on the left side of the bulldozer.
zh: 画面中央是一台正在进行土方作业的的工程推土机，其作业场地为平整且崎岖不平坦的地形。地面覆盖着泥土与散落碎石的混合物，包括工程推土机左侧的一堆树枝和碎木。

err.zh: 平整且崎岖不平坦的地形

text: In the foreground, a dump truck is tilted, unloading a pile of dirt onto the ground. The truck's bed is raised, and the dirt is forming a mound as it spills out. A green tarp covers the box of the truck. The surrounding area appears to be undeveloped land. The background features a flat landscape with some vegetation and a few distant buildings, as well as overhead power lines stretching across the scene.
zh: 前景中，一辆自卸卡车倾斜着，将一堆泥土倾倒到地面上。卡车的车斗被抬起，随着倾倒，泥土堆成一个小丘。一块绿色防水布盖在卡车的箱上。周围区域看起来是未开发的土地。背景呈现一片平坦的景观，带有一些植被和几栋远处的处的建筑，以及头顶部的横跨场景的电力线。

err.zh: 头顶部的横跨场景的电力线

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow excavator in the center foreground, positioned on a dirt path. In the background, there is a substantial scaffolding structure covered with green safety nets supporting an unfinished concrete construction.  A tower crane is also present to the right of the scaffolding. To the left of the excavator, there is one worker visible on the ground. The environment appears to be dusty.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中央有一台大型黄色色挖掘机停放在土路上。背景中，有一处大型脚手架结构，覆盖着已完工的具体施工。脚手架右侧还有一台塔式起重机。挖掘机左侧，地面上可见一名工人。环境显得尘土飞扬。

err.en: covered with green safety nets supportin
err.zh: 覆盖着已完工的具体施工

text: The image shows a large construction site with extensive formwork and rebar installation in progress. There are at least five workers visible, all wearing orange safety vests and yellow hard hats, distributed throughout the site, and engaged in various construction activities. The site is surrounded by sloped concrete side walls with greenery on top. The structure under construction has a concrete slab and two rebar side walls on two sides. A rebar wall in the middle separates the structure into two sections. Both the left and right sections feature a scaffolding framework made of metal poles. In the foreground, there are two stacks of red plywood sheets and two stacks of wooden planks on the left. On the right, there are two more stacks of red plywood sheets and a box made of wooden sheets.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，正在进行进行大量的钢筋绑扎和钢筋安装工作。现场至少有五名工人可见，均穿着橙色安全背心和黄色安全帽，分布在工地各处，并从事各种施工作业。工地周围是倾斜的混凝土侧墙，顶部有绿色植物。正在施工的结构下方有一块混凝土板和两侧各一道钢筋侧墙。中间一道钢筋侧墙将结构分隔成两个部分。左右两部分均具有由金属杆构成的脚手架框架。前景处有两堆红色胶合板和两堆木质托盘位于左侧。右侧处有两堆更多红色胶合板和一只木质板箱。

err.zh: 正在进行进行大量的钢筋绑扎和钢筋安装工作

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground wearing a yellow safety vest and a red hard hat, facing away from the camera. In the midground, there are multiple workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests, spread out and engaged in various activities. They are working on a rebar grid structure on the right. There is a yellow tower crane structure to the left, and it is surrounded by orange metal barriers. In the background, there are three more tower cranes on the left. There is also a dirt embankment with temporary site fencing on the top.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景中有一名工人背对镜头，身穿黄色色安全背心，头戴红色安全帽。中景处有多名工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身穿安全背心，分散开来，正从事着各种作业。他们正在右侧的钢筋网格上施工。左侧有一台黄色色塔式起重机，周围环绕着橙色金属护栏。背景中，左侧还有三台塔式起重机。顶部还有一处土方方，围着临时工地围栏。

text: The image shows a construction site with excavation work in progress. There is one yellow excavator in the center of the image actively digging into the reddish-brown earth, with its bucket full of soil. In the foreground, a dump truck is in a trench and the excavator is loading soil into the box of the truck. In the background, five tower cranes can be seen against the skyline. A brick building and a utility pole are also visible on the right.
zh: 画面显示一处正在进行土方开挖作业的的建筑施工现场。画面中央有一台黄色挖掘机正在向红褐色土层中挖掘，其铲斗内装满泥土。前景处，一辆自卸卡车停在沟槽内，挖掘机正将泥土装载进卡车的车厢内。背景中，五座塔楼可被看见对着天际线。一座砖砌建筑与一座公用极也可见于右侧。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators positioned in a trench filled with water. The excavator on the left is actively digging soil. There is a muddy track running through the center of the site, with a vehicle parked on it, and three individuals are next to the vehicle. The trench has a retaining wall made of sheet piles on the left, and there are piles of soil and debris around the site. In the background, there are trees and a blue fence, and the sky is overcast. On the right, a line of sandbags is visible.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，两台挖掘机位于一条沟槽内，槽中注满水。左侧的挖掘机正在挖掘泥土。有一条泥泞路贯穿场地中央，上面停着一辆车，车旁有三个人。沟槽左侧设有由钢板桩构成的挡墙，场地周围堆有土堆和碎石。背景中可见树木和蓝色围栏，天空笼罩在上。右侧可见一排沙袋。

text: The image shows a construction site on a foggy day with low visibility. In the foreground, there is a row of large concrete pipes lined up on the left side, and a muddy road stretches through the center. A red dump truck is visible in the midground on the right side along with a partially visible yellow excavator. There appears to be a teal excavator, in the background on the left behind the mound of soil with a tree on the top. The ground is uneven with multiple dirt piles scattered throughout the site. A stainless steel barrier is placed in the foreground on the right.
zh: 图像显示的是一个大雾天，能见度较低的建筑工地上。前景中，左侧有一排大型混凝土管道，中间有一条泥泞路延伸。右侧中景处可见一辆红色泵车，旁边还有一台部分可见黄色挖掘机。背景中似乎有一台青绿色挖掘机，位于左侧土堆后方，顶部有一棵树。地面平坦，整个工地地上散落着多个土堆。前景右侧放置着一道不锈钢护栏。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being poured. Three workers are visible in the foreground; two are guiding a large hose to pour concrete into the rebar mesh on the ground, and the third is standing nearby. All workers are wearing safety helmets.
