There is a large network of rebar laid out on the ground next to the three workers. In the background, two tower cranes are visible. The yellow tower crane is at this construction site, and at least two more workers are next to the tower crane. Some high-rise buildings can also be seen. An orange excavator can be seen on the right next to the concrete retaining wall.
zh: 图像显示的是一个混凝土浇筑施工现场。前景中有三名工人；其中两人正在引导一根粗大的软管将混凝土浇筑入地面上的铺设的钢筋网，第三人则站在附近。所有工人都佩戴着安全帽。在三名工人前方地面上铺设着一张粗大的钢筋网。背景中可见两台塔式起重机。黄色的塔式起重机位于该施工现场处，且至少还有两名工人位于塔式起重机前方。此外还能看到一些高层建筑。一台橙色挖掘机可见于混凝土挡土墙右侧。

text: In the image, there is one individual wearing a white hard hat, a striped shirt, and gloves, who appears to be conducting a soil test. The person is kneeling and using a hammer to strike a green tool. In the foreground, there is a red toolbox containing various cylindrical metal objects and some plastic bags. A pickaxe is lying on the ground next to the toolbox. The ground is wet, with footprints and puddles.
zh: 图中有一个人戴着白色硬帽、条纹衬衫和手套子，似乎正在进行进行土试验。此人跪在地上，用锤子敲击一个绿色工具。前景中有一个红色工具箱，里面装着各种圆柱形金属物件和一些塑料袋。一根轴放在地上，紧挨着工具箱。地面是湿的，带着脚印和泥坑。

text: In the center, there is an excavator with its boom extended upwards. The ground is uneven and covered with debris. Some vegetation is on the left. In the background, there are high-rise buildings.
zh: 中心有一台挖掘机，其臂向上伸展。地面平整，覆盖着碎石。左侧有一些植被。背景中有高层建筑。

text: The worker is wearing a slipper.
zh: 工人佩戴着绝缘帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck. A worker with a yellow hard hat is crouching under the left outrigger of the truck. The red boom of the truck extends to the upper right of the image. The ground is uneven and muddy, with scattered debris such as broken bricks and black wooden boards on the left.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有一辆混凝土泵车。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正蹲在卡车左侧排气管下方。卡车的红色排管延伸至画面右上方。地面平坦且泥泞滑，左侧散落着诸如碎砖和黑色木板之类的杂物。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers. Two workers, wearing orange and yellow safety jackets and yellow hard hats, are in the foreground. while the third, in an orange vest, is in the upper right corner of the image behind a concrete mixer truck. The worker and the concrete mixer truck are on the upper right side of the excavation area, above a concrete tunnel structure. The site has red wooden sheets as formwork. A concrete hose hanging from above is pouring concrete into the formwork. The ground is uneven and muddy, and there is a bull float in the foreground. A row of rebars protruding from a concrete short wall is on the left.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人。前景中有两名工人，身穿橙黄色安全夹克和黄色安全帽。第三名，身穿橙色背心，位于图像右上角，在一辆混凝土搅拌车后面。工人和混凝土搅拌车位于挖掘区右上侧，在混凝土隧道结构上方。工地有红色木板作为模板。一根混凝土软管从上方悬挂，将混凝土倒入模板。地面平整且泥泞，前景中有一头牛。一排钢筋从混凝土短墙左侧突出。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy
there is a bull float in the foreground

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible in the foreground, wearing a red hard hat and blue shirt, standing next to a concrete mixer truck that is pouring concrete into a pit with concrete side walls. The concrete side wall is reinforced with steel rebar. In the background, there is a rocky hillside with an excavator and some dump trucks in the upper left corner. On the right, a pile of rusty pipes can be seen near some sheds. The overall scene is dusty.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中可见一名工人，头戴红色安全帽，身穿蓝色上衣，站在一辆混凝土搅拌车旁，该车正向向一个基坑内浇筑混凝土，基坑侧壁内配置有钢筋。背景中，左上方可见一处岩石山体，配有一台挖掘机和若干辆泵车。右侧，一些锈迹斑斑的管道堆可被看见，靠近某些棚子。整体场景布满灰尘土。

text: The image shows a construction site with one individual in the center, wearing a hard hat, holding a surveying equipment pole. To the left, there is a yellow excavator, and multiple large concrete pipes are laid out on the ground near the excavator. On the right, a concrete pipeline is in the foreground and some concrete pipe sections are in the background. The ground is uneven and consists of exposed earth.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一名工人，头戴安全帽，手持测量仪器。左侧有一台黄色挖掘机，挖掘机附近地面上铺设着多根大型混凝土管道。右侧前景处有一根混凝土管道，背景中可见若干混凝土管段。地面平整，由裸露的泥土构成。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers visible, wearing hard hats and dark clothing, standing next to a row of yellow barriers in the background. A large blue Kobelco excavator is positioned to the left of the worker, with its bucket raised above the ground. Behind the barriers, there is a building with multiple balconies, some with hanging laundry. The sky is clear. The ground around the excavator is uneven and dug up.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，两名工人清晰可见，头戴安全帽，身着深色衣物，站在背景中一排黄色护栏旁。一台大型蓝色Kobelco挖掘机位于工人左侧，其铲斗高举于地面之上。在护栏后方，有一栋建筑，带有多个阳台，部分悬挂着晾晒衣。天空晴朗。挖掘机周围的地面平整且被挖起。

err.en: The ground around the excavator is uneve
err.zh: 挖掘机周围的地面平整且被挖起。

text: The image shows a yellow dump truck unloading large rocks. The truck's bed is tilted at a steep angle, and several boulders are visible at the edge of the bed. The truck is positioned on a construction site with a mountainous background. On the right, a worker with a red shirt is standing next to two rusty pipes.
zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车正在卸载大块岩石。卡车的车厢以陡峭角度倾斜，车厢边缘可见几块斗篷。卡车停在一处具有山地背景的施工场地上。右侧，一名穿红色衬衫的工人站在两根生锈管旁边。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck in the middle, its boom extended over a trench where concrete is poured. A concrete mixer truck is parked next to the pump truck. There are at least five workers visible; two are operating the hose from the pump truck, two are standing next to the trucks, and the fifth one is walking on a pile of dirt on the right. The structure in the trench is enclosed by metal plate formworks and supported by metal poles. In the background, there are some buildings and trees. The ground is uneven and muddy, with construction debris scattered around.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中间停着一辆混凝土泵车，其输送管横跨在浇筑混凝土的沟槽上方。一辆混凝土搅拌车停靠在泵车旁边。画面中至少可见五名工人；其中两人正在从泵车上操作软管子，两人站在卡车旁边，第五人正行走在右侧的一堆泥土上。沟槽内的结构由金属模板支撑，并由金属立柱支撑。背景中有一些建筑物和树木。地面平整且泥泞滑，周围散落着施工废料。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy
enclosed by metal plate formworks and su
err.zh: 由金属模板支撑，并由金属立柱支撑

text: The image shows two workers wearing blue uniforms and yellow hard hats on a construction site. They are engaged in different activities; one is using a broom to sweep the ground, while the other is holding a jackhammer. Behind them, there is a mesh of steel reinforcement bars attached to a wall. The ground is uneven with scattered rocks and debris.
zh: 图中显示两名工人身穿蓝色工作服，头戴黄色安全帽，正在建筑工地上作业。他们正在进行不同的活动；其中一人使用扫帚清扫地面，而另一人手持一把锤子。在他们身后，有一面由钢筋网片附着在墙壁上。地面平整，散落着碎石和碎屑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a total of seven workers engaged in various activities. On the left, three workers are crouching and laying green tiles on the ground. To the right, three workers are near a pile of dirt along with two trolleys and one blue barrel. A tower crane is visible in the distant background. The sky is clear, and the sun is shining brightly.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，共有七名工人正在从事各种活动。左侧，三名工人正蹲在地上铺设绿色瓷砖块。右侧，三名工人靠近一堆泥土，旁边有两把铁锹和一根蓝色管子。远处背景中可见一台塔式起重机。天空晴朗，阳光灿烂。

err.en: two trolleys and one blue barrel
err.zh: 两把铁锹和一根蓝色管子

text: The image shows a large excavation site with reddish-brown soil. In the center, there are three excavators actively digging. The terrain is uneven with visible tracks and mounds of soil. In the far background, there is a tall building under construction with a tower crane. A forest is also in the background. The sky is clear, suggesting fair weather conditions.
zh: 图像显示一个大型挖掘工地，土壤呈红褐色。画面中央有三名挖掘机正在积极挖掘。地形平坦，可见车辙和土堆。远处背景中有一栋正在建设的高楼，配有塔式起重机。背景中还有树林。天空晴朗，表明天气状况良好。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single yellow bulldozer on the dirt ground in the middle. The bulldozer is pushing soil with visible soil in front of the blade. The site is surrounded by piles of earth and some green flags. In the background, there is an embankment and a train passing by. The foreground includes a young tree and a metal railing on the bottom right.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，一台黄色推土机位于泥地中央。推土机正用前铲刀推土，可见泥土在刀片前。工地周围堆着土堆和一些绿色旗帜。背景中有一处基坑和一列火车经过。前景包括一棵幼树和右下角处的的一道金属栏杆。

text: The image shows a section of a construction site with three visible workers. All of them are on the scaffold structure in the upper left. The scaffold is surrounded by blue metal fences. A stack of red poles can be seen in the upper left. On the right, there is a blue container or cabinet. An orange structure is next to the blue container. The yellow lattice of a tower crane can be seen in the lower right.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地的局部，有三名可见工人。他们全部位于左上方的的高处。脚手架周围设有蓝色金属围栏。左上方可见一摞红色极。右侧有一个蓝色容器或柜子。蓝色容器旁紧挨着一个橙色结构。右下方可见一座塔吊的黄色网格。

err.en: on the scaffold structure in the upper l

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven, muddy terrain. There are three individuals visible: one person is standing on a mound of earth in the background, and two others are in the excavation pit. Two yellow excavators are parked on the mound of earth on the right. The sky is overcast, and there are power lines and a power pylon visible in the far background.
zh: 图像显示一处施工现场，地形平坦且泥泞湿。画面中可见三个人：一人站在背景中的土堆上，另外两人位于挖掘坑内。右侧土堆上停放着两台黄色挖掘机。天空阴沉，远处背景中可见电线和电力铁塔。

text: The image shows a construction site in an excavation pit. There are seven workers visible, all wearing hard hats and some with high-visibility vests. They are engaged in activities related to installing metal panel formwork. The finished section has a concrete base and rebar side walls. The unfinished section features rebar mesh and rebar side walls. In the background, a blue fence surrounds the site, and a pile of earth is visible in front of it. Some trees are behind the blue fence. In the foreground, various construction materials, including rebars and bricks, are scattered around. A fence made of metal tubes is visible.
zh: 图像显示一个位于开挖基坑内的施工现场。可见七名工人，均佩戴安全帽，部分人员穿着高能见度反光背心。他们正从事与金属面板板安装相关的的工作。已完工部分具有混凝土基础及钢筋侧墙。已完工部分设有钢筋网及钢筋侧墙。背景中，蓝色围栏围绕该场地，其前方可见一堆土方。蓝色围栏后方有一些树木。前景中，各类建筑材料，包括钢筋及砖块，散落在周围。可见一道由金属管构成的围栏。

err.en: The unfinished section features rebar me
err.zh: 已完工部分设有钢筋网及钢筋侧墙。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, with a bucket full of dirt. There is one worker in a red hard hat and dark clothing standing to the left of the excavator. In the background, there are multiple large concrete pipes laid horizontally on the ground. A black pipe is visible near the concrete pipes. Residential buildings are visible in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，旁边放着一桶装满泥土的桶。挖掘机左侧站着一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿深色衣服的物的工人。背景中，地面上水平铺设着多根大型混凝土管道。混凝土管附近可见一根黑色管道。远处背景中可见住宅建筑。

err.en: with a bucket full of dirt
err.zh: 旁边放着一桶装满泥土的桶

err.en: one worker in a red hard hat and dark cl
err.zh: 身穿深色衣服的物的工人

text: The image shows a construction site with a red dump truck in the center, its bed raised. There is one visible person standing next to the truck. A driver is visible in the cab. On the left, there is a bulldozer, an excavator, and a water truck. Additionally, there is a stack of green pipes and a stack of corrugated black pipes. On the right, a drum roller is behind the red dump truck with some black pipes nearby. In the far background, there are high-rise buildings under construction with two tower cranes visible against the skyline.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一辆红色泵车，其车斗架已升起。卡车旁站着一名可见人员。驾驶室内可见一名司机。左侧有一台推土机、一台挖掘机以及一辆水车。此外，有一堆绿色管道和一堆黑色波纹状管道。右侧，一台鼓式压路机位于红色泵车后方，附近有一些黑色管道。远处背景中，有正在施工的高层建筑，天际线上可见两台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow KATO excavator in the center, its bucket touching the ground. To the right of the excavator stands a worker wearing a white hard hat. To the left of the excavator, there is a drum roller. In the foreground, there is a pink, motorbike in front of a pile of scattered bricks. A pile of soil and a tripod is also visible on the right. In the background, a fence made of concrete columns and metal meshes runs along the edge of the site. Residential buildings can be seen in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台黄色卡特挖掘机，其铲斗触地面。挖掘机右侧站着一名戴白色硬帽的工人。挖掘机左侧有一台鼓滚器。前景中，有一辆粉红色摩托车位于一堆散落砖前。右侧也可见一堆土和一个三脚架。背景中，由混凝土柱和金属网制成的围栏沿工地边缘延伸。远处背景中可见住宅建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is freshly poured and leveled. The concrete is enclosed by formworks supported by metal poles. Rebars can be seen protruding from the concrete. Some white cables are on top of the concrete in the foreground. There are two workers in the center of the image, each worker is holding a hose. Both workers are wearing yellow hard hats, orange pants, and long rubber boots. To the right of the workers, there is a yellow Hyundai excavator parked on a mound of earth. In the background, there are trees and power lines, and in the far background, some buildings are visible. Scattered construction materials, such as wooden planks and metal poles, are seen around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，混凝土刚刚浇筑并找平。混凝土被金属杆围住。钢筋可以从混凝土中看到突出。一些白色电缆位于前景的混凝土顶部。图像中心有两名工人，每名工人都拿着一根软管。两名工人都戴着黄色安全帽、橙色裤子，以及长橡胶靴。在工人的右侧，有一台黄色现代挖掘机停在一堆土上。在背景中，有树木和电线，并且在远处背景中可以看到一些建筑物。散落的建筑材料，如木托盘和金属杆，在工地周围可见。

text: The worker standing next to the cabin of the red dump truck is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 该工人站在红色泵车驾驶室旁，未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with three tower cranes in the background and one more in the foreground. There are multiple workers visible; at least three can be seen on the right side of the image, working on a building under construction with scaffolding and formwork. In the foreground, there are piles of construction materials, including yellow scaffolding components, white bricks, and steel rebars. The arm and the bucket of an excavator are on the left. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，背景中有三台塔式起重机，前景中有一台更为突出。可见多名工人；至少有三人在画面右侧，正在一处带有脚手架和脚手架结构的物的上施工。前景处有成堆的建筑物料，包括黄色脚手架部件、白色砖块以及钢筋。挖掘机的的手臂和料斗位于左侧。天空呈现灰白色。

err.en: working on a building under construction
err.zh: 正在一处带有脚手架和脚手架结构的物的上施工

text: The image shows a construction site with various activities in progress. There are at least six workers visible; two are standing on the top level of the structure on the left, while four others are in the middle. The site is filled with construction materials, including wooden planks, red wooden sheets, and rebars. The structure is supported by scaffolding made of metal poles. In the background, there is a yellow tower crane, and further back, an excavator is visible.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，各项活动正在进行推进。画面中至少可见六名工人；其中两人站在左侧的顶层结构上，另外四人位于中部。现场堆满了建筑材料，包括木托盘、红色木板以及钢筋。结构由金属杆搭建而成的脚手架提供支撑。背景中有一台黄色塔吊，更远处可见一台挖掘机。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator in the center, with its arm extended and bucket raised. The background features a cityscape with multiple high-rise buildings and trees. The foreground includes a pile of excavated earth. A well with a lid is in the lower left.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色挖掘机，其臂架和铲斗已抬起。背景为城市景观，有多栋高层建筑和树木。前景有一堆挖掘出的泥土。左下方有一辆带盖子的的好车。

text: In the center, there is a large yellow excavator with its boom extended. A black tool is attached to the boom of the excavator chassis. The excavator is positioned on a dirt surface with tracks visible. To the left, there is a small concrete structure resembling a tunnel or drainage channel. The ground is uneven and scattered with rocks and debris. The background features vegetation and a power line tower.
zh: 画面中央有一台大型黄色挖掘机，其动臂向前伸展。一台黑色工具连接在挖掘机动臂的底盘架上。挖掘机停放在一片可见车辙的泥土地面上。左侧有一个小型混凝土结构，形似隧道或排水沟。地面平整，散落着岩石和碎屑。背景中带有植被和一座输电铁塔。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, partially constructed structure featuring an extensive rebar framework. There are at least seven workers visible, all wearing red uniforms and yellow hard hats; most of them are standing on the scaffolding hanging by the rebars on the left side of the structure. Another is crouching on the main scaffold fenced by blue metal fences in the middle of the image. Some construction materials are on the main scaffold. A tower crane is present to the right of the structure. The background features a barren hillside with a manmade platform on the top. There are some greenery on the hillside.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有一个大型、部分建成的结构，带有一个广泛的的重钢框架。至少有七名工人可见，全都穿着红色制服和黄色安全帽；他们中的大多数都站在脚手架上，由左侧的钢筋上悬挂着。另一个蹲在中间的主脚手架上，由蓝色金属围栏围着。一些建筑材料在主脚手架上。一台塔式起重机在结构的右侧。背景特征是一个荒芜山坡，顶部有一个制造平台。山坡上有一些植被。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom over an area where concrete is being laid. A concrete mixer truck is to the right of the pump truck. An excavator is to the left of the pump truck and digging a pile of dirt. There are at least six workers visible; some are spreading concrete while others are standing nearby. A tower crane can be seen in the far background on the left. The site is bordered by a metal fence, and there are trees beyond the construction area.
zh: 一辆混凝土泵车正将料斗车伸向一片正在浇筑混凝土的区域。一辆混凝土搅拌车位于泵车右侧。一台挖掘机位于泵车左侧，正在挖掘一堆泥土。现场至少可见六名工人；部分工人正在摊铺撒混凝土，另一些工人则站在附近。左侧远处背景中可见一台塔式起重机。该工地被金属围栏所包围，施工区域之外还有树木。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the foreground, its bucket raised. In the background, there are two borehole drilling machines with verticle booms. The ground is uneven and muddy, with a stack of soil in the foreground. The background is relatively barren with a few mounds of soil.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景中有一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起。背景中可见两台钻孔钻机，配有竖直钻杆。地面平整且泥泞湿，前景处有一堆土。背景较为荒芜凉，仅有几堆土。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy

text: The excavator is positioned in the center, actively digging into the earth with its bucket. The operator is visible inside the cabin of the excavator. In the background, there is an embankment and buildings under construction.
zh: 挖掘机位于场地中央，正用其铲斗向地面挖掘。操作员在挖掘机驾驶室内清晰可见。背景中有一处基坑及在建建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site with two pieces of heavy machinery: an excavator on the left and a bulldozer on the right, both on a dirt surface. In the foreground, there are two piles of wooden planks on the ground. To the right, there are several large concrete pipes. The background features a body of water and partially obscured buildings. The sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有两台重型型机械：左侧是一台挖掘机，右侧是一台推土机，均位于泥土地面上。前景地面上有两堆木方木。右侧有几根大型混凝土管道。背景中有一片水域以及部分被遮挡的建筑物。天空呈现灰白色。

text: The image shows an excavation site with several workers. In the foreground, workers in red hard hats are observing, discussing, and actively working on masonry of the foundation. In the background, more workers are scattered across the site, and an excavator is visible on the upper left side. The ground is uneven with visible trenches and piles of bricks throughout.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有多名工人。前景中，几名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在观察、讨论，并积极从事基础砌石作业。背景中，更多工人散布在场地各处，一台挖掘机可见于左上方。地面平整，可见沟槽和砖堆遍布各处。

text: The image shows three workers with yellow hard hats, engaged in tasks related to reinforcing steel bars at a construction site. One worker is bending over the rebar framework, while the other is handling large curved segments of material. A yellow excavator is visible in the background on the left, while the third worker is standing at the back of it.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在建筑工地上进行钢筋作业。一名工人正跨越钢筋框架，另一名工人正在处理大弧形段材料。左侧背景中可见一台黄色挖掘机，第三名工人站在它后方。

text: The worker with a red hard hat in the middle does not have long pants.
zh: 戴红硬帽的工人中间没有穿长裤。

err.en: The worker with a red hard hat in the mi

text: The image shows a yellow dump truck being loaded by a yellow excavator, with another excavator visible in the background. On the left, there is a person next to a stack of rebars. A building is in the background.
zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车正在被一台黄色挖掘机装载，背景中还有另一台挖掘机可见。左侧有一人正走向一堆钢筋。背景中有一栋建筑物。

err.en: there is a person next to a stack of reb
err.zh: 有一人正走向一堆钢筋

text: The image shows a blue excavator engaged in digging or earthmoving activities, surrounded by scattered debris and construction materials. The background features blue metal fences and transmission towers.
zh: 图中展示了一台蓝色挖掘机正在进行挖掘或土方方作业，周围散落着碎石和建筑材料。背景中可见蓝色金属围栏和输电塔。

text: The image shows three workers wearing yellow hard hats and green uniforms installing rebar on a construction site. They are spaced out across the rebar grid, bending over to tie or adjust the rebar. The grid covers the entire visible floor area, and there's a concrete wall in the background with wooden supports attached.
zh: 画面显示三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿绿色工装的工人正在建筑工地上安装栏杆。他们分散在栏杆网格上，弯腰去系或调整栏杆。网格覆盖了整个可见地面区域，背景中有一面混凝土墙，上面附着木质支撑。

text: The crane is centered against a cloudy sky, with its jib extending horizontally across the frame. The crane's counterweights and operator's cab are visible, and a hook hangs from the jib's end. Electrical poles and wires are visible on the right side, and another crane can be seen in the distance on the left, behind the blue barrier.
zh: 起重机矗立在阴云密布的天幕中，其吊臂横向横跨整个画面。起重物的与操作室清晰可见，一钩自吊臂末端垂下。电气极与线缆显露于右侧，另一台起重机可于左侧远处、蓝色屏障之后被看见。

text: In the foreground, there is a water truck spraying water on the ground, creating a mist. Moving towards the middle, there is an excavator operating on a raised area of dirt. To the right of the image, a loader is visible, working on the ground. The terrain is mostly barren with exposed soil.
zh: 前景中，一辆洒水车正在向地面喷水，形成一片水雾。画面中部，一台挖掘机正在一处隆起的土堆上作业。画面右侧，可见一台装载机正在地面作业。地形大多荒芜凉，裸露着泥土。

text: The image shows a construction site with a metal railing and two parked cars, one partially visible. A bulldozer is actively moving earth in the center. Scattered across the site are mounds of dirt. Flags of various colors are placed around the site. A worker with a yellow hard hat is in the middle of the background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，设有金属护栏，两辆停放的汽车，其中一辆部分可见。一台推土机正在场地中央进行土方方的作业。场地周围散落着成堆的泥土。场地周围插着各色各样的颜色的各样的旗帜。一名戴着黄色硬帽的工人在背景中央。

err.zh: 各色各样的颜色的各样的旗帜

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of black corrugated pipes on the left and a dump truck on the right with a person standing nearby. Moving towards the middle ground, there are three tower cranes. A mobile crane is under the tower crane in the middle with its boom extended upward. A multi-story buildings under construction are visible, with scaffolding around them and numerous workers on the scaffolding.
zh: 前景左侧有一大堆黑色波纹管，右侧有一辆泵车，旁边站着一个人。中景处有三台塔式起重机，中间那台塔式起重机的吊臂向上伸展。可见多层在建建筑物，周围搭着脚手架，脚手架上有众多工人。

err.en: A mobile crane is under the tower crane
err.zh: 中间那台塔式起重机的吊臂向上伸展。

text: In the foreground, there are three workers standing to the left of a conveyor belt that is transporting aggregate material. All the workers are wearing red hard hats. To the right of the conveyor belt, there is a motor. The background features some workers and a residential area with low-rise buildings.
zh: 前景中，传送带左侧站着三名工人，该传送带正输送骨料料。所有工人都戴着红色安全帽。传送带右侧有一台电机。背景中有一些工人以及一片低层建筑群的落的成的住宅区。

err.en: a residential area with low-rise buildin
err.zh: 低层建筑群的落的成的住宅区

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a white hard hat is operating a surveying instrument on a tripod. Moving towards the middle ground, there is an excavation site with standing water and two workers. The background features a white metal fence.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴白色安全帽的工人正在三脚架上操作一台测量仪器，朝地面中部移动。地面中部有一处积水基坑，旁边站着两名工人。背景中可见一道白色金属围栏。

text: The image shows two road rollers on a newly laid asphalt surface. In the background, there is a yellow asphalt paver. The construction area is bordered by a mound of earth on the left and a fence with blue covering on the right.
zh: 图片显示，新铺设的沥青路面上有两个道路滚轮。背景中，有一台黄色沥青摊铺路机。施工区域左侧由一堆泥土包围，右侧由蓝色覆盖物围栏围。

text: The image shows an excavated area with exposed earth and metal sheet piles as retaining structures. An orange Hitachi excavator is positioned in the center. The excavator is equipped with a pile driver to install the sheet piles. There is a street lamp and a blue fence partially enclosing the site, with stacked construction materials behind it. A concrete structure with stairs leading up to a platform is visible on the right.
zh: 图中展示了一个开挖区域，露出泥土体及作为挡土结构的物的金属板桩。一台橙色的日立挖掘机位于中心位置。该挖掘机配备有桩机以安装金属板桩。有一盏路灯及一道蓝色围栏部分包围该场地，其后方堆叠着建筑材料。右侧可见一混凝土结构带有楼梯，通向上通往平台。

err.en: exposed earth and metal sheet piles
err.zh: 露出泥土体及作为挡土结构的物的金属板桩

err.en: stairs leading up to a platform
err.zh: 带有楼梯，通向上通往平台

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete foundation and multiple vertical rebar structures in place. At least seven workers are visible, wearing safety vests and hard hats, scattered across the site. On the ground, there are at least five stacks of wooden boards, several stacks of metal tubes, and square-shaped stirrups.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，设有大型混凝土基础，并竖立多处钢筋结构。现场至少可见七名工人，身穿安全背心，头戴安全帽，分散于工地各处。地面上，至少有五堆木板，若干堆金属管，以及方形搅拌桶。

text: In the foreground, there is a turquoise excavator with its arm extended towards the ground. Behind the excavator, there are two pile drivers. The right driver has a metal pole erected.
zh: 前景中，有一台青绿色的挖掘机，其臂伸向地面。挖掘机后方，有两堆司机。右侧司机竖立着一根金属极。

text: In the foreground, a yellow bulldozer is positioned in the center, actively engaged in moving earth. To the left and slightly in the background, a single worker is walking across the terrain. The ground is uneven, with visible tracks and scattered debris.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色色推土机位于画面中央，正在进行进行土方作业。左侧稍靠后的方，一名工人正行走在地形上。地面平整，可见车辙印迹及散落的碎石。

text: In the foreground, a yellow soil compactor with a single drum roller is positioned on a reddish-brown dirt surface. Behind the compactor, there is a mound of similar dirt, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 前景中，一名身着黄色土戏服装的演员手持单鼓滚筒，站在一片红褐色泥土地面上。演员身后有一堆类似的泥土堆，天空笼罩在上方。

err.en: a yellow soil compactor with a single dr
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土戏服装的演员手持单鼓滚筒

text: The image shows a construction site with numerous workers spread across the area, all wearing hard hats. They are working on a structure with exposed steel reinforcement bars. Some workers are standing on the steel framework, while others are moving around the site. There are temporary wooden and metal supports in place. In the background, there are two tower cranes and multiple transmission towers.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，众多工人分散在整个区域，全都戴着安全帽。他们正在处理带有外露钢筋的结构。一些工人站在钢架上，而另一些工人则在工地周围活动。现场有临时的性的木质和金属支撑。背景中，有两座塔楼和多座输电塔。

text: The image shows two yellow excavators positioned on a mound of earth. The excavator on the left, branded Komatsu, is actively digging, while the one on the right, labeled CAT 323, is stationary. There is a large excavation pit in the center, with exposed earth and rocks.
zh: 图中显示两台黄色挖掘机停在一堆土堆上。左侧的挖掘机品牌为小松，正在积极挖掘；右侧标有CAT 23 的挖掘机则处于静止状态。中央有一个大型挖掘坑，露出泥土和岩石。

text: In the foreground, there is a collection of construction materials, including rebars, broken concrete pieces, and wooden boards. Seven workers wearing yellow or red hard hats are spread across the site; four are working on reinforcing steel bars for a foundation or structure, while two are walking along the site. The seventh one is on the right bank riding a scooter next to a stack of rebars.
zh: 前景中有一堆建筑材料，包括钢筋、破碎的混凝土块和木板。七名头戴黄色或红色安全帽的工人散布在工地各处；四名工人正在为地基或结构加固钢筋，两名工人正沿着工地行走。第七名工人正骑着滑板车驶向一堆钢筋。

text: The image shows a close-up of a yellow construction excavator with the model number SH220 visible on its side. The excavator's body is marked with dirt and mud. There are various stickers and safety labels on the door of the excavator's cabin. The excavator's undercarriage and tracks are also visible, covered with mud.
zh: 图中展示了一台黄色挖掘机的，其侧面可见型号为SH2-220。该挖掘机的机身身上沾满了泥土和泥浆。驾驶室门上贴有多种贴纸和安全标签。该挖掘机的底盘和履带也可见，上面覆盖着泥。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned in the middle with its bucket raised, and a worker wearing a hard hat standing beside it. To the left, two pile drivers are installed, standing vertically. To the right, a stack of black pipes is visible. The background is a construction site with mounds of earth and additional materials spread across the area.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机位于画面中央，其铲斗已抬起，一名头戴安全帽的工人站在其旁。左侧，两堆桩工竖立着。右侧，可见一堆黑色管道。背景为一处施工现场，泥土与额外材料散布于该区域。

err.en: two pile drivers are installed, standing

text: In the foreground, two workers with yellow hard hats are laying mortar between brick structures. Behind them, a worker on the right is current rebars while five stacks of rebars are on the ground. In the background, various construction activities are taking place with several workers around an area with steel rebar frameworks. There are construction materials and equipment, such as scaffolding and formwork, visible throughout the site.
zh: 前景中，两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在砖体结构之间铺设砂浆。在他们身后，右侧的一名工人正在当前绑扎钢筋，而地面上则堆放着五堆钢筋。背景中，各类施工作业正在展开，多名工人围绕着一处钢架结构。现场可见有建筑材料与设备，诸如脚手架及模板，遍布整个工地。

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven, dug-up ground. Three excavators are positioned in the center, one closer to the camera and the others slightly further away. Another construction vehicle is to the right of the right excavator. In the background, multi-story residential buildings are observed.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面平整，有挖掘痕迹。三台挖掘机位于画面中央，其中一台靠近镜头，另外两台稍远一些。另一台施工车辆位于右侧挖掘机的右侧。背景中可见多层住宅建筑。

text: The image shows two workers wearing yellow hard hats near a pile of metal tubes. Above them, a large stack of rebars is being hoisted by a crane. In the midground, there is an extensive scaffolding structure with multiple levels around an unfinished building. Two tower cranes are visible in the background, with buildings and a hazy sky further back.
zh: 画面中，两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在一堆金属管材旁。在他们上方，一大摞钢筋正被起重机吊装起。在画面中部，有一大片多层脚手架结构环绕着一栋已完工的大楼。背景中可见两座塔式起重机，以及远处还有建筑物和一片朦胧的天空。

text: The image shows a construction site at night. An excavator is positioned to the left, with its arm extended over a dump truck in the center, which has its headlights on. The ground appears to be uneven.
zh: 夜间，一处建筑工地上，一台挖掘机位于左侧，其臂架横跨画面中央的一辆自卸卡车，该卡车的前灯亮着。地面看起来是平整的。

text: The image shows three excavators in a dug-out area with mounds of earth around them. They are working at night. The left excavator is facing the camera and on the upper left. The remaining excavators are facing the right of the image and lower in the image.
zh: 画面显示三名挖掘机手正在一处挖掘区域作业，周围堆着土堆。他们夜间施工。左侧的挖掘机手正对向镜头，位于画面左上方。其余的挖掘机手背对向画面右侧，位于画面下方。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow wheel loader with a dirty bucket and muddy tires. Behind the loader, to the right, there are large beige pipes lying on the ground. In the background, there are white buildings with several visible windows.
zh: 前景中有一辆黄色轮式装载机，其料斗脏污，轮胎沾满泥浆。装载机后方右侧，地面上横放着几根大型米色管道。背景中可见几栋白色建筑，带有若干扇形窗户。

text: In the foreground, there is a large excavation area with mounds of earth. Two dump trucks are positioned in front of an excavator on the left, which is actively digging. To the right, one more excavator is working alongside several other dump trucks. In the distance, additional construction machinery is visible, with hills with greenery and a clear sky in the background.
zh: 前景中有一大片大型土方方开挖区域，两台自卸卡车停在一台正在作业的、积极挖掘的挖掘机左侧前方。右侧，另一台挖掘机正与数台自卸卡车协同作业。远处可见更多施工机械，背景中有植被覆盖的山丘以及晴朗的天空。

err.zh: 一大片大型土方方开挖区域

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is kneeling and working on a wooden formwork. Moving towards the background, there are two tower cranes with their booms extended across the site. In the midground, another worker is visible walking across the site. The background features a large building under construction with multiple floors visible.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在木质模板上作业，朝背景方向移动。背景中，有两台塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个工地。中景处，另一名工人正行走在工地上。背景中，有一栋大型在建建筑，可见多层楼面。

err.en: Moving towards the background, there are
err.zh: 朝背景方向移动。背景中，有两台塔式起重机

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing yellow hard hats and orange uniforms. They are positioned on a scaffold structure with various construction materials around them, including steel rods and wooden planks. To the right, there is the base of a tower crane. In the background, a river is near some trees and bushes.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿橙色工作服。他们站在脚手架上，周围堆放着各种建筑材料，包括钢管和木托盘。右侧有一台塔式起重机。背景中，一条河流靠近一些树木和灌木丛。

err.en: the base of a tower crane

text: The person squatting in the middle is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 蹲在中间的人没有戴硬草帽。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a white hard hat and blue shirt standing and observing the area. Two workers are near a formwork structure: one is squatting, and the other is standing with a yellow hard hat. On the right, there are also two workers with yellow hard hats. Large rocks and rubble are scattered across the site. The environment is dusty, and the ground is uneven with puddles of water and mud.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿蓝色上衣的工人正站立并观察该区域。两名工人位于一处施工结构附近：其中一人蹲着，另一人则头戴黄色安全帽站立着。右侧，还有两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。现场散落着大块岩石与碎石。环境显得尘土飞扬，地面平坦，伴有水坑与泥地。

text: The image shows a water-filled trench with blue protective sheets on the left and a white car parked on the embankment. An excavator is positioned on a mound of earth on the right. The excavator is loading a dump truck on its right. The surrounding area is a mix of dug-up soil and construction debris, with no visible workers or additional equipment in the immediate vicinity.
zh: 图中显示一条注满水的的水的水沟，左侧铺有蓝色防护板，右侧路基上停放着一辆白色汽车。一台挖掘机位于右侧土堆上，其右侧装载着一辆自卸卡车。周围区域是挖掘的泥土和施工碎屑的混合物，附近没有可见工人或额外设备。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebar gridwork laid out on the ground. There are six workers dispersed across the site, all wearing hard hats and engaged in various tasks related to the rebar installation. the right edge features blue fencing. In the background, there are multiple buildings and unfinished sections of the project.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面上铺设着大面积的钢筋网格。现场有六名工人分散各处，均佩戴安全帽，正从事与钢筋安装相关的的工作。右侧边缘设有蓝色围挡网。背景中可见多栋建筑物及项目已完工的部分。

text: The image shows a single excavator positioned on a mound of dirt in the center, with its arm extended to the left. The terrain is uneven and appears to be a construction site with various debris and materials scattered around, including a stack of wooden planks to the left. In the background, there is a blue fence and beyond it.
zh: 画面中，一台挖掘机停在一堆泥土堆中央，其机械臂向左伸展。地形平坦，看起来像一个建筑工地，周围散落着各种碎屑和材料，包括左侧的一堆木托盘。背景中，有一道蓝色围栏，并延伸到其外。

text: The image shows a blue dump truck loaded with bags parked on a dirt road next to a body of water.
zh: 一辆蓝色自卸卡车装载着袋子，停在一处泥路上，前方是一处水坝。

text: The image shows two workers wearing yellow hard hats operating a pile driver on a muddy construction site. The worker closer to the pile driver is handling the machinery, while the other is assisting and bending over some construction materials. There are several wooden planks and metal rods scattered around the site. The background features a pond of water and a blue fence.
zh: 图中显示两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一处泥泞地施工场地操作一台打桩机。靠近打桩机的的那名工人正在操控机器，另一名工人则在协助并弯腰搬运一些建筑材料。现场周围散落着若干木托盘和金属杆。背景中可见一处水塘和一道蓝色围栏。

text: The image shows an excavation site with a large body of water. Five workers wearing red or yellow hard hats are standing on the edge of the excavation area. In the background, there are various buildings with different architectural designs, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 图像显示一个大型水体开挖现场。五名工人戴着红色或黄色安全帽站在开挖区域边缘。背景中，有各种不同建筑设计的，天空被投射。

text: The image shows two dump trucks on an uneven dirt ground, with one being loaded with soil. A worker is standing near the first truck on the left. In the midground, a drum roller is in the middle while a bulldozer is operating to the right, and several pile drivers are actively working across the site, with visible dust clouds around them. In the left of the background, at least two mobile cranes can be seen. To the right, some concrete pipes, orange pipes, and black pipes are visible.
zh: 画面显示两辆自卸卡车停在平整的泥地上，其中一辆装载着泥土。一名工人站在左侧第一辆卡车附近。场地中部，一台压路机位于中间，同时一台推土机正在右侧作业，几名司机正在整个场地上积极作业，他们周围可见扬尘云。左侧背景中，至少可以看到两台移动起重机。右侧，一些混凝土管道、橙色管道以及黑色管道可见。

text: In the image, a muddy construction site is visible with tire tracks imprinted on the ground. Some metal sheets are paved on the ground. On the left side, there is a steep dirt embankment. Moving towards the center, there is a single worker standing in front of a yellow excavator that is positioned on a flat area with a dirt surface. On the right, a row of transmission tower and a row of street lamps can be observed above the trees and bushes.
zh: 画面中可见一处泥泞地施工现场，地面上印有轮胎印迹。部分金属板铺设在地面上。左侧有一处陡峭的泥土质嵌入物。向中心移动，有一名工人站在黄色挖掘机前，该挖掘机位于一片平坦的泥地之上。右侧可看到一排输电塔和一排路灯，位于树木和灌木丛上方。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a camouflage uniform and a red hard hat standing on a black barrel and painting a blue wall. There is a white wall and a metal pole to the right of the worker.
zh: 画面中，一名工人身穿迷彩服，头戴红色硬帽，站在黑色枪管旁，并在蓝色墙壁上作画。右侧有一面白色墙壁和一根金属杆。

text: The image shows two workers operating within an industrial setting. On the left, a worker is adjusting a large, orange hopper suspended above machinery. On the right, another worker is handling a long metal rod that extends towards the hopper. Both workers are wearing yellow hard hats
zh: 图中显示两名工人在工业环境中作业。左侧的工人正在调整一台大型橙色离心机上方悬挂的部件。右侧的另一名工人正握持一根长金属杆，将其伸向该离心机。两名工人都佩戴着黄色安全帽。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator on a mound of dirt, with a drum roller in the midground. Concrete pipes are stacked on the left of the background, and buildings and vegetation are visible in the background across the water, under an overcast sky.
zh: 一台黄色挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，中部装有一个滚筒。混凝土管道堆放在背景左侧，水面之上可见建筑物和植被，上方是阴云密布的天。

err.en: with a drum roller in the midground

text: The right edge of the excavation is not fenced nor warned.
zh: 开挖的右边缘未设置挡土墙，也未发出警告。

text: In the foreground, there are large steel rebar grids laid out on the ground, with five workers with yellow hard hats attending to them. From left to right: the first worker is squatting over the rebar; the second is standing and observing the area; the other three are standing in the middle and right of the image. The background features a water body, some trees, and a structure on the right.
zh: 前景中，地面上铺设着大型钢筋网格，五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在对其进行作业。从左至右：第一名工人正蹲在钢筋上；第二名站立着并观察该区域；其余三名站立在画面中部及右侧。背景中可见一具象的水塔、部分树木，以及右侧的一处构筑物。

err.en: The background features a water body, so
err.zh: 背景中可见一具象的水塔、部分树木，以及右侧的一处构筑物。

text: The image shows a green dump truck tipping its bed to unload soil, with large black pipes laid horizontally behind it. An orange bulldozer is visible to the right, along with some concrete pipes. To the left, a pickup truck, a white and blue truck, a stack of orange pipes, and some other construction vehicles are visible. In the background, two tower cranes are erected with a high-rise building under construction.
zh: 一辆绿色自卸卡车正倾斜车斗以卸载泥土，其后方横放着几根粗大的黑色管道。右侧可见一台橙色推土机，旁边还有一些混凝土管道。左侧有一辆皮卡卡车、一辆白色和蓝色卡车、一堆橙色管道，以及其他一些施工车辆可见。背景中，两座塔式起重机正在建造，下方有一栋在建的高层建筑。

err.en: two tower cranes are erected with a high
err.zh: 两座塔式起重机正在建造，下方有一栋在建的高层建筑

text: A worker wearing a blue hard hat and a black jacket is using a surveying instrument mounted on a tripod, standing on muddy ground. In the background, there is a blue fence and some construction debris scattered around the area, with power lines and a power pylon visible against a hazy sky.
zh: 一名头戴蓝色安全帽、身穿黑色夹克的工人，正使用架设在三脚架上的的一台测量仪器，站立在泥泞地上。背景中有一道蓝色围栏，该区域周围散落着一些建筑废料，同时可见电力线与一道电力围栏，映衬着朦胧的天空。

text: The image shows a blue excavator with its bucket raised, positioned on a mound of dirt, facing towards the right. In the background, there are various structures, including a building with a red roof behind a blue fence, and another larger multistory building further back.
zh: 图中展示了一台蓝色挖掘机，其铲斗被抬起，停在一堆泥土上，朝向右侧。在背景中，有各种结构，包括一栋带有红色屋顶的建筑位于蓝色围栏后面，以及另一栋更大的历史建筑更靠后方。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow dump truck facing left with its bed raised, and a bulldozer is positioned to the right. Behind these, there is visible near a pile-driving rig with a tall mast. Further back, two blue excavators are operating next to each other. A red dump truck is being loaded. Two other workers are seen walking in the area in the background.
zh: 前景中，有一辆黄色自卸卡车朝左方行驶，其货箱已升起，右侧则停放着一台推土机。在这些车辆后方，可见一台打桩机旁立着一根高耸的桅杆。更远处，两台蓝色挖掘机正相互作业。一辆红色自卸卡车正在装载。背景中，另有两名工人正在区域内行走。

err.en: a pile-driving rig with a tall mast
err.zh: 一台打桩机旁立着一根高耸的桅杆

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation area. Concrete structures with vertical rebars are visible. Two workers are walking through a puddle of water in the trench while pushing a trolley. A green safety net is installed on the railing of the embankment of the excavation. On the left of the excavation, there is a scaffolding structure placed against the side wall with four workers on top. In the background, there is an excavator at the site and two power tylons outside the excavation.
zh: 图中显示一个大型基坑的施工现场。混凝土结构可见竖向钢筋。两名工人正穿过基坑中的积水洼，同时推着一辆手推车。基坑边缘的栏杆上安装着绿色安全网。在基坑的左侧，有一个脚手架结构靠在侧墙上，上面有四名工人。在背景中，现场有一台挖掘机，基坑外有两台挖掘机。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site. Starting from the left, there is a sidewalk with barriers leading to a large area with extensive scaffolding over what appears to be an excavation site. The scaffolding is made of yellow tubes, red and white stripes, and covered with green safety netting. Multiple bundles of rebars are organized on the ground, and three stacks of wooden boards are placed on the structure. The construction site is bordered by a road with a green fence.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角。从左侧开始，有一条带护栏的人行道，通向一片拥有大量脚手架的开阔区域，该区域似乎是一个挖掘工地。脚手架由黄色管材、红白条纹构成，并覆盖有绿色安全网。多组钢筋棒被组织在地面上，三堆木板被放置在地面上。建筑工地被一条带有绿色围栏的道路所包围。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area covered with steel rebars laid out in a grid pattern for concrete work. Eight workers wearing yellow hard hats are scattered across the site, with two in the middle walking along the rebar grid and six others on either side of the rebar walls. On the left edge of the excavation, there is a blue fence. On the right edge, there are four more workers with yellow hard hats, a yellow dump truck, and a blue truck with a red crane.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，大面积铺设着用于混凝土作业的钢筋网格。八名头戴黄色安全帽的工人散布在现场，其中两人沿着钢筋网格中间行走，另外六人位于钢筋墙两侧。在开挖的左边缘，有一道蓝色围栏。在右边缘，有四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人、一辆黄色泵车，以及一辆带有红色起重机的臂的蓝色卡车。

text: The worker on the left is taking notes or reading from a clipboard. The worker on the top is reaching up to measure or mark something on a vertical surface. They are both standing in front of a large wall made of wood planks. They are standing on top of a rebar grid structure.
zh: 左侧的工人正在从剪贴板上取笔记或阅读。顶部的工人正在达到以测量或标记某垂直表面。他们俩都站在由木板制成的大墙的前。他们俩都站在重新网格顶部。

text: The excavator is positioned on a dirt surface with its arm extended to the left. The excavator is blue and green with the brand "KOBELCO" visible on its side.
zh: 挖掘机停放在泥面上，其臂向左伸展。挖掘机呈蓝色和绿色，其侧面可见品牌“KOBEL co”。

text: In the foreground, there is a concrete tunnel structure with exposed rebar before it. Five workers in orange safety gear are spread across the slab, with two on the left side and three on the roof of the tunnel. There are also three piles of wooden planks on the roof of the tunnel. The background features a sheet pile retaining structure. There is a fence made of metal tubes and green safety netting in the foreground.
zh: 前景中，有一处混凝土隧道结构，其前方露出钢筋。五名身着橙色安全装备的工人分散在板面上，其中两人位于左侧，三人位于隧道顶部。隧道顶部还有三堆木托盘。背景中设有一排桩基结构。前景中设有一道由金属管构成的并配有绿色安全网的围栏的围栏。

err.en: a fence made of metal tubes and green sa
err.zh: 一道由金属管构成的并配有绿色安全网的围栏的围栏

text: The image shows two workers wearing orange overalls and white hard hats standing on the lower left and facing to the right. Behind them, an excavator operated by a worker is digging or moving sand. In the background, there are piles of sand and some construction materials scattered around the site. In the background, there is a pile of concrete pipes and a pile of black pipes. There are also another excavator and a concrete mixer truck.
zh: 画面中有两名工人，他们戴着橙色安全帽和白色安全帽，站在左下方，面朝右侧。在他们身后，一台由一名工人操作的挖掘机正在挖掘或搬运沙子。在背景中，有沙堆和一些散落在工地周围的的建筑工地的材料。在背景中，有一堆混凝土管和一堆黑色管子。还有另一台挖掘机和一辆混凝土搅拌车。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and white hard h
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和白色安全帽

text: In the foreground, there is a muddy path with a worker walking towards the camera. To the right of the path, there is a yellow bulldozer facing back. In the midground, there are various construction vehicles, including a white and blue water truck and a red trailer truck, with several stockpiles of construction materials such as pipes and sandbags.
zh: 前景中，有一条泥泞路，一名工人正朝摄像机方向走来。在路径的右侧，有一台黄色的压路机背对镜头。在中景处，有多辆施工车辆，包括一辆白色和蓝色的水车以及一辆红色拖车，旁边堆放着若干堆施工材料，如管道和沙袋。

text: In the foreground, there is an excavator. To the left, behind the excavator, there is a pile of black pipes. Moving towards the right, several large concrete pipes are laid out horizontally. There is also a white SUV parked on the construction site. The terrain is uneven and consists of exposed earth.
zh: 前景中有一台挖掘机。挖掘机左后方有一堆黑色管道。向右移动时，可见数根大型混凝土管道水平铺设。施工现场还停放着一辆白色SUV。地形平坦，由裸露的泥土构成。

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor with a single drum being operated by a person visible through the cabin window. The ground appears to be a mixture of compacted and loose soil, with tire tracks evident. There are several buildings, including low-rise and high-rise in the background.
zh: 画面中，透过驾驶室车窗可见一名身着黄色土作业服的工人正在操作单钢轮。地面看起来是压实土与松散土的质的的混合物，并带有轮胎痕迹。背景中可见多座建筑物，包括低层与高层建筑。

err.en: mixture of compacted and loose soil
err.zh: 压实土与松散土的质的的混合物

text: The image shows numerous metal tubes and metal tube structures scattered around, with approximately ten workers wearing hard hats and safety vests engaged in various activities. In the upper part of the image, there is a base of the tower crane on the left. There is a concrete platform on the right. A concrete building under construction is on top of the platform, with blue metal fences surrounding it. On the left, there is some greenery in the background.
zh: 画面中散布着许多金属管材和金属管结构，大约有十名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在从事各种活动。在画面的左上部分，有一台塔式起重机。右侧有一个混凝土平台。平台上方有一栋正在施工中的混凝土建筑，周围环绕着蓝色金属围栏。左侧背景中有一些绿植栽。

err.en: there is a base of the tower crane on th

text: The image shows a large open area with patches of blue tarp and construction materials scattered around. An excavator is positioned in the center-left part of the image. A concrete pump truck is in the center of the image with a bulldozer and a loader nearby on the right. In the background, there are temporary residential structures with white and blue colors. The boom of a mobile crane can be seen.
zh: 图像显示一片开阔的大型场地，周围散落着蓝色防水布和建筑材料。一台挖掘机位于画面左侧中部。画面中央有一辆混凝土泵车，其右侧附近停着一台挖机和一台装载机。背景中可见一些临时性建筑，呈白色和蓝色。可以看到一台移动吊车的吊臂。

text: The image shows six workers wearing yellow hard hats and red jackets, gathered at a construction site. The workers are at the left of the site. There is a wheelbarrow in the lower left. The background features a partially constructed concrete structure with a fence made of metal tubes and safety netting along the edge of the foundation.
zh: 画面显示六名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色工作服的工人，聚集在一处建筑工地的左侧。左下方有一根钢筋。背景中可见部分已浇筑的混凝土结构，基础边缘设有由金属管构成的并配有安全防护网的片的。

err.en: a fence made of metal tubes and safety n
err.zh: 由金属管构成的并配有安全防护网的片的

text: The image shows a group of nine individuals, six of them wearing hard hats, gathered in the foreground. An excavator is positioned in the upper right, actively moving earth. The excavation site features vertical earth retention walls made of sheet piles on the left side, and the ground appears muddy with scattered debris.
zh: 画面显示九人组成的群体，其中六人佩戴安全帽，聚集在前景。一台挖掘机位于右上方，正在进行土方方作业。开挖场地左侧设有由钢板桩构成的垂直挡土墙，地面显得泥泞污，并散落着碎屑。

text: Two workers in the middle do not have hard hats.
zh: 两名工人中间没有戴安全帽。

err.en: Two workers in the middle do not have ha
err.zh: 两名工人中间没有戴安全帽。

text: In the foreground, a yellow Hyundai excavator is engaged in digging. Behind the excavator, there is a slope with exposed earth and scattered rocks. A white metal fence is visible in the midground, and beyond that, there is a building with traditional architectural features and a tiled roof.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色现代挖掘机正在进行挖掘作业。挖掘机后方，有一处坡面，露出泥土体与散落的岩石。中景处，可见一道黑色金属围栏，再往后，有一栋建筑，具备传统建筑特征，并配有瓦片屋顶。

text: The image shows a construction site with two pile driver rigs with visible drilling equipment. A huge amount of water hoses are laid on the ground. To the left, two rebar cages can be seen. In the background, several transmission towers can be seen above the meadow.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，有两台钻机架，可见钻探设备。地面上铺设了大量水管。左侧可以看到两个钢筋笼。背景中，在阴影上方可以看到几座输电塔。

text: In the foreground, there is a worker wearing a straw hat and a long-sleeve shirt, working next to a large concrete structure with waterproofing applied to its exterior. The worker is applying waterproofing near the base of the wall.
zh: 前景中，有一名头戴草帽、身穿长袖衬衫的工人，正临近一大型混凝土结构，其内部已施作防水处理。该工人正在墙体基附近施作防水处理。

err.en: with waterproofing applied to its exteri
err.zh: 其内部已施作防水处理

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of excavated earth. A yellow Hyundai excavator is positioned on the left side, actively digging into the hillside. The terrain appears rocky and uneven, with exposed earth and rock layers visible.
zh: 前景中有一大堆开挖的土方。一台黄色的现代挖掘机位于左侧，正在向山体内部积极挖掘。地形显得岩石且平整，可见裸露出的土和岩层。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow mobile crane positioned on a platform and to the left of a pile-driving rig. To the right, there is a large pile of black pipes. Further back, a large mound of earth stretches across the middle of the image, with more concrete pipes visible on the slope.
zh: 前景中，有一台黄色色移动起重机停放在平台上，位于一堆驱动装置的左侧。右侧，有一大堆黑色管道。更远处，一大片土堆横贯图像中部，斜坡上可见更多混凝土管道。

text: The image shows three workers wearing yellow hard hats engaged in activities: one is pushing a wheelbarrow, another is shoveling material into a wheelbarrow, and the third is standing and observing. In the midground, two piles of construction materials are on the left and right, respectively. In the background, there are two tower cranes.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在从事以下活动：一人正在推运一辆轮式起重机，另一人正在将材料装入一辆轮式起重机，第三人则站立并观察。在画面中部，左右两侧分别堆放着两堆建筑材料。在背景中，有两台塔式起重机。

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road with scattered debris and bricks leading towards the center of the image. A dump truck is positioned on the left side of the road. Moving towards the background, there is a red dump truck in the middle and an excavator to its right, both situated on mounds of earth. The excavator is loading the dump truck.
zh: 前景中，一条土路向画面中心延伸，路上散落着碎石和砖块。一辆自卸卡车停在道路左侧，正驶向背景。背景中，一辆红色自卸卡车位于中间，其右侧有一台挖掘机，两者均停放在泥地上。挖掘机正装载着自卸卡车。

err.en: Moving towards the background, there is
err.zh: 一辆自卸卡车停在道路左侧，正驶向背景

text: In the foreground, a worker is bending over near the front of an orange dump truck. To the right, an excavator with a blue cab is positioned above the mound of dirt, with its bucket raised as if it has just deposited material into the truck's bed. The ground throughout the image is uneven and muddy.
zh: 前景中，一名工人正弯腰俯身在一辆橙色自卸卡车前部附近。右侧，一台蓝色车头的挖掘机位于土堆上方，其铲斗高高抬起，仿佛刚刚将物料卸入卡车车斗中。整个图像的地面平坦且泥泞滑。

text: The image shows three workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests working on a concrete surface. Two workers on the left are using trowels to smoothen fresh concrete. The third worker is standing on a hardened concrete surface. There are construction materials in the middle, wooden planks and red wooden sheets.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿反光背心的的工人正在混凝土表面上作业。左侧的两名为使用泵送新鲜混凝土。第三名工人站在已硬化的混凝土表面上。中间有建筑材料、木托盘和红色木板。

err.en: using trowels to smoothen fresh concrete
err.zh: 为使用泵送新鲜混凝土

text: The image shows four workers wearing orange safety overalls and yellow hard hats engaged in activities on top of a concrete unfinished concrete tunnel reinforced with steel bars. In the foreground, there is a pile of rusty rebars with broken tiles on top. There is also a fence made of black and yellow tubes and green safety netting.
zh: 画面显示四名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色安全帽的工人，正在一座顶部为钢筋混凝土、内部由钢筋加强的化的成的混凝土隧道中从事作业。前景处有一堆锈蚀的钢筋条，上面覆盖着破碎的瓷砖块。此外，还有一道由黑色与黄色管材以及绿色安全网制成的而成的围栏。

err.en: wearing orange safety overalls and yello
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色安全帽
绿色安全网制成的而成的围栏

text: The image shows an excavator on the right side with its branding partially visible. There is a large trench with uneven, excavated soil, along the edge of which are nine individuals wearing hard hats and various clothing. In the background, three finished buildings are behind the white barrier.
zh: 画面右侧有一台挖掘机，其品牌标识部分可见。现场有一个大型沟槽，沟内是平整的开挖土方，沿沟槽边缘站着九名头戴安全帽、身着不同服装的人员。背景中，白色围挡墙后方有三栋已完工建筑。

text: The image shows two workers at a construction site. Both are crouching and working on a concrete structure with protruding rebars. There are multiple vertical rebars protruding from the concrete foundation in the foreground. In the upper part of the image, the opening of a concrete pipe is partially visible behind a short wall made of red bricks.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地有两名工人。两人都在哭喊，正在处理一块带有外露钢筋的混凝土结构。前景的混凝土基础中有多根垂直钢筋伸出。在画面上部，一个混凝土管子的开口部分可见，位于一面由红砖砌成的短墙后面。

text: In the foreground, a yellow excavator is positioned on muddy terrain, its arm extended to the right with the bucket raised slightly above the ground. The background features a cleared area with piles of dirt and some fallen trees. Power lines are visible in the far background, spanning across the top of the image.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色色挖掘机停驻在泥泞土地上，其臂向右伸展，铲斗略高于地面。背景中有一片开阔区域，堆放着土堆和一些倒伏的树木。远处背景中可见电力线，横跨图像顶部。

text: A worker is bending over a workbench, handling rebar with cutting machinery. Three bundles of rebar are stacked on the ground. A shed provides cover over the work area, and clothes are hung up to dry under the shelter. In the background, a construction site is visible with a perimeter fence displaying blue banners with white text. A transmission tower is visible in the upper right.
zh: 一名工人正弯腰跨越工作台，手持钢筋在切割机械旁操作。三根钢筋堆放在地面上。一个棚子搭在作业区域上方，衣物悬挂在棚子下方晾干。背景中可见一处建筑工地，周围围栏上展示着带有白色文字的的白色蓝色横幅。右上方可见一座输电塔。

err.zh: 带有白色文字的的白色蓝色横幅

text: In the foreground, there is a cluttered area with numerous construction materials, including piles of rebars, medal tubes, wood planks. Around six workers are scattered on the right, and two more workers are on the left. The background shows two buildings surrounded by yellow scaffolding and green safety netting. There is a total of six tower cranes, some are fully revealed and some are partially hidden, in the image.
zh: 前景中有一处杂乱区域，堆放着大量建筑材料，包括成堆的钢筋、钢管和木托盘。画面右侧零散着六名工人，左侧还有另外两名工人。背景中可见两栋建筑，被黄色脚手架和绿色安全网围住。画面中总共有六台塔吊，其中一些完全显露出来，另一些则部分隐藏于画面之中。

err.en: Around six workers are scattered on the
err.zh: 画面右侧零散着六名工人

text: The image shows a large pile of debris and waste, including plastics, fabrics, and other assorted refuse. A blue Kobelco excavator is positioned in the middle on an uneven dirt surface. Two structures, one with a red brick facade on the right and one made of concrete on the left, are in the image. The background features several high-rise buildings covered with green safety netting.
zh: 图中显示了一大堆垃圾和废弃物，包括塑料、织物以及其他各种杂物。一台蓝色的科贝尔科挖掘机位于平坦泥土地面的中央。画面中还有两座建筑，右侧一座带有红砖外墙，左侧一座由混凝土建成。背景中可见几栋高层建筑，覆盖着绿色安全网。

text: The image shows three yellow excavators with their arms extended into the muddy ground. The ground throughout the site appears muddy and has tire tracks.
zh: 图中显示三名黄色挖掘机将手臂伸入泥泞地。整个工地看起来泥泞，且有轮胎痕迹。

text: The image shows a worker on a ladder leaning against a white barrier. Another worker is crouched down, engaging in a task near the base of a white column. Various construction materials and tools are scattered around the area, including a long white panel lying on the ground, a circular saw, and a straw hat.
zh: 一名工人正倚靠在梯子上，面对一道白色屏障。另一名工人蹲伏着，正在靠近一根白色立柱底部从事一项任务。各种建筑材料和工具散落在该区域周围，包括一块平铺在地面上的、一把圆锯以及一顶草帽的长白色面板。

err.en: a long white panel lying on the ground,
err.zh: 一块平铺在地面上的、一把圆锯以及一顶草帽的长白色面板

text: The image shows a wet concrete surface with visible tire tracks. A yellow and black barrier runs parallel on both sides and the middle of the area. Two yellow mobile cranes are in the middle. A blue truck with a red payload is on the left. In the background, a blue overhead structure spans across the area, and multiple tower cranes are visible in the distance on the left.
zh: 画面显示一片潮湿的混凝土路面，上面有清晰可见的轮胎印痕。一道黄黑相的路障沿两侧及该区域的中线平行延伸。两辆黄色轿车停在中线位置。一辆载有红色货物的的蓝色卡车停在左侧。在背景里，一道蓝色高架结构横跨整个区域，并且多座塔式起重机在远处左侧可见。

err.en: A blue truck with a red payload
err.zh: 一辆载有红色货物的的蓝色卡车

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road leading towards the background. On the left, an excavator is positioned on the road, with its bucket in contact with a pile of dirt. Further back on the right, another excavator is visible at a higher elevation, with its arm extended outward. The background features a hill of dirt with vegetation on the top.
zh: 前景中，一条土路通向背景。左侧，一台挖掘机停在路旁，其铲斗与一堆泥土接触。更靠后的右侧，另一台挖掘机在较高处可见，其臂向外伸出。背景中，有长着植被的土丘。

text: A wheel loader is positioned in the upper left on a dirt road. To the right, there is a pile of rubble and some construction materials.
zh: 一辆轮式装载机停在上坡土路的左侧。右侧有一堆碎石和一些建筑材料。

text: The image shows a deep excavation site with vertical and horizontal steel reinforcements in place. A worker is present at the bottom of the excavation. There is a ladder providing access to the excavation's base.
zh: 图中显示一处深层开挖场地，已设置竖向和水平钢筋加固。一名工人位于开挖底部。有一架梯子提供进入开挖底部的通道的通道。

err.en: providing access to the excavation's bas
err.zh: 提供进入开挖底部的通道的通道

text: The image shows a dump truck tilted, with a van parked nearby and two individuals standing to the left. On the right, two sedans can be seen. In the background, there is a cleared hillside with trees and a communication tower visible in the distance.
zh: 图中显示一辆倾斜的自卸卡车，旁边停着一辆厢式货车，左侧站着两个人。右侧可以看到两个僧侣。背景中有一座清晰的山坡，上面有树木，远处可见一座通信塔。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator on an earth path, with its arm extended to the left side of the image. The excavator has a pile driver installed and is driving a pile. A blue mesh fence runs parallel to the path, and beyond the fence, there is a body of water. In the background, multiple high-rise buildings are visible, with a clear sky above.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机位于一条土路之上，其臂架延伸至图像左侧。挖掘机上装有一根桩，并正在驱动一根桩。一道蓝色网格围栏与土路平行延伸，而在围栏架之外，有一片水域。在背景之中，多座高层建筑清晰可见，上方是一片晴朗的天空。

text: In the image, nine individuals are gathered at a construction site with an excavated area featuring exposed sheet pile walls. Most individuals are wearing white hard hats, and two are actively engaged in inspecting or measuring something on the ground with a tool, while the others observe. The group is standing on the uneven, rocky ground of the site.
zh: 图像中，九个人聚集在一处施工场地，该场地有一片开挖区域，露出钢板桩墙。大多数人戴着白色安全帽，其中两人正积极使用工具对地面进行检查或测量，其余人则在旁观察。该群体站立在地面平整、岩石质地的面上。

err.zh: 地面平整、岩石质地的面上

text: The image shows around twenty construction workers spread across a large excavation site with concrete foundations and rebar frameworks in various stages of completion. The base of a tower crane is positioned in the middle. In the middle, workers are actively engaged in tasks around the rebar structures. Various construction materials are scattered around, including green mesh, wooden planks, and concrete slabs. The background shows a perimeter fence with greenery beyond it.
zh: 画面显示，约二十名建筑工人分散在一处大型开挖场地，该场地设有混凝土基础及处于不同完工阶段的的重钢结构。塔式起重机的基位于中部。在中部，工人正积极从事围绕重钢结构的的工作。各种建筑材料散落在周围，包括绿色网、木托盘以及混凝土试块。背景显示，一道周边围栏，其外围有绿色植物。

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of soil and rubble in the foreground, featuring a Hyundai excavator positioned on cleared ground with its arm extended towards soil pile.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，前景处有一堆泥土和碎石，一台日立建挖掘机停在平整的地面上，其臂伸向土堆。

text: The image shows a collection of brown pipes and construction materials in the foreground. A yellow dump truck is tilted next to a white cement mixer truck. A crane is visible with its boom extended upwards in the middle ground. In the background, a rocky hillside and another crane with a red boom can be seen. The sky is overcast.
zh: 前景处堆放着一堆棕色管道和建筑材料。一辆黄色色泵车倾斜着，紧挨着一辆白色水泥搅拌车。画面中部可见一台起重机，其吊臂向上伸展。背景中，一处岩石山崖旁，还能看到另一台带有红色吊臂的起重机。天空笼罩于上方。

text: In the center of the image, there is a single excavator with a visible operator inside. The excavator is in the process of digging the muddy earth, with its bucket raised. The ground around the excavator is uneven and covered in mud.
zh: 画面中央有一台挖掘机，其操作室内可见一名操作人员。该挖掘机正在进行挖掘泥土，其铲斗已抬起。挖掘机周围地面平整且被泥浆覆盖。

text: The worker with a yellow hard hat is using a grinder on a metal panel. A pile of rusty metal tubes is next to him.
zh: 戴黄色安全帽的工人正在金属面板上使用磨床。一堆生锈金属管位于他前方。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site. A red crane is positioned near the center, and two yellow tower cranes are to the left and right of the image. Several construction workers are visible in the upper right; three of them are near the crane on the right, and one is on top of the image. There are two buildings under construction, one is in the upper left and one is in the upper right. Both of them consist of rebar frameworks. There are at least ten stacks of rebars scattered across the site.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角。一台红色起重机位于画面中央附近，两台黄色塔式起重机分别位于画面的左侧和右侧。画面右上方可见几名建筑工人；其中三人靠近右侧起重机，另一人位于画面顶部。画面下方有两栋在建建筑，一栋位于左上方，另一栋位于右上方。这两栋建筑均采用钢筋框架结构。工地上散落着至少十堆钢筋。

err.en: one is in the upper left and one is in t
err.zh: 一栋位于左上方，另一栋位于右上方

text: The image shows three workers installing rebar on a construction site. The worker on the left is wearing a red hard hat and a green safety vest, while the workers on the right are wearing yellow hard hats and green safety vests. In the background, there is a high wall with some tubes leaning onto it.
zh: 图像显示三名工人在建筑工地上安装栏杆。左边的工人戴着红色安全帽和绿色安全背心，而右边工人戴着黄色安全帽和绿色安全背心。背景中有一堵高墙，上面靠着一些管子。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, excavated area filled with water. The workers are working on an unfinished concrete tunnel. Four workers wearing yellow hard hats are visible in the center. A worker is using a concrete hose hanging from above to pour concrete into the formwork. A dirt road runs along the right side of the trench. A concrete mixer truck and a concrete pump truck are on the dirt path.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一个大型开挖区域，里面灌满了水。工人正在一条已完工的具体隧道内作业。画面中央可见四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。一名工人正使用一根混凝土软管，从上方将混凝土浇筑入成型作业。一条土路沿着沟槽右侧延伸。一辆混凝土搅拌车与一辆混凝土泵车停放在土路上。

err.zh: 一条已完工的具体隧道

text: The image shows a pile driving rig on muddy terrain with two workers wearing red hard hats guiding a pile into the ground. Behind the rig, there are several concrete piles laid horizontally on the ground. The background shows some greenery.
zh: 图中显示，在泥泞土地上有一台打桩机，两名戴着红色安全帽的工人正在引导一根桩打入地面。在打桩机后面，地面上水平放置着几堆混凝土。背景中显示着一些绿色植物。

text: In the foreground, there are four workers; one wearing a red hard hat and orange overalls is standing inside a rebar structure, another in a yellow hard hat is assisting from the inside, and two others are nearby, one in a blue hard hat and the other in a yellow hard hat and a pair of shorts. An excavator with a yellow arm and a dirty bucket is positioned to the right, operated by a driver in a yellow cabin. Behind the workers and excavator, there is a partially constructed concrete tunnel structure with exposed rebar. The background features treens and grass.
zh: 前景中有四名工人；其中一人戴着红色硬帽和橙色护目镜，站在一个重新结构化的结构内；另一人戴着黄色硬帽，从内部协助；还有两人在附近，一人戴着蓝色硬帽，另一人戴着黄色硬帽和一对短裤。一台带有黄色臂和脏桶的挖掘机位于右侧，由一名穿着黄色驾驶舱的司机操作。在工人和挖掘机后面，有一个部分建造的混凝土隧道结构，带有外露出的重新结构化的。背景中呈现出树木和草。

err.zh: 外露出的重新结构化的

text: The image shows a newly paved road with two road rollers and an asphalt paver in a line, positioned on the road and facing away from the viewpoint. On the right side of the road, there is a white dump truck partially visible. Along the sides of the road, there are several workers, including a group of two gathered to the right, with the other person surveying with a piece of equipment mounted on a tripod.
zh: 画面显示一条新铺设的道路，路两侧各有一台路面压路机和一台沥青摊铺路机，其中一台位于道路一侧并背对镜头。道路右侧有一辆白色自卸卡车部分可见。道路另一侧有几名工人，包括一组两人聚集在右侧，另一人正使用架设在三脚架上的的一件设备进行调查。

err.en: two road rollers and an asphalt paver in
err.zh: 各有一台路面压路机和一台沥青摊铺路机

text: In the foreground, there is a gravel-covered area bordered by wooden planks. Four workers wearing orange and blue uniforms with yellow hard hats are spreading and leveling concrete. To the right, a worker is holding a concrete hose hanging from above to pour concrete into the area. In the upper left or the image, a concrete mixer truck and a concrete pump truck can be seen.
zh: 前景中有一片由木条边框围成的碎石覆盖区域。四名身穿橙蓝相间制服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正分散开来浇筑混凝土。右侧有一名工人手持混凝土软管，从上方向该区域浇筑混凝土。左上方或图像中可见一辆混凝土搅拌车及一辆混凝土泵车。

err.en: In the upper left or the image

text: In the image, there are five excavators with different color. Three of them are in them are digging in the mud while two of them are on the bank to the left of a green drump truck. Moving towards the background, a large white building and two tower cranes are visible.
zh: 图中有五个不同颜色的挖掘机。其中三台正在泥地里挖掘，另外两台位于绿色自卸卡车的左侧，正朝着背景中一栋大型白色建筑移动。可以看到两台塔式起重机。

err.en: Moving towards the background, a large w
err.zh: 正朝着背景中一栋大型白色建筑移动。可以看到两台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows four workers laying bricks in the middle. One of the workers in pink is handling bricks on the right. On the left, there is a pile of wooden boards and a stack of blue metal panels. The terrain appears to be uneven and dug up. Vegetation is visible in the background.
zh: 画面中央有四名工人在砌砖。其中一名穿粉色衣服的的人正用右手搬砖。左侧有一堆木板和一堆蓝色金属板。地面看起来是平整的，并且被挖开了。背景中可以看到植被。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven and dug
err.zh: 地面看起来是平整的，并且被挖开了。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large grid of rebar laid out in the foreground. Six workers wearing orange uniforms and yellow hard hats are distributed across the scene, with four bending over the rebar and three standing, handling materials or tools. The background features a blue fence runs along the edge of the site. A power pylon is in the background.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景处铺设着大片大型钢筋。六名身着橙色制服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人散布在场景中，其中四人正弯着钢筋，三人站立着，处理材料或工具。背景中，一道蓝色围栏沿着工地边缘延伸。一台电钻机位于背景中。

text: In the foreground, two workers with blue or white hard hats are standing on the concrete platform. Another worker with a white hard hat is on the left on the ground level, holding a surveying tool. Moving towards the center, more workers can be seen. An excavator is unloading soil into the trench. An orange dump truck is in front of the excavator. In the background, trees and a power line tower can be seen.
zh: 前景中，两名头戴蓝色或白色安全帽的工人正站在混凝土平台上。另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人位于左侧地面层，手持测量工具，正朝中心方向移动。更多工人可见。一台挖掘机正将泥土卸入沟槽中。一台橙色自卸卡车停在挖掘机前方。背景中可见树木及输电线路塔。

err.en: Moving towards the center, more workers
err.zh: 正朝中心方向移动。更多工人可见。

text: In the foreground, there is a large area of rebars laid out on the ground, forming a grid structure with wooden formwork around the perimeter. A concrete pump with a long boom is positioned in the middle. Two workers are pouring concrete in the middle. The middle worker is holding the concrete hose. To the right, there is another worker walking next to a building covered with green safety netting. To the left, a white concrete truck can be seen.
zh: 前景中，地面上铺设着大片钢筋，沿周边形成木质模板结构。一台混凝土泵位于中央。两名工人正在中央浇筑混凝土。中间的工人手持着混凝土软管。右侧，另一名工人正走向覆盖着绿色安全网的罩的建筑。左侧，可见一辆白色混凝土卡车。

err.en: forming a grid structure with wooden for
err.zh: 沿周边形成木质模板结构

err.en: a building covered with green safety net
err.zh: 覆盖着绿色安全网的罩的建筑

text: The image shows a large excavation with extensive rebar frameworks in place. The framework runs from the lower left of the image to the background. Seven workers wearing yellow hard hats are visible within the rebar structure, engaged in construction activities. Outside the excavated area, there is a metal panel in the upper part of the image along with some broken bricks.
zh: 图像显示一个大型基坑，内部设有密集的的重框架。该框架从图像左下方延伸至至背景。在重结构内可见七名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，正从事施工作业。在开挖区域之外，图像上部有一金属板，旁边伴有一些破碎砖块。

text: The image shows a large excavation area with water accumulation and scattered construction debris. A series of rebars are laid out in a grid pattern across the site on top of a concrete foundation. Ten workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in various activities related to the reinforcement work. On the right, a worker is standing on the bank next to a stack of rebars. On the left, a worker with a red hard hat is standing next to a wall with white and black color.
zh: 图像显示一个大型开挖区域，伴有积水积聚和散落的施工废料。一系列钢筋以网格状排列于混凝土基础之上。十名头戴橙色安全帽、身着黄色安全帽的工人正从事与钢筋作业相关的活动。右侧，一名工人站立于钢筋堆旁。左侧，一名头戴红色安全帽的工人站立于一面白色与黑色相的墙体旁。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and yellow hard
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽、身着黄色安全帽

err.en: On the right, a worker is standing on th
err.zh: 右侧，一名工人站立于钢筋堆旁。

text: The image shows an excavation site at night illuminated by artificial lighting. In the middle, at least four excavators are digging. To the right, a large building with several lit windows can be seen.
zh: 夜间，一处工地被人工照明照亮。画面中央，至少四名挖掘机正在挖掘。右侧，可以看到一栋大型建筑，其上有多个亮着的灯的火的光的线的。

err.zh: 多个亮着的灯的火的光的线的

text: In the image, there are two workers with white hard hats visible on a construction site with complex rebar frameworks laid out on the floor. They are standing on a multi-story building under construction. The site is equipped with yellow scaffolding and green safety netting. In the roof, the building has at least two stacks of wooden boards on the ground. Some vertical rebars are protruding from the ground.
zh: 图像中，两名头戴白色安全帽的工人正站在一个结构复杂的、钢筋框架外露在地板上的。他们正站在多层建筑下方施工。该工地配备有黄色脚手架和绿色安全防护网。在屋顶，该建筑至少有两堆木板堆放在地面上。一些竖直钢筋从地面伸出。

err.en: on a construction site with complex reba
err.zh: 正站在一个结构复杂的、钢筋框架外露在地板上的。

err.en: standing on a multi-story building under
err.zh: 正站在多层建筑下方施工

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red hard hat and orange safety pants holding a measuring stick next to a large concrete pipe laid on a bed of gravel. A yellow excavator is behind the concrete pipeline.
zh: 图中一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿橙色安全裤，手持测量杆，正走向放置在碎石床上的的一根大型混凝土管道。混凝土管道后方停着一台黄色挖掘机。

err.en: holding a measuring stick next to a larg
err.zh: 正走向放置在碎石床上的的一根大型混凝土管道

text: The image shows a construction site with several large concrete pipes lying horizontally on the ground. A blue excavator is positioned in the center, engaged in digging or moving earth. Behind the excavator, the terrain is a mix of bare earth and grassy areas, with a blue fence and several poles visible in the midground.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，地面上水平放置着几根大型混凝土管道。一台蓝色挖掘机位于画面中央，正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土。在挖掘机后方，地形是裸露的泥土与草地地的带的，并可见一道蓝色围栏以及几根立柱立于中景地面。

err.en: a mix of bare earth and grassy areas
err.zh: 裸露的泥土与草地地的带的

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer with a front blade, positioned on a dirt surface with visible tracks behind it. The ground is uneven with various piles of dirt and some debris of trees scattered around.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色推土机，其前装有刀片，停在一处泥土地表面上，该表面可见车辙痕迹。地面平整，周围散落着一些土堆和树木碎片屑。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a safety vest is facing away from the camera, with construction materials and a wheelbarrow nearby. Three workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are engaged in tasks involving shovels and buckets, with another one with a red hard hat standing and observing. An excavator is positioned near a mound of earth on the right with a worker with a white hard hat. In the right of the background, two more excavators can be seen. The background features massive coverage by blue tarps.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人背对镜头，其附近堆放着建筑材料和一辆轮式起重机。三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正从事涉及铲斗机和料斗的任务，另有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人站立并观察。一台挖掘机位于右侧的一堆泥土堆旁，旁边有一名头戴白色安全帽的工人。右侧背景中，可以看到另外两台挖掘机。背景由大片蓝色防护网覆盖。

text: In the foreground, there are tire tracks from heavy machinery. A yellow drum roller is visible on the left, and to its right, an excavator is in operation, moving earth. Scattered around the site are various construction materials, including black pipes. In the upper part of the image, there is a fence made of concrete columns and black fences. To the right of the fence, there is a loader.
zh: 前景中有重型机械的轮胎轨道。左侧可见一台黄色色鼓式压路机，其右侧有一台挖掘机正在进行土方方作业。场地周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括黑色管道。画面上方有由混凝土立柱和黑色围栏构成的的一道围栏。围栏的右侧有一台装载机。

err.zh: 一台黄色色鼓式压路机

err.en: a fence made of concrete columns and bla
err.zh: 由混凝土立柱和黑色围栏构成的的一道围栏

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on a mound of dirt, with its bucket touching the ground. In the background, there is a construction site with a tower crane. More than ten parked scooters and motorcycles are on the left and a van is on the right.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其铲斗接触地面。背景中有一处建筑工地，配有塔式起重机。左侧停放着十余辆摩托车和摩托车，右侧停着一辆面包车。

err.en: More than ten parked scooters and motorc
err.zh: 十余辆摩托车和摩托车

text: In the foreground, there is a large area covered with a grid of rebar on the ground, with one worker with a yellow hard hat and a black jacket bending over it. A concrete pump with a red boom extends across the middle of the image, with concrete being poured by a worker holding the hose. Under the concrete pump boom, an array of horizontal and vertical rebar framework can be seen along with around five workers.
zh: 前景中，地面上铺设着一大片由钢筋网格覆盖的大面积，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黑色夹克的工人正弯腰跨过该网格。画面中部，一台混凝土泵正将混凝土通过一名手持软管的工人进行浇筑。在混凝土泵下方，可看到一套水平及垂直的钢筋框架，周围分布着五名工人。

err.en: with a red boom extends across the middl
err.zh: 画面中部，一台混凝土泵正将混凝土通过一名手持软管的工人进行浇筑

text: The image shows an excavated area with exposed earth and a pile of dirt. An excavator is positioned in the center, with its arm extended and bucket touching the ground. To the right, a drilling bit and a pile driving rig are visible.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖区域，露出泥土和一堆泥土。一台挖掘机位于中央，其臂和铲斗接触地面。右侧可见一台钻机钻机和一个驱动钻机架。

err.en: with its arm extended and bucket touchin
a drilling bit and a pile driving rig
err.zh: 一台钻机钻机和一个驱动钻机架

text: In the foreground, there is a large expanse of dirt with tire tracks, leading towards construction activity in the background. On the left, a green excavator is stationed near a pile-driving rig. Two orange excavators are actively digging in the middle and on the right of the image. Further back, there is a partially constructed concrete roadway with several workers and vehicles, including a yellow excavator.
zh: 前景中有一大片宽阔的泥地，上面布满轮胎印痕，通向背景中的施工活动。左侧有一台绿色挖掘机停放在一堆驱动装置附近。画面中部和右侧有两台橙色挖掘机正在积极挖掘。更远处，有一条部分建成的混凝土道路，上面有几名工人和车辆，包括一台黄色挖掘机。

text: In the foreground, there are two excavators facing each other, one yellow and one orange, positioned on a mound of reddish-brown earth.
zh: 前景中，有两名挖掘机相对而立，一台黄色，一台橙色，停在一堆红褐色泥土堆上。

text: Four workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are smoothing concrete on a construction site. The structure has rebar grids as reinforcement and enclosed by formworks made of red metal plates and metal tubes. Three workers are bending over and using a hand tool, the fourth worker on the right is standing and guiding a long hose. Behind the workers, there is a blue building and greenery, including a tree partially visible on the right side.
zh: 四名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳的工人正站在混凝土施工场地的光滑混凝土上。该结构具有钢筋网格作为加强筋，并由红色金属板和金属管围成的模板制成。三名工人正在弯曲，并使用手动工具，右侧第四名工人站立并引导一根长管。在工人身后，有一栋蓝色建筑和绿色植物，包括一棵部分可见于右侧的树。

err.en: Four workers in orange overalls and yell
err.zh: 四名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳的工人

err.en: are smoothing concrete on a construction
err.zh: 正站在混凝土施工场地的光滑混凝土上

text: At the construction site, there are several stacks of construction materials, including metal tubes and bundles of rebars and stirrups. Moving towards the center, there are at least six workers engaged in various activities such as bending over and walking across the construction site, which is characterized by a dense array of vertical scaffolding poles. The workers are wearing yellow or red hard hats.
zh: 施工现场堆放着多堆建筑材料，包括金属管材、成束的钢筋和搅拌棒。向中心移动，至少有六名工人从事着各种活动，例如弯曲跨越和步行穿过施工现场，其特点是密集的垂直脚手架极的阵列。工人戴着黄色或红色安全帽。

text: The image shows a nighttime scene at a construction site within a large, dimly lit cavernous space. In the center, there is an excavator with its arm extended, positioned next to a truck. To the right of the image, there is another truck. The ground is uneven and covered with debris or construction material.
zh: 画面呈现一处夜间施工现场场景，位于一个大型、昏暗的洞状空间内。画面中央有一台挖掘机，其臂架正位于一辆卡车旁。画面右侧还有另一辆卡车。地面平整，覆盖着碎屑或建筑材料。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat crouched over a large grid of rebar. Another worker stands facing away, observing the site, wearing a white hard hat. There are multiple stacks of metal tubes at the construction site.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，站在一大片钢筋网格上方。另一名工人背对镜头站立，观察工地现场，头戴白色安全帽。施工现场有多堆金属管材。

text: In the foreground, there is a muddy construction site with standing water and scattered construction materials. A pile-driving rig is positioned centrally, surrounded by various equipment. To the left, several tents are set up. To the right, there is a stack of black pipes. Several mounds of reddish-brown soil are in the midground. The background features greenery and power pylon.
zh: 前景中，有一处泥泞地施工现场，伴有积水和散落的建筑材料。中央位置有一台桩机，周围环绕着各种设备。左侧搭设着数顶帐篷。右侧有一堆黑色管道。中景处有几堆红褐色泥土。背景中点缀着绿植丛和电力围栏网。

text: The image shows a close-up view of a yellow tower crane against a cloudy sky. The crane has a horizontal jib with a trolley and a hook hanging at the end of the jib. A part of the jib of another tower crane is visible on the left.
zh: 画面特写了一台黄色塔式起重机，背景是多云的天空。起重机的带有水平吊臂，吊臂末端悬挂着一个滑轮。画面左侧可见另一台塔式起重机的一部分吊臂。

text: In the image, there is one worker in orange coveralls and a yellow hard hat standing on a wooden platform. The worker is handling a concrete hose that is hanging from above and pouring concrete into a vertical rebar structure. Behind the worker, there is another worker with the same attire and an earthen embankment with some scattered debris. The rebar structure is supported by a series of metal forms.
zh: 画面中，一名身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在木质平台上。该工人正操作一根从上方垂下的并往竖直钢筋笼内浇筑混凝土的软管。在工人身后，还有另一名穿着相同服装、佩戴耳塞的工人，周围散落着一些碎屑杂物。钢筋笼由一系列金属构件支撑。

err.en: an earthen embankment with some scattere
err.zh: 佩戴耳塞的工人，周围散落着一些碎屑杂物

text: The image shows six workers on a rebar framework, with three bending over and three standing. The construction site has a stack of wooden boards and a stack of rebars in the background. The two stacks of construction materials are in front of a retaining wall.
zh: 图像显示六名工人在脚手架上，其中三人弯着身子，三人站着。建筑工地背景中有一堆木板和一堆钢筋。两堆建筑材料位于挡土墙的前方。

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive scaffolding and formwork in place. The scaffolding on the left of the image is made of metal tubes. The formwork on the right is made of red wooden sheets. From left to right, there are three workers visible: one is walking on the scaffolding, another is bending over, possibly handling materials, and the third is standing on the formwork. There are multiple stacks of plywood and wooden planks on the formwork.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，设有大量脚手架和模板。图片左侧的脚手架由金属管构成。右侧的模板由红色木板制成。从左到右，可见三名工人：一人在脚手架上行走，另一人弯腰，可能在搬运材料，第三人站在模板上。模板上有多个胶合板和木托盘。

text: In the foreground, there is one worker kneeling on the ground. Moving towards the center, there are eight workers standing, five of whom are wearing red hard hats and three with yellow hard hats. In the background, there are high-rise buildings.
zh: 前景中，有一名工人蹲坐在地上，正朝画面中心移动。朝画面中心方向，有八名工人站立，其中五名戴着红色安全帽，三名戴着黄色色安全帽。背景中，有高层建筑。

err.en: Moving towards the center, there are eig
err.zh: 正朝画面中心移动。朝画面中心方向，有八名工人站立

text: In the foreground, there is a bulldozer with its blade engaged in the soil. There are two individuals in the background: one standing to the left and another squatting to the right, both at a considerable distance from the bulldozer.
zh: 前景中，一台旋挖机正将刀片头切入土中。背景里有两个人：一人站在左侧，另一人蹲在右侧，两人均距离旋挖机较远。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is crouching and tying rebar at the edge of a formwork. Three workers with yellow hard hats are standing and working on the rebar framework, with one bending over the structure. The right of the image shows a stack of bamboo in the foreground and multiple metal tubes in the midground. Some rebars can be seen put against the concrete wall in the background.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正对着脚手架管边缘处哭泣，并系着脚手架。三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在脚手架框架上作业，其中一人弯身越过脚手架。画面右侧前景处可见一丛竹子，中景处可见多根金属管。背景中，一些钢筋可被放置在混凝土墙前。

err.en: crouching and tying rebar at the edge of
err.zh: 正对着脚手架管边缘处哭泣，并系着脚手架
可被放置在混凝土墙前

text: In the foreground, there is a car parked on the left, and a green dump truck is loaded with soil on the right. To the right of the dump truck, a worker is standing next to a bulldozer. Piles of orange pipes are behind the bulldozer. In the background, an excavator is operating on a raised area of dirt to the left. Buildings and vegetation are visible in the far background.
zh: 前景中，左侧停着一辆汽车，右侧有一辆绿色自卸卡车装载着泥土。自卸卡车右侧，一名工人站在一台铣刨机旁。铣刨机后方堆放着橙色管道。背景中，一台挖掘机正在左侧一处隆起的土堆上作业。远处背景中可见建筑物与植被。

text: The image shows a dirt road leading towards a construction area. An excavator is positioned to the right of a body of water, with its arm extended over a pile of dirt. A dump truck is facing away from the viewpoint, parked to the right of the excavator. Further to the right, a short concrete wall is visible, with some trees behind it. In the background, some high-rise buildings are visible.
zh: 一条土路通向施工区域。一台挖掘机位于一台水车的右侧，其臂架在一堆泥土上方。一辆自卸卡车背向视角，停放在挖掘机的右侧。再往右方，可见一堵短混凝土墙，其后方有一些树木。背景中，可见一些高层建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with reddish-brown soil and scattered construction materials. On the left, there is a worker wearing a white hard hat. In the center, an orange excavator is positioned to the right of the worker. In the foreground, there is an electric scooter and several rebar cages. In the background, there are multiple buildings under construction, covered with green safety netting, A yellow concrete mixer truck is in front of the white barrier that separates the construction site and the buildings. A yellow tower crane is visible on the left side. A van is to the right of the tower crane.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有红褐色土壤和散落的建筑材料。左侧有一名工人戴着白色安全帽。中间有一台橙色挖掘机位于工人右侧。前景有一辆电动滑板板和几个钢筋笼。背景有多栋在建建筑物，覆盖着绿色安全网，一辆黄色混凝土搅拌车位于白色屏障前，该屏障将施工场地与建筑物隔开。左侧可见一台黄色塔式起重机。一辆面包车位于塔式起重机右侧。
