text: The image shows three workers wearing red and yellow hard hats in discussion next to a large concrete pipe in the lower right corner of the image. The excavated trench runs from the lower right to the background. In the background, two more workers are outside the excavation. An excavator and a pile of concrete pipes are behind the workers.
zh: 三名头戴红黄安全帽的工人正在讨论，准备将一根大型混凝土管放入画面右下角部的。挖掘沟槽从右下角延伸至背景。背景中，另外两名工人在挖掘之外。一台挖掘机和一堆混凝土管位于工人身后。

err.en: in discussion next to a large concrete p
err.zh: 准备将一根大型混凝土管放入画面右下角部的

err.en: in the lower right corner of the image

text: The image shows a large stockpile of rebars on the left of the image. A mobile crane is in the middle, with a worker standing to its right. They are all on an elevated platform. On the ground level in the upper part of the image, two strips of green tarps are covering some vegetation.
zh: 图像左侧显示一大堆钢筋。一台移动式起重机位于画面中央，其右侧站着一名工人。他们全都位于一个高架平台上。在图像上部地面高度上，两条绿色草带覆盖着一些植被。

text: In the center of the image, there is a yellow bulldozer with tracks, positioned on muddy terrain. Surrounding the bulldozer, the ground is uneven with tracks and piles of dirt. The terrain is barren with some scattered debris and vegetation on the right side.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色色推土机，带有履带，停放在泥泞土地上。推土机周围，地面平坦，带有履带和土堆。地形荒芜凉，右侧有一些散落的碎屑和植被。

text: The image shows an excavator operating in the center with a pile of dirt inext to it, and a worker wearing a white hard hat is standing to the left of the excavator. A parked motorcycle is visible to the right. To the left, there are three rebar cages. A concrete mixer truck is positioned on an elevated dirt platform in the midground, and behind it, two large buildings are under construction, covered with green netting, and a tower crane is visible to the left of the buildings. A second tower crane is on the right.
zh: 画面中央有一台正在作业的中的挖掘机，其右侧有一堆泥土，挖掘机左侧站着一名头戴白色安全帽的工人。右侧可见一辆停放的摩托车。左侧有三间板房。一台混凝土搅拌车停放在中景的高土台上，其后方有两栋正在施工中的大型建筑，覆盖着绿色网布，建筑左侧可见一台塔式起重机。右侧有一台第二台塔式起重机。

err.zh: 一台第二台塔式起重机

text: The image shows a fenced area with several bundles of rebar, some covered with striped blue and white tarps. Within the fenced area, at least six workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests are engaged in various activities. A blue-colored shed is in the middle of the image. Two tower cranes are visible in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个围栏网区域，里面有几束钢筋，一些覆盖着条纹状的蓝色和白色塔普。在围栏网区域内，至少六名工人戴着黄色安全帽和高能见度背心，正从事各种活动。一件蓝色雨衣位于图像中央。背景中可见两座塔楼。

text: The image shows two workers wearing yellow hard hats squatting in front of a wall of rebars at a construction site. They are all wearing yellow hard hats, safety gloves, and long rubber boots. The workers are handling a metal tube together. Beneath them, a grid structure of rebars is laid on the ground.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正蹲在一处建筑工地的红砖墙前。他们全都戴着黄色安全帽、安全手套，并穿着长胶靴。工人们正一起搬运一根金属管。在他们脚下，地面上铺设着红砖结构。

text: The image shows an excavation area with standing water and muddy conditions. Two workers in orange attire are inside the pit, surrounded by vertical rebar structures. To the right, an excavator is operating near the edge of the excavation. In the background, there is a partially constructed building with one worker visible on the upper level. The perimeter of the excavation is lined with sheet piling, and the construction site has blue fences as barriers.
zh: 图像显示一个积水及泥泞地条件的下的开挖区域。两名身着橙色工作服的工人位于基坑内，被竖直钢筋结构所环绕。右侧，一台挖掘机正在开挖边缘附近作业。背景中，有一栋在建建筑，上层可见一名工人。开挖周边铺设着彩条布，且施工现场设有蓝色围栏作为屏障。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on the edge of a dirt excavation site with muddy water puddles nearby. Across the dirt road in the middle, there is a river running next to a farm field. In the distance, multiple buildings under construction are visible with several tower cranes erected around them.
zh: 一台挖掘机停靠在泥泞地开挖场的边缘，附近有浑浊的水坑。在中间的，有一条土路通向一片农田。在远处，多栋正在建设中的建筑可见，周围竖立着几座塔吊。

err.en: Across the dirt road in the middle, ther
err.zh: 在中间的，有一条土路通向一片农田。

text: The image shows a yellow road roller compacting material on the road surface on the left. A second road roller is visible in the background in the middle. Workers are gathered on the left. A dump truck has its dump box tilted on the right.
zh: 左侧路面上堆放着黄色路滚轮。背景中间可见第二个路滚轮。左侧聚集着工人。右侧有一辆自卸卡车，其卸料箱呈倾斜状态。

err.en: yellow road roller compacting material o
compacting material on the road surface

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and safety vest is squatting on the edge of a foundation, laying bricks to the wall. Moving to the right, two workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests are standing on a sandy area, one is handling a shovel. Behind them, there is a tall concrete retaining wall. To their left, a wheel barrel can be seen. To the right, a pile of bricks is partially covered by a red and blue striped tarp.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正蹲在基础边缘，向墙面砌砖。向右看，两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人站在沙地上，其中一人手持铁锹。在他们身后，有一堵高大的混凝土挡土墙。在他们左侧，可见一个轮轴。向右看，一堆砖被红蓝条纹防水布部分遮盖。

text: In the foreground, a concrete mixer truck is connected to a concrete pump with an extended boom, pouring concrete onto a large, square foundation area with multiple sections. Four workers are visible on the foundation, spreading and smoothing the concrete. An excavator is near the concrete truck. In the background, there is another excavator visible, as well as a forest. On the left of the background, there is a converter station surrounded by transmission towers.
zh: 前景中，一辆混凝土搅拌车通过一根延伸的管道向一台混凝土泵输送混凝土，将混凝土浇筑到一块大型方形基础区域，该区域被划分为多个部分。四名工人在基础上可见，正在摊铺平并抹平混凝土。一台挖掘机位于混凝土搅拌车附近。背景中，还有另一台挖掘机可见，以及一片树林。在背景的左侧，有一座换电站站，周围环绕着输电塔。

err.en: concrete mixer truck is connected to a c
err.zh: 混凝土搅拌车通过一根延伸的管道向一台混凝土泵输送混凝土

text: The image shows a yellow KATO excavator in the foreground, with a worker with a white hard hat standing to the left. In the background, another blue KOBELCO excavator is visible, with a third red excavator partially visible to the right.
zh: 前景中有一台黄色的卡特挖掘机，其左侧站着一名戴白色安全帽的工人。背景中可见另一台蓝色的科贝尔挖掘机，右侧还有一台红色挖掘机部分可见。

text: The worker on the left is in the blind spot of the excavator.
zh: 左侧的工人处于挖掘机的器的盲区。

text: The image shows an orange excavator with its arm extended and a bucket unloading soil. The background features a slope with a smooth surface with vegetation on top of it.
zh: 图中展示了一台橙色挖掘机，其机械臂已伸出，铲斗内装满了泥土。背景中可见一处斜坡，坡面较为平滑，顶部生长着植被。

text: The image shows three workers wearing yellow hard hats and yellow safety vests, handling rebars. A rebar cutting machine is situated to the right, with additional seven bundles of rebars on the ground to the left. A yellow tower crane is visible in the background, and behind the workers, there are yellow barriers and a blue structure.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人，手持钢筋。一台钢筋切断机位于右侧，地面上左侧另有七根钢筋。背景中可见一台黄色塔吊，工人身后有黄色护栏和蓝色结构。

zh: 画面显示的是从车辆内部视角拍摄的施工现场场景，前景中可见仪表盘。正前方有一辆混凝土搅拌运输车停放在铺装路面上，其搅拌筒和料斗清晰可见。周围区域似乎处于开发阶段，路面两侧均无植被，仅露出泥土。画面左侧有一处水体。

text: The image shows multiple workers engaged in various activities at a construction site with rugged terrain. Starting from the left, a worker is sitting on a pile of rocks, while below him, six workers are handling two wheelbarrows on a scaffolding structure with planks as the floor. Below the bridge, there are large rocks and two workers on top of the large, fractured rocks. Trees are visible in the background.
zh: 画面显示，在崎岖地形的建筑工地上，有多名工人正从事各种活动。从左侧开始，一名工人坐在一堆岩石上，在他下方，六名工人正在脚手架上处理两根轮状横条，地板为木板。在桥下方，有巨大的岩石和两名工人位于巨大、破裂开的岩石的顶部。树木在背景中可见。

text: The image shows a yellow mobile crane with a red telescopic boom in the middle.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色移动式起重机，中部带红色望远镜式吊钩。

text: In the foreground, there is a construction site with scattered metal tubes and a water body on the left. A concrete pump truck with an extended boom is positioned in the center. To the right, three workers wearing yellow hard hats are near the formwork for a concrete structure for the concrete pour. The formwork consist of red metal panels reinforced by metal poles.
zh: 前景中有一处施工现场，散落着金属管，左侧有一具水。一辆混凝土泵车位于中央，带有一个延伸的boom。右侧，三名工人戴着黄色硬帽，靠近为混凝土浇筑的formwork。formwork由红色金属板通过金属极强化。

text: The right edge of the excavation is not fenced nor warned.
zh: 开挖右侧边坡未设挡土墙，亦未设置警示标志。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete slab, numerous vertical rebar installations, and metal pole scaffolding. Several piles of wooden planks, rebar bundles, and metal poles of different colors are scattered across the site. Multiple workers are visible, engaged in various construction activities.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一块大型混凝土板、大量垂直钢筋安装、金属极脚手架。多堆不同颜色的木托盘、钢筋束和金属极，散落在工地各处。多名工人可见，正从事各种施工活动。

text: In the foreground, five individuals are standing on a dirt road, three of whom are wearing hard hats. To the right, an excavator is positioned in a trench, with its bucket raised above the ground. Behind the group, another excavator is visible near a tree line.
zh: 前景中，五个人站在土路上，其中三人戴着安全帽。右侧，一台挖掘机位于沟槽内，其斗笠悬于地面之上。人群后方，另一台挖掘机在一条树线附近可见。

text: The image shows a large pile of reddish-brown earth. A green dump truck fully loaded with soil is positioned to the left of a yellow bulldozer actively moving soil. In the midground, various construction materials, such as concrete pipes and orange pipes, are scattered across the site. Two more bulldozers are also visible on the right. In the background, multiple tower cranes and mobile cranes are visible. A line of yellow trees and at least four more tower cranes are visible in the farther background.
zh: 画面中有一大堆红褐色泥土。一辆满载土的方的货卡车停在正在作业的黄色推土机的左侧。地面上散落着各种建筑材料，如混凝土管和橙色管。右侧还能看到另外两台推土机。背景中可见多台塔吊和移动吊机。远处背景里有一排黄树和至少四台塔吊。

err.zh: 一辆满载土的方的货卡车

text: A worker on the left is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 左侧的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: In the image, four workers with red hard hats are present in an indoor construction setting, spreading out an insulation material on the floor. The left worker is unrolling the material, the three other workers are spreading the adhesive on the ground.
zh: 画面中，四名头戴红色安全帽的工人身处室内施工环境，正在地面上铺展保温材料。左侧的工人正在卷起材料，另外三名工人正在地面上涂抹布胶水。

text: In the foreground, there is a large area covered with brown rebars laid out in a grid pattern. Moving towards the background, more than ten workers wearing yellow and red hard hats are engaged in various activities across the site, with some bending over the rebars while others are walking or standing. There are wooden planks and construction materials scattered around the site.
zh: 前景中，有一大片用棕色护栏围成的较大区域，呈网格状排列。背景中，有十余名头戴黄色红安全帽的工人正在现场各处从事各项作业，其中部分人正翻越护栏，另一些人则在行走或站立。现场周围散落着木质托盘架及建筑材料。

text: In the foreground, three workers wearing yellow hard hats are standing on a network of rebar that covers the ground on the left. There is a large pile of rebars next to them. In the middle, another worker in a yellow hard hat is bending over the rebar. Behind this worker, there is a concrete structure with vertical metal rods as scaffolding. A stack of wooden planks is near the rebar framework.
zh: 前景中，三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在左侧覆盖地面的的一张钢筋网上。他们旁边有一大堆钢筋。中间，另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正弯身跨过钢筋。在这名工人身后，有一混凝土结构，带有竖直金属杆作为脚手架。钢筋框架附近有一堆木托盘。

text: The image shows a concrete mixer truck with the brand "SANY" positioned on the left, with its drum facing a concrete pump. One worker is standing next to the pump. A tower crane is visible in the background with a light next to it.
zh: 画面中是一辆混凝土搅拌车，品牌标识“Sany”位于车辆左侧，其搅拌鼓正对着一台混凝土泵。一名工人站在泵的旁边。背景中可见一台塔式起重机，位于其旁边。

err.en: with a light next to it

text: The image shows three workers wearing hard hats inside a building with a steel structure. One worker is standing on a ladder and working on a column, while the other two are standing on the ground, holding the ladder. The interior has unfinished floors and exposed steel beams, with natural light coming in from the windows.
zh: 图像显示三名头戴安全帽的工人在一栋钢结构建筑内部。一名工人站在梯子上，正在一根立柱上作业，另外两名工人站在地面上，扶着梯子。室内有完工的地面和外露出的钢梁，自然光从窗户照进来。

text: The image shows a group of eight individuals gathered, most wearing hard hats in various colors, with one person in a white hard hat gesturing as if explaining or directing. In the background, there is a large mound of earth and some construction debris. An electric scooter can be seen in the foreground.
zh: 图中显示八个人聚在一起，大多数人戴着各种颜色的安全帽，其中一人戴着白色安全帽，神情严肃，仿佛在解释或指挥。背景中有一个巨大的土堆和一些建筑废料。前景中可以看到一辆电动滑板车。

err.en: gesturing as if explaining or directing
err.zh: 神情严肃，仿佛在解释或指挥

text: The image shows a construction site with several vertical scaffolding covered with green safety netting. Multiple stacks of construction materials, including wood planks and metal tubes, are organized throughout the site. There are at least five workers visible. The background features several stacks of white construction material piled on the other side of a road. There is a white SUV on parked on the road.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，多处竖立的脚手架上覆盖着绿色安全防护网。工地各处堆放着多堆建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属管。可见至少五名工人。背景中，道路另一侧堆放着几堆白色建筑材料。道路上停着一辆白色SUV。

text: In the foreground, there is an excavator positioned on a mound of earth, with its arm extended towards the right. To the right of the excavator, there are various pieces of equipment, including a drill bit and two pile drivers, scattered on the ground. In the background, a worker wearing a red shirt is standing near a stack of black pipes. The pipes are in front of another pile driver.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其臂向右伸出。在挖掘机的右侧，地面上散落着各种设备，包括一根钻杆和两根桩。背景中，一名身穿红色上衣的工人站在一堆黑色管道旁。这些管道位于另一堆桩的前。

text: In the foreground, there is a road under construction with white tarps laid out in sections across the surface. A blue water truck is positioned on the road towards the left of the image. Large mounds of earth are visible on both sides of the road, with the larger piles on the right.
zh: 前景中，有一条正在施工的道路，路面上铺设着白色碎石。一辆蓝色水车停在画面左侧的道路上。道路两侧可见大堆土，右侧土堆更大。

text: The image shows more than ten workers wearing hard hats, with one in camouflage in the foreground adjusting scaffolding while others are observing or walking across the site. An excavator is positioned in the midground, working among large rock debris. The background features a rocky mountain slope.
zh: 画面中显示有十余名头戴安全帽的工人，其中一人位于前景，身着迷彩服正在调整脚手架，其余人则在工地现场走动或观察。一台挖掘机位于地面中部，正在大型岩石碎屑中作业。背景为一处岩石山坡坡。

text: The image shows an elevated scissor lift with two workers inside the basket, positioned near the ceiling of a large industrial building. On the ground, there are two motorcycles parked on the left. The floor is scattered with various debris and construction materials.
zh: 图中显示一台高架式施工升降机，吊篮内有两名为工人的的人员，位于一栋大型工业建筑顶部附近。地面上，左侧停放着两辆摩托车。地面散落着各种碎屑和建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with a tarp with red and blue strips. On the right, there is a stack of wooden boards with a stainless steel bottle on top of it. Two gas cylinders are in front of the wooden boards. Four workers wearing yellow hard hats are engaged in various activities: one is pushing a wheelbarrow, three are working with shovels.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，搭设着红蓝相的脚手架。右侧有一摞木板，上面放着一个不锈钢瓶。木板前面有两个气缸。四名戴着黄色安全帽的工人正在从事各种活动：其中一人正在推着一个轮轴，另外三人正在使用扳手作业。

text: The image shows three workers wearing red or yellow hard hats inspecting or working on two large pipes. The ground is uneven and consists of dirt and rocks.
zh: 画面显示三名头戴红色或黄色安全帽的工人，正在检查或操作两根大型管道。地面平整，由泥土和岩石构成。

text: The image shows two workers with hard hats at a construction site. On the left, a worker is operating a handheld device. On the right, another worker is kneeling and using a hammer on the ground. Behind them, there is a pile of large rectangular blocks. The ground is uneven with visible rocks and soil.
zh: 图像显示两名头戴安全帽的建筑工人在施工现场。左侧一名工人正在操作一台手持设备。右侧另一名工人跪在地上，使用一把锤子。在他们身后，有一堆大型矩形砌块。地面平整，可见岩石和泥土。

text: The worker in a brown shirt and a red hard hat stands in the foreground and observes the site. To the left, another worker in blue hard hat operates an excavator with its bucket in contact with a rusted metal container. A yellow dump truck is positioned in the center, with its bed raised. Behind the truck, a large pile of rocks is visible. To the right, a red mobile crane, a white truck, and piles of different construction materials are visible.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿棕色衬衫、头戴红色安全帽的工人站在现场进行观察。左侧，另一名头戴蓝色安全帽的工人正在操作一台挖掘机，其铲斗与一个锈迹斑斑的金属容器接触接。画面中央，一辆黄色色泵车停放着，其车斗被抬起。卡车后方，可见一大堆岩石。右侧，可见一台红色移动式起重机、一辆白色卡车以及不同建筑材料的堆。

err.en: in contact with a rusted metal container

text: In the foreground, there is a large area of rebars laid out on the ground, with several workers dispersed across the site, some bending over the rebar and others walking or standing. Moving towards the background, there is an extensive scaffolding structure with more workers visible on various levels. Two yellow tower cranes rise above the site, and there are multiple stockpiles of construction materials, such as wooden planks and additional rebar bundles.
zh: 前景中，地面上铺设着大片大型钢筋，几名工人分散在场地各处，有的弯身跨过钢筋，有的则行走或站立着，朝背景方向移动。背景里，有一处规模庞大的、层级复杂的的多层的脚手架，更多工人可见于不同高度。两栋黄色塔吊机矗立在场地上方，并且有多堆建筑材料，诸如木方木和额外的钢筋束。

err.zh: 规模庞大的、层级复杂的的多层的脚手架

text: The image shows multiple stacks of metal panels, with scattered debris around them. A yellow wheel loader is positioned in the center, with its bucket raised. To the right, a red dump truck is visible. In the background, there are temporary blue construction site offices and an electrical pylon. Trees and a clear sky can be seen in the distance.
zh: 画面中可见多堆金属板材，周围散落着碎屑。一台黄色轮式装载机位于画面中央，其料斗处于升起状态。右侧可见一辆红色泵车。背景中有一座临时蓝色施工场地办公室和一座电力围栏。远处可见树木和晴朗的天空。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers wearing seven red overalls and yellow hard hats. A blue truck carrying rebars is parked carrying rebars. The blue truck also has a red mobile crane mounted. One pile of rebar is on both sides of the blue truck, and a worker interacts with the truck's cargo area. A yellow excavator is visible in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，几名工人戴着红色安全帽和黄色安全帽。一辆蓝色卡车装载着钢筋停放在旁边。蓝色卡车上还装着一台红色移动起重机。一堆钢筋放在蓝色卡车的两侧，一名工人与卡车的货物区域互动。背景中可见一台黄色挖掘机。

err.en: seven red overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 红色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: The image shows a construction site with a large green tarp covering the ground. Starting from the left, there are two workers operating an rebar machine. Moving to the right, three workers with yellow hard hats are engaged in activities related to rebar handling and preparation. There are seven bundles of rebars both on and adjacent to the tarp area. In the upper part of the image, there is a stack of wooden sheets and a stack of wooden boards.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，地面覆盖着大面积的绿色防护布。从左侧开始，有两名工人正在操作一台钢筋机械。向右移动，有三名戴着黄色安全帽的工人正从事与钢筋加工及准备相关的的工作。在防护布区域及其相邻位置，共有七根钢筋。在画面上部，有一摞木板以及一摞木模板。

text: The image shows a large stockpile of various lengths of metal poles lying horizontally on the ground. A tower crane is positioned in the center of the image, with its jib extending horizontally across the frame.
zh: 地面上横放着一大堆长短不一的金属极。一台塔式起重机位于画面中央，其吊臂横向横跨整个画面。

text: In the foreground, a yellow and red mobile crane is positioned with its boom extended towards the right side of the image. The crane's hook is hanging down. Behind the crane, there is a white pickup truck parked.
zh: 前景中，一台黄红相的吊车位于画面右侧，吊钩向下垂挂。吊车后方停着一辆白色皮卡卡车。

err.en: with its boom extended towards the right

text: In the foreground, a blue barrier surrounds a stockpile of construction materials. Beyond the barrier, six workers are visible, with some on the ground and others on a red trailer truck. Construction vehicles, such as excavators and dump trucks, are scattered across the site in the background.
zh: 前景中，一道蓝色围挡围绕着一堆建筑材料。在围挡外，可以看到六名工人，其中一些在地面上，另一些则在一辆红色拖车上。施工车辆，如挖掘机和泵车，散布在背景中的整个工地上。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area covered with rusted steel rebars laid out in a grid pattern. Eight workers wearing yellow hard hats are visible, working together or standing in the background. Various construction materials, including two stacks of rectangular rebars are on the right, two stacks of wooden planks are in the middle, and two stacks of wooden sheets are on the left.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大面积区域铺设有锈迹斑斑的钢条，以网格状排列。可见八名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，他们或一起工作，或站在背景中。各种建筑材料，包括右侧两堆矩形条，中间两堆木托盘，以及左侧两堆木片。

text: The image shows four workers at a construction site with a retaining wall in the background. The workers are standing in a foundation, handling red metal panels, metal poles, and rebars. The worker in the middle on top of the formwork is guiding a concrete hose hanging from above.
zh: 图中显示，在带有挡土墙的施工场地的四个工人。工人站在基础中，处理红色金属板、金属极和重条。中间的工人在顶部上的形式工作指导混凝土管悬挂在上方。

err.en: on top of the formwork is guiding a conc
err.zh: 在顶部上的形式工作指导混凝土管悬挂在上方

text: The image shows an orange excavator on the left with an operator inside, positioned next to a vertical concrete wall. In the center, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and blue safety vest is holding a shovel on the muddy ground. The ground appears uneven with rocks and soil, and the background shows a steep excavation site with exposed earth and retaining structures.
zh: 画面左侧是一台橙色挖掘机，机内有一名操作人员，其右侧紧邻一道垂直混凝土墙。画面中央，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿蓝色安全背心的的工人，正手持铁锹，站在泥泞地上。地面看起来较为平整，夹杂着岩石与泥土，背景则呈现一处陡峭的开挖场地，露出泥土体与保留结构。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow bulldozer, with its tracks covered in mud. The background features mounds of reddish-brown earth. The background shows some trees.
zh: 前景中有一台黄色推土机，其履带被泥浆覆盖。背景中可见红褐色泥土的声响。背景中有一些树木。

text: The image shows a large pile of red soil with a yellow soil compactor on the right and a bulldozer on the left, both facing towards the center of the image. Behind these machines, there is a construction site with an unfinished concrete structure enclosed by scaffolding and green safety netting. A tower crane is visible in the background, in the middle.
zh: 画面中有一大堆红土，右侧有一台黄色土施工机械，左侧有一台推土机，两者均朝向画面中心。在这些机械后方，是一处建筑工地，有已完工的结构，被脚手架和绿色安全网围住。背景中，中间可见一台塔式起重机。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow soil compactor with a single drum roller.
zh: 前景中，有一名身着黄色土作业服的工人，正操作着一台单鼓式压路机。

err.en: a yellow soil compactor with a single dr
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土作业服的工人，正操作着一台单鼓式压路机

text: The image shows two workers engaged in construction activities near a concrete formwork. On the left, a worker with a yellow hard hat is handling a hose. On the right, another worker is using a shovel, standing on top of two wooden plants above the pool of fresh concrete. The formwork is made of wooden planks with metal tubes laying on top.
zh: 画面显示两名工人正在混凝土模板附近从事施工作业。左侧一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正握持一根软管。右侧另一名工人手持铁锹，站立于两株木质植物之上，其下为新鲜混凝土池。模板由木质框架构成，金属管置于其顶部。

text: The image shows two workers engaged in construction activities within a framework of metal scaffolding. One worker is reaching for a shovel while the other worker is actively adjusting or manipulating the metal tube structure. The ground is uneven and covered with wet concrete. Some wooden planks and metal tubes are visible on the left.
zh: 画面显示两名工人在金属脚手架框架内从事施工作业。一名工人正伸手去拿一把铁锹，另一名工人正在调整或操作金属管。地面平整，覆盖着湿混凝土。左侧可见一些木垫板和金属管。

text: The image shows an excavated area with a slope leading down to a lower level where construction activity is taking place. A single orange excavator is positioned near the slope. On the lower level, there are several workers scattered across the site, with one concrete mixer truck and a yellow excavator on the left. In the background, there is a retaining wall and above it, a row of blue construction site offices with white facades.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖区域，其边坡坡向下延伸至较低标高高处，该处正在进行施工作业。一台橙色挖掘机停靠在边坡坡附近。在较低标处，有多名工人分散在场地各处，其中有一辆混凝土搅拌车以及一台黄色挖掘机位于左侧。在背景中，有一道挡土墙，其上方是一排蓝色施工办公用房，带有白色立面。

err.en: leading down to a lower level
err.zh: 坡向下延伸至较低标高高处

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road with tire tracks. To the left, a wheeled loader is visible. Along the right side, a concrete wall with blue fences at its base stretches into the distance. Street lamps line the top of this wall.
zh: 前景中有一条带轮胎印痕的土路。左侧可见一辆轮式装载机。右侧沿一道混凝土墙，其底部延伸着蓝色围栏，向远处延伸。路灯线沿着这面墙的体的顶部。

err.en: Street lamps line the top of this wall.
err.zh: 路灯线沿着这面墙的体的顶部。

text: In the foreground, there are multiple steel rebars laid out, and four workers wearing yellow hard hats and green jackets are working among them. In the background, a high concrete retaining wall is visible. A red excavator is at the bottom of the retaining wall, while three concrete mixer trucks are on top of the retaining wall. A large mound of soil covered with green tarps is behind the mixer trucks. Farther in the background, multiple skyscrapers are visible.
zh: 前景中，有多根钢筋平铺开来，四名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿绿色工作服的工人正在其中作业。背景中，可见一道高耸的混凝土挡土墙。一台红色挖掘机位于挡土墙底部，同时三辆混凝土搅拌车停在挡土墙顶部。搅拌车后方有一大堆覆盖着绿色植被的土堆。更远处背景中，可见多栋高楼。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and dark clothing is standing in front of a yellow excavator in the center. The excavator is positioned on a mound of broken bricks and debris. The background features a terraced landscape with fencing and vegetation. Power pylons are also visible running along the terrace.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿深色衣物的工人站在画面中央一台黄色挖掘机的前。该挖掘机停在一堆碎砖与瓦砾堆上。背景为带围栏网与植被的梯田景观。电力围栏网也沿梯田可见。

text: The image shows multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including blue and red scaffolding components, rebars, and wooden planks. In the lower part of the image, there is a concrete platform with two buildings under construction and three stacks of rebars on the ground. Both buildings are covered with scaffolding and enclosed by blue metal fences.
zh: 图中展示了多堆建筑材料，包括蓝色和红色的脚手架组件、钢筋以及木托盘。在图像的下部，有一个混凝土平台，其下方有两栋在建建筑，地面上有三堆钢筋。两栋建筑均被脚手架覆盖，并由蓝色金属围栏围住。

err.en: there is a concrete platform with two bu
err.zh: 有一个混凝土平台，其下方有两栋在建建筑

text: The image shows two workers handling rebars on a concrete surface with a large grid of rebar laid out next to them. Three other workers are bending over the rebar grid to the right. Metal formwork reinforced by vertical metal poles is visible. The background shows a row of sheet piles and a concrete retaining wall. Some trees and blue fences are visible on the retaining wall.
zh: 画面显示两名工人正在混凝土表面上处理钢筋，旁边铺设着大片大型钢筋网格。另外三名工人正将钢筋网格弯折至右侧。由竖向金属构件加固而成的钢筋形态清晰可见。背景中可见一排钢板桩以及一道混凝土挡土墙。挡土墙上可见一些树木和蓝色围栏。

err.en: bending over the rebar grid to the right
err.zh: 将钢筋网格弯折至右侧

err.en: Metal formwork reinforced by vertical me
err.zh: 由竖向金属构件加固而成的钢筋形态

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat on the left. In the middle, two blue excavators are loading two dump trucks with brown soil.
zh: 图片显示一名工人在左侧戴着一顶黄色安全帽。在中间，两名蓝色挖掘机正在装载两辆带有棕色泥土的自卸卡车。

err.zh: 两辆带有棕色泥土的自卸卡车

text: In the foreground, a yellow Komatsu excavator is positioned in the middle, with its bucket resting on the ground. Broken bricks and debris are next to the excavator. The background shows a construction site with five tower cranes. In the left of the background, two concrete buildings under construction are visible, they are covered with green safety nettings.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色小松挖掘机位于画面中央，其料斗停放在地面上。破碎的砖块和碎屑位于挖掘机的前方。背景显示一个建筑工地，配有五座塔式起重机。在背景的左侧，两栋正在施工中的混凝土建筑清晰可见，它们覆盖着绿色安全网。

text: The image shows around ten workers engaged in activities on a dense grid of rebar, with some bending over and others sitting or kneeling as they work. All workers are wearing hard hats in various colors, predominantly yellow, and high-visibility vests. In the background, there is a concrete structure with more rebar protruding vertically.
zh: 画面显示，大约十名工人正在密集的钢筋网格上从事作业，部分钢筋弯曲悬挑，其余的则坐着或跪着进行工作。所有工人都戴着颜色各异的、以黄色为主的高可视度安全帽，并穿着高可视度背心。背景中，有一处混凝土构造，更多钢筋垂直突出。

err.en: with some bending over and others sittin
err.zh: 部分钢筋弯曲悬挑，其余的则坐着或跪着进行工作

text: In the foreground, there is a wet construction site with puddles of water and scattered construction materials. Threre are three huge piles or rebars of different shapes on the ground. Two workers wearing hard hats are present on the left; one is squatting on the ground while the other is hidden near some stacked rebars. A blue shed is visible on the right.
zh: 前景中有一处湿施工场地，地面有积水坑洼和散落的着的建筑材料。地面上有三堆形状各异的大型钢筋堆。左侧有两名头戴安全帽的工人；其中一人蹲在地上，另一人隐藏在部分堆叠的钢筋附近。右侧可见一件蓝色外套。

err.en: A blue shed is visible on the right.
err.zh: 右侧可见一件蓝色外套。

text: The image shows a large mobile crane with a red boom extended horizontally, mounted on a yellow multi-axle truck chassis. In the background, a viaduct with two traffic lights showing red light is visible.
zh: 图中展示了一台大型移动式起重机，其红色吊臂水平伸出，安装在黄色多轴卡车底盘架上。背景中，一个十字路口路口的处可见两盏交通信号灯显示为红灯。

text: The image shows two pile drivers with their boom extended vertically on the right. To the left, there are two mobile cranes visible. In the distance, there is a row of tower cranes spanning from the left to the right.
zh: 画面右侧，两堆轮胎垂直堆叠。左侧，可见两条移动轮胎。远处，有一排塔式起重机轮胎，横跨左右。

err.en: two pile drivers with their boom extende

text: The image shows seven workers wearing orange safety vests and yellow hard hats engaged in various activities around an excavation site. In the lower part, a pile of wooden sheets, a pile of metal poles, and a pile of rubbles are visible. The structure under construction consists of a rebar framework structure in the middle. To the left, the excavation slope is covered with red and blue tarps with a row of blue metal fences. On the right, there is a blue truck with a crane mounted on it.
zh: 画面显示七名身穿橙色安全背心、头戴黄色安全帽的工人，正在一处开挖现场周围从事各种作业。在画面下方，可见一堆木质板材、一堆金属杆以及一堆砖块。施工结构位于画面中部。在左侧，开挖坡面覆盖着红色与蓝色防水布，并排列着一排蓝色金属围栏。在右侧，有一辆蓝色卡车，其上装有一台起重机。

err.zh: 施工结构位于画面中部。

text: The worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a high-visibility vest is sweeping a recently wet concrete surface. Four visible bundles of rebars are neatly stacked alongside the concrete area. On the right, a worker with a yellow hard hat is kneeling in a rebar grid structure lying on a concrete foundation. Another worker with a white hard hat is walking on the dirt surface with broken bricks.
zh: 头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人正在清扫一片近期湿润的混凝土表面。四根可见钢筋整齐地码放在混凝土区域旁。右侧，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在一根钢筋网格上，该网格位于混凝土基础上。另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人正行走在一片带有破碎砖块的的地面上。

text: The image shows three yellow or orange excavators moving earth and loading five dump trucks next to a pile of dirt. In the upper left, a worker is visible. Three of the dump trucks are in the middle. To the left, a dump truck fully loaded is driving along the road.
zh: 画面显示三台黄色或橙色挖掘机正在将泥土装载到五辆自卸卡车中，随后倾倒在一堆泥土上。在左上方，一名工人可见。三台自卸卡车位于中间。在左侧，一台满载的自卸卡车正沿着道路行驶。

err.en: moving earth and loading five dump truck
err.zh: 正在将泥土装载到五辆自卸卡车中，随后倾倒在一堆泥土上

text: The worker on the left is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 左侧的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: In the center of the image, a bulldozer is actively engaged in earthmoving activities, creating a path through a dirt area. The surrounding ground is uneven and consists of various soil types. Some debris of trees are visible in the lower left.
zh: 画面中央，一台推土机正在进行进行土方作业，在泥地中开辟出一条通道。周围地面平整，由多种土壤类型构成。左下方可见一些树木的残枝。

text: In the image, seven workers are wearing blue uniforms and yellow hard hats, standing among large gray rocks. The ground is uneven and covered with rocks of various sizes, and a concrete wall is visible in the background.
zh: 图中，七名工人身穿蓝色制服，头戴黄色安全帽，站在巨大的灰色岩石之间。地面平坦，覆盖着各种大小的不一的岩石，背景中可见一堵混凝土墙。

err.zh: 各种大小的不一的岩石

text: The edge of the embankment on the left is not guarded.
zh: 左侧的嵌入边缘未设防护。

text: The image shows a concrete surface with various steel rebars protruding and bent at different angles. Six workers wearing hard hats and safety vests are standing on the concrete surface. The background features bare earth covered with green tarps.
zh: 图像显示一片混凝土表面，上面伸出多根钢筋，且弯曲的角度各不相同。六名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人站在混凝土表面上。背景中可见裸露的泥土被绿色植被所覆盖。

text: In the foreground, two green dump trucks are positioned side by side with their beds tilted upwards, unloading soil onto the ground. In the background, construction materials, including large pipes, are scattered across the site, and construction machinery, including a blue and white water truck and a red excavator, are partially visible.
zh: 前景中，两辆绿色自卸车并排停放，车斗向上倾斜，将未装载的泥土倾倒在路面上。背景中，建筑材料，包括大型管道，散落在工地各处，施工机械，包括一辆蓝白相间的水罐车和一台红色挖掘机，部分可见。

err.zh: 将未装载的泥土倾倒在路面上

text: The image shows a large excavation area with uneven terrain and scattered debris. An individual is walking across the site on the right. A teal excavator is stationed with its arms extended in the middle. The background shows a flat expanse with some vegetation and power lines stretching across the horizon.
zh: 图像显示一片大型开挖区域，地形平坦，散落着碎石。一个人正从场地右侧走过。一台青绿色挖掘机停放在中间，其臂架向外延伸。背景呈现一片平坦的开阔地带，长着一些植被，一条电力线横贯地平线。

text: In the foreground, there is an excavator bucket positioned above a dug-up area. The arm of the excavator extends towards the top right corner of the image, where part of the excavator body is visible. The surrounding ground appears muddy and uneven.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机位于一处挖掘区域上方。挖掘机的臂伸向画面右上角，部分机身可见。周围地面显得泥泞且凹凸不平。

text: The image shows two workers wearing green overalls and red hard hats inside a structure with dense scaffolding. The two workers are facing red surfaces in the background.
zh: 图像显示两名工人身处密集的脚手架结构内部，他们戴着绿色眼罩和红色安全帽，面向红色表面。

text: The image shows four workers engaged in welding activities on a rebar framework in the foreground, with two workers kneeling and other two standing beside them. In the midground, a worker is shoveling earth on the left. An excavator is positioned in the background on the left, with its arm extended to the left. The construction site is characterized by exposed earth and partially constructed rebar frameworks.
zh: 前景中，四名工人正在钢筋框架上进行焊接作业，其中两人跪着，另外两人站在他们旁边。中景处，一名工人正在左侧进行土方方作业。一台挖掘机位于背景左侧，其臂向左延伸。该建筑工地的特征为裸露的土和部分建成的钢筋框架。

text: In the foreground, there is a blue corrugated metal roof visible. Beyond it, a large construction site unfolds with numerous workers scattered throughout, many of whom are wearing yellow hard hats and are engaged in various activities. In the middle ground, there is an excavator operating next to a pile of wooden sheets, and several workers are handling rebar frameworks on what appears to be a foundation or floor structure. On the left side of the background, three excavators are visible near a stack of pre-cast concrete blocks. On the right of the background, more than five tower cranes are visible.
zh: 前景中，可见一座蓝色波纹状金属屋顶。其后方，一处大型建筑工地展开，众多工人散布其间，其中许多人头戴黄色安全帽，正从事各种作业。中景处，一台挖掘机正驶向一堆木板，另有几名工人正在处理钢筋框架，似用于基础或楼板结构。背景左侧，三台挖掘机可见，靠近一堆预制混凝土砌块。背景右侧，可见五台以上塔式起重机。

err.en: operating next to a pile of wooden sheet

text: The image shows five workers wearing red uniforms and yellow hard hats on the concrete platform with some water on the ground. A partially constructed building with scaffolding is visible. The scaffolding is covered with blue metal fences. IN the upper left, there are several piles of red scaffolding components along with trees and a water body.
zh: 画面显示五名工人身穿红色制服，头戴黄色安全帽，站在混凝土平台上，地上有些水。一栋部分建成的建筑可见，带有脚手架。脚手架被蓝色金属围栏覆盖。在左上角，有一些红色脚手架部件，沿着树和身体水。

err.en: along with trees and a water body

text: The image shows a concrete pump truck with an extended boom pouring concrete into a designated area. A white concrete mixer truck is next to the pump truck. In the background, multiple buildings under construction are surrounded by scaffoldeding and green safety netting, with three tower cranes visible above them.
zh: 图中显示一辆混凝土泵车，正将混凝土泵送并浇筑到指定区域。一辆白色混凝土搅拌车紧随在泵车之后。在背景中，多栋正在施工的建筑被脚手架和绿色安全防护网包围，其上方可见三座塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a focus on a large area of rebar gridwork on the floor, which is partially covered with black surfaces. In the upper part of the image, from left to right, there are six workers visible. In the lower part of the image, there are four piles of rebars and two piles of wooden planks.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，重点在于大面积钢筋网格作业，地面部分被黑色表面覆盖。在图像的上部，从左到右，可以看到六名工人。在图像的下部，有四堆钢筋和两堆木托盘。

text: The image shows two workers wearing yellow hard hats and grey jackets walking on a construction site with their backs to the camera. Behind them, there is a large gabion wall next to a concrete wall.
zh: 画面中，两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿灰色工作服的工人正背对镜头行走在建筑工地上。在他们身后，是一堵大型石膏墙，紧挨着一堵混凝土墙。

text: In the foreground, a yellow wheel loader is actively engaged in moving earth, positioned in the center of the image. In front of the loader, there are two piles of structural steel components. Behind the loader, there are large mounds of excavated soil and a utility pole.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色轮式装载机正积极地进行土方作业，位于画面中央。装载机前方有两堆结构钢构件。装载机后方有大片开挖土方方以及一台电力设备。

text: The image shows large stacks of black sheets on the right and various construction materials, including wooden planks and metal rods, on the left. One worker is walking on the left, and the other is engaged in an activity near the construction materials. In the background, there is a concrete structure with openings in the middle. Yellow scaffolding is visible on the right side.
zh: 画面右侧堆放着成摞的黑色板材，左侧则摆放着各类建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属杆。一名工人正走在左侧，另一名工人则在靠近建筑材料处从事某项作业。背景中可见一处带有开口的的水泥构造物。右侧一侧显露着黄色脚手架。

text: In the foreground, a wheel loader is visible, along with a pile of rubbles to the left and three corrugated pipes on the right. In the middle, a worker is standing next to a yellow excavator that is operating while another excavator and a drum roller are next to it. In the background, multiple high-rise buildings are visible, and the sky is hazy.
zh: 前景中可见一台轮式装载机，其左侧有一堆路牙，右侧有三根波纹管。中部有一名工人正站在一台黄色挖掘机旁，另一台挖掘机和一台鼓式压路机紧随其后。背景中可见多栋高层建筑，天空朦胧。

text: The image shows a road roller compacting the soil in the center. A worker wearing a white hard hat is standing on the left. On the right, a pile of sand and a pile of orange pipes are visible. Moreover, there is a trailer truck covered with a green tarp. A bulldozer and a worker are on two sides of the truck. The background features multiple buildings under construction. The left one has a white facade and is covered with scaffolding. The middle ones are covered with scaffolding and green safety netting. The jib of a tower crane is visible.
zh: 图中显示一台道路压路机正在压实中央的土壤。左侧站着一名戴着白色安全帽的工人。右侧可见一堆沙子和一堆橙色管道。此外，有一辆拖车卡车，上面覆盖着绿色防水布。卡车两侧各有一台压路机和一名工人。背景中有多栋正在施工的建筑。左边的一栋有着白色立面，并且覆盖着脚手架。中间的几栋覆盖着脚手架和绿色安全网。可见一台塔式起重机的器的。

err.en: The jib of a tower crane is visible.
err.zh: 可见一台塔式起重机的器的。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is handling a rebar on a construction site, and wooden formwork is visible around him. In the midground, there is a scaffolding structure with yellow guardrails and green safety netting. The background features a blue construction site office with a partially visible tower crane behind it, and multi-story buildings under construction further in the distance.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在建筑工地上操作一台钢筋加工机械，其周围可见木质模板。中景处，有一处带有黄色护栏和绿色安全网的的结构。背景中，可见一栋蓝色建筑工地的办公楼，其后方部分可见一台塔式起重机，更远处则可见多层正在施工中的建筑。

err.zh: 操作一台钢筋加工机械

text: The image shows four workers on a construction site working on a reinforced concrete structure that appears to be a foundation or part of an underground passage. All workers are wearing safety helmets, and the terrain around the construction site is uneven with visible rocks and soil.
zh: 图像显示四名工人在一处建筑工地上作业，正在施工一段钢筋混凝土结构，看起来像是基础或地下通道的一部分。所有工人都戴着安全帽，施工现场周围地形平坦，可见岩石和土壤。

text: The image shows four workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests on the left of the image. The center shows a foundation pit enclosed by grey tiles. In the middle ground, a yellow excavator is visible. In the background, the mounds of earth are covered with blue tarps.
zh: 图片左侧显示四名工人，他们戴着黄色安全帽，穿着高能见度背心。图片中心显示一个基础坑，被灰色瓷砖包围。在中间地面上，可以看到一台黄色挖掘机。在背景里，地球的的表面被蓝色胶带覆盖。

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road leading towards the center of the image where two dump trucks are parked side by side; the left one is green and loaded with soil, while the right one is white with a camouflage pattern and appears to be empty. Behind the trucks, two pile-driving rigs with their masts extended vertically are positioned between them.
zh: 前景中，一条土路通向画面中心，两辆自卸卡车并排停放；左侧一辆为绿色，装载着泥土，而右侧一辆为白色，带有迷彩图案，看起来是空的载的。在卡车后方，两堆钻机架，其桅杆垂直延伸，位于它们之间。

text: The image shows multiple lengths of rebars laid out on the ground, some bent into shapes, and construction tools scattered nearby. Several workers wearing hard hats and reflective vests are actively engaged in tasks around the rebars. On the left, a worker is working with a rebar-cutting machine under a blue shed. In the middle ground, there are stockpiles of straight rebars and rebar rolls. In the background, there are multiple high-rise buildings under construction with about ten tower cranes visible.
zh: 地面上摆放着多根钢筋，部分钢筋被弯成各种形状，附近散落着一些施工工具。几名头戴安全帽、身穿反光背心的的工人正积极地在钢筋周围从事作业。左侧，一名工人正在一台钢筋切断机下、一件蓝色雨衣下工作。中间地面上，堆放着成堆的直钢筋和钢筋卷。背景中，有多栋正在施工的高层建筑，大约十台塔吊可见。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a red hard hat and boots stands on the left, looking towards a yellow excavator in the middle, with its bucket shoveling a pile of rubble. The background features a waterbody and a village full of trees.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴红色安全帽、脚穿靴子的的工作人员站在左侧，面向画面中央一台黄色色挖掘机，其铲斗正覆盖着一堆碎石。背景中可见一片水域和一座树木繁茂的村庄。

err.en: with its bucket shoveling a pile of rubb
err.zh: 其铲斗正覆盖着一堆碎石

text: The image shows a yellow metal fence with vertical bars and a gate in the foreground. An excavator is positioned in the center. A worker wearing a red hard hat is walking across the site to the right. In the background, there are multiple unfinished concrete buildings with visible scaffolding and green safety netting, and three tower cranes are erected to the far right.
zh: 画面中有一道黄色金属围栏，带有竖直栏杆，前景处设有一扇闸门。一台挖掘机位于画面中央。一名头戴红色安全帽的工人正从工地向右行走。背景中可见多栋未完工的混凝土建筑，带有外露出的钢筋和绿色安全防护网，右侧远处竖立着三座塔吊。

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road leading towards the background with puddles of water and scattered debris. A dump truck is parked on the right side of the road, partially covered with a green tarp. The background features an open field with patches of greenery and a few distant buildings, along with overhead power lines stretching across the sky.
zh: 前景中，一条土路通向背景，背景中有水坑和散落的碎石。一辆自卸卡车停在道路右侧，部分被绿色防水布覆盖。背景中有一片开阔的田野，点缀着绿色植被和几栋远处的处的建筑，同时头顶部的有电力线横跨天空。

err.zh: 同时头顶部的有电力线

text: In the foreground, seven workers are in a trench working on a structure. In the middle, the unfinished section of the structure features a wall with a concrete foundation and vertical rebars protruding. The top of the section is covered with red smooth sheets. Moving right, the finished section of the structure features a concrete surface. The road to the right of the site is scattered with broken bricks and rubbles along with a stack of rebars. Beyond the construction site, there is a body of water and greenery.
zh: 前景中，七名工人在沟槽内作业，结构上，该结构特征为带混凝土基础的及竖向钢筋的墙体。结构顶部，该结构特征为覆盖红色光滑板材。结构右侧，该结构特征为混凝土表面。道路右侧，该结构特征为散落破碎砖块及砾石，并伴有一堆钢筋。施工现场之外，存在水体及植被。

err.en: In the middle, the unfinished section of
err.zh: 结构上，该结构特征为带混凝土基础的及竖向钢筋的墙体。

err.en: Moving right, the finished section of th
err.zh: 结构右侧，该结构特征为混凝土表面。

err.en: The road to the right of the site is sca
err.zh: 道路右侧，该结构特征为散落破碎砖块及砾石，并伴有一堆钢筋。

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of red pipes on the left and black pipes in the middle and on the right, with a blue truck positioned near the center. A yellow excavator is located behind the truck, and a blue crawler crane with its boom extended is situated in the middle of the image.
zh: 前景中，左侧有一大堆红色管道，中间是黑色管道，右侧则有一辆蓝色卡车停在中心附近。黄色挖掘机位于卡车后方，而一台蓝色履带吊臂的起重机则位于画面中央。

err.en: black pipes in the middle and on the rig
err.zh: 中间是黑色管道，右侧则有一辆蓝色卡车

text: The image shows a group of ten individuals wearing hard hats gathered, with one person with a red hard hat on the right holding a document. Behind them, a yellow Komatsu hydraulic excavator is visible with its bucket raised mid-air.
zh: 画面显示十名头戴安全帽的人员聚集在一起，其中右侧一人戴着红色安全帽，手持一份文件。在他们身后，一台黄色色的小松液压挖掘机清晰可见，其铲斗斗正在半空中抬起。

text: A worker in the middle is wearing a pair of shorts.
zh: 一名工人正中间戴着一副短筒。

text: In the foreground, there is a large construction site with several workers dispersed across the area. There is a yellow tower crane standing in the center of the image. Below the crane, workers are engaged in various activities on the concrete floor. To the left of the concrete surface, the top of another structure is under construction, which is sectioned off by steel reinforcement bars creating a grid pattern. The background features numerous construction materials, including wooden planks, along with white buildings and green tarps.
zh: 前景中有一处大型建筑工地，多名工人分散在区域内各处。画面中央矗立着一台黄色塔式起重机。起重机下方，工人正在混凝土地面上从事各种作业。混凝土表面左侧，另一处建筑的的上部正在施工，其被钢筋条分割成网格状。背景中可见大量建筑材料，包括木托盘，以及白色建筑和绿色篷布。

text: In the foreground, the ground is covered with a pond of water with tire tracks. Two yellow mobile cranes with a red crane visible behind are in the middle. In the background, an overpass stretches across the scene, and various structures and vehicles can be seen in the distance under the overpass.
zh: 前景中，地面被一汪水覆盖，带有轮胎痕迹。两辆黄色摩托车，红色吊车可见，位于画面中部。背景中，一座立交桥横跨整个场景，各种结构和车辆可在远处立交桥下看到。

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer with visible exhaust fumes in the foreground on the left. A worker in a blue helmet is standing on the short wall along the dirt road. Several more workers are standing on the short wall farther back. In the middle, there is an excavator and another construction vehicle. The background features a mountainous terrain covered with trees and a river is visible on the right.
zh: 画面前景左侧是一台黄色推土机，可见其排出的废气。一名头戴蓝色安全帽的工人站在土路旁的。更远处还有几名工人站在土路旁。画面中部有一台挖掘机和另一台施工车辆。背景是覆盖着树木的山地地貌，右侧可见一条河流。

err.en: standing on the short wall along the dir
standing on the short wall farther back

text: In the foreground, there is a large area of churned soil. A blue Kobelco excavator is positioned in the center, holding a bucket full of soil. The background is hazy, but there are transmission towers and vegetation visible at a distance.
zh: 前景中有一大片烧焦的泥土。一台蓝色Kobelco挖掘机位于画面中央，手持一桶装满泥土的桶。背景朦胧，但远处可见输电塔和植被。

err.en: holding a bucket full of soil
err.zh: 手持一桶装满泥土的桶

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow mobile crane, a grey mobile crane, a red pile driver, and other construction vehicles and equipment. In the background, multiple tower cranes are present, and construction activity is evident with buildings under construction in the distance.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有一台黄色移动式起重机、一台灰色移动式起重机、一台红色汽车起重机，以及其他施工车辆和设备。背景中可见多台塔式起重机，远处有正在施工的建筑，施工活动明显。

text: In the foreground, a bulldozer is centered on a dirt path with churned soil and tracks visible. To the left, there is a pile of debris and vegetation. The background features a hazy skyline with buildings and construction cranes.
zh: 前景中，一台推土机位于一条土路中央，路面有烧土和可见车辙。左侧有一堆碎石和植被。背景中可见一片朦胧的天际线，有建筑物和施工吊车。

text: The image shows a yellow and black bulldozer with tracks, actively moving earth on a construction site. The ground around the bulldozer appears uneven and consists of various shades of brown soil, with some areas looking freshly disturbed by the equipment.
zh: 图中显示一台黄黑相间的推土机，带有履带，正在建筑工地上积极移动。推土机周围的地面看起来均匀，由各种棕色土壤组成，其中一些区域看起来被该设备新扰动。

text: The image shows a mobile crane mounted on a truck positioned centrally, with its boom extended to the right side. A worker wearing a yellow hard hat is standing on the left. The ground appears to be uneven and wet.
zh: 图中显示一辆移动起重机安装在卡车中央，其吊臂向右侧延伸。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在左侧。地面看起来平整且潮湿。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker wearing a red coverall and a yellow hard hat, bending over a pile of construction materials. The materials include red scaffolding components. To the left, there is a large piece of orange machinery next to the rear of a green and grey mobile crane. A partially constructed building with exposed scaffolding occupies the right side of the image, and lush greenery can be seen in the background, along with a body of water.
zh: 画面中展示了一处建筑工地，一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿黄色安全帽，正弯腰处理一堆建筑材料。这些材料中包含红色脚手架。在左侧，有一台大型橙色机械，位于一台绿色和灰色移动起重机后方。一栋部分建成的建筑，带有外露出的脚手架，占据了图像的右侧，并且可以看到茂盛的植被，沿着水体。

err.en: wearing a red coverall and a yellow hard
err.zh: 头戴红色安全帽，身穿黄色安全帽

err.en: next to the rear of a green and grey mob
err.zh: 位于一台绿色和灰色移动起重机后方

err.en: along with a body of water

text: In the foreground, there is uneven, excavated ground with a large wooden beam lying horizontally. An excavator is positioned in the middle, to the left of a pile-driving machine. In the background, there are several workers gathered around another pile-driving machine on the left.
zh: 前景中，有一片平整的开挖地面，上面横放着一根大型木梁。一台挖掘机位于画面中部，在一台驱动机械的左侧。背景中，有几名工人聚集在另一台驱动机械的左侧。

text: The excavator on top of a mound of soil is actively engaged in work, with its bucket raised. To the left, there is a water body and multiple trees. To the right, there is a fence made of yellow and black metal poles and green safety netting.
zh: 土堆顶部的有一台挖掘机正在作业，其铲斗已升起。左侧有一具水体的及多棵树木。右侧有一道由黄黑金属杆及绿色安全网构成的之围栏。

text: The image shows an interior construction site with five workers with red hard hats. There is a metal pole scaffolding structure in the middle. The site is scattered with wooden planks, debris, and construction materials. The ceiling is covered with red wooden planks and reinforced by more wooden boards. Several concrete columns are visible. The perimeter of the building is covered with green safety netting.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，有五名头戴红色安全帽的工人。中间有一处金属极脚手架。现场散落着木托盘、碎屑和建筑材料。天花板覆盖着红色木托盘，并由更多木板加固。可见几根混凝土柱。建筑外围覆盖着绿色安全网。

text: The image shows a concrete platform with scattered rebar and wooden planks on top of it. Three workers wearing yellow hard hats are standing next to a pile of rebars on the left. Further right, two workers are next to a stack of wooden planks. In the background, there is a partially constructed building with scaffolding and a blue tarp covering part of it.
zh: 图像显示一个混凝土平台，上面散落着钢筋和木托盘。三个戴着黄色安全帽的工人站在左侧一堆钢筋旁边。再往右，两个工人站在堆叠的木托盘旁边。背景中有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有脚手架，并且一块蓝色防水布覆盖着它的一部分。

text: The image shows a large red pile driver mounted on a yellow tracked excavator base. Various black rebar cages are scattered around. A yellow mobile crane is positioned to the right, with its boom stowed. In the background, three booms of mobile cranes and two booms of pile drivers are visible. Multiple tower cranes are also visible in the distance.
zh: 图中显示一台大型红色挖掘机安装在黄色履带式挖掘机基上。周围散落着许多黑色钢筋笼。一台黄色移动式起重机位于右侧，其吊臂已伸出。背景中可见三台移动式起重机和两台挖掘机。远处也可见多台塔式起重机。

err.en: three booms of mobile cranes and two boo
err.zh: 三台移动式起重机和两台挖掘机

text: In the image, one worker is wearing a yellow hard hat and high-visibility orange jacket, smoothing concrete on a machine with a trowel. Another worker with a yellow hard hat is on the left. The environment suggests an indoor setting.
zh: 图中一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度橙色夹克，正在一台装有传送带的（trowel）的机器上抹平混凝土。另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于左侧。环境暗示为室内场景。

text: In the foreground, two workers are leveling freshly poured concrete; one is closer to the center, and the other is to the right, both using long-handled trowels. A third worker, wearing a red hard hat, is guiding the concrete hose to pour the concrete to the left. In the background, there is a massive scaffolding structure made of metal poles.
zh: 前景中，两名工人正在摊铺新浇筑的混凝土；其中一名位于画面中央偏近处，另一名位于右侧，两人均使用长柄拖车进行作业。第三名工人头戴红色安全帽，正引导混凝土软管将混凝土浇筑向左侧。背景中矗立着一座由金属杆件搭建而成的的大型脚手架结构。

text: In the foreground, a yellow soil compactor with muddy wheels is centered in the image, positioned on a dirt surface. In the background, there is an unfinished concrete structure with exposed rebar protruding upwards and metal pole scaffolding surrounding the structure.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色土机位于画面中央，其沾满泥浆的轮子停在一处泥土地表面上。背景中，有一处已完工的结构，其外露的钢筋向上突出，金属脚手架环绕其周围。

text: The image shows a large excavation with extensive steel reinforcement in place for concrete structures. Multiple workers wearing yellow hard hats are actively working throughout the site. On the right, a metal pole scaffolding forms a pathway whose sides are covered with blue safety netting. In the upper right, a yellow excavator is visible. The background features a row of sheet piles.
zh: 图中展示了一个大型基坑，内部设有大量钢筋以替代混凝土结构。现场有多名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在积极作业。右侧，一个金属极脚手架形成一条通道，其侧面覆盖着蓝色安全网。右上方，一台黄色挖掘机清晰可见。背景中有一排钢板桩。

text: In the foreground, there is a worker wearing a white hard hat and a light-colored shirt standing to the left of a red excavator. Some rebar cages and a scooter are also visible. In the middle ground, a white concrete mixer truck, a silver van, and the base of a tower crane are visible. In the background, two high-rise buildings under construction are visible. The buildings are covered with green safety netting. To the right, there is another tower crane.
zh: 前景中，有一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿浅色衬衫的工人站在一台红色挖掘机左侧。一些钢筋笼和一辆踏板车也清晰可见。中景处，可见一台白色混凝土搅拌车、一辆银色面包车以及一台塔式起重机。背景中，两栋在建的高楼清晰可见。这些建筑被绿色安全网覆盖。右侧，还有另一台塔式起重机。

err.en: and the base of a tower crane

text: The image shows a construction worker wearing a yellow hard hat, orange jacket, and camouflage pants standing on a grid of rebar, tying the rebar together. The worker is holding a rebar tie tool, and a blue cooler is nearby. The background shows a white concrete platform with a stack of rebars on the left.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿橙色夹克，下身穿迷彩裤，站在钢筋网格上，将钢筋捆绑在一起。工人手持一根钢筋，旁边有一台蓝色冷却机。背景显示一个白色混凝土平台，左侧堆放着一堆钢筋。

text: The image shows a concrete sidewalk running parallel to a dirt road under construction. To the left, a concrete utility pole is visible. Along the sidewalk to the right, six individuals are present, four of them are next to a yellow excavator. In the background, another excavator is positioned in the middle.
zh: 画面中，一条混凝土人行道与一条正在施工中的土路平行延伸。在左侧，可见一个混凝土电线杆。沿着人行道向右，有六个人在场，其中四人正走向一台黄色挖掘机。在背景中，另一台挖掘机位于中间位置。

err.en: are next to a yellow excavator
err.zh: 正走向一台黄色挖掘机

text: The image shows six workers in the foreground spread out across a large area of rebar gridwork. They are wearing red or yellow hard hats and are in various postures, some kneeling and some bending over the rebar. To the right, there is a perimeter fence made of yellow metal poles and green safety netting. The background shows the base of a tower crane, several more workers and a building under construction. In the upper left, some high-rise buildings are visible.
zh: 画面前景中，六名工人分散在一片大型钢筋网格作业区域内。他们头戴红色或黄色安全帽，处于各种姿态，有的蹲着，有的弯身翻越钢筋。右侧有一圈由黄色金属杆和绿色安全网构成的围栏。背景中可见一台塔式起重机底座，还有更多工人及一栋在建建筑。左上方可见一些高层建筑。

text: The image shows two workers with yellow hard hats positioned on a grid of rebar at various points. The worker in the center is holding a long rebar on his back.
zh: 图中显示两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，站在不同位置的的重钢梁的网格中。中间的工人背上扛着一根长重钢梁。

text: The image shows a pile of reddish-brown earth with scattered construction materials, including a blue pipe and a wooden plate on the left. A yellow mobile crane is positioned in the center. To the right, the rear of an excavator is visible. The background features two utility poles.
zh: 画面中有一堆红褐色的泥土，周围散落着建筑材料，左侧可见一根蓝色管道和一块木板。画面中央停放着一台黄色移动式起重机。右侧可见一台挖掘机的器的。背景中有两根电线杆。

text: In the foreground, there is an excavator with a bucket attachment in the center, positioned on a dirt surface with scattered wooden planks around it. To the right, two pile-driving machines with a tall mast and a suspended hammer are visible. To the left, a dirty drilling bit is placed on the ground. The background shows an expansive construction site with uneven terrain.
zh: 前景中，有一台挖掘机，其中心位置附着水桶，停放在一片泥土地面上，周围散落着木屑。右侧，可见两台钻机，带有高桅杆和悬吊锤。左侧，一台脏污的钻杆被放置在地面上。背景显示一片广阔的的建筑场地，地形平坦。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator with the branding "KATO" on muddy terrain, actively engaged in digging. In the middle ground, there is a dump truck on the left and another excavator on the right. The background features a construction site with various buildings covered with green safety netting.
zh: 前景中，有一台黄色挖掘机，机身上印有“Kato”品牌标识，正活跃地在泥泞土地上进行挖掘作业。中景左侧有一辆泵车，右侧还有另一台挖掘机。背景为一处建筑工地，各类建筑物上覆盖着绿色安全防护网。

text: The image shows a bulldozer with tracks, actively moving earth. The operator is visible inside the cabin. The ground around the bulldozer is uneven with various piles of soil and some debris, including branches and roots.
zh: 图中展示了一台带轨道的道砻，正在进行土方作业。操作员在驾驶室内清晰可见。道砻周围地面平整，分布着若干土堆及部分杂物，其中包括树枝和树根。

text: The construction site has a large area of reinforced steel bars laid out in a grid pattern. Multiple bundles of metal poles and wooden boards are organized on the site on the left. On the upper left, three workers walk on the construction materials. In the lower right, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is near a formwork panel.
zh: 施工现场钢筋呈网格状大面积铺设。多组金属极和木质板材在场地左侧有序堆放。左上方，三名工人正在搬运建筑材料。右下方，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人靠近一块施工面板。

text: The image shows a large pile of dirt with a yellow Komatsu excavator positioned on top of it. An extensive construction site is visible in the background with multiple levels of scaffolding covered in green safety netting, unfinished concrete structures with exposed rebar, and a tower crane with its boom extended horizontally. In the middle, the boom of a mobile crane is visible.
zh: 图中显示一大堆泥土，一台黄色的小松挖掘机位于其顶部。背景中可见一个大型建筑工地，带有多个层级的脚手架，覆盖着绿色安全网，已完工的结构物带有外露出的钢筋，以及一台塔式起重机，其吊臂水平延伸。在中间，一台移动式起重机的吊臂可见。

text: The image shows a concrete pump boom extending across the scene with a worker standing on top of a concrete structure on the left. Four workers are on scaffolding working on a wall made of vertical rebar and wood formwork. A fifth worker is standing on the finished concrete wall on the right. The sixth worker is standing on the left, on top of the deployed outrigger of a construction vehicle.
zh: 图像显示混凝土泵车横跨整个场景，一名工人站在左侧的混凝土结构上。四名工人在脚手架上，正在对由竖直钢筋和木模板构成的的一面墙进行作业。第五名工人站在右侧已完工混凝土墙上。第六名工人站在左侧，位于一辆施工车辆的展开触发器顶部。

text: In the foreground, two workers are present on uneven, excavated ground; the one on the left is wearing a white hard hat and holding a shovel, while the one on the right is wearing a red hard hat and leaning on a shovel. Behind them, a large, sloped excavation site with exposed earth extends across the entire background.
zh: 前景中，两名工人站在平整的开挖地面上；左侧的工人头戴白色安全帽，手持铁锹，右侧的工人头戴红色安全帽，倚靠在一把铁锹上。在他们身后，是一个大型倾斜的开挖场地，裸露出的土横跨整个背景。

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of steel beams and a mound of earth in the foreground on the left. A blue truck is parked to the right. Further to the right, a red telescopic crane is extended upwards. The background features a large steel structure with multiple levels.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左前方有一堆钢梁和一堆土方。右侧停着一辆蓝色卡车。再往右方，一台红色塔式起重机向上延伸。背景中可见大型钢结构，具有多层结构。

text: The image shows a large excavation area with muddy water pooled at the bottom. An orange excavator is positioned within the excavation. Scattered around the site are construction materials, including piles of bricks, two stacks of rebars, and wooden planks. In the background, a blue construction barrier encloses the area, and beyond it, a green scaffolded building and a tower crane are visible.
zh: 画面显示一处大型基坑，底部积有泥水。一台橙色挖掘机位于基坑内。场地周围散落着建筑材料，包括成堆的砖块、两摞钢筋以及木托盘。背景中，一道蓝色施工围挡封闭着该区域，其外可见一栋带绿色脚手架的建筑及一台塔式起重机。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a reflective vest is inside a foundation pit while arranging bricks. Moving to the middle ground, another worker in a red hard hat is operating a machine; one worker is on the left near a concrete mixer, and two workers are on the right next to wheelbarrows. More foundation pits are visible. In the background, there is a large pile of pre-cast concrete beams, scaffolding, and various construction materials covered with tarps.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿反光背心的的工人正在基坑内码放砖块。向中景处，另一名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在操作一台机械；一名工人位于左侧靠近一台混凝土搅拌机处，另有两名工人位于右侧靠近一排钢筋处。可见更多基坑。背景中，有一大堆预制混凝土梁、脚手架，以及各类建筑材料被苫布覆盖。

text: In the foreground, there is an excavator with its boom extended to the right. To the left of the excavator, a person wearing a white hard hat is standing and observing the scene. The middle ground shows uneven, dug-up earth and some standing water. Another excavator is on the left. In the background, a forest can be seen.
zh: 前景中，有一台挖掘机，其动臂向右延伸。在挖掘机的左侧，一名头戴白色安全帽的人员正站立并观察着现场。地面呈现出平整的开挖土方以及部分积水。另一台挖掘机位于左侧。背景中，可以看到一片树林。

text: In the image, there is one worker wearing an orange shirt and a white hard hat, sitting on the left side of an excavated area. The ground is uneven with visible dirt and rocks.
zh: 图中有一名工人身穿橙色上衣，头戴白色安全帽，坐在开挖区域的左侧。地面平整，可见泥土和岩石。

text: The image shows an excavation site with a complex metal pole framework inside. Five workers are visible, three working within the framework, while two others are to the left of the rebar wall. Above this area, wooden planks are visible piled on the roof of the concrete tunnel. The excavation is enclosed by sheet piles at both sides. In the background, there is a blue metal fence.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖现场，内部有一个复杂的金属极框架。五名工人可见，其中三名在框架内作业，另外两名位于重新支护墙体的左侧。该区域上方，可见木方木堆放在混凝土隧道顶部。开挖由两侧钢板桩围护。背景中有一道蓝色金属围栏。

text: The image shows a large reinforced concrete foundation with an array of vertical and horizontal steel rebars. Three workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are standing on wooden planks placed over the foundation, with one of them guiding a black hose hanging from above to pour concrete into the formwork. Behind them, a mound of earth is visible, and a blue fence partially encloses the construction area.
zh: 图中展示了一个大型钢筋混凝土基础，其中布置有纵横交错的钢筋。三名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳的工人站在置于基础之上的方的木板上，其中一人引导一根黑色软管从上方垂下，将混凝土浇筑入成型作业。在他们身后，可见一堆土，且一道蓝色围栏部分围合施工区域。

err.en: orange overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳

text: The image shows four workers engaged in construction activities around a circular concrete structure filled with water. Three of the workers are wearing hard hats, while the middle one is wearing shorts and slippers. A pile driver and several stacks of rebars are in the upper left.
zh: 图中显示四名工人正在围绕一个圆形混凝土结构进行施工活动，该结构内注满水。其中三名工人戴着安全帽，而中间那名工人则穿着短裤并戴着太阳镜。左上方有一堆司机以及几堆钢筋。

text: The image shows a blue excavator on a dirt path. To the left, there is a water body, and along the edge, there are remnants of vegetation and debris.
zh: 图中显示一台蓝色挖掘机停在土路上。左侧有一具象的水，沿边缘处有一些植被和碎屑的残留迹。

text: The site is scattered with various construction materials, including piles of white tiles, wooden planks, and steel rods. Multiple pieces of heavy machinery, such as excavators and dump trucks, are distributed throughout the site. A large dirt mound spans the area, with several vehicles parked on and around it. Four tower cranes dominate the skyline, with one prominently in the center and others in the background.
zh: 现场散落着各种建筑材料，包括成堆的白色瓷砖块、木质托盘架以及钢棒。多台重型机械，如挖掘机和自卸卡车，散布在整个工地各处。一大土堆横跨该区域，其周围停放着数辆车辆。四座高层楼主导着天际线，其中一座显著地矗立于中央，其余则隐于背景之中。

text: The image shows a large pile of excavated earth. A blue Kobelco excavator is positioned in the middle, with its arm extended and bucket raised. In the background, two tall pile driver rigs stand upright.
zh: 图中显示一大堆挖掘出的来的泥土。一台蓝色的科贝尔公司挖掘机位于中间，其臂和铲斗被抬起。在背景中，两台高大的钻机立着。

err.en: with its arm extended and bucket raised

text: The image shows a worker wearing a white hard hat standing on the rebar-reinforced floor. To the right, there is a scaffolding structure made of yellow metal poles and green safety netting. Construction materials such as a stack of planks and a stack of metal poles are visible.
zh: 图中显示一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在钢筋混凝土地面上。右侧可见由黄色金属杆和绿色安全网构成的脚手架。还可见成堆的砖块和成堆的金属杆等建筑材料。

text: In the foreground, there is a muddy road with tire tracks. A black truck is parked on the left side of the image. In the center, a mobile crane with an extended boom is positioned near steel columns that are part of an incomplete structure.
zh: 前景中有一条泥泞路，上面有轮胎印痕。一辆黑色卡车停在画面左侧。画面中央有一台移动起重机，其吊臂靠近一根钢柱，这些钢柱是完整结构的一部分。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of reinforced steel bars laid out on a concrete base, with formwork panels erected vertically along the edge. Six workers are visible across the scene, working on the rebar and carrying materials. Scattered construction materials, such as wooden planks and additional rebar, are visible on the concrete surface. The left of the image shows the finished concrete section. The background features sheet piles.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，大面积钢筋平铺在混凝土基上，边缘竖立着模板面板。场景中中可见六名工人，正在从事钢筋绑扎及材料搬运工作。散落的着建筑材料，诸如木托盘及额外钢筋，可见于混凝土表面。画面左侧显示已完工混凝土截面。背景特征为板材堆。

text: In the foreground, a yellow excavator is positioned with its arm extended and bucket touching the ground, amidst a muddy terrain with visible tire tracks and puddles. In the middle ground, four more excavators are seen on the left. In the background, a building with multiple floors and two cranes are visible, with a hazy sky overhead.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色挖掘机停在地面上，其臂和铲斗接触着地面，周围是泥泞土地质，可见轮胎痕迹和泥水坑洼。中景中，左侧可见四台挖掘机。背景中，一栋建筑有多层楼板和两个吊篮可见，头顶上是昏沉的天空。

text: In the foreground, there is a single excavator with a muddy appearance, actively engaged in digging or moving soil. The excavator is positioned on a surface that is uneven and muddy. The background features a cleared area with some debris. Power lines and towers are visible in the far background. Some trees are underneath the power lines.
zh: 前景中有一台外观泥泞污的挖掘机，正积极地进行挖掘或搬运泥土作业。挖掘机停放在一片平坦且泥泞污的地面上。背景中有一片开阔区域，带有一些碎屑物。远处背景中可见电力线路和塔架。部分树木位于电力线路下方。

text: The image shows a pile of dirt in the middle. A yellow bulldozer is in the center, actively moving the pile of dirt. To the right of the bulldozer, there is a dump truck. The earthen ground in the image has tire tracks on it. In the background, multistory buildings are visible.
zh: 画面中央有一堆泥土。一台黄色推土机位于中心，正在移动这堆土。推土机的右侧有一辆自卸卡车。图像中的地面有轮胎痕迹。背景中可见多栋历史建筑。

text: In the foreground, there is a large stack of rectangular construction bricks arranged neatly on the ground. Moving towards the background, one individual wearing a red jacket is squating on the left and another worker on the right is standing next to a wheelbarrow. The background features a concrete retaining wall.
zh: 前景中，地面上整齐码放着一大堆矩形建筑砖。背景中，一名身穿红色夹克的工人站在左侧，另一名工人站在右侧，紧挨着一个轮轴。背景中有一堵混凝土挡土墙。

text: In the foreground, there is a partially submerged excavator with its cabin door open. Moving to the midground, there are two more excavators with its arm extended. In the background, buildings with red facades are visible.
zh: 前景中，有一台部分浸没的挖掘机，其驾驶室门敞开。中景处，有两台挖掘机伸出其臂架。背景中，可见带有红色立面的（立面）的建筑物。

err.en: buildings with red facades are visible
err.zh: 可见带有红色立面的（立面）的建筑物

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of metal poles on the ground. To the right, a scaffolding structure is visible. In the background, massive area is covered with green safety netting.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面上堆放着一堆金属极。右侧可见脚手架结构。背景中大片区域覆盖着绿色安全防护网。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator with its bucket raised, positioned next to a pile of metal sheets. Behind the excavator, some individuals are walking on the right of the background of the image. To the left of the background, trees and blue fences can be seen. The ground is muddy with visible tire tracks and scattered debris.
zh: 图中展示了一台黄色挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起，正驶向一堆金属板材。在挖掘机后方，有几个人正走在画面右侧的背景中。在画面左侧背景中，可以看到树木和蓝色围栏。地面泥泞湿，可见轮胎印迹和散落的杂物。

err.en: positioned next to a pile of metal sheet

text: The image shows a construction site with a dense network of rebar laid out on the ground, forming the reinforcement for concrete structures. In the image, there are multiple stacks of construction materials, including stacks of wood planks, stacks of metal poles. In the middle ground, there are eight workers with yellow or blue hard hats.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，地面上铺设着密集的钢筋网，形成混凝土结构的体的。在图像中，有多堆建筑材料，包括木托盘堆和金属杆堆。在中间地面上，有八名戴着黄色或蓝色安全帽的工人。

err.en: forming the reinforcement for concrete s
err.zh: 形成混凝土结构的体的

text: In the foreground, a yellow excavator is positioned near a small body of water, with its bucket touching the ground. Behind the excavator, there are several mounds of dirt. To the right, the terrain is uneven with scattered vegetation. In the background, there are some structures with blue fencing around it.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色挖掘机停在一小水塘旁，其铲斗接触地面。挖掘机后方，有几堆泥土。右侧，地形平坦，散布着植被。背景中，有一些结构，周围环绕着蓝色围栏网。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with puddles of water. Four workers with white or yellow hard hats are present in the center. Two of them on the right are next to a pile driver. The background features blue metal fences and a transmission tower.
zh: 图片显示一个泥泞地施工现场，有积水坑。画面中央有四名戴着白色或黄色安全帽的工人。其中两人位于右侧，正靠近一堆司机。背景中有蓝色金属围栏和一座输电塔。

text: The image shows an excavator bucket positioned above a trench with three workers with red or yellow hard hats standing nearby. The excavator bucket is full of concrete. A large concrete pipe section is visible within the trench. A section of the pipe is enclosed by red wooden boards and supported by wooden braces. Some liquid concrete is visible within the formwork.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机位于沟槽上方，附近有三名戴着红色或黄色安全帽的工人。挖掘机料斗内装满了混凝土。沟槽内可见一段大型混凝土管道。该管道的一段被红色木板围住，并由木支架支撑。部分液态混凝土在作业面内可见。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator with the brand name CASE on its arm. Behind the excavator, there is a large pile of brown pipes with flanges on the ends. Further in the background, there is an embankment and the boom of a crane.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机，其臂上印有CASE品牌标识。挖掘机后方有一大堆棕色管道，管口处带有法兰盘。更远处背景中，有一台起重机以及一台起重机的。

err.en: there is an embankment and the boom of a
err.zh: 有一台起重机以及一台起重机的。

text: The image shows a yellow and black bulldozer on a mound of dirt. The surrounding area is a construction site with piles of dirt and debris. The background shows a farmland.
zh: 图中显示一台黄黑相的压路机停在一堆泥土上。周围区域是一个施工现场，有土堆和碎石。背景显示一片农田。

text: The image shows two bundles of rebars on the left and in the middle. Some workers in hard hats and different-colored jackets are on the left section of the image. To the right, there is a tunnel structure enclosed with red wooden boards in the interior and and rebar framework in the exterior. One worker in the background is in front of the river's edge.
zh: 图像左侧和中间显示着两堆钢筋。左侧部分图像中，有一些戴着安全帽、穿着不同颜色夹克的工人。右侧，有一个隧道结构，内部围着红色木板，并且内部有钢筋框架。背景中，有一名工人在河流边缘的前部。

text: The image shows an excavator to the left, large areas covered with blue tarps. More than 20 construction workers are scattered across the site in the upper half of the image. The base of a tower crane is visible.
zh: 画面左侧是一台挖掘机，其上方覆盖着大片蓝色碎片状物。画面上半部分散布着二十多名建筑工人。一台塔式起重机的器的物的可见。

err.en: The base of a tower crane is visible.
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机的器的物的可见。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large grid of rebar laid out on the ground with a pink wooden tool resting on it. Seven workers wearing yellow hard hats are spread across the site. Two workers in the background near a row of sheet piles are pouring concrete with a concrete hose hanging from above.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，地面上铺设着大量钢筋，上面放着一把粉色木制工具。七名头戴黄色安全帽的工人分散在工地各处。背景中，两名工人靠近一堆钢筋，正用混凝土软管浇筑混凝土，软管从上方垂下。

text: The image shows three blue dump trucks unloading material. There are two workers in the center, to the right of the trucks. Numerous wooden planks and metal pole scaffolding materials are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图中显示三辆蓝色自卸卡车。在卡车右侧中心处有两名工人。大量木托盘和金属极材料散落在整个场地。

text: The image shows a large pile of steel reinforcement bars in the foreground, with an orange excavator positioned in the middle. Behind the excavator, the site extends with various mounds of excavated soil. In the background, there are at least five tower cranes standing tall against the backdrop of under-construction high-rise buildings.
zh: 前景处有一大堆钢筋，中部位置有一台橙色挖掘机。挖掘机后方，场地延伸出各种堆起的挖出的土。背景中，至少有五座塔吊机矗立在高层建筑之下。

text: In the image, there are four workers wearing hard hats and engaged in various activities within an excavation site. Four metal panels enclose a rectangular area. The metal panels are supported by metal poles. There are metal formwork panels and metal poles scattered around the site.
zh: 图像中有四名头戴安全帽的工人，正在一个开挖现场从事各种作业。四块金属板围出一个矩形区域。这些金属板由金属支柱支撑。现场周围散布着金属作业面板板和金属支柱。

text: In the foreground, a large area is covered with blue tarps, under which earthworks are protected. A worker wearing a high-visibility vest is standing near an embankment on the left. In the midground, there is a tower crane with its jib extending towards the left side of the image. A pile of pre-cast concrete is underneath the tower crane. On the right, a red pile driver is visible, standing vertically.
zh: 前景中，一大片区域被蓝色防水布覆盖，其下保护着土方工程。一名身穿高能见度背心的的工人站在左侧的嵌入物附近。中景中，有一台塔式起重机，其吊臂向图像左侧延伸。塔式起重机下方有一堆预制混凝土。右侧，可见一辆红色卡车，竖直停放着。

text: The workers are wearing yellow hard hats and yellow high-visibility vests. They are engaged in various tasks related to reinforcing the structure, such as adjusting and tying the rebar. A worker in the middle is welding with a black face shield. The image features a rebar framework on top of a concrete foundation. There are two stacks of rebars and one stack of red wooden sheets on top of the concrete platform in the background.
zh: 工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿黄色高能见度背心。他们正从事与加固结构相关的的工作，例如调整和绑扎钢筋。中间的一名工人正使用黑色面罩进行焊接作业。画面顶部有一根钢筋框架，位于混凝土基础之上。背景中可见两堆钢筋和一堆红色木板，放置在混凝土平台上。

err.en: The image features a rebar framework on
err.zh: 画面顶部有一根钢筋框架，位于混凝土基础之上。

text: The image shows a large pile of aggregate with about ten workers gathered around it, wearing red or white hard hats. Behind the group, there is a bulldozer with a worker seated inside. To the right, a drum roller is visible. The background shows a stone retaining wall.
zh: 图中显示一大堆骨料料，约有十名工人围在旁边，头戴红色或白色安全帽。人群后方有一台铣刨机，一名工人坐在里面。右侧可见一台鼓式压路机。背景中有一堵石砌挡土墙。

text: In the foreground, there is a large expanse of disturbed soil with tire tracks. To the left, there is a dump truck generating a cloud of dust as it moves. To the right, there is a bulldozer at work. Power lines run across the background. A blue sky with scattered clouds can be seen.
zh: 前景中有一大片被扰动的大面积土壤，上面有轮胎痕迹。左侧有一辆自卸卡车正在移动时扬起一片尘土。右侧有一台路面铣刨机正在作业。背景中可见一条电力线横穿。一片蓝天上散布着云朵。

text: The image shows two workers applying a protective wrap to a large pipe buried underground. Both workers are wearing blue uniforms and red hard hats. The pipe is situated in a trench with exposed earth around it, and there are additional rolls of the wrapping material on top of the pipe.
