zh: 前景中有烧焦和泥泞土地，可见轮胎痕迹。一台黄色鼓滚轮正在积极从事土方活动。右侧有两堵红砖墙。背景中有树木和栅栏。

text: The image shows about six construction workers with red or white hard hats engaged in various activities around a concrete foundation with protruding rebar. Some workers are standing, while others are bent over or crouched, handling materials or working on the site. Numerous wooden planks and sheets are scattered across the area.
zh: 画面显示约有六名头戴红色或白色安全帽的建筑工人，正围绕一处带有外露钢筋的混凝土基础开展各项作业。部分工人站立着，另一些则俯身或弯腰，正在搬运材料或进行施工作业。现场各处散落着大量木托盘和板材。

text: The image shows a muddy and tire-tracked road leading towards the background with a car parked on the left side. An excavator is actively moving earth in the center of the image, generating a cloud of dust. The background features a partially cloudy sky and a landscape with vegetation and multiple construction cranes visible in the distance.
zh: 画面中，一条泥泞路通向背景，左侧停着一辆汽车。一台挖掘机正在画面中央积极地进行土方方作业，扬起一片尘土云。背景呈现部分多云的天空，以及带有植被的景观貌，远处可见多台建筑起重机。

text: The image shows a worker in an orange jumpsuit and yellow hard hat standing on a freshly poured concrete surface. Another worker is bent over, smoothing the concrete on the left. A third worker is in the upper left corner of the image, next to some trees. The midground features an earthen embankment with ten stacks of rebars. The background features a lake and some woods.
zh: 画面中，一名身穿橙色连体服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在新浇筑的混凝土表面上。另一名工人弯着腰，正在抹平左侧的混凝土。第三名工人位于画面左上角，靠近一些树木。地面中部特征是一处带耳塞的嵌件，配有十堆钢筋。背景中有一片湖泊和一些树木。

err.en: an earthen embankment with ten stacks of
err.zh: 一处带耳塞的嵌件，配有十堆钢筋

text: In the foreground, there is a teal-colored excavator with its arm extended towards the ground. Two workers are near the excavator's tracks. Behind them, there are two pile-driving machines. In the middle ground, a worker in a red shirt is standing near a large dirt pile. Further back, there are stockpiles of materials, including bricks and wooden planks.
zh: 前景中，有一台青绿色的挖掘机，其臂部伸向地面。挖掘机履带附近有两名工人。在他们身后，有两台压路机。中景处，一名身穿红色衬衫的工人正站在一堆大型土堆旁。更远处，堆放着成堆的材料，包括砖块和木托盘。

text: In the foreground, an excavator with a yellow arm and a gray bucket is positioned on the left, with dust visible around its bucket. Moving to the right, there are two workers in the center of the image standing beside the excavator. A grader is behind the workers. Further back, there is a road roller. The background features a mountain covered with trees.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色臂、灰色料斗的挖掘机位于左侧，其料斗周围可见尘土。向右移动，画面中央有两名工人站在挖掘机旁。一名负责人站在工人身后。更远处，有一台路面滚压机。背景中有一座覆盖着树木的山。

text: The image shows an excavation area with several construction workers wearing yellow, blue, or red hard hats and safety vests; some are working on the foundation, and others are walking across the site. The area is covered with green tarps, and construction materials like concrete blocks and rebars are visible. The background features multiple buildings under construction and a total of six tower cranes spanning across the horizon.
zh: 画面显示一处施工区域，有多名头戴黄色、蓝色或红色安全帽并身穿安全背心的的施工人员；部分人员正在地基基础上作业，另一些人员则在工地上行走。该区域被绿色植被所覆盖，且可见混凝土块和钢筋等建筑材料。背景中有多栋正在建设中的建筑，以及横跨地平线共有六座塔楼。

text: The image shows a construction site with three individuals standing and conversing in the foreground. A white truck with its outriggers extended is in the lower right of the image.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，前景中有三个人站着并交谈。一辆白色卡车及其触发器位于图片右下方。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a safety vest is standing next to an excavated trench. An excavator is behind the worker. A series of large pipes run parallel in the trench in the foreground. A worker with a yellow hard hat can be seen standing on top of the pipeline. The terrain of the construction site is uneven, with mounds of earth and a steep incline on the right.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿安全背心的的工人站在一条开挖的沟槽旁。一台挖掘机位于该工人身后。前景的沟槽内，数根粗大的管道平行排列。一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人可见站在管道上方。施工场地的形平坦，伴有泥土堆和右侧一条陡峭的坡面。

err.en: The terrain of the construction site is

text: The image shows two excavators positioned on an elevated dirt mound, with their booms extended and lights on. A large corrugated pipe is partially buried in the mound. Vegetation is visible on the slope behind the excavators, and ambient light suggests nearby infrastructure or lighting beyond the immediate area of construction.
zh: 两名挖掘机手停在一处隆起的的高土堆上，其吊臂伸展且照明开启。一根大型波纹状管道部分埋于土堆之中。植被可见于挖掘机手后方的坡面上，环境光暗示着附近的基础设施或照明超出施工区域之外。

text: The image shows a dirt embankment with some vegetation. Above it, two tower cranes are visible against a cloudy sky. A building covered with green safety netting under construction are visible to the right.
zh: 图中显示一处土堆，上面长有一些植被。土堆上方，两栋塔楼在多云的天空背景下清晰可见。右侧可见一栋正在施工的建筑，覆盖着绿色安全防护网。

text: The image shows three workers wearing hats engaged in activities involving the earth; they are digging or shoveling. Two trees with green and yellow lucus are visible. A wheeled loader is behind the workers. The background features several towers.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴安全帽的工人正在进行与地球相关的作业，他们在挖掘或铲土。两棵带有绿色和黄色露的树可见。工人身后有一台轮式装载机。背景中有几座高楼。

text: In the foreground, a yellow Komatsu hydraulic excavator is positioned in the middle, with its arm extended and bucket resting on the ground. In the background, there is a construction site with visible foundation work, including formwork and reinforcing bars.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色小松液压挖掘机位于画面中央，其臂架和铲斗停放在地面上。背景中，有一处施工现场可见基础作业，包括模板作业和钢筋。

err.en: with its arm extended and bucket resting
err.zh: 其臂架和铲斗停放在地面上

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven dirt terrain and two workers standing near two large concrete cylinders on the left. An excavator is positioned in the center, with its arm extended towards the right. Utility poles and transmission lines traverse from the foreground to the background.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面为平整的泥土地地，左侧有两名工人站在两个大型混凝土圆柱体附近。一台挖掘机位于画面中央，其机械臂向右伸展。电力杆和输电线路从前景延伸至背景。

text: The image shows a construction site with complex scaffolding. Four workers are present, wearing red yellow and white hard hats, with two climbing on the scaffolding. The scaffolding structure is extensive, with multiple wooden and metal poles intersecting. The ground appears to be uneven with some debris scattered around.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，设有复杂的脚手架。现场有四名工人，头戴红黄及白色安全帽，其中两人正在脚手架上攀爬。脚手架结构庞大，由多根木质及金属杆件交错搭建而成。地面看似平整，周围散落着一些碎屑。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: In the foreground, there is a water-filled trench with scattered construction materials, including a huge amount of hollow metal beams. Moving towards the middle, three workers are visible on a stack of metal beams. A multi-story steel structure dominates the background, with visible cross beams and columns.
zh: 前景中有一条注满水的沟，沟内散落着施工材料，其中包括大量空心金属梁。向中部移动，可见三处工人位于一摞金属梁之上。多层钢结构占据背景，可见横梁与柱交错。

text: The image shows a flatbed truck with a crane mounted on it parked on a concrete slab. Two workers with yellow hard hats are next to the truck. To the right, a large excavation site is visible with retaining walls made of sheet piles. Multiple stacks of metal poles, metal panels, and wooden planks are scattered across the site. Blue metal fences are visible in the upper right corner. A worker wearing a blue shirt is standing near the metal poles. The background shows a green landscape with trees and a hint of structures in the far distance.
zh: 图像显示一辆平板床式卡车，上面装有一台起重机，停放在混凝土板上。两名戴着黄色安全帽的工人位于卡车旁边。右侧可见一个大型开挖场地，设有由钢板桩构成的挡土墙。多根金属杆、金属板和木垫板散落在场地各处。右上角可见蓝色金属围栏。一名穿着蓝色衬衫的工人站在金属杆附近。背景显示一片绿色景观地，带有树木和远处结构的物的。

err.en: a hint of structures in the far distance

text: The image shows a construction site with a large expanse of formwork and rebar laid out for concrete work. A worker is squating and working on the rebar mat that covers the formwork. The formwork consists of red and white panels, and the rebar is arranged in a grid pattern.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，有一大片大面积的钢筋工程，为混凝土作业铺设了钢筋。一名工人正在绑扎钢筋，作业在覆盖钢筋工程的上。钢筋工程由红色和白色面板组成，钢筋以网格状排列。

err.en: working on the rebar mat that covers the
err.zh: 作业在覆盖钢筋工程的上

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive rebar frameworks. A worker in yellow and green protective clothing is handling materials in the foreground. In the background, there is a partially constructed building with scaffolding and formwork.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，拥有庞大的钢筋框架。一名身穿黄绿防护服的工人正在前景处理材料。背景中，有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有脚手架和脚手架作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a red electric kiosk on the left and various construction materials scattered around, including bricks, a wooden plank, and a bucket. Two workers are present, both wearing safety helmets, one bending over and working on the ground, and the other standing and working on a wall section.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左侧有一台红色电动升降平台，周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括砖块、一块木板以及一个水桶。两名工人在场，均佩戴安全帽，其中一人弯腰在地面作业，另一人站立并在墙体段上作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large grid of rebar on the floor. Multiple workers are engaged in activities related to the rebar installation in the upper right. In the background, there are multiple construction materials and the base of a yellow crane.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，地面上铺设着大面积的钢筋网格。多名工人正在右上方参与钢筋安装作业。背景中可见多种建筑材料以及一台黄色色起重机的。

err.en: the base of a yellow crane

text: In the foreground, there is a muddy terrain with tire tracks crisscrossing the area. In the middle ground on the left, there is a concrete well, and further back, there is one person standing on the slope of an excavated area. On the right side of the image, an excavator is positioned on the edge of the excavation, with its arm extended and bucket raised. A stack of black corrugated pipes is to the right of the excavator. The background shows a large expanse of excavated earth with varying levels of elevation.
zh: 前景处是一片泥泞土地，上面布满轮胎印痕。中景左侧有一块混凝土，再往后方有一人站在开挖区域的斜坡面上。画面右侧，一台挖掘机停在开挖边缘，其臂架和铲斗被抬起。挖掘机右侧有一堆黑色波纹管。背景显示一片大面积开挖土方，具有不同高程。

text: In the center of the image, there is a yellow and black excavator positioned on a mound of earth. The excavator's arm is extended upwards, and it appears to be inactive at the moment. The surrounding area is a dirt terrain with various sizes of rocks and soil.
zh: 画面中央，一台黄黑相间的挖掘机停在一堆泥土堆上。挖掘机的臂向上伸展，看起来正处于作业状态。周围是泥土地地，散布着大小不一的岩石和泥土块。

err.en: it appears to be inactive at the moment
err.zh: 看起来正处于作业状态

text: The image shows a concrete pump truck positioned with its boom extended and hose hanging down; one worker is visible on the truck bed managing the hose. The construction site has scattered debris and construction materials, with an area of reinforced steel bars visible on the left.
zh: 图中显示一辆混凝土泵车，其泵和软管向下悬挂；一名工人可见于卡车床上管理着软管。建筑工地上散落着碎屑和建筑材料，左侧可见一片钢筋。

text: In the foreground, there is uneven, excavated ground with scattered debris and rocks. Moving towards the middle, four workers wearing yellow hard hats are working on a large rebar framework for a foundation or wall. One worker on the left is bending over the rebar, possibly tying it together, while the other three stand upright, working on different sections of the rebar structure.
zh: 前景中，地面平整，经过开挖，散落着碎石和岩石。向中部移动，四名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一个大型钢筋框架上作业，用于基础或墙体。左侧的一名工人正弯身跨越钢筋，可能将其绑扎在一起，而另外三名工人则直立站立，在钢筋结构的不同部位上作业。

text: In the foreground, a green dump truck is loaded with soil, positioned in the center of the image. To the left, another truck appears partially within the frame, fully loaded with soil. In the midground, two pile drivers are operating. The background shows construction materials such as precast concrete and construction equipment such as mobile cranes on the left.
zh: 前景中，一辆绿色自卸卡车装载着泥土，位于画面中央。左侧，另一辆卡车部分出现在画面框架内，满载着泥土。中景处，两名司机正在操作。背景中显示出建筑材料，如预制混凝土以及施工设备，如左侧的移动起重机。

text: The construction site seems to be in an early phase, with foundation work underway. Six workers are visible in the image. Three of them are in the foreground and three others in the background.
zh: 该施工现场似乎处于早期阶段，地基工程正在进行进行。图中可见六名工人。其中三人在前景，另外三人在背景中。

err.zh: 地基工程正在进行进行

text: The image shows a large wheel loader with its bucket raised, positioned on a mound of dirt. The operator is visible inside the cabin of the loader. To the right, there is an open concrete structure partially embedded in the ground in the lower right of the image. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, indicating recent activity.
zh: 图中显示一台大型轮式装载机，其铲斗已升起，停在一堆泥土上。操作员可见于装载机驾驶室内。右侧，有一处敞开的混凝土结构部分嵌入于地面，位于图像右下方。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹，表明近期有活动。

text: In the foreground, there is a pile driver mounted on a excavator chassis, surrounded by muddy terrain. In the middle, a tall, vertical rebar structure is being constructed. Behind these machines, a mobile crane is visible.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机底盘架上装载着一堆土方，周围是泥泞地。中部，一座高耸的垂直钢筋笼结构正在施工。在这些机械后方，可见一台移动式起重机。

err.en: a pile driver mounted on a excavator cha
err.zh: 一台挖掘机底盘架上装载着一堆土方

text: The image shows a construction site with a large pile of earth and an excavator on top. The excavator is a teal color with the model number SK210 marked on it. Behind it, there are additional piles of earth and construction debris.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有一大堆泥土，顶部有一台挖掘机。该挖掘机为青绿色，上面标有型号SK2-110。在其后方，还有额外的几堆泥土和建筑废料。

text: In the center of the image, there is a yellow bulldozer with tracks, actively moving earth on a construction site. The ground is uneven with various piles of dirt and mud, and there are some scattered branches and debris to the left of the bulldozer.
zh: 画面中央是一台带履带的黄色推土机，正在建筑工地上作业。地面较为平整，分布着若干堆泥土和泥浆，推土机左侧散落着一些树枝和碎屑。

text: The image shows approximately 18 workers spread across a construction site with snowy conditions. From the left to the right, several workers are wearing hard hats of various colors, such as yellow and red, and are engaged in different activities. Some are walking, while others are working with construction materials and tools. In the foreground, a few workers are handling what appears to be a concrete chute, guiding concrete into a formwork.
zh: 画面显示，在积雪天气条件下，约有十八名工人分散在一处建筑工地上。从左至右，若干名工人戴着不同颜色的，例如黄色和红色，的安全帽，并从事不同的活动。一些人在行走，而另一些人则在使用建筑材料和工具进行作业。在前景中，几名工人正在处理看似是混凝土搅拌车，引导混凝土进入一个成型作业。

text: The image shows an uneven dirt terrain with a surveying tripod on the left. Two workers are present; one is standing near the center wearing a black shirt and a blue hard hat, and the other is in the middle, wearing a white shirt and a white hard hat.
zh: 图像显示一片平坦的泥土地地，左侧有一架测量三脚架。现场有两名工人；其中一人站在靠近中心的位置，身穿黑色上衣，头戴蓝色安全帽，另一人位于画面中部，身穿白色上衣，头戴白色安全帽。

text: The image shows three workers engaged in construction activities within an interior space with exposed brick walls. One worker in the middle is standing on the tiling the brick wall, another is elevated on the scaffold laying bricks, and the third is standing on the right. The background features a metal staircase.
zh: 图像展示了三名工人在一处内部空间进行建筑施工活动，该空间内墙壁为裸露的砖墙。中间的一名工人站在瓦架上，正在铺设砖墙；另一名工人站在脚手架上，正在砌砖；第三名工人站在右侧。背景中设有一处金属楼梯。

err.en: standing on the tiling the brick wall

text: The image shows a large concrete slab in the trench with five workers. To the left, a retaining wall with metal sheet piles extends across the image, and an excavated area with mounds of earth is visible. To the right, another worker in an orange suit is handling rebar near a large stockpile of rebar bundles. There is a total of eight stacks of rebars on the embankment on the right. In the background, there are buildings and greenery above the retaining wall.
zh: 图中显示一块大型混凝土板位于沟槽内，共有五名工人。左侧，一道挡土墙，上面铺着金属板，横跨整个图像，并且一个挖掘区域，可见一堆泥土。右侧，另一名穿着橙色套装服的工人，正在处理一根钢筋，靠近一堆大型钢筋束。右侧总共放置着八根钢筋。在背景中，挡土墙上方有建筑物和绿植类。

text: The image shows a worker using a hammer to assemble white construction panels. To the right, the legs of three individuals can be seen. The ground is scattered with construction materials, including panels, metal beams, and wooden planks.
zh: 图中显示一名工人正使用锤子组装黑色建筑面板。右侧可见三个人的腿。地面散落着建筑材料，包括面板、金属梁和木托盘。

text: The image shows a large trench with a partially buried concrete pipe running through it. Two workers, one wearing a yellow hard hat and the other with a red hard hat, are standing near the edge of the trench in the upper left. An excavator bucket is visible on the right side, positioned over the trench, suggesting excavation work is in progress.
zh: 图中显示一条大型沟槽，一根混凝土管道部分埋设并穿过其中。两名工人，一人戴着黄色安全帽，另一人戴着红色安全帽，站在沟槽上缘的左侧。一台挖掘机在右侧可见，位于沟槽上方，表明挖掘工作正在进行中。

text: The image shows a large excavation pit with sloped sides. Four workers wearing hard hats are present within the pit and engaged in various activities. A worker is using a handtool and working on the slope. The surrounding area is fenced off with a barrier made of metal poles and green safety netting, and beyond the fence, vegetation and structures can be seen in the distance.
zh: 图像显示一个大型基坑，边坡坡呈斜坡状。坑内有四名头戴安全帽的工人，正从事各种作业。一名工人手持工具，在边坡坡上作业。周边区域由金属立柱和绿色安全网构成的围栏护，围栏外远处可见植被和建筑物。

text: In the image, there is a rocky excavation site with three workers on the left. Two workers are wearing white hard hats. One worker is standing, observing the site, while. A yellow Komatsu excavator is positioned on the right, with its bucket raised above a pile of rocks, indicating recent activity in moving or breaking up the rock material.
zh: 图像中是一个岩石采石场，左侧有三名工人。两名工人戴着白色安全帽。一名工人站着，观察着现场。一台黄色挖掘机位于右侧，其斗篷举在岩石堆上方，表明近期有移动或破碎岩石材料的活动。

text: The image shows an orange excavator and a yellow excavator positioned on uneven, muddy terrain.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机和一台黄色挖掘机停放在平坦、泥泞滑的地面上。

text: The image shows a yellow and red mobile crane parked on a wet road surface. The crane's telescopic boom is extended horizontally towards the right side of the image. A concrete flyover with two red lights is visible in the background. A tower crane is visible to the left.
zh: 画面中，一台黄红相的履带式起重机停放在潮湿滑的路面上。起重机的器的水平地伸向画面右侧。背景中可见一座混凝土飞罩，带有两盏红灯。画面左侧可见一座塔式起重机。

err.en: The crane's telescopic boom is extended
err.zh: 起重机的器的水平地伸向

text: The image shows a yellow pile driver actively driving piles into the ground, supported by two workers guiding the process near the pile. Two workers wearing orange safety vests are standing near the pile driver. A red and a blue excavator are to the left of the pile driver. In the background, power lines and greenery are visible.
zh: 图中显示，一名黄色司机正将土堆推入地面，由两名工人在土堆附近引导作业过程。两名身穿橙色安全背心的的工人站在土堆司机附近。一台红色和一台蓝色挖掘机位于土堆司机的左侧。在背景中，可见电力线和植被。

text: In the foreground, there is a dense array of vertical and horizontal rebars forming a grid-like structure, with scaffolding rising behind it. A mobile crane with its boom extended is positioned on the left side of the image. In the center, a tall yellow tower crane stands with its jib extending across the image. The construction site is surrounded by a green fence, and behind the fence, there is a large mound of earth with green netting partially covering it.
zh: 前景中，有一组密集的排列的竖向与横向钢筋，构成类似网格的结构，其后方有脚手架正在升起。一台移动式起重机，其吊臂向左延伸至画面左侧。画面中央，矗立着一座高耸的黄色塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨画面。施工现场四周被绿色围栏网所环绕，围栏网后方，有一大堆土方，部分被绿色网覆盖。

err.en: with its boom extended is positioned on
err.zh: 其吊臂向左延伸至画面左侧

text: The image shows a green dump truck loaded with red soil, positioned in the center of the image. To the left, a yellow bulldozer is visible, and behind it, there are large black pipes stacked horizontally. On the right side of the image, another yellow bulldozer is working near a pile of concrete segments.
zh: 画面中，一辆绿色自卸卡车装载着红色泥土，位于画面中央。在左侧，可以看到一台黄色压路机，在其后方，有大型黑色管道水平堆叠。在画面右侧，另一台黄色压路机正在一堆混凝土段附近作业。

text: The image shows a yellow mobile crane extending diagonally across the image. To the left, a group of workers is visible on and around a complex rebar structure. Bundles of rebars are scattered throughout the site. On the right, more rebar bundles are neatly arranged, and storage containers are placed in the background. The construction site appears active with various materials and equipment in use.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色移动式起重机斜向横跨整个画面。左侧可见一组工人，他们正围绕着一根复杂的钢筋作业。成束钢筋散落在工地各处。右侧，更多的钢筋束被整齐地排列，并且存储容器被放置在背景中。该施工现场看起来处于活跃状态，各种材料和设备正在使用中。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of reinforced steel bars laid out on the ground, forming a grid pattern. A red crane with a pile driver attachment is positioned to the left, and there are several blue and white striped tarps partially covering mounds of dirt in the background. To the right, a worker wearing an orange jacket is standing near the edge of the excavation area. Behind the tarps, residential buildings can be seen in the distance.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，地面上铺设着大片钢筋，形成网格状排列。一台红色吊车位于左侧，吊着桩基。背景中有一些蓝白相的土堆部分覆盖着泥土。右侧，一名身穿橙色夹克的工人站在开挖区域边缘附近。土堆后方，远处可见住宅建筑。

err.en: blue and white striped tarps partially c
err.zh: 蓝白相的土堆部分覆盖着泥土

text: The worker on the right is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 右侧的工人戴着一顶草帽，但并非一顶硬草帽。

text: In the foreground, there are multiple stacks of construction materials, including wooden planks and metal scaffolding poles, with two workers organizing the poles. Moving towards the middle ground, there are several workers engaged in various activities around the construction site, with some standing and others bending over their tasks amidst a dense array of vertical rebar structures.
zh: 前景中有多堆建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属脚手架杆，两名工人正在整理杆体，朝中间地面移动。中景处有数名工人正从事建筑工地周围的各种活动，有人站立，另一些人则俯身于任务之中，置身于密集的竖杆结构之间。

text:
Here is the trimmed caption:

In the foreground, a worker wearing a wide-brimmed hat is mixing concrete next to a column formwork, with a bucket and shovel at his feet. In the distance, there are green mesh barriers and a partially visible structure with multiple columns.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴宽边帽的工人正将混凝土拌合至柱状作业中，脚边放着一只桶和一把铲子。远处有绿色网状屏障，以及部分可见结构，带有多个柱体。

err.en: mixing concrete next to a column formwor
err.zh: 将混凝土拌合至柱状作业中

text: The image shows a paved road in the foreground, with a dump truck parked to the left and an excavator positioned on a mound of earth to the right, with its boom extended and bucket in the soil.
zh: 前景是一条铺装好的道路，左侧停着一辆自卸卡车，右侧有一台挖掘机位于土堆上，其吊斗和铲斗插在泥土中。

err.en: boom extended and bucket in the soil
err.zh: 吊斗和铲斗插在泥土中

text: In the foreground, there are multiple blue tarps covering the ground, with some piles of dirt visible between them. In the center of the image stands a tall red pile driver with a blue drilling apparatus attached. There is one worker visible, wearing a red shirt and a helmet, operating the pile driver from a seated position.
zh: 前景中，多辆蓝色拖拉机停在地面上，它们之间可见一些土堆。画面中央立着一台高大的红色钻机，上面装有蓝色钻探装置。可见一名工人，身穿红色上衣并戴着头盔，正坐在操作该钻机器的上。

err.en: multiple blue tarps covering the ground
err.zh: 多辆蓝色拖拉机停在地面上

err.en: operating the pile driver from a seated
err.zh: 正坐在操作该钻机器的上

text: The image shows a construction site with a network of rebar laid out on the ground. Two workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests are present; one is bending over the rebar, and the other is walking across the site. In the midground, there are multiple vertical formworks in place, suggesting the preparation for concrete pouring. In the background, high-rise buildings dominate the skyline, and a tower crane is visible on the right side. There are blue tarps and construction materials scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，地面上铺设着钢筋网。两名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人在场；其中一人正弯腰操作钢筋，另一人正行走在工地上。场地中部，有多处垂直的模板，暗示着混凝土浇筑的准备。背景中，高层建筑主导着天际线，右侧可见一台塔式起重机。现场散落着蓝色图纸纸和建筑材料。

text: The image shows a concrete pump truck with an extended boom over a construction site with several foundation pits outlined with rebar frameworks. A concrete mixer truck is parked near the pump truck, likely supplying concrete. There are at least seven workers scattered across the site, some near the pump truck and others by the rebar frameworks.
zh: 图中显示一辆混凝土泵车，其上方装有伸缩式料斗，位于一处施工现场，该工地设有多个基坑，并用钢筋框架进行围护。一辆混凝土搅拌车停靠在泵车附近，很可能用于供应混凝土。现场至少有七名工人分散各处，部分靠近泵车，其余人员位于钢筋框架附近。

text: The image shows an excavation area with exposed earth and wooden supports. Two workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests are present; one is maneuvering a wheelbarrow, and the other is standing on a wooden platform surrounded by bricks.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖区域，露出泥土和木质支撑。两名工人佩戴黄色安全帽和高能见度背心，其中一人正在操作一台轮式挖掘机，另一人站在木质平台上，周围环绕着砖块。

text: In the foreground, a pile driver is mounted on a truck, actively engaged in driving piles into the ground. Behind it, a bulldozer is visible, stationed on the construction site with muddy terrain. The background is overcast, and the construction site appears to be in an early phase with no completed structures.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机装载在卡车上，正积极地将土堆推入地面。其后方，一台推土机可见，停放在施工场地的面上，地面泥泞滑。背景被投射，且该施工场地似乎处于早期阶段，无已完成结构。

text: In the center of the image, a yellow bulldozer is actively engaged in earthmoving operations, with its blade partially submerged in a mound of soil. To the left of the bulldozer, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is visible, standing on the ground. The background features a landscape with multiple residential buildings in various stages of construction, and the terrain appears to be a large, open construction site with disturbed soil indicating ongoing work.
zh: 画面中央，一台黄色压路机正在进行土方作业，其刀片部部分埋入土堆中。压路机左侧，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人清晰可见，站立于地面之上。背景呈现一片景观，包含多栋处于不同施工阶段的住宅建筑，地形看似为一处大型、敞开的之施工场地，受扰动的土壤表明持续作业中。

err.zh: 大型、敞开的之施工场地

text: The image shows a dense network of scaffolding and construction framework with numerous workers throughout the site. In the foreground, there are large stacks of wooden planks and construction materials. Moving towards the middle, there are at least a dozen workers wearing hard hats, some are climbing on the scaffolding while others are walking through the site.
zh: 图像显示了一个密集的脚手架与施工框架网络，整个工地遍布着众多工人。前景处有大型木托盘堆和建筑材料。向画面中部看去，至少有上百名戴着安全帽的工人，其中一些正攀爬在脚手架上，而另一些则穿行于工地之中。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests engaged in various activities. A tower crane is positioned on the right, lifting a large metal container. There are several piles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, as well as green waste bins and a bicycle.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有多名头戴安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人正在从事各种活动。一台塔式起重机位于右侧，正在吊运一个大型金属容器。现场有几堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘，此外还有绿色废料箱和一辆自行车。

text: The image shows a construction site viewed from above. Starting from the left, there is one worker near some construction materials on the ground. Moving right, a group of six workers wearing safety vests are gathered around a structure with several cables running across the ground.
zh: 从上方看，这是一个建筑工地。从左边开始，有一名工人靠近地面上的一些建筑材料。往右移动，一群穿着安全背心的的工人聚集在地面上横跨的几根电缆周围。

err.zh: 一群穿着安全背心的的工人

text: In the foreground, a worker is bending over to pick up rocks. Moving right, three workers with yellow and red hard hats are standing and walking among the rocks, with one holding a long pole. In the midground, two workers are on a raised platform with a blue tarp, one of whom is handling materials. In the background, against a rocky cliff, there is a structure with red banners, and additional construction materials are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 前景中，一名工人正弯腰拾起一块岩石。右侧，三名头戴黄色、红色安全帽的工人在岩石间穿行，其中一人手持一根长杆。中景处，两名工人站在铺有蓝色防水布的抬升平台上，其中一人正在搬运材料。背景中，对着岩壁，悬挂有红色横幅幅，且施工现场各处散落有额外的建筑材料。

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer positioned on muddy terrain with visible tracks in the soil, indicating recent movement. The ground is uneven with various piles of dirt and some debris, including branches and a piece of flat material.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色推土机停放在泥泞土地上，地面上可见车辙印在泥土中，表明最近有移动。地面平坦，有各种土堆和一些碎片，包括树枝和一块扁平材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers and equipment. Starting from the left, one worker is near a pile of materials, and a telehandler is positioned with its boom extended towards the center, where a group of workers is gathered around a formwork structure. There are wooden planks, rebars, and construction materials scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人和设备。从左侧开始，一名工人靠近一堆材料，一台塔式起重机位于其吊臂向中心延伸，那里有一组工人聚集在一个成型结构周围。现场散落着木托盘、钢筋和建筑材料。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator positioned on the left side of a dirt road with its boom extended to the right. Moving towards the background, the dirt road leads to a construction area where one worker wearing a red shirt is walking along the road, and another worker is standing near a blue vehicle on the right side of the road.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色挖掘机位于土路左侧，其履带向右延伸，朝向背景中的施工区域移动。背景里，一名身穿红色上衣的工人正沿着道路行走，另一名工人站在道路右侧一辆蓝色车辆附近。

err.en: Moving towards the background, the dirt
err.zh: 朝向背景中的施工区域移动

text: The image shows an excavated area with visible brown soil and construction debris. A blue excavator is positioned near the center, with a worker visible beside it. A large pile-driving machine with its boom extended diagonally upward is to the right of the excavator. In the background, various other pieces of construction equipment are partially visible.
zh: 画面显示一片开挖区域，可见褐色土壤和建筑废料。一台蓝色挖掘机位于画面中央附近，旁边可见一名工人。一台大型推土机械以其对角线向上延伸至挖掘机的右侧。背景中，其他各种施工设备部分可见。

text: The image shows a yellow wheel loader actively engaged in earthmoving operations, with its bucket partially filled with red soil. Behind the loader, there is a body of water, and on the far side of the water, vegetation and a sloped terrain are visible.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色轮式装载机正在进行土方作业，其铲斗内部分装有红色土壤。装载机后方有一堆水，在水体的远侧可见植被和倾斜地形。

text: The image shows two excavators, one actively digging and the other at rest, in a large muddy area with standing water and scattered debris.
zh: 画面中有两名挖掘机操作员，一人正在积极挖掘，另一人处于休息状态，现场是一片泥泞地，伴有积水和散落的物。

text: In the foreground, a white and black Genlyon dump truck with a green tarp covering its load is parked on a dirt road. To the left of the truck, there is a speed limit sign indicating 30 km/h, and behind it, there is a tall cell tower. Vegetation is visible on both sides of the truck, and a fence runs parallel to the road on the left side.
zh: 前景中，一辆黑白相间的通用自卸卡车停靠在土路上，绿色篷布覆盖着货物。卡车左侧有一个限速标志，显示30 km/h，其后方有一座高大的细胞塔。植被在卡车两侧可见，栅栏沿着道路左侧延伸。

text: The image shows a large white geomembrane liner covering the ground, with a dirt path cutting through the center where multiple workers are spread out, handling sacks filled with material. A yellow bulldozer is visible to the right of the path, and further back, another piece of heavy machinery is present.
zh: 画面显示一条大型白色土工膜管，覆盖地面，中间有一条泥土路穿过，多名工人分散开来，处理装满材料的的手提袋。路径右侧可见一台黄色压路机，更后方还有一台重型机械。

text: The image shows several workers wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats distributed across a multi-level construction site. Starting from the bottom left, two workers are on a scaffold with steel rebar structures above them. Moving to the right, one worker is climbing a ladder, while another stands on a platform above. Various construction materials, such as rebars and protective netting, are visible throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示，在一个多层建筑工地上，有多名工人佩戴红色安全帽和黄色安全帽。从左下角开始，两名工人位于钢架结构上方的脚手架上。向右移动，一名工人正在攀爬梯子，而另一名工人站在上方平台上。整个工地现场可见各种建筑材料，如钢筋和防护网。

err.en: wearing red overalls and yellow hard hat
err.zh: 佩戴红色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: In the foreground, there is a large area covered with rebar mesh next to which four workers are visible, with one operating a yellow bulldozer. A yellow mobile crane is positioned centrally, while a white flatbed truck is parked near blue storage containers in the midground. The background features a river and dense greenery.
zh: 前景中，有一大片被钢筋网覆盖的大面积，其后可见四名工人，其中一人正在操作一台黄色压路机。一台黄色移动式起重机位于中央，而一辆白色平板卡车停靠在中景处蓝色集装箱附近。背景中有一条河流和茂密的植被。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a brown jacket, blue jeans, and a yellow hard hat is kneeling and working on a steel rebar grid on a concrete surface. To the right, a series of wheelbarrows are lined up against a white barrier wall. In the background, there is a blue structure with a red beam across it, and a pile of materials is partially visible.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿棕色夹克、蓝色牛仔裤并头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在混凝土表面，对着一根钢筋网格进行作业。右侧，一排钢筋排放在白色挡墙前。背景中，有一根蓝色结构梁横跨其上，且部分材料堆隐约可见。

err.en: a blue structure with a red beam across
err.zh: 一根蓝色结构梁横跨其上

text: The image shows a pile driver with a worker standing beside it on the left, and another pile driver is positioned in the center. An excavator with an operator is visible to the right.
zh: 画面左侧有一堆司机，旁边站着一名工人，画面中央还有另一堆司机，右侧可见一台挖掘机及其操作员。

text: The worker on the left is in the blind spot of the excavator.
zh: 左侧的工人处于挖掘机的器的盲区。

text: In the center of the image, there is a single bulldozer on a dirt track, surrounded by rough terrain with various piles of soil and debris. The bulldozer appears to be engaged in earthmoving activities, as evidenced by the disturbed soil in front of its blade and the tread marks on the ground.
zh: 画面中央是一台正在土路上作业的的道尔，周围是崎岖不平坦的土路，散布着各种土堆和碎石。从它刀片前被扰动的土以及地面上留下的轮胎印迹来看，这台道尔似乎正在进行土方作业。

err.zh: 一台正在土路上作业的的道尔

text: The image shows two pile drivers, one vertical and one angled, with a worker visible near the base of the vertical pile driver. Several construction vehicles, including a yellow crane, a concrete pump truck, and a flatbed truck, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图中显示两堆桩基，一根竖直放置，另一根倾斜放置，一名工人出现在竖直桩基的底部附近。现场周围散布着多台施工车辆，包括一台黄色起重机、一辆混凝土泵送卡车和一辆平板卡车。

text: The image features a yellow tower crane against a cloudy sky. The crane's vertical tower is equipped with ladders and platforms for access. At the top, the horizontal jib extends from left to right, with a trolley and hook mechanism visible along its length. The counterjib, which balances the crane's structure, is on the left side with counterweights attached.
zh: 画面中，一台黄色塔式起重机矗立在多云的天空背景下。起重机的垂直塔身配备有梯子和平台以供通行。在顶部，水平吊臂从左向右延伸，沿其长度可见一台小车和挂钩机构。配重，用于平衡起重机结构，位于左侧，并附有配重。

err.en: The counterjib, which balances the crane
err.zh: 配重，用于平衡起重机结构，位于左侧，并附有配重。

text: In the foreground, there is a pile of grey concrete blocks on the left and uneven, dug-up ground with some debris. In the center, a yellow wheel loader is parked, and a person wearing dark clothing is standing by the loader's rear. On the right, there is a white van with its rear doors open and another person standing facing the van's interior.
zh: 前景左侧有一堆灰色混凝土块，地面平整，并挖起一些碎屑。中央停放着一辆黄色轮装载机，一名身穿深色衣物的人站在装载机后方。右侧有一辆白色厢式货车，其后门敞开，另一人正面向车厢内站立。

err.en: uneven, dug-up ground with some debris
err.zh: 地面平整，并挖起一些碎屑

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of rebars on the ground and a rusted drum with a hose and a thermos on top. Six workers are spread out within an excavated area with a steep dirt wall, some standing and others digging or working with the soil.
zh: 现场堆放着一堆钢筋，地面上有一台带锈迹的卷扬机，上面放着一台热成像仪。六名工人分散在开挖区域内，周围是陡峭的土墙，有的站着，有的正在挖掘或操作着泥土。

err.en: a rusted drum with a hose and a thermos
err.zh: 一台带锈迹的卷扬机，上面放着一台热成像仪

err.en: The image shows a construction site

text: The image shows a construction site with numerous workers preparing for a concrete pour. Two yellow tower cranes stand prominently on the site. In the background, an excavated area with red-brown earth is visible, and beyond that, there are buildings and trees with yellow foliage.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，众多工人正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。两台黄色塔式起重机在工地上显著地矗立着。在背景中，一个挖掘区域露出红褐色泥土，并且在那之外，有建筑物和长着黄色叶子的叶子的树木。

err.zh: 长着黄色叶子的叶子的树木

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers engaged in various activities. Starting from the left, one worker is carrying a long rod, walking along a path with debris scattered around. Moving to the right, a group of workers in orange and yellow safety gear is assembling rebar frameworks for concrete structures. Further to the right, two workers are bending over, working on the rebar grid on the ground. In the background, there is a terraced excavation area with more workers and a crane visible in the distance.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在进行各种作业。从左侧开始，一名工人扛着一根长杆，沿着散落着碎屑的路行走。向右移动，一群穿着橙色和黄色安全装备的工人正在组装钢筋框架。再往右，两名工人正弯着身子，在地面上的操作钢筋网格。在背景中，有一处带围栏的挖掘区域，远处可见更多工人和一台起重机。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with a yellow excavator prominently positioned, its bucket partially submerged in the mud. Two additional excavators are visible in the background, one partially obscured by the first. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and puddles of water.
zh: 图中显示一处泥泞地施工现场，一台黄色挖掘机显著地停在那里，其铲斗部分浸在泥中。背景中可见另外两台挖掘机，其中一台部分被第一台遮挡。地面平坦，可见轮胎痕迹和水坑。

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of excavated earth with a yellow bulldozer on the left and an orange excavator on the right, both positioned on top of the mound. The construction is taking place under an overpass, and beyond the work area, there are parked cars and a fence visible in the background.
zh: 前景中有一大堆挖掘出的来的泥土，左侧有一台黄色推土机，右侧有一台橙色挖掘机，两者都位于土堆顶部。施工在一条过路下方进行，而在施工区域之外，背景中可见停放的汽车和围栏。

text: In the center of the image, there is an orange excavator positioned on a slope, actively engaged in digging or moving earth. The excavator is surrounded by loose soil and rock debris, indicative of recent excavation work. The terrain appears uneven with various shades of brown, suggesting different soil layers or materials.
zh: 图像中央有一台橙色挖掘机停靠在斜坡面上，正在进行积极挖掘或搬运泥土。挖掘机周围散落着松散的土壤和岩石碎屑，表明近期有挖掘作业。地形看起来平整，带有各种棕色色调调，暗示不同的土层或材料。

text: The image shows a dirt road leading towards a cement mixer truck parked on the right side, with its drum facing the camera. Piles of red bricks line the edge of the road on the right. Beyond the truck, large mounds of earth are visible, and in the distance, construction activity with cranes and partially constructed buildings can be seen under an overcast sky.
zh: 一条土路通向右侧停放的一辆水泥搅拌车，其搅拌鼓朝向镜头。右侧路边堆着红砖。卡车之外可见大片广阔的土地，远处在阴沉天之下能看到施工活动，伴有起重机和部分建成的建筑。

text: In the foreground, there is an orange pile driver positioned on muddy terrain with various construction materials scattered around, such as pipes and wooden planks. In the midground, to the left, there is a blue tarp partially covering some materials, and to the right, there is a green tower crane. In the background, another crane is visible, and there are multiple construction elements and structures, suggesting an active construction site with multiple ongoing operations.
zh: 前景中，有一堆橙色管材位于泥泞土地之上，周围散落着各种建筑材料，如管道和木托盘。中景左侧，有一块蓝色防水布部分覆盖着一些材料，右侧则是一台绿色塔式起重机。背景中，另一台起重机清晰可见，且存在多种建筑构件与结构，暗示着一处正在进行多项作业的的施工工地。

text: Four workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are walking along a dirt path next to a construction site. They are moving away from the camera, with three of them in a line and one slightly ahead. In the background, there is an excavation area with retaining walls and what appears to be a concrete foundation or structure.
zh: 四名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色安全帽的工人正沿着一条土路走向一处建筑工地。他们正背对镜头移动，其中三人走在前面，另外三人略微靠前。背景中有一处开挖区域，带有挡土墙，看起来像是混凝土基础或结构。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and yellow hard
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色安全帽

err.en: three of them in a line and one slightly
err.zh: 其中三人走在前面，另外三人略微靠前

text: The image shows a green dump truck loaded with dirt, positioned on the left side of the image. In the midground, another dump truck is visible, and it appears to be in the process of being loaded with dirt by a yellow wheel loader. The ground is uneven and covered with dirt, indicative of an active construction site.
zh: 图像显示一辆绿色自卸卡车装载着泥土，位于图像的左侧。在中间地面上，另一辆自卸卡车可见，并且似乎正在被一辆黄色轮装载机装载泥土。地面是平整的，并且覆盖着泥土，表明这是一个活跃的的建筑场地。

text: The image shows nine workers on a construction site working with steel reinforcement bars for a concrete structure. All workers are wearing safety helmets and vests, and the background shows a soil embankment.
zh: 图片显示，在一个建筑工地上，九名工人正在使用钢筋钢筋进行混凝土结构施工。所有工人都戴着安全帽和背心，背景显示一个土埋设。

text: The image shows several uprooted trees and bundled branches on the ground. Five workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests are gathered around a piece of construction equipment, possibly discussing or planning.
zh: 地面上竖立着几棵被砍伐过的根部的并捆绑着枝条的树木。五名头戴安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人正围着一台施工设备，可能正在讨论或规划。

err.zh: 竖立着几棵被砍伐过的根部的

text: In the foreground, two workers wearing yellow hard hats are handling materials; one is kneeling and arranging green plastic spacers on a rebar grid, while the other is standing and pushing a wheelbarrow. Behind them, another worker in a brown jacket is also arranging spacers on the grid.
zh: 前景中，两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在搬运材料；其中一人跪着，将绿色塑料垫块码放在钢筋网格上，另一人站着，推着一个轮辐。在他们身后，另一名身穿棕色夹克的工人也在将垫块码放在网格上。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing an orange safety vest and a yellow hard hat is standing inside a formwork structure with vertical and horizontal rebar in place, seemingly inspecting or working on the rebar. Behind the worker, there are more rebar structures and formworks, with some wooden planks and construction materials scattered around.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿橙色安全背心、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在由竖直和水平杆件构成的的一处结构内，似乎正在检查或操作该结构。在工人身后，还有更多结构件和施工，周围散落着一些木质托盘子和建筑材料。

text: The image shows four workers with hard hats on a rebar grid foundation, tying rebar or preparing it for concrete pouring. Behind them, a worker in a maroon jacket is standing amidst vertical rebar rods. A yellow tower crane is visible in the background, with trees and blue sky above the construction site.
zh: 画面显示四名头戴安全帽的工人站在钢筋网格基础上，正在绑扎钢筋或为混凝土浇筑做准备。在他们身后，一名身穿蓝色夹克的工人站在竖直钢筋杆之间。背景中可见一台黄色塔式起重机，上方有树木和蓝天。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a white hard hat and orange clothing is interacting with the bucket of a yellow excavator. The excavator is positioned on a mound of earth, and the worker appears to be performing a task on the bucket's underside. The background is a flat, cleared area with a brownish hue, likely due to the soil composition or work being done in the area.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿橙色工作服的工人正与一台黄色挖掘机的上的的一只桶进行互动。该挖掘机停在一堆土堆上，工人似乎正在桶的下方执行某项任务。背景是一片平坦、开阔的区域，呈棕褐色调，可能源于土壤成分或该区域已完成的作业。

err.en: the bucket of a yellow excavator

text: The image shows seven workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats laying rebars to form a grid on a concrete base. One worker is guiding a long rebar pole. In the background, there is a trench with retaining walls on either side, and beyond the trench, there is greenery and a blue fence.
zh: 图中显示七名身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人，正将钢筋铺设成混凝土基础上的网格。其中一名工人正在引导一根长钢筋。背景中，有一道带挡土墙的体的沟渠，沟渠外侧有绿植和一道蓝色围栏。

err.en: a trench with retaining walls on either
err.zh: 一道带挡土墙的体的沟渠

text: The image shows an excavator operating in the center, with a worker in a yellow vest nearby. To the right, there are several workers grouped together, handling materials. Various construction materials, including large pipes and wooden planks, are scattered across the site.
zh: 画面中央有一台挖掘机正在作业，旁边有一名身穿黄色背心的的工人。右侧有几名工人聚在一起，正在搬运材料。各种建筑材料，包括大型管道和木托盘，散落在工地各处。

text: The image shows a complex scaffolding structure within an unfinished concrete building, with several workers engaged in activities among the scaffolding. Above the scaffolding, concrete beams and columns form the partial structure of the building. A yellow excavator is positioned on an elevated dirt area adjacent to the construction site, and a perimeter fence and some vegetation are noticeable in the background.
zh: 图像显示一栋已完工混凝土建筑内部的复杂的脚手架结构，几名工人正在脚手架间从事活动。脚手架上方，混凝土梁和柱构成建筑的部分结构。一台黄色挖掘机位于施工场地旁的高起的土地区，背景中可见周边围栏和一些植被。

text: The image shows a dirt road leading towards the construction area, lined with mounds of excavated earth. In the middle ground, construction equipment, including a red dump truck and a yellow excavator, are visible.
zh: 一条土路通向施工区域，两侧堆着挖掘出的来的泥土。在中间地面上，施工设备，包括一辆红色泵车和一台黄色挖掘机，是可见。

text: The image shows a construction site with a worker in the foreground, bundles of rebars covered with a blue and white striped tarp, and multiple workers carrying rebar frames, handling rebars, and pushing wheelbarrows.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景处有一名工人，成束钢筋被蓝白条纹防水布覆盖，还有多名工人搬运钢筋框架、处理钢筋以及推动钢筋排。

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven, excavated terrain. Six individuals are present, including those holding a surveying rod, clipboard, and shovel, all wearing hard hats.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地形平整且经过开挖。六个人在场，包括那些手持测量杆、写字板和铁锹的人，所有人都戴着安全帽。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator positioned on a mound of reddish-brown soil. The excavator's arm is extended and the bucket is touching the ground. In the middle ground, there is another excavator facing away, and various construction materials are scattered across the site. In the background, amidst a hazy sky, the outlines of construction structures and vehicles are visible.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色挖掘机停在一堆红褐色泥土堆上。挖掘机的臂伸出，铲斗触地面。中景处，另一台挖掘机背向，各种建筑材料散落在工地各处。背景中，在朦胧天空下，建筑轮廓与车辆清晰可见。

err.zh: 建筑轮廓与车辆清晰可见

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of sand and some construction debris. Two mobile cranes are visible, one with a telescopic boom extended upwards and the other with its boom extended horizontally. A tower crane is positioned in the center of the image with its jib extending across the frame. There are multiple concrete columns with scaffolding in the background, and some appear to be under construction with rebar protruding from the top.
zh: 前景处有一大堆沙土及部分建筑废料。可见两台履带式起重机，其中一台的吊臂向上伸展，另一台的则水平伸出。一台塔式起重机位于画面中央，其吊臂横跨整个画面。背景中有多根混凝土立柱，带有脚手架，部分似乎正在施工中，顶部有钢筋突出。

text: The image shows four workers wearing orange safety vests and hard hats working on a large rebar structure that is part of a foundation or wall framework. A concrete pump with a red boom is visible on the right side of the image. In the background, there is a body of water and a green area with trees and a fence.
zh: 图像显示四名工人身穿橙色安全背心，头戴安全帽，正在一座大型钢筋结构上作业，该结构是基础或墙体框架的一部分。图像右侧可见一台混凝土泵，带有红色喇叭。背景中有一片水域和一片带有树木及围栏网的片的绿色区域。

err.en: a green area with trees and a fence
err.zh: 一片带有树木及围栏网的片的绿色区域

text: In the image, there are two large yellow tower cranes with horizontal booms against a hazy sky. The crane on the left has a blue operator cabin, and both cranes have counterweights and are hoisting construction materials. Below the cranes, there is a multi-level construction site with extensive scaffolding and numerous vertical rebar rods protruding from the concrete structures.
zh: 图中有两台大型黄色塔式起重机，其水平吊臂伸向一片朦胧的天空。左侧的起重机带有蓝色操作室，两台起重机均配有配重块，并装载着建筑用材料。在起重机下方，是一处多层建筑施工场地，拥有大量脚手架以及从混凝土结构中体中伸出的众多垂直钢筋杆。

err.zh: 从混凝土结构中体中伸出

text: In the foreground, there is a large expanse of muddy terrain with tire tracks. On the left, a worker is walking beside a green dump truck. Further back, two more green dump trucks are positioned on an elevated dirt road, with one truck appearing to be unloading. In the center, there is a large, unfinished multi-story building. To the right, a tower crane stands beside the building, with its jib extending towards the top right corner of the image.
zh: 前景中有一大片泥泞土地，上面布满轮胎印迹。左侧有一名工人正行走在绿色泵车旁。更远处，两辆绿色泵车停在一处较高的土路上，其中一辆车似乎未装载货物。画面中央有一栋大型未完工多层建筑。右侧有一台塔式起重机矗立在建筑旁，其吊臂伸向画面右上角。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow perimeter fence with vertical bars and a horizontal top rail. Behind the fence, there are multiple construction materials, including bundles of rebars and covered equipment. A large mobile crane with its boom extended is positioned in the center, with its hook hanging down. To the right of the crane, there is a red boom truck and a yellow bulldozer.
zh: 前景中有一道黄色围栏，带有竖向栏杆和顶部水平轨道。围栏后有多处建筑材料，包括成束的钢筋和覆盖设备。一台大型移动式起重机位于中央，其吊臂向下伸出，吊钩垂下。起重机右侧有一辆红色自卸卡车和一台黄色推土机。

text: The image shows a yellow wheel loader with its bucket raised, positioned in the center of the image. The loader is facing right and appears to be carrying a load of dirt. Behind the loader, there is a large mound of excavated earth. In the background, utility poles and trees are visible, and there are vehicles parked in the distance. The ground is uneven and muddy, and there are scattered construction materials, such as metal beams, in the lower part of the image.
zh: 画面中是一台黄色轮式装载机，其铲斗处于抬起状态，位于画面中央。装载机朝向右侧，似乎装载着一车泥土。装载机后方有一大堆挖掘出的泥土。背景中可见电线杆和树木，远处停放着车辆。地面平坦且泥泞滑，下部散落着施工材料，如金属梁。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy

text: In the foreground, there is a muddy terrain with scattered construction materials, including wooden planks and what appears to be concrete slabs. Two excavators are positioned on either side of the image, engaged in earthmoving activities. In the background, a series of high-rise buildings under construction can be seen, with a tower crane visible in the distance.
zh: 前景中是一片泥泞土地，散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘和看似混凝土板的东西。两名挖掘机手位于画面两侧，正在进行土方作业。背景中可以看到一系列在建的高层建筑，远处可见一台塔式起重机。

text: In the foreground, there are various construction materials, including orange pipes, black corrugated pipes, and wooden planks. Two workers wearing yellow hard hats are walking across the site. In the midground, there are large concrete pipes lying horizontally. An excavator is operating to the right, near a pile of earth and a partially demolished brick building.
zh: 前景中有多种建筑材料，包括橙色管道、黑色波纹管以及木托盘。两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正行走在工地上。中景处有大型混凝土管水平放置。一台挖掘机正在右侧作业，靠近一堆泥土和一座部分拆除的砖砌建筑。

text: The image shows a concrete mixer truck positioned next to a deep foundation pit, with its chute extended over the edge to pour concrete. Three workers are present around the truck; one is guiding the chute, another is observing, and the third is walking away from the truck.
zh: 一辆混凝土搅拌车正驶向一个深基坑，其料斗架越过边缘以浇筑混凝土。三名工人在卡车周围；一人正在引导料斗架，另一人正在观察，第三人正走开离卡车而去。

text: The image shows road construction equipment and several workers. A yellow tracked paver is laying asphalt with a worker operating it, while a worker in a white shirt and hat oversees the process. Two workers in camouflage and straw hats are using shovels near the paver.
zh: 图中展示了道路施工设备和多名工人。一台黄色压路机正在铺设沥青，一名工人正在操作它，同时一名身穿白色衬衫、头戴帽子的的工作人员正在监督施工过程。两名身穿迷彩服、头戴草帽的工人正在压路机附近使用铁锹。

text: The image shows a construction site with workers in various stages of activity. In the foreground, a worker in a green jacket is hosing down the ground, while another in an orange jacket is kneeling and working with bricks. In the midground, two workers in green jackets are standing near a pile of bricks, with one appearing to be supervising. The construction site features a large retaining wall in the background, several piles of bricks, and concrete structures at various stages of completion.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，工人正处于不同的作业阶段。前景中，一名身穿绿色夹克的工人正蹲在地上，另一名身穿橙色夹克的工人则跪在地上，正用砖块作业。中景处，两名身穿绿色夹克的工人站在一大堆砖块附近，其中一人似乎正在监督。该建筑工地背景中设有一堵大型挡土墙，若干堆砖块，以及处于不同完工阶段的的具体结构的。

err.en: concrete structures at various stages of

text: In the foreground, a yellow bulldozer is positioned on reddish-brown soil, with its blade partially submerged in the earth. In the background, there is one worker visible, wearing a blue jacket, walking on the construction site.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色压路机停放在红褐色泥土上，其刀片部部分埋入土中。背景中，可见一名工人，身穿蓝色夹克，行走在建筑工地上。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on a pile of debris in the center, with its arm extended towards a dump truck on the right. Behind the excavator, a steep, rocky slope is visible. In front of the excavator, there is a stone retaining wall, and below that, some construction materials are scattered along the base.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机位于一堆碎石中央，其臂伸向右侧的一辆自卸卡车。挖掘机后方可见一处陡峭的岩石边坡坡。挖掘机前方有一道石挡土墙，其下方一些建筑材料散落在基上。

err.zh: 一处陡峭的岩石边坡坡

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on a dirt road with its boom and bucket raised. The excavator is facing a large mound of earth, and there are no visible operators or other workers around it. The background shows a cleared area with a gentle slope and overcast sky.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在一处土路上，其动臂和铲斗已升起。挖掘机正对着一大堆土，周围没有可见操作员或其他工人。背景显示一片开阔区域，带有平缓坡面及晴朗天空。

text: The image shows two workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats at a construction site. One worker is standing inside a large concrete structure on the left, holding a bucket, while the other is outside on the right, holding a tool. Above the structure, there is a pile of sand and several wooden planks.
zh: 图片显示两名建筑工人，他们戴着橙色护目镜和黄色安全帽。一名工人站在左侧的大型混凝土结构内，手持一个桶，而另一名工人站在右侧外部，手持一件工具。在结构上方，有一堆沙子和几块木板。

text: The image shows a concrete surface with rebar and cables, a bulldozer on the left, and an excavator operating in the center. There are three workers, one on a sloped wall and two on the ground, one holding a hose. The background features a large retaining wall with a patterned design, and the environment appears dusty or foggy.
zh: 画面显示一处混凝土表面，上面有钢筋和电缆，左侧有一台打桩机，中间有一台挖掘机在作业。共有三名工人，一名在倾斜的墙面上，两名在地面上，其中一人拿着一根软管子。背景中有一面大型挡土墙，带有图案化的设计，环境显得尘土大或雾大。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a blue hard hat and gloves is handling materials near a stack of wooden planks. Behind the worker, a concrete wall with yellow guardrails is visible, and a red fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴蓝色安全帽、手戴手套的工人正在处理材料，身旁堆放着一堆木托盘。工人身后可见一面混凝土墙，墙上装有黄色护栏，并挂着一具红色灭火器。

text: In the foreground, a yellow bulldozer is actively moving soil, with a green dump truck positioned to its left. In the midground, there are large concrete pipes stacked on the left and right sides, with additional construction equipment, including another bulldozer, visible in the background. The background also features a body of water and a high-rise building under construction, with a crane visible in the distance.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色推土机正在积极作业，其左侧停着一辆绿色泵车。中景处，左侧和右侧堆叠着大型混凝土管道，并伴有额外的施工设备，包括另一台推土机，在背景中可见。背景中还有一台水车和一座正在施工的高层建筑，远处可见一台起重机。

text: The image shows a muddy terrain with puddles of water. Two excavators are positioned in the middle of the image, one on the left appears stationary, while the one on the right is actively digging and lifting mud.
zh: 图像显示一片泥泞土地，上面有水坑。两名挖掘者位于图像中央，左侧的一位看起来是静止的，而右边一位正在积极挖掘并提起泥土。

text: The image shows two workers wearing red overalls and safety harnesses standing on a scaffold platform attached to a multi-story building under construction. A mobile crane with the brand "ZOOMLION" on its side is parked next to a stockpile of construction materials, including yellow and blue tarped items, wooden planks, and steel rebars.
zh: 画面中，两名工人身穿红色工装服，佩戴安全吊带，站在附着于多层建筑下方的施工脚手架平台上。一台侧面印有“ZOOM LION”品牌标识的移动起重机停放在施工材料堆旁，其中包括黄色和蓝色打包物品、木托盘以及钢条。

err.zh: 多层建筑下方的施工脚手架平台

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of brown dirt and scattered construction materials in the foreground. Two workers wearing hard hats are visible, one standing inside a structure with steel beams and the other bending over working on a ledge. In the background, there is a partially constructed building with scaffolding and more steel structures.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有一堆棕色泥土和散落的着的建筑材料。可见两名头戴安全帽的工人，其中一人站在带有钢梁的结构内，另一人正弯腰在脚手架上作业。背景中有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有脚手架和更多钢结构。

text: In the foreground, there is a pile of broken concrete on the pavement. Three workers are engaged in activities: one on the left wearing a yellow hard hat is holding a shovel, and the other two in the center are operating a jackhammer to break the pavement, both wearing red hard hats and ear protection.
zh: 前景中，路面上有一堆破碎的混凝土。三名工人正在从事活动：左侧一名头戴黄色安全帽，手持铁锹；中间另外两名头戴红色安全帽并佩戴护耳器，正操作大锤以破碎路面。

text: The image shows a yellow Komatsu excavator engaged in earthmoving activities within a large excavation site. The excavator's arm is extended, and its bucket is in contact with the ground, suggesting active work. The surrounding area is characterized by mounds of excavated soil, and the terrain appears uneven. In the background, there are trees without leaves and some buildings with red roofs.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色小松挖掘机正在大型挖掘场地进行土方作业。挖掘机的臂部伸出长，其铲斗与地面接触，表明正在进行积极作业。周围区域以堆满挖掘的土壤为特征，且地形显得平整。背景中有一些无叶树木以及部分红顶建筑。

text: The image shows three workers wearing yellow hard hats: one seated on the ground, another working on a formwork panel, and a third shoveling material on top of the formwork.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人：一人坐在地面上，另一人在操作台上工作，第三人在操作台上方覆盖材料。

err.en: shoveling material on top of the formwor
err.zh: 在操作台上方覆盖材料

text: The image shows an excavator arm with the manufacturer's logo "XCMG" visible, positioned over a deep trench with exposed earth layers.
zh: 图中展示了一台挖掘机，其制造商标志“X-CM G”清晰可见，该设备正位于一条深沟之上，沟内暴露着土层状地层。

text: In the foreground, there is a cluttered area with various construction materials, including wooden planks and metal rods. Three workers are visible within a large, partially constructed rebar framework, with one worker bending over and the others standing. Bamboo scaffolding supports the structure.
zh: 前景中有一处杂乱区域，堆放着各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属杆。三名工人可见于一座大型、部分已建成的钢筋框架内，其中一名工人正弯腰，另一名则站立着。竹脚手架支撑着该结构。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with standing water. A steel column is visible on the left. Three workers wearing red hard hats are engaged in activities around a wheelbarrow and construction debris. On the right side, a worker is operating a wheelbarrow near a construction vehicle with muddy wheels. In the background, there is a partially constructed multi-story steel structure.
zh: 图中显示一个泥泞地施工现场，有积水。左侧可见一根钢柱。三名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在轮轴和建筑废料周围进行作业。右侧，一名工人正在一台轮轴附近操作，旁边是一辆带有泥泞轮的的建筑车辆。背景中，有一栋部分建成的多层钢结构建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large pile of materials, including wooden planks, metal sheets, and pipes. A bulldozer is positioned next to a covered area with white and blue tarpaulins. A red and white concrete pump truck is parked on a dirt road, with its boom retracted.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，堆放着大量材料，包括木托盘、金属板和管道。一台推土机停在一处覆盖着白色和蓝色防水布的区域旁。一辆红白相的混凝土泵车停在一处土路上，其保险杠被刮掉。

text: The image shows multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks. Several workers are dispersed across the site, with some on scaffolding and others on the ground level amidst various construction elements. A yellow crane is visible on the left side, and there is an extensive network of scaffolding throughout.
zh: 画面中可见多堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。多名工人分散在工地各处，部分人位于脚手架上，另一些人则处于地面层，周围分布着各种施工元素。左侧可见一台黄色色起重机，且整个现场遍布着密集的脚手架网络。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a high-visibility safety vest standing in the middle ground, observing the area. In the background, three workers are handling blue tarps covering materials, with one worker crouched and two standing. To the right, another worker on an elevated platform appears to be performing a task, while a blue truck is parked further back. The site is enclosed by a metal fence with trees visible behind it.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度安全背心的的工人站在空地上，正在观察该区域。背景中，三名工人正在搬运蓝色托盘板覆盖材料，其中一名工人弯腰，另外两名站立。右侧，另一名工人站在升高的平台上，似乎正在执行一项任务，同时一辆蓝色卡车停在更远处。该场地被金属围栏围住，围栏后树木可见。

text: The image shows a red-brown dirt ground with several concrete footings and cylindrical structures evenly spaced. Five workers are visible, two standing near the concrete structures, one bending over construction materials, and two working together with a wheelbarrow.
zh: 红褐色泥土地面上分布着若干混凝土构件和圆柱形结构，间距均匀。可见五名工人，其中两人站在混凝土结构旁，一人正弯腰搬运建筑材料，另外两人正操作着一台轮式起重机。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow single-drum vibratory roller with a dirty exterior indicating recent use. The roller is positioned on a compacted dirt surface with no visible operators or additional construction activity. In the background, there are stacked concrete blocks and a white vehicle parked to the right.
zh: 前景中，有一台黄色单鼓振动辊，其内部污迹表明近期使用过。该辊位于一片压实的泥土地面上，未见操作人员或额外施工活动。背景中，有堆叠的混凝土砌块，以及一辆白色车辆停靠在右侧。

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor with a drum roller at the front and large wheels at the back, positioned on muddy terrain. The background features an expansive construction site with uneven, reddish-brown earth and some mounds of soil.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色土壤压实机，前部配有鼓轮，后部配有大轮，停放在泥泞土地面上。背景为一处开阔的施工现场，地面平整，呈红褐色泥土，并伴有部分土堆。

text: The image shows several workers wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats working on a construction site with a complex framework of steel rebar. Starting from the left, a group of workers is gathered around a circular rebar structure, possibly preparing or inspecting it. Moving to the right, individual workers are seen interacting with the rebar framework, some standing within the structure and others on the outside. The construction site is equipped with various scaffolding and support structures.
zh: 图像显示几名工人身穿红色工作服，头戴黄色安全帽，正在一个由钢架搭建而成的结构复杂的、复杂的框架的施工现场上作业。从左侧看，一群工人聚集在一个圆形钢架结构周围，可能正在准备或检查它。往右移动，个别工人被看到与钢架结构互动，一些站在结构内部，另一些在外部。该施工现场配备了各种脚手架和支撑结构。

err.en: a complex framework of steel rebar
err.zh: 结构复杂的、复杂的框架

text: The image shows two workers wearing orange hard hats inspecting a large concrete pipeline that runs along the bottom of a deep trench. The trench walls are exposed earth, and there's a power line structure visible at the top of the trench in the background. The ground surrounding the trench is uneven and consists of similar earthy material.
zh: 图中显示两名头戴橙色安全帽的工人正在检查一条沿深沟底部延伸的大型混凝土管道。沟壁为裸露出的土，且在沟顶部背景中可见一条电力线。沟周围的的地面平整，由类似的土质材料构成。

err.en: The ground surrounding the trench is une

text: The image shows a white truck parked with two individuals working at its rear, possibly engaged in unloading or preparing materials. A large, unfinished concrete retaining wall spans the width of the image, with piles of rubble and construction debris scattered in front of it. Along the slope to the left, three individuals are standing at different elevations, each appearing to be observing the site or waiting.
zh: 一辆白色卡车停放在画面中，两名人员正在其车尾端作业，可能在进行卸货或准备物料。一道大型、已完工的水泥挡土墙横贯画面宽度，其前方散落着成堆的碎石与建筑废料。沿着左侧的斜坡面，三名人员正站在不同的高度上，各自看起来像是在察看现场或等候。

text: In the foreground, there is a rough pathway with scattered debris, predominantly broken bricks and some waste materials. A red dump truck is positioned on the right side of the path, with its bed raised, suggesting unloading. An excavator is adjacent to the truck, and in the background, a large, terraced excavation site is visible with no visible activity.
zh: 前景中有一条崎岖小径，散落着碎屑，主要是破碎的砖块和一些废料。一辆红色自卸卡车停在小径的右侧，其车斗架起，暗示着未装载。一台挖掘机紧邻着卡车，并且在背景中，一个大型的、有坑的挖掘场地是可见，没有可见活动。

text: The image shows a large construction site with a concrete floor. Workers are dispersed across the site, engaged in various tasks near steel rebar frameworks, walking, or standing by materials. A yellow tower crane stands on the left side, and bundles of rebars, foam insulation panels, and wooden planks are scattered throughout.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，设有混凝土地面。工人分散在工地各处，正在钢筋框架附近从事各种任务，有的行走，有的站立在材料旁。一台黄色塔式起重机位于左侧，成束钢筋、泡沫保温板以及木托盘散落在各处。

text: In the center of the image, a yellow wheel loader is positioned in front of a partially collapsed tunnel, with debris from the collapse in front of it. The tunnel's concrete lining is visibly damaged and broken.
zh: 画面中央，一台黄色轮式装载机停在一处部分坍塌塌的隧道口前，其前方堆积着坍塌落下来的碎石瓦砾。隧道的混凝土衬面明显受损毁且破碎。

text: In the foreground, there is a green construction fence with a concrete foundation and scattered construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks. A concrete pump hose extends from the left to the center, where concrete is being poured into a formwork. Five workers in safety gear, including helmets, are engaged in the concrete pouring process. Behind them, a retaining wall with blue tarps at the top is visible, and a building with similar blue elements is in the background.
zh: 前景中，有一道绿色施工围栏，带有混凝土基础，周围散落着施工材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。一根混凝土泵管从左侧延伸至中心，混凝土正被浇筑进一个成型作业中。五名身着安全装备的工人，包括安全帽，正参与混凝土浇筑过程。在他们身后，有一堵挡土墙，顶部可见蓝色标牌，背景中有一栋建筑，带有类似的蓝色元素。

text: The image shows a blue excavator in the center, positioned on a pile of dirt and rocks, actively engaged in excavation work under a structure with a dark metal roof supported by vertical columns. The ground is uneven with visible earth and debris. In the background, there is a partially constructed building with white window frames.
zh: 画面中央是一台蓝色挖掘机，停在一堆泥土和岩石上，正积极进行挖掘作业。其结构由垂直立柱支撑着深色金属屋顶。地面平整，可见泥土和碎屑。背景中有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有白色窗框。

text: The image shows three workers installing large black pipes along a concrete retaining wall next to a body of water.
zh: 三名工人正在混凝土挡土墙旁安装大型黑色管道，准备通入水体。

err.en: next to a body of water

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with tire tracks crisscrossing the area. An orange dump truck is located towards the left, moving across the site. In the center, there is a blue excavator, which appears stationary. Throughout the site, several workers are visible, scattered at various points, with some near the dump truck and others closer to the excavator.
zh: 画面显示一处泥泞地施工现场，一条轮胎轨迹横穿整个区域。一辆橙色自卸卡车位于左侧，正横穿工地。画面中央有一台蓝色挖掘机，看起来处于静止状态。整个工地中可见几名工人，分散在不同位置，其中一些靠近自卸卡车，另一些则更靠近挖掘机。

err.zh: 一条轮胎轨迹横穿整个区域

text: The image shows an excavation site with two excavators in operation. One excavator has a raised bucket filled with dirt, while the other is actively digging into the ground. A blue structure and a brown truck are visible in the background, set against a backdrop of uneven, dug-up soil.
zh: 图中显示一个正在作业的的施工场地，有两名挖掘机在进行作业。一台挖掘机的铲斗内装满泥土，另一台则正在向地面挖掘。背景中可见一台蓝色挖掘机和一辆棕色卡车，与一片平整、被挖起的土的背景相映衬。

text: In the foreground on the left, a worker is arranging bricks next to a wheelbarrow. In the midground, a large mobile crane is positioned next to a tower crane with the name "ZOOMLION" on its side. The tower crane extends over a long yellow lattice boom lying horizontally across the image.
zh: 前景左侧，一名工人正将砖块排列至轮轴旁。中景处，一台大型移动式起重机位于塔式起重机旁，其侧面标有“ZOOM LION”字样。塔式起重机横跨画面横向延伸，覆盖一片长黄色网格状结构。

text: The image shows a large excavation area with mounds of earth. Across the site, blue tarps are draped over unidentified materials. In the center, construction equipment, including an excavator and a backhoe loader, are positioned on the dirt mounds. Various construction materials and debris are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图片显示一个大型土方方开挖区域。在整个场地，蓝色防水布覆盖在识别材料上。在中心，施工设备，包括一台挖掘机和一台装载机，放置在土堆上。各种建筑材料和碎屑散布在整个场地。

text: A worker wearing a camouflage uniform and a red hard hat is observing the work. Two excavators are actively engaged in digging and moving soil in the center of the image.
zh: 一名身穿迷彩服、头戴红色硬帽的工人正在观察作业。画面中央有两名挖掘机手正积极地进行挖掘和搬运泥土方的作业。

text: The worker in the middle is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 中间的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: The worker in the middle is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 中间的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: The worker in the middle is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 中间的工人戴着一顶草帽，但不是硬草帽。

text: The image shows two excavators facing each other, one orange and one yellow, both with their buckets filled with dirt. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and mounds of dirt. In the background, there are trees and a building with a red roof.
zh: 画面中显示两台挖掘机相对而立，一台为橙色，另一台为黄色，两者的的铲斗均装满泥土。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹以及泥土堆。背景中有树木以及一栋带红色屋顶的建筑。

text: The image shows a large excavation area with exposed earth and a worker wearing a white hard hat. An excavator is stationed on the soil with its arm extended. A concrete mixer truck is positioned in the middle ground, with its drum extended towards a building under construction, which is covered with green scaffolding and netting.
zh: 图中显示一处大型土方方开挖区域，一名头戴白色安全帽的工人。一台挖掘机停放在土堆上，其臂部向一侧延伸。一辆混凝土搅拌车停放在地面中央，其搅拌鼓朝向一栋正在施工的建筑延伸，该建筑被绿色脚手架和网架覆盖。

err.en: with exposed earth and a worker wearing
err.zh: 一名头戴白色安全帽的工人

text: In the foreground, there is a pile of earth with a tarp partially covering the bottom right corner. An excavator is loading dirt into the bed of a green dump truck. To the right of the excavator, a yellow bulldozer is visible. In the background, there are large black pipes laid out on the ground, with a single worker in red near them.
zh: 前景中有一堆泥土，一块防水布部分覆盖其右下角。一台挖掘机正将泥土装载到一辆绿色自卸卡车的中。在挖掘机的右侧，可见一台黄色推土机。背景中，地面上铺设着大型黑色管道，附近有一名穿红色衣服的的单名工人。

err.zh: 一名穿红色衣服的的单名工人

text: In the foreground, two orange road rollers are positioned on freshly laid asphalt, with operators visible in the seats. Moving towards the background, there are at least five workers on the ground, with one guiding the roller and others engaged in tasks related to road construction. Behind the workers, there is another piece of construction equipment laying asphalt, with an operator inside and visible smoke coming from it.
zh: 前景中，两台橙色路面压路机停放在新铺设的沥青上，操作员坐在座位上清晰可见，正朝向背景移动。背景中，地面上至少有五名工人在作业，其中一人引导压路机，其余人从事与道路施工相关的的工作。工人身后，地面上还有一台施工设备正在铺设沥青，设备内可见一名操作员，并冒出烟雾。

err.en: Moving towards the background, there are
err.zh: 正朝向背景移动。背景中，地面上至少有五名工人在作业

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer with tracks, actively moving soil on a construction site. The ground is uneven and covered with a mix of loose soil and clumps of earth.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色推土机，带有履带，正在建筑工地上积极移动土壤。地面平整，覆盖着松散土壤和土块的。

err.en: covered with a mix of loose soil and clu
err.zh: 覆盖着松散土壤和土块的。

text: The image shows two excavators facing each other, with the one on the left having a raised bucket and the one on the right actively digging and holding soil in its bucket. The ground between them appears to be recently disturbed earth with tracks and mounds of dirt.
zh: 图中显示两名挖掘机手相对而立，左侧的一台举着提升的铲斗，右侧的一台积极挖掘并持有土壤在其铲斗。它们之间的地面似乎最近被扰动的地球，带有轨道和泥土堆。

text: The image shows a close-up of a blue excavator with the model number SK210 written on its side, indicating it is a Kobelco machine. The excavator is positioned on a surface with visible tracks and is surrounded by excavated earth.
zh: 图像显示一台蓝色挖掘机的，其侧面标有型号SK2-110，表明这是一台Kobelco机器。该挖掘机位于可见轨道上，周围环绕着被挖掘的泥土。

text: The image shows a dirt road with piles of red soil on either side. Approximately nine workers are scattered across the site, with some walking and others engaged in tasks. An orange excavator is positioned to the left, while a yellow mobile crane is visible further back. On the right, a concrete silo is connected to a concrete pump hose extending towards a scaffolding structure.
zh: 图中显示一条土路，两侧均有红土堆。大约九名工人散布在工地各处，部分人正在行走，另一些人则忙于作业。一台橙色挖掘机位于左侧，一台黄色移动起重机可见于更后方。右侧，一台混凝土搅拌车通过混凝土泵管连接至脚手架结构。

text: In the foreground, there is uneven, excavated earth with a large metal plate on the ground. To the left, an excavator with a full bucket is positioned next to a pile of dirt. In the center, a pile driving rig is visible with its hammer raised, ready for operation. Various construction materials, such as beams and pipes, are scattered around the site.
zh: 前景中，地面上有一块平整的开挖土方，上面放着一块大型金属板。左侧，一台挖掘机带着完整的的一斗，停在一堆泥土旁边。中央，可见一台钻机架，其锤头高高抬起，随时准备作业。现场周围散落着各种建筑材料，例如梁和管道。

text: In the foreground, there is a large expanse of reddish-brown soil with some scattered debris. There are three construction vehicles: a compactor with a roller, a bulldozer, and another compactor with a roller. Behind these vehicles, there is a stack of concrete pipes. In the background, there are buildings and vegetation, with a body of water visible on the far left.
zh: 前景中有一大片红褐色土壤，上面散落着一些碎屑。那里有三台施工车辆：一台带滚筒的压路机、一台平地机，以及另一台带滚筒的压路机。在这些车辆后面，有一堆混凝土管道。背景中有一些建筑物和植被，左侧远处可见一片水域。

text: The image shows three workers engaged in construction activities. The worker on the left is using a shovel, while the worker in the center is smoothing concrete with a trowel. They are surrounded by large, irregularly shaped stones, and there is a metal mesh structure in the background, possibly part of a reinforcement framework. The ground is covered with wet concrete where the work is taking place.
zh: 图中显示三名工人正在进行施工作业。左侧的工人使用铁锹，中间的工人正在用抹子抹平混凝土。他们被大块、规则形状的石料所环绕，背景中有一金属网架，可能属于钢筋骨架的一部分。地面覆盖着湿混凝土，作业正在此处进行。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat walking on a sandy surface with construction materials scattered around, including a green hose. A multi-level scaffolding structure with a few workers on different levels is visible in the middle ground, with a worker in red on an upper level.
zh: 图中显示一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正行走在布满施工材料的的地面上，其中包括一根绿色软管。一个多层脚手架结构清晰可见，中间地面上有一名穿红色衣服的的工人。

err.en: with a few workers on different levels i
err.zh: 中间地面上有一名穿红色衣服的的工人

err.en: a few workers on different levels
err.zh: 一名穿红色衣服的的工人

text: The image shows a worker in camouflage attire and a safety helmet walking among large bundles of rebars. In the background, there is an unfinished multi-story concrete building with visible floor labels (1F, 2F, 3F) and several workers in safety gear engaged in various activities.
zh: 图中显示一名身着迷彩服、头戴安全帽的工人，正穿行于成排的大型钢筋束之间。背景中有一栋已完工的多层混凝土建筑，可见楼层号标识（1F、2F、3F），还有数名身着安全装备的工人正从事着各种作业。

err.zh: 已完工的多层混凝土建筑

text: The image shows a yellow dump truck positioned on the left, with its bed raised, indicating it is unloading or has unloaded soil. In the middle ground, there are four workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests; they are spread out across the site, with some standing and others appearing to be engaged in work activities. Various colored flags are planted in the ground throughout the site. The background shows a rural landscape with trees and buildings in the distance. The ground is uneven and appears to be in the process of being excavated or leveled.
zh: 画面左侧停放着一辆黄色自卸卡车，其车斗已升起，表明该车未装载或已卸载泥土料。地面中部有四名工人头戴安全帽、身穿高能见度背心，他们分散于整个工地，部分人站立，另一些人似正从事作业活动。工地各处插着各色旗。背景呈现乡村景色，远处有树木与建筑物。地面平整，似正在被挖掘或整平。

err.en: indicating it is unloading or has unload
err.zh: 表明该车未装载或已卸载泥土料

text: The image shows a construction site with a group of workers, including two wearing hard hats and safety vests, amidst numerous wooden planks and scaffolding materials. A large yellow mobile crane is operating in the midground, with construction debris visible, including a pile of materials covered with a blue tarp. The background features a multi-story building under construction, enveloped in green safety netting and supported by scaffolding, with two tower cranes visible above.
zh: 图中展示了一个建筑工地，有一组工人，其中两人佩戴安全帽和反光背心，周围堆放着大量木方和脚手架材料。一台大型黄色色移动式起重机正在地面中央作业，可见施工废料，包括一堆覆盖着蓝色防水布的材料。背景中有一栋多层建筑正在施工，被绿色安全网和脚手架包围，上方可见两台塔式起重机。

err.zh: 一台大型黄色色移动式起重机

text: In the foreground, there is uneven, muddy terrain with scattered construction materials, including wooden planks and a white bucket. A utility pole stands prominently in the center. To the left, a blue barrier is supported by wooden scaffolding, behind which a worker in orange is partially visible, engaged in an activity. Trees are visible in the background, indicating the site is near a vegetated area.
zh: 前景中是平坦的泥泞土地，散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘和一个白色桶。一个电力杆架显著地矗立在中央。左侧，一个蓝色屏障由木质脚手架支撑，其后方一名穿橙色衣服的的建筑工人部分可见，正从事某项活动。树木在背景中可见，表明该场地靠近一个植被区域。

text: In the foreground, there is a body of water partially enclosed by a concrete structure with protruding steel reinforcement bars. A large pile-driving machine is positioned on the left, standing over the concrete structure. A yellow dump truck is visible to the right, with a few workers scattered around the area.
zh: 前景中，有一处被混凝土结构部分围护的水体，该混凝土结构带有外伸的钢筋。一台大型打桩机位于左侧，矗立在混凝土结构之上。右侧可见一辆黄色色泵车，该区域周围散布着几名工人。

text: The image shows a yellow and black soil compactor actively engaged in compacting the soil, with a worker operating the machine. To the right of the compactor, there is another soil compactor of similar color and design, also in operation. The background features a landscape with mounds of soil and a partially constructed building with a red roof.
zh: 图中显示一名身着黄黑相间服装的土工人员正积极地进行土壤压实作业，旁边有一名工人正在操作机械。在该人员右侧，还有一名身着类似颜色服装的土工人员，同样在进行作业。背景呈现一片带有土堆的景观貌，以及一栋部分建成的、带有红色屋顶的建筑物。

err.zh: 身着黄黑相间服装的土工人员

err.en: another soil compactor of similar color
err.zh: 另一名身着类似颜色服装的土工人员

text: The image shows five workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests actively engaged in tasks around multiple bundles of rebars laid out on the ground.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人，正积极地在地面上铺设多组钢筋。

err.en: actively engaged in tasks around multipl
err.zh: 正积极地在地面上铺设多组钢筋

text: In the foreground, a concrete mixer chute is pouring concrete into a formwork area with rebar reinforcement. A worker is bending over, possibly smoothing or guiding the concrete, next to a puddle of water. Several workers are engaged in various activities around the formwork, including one walking along the formwork edge and others standing or working within the rebar structure.
zh: 前景中，一台混凝土搅拌车正将混凝土浇筑进带有钢筋配筋的成型作业区。一名工人正弯身越过，或许是在抹平或引导混凝土，紧接着去一摊水。几名工人正从事着成型作业区周围的的各种活动，包括一名沿着成型作业边缘行走，以及另一些站立或工作在钢筋配筋之内。

zh: 画面显示两名工人跪在地上，正在使用工具对看似是导轨轨或轨道进行作业。一辆自卸卡车停在左侧，一辆黑色SUV停在右侧。四名个人站在跪地工人的右侧，，其中三人戴着白色、红色和黄色的安全帽。

text: The image shows a green excavator on a patch of land under construction or land modification. The excavator is positioned between two bodies of water and is actively moving earth or debris.
zh: 图中显示一台绿色挖掘机正在施工或土地改良的土堆上作业。挖掘机位于两堆土之间，正在搬运泥土或碎石。

text: In the foreground, there is a paved road running horizontally across the image. On the left, a white dump truck is being loaded with soil by a yellow excavator. Behind the truck and excavator, there is a large, sloped, earthen area that appears to have been excavated.
zh: 前景中，有一条横向贯穿画面的左侧的铺装道路。左侧，一辆白色自卸卡车正被一台黄色挖掘机装载泥土。在卡车和挖掘机后方，有一大片大型、倾斜的裸露区域，看起来像是被挖掘过的。

err.en: In the foreground, there is a paved road
err.zh: 前景中，有一条横向贯穿画面的左侧的铺装道路。

text: The image shows ten workers wearing yellow hard hats and red safety vests distributed across a construction site. Starting from the left, a group of four workers is gathered around a pile of materials near a structure with exposed rebar. Moving right, two workers are walking with a wheelbarrow, followed by another worker standing nearby. Further to the right, three workers are positioned along a trench with green mesh material partially covering the ground. The site appears to be in an early phase of construction with bare earth and some construction materials visible.
zh: 图像显示十名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色安全背心的的工人分布于一处建筑工地。从左起，四名工人聚集在一堆材料旁，该结构处有外露出的钢筋。向右移动，两名工人正行走于一个钢筋笼旁，随后另一名工人站立于附近。再向右，三名工人位于一道沟渠沿线，绿色网片材料部分覆盖着地面。该工地似乎处于施工早期阶段，裸露出泥土体及部分建筑材料可见。

err.en: wearing yellow hard hats and red safety
err.zh: 身穿红色安全背心的的工人

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer positioned in the center, with its blade engaged in the soil. To the left, a dump truck is tilted, unloading soil onto the ground. The middle ground is dominated by mounds of earth and a bare tree to the right. In the background, there are structures and another piece of construction equipment, possibly an excavator, with a body of water visible to the right.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色推土机，其刀片头正切入泥土中。左侧有一辆倾斜的自卸卡车，未装载泥土到地面。中间地面被大量泥土占据，右侧有一棵光秃秃的树。背景中可见一些结构及另一台施工设备，可能是一台挖掘机，其车身在右侧可见。

text: The worker in the middle with a white hard hat is in the bling spot and within operation radius of the excavator.
zh: 中间的工人戴着白色硬帽，位于挖掘机的操作半径内的。

text: In the foreground, a yellow construction vehicle is being transported on a flatbed trailer, which is parked on a wet concrete surface. Behind it, there is a red mobile crane, and further back, a blue overhead gantry structure spans across the area. In the middle ground, various other construction vehicles and equipment are visible, including a white truck facing the crane. In the background, an elevated roadway with vehicles is seen above a blue fence that encloses the construction site.
zh: 前景中，一辆黄色工程车正被装载在一辆平板拖车上，该拖车停放在潮湿的混凝土表面上。在其后方，有一台红色移动式起重机，再往后，一台蓝色龙门架横跨整个区域。在中景处，可见其他各类工程车辆和设备，包括一辆面向起重机的器的方向的行驶的的白色卡车。在背景中，一条高架道路及其上的行驶的车辆位于一道蓝色围栏上方，该围栏封闭着施工场地。

err.en: a white truck facing the crane
err.zh: 一辆面向起重机的器的方向的行驶的的白色卡车

text: In the foreground, a yellow mobile crane is centered in the image, with its boom retracted and resting over the body. To the left of the crane, there is a pile of construction materials, including wood planks and metal rods. Behind the crane, an unfinished building with scaffolding is visible.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色移动式起重机位于画面中央，其吊臂伸出并搭在建筑物主体之上。起重机左侧有一堆建筑材料，包括木板和金属杆。起重机后方可见一栋未完工的建筑，带有脚手架。

err.en: with its boom retracted and resting over
err.zh: 其吊臂伸出并搭在建筑物主体之上

text: The image shows a network of steel reinforcement bars laid out on the ground, with a circular reinforced structure in the center. Four workers wearing orange overalls and white hard hats are present, three of whom are standing to the right, observing the site, while one on the left appears to be working or inspecting the rebar framework. Behind them, there is scaffolding supporting vertical rebar configurations extending upwards.
zh: 图像显示，钢筋网架在地面上铺设，中心有一个圆形加固结构。四名工人戴着橙色安全帽和白色安全帽在场，其中三人站在右侧，观察现场，而左边一人似乎正在工作或检查钢筋框架。在他们身后，有脚手架支撑着垂直钢筋向上延伸。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and white hard h
err.zh: 戴着橙色安全帽和白色安全帽

text: The image shows multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including white and blue pipes, and a large pile of gravel on the right. Several earthmoving machines, such as excavators and dump trucks, are actively engaged in work across the site. In the midground, there is a yellow crawler crane to the right and a blue tower crane in the center with its jib extending across the image.
zh: 画面中可见多堆建筑材料，包括白色和蓝色的管道，右侧有一大堆碎石。多台工程机械机械，如挖掘机和自卸卡车，正在现场积极作业。画面中部偏右有一台黄色履带起重机，正中央有一台蓝色塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面。

text: A worker in a purple shirt and a yellow hard hat is pushing a wheelbarrow, while another worker in a blue shirt and yellow hard hat stands nearby.
