zh: 画面左侧是一台正在作业的、不断翻动泥土、扬起一片尘土云团的的大型挖掘机。画面中部立有一块写有汉字的路牌、位于某些金属护栏后方。右侧还有另一台挖掘机、处于静止状态、更靠后方可见一辆自卸卡车。地面平坦、带有清晰可见轮胎轨迹、背景呈现丘陵地貌、伴有稀疏植被。

text: In the foreground, a dump truck with its bed raised is positioned on the left side of a paved road, indicating the unloading of materials. Adjacent to the dump truck, on the right, there is a white van with its rear doors open, revealing blue plastic barrels inside. The road stretches into the distance with construction activity visible on both sides.
zh: 前景中，一辆自卸式卡车停在铺装路面的左侧，其货箱升起，表明材料尚未装载。紧邻自卸式卡车右侧，有一辆白色厢式货车，其后门敞开，露出内部蓝色塑料桶。道路向远处延伸，两侧均可见施工活动。

text: The image shows a construction site viewed from above. The ground is covered with a green tarp, and there are multiple construction materials and equipment scattered across the site. From left to right, there are several workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests engaged in various activities. Some are walking across the site, while others are handling materials or working near scaffolding. There are stacks of construction materials, such as wooden planks and metal rods, organized in different areas.
zh: 该图片展示了从上方视角观看的建筑工地的面。地面覆盖着绿色防水布，并且现场散落着多种建筑材料和设备。从左到右，有几位头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正从事着各种活动。有些人在工地上行走，而另一些人则在处理材料或靠近脚手架工作。有堆叠着的建筑材料，例如木托盘和金属杆，被组织在不同的区域。

err.en: The image shows a construction site view
err.zh: 该图片展示了从上方视角观看的建筑工地的面。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red jacket standing near a bulldozer. An excavator operates on a mound of earth, with visible smoke or dust around it. Several large concrete pipes lie on the ground to the right of the excavator. In the background, another bulldozer works, with two more pieces of heavy machinery visible, one of which appears to be an excavator. The background shows a hilly landscape with vegetation and structures in the distance.
zh: 图中显示一名身穿红色夹克的工人站在一台铣刨机旁。一台挖掘机正在一堆土丘上作业，其周围可见烟雾或尘埃。几根大型混凝土管道横放在挖掘机右侧的地面上。背景中，另一台铣刨机正在作业，还有两件更重的型的机械可见，其中一台似乎是挖掘机。背景呈现一片多植被与结构在远处的的小丘的景观。

err.en: two more pieces of heavy machinery

text: In the foreground, there is an excavated area with uneven, mounded soil. Two large corrugated pipes are partially buried in the dirt. Moving towards the background, there are two excavators; one is yellow and the other is red, both positioned on the soil mounds. The red excavator is actively digging. Further back, there are two more yellow excavators, one of which appears to be stationary. A body of water is present in the background, reflecting the sunlight.
zh: 前景中有一片开挖区域，土壤平整且坚实。两根大型波纹状管道部分埋于泥土中。背景中，有两台挖掘机；一台为黄色，另一台为红色，均位于坚实土质之上。红色挖掘机正在积极挖掘。更远处，还有两台黄色挖掘机，其中一台似乎处于静止状态。背景中有一汪水，反射着阳光。

text: Two workers in the middle next to the excavator are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 两名工人正走向挖掘机，未佩戴安全帽。

err.en: in the middle next to the excavator

text: The image shows a trench with a concrete base and large concrete pipes positioned on one side, ready for installation. A blue truck is parked on the right side of the trench, with its bed raised, suggesting it may be unloading soil or materials. The terrain is uneven with mounds of earth, and there are no visible workers or other construction equipment in the immediate area. The background is dominated by a green, hilly landscape with some vegetation and a clear sky above.
zh: 图中显示一条沟槽，底部为混凝土基础，一侧放置着大型混凝土管道，已准备安装。一辆蓝色卡车停靠在沟槽右侧，其车斗架升起，暗示可能尚未卸载泥土料或材料。地形平坦，伴有泥土堆，且附近区域没有可见工人或其他其他施工设备。背景以绿色为主，多山丘，带有一些植被，上方天空晴朗。

err.en: suggesting it may be unloading soil or m
err.zh: 暗示可能尚未卸载泥土料或材料

err.en: The terrain is uneven with mounds of ear
no visible workers or other construction
err.zh: 没有可见工人或其他其他施工设备

text: The image shows stockpiles of yellow formwork panels and timber planks in the foreground. A worker wearing a safety vest is visible among the formwork panels, with more timber planks and scaffolding materials to the right. In the background, a dense arrangement of vertical and horizontal scaffolding structures can be seen, indicative of an extensive construction framework in progress.
zh: 画面前景处堆放着成堆的黄色安全帽和木质托盘架，一名身着安全背心的的工人在成堆的木质托盘架中清晰可见，其右侧还有更多木质托盘架和脚手架材料。背景中，可以看到密集布的垂直与水平脚手架结构，表明一个正在推进中的广泛施工框架。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with two excavators. The excavator on the left is stationary, while the one on the right is actively digging. The operator is visible inside the cabin of the excavator on the right.
zh: 图片显示一个泥泞地施工现场，有两台挖掘机。左侧的挖掘机处于静止状态，而右侧的挖掘机正在积极挖掘。操作员在右侧挖掘机的器的驾驶室内可见。

err.en: the cabin of the excavator on the right
err.zh: 右侧挖掘机的器的驾驶室内

text: The image shows a worker wearing a pink hard hat and a green jacket walking across a dirt area with uneven terrain and scattered rocks. To the right, a yellow excavator with the brand "SANY" is positioned on the dirt, its arm extended and bucket raised above the ground.
zh: 画面中，一名工人头戴粉色安全帽，身穿绿色夹克，正行走在一片地势平坦、散落着碎石的泥地之上。右侧，一台黄色挖掘机，其品牌“Sany”位于泥地之上，其吊臂和料斗架于地面之上。

text: In the foreground, a worker is walking on a muddy path with construction in progress. To the left, a yellow soil compactor is stationed on the dirt road. Further back on the right, another construction vehicle is partially visible, working on the site. In the background, multiple residential buildings in various stages of completion can be seen under a hazy sky.
zh: 前景中，一名工人正行走在泥泞路上，施工进展中。左侧，一名身着黄色土施工服的工人站在土路上。更靠后的右方，另一台施工车辆部分可见，正在工地上作业。背景中，多栋住宅建筑处于不同完工阶段，可在一片朦胧的天空下看到。

err.en: a yellow soil compactor is stationed on
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土施工服的工人站在土路上

text: The image shows a wet muddy ground. A water truck with a blue tank is actively spraying water on the ground, likely for dust control. Behind the water truck, a white truck is parked. A dump truck is parked to the right with its bed raised, indicating it may be unloading material.
zh: 画面显示一片潮湿泥地。一辆带有蓝色水箱的洒水车正在向地面喷水，可能用于降尘。洒水车后方停着一辆白色卡车。右侧停着一辆自卸车，其车斗已升起，表明可能未装载物料。

err.en: indicating it may be unloading material

text: In the foreground, there is a white dump truck parked on a paved road, with its bed raised slightly and a green tarp partially covering the load. To the right, an excavator is positioned on a mound of earth, with its bucket in the soil, suggesting excavation work is in progress.
zh: 前景中，一辆白色自卸卡车停放在铺装路面上，其货箱略微抬高，一块绿色篷布部分覆盖着货物。右侧，一台挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其铲斗位于泥土中，表明挖掘工作正在进行进行。

text: The image shows seven workers wearing orange and one in blue engaged in construction activities around a concrete foundation with vertical rebar structures. Wooden planks and construction debris are scattered around the site. A crane with a red boom is visible in the background, and beyond the construction pit, a blue fence and greenery are present.
zh: 画面中，七名身穿橙色工作服和一名身穿蓝色工作服的工人正在一处带有竖向钢筋结构的的基础混凝土周围进行施工作业。木质托盘板和建筑废料散落在工地周围。背景中可见一台带有红色吊斗的起重机，而在建筑基坑之外，则设有蓝色围栏和绿色植被。

text: The image shows a blue truck with a red crane arm on the left and a motorcycle parked in front of it. A yellow bulldozer is facing right with a pile of dirt in front of it. In the background, an excavator is visible, and further back, there are structures with multiple cranes, including tower cranes.
zh: 画面中有一辆蓝色卡车，其左侧伸出一只红色吊臂，车头前停放着一辆摩托车。一辆黄色色推土机正朝向右侧，其前方堆着一堆泥土。背景中可见一台挖掘机，更靠后方，存在多处结构，其中包括塔式起重机。

text: In the foreground, there are seven workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests engaged in various activities within and around several rectangular excavations. One worker is pushing a wheelbarrow, two are working with shovels, and others appear to be performing tasks that involve kneeling or adjusting materials on the ground.
zh: 前景中有七名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人，正在几处矩形开挖坑内及周边从事各项作业。其中一名工人正在推运一辆轮式挖掘机，两名工人正在使用电钻，其余几名工人似乎正在执行涉及在地面上跪姿或调整物料的任务。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebar framework laid out on the ground. Starting from the left, there are two workers standing together, with one bending over the rebar. Moving right, a group of three workers is gathered, with one handling some materials. Further right, two workers are standing with one appearing to be supervising or instructing. In the far right corner, a solitary worker is seen working with the rebar. The background shows a sloped earth wall, and there are various construction materials scattered across the site, including planks of wood placed over the rebar framework.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面上铺设着大面积的钢筋框架。从左侧开始，有两名工人站在一起，其中一人正弯着钢筋。往右移动，有一组三人聚集在一起，其中一人正处理着一些材料。再往右，有两名工人站着，其中一人似乎在监督或指导。在最右侧角落，可见一名单独的工人正在对钢筋进行作业。背景呈现一面倾斜的土墙，并且现场各处散落着各种建筑材料，包括放置在钢筋框架上方的的一堆木方木。

text: The image shows a cluttered area with construction materials, including wooden planks, metal rods, and tools scattered on the ground. Five workers are visible on the site, with the first two standing and discussing something, the third leaning over the rebar framework, and the last two bent over, actively working on the rebar structure. In the background, there is a green mesh barrier lining the construction site, and beyond that, some buildings and trees are visible.
zh: 画面显示一个杂乱的区域，地面上散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘、金属杆和工具。现场可见五名工人，其中前两名站着在讨论某事，第三名正俯身于钢筋框架之上，最后两名弯着腰，正忙于钢筋结构作业。背景中有一道绿色网状围栏环绕着施工场地，其外可见一些建筑物和树木。

text: In the foreground, there is a green excavator positioned on the left side of a dirt path, with its arm extended towards the ground. Along the path, there are multiple concrete slabs laid out to form a makeshift road. Towards the center and right of the image, the terrain appears to be uneven with various piles of dirt and debris. In the background, there are two individuals: one on the far left walking away from the excavator and another on the right side of the path walking towards the camera.
zh: 前景中，一台绿色挖掘机位于土路左侧，其臂部伸向地面。沿该路径，有多块混凝土板铺设而成，形成一条简易道路。在画面中央及右侧，地形看起来较为平坦，分布着若干堆泥土和碎石。背景中，有两个人：一人位于挖掘机左后方，正背向挖掘机走去；另一人位于路径右侧，正朝向镜头方向走来。

err.en: the terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows four workers wearing hard hats, standing on a floor made of closely spaced rebars, under a large concrete structure supported by columns.
zh: 图中显示四名头戴安全帽的工人，站在由紧密排列的钢筋构成的、并由立柱支撑的大型混凝土楼板面上。

err.en: under a large concrete structure support
err.zh: 并由立柱支撑的大型混凝土楼板面上

text: The image shows an excavator with a full bucket, surrounded by dust clouds, and a pile driver standing idle. Construction materials, including wooden planks and a concrete block, are scattered nearby.
zh: 图中显示一台装载着满斗的挖掘机，周围尘土飞扬，一名司机正闲站着。附近散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘和混凝土块。

text: In the foreground, there is a large puddle surrounded by piles of rocks and rubble. Two orange excavators are positioned on either side of the image, with one on the left and the other on the right, both appear to be idle. A concrete wall runs across the background of the image, and there are no visible workers or other construction equipment in the scene.
zh: 前景中有一大坑，周围堆着岩石和碎石。两台橙色挖掘机分别位于画面两侧，一台在左侧，另一台在右侧，两者均处于闲置置状态。一道混凝土墙横贯画面背景，场景中中未见工人或其他施工设备。

text: The image shows multiple workers spread across an indoor construction site. Starting from the left, one worker is handling materials near a set of lockers, while another is bending over what appears to be a workstation. In the center, a worker is walking towards the camera carrying materials, and another is visible in the background. On the right, a worker is standing with materials in hand. The site is filled with numerous rebars laid out on the ground.
zh: 画面显示，室内施工现场有多名工人分散作业。从左侧看，一名工人正在处理材料，靠近一组脚手架，另一名工人正弯腰搬运一件看似是工作台的的东西。画面中央，一名工人正朝镜头方向走来，手里拿着材料，背景中还能看到另一名工人。右侧，一名工人站立着，手里拿着材料。地面上铺满了许多钢筋。

text: In the image, there are two excavators positioned on the edges of a large excavation pit with steep, dirt walls. The pit is filled with water at the bottom. On the right side of the pit, there is a stockpile of construction materials, including metal sheets or panels. The surrounding ground is uneven with visible tracks and debris, indicating recent construction activity.
zh: 图中显示，两台挖掘机停在一处大型基坑的边坡上，该基坑具有陡峭的土质边坡壁。坑底积存有水。在坑的右侧，有一堆建筑材料，包括金属板或面板板。周围地面平整，可见车辙和碎屑，表明近期施工活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with a focus on a reinforced concrete floor slab under construction. A worker wearing a pink hard hat and a red checkered shirt is kneeling on the slab, seemingly inspecting or working on the rebar grid. The background reveals an extensive array of vertical rebars protruding from the slab, indicating preparation for vertical structural elements. The construction site is open with a clear sky above, and the terrain in the distant background appears relatively flat with no significant structures visible.
zh: 图像显示一个在建工地，重点在于正在施工中的钢筋混凝土楼板板。一名头戴粉色安全帽、身穿红色格纹衬衫的工人正跪在楼板板上，似乎在检查或处理钢筋网格。背景揭示大量从楼板板伸出的来的垂直钢筋，表明为垂直结构元素做准备。工地上方天空晴朗，远处地形显得相对平坦，没有明显可见结构。

text: The image shows a worker wearing an orange hard hat, observing the site. An excavator is positioned next to a pile of construction materials, with its arm extended towards the ground. Two workers are standing by another pile of materials, one holding a bag and the other wearing a white hard hat. A pile driver with its tower extended upwards is visible in the center, with various stockpiles of materials and construction debris scattered across the site, including temporary structures in the distance.
zh: 画面中，一名工人头戴橙色安全帽，正在观察现场。一台挖掘机位于一堆建筑材料旁，其机械臂伸向地面。另外两名工人站在另一堆材料旁，其中一人提着一个袋子，另一人头戴白色安全帽。画面中央可见一台塔式起重机，其塔身向上延伸，现场各处散落着各种材料堆和建筑废料，远处还可见一些临时结构。

text: The image shows two workers laying bricks to create a formwork for concrete. One worker is kneeling on the right side, while the other is bending over the formwork on the left. A third worker is sitting on the edge of the concrete slab behind them. A wheelbarrow, piles of bricks, wooden planks, and metal rods are scattered around the site.
zh: 图中显示两名工人正在砌砖，为混凝土制作模板。一名工人跪在右侧，另一名则弯腰在左侧的模板上。第三名工人坐在他们身后的混凝土板边缘。轮轴、砖堆、木托盘和金属杆散落在工地周围。

text: The image shows a worker walking towards the right, with construction debris around him. Two wheelbarrows are positioned near the center, with a pile of bricks to the right. Several workers are engaged in various activities in the middle ground, including shoveling and moving materials. A yellow excavator operates to the left, with a worker standing behind it.
zh: 画面中，一名工人正向右行走，其周围散落着建筑废料。两排车轮位于画面中央附近，右侧堆放着一堆砖块。地面上有多名工人正在从事各种活动，包括铲运和搬运材料。一台黄色挖掘机在左侧作业，其后方站着一名工人。

text: The image shows two workers with yellow hard hats, one taking a photo, and six workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats engaged in various activities on a concrete surface with steel reinforcement visible.
zh: 画面显示两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，其中一人正在拍照，另有六名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人在带有可见钢筋的混凝土表面上从事各种作业。

err.en: six workers in orange overalls and yello
err.zh: 六名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人

text: The image shows a construction worker wearing a yellow hard hat and dark clothing, tying rebar together with a tool. A large concrete wall with vertical rebar protruding is visible to the left.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿深色衣物，正使用工具。左侧可见一面大型混凝土墙，上面有垂直钢筋突出。

err.en: tying rebar together with a tool

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor working on a dirt surface. In the background, across a body of water, multiple high-rise buildings under construction can be seen.
zh: 画面中，一名身着黄色服装的土工正在泥土地面上作业。背景中，横跨一片水域，多栋正在施工的高层建筑清晰可见。

text: The image shows seven workers wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats working on a rebar framework. A concrete structure with more rebar protruding from its top is visible to the right, with one worker standing on it.
zh: 图中显示七名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿黄色硬帽，正在一个钢筋框架上作业。一个混凝土结构，其顶部有更多的钢筋向右突出，一名工人站在上面。

err.en: red overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 红色安全帽，身穿黄色硬帽

text: The image shows a newly paved asphalt road with four workers in the background, one operating a yellow road roller. On the left side of the road, there is one worker standing near a white line marking. In the far background, there are two white structures and large mounds of red earth on either side of the road.
zh: 图中展示了一条新铺设的沥青道路，背景中有四名工人，其中一人正在操作一台黄色压路机。在道路的左侧，有一名工人站在一条白色标线附近。在远处的背景中，道路两侧各都有两个白色构造物和一大堆红土。

err.en: two white structures and large mounds of
err.zh: 道路两侧各都有两个白色构造物和一大堆红土

text: The image shows three workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests walking past a concrete truck. In the foreground, there is a blue portable toilet and various construction materials scattered around, including red and white metal beams, wooden planks, and blue plastic crates. The background is bordered by greenery, indicating the site is adjacent to a wooded area.
zh: 画面中，三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿黄色安全背心的的工人正走过一辆混凝土搅拌车。前景处有一台蓝色便携式收音机，周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括红白相的金属梁、木质托盘以及蓝色塑料筐。背景由绿植类环绕界，表明该工地毗邻一片林地区域。

text: In the foreground, a green dump truck is tipping its bed to unload soil. Behind it, there is a pile driver with a worker operating it. Further back, multiple construction vehicles are visible, including two yellow bulldozers, a yellow roller, and several other dump trucks in various colors.
zh: 前景中，一辆绿色自卸车正将其车斗卸土。其后方，有一堆司机，一名工人正在操作它。更远处，可见多台施工车辆，包括两台黄色推土机、一台黄色压路机以及数辆其他颜色的各异的自卸车。

err.en: a pile driver with a worker operating it
err.zh: 有一堆司机，一名工人正在操作它

text: The image shows an extensive network of scaffolding and formwork, indicating ongoing construction work. Two tower cranes dominate the middle ground, with one on the left partially obscured by a mobile crane's boom, which is in the process of lifting. In the background, a high-rise building under construction is visible, along with several other structures in the distance, shrouded in haze.
zh: 画面中可见大片脚手架与施工结构，表明施工工作正在进行进行。两台塔式起重机占据画面中央，其中左侧一台部分被移动吊车的吊臂遮挡，该吊臂正处于起吊状态。背景中，一栋在建的高层建筑清晰可见，远处还有若干其他结构，笼罩在薄雾之中。

err.zh: 表明施工工作正在进行进行

text: The image shows multiple bundles of rebars arranged horizontally. A worker wearing a white hard hat is standing near a pile of rebars, and another worker is visible further back, partially obscured by construction materials. A yellow construction vehicle, possibly a crane or lifting equipment, is present in the midground, along with various construction materials, including wooden planks and more rebar bundles.
zh: 画面中可见多组水平排列的钢筋。一名头戴白色安全帽的工人站在钢筋堆旁，另一名工人位于更靠后的方，部分被建筑材料遮挡。一辆黄色色施工车辆，可能是一台起重机或升降设备，出现在画面中部，周围还有各种建筑材料，包括木托盘以及更多成束的钢筋。

text: The image shows an open trench with sand piles and various bags, possibly containing construction materials, alongside wooden planks. A worker is standing near the trench, facing the camera. In the midground, there are six workers wearing hard hats, engaged in various activities. In the background, there is a blue container truck, a white car, and construction machinery, including a yellow crane. The setting appears to be an urban area with buildings and street lighting in the far background.
zh: 画面显示一条敞开的沟渠，旁边堆放着沙堆和各种袋子，可能装有建筑材料，还有木托盘。一名工人站在沟渠附近，面向镜头。中景处有六名头戴安全帽的工人，正从事着各种活动。背景中有一辆蓝色集装箱卡车、一辆白色汽车以及建筑机械，包括一台黄色色起重机。场景看起来是一处带有建筑物和路灯的城市区域。

text: The image shows two workers wearing red helmets and gloves operating machinery inside a dimly lit area with concrete walls. The worker on the left is handling the controls of a drilling or boring machine, while the worker on the right is holding a hose or cable connected to the machine. There is a puddle on the ground, and various pieces of equipment and materials are scattered around the site.
zh: 画面显示两名头戴红色安全帽、手戴手套的工人，正在昏暗的混凝土墙内操作机械设备。左侧的工人正在操作一台钻孔或掘进机的器的，而右侧的工人则手持一根软管或电缆线，将其连接至机器。地面上有一摊水洼，且现场四周散落着各种设备与物料。

err.en: handling the controls of a drilling or b
err.zh: 操作一台钻孔或掘进机的器的

text: The bulldozer is moving earth. An excavator is loading soil into a green dump truck, where one worker is visible standing by the truck. A large crawler crane is positioned in the center of the image. Residential buildings and a tower crane are visible in the background.
zh: 推土机正在移动地球。一台挖掘机正将泥土装载进一辆绿色自卸卡车，一名工人站在卡车旁清晰可见。一台大型履带起重机位于画面中央。住宅建筑与一台塔式起重机在背景中清晰可见。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a blue jacket and yellow hard hat is smoothing concrete with a trowel on a wooden platform. Behind the worker, there is a body of water reflecting a patterned wall, and beyond that, a sloped dirt bank leading up to the wall.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿蓝色夹克、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在木质平台上抹平混凝土，旁边放着一辆手推车。工人身后是一面映出波纹状纹理的墙体，再往后是一道倾斜的土堤，一直延伸到墙边。

err.en: Behind the worker, there is a body of wa
err.zh: 工人身后是一面映出波纹状纹理的墙体

err.en: a worker wearing a blue jacket and yello

text: In the foreground, there is a pile of wooden planks and a concrete pump truck with its boom extended towards the left side of the image. A concrete mixer truck is positioned near the pump truck, likely preparing to deliver concrete. In the midground, there are various construction materials, including wooden and metal forms, as well as rebars. On the right side, there is a building with blue window coverings. In the background, a high-voltage power line tower is visible.
zh: 前景处有一堆木托盘，以及一辆混凝土泵车，其车头朝向画面左侧延伸。一辆混凝土搅拌车停在泵车附近，可能正准备运送混凝土。中景处有各种建筑材料，包括木质和金属模板，以及钢筋。右侧有一栋建筑，带有蓝色窗饰。背景中可见一座高压输电塔。

err.en: its boom extended towards the left side
err.zh: 其车头朝向画面左侧延伸

text: The image shows three workers wearing orange safety gear inside a concrete trench. The worker on the left is using a tool to work on the trench floor, while the central worker is holding a hose or cable, and the worker on the right is standing and observing. The trench walls show signs of recent work with exposed rebar and uneven surfaces.
zh: 三名头戴橙色安全帽的工人在混凝土沟槽内作业。左侧工人正使用工具对沟槽底部进行施工，中间工人手持一根软管或电缆线，右侧工人则站立并观察。沟槽壁显示出近期施工痕迹，钢筋外露且表面平整。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on an uneven surface of brown soil, with its arm extended and bucket raised above a mound of earth. Large piles of excavated soil are visible behind the excavator. In the background, atop the soil piles, there are two birds.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在一块平整的棕色土堆上，其机械臂和铲斗斗架在土堆上方。挖掘机后面可见大堆挖掘出的来的土。在背景中，土堆顶部有两只鸟。

text: The image shows four individuals at a construction site. Two wear red and yellow hard hats respectively, with one handling a tool near a concrete structure. The other two individuals, one in a white shirt and one in a striped shirt, are focused on the task at hand around a circular concrete formwork or well ring.
zh: 图中显示四名建筑工地的四名工人。两人分别戴着红黄安全帽，其中一人手持工具靠近混凝土结构。另外两人，一人穿白衬衫，一人穿条纹衬衫，正专注于手头的围绕圆形混凝土模板或环状物的。

err.en: are focused on the task at hand around a
err.zh: 正专注于手头的围绕圆形混凝土模板或环状物的。

text: The image shows a worker operating a water truck, discharging water onto the muddy ground. The blue water truck is equipped with a rear platform and side railings.
zh: 图中显示一名工人正在操作一辆水车，将水抽吸到泥泞地上。蓝色水车配备有后平台和侧栏杆。

err.en: discharging water onto the muddy ground

text: The image shows a patterned arrangement of yellow and black safety mats. Behind the mats, a concrete structure with vertical scaffolding poles is visible, and three workers are present on the scaffolding, wearing safety gear, including hard hats. The sky is overcast, and the construction site appears to be in an open area with no immediate adjacent structures.
zh: 图像展示了黄黑相间的安全帽排列。在安全帽后面，可见一个带有垂直折叠极的混凝土结构，并且三个工人出现在折叠极上，佩戴着安全装备，包括硬帽。天空是过曝的，并且建筑工地似乎是在开放区域，没有立即相邻结构。

text: The image shows two excavators, one blue and one yellow, engaged in digging or moving soil, with a small pile of white rubble nearby.
zh: 图中显示两名挖掘机，一台蓝色，一台黄色，正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土，旁边有一小堆白色碎石。

text: In the foreground, there is a partial brick wall. Behind the wall, a blue truck is parked next to an excavator with a teal and blue color scheme, labeled "KOBELCO." The operator is visible inside the excavator's cabin.
zh: 前景中有一堵部分砖墙。墙后停着一辆蓝色卡车，紧挨着一台采用青绿和蓝色配色方案的、标有“KOBEL CO.”字样的式的挖掘机。操作手在挖掘机驾驶室内可见。

err.zh: 标有“KOBEL CO.”字样的式的挖掘机

text: The image shows a nighttime scene at a construction site within a large cavernous space. In the center, an excavator is positioned next to a dump truck with its bed tilted upwards, suggesting the unloading of material. The area is illuminated by artificial lighting, which highlights a vast spread of debris or excavated material on the ground.
zh: 图像展示了一个位于大型洞室空间内的的大型洞室空间的夜间施工现场场景。画面中央，一台挖掘机正将一车倾斜的物料倾倒进一辆自卸卡车，暗示着大量未装载的物料。该区域由人工照明照亮，突显出地面上广泛散布的碎屑或挖掘出的材料。

err.en: The image shows a nighttime scene at a c
err.zh: 图像展示了一个位于大型洞室空间内的的大型洞室空间的夜间施工现场场景。

err.en: an excavator is positioned next to a dum
err.zh: 一台挖掘机正将一车倾斜的物料倾倒进一辆自卸卡车，暗示着大量未装载的物料

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow soil compactor with its roller visible. The equipment appears to be stationary on a compacted dirt surface.
zh: 前景中，有一名身着黄色土作业的工人，其滚筒清晰可见。该设备似乎静止在压实的泥土地面上。

err.zh: 身着黄色土作业的工人

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of exposed earth and a worker standing near the center. A bulldozer is in operation next to a pile of red pipes, while an excavator is working behind it. A pile driver is visible in the middle, with a water truck and a dump truck positioned to its right. In the background, there are two tower cranes, and construction appears to be ongoing on multiple buildings.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，有大片裸露的土方，一名工人站在中心位置。一台推土机正在对一堆红色管道进行作业，其后方有一台挖掘机正在工作。画面中部可见一名司机，旁边停着一辆水车和一辆抽水泵车。背景中，有两台塔式起重机，且多栋建筑上似乎正在进行施工。

err.en: A pile driver is visible in the middle
err.zh: 画面中部可见一名司机

err.en: a dump truck positioned to its right

text: The image shows a group of workers with yellow hard hats working among piles of rebar and rocks. Several workers are positioned along a trench with blue pipes running through it.
zh: 画面中，一群头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在成堆的钢筋和岩石之间作业。几名工人正沿着一条开有蓝色管道穿过的其中的的沟渠定位。

err.en: a trench with blue pipes running through
err.zh: 一条开有蓝色管道穿过的其中的的沟渠

text: In the foreground, there is a construction site with muddy terrain and scattered wooden planks. On the left, a worker is standing on a staircase leading to a partially constructed structure with metal framing. In the center, a group of approximately ten workers is engaged in various activities around a wooden framework on the ground, with some handling materials and others observing. To the right, a yellow bulldozer is parked, and behind it, there is a large building with a metal exterior.
zh: 前景中是一片泥泞土地工地，散落着木托盘。左侧，一名工人站在楼梯道上，通向一个部分建成的金属框架结构。中心，大约十名工人正围绕地面上的一个木质框架从事各种活动，其中一些处理材料，另一些人在观察。右侧，一台黄色推土机停放着，其后方，是一栋大型建筑，带有金属内部。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of steel rebars laid out in a grid pattern, forming the reinforcement for a concrete structure. Approximately ten workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests are actively working on the site, handling and arranging the rebars.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，大量钢筋按网格状铺设，构成混凝土结构的体的。约十名头戴安全帽、身穿高可视性反光背心的的工人正在现场积极作业，处理并排列钢筋。

err.en: forming the reinforcement for a concrete
err.zh: 构成混凝土结构的体的
高可视性反光背心的的工人

text: In the foreground, there are two excavators positioned on either side of the image, with their booms extended towards the center. Between them, there is a worker wearing a white hard hat, who appears to be inspecting or working on the ground. To the right, another worker wearing a yellow hard hat is engaged in an activity near some concrete footings with protruding rebar.
zh: 前景中有两名挖掘机手，分别位于画面两侧，其吊臂向画面中心伸展。两人之间，有一名头戴白色安全帽的工人，似乎正在地面进行检查或作业。右侧，另有一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，正参与某混凝土构件附近的活动，该构件带有外露出的钢筋。

text: In the foreground, there are two workers kneeling and tying rebar on a large grid of steel reinforcement bars that cover the ground. Moving towards the background, three additional workers are engaged in similar activities, spaced out across the rebar grid. All workers are wearing hard hats and safety vests.
zh: 前景中有两名工人跪着，正在一根粗钢筋上绑扎钢筋，该钢筋横跨一大片钢筋网。背景中，另外三名工人正从事类似活动，分散在钢筋网中。所有工人都戴着安全帽和安全背心。

err.en: on a large grid of steel reinforcement b
err.zh: 正在一根粗钢筋上绑扎钢筋，该钢筋横跨一大片钢筋网

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is bending over a large rebar structure. Moving to the right, three workers are positioned along the edge of an excavation, with two standing and one bending over, all engaged in tasks related to construction. They are surrounded by wooden planks and construction debris.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正弯腰跨越一根大型钢筋。向右看，三名工人沿基坑边缘分布，其中两人站立，一人弯腰，均从事与施工相关的的工作。他们被木方木和建筑废料所环绕。

err.en: bending over a large rebar structure
err.zh: 弯腰跨越一根大型钢筋

text: The image shows three workers on a construction site with large black panels laid out on the ground. One worker is kneeling and inspecting the edge of a panel, while another is bending over a panel. The third worker is also kneeling and working on a panel. All workers wear white hard hats. In the background, there are stacks of materials, including wooden planks and metal rods, organized across the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地上铺设着大型黑色面板板，三名工人正在作业。其中一名工人跪着，正在检查面板板的边缘，另一名工人弯腰俯身在一块面板板上方。第三名工人同样跪着，正在一块面板板上作业。所有工人都戴着白色安全帽。背景中，材料堆放在工地各处，包括木托盘和金属杆。

text: A worker in an orange shirt and shorts is operating a large piece of tracked paving machinery. To the left, another worker is walking away from the camera, pushing a wheelbarrow near a parked pickup truck. In the background, an excavator is visible on a mound of earth.
zh: 一名身穿橙色上衣和短裤的工人正在操作一台大型摊铺路面机械。在画面左侧，另一名工人正背对镜头走去，推着一根钢筋，靠近一辆停放的自卸卡车。在背景中，一台挖掘机可见于一堆土堆之上。

text: The image shows three tower cranes with their booms extending across the frame. The foreground features an array of vertical rebars protruding from an unfinished concrete structure.
zh: 图像展示了三座塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面。前景特征是一排垂直的栏杆，从完工的结构混凝土中突出。

text: The bulldozer with a yellow blade and a blue operator's cabin is actively moving earth on a dirt terrain with visible tread marks.
zh: 黄色刀片的、蓝色操作室的的地牛正在可见胎记的泥地上移动。

text: The image shows an orange excavator positioned on a dirt surface with its arm extended and bucket resting on the ground. There is a steep, bare earthen slope in the background.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机停放在泥土地面上，其机械臂伸出，铲斗放置在地面上。背景中有一处陡峭的、裸露出土质的边坡坡。

text: In the foreground, there are blue-roofed temporary structures, likely for site offices or worker accommodations. Moving towards the center, a large expanse of rocky terrain is visible with several heavy vehicles, including dump trucks and earthmovers, actively engaged in excavation or transportation.
zh: 前景中可见蓝色篷布临时结构，可能用于现场办公或工人住宿。向中心移动，可见一大片岩石地貌，有多辆重型型车辆，包括抽油卡车和挖掘机，正积极参与挖掘或运输作业。

text: In the foreground, there are several workers spread across an excavation site with muddy terrain. From left to right, two workers are standing near a mound of earth, one wearing a yellow hard hat, and the other without visible safety gear. Moving right, another worker in a yellow hard hat is walking towards the center, where two workers are positioned by a pool of water, one of whom is crouching at the water's edge. Further right, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands observing, and another is bent over, working at the ground.
zh: 前景中，几名工人分散在一处地形泥泞滑的开挖现场。从左至右，两名工人站在土堆旁，其中一人戴着黄色安全帽，另一人未见佩戴安全防护装备。向右移动，另一名戴黄色安全帽的工人朝中心走去，那里两名工人位于一池水旁，其中一人正对着水边哭泣。再向右，一名戴黄色安全帽的工人站立观察，另一人弯腰在地面作业。

text: The image shows multiple workers spaced out across a large area of rebar framework, with most of them bending or crouching as they work on the rebar. They are wearing safety helmets, and some are visible with gloves and safety vests. In the background, there are vertical rebar structures indicating ongoing construction, and a tower crane is visible in the distance. The construction site is surrounded by a green fence, and high-rise buildings can be seen in the far background under a cloudy sky.
zh: 画面中，多名工人分散在一处大型钢筋框架周围，其中大多数人在作业中弯腰或蜷缩着身子。他们头戴安全帽，部分人可见戴着防护手套和穿着安全背心。背景中，竖立的钢筋结构表明施工正在进行进行，远处可见一台塔式起重机。施工现场被一道绿色围栏所环绕，远处背景中，在多云的天空下，可以看到高层建筑。

err.zh: 表明施工正在进行进行

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red hard hat, a grey jacket, and dark pants, standing in a puddle of water and working against a concrete wall. The worker appears to be cleaning or applying a substance to the wall.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿灰色夹克，下身穿深色裤子，站在一滩积水中，正对着混凝土墙作业。该工人似乎正在清洁或向墙面涂抹布某种物质。

err.en: applying a substance to the wall
err.zh: 向墙面涂抹布某种物质

text: The excavator is actively digging into the earth, with its bucket scooping soil. The terrain is uneven with mounds of dirt, indicative of ongoing excavation or earthmoving work.
zh: 挖掘机正在向地面挖掘，其铲斗翻动泥土。地形平坦，伴有土堆，表明正在进行持续的挖掘或土方作业。

text: The image shows four workers wearing red hard hats and green raincoats, with one operating a small excavator, another holding a bucket, a third carrying a bucket, and a fourth walking with a tool in hand. A multi-level steel structure serves as the backdrop, with various steel beams and columns visible.

text: In the foreground, a worker is standing on a wheel loader, which is positioned next to another wheel loader on its right. Both wheel loaders are facing towards the right of the image, with the closest one having a bucket in a raised position.
zh: 前景中，一名工人站在一台轮式装载机上，该装载机位于另一台轮式装载机的右侧。两台轮式装载机均朝向画面右侧，其中最近的一台装载机上带有一个斗篷。

text: The image shows a large white silo with a conveyor arm extended to the right, positioned next to a concrete foundation. An orange excavator is situated to the left of the silo, working on the ground. To the right of the silo, there are stockpiles of construction materials. In the background, there is ongoing construction activity with several structures at various stages of completion, and a few vehicles are visible in the distance.
zh: 画面中有一台大型白色打桩机，其输送臂向右延伸，正位于混凝土基础之上。一台橙色挖掘机位于打桩机的左侧，正在地面上作业。打桩机右侧堆放着成堆的建筑材料。背景中正在进行施工活动，多处结构处于不同的完工阶段，远处可见几辆车。

err.en: positioned next to a concrete foundation
err.zh: 正位于混凝土基础之上

text: The image shows an excavator with its bucket raised above the muddy ground, and another excavator positioned with its arm extended towards the ground. In the background, there is a large building and a crane visible in the distance. The ground appears to be uneven and muddy with puddles of water, and there are piles of dirt throughout the site.
zh: 画面中，一台挖掘机的正将铲斗举过头顶的泥地之上，另一台挖掘机的则将其机械臂伸向地面。背景中可见一栋大型建筑以及远处一台起重机。地面看起来平坦且泥泞湿，遍布水坑，整个场地到处是成堆的泥土。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven and mudd
err.zh: 地面看起来平坦且泥泞湿

text: The image shows an excavator digging into the ground with its bucket on an uneven dirt surface. In the background, a person stands on a bridge overlooking the excavation site.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正用其铲斗挖地面，铲斗平放在泥土表面上。在背景中，一个人站在桥上俯瞰挖掘现场。

text: The worker squatting in the middle is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 蹲在中间的工人戴着一顶草帽，但并非一顶硬草帽。

text: In the foreground, a green dump truck is visible with a pile of dirt in its bed. Moving towards the background, there are two pile drivers standing tall, with their booms extended upwards. Between them, an excavator is operating, and another one is positioned slightly behind to the right. Various construction vehicles, including bulldozers and trucks, are scattered across the site.
zh: 前景中，一辆绿色自卸卡车清晰可见，其车斗内装有一堆泥土。向背景处，有两名司机站立得高，他们的斗篷向上延伸。在他们之间，一台挖掘机正在作业，另一台则位于其右后方稍远处。各类施工车辆，包括推土机和卡车，散布于整个场地。

err.en: two pile drivers standing tall, with the
err.zh: 有两名司机站立得高，他们的斗篷向上延伸

text: In the image, a construction site is illuminated at night. From left to right, there is an excavator with its arm extended over a pile of debris. Next to it, a dump truck is positioned with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading material. To the right of the dump truck, there is another construction vehicle, possibly a water truck or a second dump truck, facing the opposite direction. The background is dark, and the construction area is surrounded by what appears to be rock walls, indicating the site may be within a quarry or a large excavation.
zh: 夜间，一处建筑工地被灯光照亮。从左至右，有一台挖掘机，其臂架横跨在一堆碎石上方。紧挨着它，一辆自卸卡车停在那里，其车斗被抬起，暗示它未装载物料。在自卸卡车的右侧，有另一台施工车辆，可能是一辆水车或第二台自卸卡车，朝向相反的方向。背景是黑暗的，并且施工区域被看起来像是岩壁所环绕，表明该场地可能位于采石场或大型开挖场地之内。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and orange gloves is kneeling and working on a rebar framework. To the right, a blue water jug is placed on the ground. Three workers with yellow hard hats are standing and working on the rebar structure that extends across the image.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、手戴橙色手套的工人正跪着身子在钢筋框架上干活。右侧，一个蓝色水桶被放置在空地上。三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站着身子在横跨整个图像的延伸的钢筋框架上干活。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a blue hard hat and a long-sleeve jacket mixing concrete with a shovel on a concrete surface. To the right, there is a bucket and a blue barrel, and behind the worker, there is a large pile of earth with a textured surface.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴蓝色安全帽，身穿长袖夹克，手持铁锹，正在混凝土表面作业。右侧有一个桶和一根蓝色管道，工人身后有一大堆泥土，表面带有纹理。

text: The image shows two yellow construction vehicles on a dirt surface with a slight haze in the air. The vehicle on the left is an excavator with its arm extended upwards and its bucket attached to a yellow and black striped beam. The vehicle on the right is a bulldozer with its blade in contact with the ground. Both vehicles appear inactive and there are no visible operators or other people in the image.
zh: 画面显示两辆黄色施工车辆停在一处略有尘土的地面上，空气中弥漫着淡淡的的薄雾。左侧的车辆是一台挖掘机，其动臂向上伸展，铲斗连接在一根黄黑相间的横梁上。右侧车辆是一台推土机，其刀片与地面接触。两台车辆均处于作业状态，画面中未见任何操作人员或其他其他人员。

err.zh: 两台车辆均处于作业状态

err.en: no visible operators or other people
err.zh: 未见任何操作人员或其他其他人员

text: The image shows a muddy excavation area with standing water and several workers. In the foreground, a worker is walking towards the center, an excavator is positioned in the middle with a worker nearby, and another worker is walking on the right. In the midground, there are two pile drivers and a worker between them. Various construction materials, such as wooden planks and metal rods, are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 画面显示一处泥泞地开挖区域，有积水和几名工人。前景中，一名工人正朝画面中心走去，一台挖掘机位于中部，其附近有一名工人，另一名工人则在右侧行走。中景处，两堆土方之间有一名司机和一名工人。各种建筑材料，如木方和金属杆，散落在工地各处。

err.en: two pile drivers and a worker between th
err.zh: 两堆土方之间有一名司机和一名工人

text: The image shows a construction site where a concrete foundation with rebar is being prepared. Eleven workers in yellow vests and hard hats are spread across the site, engaged in various activities. Construction materials, including wooden planks and rebar, are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，正在准备混凝土基础，其中包含钢筋。十一名身穿黄色背心和硬帽的工人分散在工地各处，从事各种活动。建筑材料，包括木托盘和钢筋，散落在工地各处。

text: The image shows an excavation area with exposed earth and wooden formworks supported by numerous vertical rebars. Four workers wearing orange and yellow safety gear are visible; two are working within the formwork area, one is walking along the perimeter, and another is standing on the formwork. There are piles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖区域，裸露的土方和木质模板由众多垂直钢筋支撑。可见四名身穿橙色和黄色安全装备的工人；其中两人在模板区域内作业，一人沿周边行走，另一人站在模板上。现场散落着成堆的建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。

text: In the foreground, a yellow excavator is loading a large amount of dirt into the back of a muddy dump truck. Behind the truck, there is another vehicle, possibly a truck, parked on the site.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色挖掘机正将大量泥土装载进一辆泥泞渣自卸卡车的后部。卡车后方，现场还停着另一辆车，可能是一辆卡车。

text: The image shows a construction site with a pile of dirt and construction debris, including a concrete slab and metal pieces. A pile driver is actively engaged in work, generating a cloud of dust. In the background, two more pile drivers are present, and a crane's boom extends into the sky.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有一堆泥土和建筑废料，包括一块混凝土板和金属碎片。一名司机正积极从事工作，扬起一片尘土。背景中还有两名司机在场，一台起重机的吊臂伸向天空。

text: In the foreground, there is a large mound of earth with a yellow dump truck tilted to unload its contents to the left. Adjacent to the right is an orange bulldozer on level ground. In the background, there is a body of water with buildings on the far side.
zh: 前景中，有一大堆泥土，一辆黄色自卸卡车倾斜着，正将所载货物卸到左侧。其右侧近处，是一台橙色压路机停在地面上。背景中，有一片水域，远处一侧有建筑物。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, partially scaffolded building. A tower crane is visible above the building, and there is a tree to the right. The ground appears to be uneven with exposed soil.
zh: 图片显示一处建筑工地，有一栋大型建筑部分搭设了脚手架。建筑上方可见一台塔式起重机，右侧有一棵树。地面看起来平整，有裸露的土壤。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: In the foreground, multiple construction workers are scattered across the site, with several engaged in activities near the wooden planks and scaffolding. Moving towards the center, more workers are visible among the extensive scaffolding and formwork, which are in various stages of assembly.
zh: 前景中，多名建筑工人散布于整个工地现场，其中数人正在木模板和脚手架附近从事作业。向中心移动，更多工人在庞大的脚手架和脚手架中可见，他们处于不同的的组装阶段。

text: The construction site features extensive wooden formwork and rebar structures for what appears to be a foundation or walls. There are at least eight workers visible throughout the site, most wearing hard hats and some engaged in tasks such as carrying materials. The terrain surrounding the construction area is uneven and excavated, with mounds of earth visible.
zh: 施工现场具有广泛的木结构，以及看似作为基础或墙体的。整个工地现场至少可见八名工人，大多数佩戴安全帽，部分从事搬运材料等任务。施工区域周围的地形平坦且经过挖掘，可见大量泥土。

err.en: rebar structures for what appears to be
err.zh: 以及看似作为基础或墙体的

text: The image shows a large stockpile of construction materials, primarily consisting of stacked metal forms and some scattered wooden pieces. A yellow bulldozer is positioned to the left, with its operator visible inside the cabin. To the right, there is a red dump truck facing away from the viewpoint. The ground appears to be uneven and is composed of exposed earth, suggesting excavation work.
zh: 图中显示一处大型建筑废料堆，主要由堆叠的金属构件和零散的木质碎片组成。左侧停着一台黄色推土机，其操作员在驾驶室内清晰可见。右侧有一辆红色泵车，车头背向视角。地面看起来平整，由裸露出的泥土构成，暗示着挖掘作业。

text: The image shows a dirt road with tire tracks. There are two cement mixers parked side by side, followed by a dump truck with its bed raised, indicating it is unloading or has unloaded material. A large mound of earth is behind these vehicles, and beyond that, a line of trees against a clear sky.
zh: 一条土路上留有轮胎印迹。两辆水泥搅拌车并排停放，其后跟随一辆自卸卡车，其车斗架升起，表明其未装载或已卸载物料。这些车辆后方有一大堆泥土，再往后，一排树木映衬着晴朗的天空。

err.en: indicating it is unloading or has unload
err.zh: 表明其未装载或已卸载物料

text: In the foreground, a yellow bulldozer with a raised dirt-filled blade is positioned on the left, with its front facing the camera. Behind the bulldozer, slightly to the right, there is a black pickup truck parked on the construction site. In the background, multiple green scaffoldings cover the exterior of under-construction buildings, and a tower crane is visible to the right.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色推土机位于画面左侧，其装有泥土填充的刀片体处于抬起状态，正面朝向镜头。推土机后方略偏右侧，停着一辆黑色皮卡卡车，位于施工现场内。背景中，多处绿色脚手架覆盖着在建建筑的内部，右侧可见一台塔式起重机。

err.zh: 覆盖着在建建筑的内部

text: In the foreground, a worker is walking on a dirt road with a bulldozer to their left. Further back, another bulldozer is followed by a green dump truck driving on the road. To the right, several workers are near a white van and a blue cart, with construction materials and equipment scattered around them.
zh: 前景中，一名工人正沿着土路向左行走，其左侧有一台路面铣刨机。更远处，另一台路面铣刨机正由一辆绿色泵车沿道路行驶。右侧，几名工人靠近一辆白色厢式货车和一辆蓝色手推车，周围散落着建筑材料和设备。

err.en: with a bulldozer to their left
err.zh: 向左行走，其左侧有一台路面铣刨机

text: In the foreground, there is a water-filled trench with wooden planks across it, leading to a concrete foundation with vertical and horizontal rebar in place for wall construction. Four workers wearing orange safety vests and hard hats are working on the rebar structure. Behind them, a blue fence encloses the site, and beyond the fence, there are residential buildings and vegetation.
zh: 前景中，有一条注满水的的水的水沟，横跨其上的设有木质挡板，通向一处混凝土基础，其上设有竖向及水平钢筋，用于墙体施工。四名身着橙色安全背心及安全帽的工人正在钢筋结构上作业。在他们身后，一道蓝色围栏将现场围合，而在围栏外，则有住宅建筑及植被。

err.zh: 一条注满水的的水的水沟

text: The image shows a nighttime construction scene within a large open space. Two excavators are positioned in the center, one with its bucket raised and the other with its bucket down, both appear to be engaged in earthmoving activities. A dump truck with its bed raised is located between the excavators, suggesting it is being loaded or has just been unloaded. The area is well-lit by artificial lighting, and the ground is covered with a layer of excavated material.
zh: 画面呈现一处大型露天场地内的夜间施工场景。两台挖掘机位于场地中央，其中一台的铲斗处于抬起状态，另一台的则处于放下状态，二者均似正在进行土方作业。一台自卸式卡车停放在两台挖掘机之间，暗示其正在装载或刚刚完成卸载货。该区域由人工照明设施提供充足照明，地面覆盖着一层挖掘出的来的之物料。

err.zh: 一层挖掘出的来的之物料

text: The image shows a worker standing near a water truck on the left, and another worker is walking across the site. A yellow bulldozer is in operation, with black pipes laid out in front of it. A yellow excavator is positioned behind the bulldozer, lifting red pipes.
zh: 画面左侧有一名工人站在一辆水罐车旁，另一名工人正横穿工地现场。一台黄色压路机正在作业，其前方铺设着黑色管道。一台黄色挖掘机位于压路机后方，正吊运红色管道。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on muddy terrain, with its arm extended upwards holding a pile-driving hammer. A worker wearing a green jacket and a safety helmet is standing to the left of the excavator.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在泥泞地上，其臂向上伸展，握着一堆驱动锤。一名身穿绿色夹克和安全帽的工人站在挖掘机的左侧。

text: In the foreground, there are red metal sheets and wooden planks on the ground. Moving towards the middle, there are several construction workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests; they are standing within a network of red metal formworks and scaffolding, which appear to be set up for concrete casting. In the background, there is a large mound of earth covered partially with green tarps, and more workers can be seen on top of this mound.
zh: 前景中，地面上铺有红色金属板和木托盘。向画面中部看去，有几名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的施工人员，他们站在由红色金属框架和脚手架组成的的一张网络中，这些框架和脚手架似乎是为混凝土浇筑而搭建的。背景中，有一大堆土，部分被绿色草覆盖，在这堆土的上方还能看到更多工人。

text: The image shows a nighttime construction scene illuminated by bright lights. In the foreground, there's a large, smooth concrete surface. A concrete pump with an extended boom is visible on the left, and a group of workers is gathered near the center, likely engaged in a concrete pouring operation.
zh: 夜间施工现场，灯光通明。前景是一大片大面积、平整的混凝土表面。左侧可见一台混凝土泵，配有增压装置，中心附近聚集着一群工人，很可能正在进行混凝土浇筑作业。

text: The image shows a large stockpile of black rebars in the foreground. Numerous workers are dispersed across a vast area with constructed rebar frameworks on the ground, some bending over the frameworks, possibly tying or adjusting them. A yellow tower crane stands prominently on the left side.
zh: 前景中堆放着一大堆黑色钢筋。众多工人分散在广阔区域，地面上搭建着钢筋框架，有些弯曲跨越框架，可能系住或调整它们。一台黄色塔式起重机显著地矗立在左侧。

text: The image shows three workers with white hard hats engaged in activities on a concrete floor. The worker on the left is bending over, possibly examining or working on something on the ground, while the worker in the middle is holding a plan or document, and the worker on the right is crouched and working with a tool or device. Behind them, there is a green fence and vertical rebar structures protruding from the concrete base, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 画面显示三名头戴白色安全帽的工人正在混凝土地面上进行作业。左侧的工人弯着腰，似乎在检查或处理地面上的某物；中间的工人手持一份图纸或文件；右侧的工人弓着身子，正操作着某工具或设备。在他们身后，有一道绿色围栏以及从混凝土基面伸出的来的的一根垂直钢筋结构，表明施工正在进行持续进行。

err.zh: 伸出的来的的一根垂直钢筋结构
表明施工正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows a mobile crane with its boom extended towards a tower crane in the center of the image. To the right, a large structure is under construction with extensive scaffolding. Several construction materials, including pipes and wooden planks, are scattered around the site. There are at least four workers visible: one operating the mobile crane, one near the base of the tower crane, and two on the scaffolding of the structure.
zh: 图像显示一台移动式起重机，其吊臂伸向画面中央的一台塔式起重机。右侧，一座大型建筑正在施工中，搭设有大量脚手架。现场周围散落着多种建筑材料，包括管道和木托盘。至少可以看到四名工人：一人操作着移动式起重机，一人靠近塔式起重机的基座，还有两人在脚手架上。

text: The image shows a red dump truck loaded with soil, positioned on uneven ground with its bed raised slightly. Behind the truck, a pile driving rig is visible, with its mast extended vertically into the air.
zh: 一辆红色自卸卡车满载着泥土，停放在平整的地面上，其车斗略微抬高。在卡车后方，可见一台钻机架，其桅杆垂直伸向空中。

text: The worker on the left next to a mixer truck is not wearing a high-visibility retroreflective vest when working at night.
zh: 左侧的工人即将驶向一辆混装卡车，夜间作业时未穿着高可视性反光背心。

err.zh: 即将驶向一辆混装卡车

text: In the center of the image, there is a blue car on a dirt road with tire tracks. The ground is uneven with patches of rocks and soil.
zh: 画面中央，一辆蓝色汽车行驶在一条土路上，路面上留有轮胎印迹。地面较为平整，夹杂着岩石和泥土块的。

text: In the foreground, there is a water-filled ditch with sandbags along its edge. An orange dump truck is positioned in front of a yellow excavator, which appears to be loading or unloading material into the truck's bed. Behind the truck and excavator, there is a yellow compressor or generator on a trailer. In the background, industrial buildings with blue roofs can be seen, and a blue fence runs along the perimeter of the site.
zh: 前景中，有一个注满水的的水坑，其边缘堆有沙袋。一辆橙色泵车停在一台黄色挖掘机前方，该挖掘机似乎正在向卡车车厢装载或卸载物料。在卡车和挖掘机后方，有一台黄色压缩机或发电机放置在拖车上。背景中，可以看到带有蓝色屋顶的工业建筑，并且一道蓝色围栏沿着场地周边延伸。

text: In the foreground, there is a yellow excavator with its bucket raised, positioned on the left side of the image. Two workers, one standing and one squatting, are near the excavator, both wearing white hard hats. A pile of gravel is in the center, and to the right, the excavator's arm extends over uneven dirt terrain.
zh: 前景中，有一台黄色挖掘机，其铲斗扬起，位于画面左侧。两名工人，一人站立，一人蹲着，靠近挖掘机，两人都戴着白色安全帽。画面中央有一堆碎石，右侧，挖掘机的臂架横跨平整土地面。

text: The image shows four workers wearing orange overalls and pink hard hats working on a construction site with dense rebar frameworks on the ground.
zh: 图像显示四名工人头戴橙色安全帽和粉色安全帽，在地面上一个密集的钢筋框架上工作。

err.en: orange overalls and pink hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽和粉色安全帽

text: The image shows a yellow Komatsu excavator on the right, positioned on a mound of earth, with its arm extended towards a deep trench in the center. The trench runs from the foreground into the distance, flanked by mounds of excavated soil. The background includes greenery and a partially visible structure with pixelated sections, likely for privacy.
zh: 画面右侧是一台黄色的小松挖掘机，停在一堆土堆上，其机械臂伸向画面中央的一条深邃沟。沟渠从前景一直延伸至远处，两侧堆着挖掘出的来的泥土。背景中可见绿植丛以及部分被像素化处理的过的，可能是出于隐私考虑。

err.en: a partially visible structure with pixel
err.zh: 部分被像素化处理的过的

text: The worker wearing a red hard hat and safety vest is leveling a pile of sand with a shovel. To the right, another worker is handling a hose near a concrete mixer. Behind them, a yellow mobile crane extends across the image towards an under-construction building with scaffolding.
zh: 一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正用铁锹铲起一堆沙子。右侧，另一名工人手持软管子靠近一台混凝土搅拌机。在他们身后，一台黄色移动式起重机横跨画面伸向一栋带有脚手架的在建建筑。

err.en: leveling a pile of sand with a shovel

text: In the foreground, a worker stands next to a yellow wheel loader, with a green dump truck loaded with soil in the center. Moving to the right, there are multiple construction vehicles, including a blue water truck, a yellow bulldozer, and another wheel loader.
zh: 前景中，一名工人站在一台黄色轮式装载机旁，中央是一辆装载着泥土的绿色自卸卡车。向右移动，有多台施工车辆，包括一辆蓝色自卸卡车、一台黄色平地机以及另一台轮式装载机。

text: The image shows a large pile-driving rig with its mast extended upwards and cables attached. To the left, a smaller rig is angled and appears to be in operation. Various construction materials, including cylindrical objects and blue barrels, are scattered around the site. In the background, multiple pieces of heavy machinery, such as excavators and trucks, are visible, along with a few workers near the machinery.
zh: 图中显示一台大型打桩机，其桅杆向上延伸，并连接着电缆。左侧有一台较小的、呈倾斜角度的且似乎处于作业状态的中的打桩机。现场周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括圆柱形物体和蓝色油桶。背景中可见多台重型型机械，例如挖掘机和卡车，以及几名工人靠近机械。

err.en: a smaller rig is angled and appears to b
err.zh: 呈倾斜角度的且似乎处于作业状态的中的打桩机

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer with a cabin actively moving earth on a construction site with uneven and dug-up terrain. The bulldozer is facing towards the right, indicating movement in that direction.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色推土机正在建筑工地上作业，地面平整且经过挖掘。推土机朝向右侧，表明其正在向该方向移动。

text: The image shows a muddy construction site with a large yellow excavator positioned in the center, its bucket raised and soil visible on the ground indicating recent activity.
zh: 图中显示一处泥泞污的施工场地，一台大型黄色挖掘机位于场地中央，其铲斗已抬起，地面上可见泥土土，表明近期有作业活动。

text: In the foreground, there is foliage partially obscuring the view. A yellow bulldozer is positioned in the center of the image, working on a dirt surface with visible tracks. To the right of the bulldozer, there is a trench with a pink pipe extending into it.
zh: 前景中，有植被部分遮挡了视野。一台黄色压路机位于画面中央，正在一处可见车辙的泥地表面作业。压路机右侧，有一条沟渠，一根粉色管道延伸入其中。

text: In the foreground, there is a dirt road with tire tracks leading towards a construction site. A worker wearing a safety vest is standing in the center, facing a white truck that is parked on the road. To the right of the worker, there is a yellow excavator and further right, a yellow bulldozer is visible. Both pieces of heavy machinery are stationary. In the background, a large, multi-story steel structure is under construction, with multiple floors visible.
zh: 前景中，有一条土路，路面上有轮胎痕迹，通向一处建筑工地。画面中央站着一名身穿安全背心的的工人，正面对向一辆停靠在路面上的的一辆白色卡车。在工人的的右侧，有一台黄色挖掘机，再往右方向，可见一台黄色推土机。这两台重型机械均处于静止状态。背景中，有一栋大型多层钢结构建筑正在施工，可见多个楼层。

err.en: A worker wearing a safety vest
err.zh: 一名身穿安全背心的的工人

err.en: To the right of the worker

text: The image shows a dense construction site with extensive scaffolding covering the majority of the area. A large yellow tower crane extends vertically near the center, with its boom reaching towards the right side of the image. On the left, there is a section with completed concrete flooring, while the right side shows an area with exposed scaffolding and formwork, indicating ongoing construction.
zh: 图像显示一个密集的施工现场，大量脚手架覆盖了大部分区域。一台大型黄色塔式起重机在靠近中心处垂直延伸，其吊臂伸向图像右侧。左侧有一个区域，其混凝土地面已完工，而右侧则显示出裸露出的脚手架和模板，表明施工正在进行进行中。

err.zh: 表明施工正在进行进行中

text: The worker wearing an orange safety vest and a yellow hard hat is facing away from the camera, observing the construction site. A series of rebar grids are laid out on the ground, with several workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats distributed along the length of the rebar grids. Construction materials, such as wooden planks and additional rebar, are scattered around the site. The background shows an excavated area with mounds of earth and a body of water further back, with trees and structures on the far side of the water.
zh: 一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿橙色安全背心的的工人背对镜头，正在观察施工现场。地面上铺设着一排钢筋网格，多名身穿橙色上衣、头戴黄色安全帽的工人沿钢筋网格长度分布。木材等建筑材料，如木托盘及额外的钢筋，散落在场地周围。背景显示一片开挖区域，伴有泥土堆及一具水，进一步位于水体远侧，伴有树木及结构。

err.en: a body of water further back, with trees
err.zh: 一具水，进一步位于水体远侧，伴有树木及结构

text: The image shows multiple stacks of construction materials, including wooden planks and metal rebars, arranged on the ground. Several workers wearing yellow hard hats are actively engaged in various tasks across the construction site. A large tower crane is visible in the background, extending over the site.
zh: 画面中可见多堆建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属钢筋，整齐地摆放在地面上。几名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在施工现场积极从事各项作业。背景中可见一台大型塔式起重机，横跨整个工地。

text: The image shows an excavator on muddy terrain with its bucket in contact with the ground. There are several exposed rebars protruding from the ground in the foreground and extending towards the middle of the image. Puddles of water are visible in the excavated areas, and the ground is uneven with tracks and dug-up soil, indicating recent excavation work.
zh: 图像显示一台挖掘机位于泥泞土地上，其铲斗与地面接触。前景中有几根裸露的钢筋从地面伸出，向图像中部延伸。挖掘区域可见水坑，地面平整，带有车辙和挖掘的泥土，表明近期有挖掘作业。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on the left, with its bucket extended over a dump truck, suggesting the loading or unloading of material. The background features an expansive construction site with various areas covered by black geotextile fabric, and multiple dump trucks are present, indicating ongoing earthmoving activities. The terrain is mostly bare with patches of vegetation, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 画面左侧有一台黄色挖掘机，其铲斗臂横跨在一辆自卸卡车上方，暗示着物料的装载或卸载作业。背景呈现一处大型建筑工地，多个区域被黑色土工织物覆盖，且现场有多辆自卸卡车，表明正在进行土方方作业。地形大部分裸露，仅有零星散植被，天空阴沉云密布。

text: The image shows a worker wearing an orange jacket and a yellow hard hat, working on a rebar framework for a concrete structure. The rebar is rust-colored, indicating it is likely steel.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿橙色夹克，头戴黄色安全帽，正在一个混凝土框架上作业。该框架呈锈色，表明其材质很可能为钢材。

text: The image shows multiple construction materials, including bags of cement, large black pipes, and various lengths of lumber. A mobile crane with an extended boom is positioned near a building under construction with scaffolding. An excavator is visible, and behind it, there appears to be a partially constructed building or structure.
zh: 画面中可见多种建筑材料，包括一袋水泥、大型黑色管道以及不同长度的规格的木材。一台配备伸缩臂的移动起重机正位于一栋正在施工的建筑附近，该建筑设有脚手架。一台挖掘机清晰可见，其后方似乎是一栋部分已建成的建筑或结构。

text: In the foreground, there are multiple large mounds of excavated earth. Moving towards the middle ground, there is a blue excavator on the left side. In the background, multistory buildings are visible, with a clear sky above.
zh: 前景中，有多堆大型挖掘土方堆。中景处，左侧有一台蓝色挖掘机。背景中，可见多栋历史建筑，上方是晴朗的天空。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple bundles of rebar and loose gravel on the ground. A trench with vertical rebar structures is visible, and a few workers are present, including one operating an excavator and others performing tasks along the trench. Industrial buildings are visible in the background, along with a worker at the far end of the trench and white sacks possibly containing construction materials near the trench.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面上有多堆钢筋和松散的碎石。可见一条带有竖向钢筋结构的的地沟，几名工人在场，包括一名操作挖掘机的的人员以及沿地沟执行其他任务的人员。背景中可见工业建筑，地沟远端处有一名工人以及一个白色袋子，可能装有施工材料，靠近地沟。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large reinforced steel structure. Three workers are present: one standing on the structure, handling rebar; another bending down to work on rebar on the structure; and a third walking away from the structure on the ground level.
zh: 图中显示一个大型钢结构施工现场。三名工人在场：一人站立于结构旁，手持钢筋；另一人弯腰作业于钢筋之上；第三人则走开离地面层。

text: In the foreground, there is a large pile of soil and construction debris. To the right, a yellow excavator is positioned near the edge of an excavation pit, with its arm extended over the pit. Next to the excavator, there are several bundles of rebar lying on the ground.
zh: 前景处有一大堆泥土和建筑废料。右侧，一台黄色挖掘机停靠在基坑边缘，其臂架横跨在坑上方。紧挨着挖掘机，地面上放着几根钢筋。

text: The image shows a silver sedan parked on a dirt road. In the background, there is an early-stage construction site with exposed earth and no visible structures. Several workers are scattered across the site, engaged in various activities. A bulldozer is operating in the middle distance, and there are more construction vehicles in the background, including a yellow grader.
zh: 一辆银色轿车停放在土路上。背景中有一处早期施工工地，裸露着泥土，没有可见结构。几名工人分散在工地各处，从事着各种活动。一台推土机在中距离处作业，背景中还有更多施工车辆，包括一辆黄色装载机。

text: The image shows a person wearing a grey hoodie and dark pants standing in front of a stationary excavator, which is covered in mud. The ground is uneven and muddy, suggesting recent excavation work.
zh: 图中显示一名身穿灰色上衣和深色裤子的人站在一台静止的挖掘机前，该挖掘机被泥浆覆盖。地面平坦且泥泞滑，暗示近期有挖掘作业。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat standing near construction materials, including wooden planks and metal rods. Two workers in the middle ground are climbing a ladder and standing on a constructed platform, both wearing yellow hard hats. A yellow tower crane is situated to the right, and the background features temporary blue structures, possibly site offices or storage units, as well as high-rise buildings.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在建筑材料旁，其中包括木托盘和金属杆。画面中央有两名工人正在攀爬梯子，并站在搭建中的平台上，两人均佩戴黄色安全帽。右侧设有一台黄色塔式起重机，背景中可见临时蓝色结构，可能为现场办公或仓储单元，以及高层建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, open framework structure. A worker wearing a yellow hard hat is visible within this framework, standing on a grid of rebar that covers the floor of the structure. The framework is surrounded by green safety netting, and the structure has blue scaffolding supports along the edges.
zh: 图中显示一个大型开放式建筑施工现场。在该框架内，可见一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人，站在覆盖楼板的面的层的网格的钢筋上。该框架周围环绕着绿色安全防护网，并且沿边缘设有蓝色脚手架支撑。

err.en: standing on a grid of rebar that covers
err.zh: 站在覆盖楼板的面的层的网格的钢筋上

text: The image shows two articulated dump trucks positioned on a wet surface, facing towards the camera. The truck on the left is slightly ahead of the one on the right. Behind the trucks, there is a red mobile crane with its boom partially visible. To the right, there is a yellow pedestrian barrier, and in the background, an overpass can be seen.
zh: 画面显示两辆铰接式泵车停在一处潮湿滑的表面，车头朝向镜头方向。左侧的卡车略微位于右侧卡车的前。在卡车后方，有一台红色移动式起重机，其吊臂部分可见。右侧有一道黄色行人护栏，背景中可见一座人行天桥。

text: A worker wearing a yellow hard hat is sitting and working on a task. A group of workers under a blue structure with Chinese characters are handling and possibly cutting or bending rebars. All workers are wearing hard hats in various colors, and some are wearing safety vests.
zh: 一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正坐着执行任务。一群头戴蓝色安全帽的工人正在处理，可能切割或弯曲钢筋。所有工人都戴着各色安全帽，其中一些人还穿着安全背心。

err.en: under a blue structure with Chinese char

text: The image shows a yellow and black bulldozer with muddy tracks, marked with the brand "SHANTUI." The operator is visible inside the cabin. The bulldozer is positioned on a dirt surface with disturbed soil in the foreground and background, indicating recent earthmoving activity.
zh: 图中显示一台黄黑相的道道切割机，带有泥泞污的履带，标有品牌“SHANTUI”。操作员在驾驶室内可见。这台道路切割机位于前景的泥土表面，带有扰动的土壤，背景中，表明近期有土方移动活动。

text: The image shows a dirt road with tire tracks leading to a yellow dump truck facing left. To the right, there is a blue tarp covering materials on the ground. In the midground, there is a construction site with a concrete foundation and numerous vertical rebars protruding upwards. On the left, a green mesh fence partially encloses the site.
zh: 土路有轮胎印迹，导致一辆黄色自卸卡车朝左方。右侧，地面上有一块蓝色防水布。中间，有一处建筑工地，带有混凝土基础，并有许多竖直钢筋向上突出。左侧，一道绿色网格围栏部分遮挡了工地。

err.en: leading to a yellow dump truck facing le
err.zh: 导致一辆黄色自卸卡车朝左方

text: The image shows a construction site with three tower cranes. From left to right: the first crane has a horizontal jib extended towards the center of the image, the second crane is positioned in the middle with its jib pointing to the right, and the third crane is on the right with its jib also extending towards the center. Below the cranes, there are multiple vertical steel rebars protruding from an unfinished structure.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三台塔式起重机。从左至右：第一台起重机的吊臂向画面中心延伸，第二台起重机位于中间，其吊臂指向右侧，第三台起重机位于右侧，其吊臂同样向中心延伸。起重机下方，有多根垂直的钢梁从已完工的结构体中伸出。

text: The image shows two workers engaged with a cylindrical object placed on a scale; one is pouring a substance into it while the other observes. Both are wearing white hard hats. A third person, wearing a red hard hat, is observing the process. Behind them, there is a silver pickup truck with its door open, and a bulldozer is visible in the far background.
zh: 画面中显示两名工人正与一个圆柱形物体互动；其中一人正在向该物体倾倒某种物质，另一人则在旁观察。两人都戴着白色安全帽。在他们身后，还有一位戴着红色安全帽的人员正在观察该过程。在他们后方，有一辆银色皮卡卡车，车门处于打开状态，远处背景中可见一台压路机。

zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一辆混凝土泵车正将其料斗篷覆盖在基础区域上方，那里有几名工人在场。至少有三个工人可见，他们穿着安全背心和硬帽子，站在基础钢筋框架附近。

text: The image shows a conveyor belt transporting what appears to be aggregate material at a construction site. There are at least three workers visible; two are wearing red hard hats and one is wearing a white hard hat. The workers with red hard hats are standing next to machinery that seems to be processing the material, while the worker with the white hard hat is observing or supervising.
zh: 图中显示一条传送带正在运输看似骨料料的的材料，位于一处建筑工地现场。可见至少有三名工人；其中两人戴着红色安全帽，一人戴着白色安全帽。戴红色安全帽的工人正站在看似加工该材料的料的的大型机械旁，而戴白色安全帽的工人正在观察或监督。

err.en: machinery that seems to be processing th
err.zh: 加工该材料的料的的大型机械

text: The image shows a red dump truck in the foreground, positioned on muddy terrain with its bed raised, indicating it is unloading or has unloaded material. In the background, there is an excavator at work, situated on a higher level of dirt ground. The environment appears to be a large excavation site.
zh: 画面前景处有一辆红色自卸卡车，停放在泥泞地上，其车斗架已升起，表明该车未装载或已卸载物料。背景中有一台挖掘机正在作业，位于较高的处的泥地之上。环境看起来像一个大型开挖场地。

err.en: indicating it is unloading or has unload
err.zh: 表明该车未装载或已卸载物料

text: The image shows a construction site with four individuals and a concrete pump truck. The truck is positioned on the left side of the image, with its boom extended over a network of scaffolding and rebar.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有四个人和一辆混凝土泵车。卡车位于图像的左侧，其车斗跨越脚手架网络和钢筋。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers. One worker is standing on the left side of the image, while two workers are on the right side, with one of them operating a tripod stand with a pulley system. There are several trees in the middle ground, and the site is characterized by exposed earth and some construction materials scattered around, such as wooden planks and concrete structures.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人。一名工人站在图像的左侧，另外两名工人在右侧，其中一人正在操作一台配备滑轮索系统的的三脚架。地面中央有几棵树，该场地以裸露土为特征，周围散落着一些建筑材料，例如木托盘和混凝土结构。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers. Three workers wearing blue overalls and hard hats are standing together, possibly discussing. Another three workers in yellow and red hard hats are using shovels. There are several long metal beams on the ground in the foreground. The background features a large concrete wall with wooden supports.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人。三名工人身穿蓝色工装，头戴安全帽，站在一起，可能正在讨论。另外三名工人身穿黄色红色工装，头戴安全帽，正在使用扳手。前景地面上有几根长长的金属梁。背景中有一面大型混凝土墙，带有木质支撑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow tower crane in the center, its jib extending across the frame. A mobile crane with a blue boom is visible on the left, hoisting a load. There are two covered material stockpiles in the midground, resembling large bags. Vegetation with pink blossoms is noticeable in the foreground, and there are additional trees behind the crane.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台大型黄色色塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面。左侧可见一台移动式起重机，吊臂上挂着一台蓝色吊斗。地面上有两堆材料，形似大型袋装。前景中可见一片开着粉色花朵的植被，起重机后方还有额外的树木。

err.zh: 吊臂上挂着一台蓝色吊斗

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator with a multi-tined grapple attachment, positioned over a pile of dirt, and a worker standing nearby. To the left, there is a soil compactor with a roller in front. Further back, another worker is visible, and a wheel loader is positioned near the center. The ground appears to be uneven with visible tire tracks and dug-up soil.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一台挖掘机配有多齿附件，停在一堆泥土上方，附近站着一名工人。左侧有一台带滚轮的的地面机械，更后方可见另一名工人，一台轮式装载机位于中心附近。地面看起来平整，带有可见轮胎痕迹和挖掘的泥土。

text: The image shows a single excavator operating in a muddy construction area with one visible operator inside the cab. The excavator is partially covered in mud, indicating recent activity in the area. The ground around the excavator appears to be uneven and recently disturbed, suggesting excavation work is in progress.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正在泥泞地施工区域内作业，驾驶室内可见一名操作人员。挖掘机部分被泥浆覆盖，表明该区域近期有作业活动。挖掘机周围地面看似平整且近期受到扰动，暗示挖掘工作正在推进中。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the center, operated by a person visible in the cabin. The ground is uneven with areas of exposed dirt, and there are piles of earth throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中心有一台黄色推土机，由一名可见于驾驶室内的人员操作。地面平整，有裸露的泥土区域，且整个场地散布着土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with red muddy ground and scattered debris. A worker wearing a hard hat and dark clothing is standing on the left side, holding a shovel. In the center, there is a partially built concrete structure with exposed rebar. To the right, an excavator is visible, and there are several shovels propped against the concrete structure. The background features a steel framework of a building under construction.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，地面有红色泥浆水和散落的物。左侧站着一名头戴安全帽、身穿深色衣服的物的工人，手持铁锹。中心有一处部分建成的混凝土结构，露出钢筋。右侧可见一台挖掘机，还有几把铁锹斜靠在混凝土结构上。背景中有一处正在施工中的建筑钢架。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large scaffolding structure in the background. The person on the left is standing and wearing a red hard hat, a blue shirt, dark pants, and a black shoulder bag, and appears to be observing the surroundings. The individual on the right is kneeling on the ground, wearing a white hard hat, a gray t-shirt, and dark pants, and is engaged in an activity involving the soil. The ground appears to be dry and uneven, and there is a green fence partially visible behind the scaffolding.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，背景中有一个大型脚手架。左侧的人站立着，头戴红色安全帽，身穿蓝色衬衫，下身穿深色裤子，肩挎着一个黑色挎包，似乎正在观察周围环境。右侧的人跪在地上，头戴白色安全帽，身穿灰色T恤，下身穿深色裤子，正在从事与土壤相关的的工作。地面看起来干燥且平整，脚手架后方隐约可见绿色围栏网。

text: The image shows an interior view of a construction site with one worker standing on a scaffold platform, welding at the edge of an unfinished floor. The worker is wearing a safety harness, a helmet, and protective gear. In the foreground, there is a gas cylinder lying horizontally on the floor. The background features large windows framing a view of multiple buildings under construction with green safety netting, and several cranes are visible in the distance.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的内部视角，一名工人站在脚手架平台上，正在对已完工楼层边缘进行焊接作业。该工人佩戴着安全带、安全帽以及防护装备。前景中，有一个气瓶水平放置在地板上。背景中，大窗框框出了多栋正在施工的建筑，配有绿色安全防护网，远处可见若干台起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being poured into a formwork structure reinforced with steel rebars. A concrete pump with a red boom is extended over the formwork, delivering concrete. There are three workers visible; two are on the ground near the formwork, and one is elevated on the formwork, all wearing orange safety vests and hard hats.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，混凝土正被浇筑进由钢筋加强的化的成的模板结构中。一台混凝土泵，带有红色泵体，横跨模板结构，输送混凝土。可见三名工人；两人在模板结构附近的地面上，一人被抬高在模板结构上，全都穿着橙色安全背心和硬帽子。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, partially constructed rebar framework on the left. On the right, there is a scaffolding structure where four workers are present; two are standing on the upper level, and two are on the lower level, handling construction materials. A blue mixing machine is situated on the upper level of the scaffolding. Below the scaffolding, on the ground level, another worker wearing a yellow hard hat is visible.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，左侧有一个大型、部分搭建的钢筋框架。右侧有一个脚手架，上面站着四名工人；下面有两名工人正在搬运建筑材料。脚手架的上层放置着一台蓝色搅拌机。在脚手架下方的，地面上，可以看到另一名戴着黄色安全帽的工人。

err.en: two are standing on the upper level, and
err.zh: 上面站着四名工人；下面有两名工人

text: The image shows two individuals standing at the base of a large, tiered concrete retaining wall. They appear to be engaged in a discussion or assessment of the site. The surrounding area is rocky and uneven, with some debris and construction materials scattered around the ground. The terrain behind the wall slopes upward, indicating that the construction site may be on a hillside or similar incline.
zh: 图像显示两名人员站在大型阶梯式混凝土挡土墙基上。他们似乎正在就场地进行一场讨论或评估。周边区域岩石且平整，地面上散落着一些碎石和建筑材料。墙体后方的地形向上倾斜，表明施工场地可能位于山坡一侧或类似山脊处。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of exposed earth in the foreground. In the middle ground, there is a yellow articulated dump truck. Behind the truck, there is an unfinished concrete structure with multiple vertical rebars protruding from it.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景是大片裸露的泥土。地面中部停着一辆黄色自卸卡车。卡车后方是一栋已完工的结构，其上伸出多根竖向钢筋。

text: The image shows a construction site with three pieces of heavy machinery and one worker visible. In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is standing on the ground. In the middle ground, there is a yellow compactor and a yellow bulldozer, both are stationary. To the right, another bulldozer is actively moving soil. The ground appears to be muddy with some standing water and tire tracks.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三台重型机械和一名可见工人。前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在地面上。中景处，有一台黄色色挖掘机和一台黄色色推土机，两者均处于静止状态。右侧，另一台推土机正在积极移动泥土。地面看起来泥泞湿，带有一些积水和轮胎痕迹。

err.en: yellow compactor and a yellow bulldozer
err.zh: 黄色色挖掘机和一台黄色色推土机

text: The image shows two large yellow tower cranes at a construction site, with their jibs extending outwards. The crane on the left has a counterweight and a cabin beneath its jib, while the crane on the right has its cabin positioned behind the counterweight. Both cranes have hoist lines with hooks hanging down, and the one on the right has a tangle in its line. In the background, there are multiple other cranes and a building enveloped in green scaffolding with safety netting.
zh: 画面中显示两台大型黄色塔式起重机位于建筑工地现场，其吊臂向外伸出。左侧的起重机在吊臂下方配有配重块和驾驶室，而右侧的起重机则驾驶室位于配重块后方。两台起重机均带有悬垂钢丝绳，其末端悬挂有吊钩，右侧那台在其钢丝绳上带有一个角度。背景中还有多台其他起重机以及一栋被绿色脚手架和安全网包裹的建筑。

err.en: has a tangle in its line

text: The image shows two excavators on a construction site with uneven, dug-up ground. The excavator on the left is orange and branded Hitachi, while the one on the right is yellow. Both excavators are stationary, and there is an operator visible in the cabin of the yellow excavator.
zh: 图片显示，在一个建筑工地上有两台挖掘机，地面平整。左边的那台挖掘机是橙色的，品牌为日立，而右边那台是黄色色。两台挖掘机均处于静止状态，且可以看到黄色挖掘机驾驶室内有一名操作人员。

text: The image shows a single excavator in the center, with its bucket raised and full of dirt, indicating excavation work in progress. There is one operator visible inside the excavator's cabin. The ground around the excavator is uneven and covered with dirt, suggesting an active excavation site.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其铲斗扬起且装满泥土，表明挖掘作业正在进行进行。驾驶室内可见一名操作人员。挖掘机周围地面平整且覆盖着泥土，暗示这是一个正在施工的的挖掘现场。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with scattered building materials, including wooden planks and metal rebars. There are at least four individuals visible, with two of them working together near the center of the site. Various construction materials and debris are spread throughout the area, and there are several motorcycles parked on the left side.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的俯瞰视角，现场散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属条。画面中至少可见四个人，其中两人正在场地中心附近协同作业。各种建筑材料和碎屑遍布整个区域，左侧停放着几辆摩托车。

text: The image shows a yellow Komatsu excavator in the center, actively engaged in digging within a large excavation site with visible earth and rock strata. The excavator's bucket is filled with soil, indicating ongoing work. In the background, there are blurred structures and vegetation. The sky is clear, suggesting fair weather conditions for construction activities.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色的小松挖掘机，正在一处大型开挖场地积极作业，现场可见泥土体与岩层。挖掘斗内装满泥土，表明作业正在进行持续进行。背景中可见模糊化的结构与植被。天空晴朗，表明天气条件适宜施工活动。

err.zh: 表明作业正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows a construction site with one individual visible, wearing dark clothing and walking between a bulldozer and a green truck. In the foreground, there is a brown car parked on the dirt ground. The background features a large building under construction with scaffolding and a crane.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，一名身穿深色衣物的的人正行走在一台路面铣刨机与一辆绿色卡车之间。前景处有一辆棕色轿车停放在泥地上。背景中有一栋正在施工的大型建筑，配有脚手架和起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with various activities in progress. In the foreground, there are multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including yellow and black pipes, rebars, and wooden planks. A red dump truck is parked near the center, and an excavator is positioned to its left. There are at least four workers visible, wearing hard hats and engaged in different tasks around the materials and equipment.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，各项活动正在进行推进。前景处有多个建筑材料堆，包括黄色和黑色的管道、钢筋以及木托盘。一辆红色自卸车停在中心附近，一台挖掘机位于其左侧。可见至少四名工人，头戴安全帽，正忙于材料周围和设备的不同任务。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, its bucket raised and positioned over an area that appears to have been recently dug. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and dug-up soil. There are wooden planks on the ground near the excavator.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，中央有一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起并位于一片看似近期挖掘过的区域的上方。地面平整，可见车辙印及挖出的来的土。挖掘机附近地面上有木质垫板。

text: The image shows a construction site with a dense network of rebar laid out on the ground, forming the reinforcement for a concrete structure. In the center, there is a circular rebar arrangement indicating a column or similar structure. An orange circular saw is placed on a wooden board in the foreground, suggesting cutting work might be taking place. The site appears to be well-organized and in the process of extensive foundational work.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，地面上铺设着密集的钢筋网，形成混凝土结构的体的。中心处有一个圆形钢筋布置，表明一根柱子或类似结构。前景中放置着一把橙色圆锯，在一块木板上，暗示可能正在进行切割作业。该场地看起来组织有序，且处于大规模基础施工阶段。

err.en: forming the reinforcement for a concrete
err.zh: 形成混凝土结构的体的

text: The image shows a single worker wearing an orange jacket and a yellow hard hat, welding on a large area covered with parallel rows of rebar at a construction site. The worker is positioned towards the center of the rebar area. In the foreground, there is a concrete structure with protruding reinforcement bars. Various construction materials and equipment, such as a generator, a blue container, and a bucket, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿橙色夹克，头戴黄色安全帽，正在一处大型钢筋结构施工区域进行焊接作业。该工人位于钢筋区域的中部位置。前景处可见一块混凝土结构，其中伸出钢筋。现场周围散落着各类施工材料与设备，例如发电机、蓝色容器以及水桶桶。

text: The image shows an excavator in the center with its bucket digging into the earth. An operator is visible inside the excavator's cabin. In the background, multiple workers are spread out across the site, engaged in various activities on the ground. The terrain appears to be uneven with mounds of dirt, and the background features construction or buildings in the distance.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其铲斗正在挖掘地面。驾驶室内可见一名操作员。背景中，多名工人分散在场地各处，在地面上从事着各种活动。地形看起来是平坦的，带有泥土堆，并且背景中带有远处的施工或建筑物。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven terrain and scattered debris. A yellow bulldozer with the brand "SHANTUI" is in the center, actively moving soil with its blade down. There is one individual visible in the background, walking on the cleared ground.
zh: 画面显示一处地形平坦的施工现场，散落着碎石。一台黄色推土机位于画面中央，正用其刀片向下推土。背景中可见一人，行走在空旷地上。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers engaged in activities within a framework of vertical and horizontal steel bars, which is likely for reinforced concrete work. The worker on the left, wearing a red outfit and a yellow hard hat, is standing and appears to be inspecting or directing work. The worker on the right, in a high-visibility vest and red pants, is bending over and appears to be handling materials or tools on the ground.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，两名工人正在一个由竖直和水平钢条构成的、可能用于钢筋混凝土作业的的建筑框架内开展活动。左侧的工人身穿红色服装、头戴黄色安全帽，站立着，似乎正在检查或指挥作业。右侧的工人身着高可视性背心心和红色裤子，弯着腰，似乎正在地面处理材料或工具。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of rebars scattered on the ground. A blue truck is parked near the foreground, and there is one worker visible in the middle ground, walking among the rebars. The site is characterized by multiple concrete columns and beams, indicating an unfinished structure with multiple floors.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，地面上散落着大量钢筋。一辆蓝色卡车停在前景附近，中间地面上可见一名工人在钢筋间行走。该工地具有多根混凝土立柱和梁，表明这是一个已完工的多层结构。

err.zh: 一个已完工的多层结构

text: A worker in the middle is wearing a straw hat and a pair of shorts.
zh: 一名中年男子头戴草帽，身穿短裤。

text: The image shows an indoor construction site with a steel structure and large windows. There is a grid of rebar laid out on the floor, indicating preparation for a concrete pour. Two workers are present; one is near the center of the image, working with the rebar, and the other is on the right, operating a wheelbarrow. The floor appears wet, suggesting recent work with concrete or cleaning activities.
zh: 图像显示一处室内施工现场，设有钢结构和大面积窗户。地面铺设着钢筋网格，表明正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。现场有两名工人；其中一人位于画面中央，正在操作钢筋，另一人位于右侧，正在操作一台钢筋弯曲机。地面看起来是湿的，暗示近期进行过混凝土作业或清洁活动。

err.zh: 正在操作一台钢筋弯曲机

text: The image shows a construction site with two yellow construction vehicles, which appear to be compactors or rollers, working on the land. The terrain is uneven with mounds of red-brown earth scattered throughout the area. There are no visible workers on foot, and the background features a row of buildings in the distance with trees and a body of water.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有两台黄色施工车辆，看起来像是压路机或滚轮，正在土地上作业。地形平坦，周围散落着红褐色泥土。没有可见的工人，背景特征为远处的一排建筑物，带有树木和一片水域。

text: The image shows a construction site with two yellow excavators positioned near the center, behind a yellow and black striped safety barrier. The ground is covered with blue tarps, and there are various construction materials and equipment scattered around, including a wheelbarrow in the foreground. In the background, there are portable office units and a tall red crane.

zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大量垂直钢筋从混凝土基础中伸出。画面中央可见一名工人，身穿紫色夹克，头戴安全帽，站在钢筋结构内。前景处有一堆水平钢筋和一些散落在地面的上的木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with several pieces of heavy machinery in operation. In the foreground, there is a motor grader with a yellow body and a bulldozer to its right. Further back, a yellow excavator is visible, and behind it, another bulldozer is present.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，现场有多台重型机械在作业。前景中，有一名身穿黄色色工作服的铲土机操作员，其右侧有一台推土机。再往后，可见一台黄色色挖掘机，其后方还有一台推土机。

err.en: a motor grader with a yellow body
err.zh: 一名身穿黄色色工作服的铲土机操作员

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing orange coveralls and yellow hard hats. Two workers are carrying materials, while the others are engaged in various tasks around the site. There is a large pile of debris and construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，五名工人戴着橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽。两名工人正在搬运材料，其余工人正在工地周围从事各种任务。那里有一大堆建筑垃圾和施工材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。

err.en: orange coveralls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: The image shows a blue excavator positioned on a mound of earth in the center. There are piles of dug-up soil and debris around the excavator. In the background, there is a flat area with red soil, and beyond that, some vegetation and a wire fence are visible.
zh: 图像显示一台蓝色挖掘机位于画面中央的土堆上。挖掘机周围堆放着挖出的来的的一堆堆土和碎石。背景中有一片平坦的红土区域，再往远处可见一些植被和一道铁丝围栏。

err.zh: 挖出的来的的一堆堆土

text: The image shows a large construction site with multiple levels of an unfinished building structure in the background, covered with green safety netting and scaffolding. Two tower cranes are visible above the building.
zh: 图片显示一个大型建筑工地，背景中有一栋已完工的大楼，覆盖着绿色安全防护网和脚手架。建筑上方可见两台塔式起重机。
