text: The image shows three individuals at a construction site with uneven, excavated earth. The person on the left is wearing a red hard hat and casual clothing, holding a notepad and pen. In the center, an individual in an orange jumpsuit and no hard hat stands with hands on hips. To the right, a person is kneeling and examining the ground; this individual is wearing a yellow hard hat, a blue shirt, and gloves.
zh: 图片显示三名工人在一处施工现场，地面平整且经过开挖。左侧的人戴着红色安全帽和便服装，手持记事本和笔。中间一名个人穿着橙色连体服，未戴安全帽，双手叉腰站立。右侧一名个人正跪着检查地面；此人戴着黄色安全帽、蓝色衬衫和手套袖。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing hard hats; one in blue overalls walking towards the left, and the other in a red shirt carrying a flat piece of material on his shoulder. There are multiple stacks of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, scattered around the site. In the background, there is a concrete bridge structure and power lines.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两名头戴安全帽的工人；其中一人身穿蓝色工装，正朝左侧行走，另一人身穿红色上衣，肩上扛着一块平板状材料。工地周围散落着多堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。背景中可见一座混凝土桥梁以及电力线路。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow mobile crane in the center, its boom extended upwards. In the foreground, there is a black pickup truck and a worker wearing a blue jacket walking towards the left. To the right of the crane, there is a wheeled loader and various construction materials.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央有一台大型黄色色移动式起重机，其吊臂向上延伸。前景处有一辆黑色皮卡车，以及一名身穿蓝色夹克的工人正朝左侧行走。在起重机的右侧，有一台轮式装载机以及各种建筑材料。

err.zh: 大型黄色色移动式起重机

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing hard hats and safety vests. One worker is moving towards the left, another is standing near the center, and the third is bending over some construction materials on the right. There are multiple bundles of rebar, some of which are arranged on the ground and others are stacked under a shed. A green tarp covers a pile of materials in the foreground, and a wheelbarrow is visible nearby.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着安全帽和反光背心。一名工人正朝左边走，另一名站在靠近中心的位置，第三名正弯腰处理右侧的一些建筑材料。地面上有多根钢筋，其中一些排列在地上，另一些堆在棚子下面。前景中一块绿色防水布盖着一堆材料，附近可见一个轮轴。

text: The image shows a construction site with various construction materials and no visible workers. In the center, there is a large stockpile of blue and red rebars, with some covered by a blue tarp. To the left, there are wooden planks and yellow formworks, while on the right, there are additional rebars and a yellow lifting strap hanging from a crane hook above. The background features greenery, indicating the site is near a vegetated area.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，现场堆放着各种建筑材料，没有可见工人。画面中央有一大堆蓝红相的钢筋，部分被蓝色防水布覆盖。左侧有木托盘和黄色脚手架，而右侧则有额外的钢筋以及一条黄色吊装索悬挂在上方起重机吊钩上。背景有绿植，表明该工地靠近植被区域。

text: The image shows a yellow front-end loader in the process of moving a large amount of earth. The loader's bucket is engaged in the dirt pile, indicating active work. In the background, there are structures that appear to be part of the construction site, including a blue-roofed building. The ground is uneven with multiple dirt piles.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色前卸装载机正在搬运大量泥土。装载机铲斗插入土堆中，表明正在作业。背景中可见一些结构，包括一栋蓝色脚手架建筑。地面平整，有多个土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete pump truck with its boom extended towards a multi-story building covered in scaffolding. In the foreground, there is one worker wearing a blue hard hat near the center, and three individuals are standing to the right of the pump truck, with one appearing to operate the equipment.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一辆大型混凝土泵车正驶向一栋被脚手架覆盖的多层建筑。在前景中，有一名工人戴着蓝色安全帽位于中心附近，还有三个人站在泵车右侧，其中一人似乎正在操作设备。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with extensive groundwork in progress. There is a large area covered with rebar mesh towards the top, and several wooden formworks are laid out across the site. A group of workers is scattered throughout, engaged in various activities related to construction. Piles of construction materials, including wooden planks and rebar, are visible around the site. The terrain surrounding the construction area is uneven and appears to be in the early stages of development.
zh: 图像展示了一个建设工地的空中视角，地面工程进展显著。顶部有一大片区域被钢筋网覆盖，现场散布着多组木质模板。一群工人分散在各处，正从事与建设相关的的一系列活动。现场周围可见成堆的建筑物资，包括木板和钢筋。建设区域周围地形平坦，似乎处于发展初期阶段。

err.zh: 建设区域周围地形平坦

text: The image shows a nighttime scene at a construction site. A bright light source is emanating from a vehicle, possibly a truck, which is facing the camera. An extended boom from a crane or similar equipment is visible above the vehicle. The construction area is enclosed by a blue fence, and there are trees with bare branches overhead. In the background, the silhouette of a tower crane can be seen against the night sky.
zh: 夜间，一处建筑工地现场。一辆车辆（可能是卡车）正对着镜头方向，其上方有一盏明亮的光源自该车辆。车辆上方可见一台起重机或类似设备的。施工区域被蓝色围栏围住，上方有光秃秃的树枝。背景中，一台塔式起重机的器的轮廓映衬在夜空之下。

err.en: An extended boom from a crane or similar
err.zh: 车辆上方可见一台起重机或类似设备的。

err.en: the silhouette of a tower crane
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机的器的轮廓

text: The image shows an indoor construction site with six workers wearing hard hats. One worker is climbing a staircase structure, while two workers are standing at the base of the staircase, and three others are dispersed across the floor of the facility. Large cylindrical objects, possibly pipes or ducts, are visible in the background, along with various construction materials scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，有六名头戴安全帽的工人。一名工人正在攀爬楼梯结构，两名工人站在楼梯底部，另外三名工人分散在厂房房地顶。大型圆柱形物体，可能是管道或导管，在背景中可见，并伴随各种建筑材料散布在整个工地现场。

err.en: dispersed across the floor of the facili

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, actively engaged in digging or moving soil. There is a pile of rubble in the foreground, consisting mainly of broken bricks and concrete. In the background, there is a structure with a traditional architectural style, featuring a tiled roof and white walls with blue accents.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土。前景处有一堆碎石，主要由碎砖和混凝土构成。背景中有一处传统建筑风格风格的的结构，带有瓦片屋顶和带有蓝色点缀的白色墙面。

err.en: a structure with a traditional architect
err.zh: 一处传统建筑风格风格的的结构

text: The image shows a single yellow excavator in the center, actively engaged in digging or excavation work in a muddy area with visible water accumulation. The excavator is positioned on a slope and is surrounded by a mixture of soil and broken bricks. There is a partially demolished concrete structure at the base of the slope, and the background features a metal fence and a building with a partially visible facade.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色挖掘机，正活跃地进行挖掘或土方方作业，处于一片可见积水积聚的泥泞地之中。挖掘机位于斜坡道上，周围环绕着泥土与碎砖的混合物。斜坡道底部有一处部分拆除的混凝土结构，背景中可见金属围栏以及一栋立面部分外露的建筑。

text: The worker next to the excavator is in its blind spot and within its operation radius.
zh: 该工人正走向挖掘机，处于其盲区及作业半径范围内。

err.en: The worker next to the excavator

text: The image shows a mobile crane mounted on a truck chassis, positioned in the center and facing towards the right of the frame. The crane is predominantly yellow with a red telescopic boom, which is retracted. The truck has multiple axles and is parked on a dirt surface with visible tire tracks. In the background, there is a construction site with various materials and equipment, including what appears to be steel beams on the ground and another crane in the distance.
zh: 图像显示一辆安装在卡车底盘架上的移动起重机，位于画面中央，朝向画面右侧。起重机主体为黄色，配有一根被拉起的的天红色吊臂。卡车拥有多个车轴，停放在一片泥土地面上，可见轮胎压痕。背景中有一处建筑工地，包含各种材料和设备，其中包括地面上似乎有一根钢梁，远处还有另一台起重机。

text: A mobile crane is hoisting materials with its boom extended upwards, while a worker in a yellow hard hat is observing or operating near the crane. In the foreground, another worker wearing a yellow hard hat is facing away from the camera, possibly handling cables or equipment. Two trucks are present; one is a dump truck on the left and the other is a blue cargo truck on the right, both stationary.
zh: 一台移动式起重机正用其吊臂向上伸展，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人在起重机附近观察或操作。前景中，另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人背对镜头，可能正在处理电缆线或设备。画面中有两辆卡车；左侧是一辆泵车，右侧是一辆蓝色货车卡车，两车均处于静止状态。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavated area and a retaining wall in the background. There are nine workers visible; some are on scaffolding while others are on the ground. The workers are engaged in various activities, likely related to the construction or reinforcement of the wall. There are multiple wooden poles and scaffolding structures erected against the wall.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，背景中有一处开挖区域和一道挡土墙。可见有九名工人；部分人位于脚手架上，另一部分人位于地面上。这些工人正从事各种活动，很可能与墙体体的施工或加固有关。有多根木杆和脚手架结构搭建在墙体上。

text: The image shows a large mobile crane mounted on a multi-axle truck, parked on a paved area with an overpass in the background. The crane's boom is partially extended and stowed for transport.
zh: 图中显示一辆大型移动式起重机安装在多轴卡车上，停放在铺装路面上，背景中有一辆过路车辆。起重机的臂部分伸出出，用于运输。

text: The image shows a construction site viewed from above. Two workers are visible: one in an orange jumpsuit and yellow hard hat standing on a raised platform, and the other in a white hard hat standing on the ground level. There is a pile of rebars near the platform, and construction debris is scattered around the area. A wheelbarrow is also present in the foreground, and a blue trash bin is placed on the platform.
zh: 图中展示了一个从上方视角观看的建筑工地的场景。可以看到两名工人：一名身穿橙色连体服、头戴黄色安全帽，站在抬高的平台上；另一名身穿白色连体服、头戴白色安全帽，站在地面上。平台附近有一堆钢筋，建筑废料散落在周围区域。前景中还有一个轮轴，平台上放置着一个蓝色垃圾桶。

err.zh: 身穿白色连体服、头戴白色安全帽

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, its bucket raised and containing soil. To the right of the excavator, there is a pile driving machine. The ground is uneven and covered with loose soil, indicative of recent excavation or earthmoving activities.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，中央有一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起并装有泥土。在挖掘机的右侧，有一台压路机。地面平整且覆盖着松散的泥土，表明近期有挖掘或土方移动活动。

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor actively compacting the ground in the foreground. In the background, various construction activities and equipment are busy, including an excavator, a crane, and several other vehicles and machinery engaged in earthmoving and construction tasks.
zh: 前景中，一名身着黄色土作业服的工人正在积极夯实地面。背景中，各项施工活动及设备繁忙运作，包括一台挖掘机、一台起重机以及多辆其他车辆和机械，正从事土方搬运与施工任务。

err.zh: 身着黄色土作业服的工人

text: Four individuals are gathered on a dirt surface, each wearing a hard hat. Three of them are crouched around a small object on the ground, with one person holding a hammer. The fourth individual is sitting and appears to be observing the others or waiting for his turn.
zh: 四人聚集在一片泥地上，每人头戴一顶硬帽。其中三人围着一个小型地面物体，一人手持一把锤子。第四人坐着，似乎在观察其他人，或等待自己转圈。

text: The image shows a large, open construction area with a clear sky. In the background, there is a long elevated structure with blue barriers and street lamps along its length. The ground is uneven with tracks and several mounds of dirt, some covered with blue tarps.
zh: 画面呈现一片开阔的大型施工区域，天空晴朗。背景中可见一条长长的的高架结构，其长度上设有蓝色围挡板和路灯。地面平整，设有轨道以及多处土堆，部分覆盖着蓝色防水布。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, vertical rebar structure in the foreground where one worker wearing a yellow hard hat and red overalls is climbing. Below and to the right, there is an organized stockpile of various construction materials. The background features a body of water and greenery along the far edge.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一根粗大的垂直钢筋，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿红色上衣的工人正在其下方右侧攀爬。旁边堆放着各种建筑材料。背景中可见一片水域及沿远边缘生长的着的绿植类。

err.en: Below and to the right, there is an orga
err.zh: 旁边堆放着各种建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers on a scaffold structure against a building with concrete walls. The workers are wearing safety helmets and are engaged in construction activities. The scaffolding is made of yellow poles and wooden planks, providing access to the building's exterior.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，三名工人站在脚手架上，背景是一栋带有混凝土墙的建筑。工人佩戴安全帽，正在进行施工作业。脚手架由黄色杆杆和木板构成，提供进入建筑内部的的空间。

text: The image shows a construction or excavation site with two workers wearing yellow hard hats. One worker is standing near the center of the image looking down at the ground, and the other is seated on the right side, facing away from the camera. There is a white pipe running along the trench in the foreground, and the area is cordoned off with red and white caution tape.
zh: 图像显示一个施工或挖掘现场，有两名工人戴着黄色安全帽。一名工人站在画面中央附近，低头看着地面，另一名工人坐在右侧，背对镜头。前景的沟槽中有一根白色管道，该区域用红白相的警戒带封封。

err.en: cordoned off with red and white caution
err.zh: 用红白相的警戒带封封

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the center, equipped with a blade and tracks, actively moving soil. The ground is uneven with visible tire and track marks, indicating recent work. The surrounding area is characterized by exposed earth and scattered debris, suggesting ongoing site preparation or excavation activities.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中央有一台单轴推土机，配备刀片和履带，正在积极移动土壤。地面平整，可见轮胎和履带痕迹，表明近期作业。周边区域以裸露的泥土和散落的碎石为特征，暗示持续的场地准备或挖掘活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive scaffolding throughout. In the center, there is a blue truck visible among the scaffolding. The site is surrounded by concrete columns and beams, with some wooden planks and construction debris scattered on the ground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，四周遍布脚手架。在中心，有一辆蓝色卡车可见于脚手架之中。该场地被混凝土柱和梁所环绕，地面上散落着一些木托盘和建筑废料。

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers wearing red hard hats and engaged in various activities. Two workers are handling rebars near the center, while others are positioned around an area with muddy water and rocky debris. There is a blue pipe partially visible on the left, and a bundle of cables on the right. A retaining wall with visible support anchors is in the background, and a worker on the far right appears to be observing the site from an elevated position.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有七名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在从事各种活动。两名工人正在处理中心附近的的重钢梁，而其他人则位于一片有泥水和岩石碎屑的区域周围。左侧可见一根蓝色管道，右侧有一束电缆线。背景中可见一道挡土墙，上面有支撑锚，而最右侧的一名工人似乎正从高处位置观察该工地。

text: The image shows a construction site with a focus on steel reinforcement bars (rebars) storage. Multiple bundles of rebars are neatly arranged on the ground, with some covered by tarpaulins. In the center, a worker is bending over, possibly tying or inspecting the rebars. There is construction material scattered around, including wooden planks and more rebars. The site appears to be well-organized, with different sizes of rebars separated and stored in designated areas.
zh: 图中展示了一个施工现场，重点在于钢筋（钢筋）的存放。多根钢筋整齐地摆放在地面上，部分被篷布覆盖。在中心，一名工人正在弯曲，可能是在绑扎或检查钢筋。周围散落着施工材料，包括木托盘和更多钢筋。该场地看起来组织良好，不同规格的钢筋分开并储存在指定区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing red hard hats; two are inside a concrete structure, and one is outside, interacting with formwork. There is a large pile of bricks and a smaller pile of white rubble in the background. Scaffolding with yellow safety netting is visible on a building, and there are various construction materials scattered around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着红色安全帽；其中两人在混凝土结构内部，一人在外部，与模板工互动。背景中有一大堆砖和一小堆白色碎石。建筑上可见带有黄色安全网的，周围散落着各种建筑材料。

err.zh: 建筑上可见带有黄色安全网的

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and carrying a bag, walking towards the left. In the middle ground, there is a red truck loaded with materials covered by blue tarpaulin. Two excavators are operating in the background, moving earth.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一名工人，头戴宽边帽，肩扛着一只袋子，正朝左侧行走。中景处有一辆红色卡车，车上装载着材料，并用蓝色防水布覆盖。背景中有两名挖掘机正在进行土方作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with three excavators operating in an area with mounds of dirt. In the background, there are unfinished buildings with colorful roofing. A tower crane is visible in the far background, amidst trees.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三台挖掘机正在一片泥土堆旁作业。背景中可见已完工建筑物，带有彩色屋顶。远处背景中，树木之间可见一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large mobile crane mounted on a truck chassis in the foreground. The crane is predominantly yellow with some red on the boom, and the truck is yellow with a white cab. The crane's outriggers are extended, and the boom is raised and extended towards the left side of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，前景中有一辆卡车底盘架上安装着一台大型移动式起重机。起重机主体为黄色，吊臂上带有一些红色，卡车为黄色，驾驶室为白色。起重机的吊臂向外伸展，吊臂向图像左侧升起并延伸。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers engaged in activities related to reinforcing steel bars (rebars). All workers are wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests for protection. They are positioned on and around a dense grid of horizontal and vertical rebars, likely preparing or assembling the reinforcement for a concrete structure.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有六名工人正在从事与钢筋（钢筋条）相关的的工作。所有工人都戴着黄色安全帽和安全背心以作保护。他们位于并环绕着密集的水平及垂直钢筋网格，很可能正在准备或组装用于混凝土结构的体的中的钢筋。

err.en: the reinforcement for a concrete structu
err.zh: 用于混凝土结构的体的中的钢筋

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing hard hats. One worker is operating an excavator, which is positioned in the center, with its bucket raised and filled with dirt. Another worker is standing in front of the excavator, observing or guiding the operation. In the background, there are multiple construction elements, including a pile of pipes, a vertical structure that could be part of a crane or rig, and the silhouette of buildings and cranes in the far distance.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三名头戴安全帽的工人。其中一名工人正在操作一台挖掘机，该挖掘机位于画面中央，其铲斗扬起并装满泥土。另一名工人站在挖掘机前方，正在观察或指导操作。背景中可见多种建筑元素，包括一堆管道、一个垂直结构，可能是起重机或吊架的一部分，以及远处建筑物和起重机的车的队的。

err.en: the silhouette of buildings and cranes i
err.zh: 远处建筑物和起重机的车的队的

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in the center; one is yellow and the other is orange. There are two workers in the foreground, one is kneeling and the other is standing, both are wearing hard hats and are near a pink object on the ground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心有两名挖掘机；一台是黄色的，另一台是橙色。前景有两名工人，一人跪着，另一人站着，两人都戴着安全帽，并且靠近地面上的一个粉色物体。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators operating on uneven dirt terrain. There are three workers visible between the excavators and a red truck parked to the right. A blue barrier fence runs parallel to the truck, and in the background, there are buildings and power lines.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，两台挖掘机在平坦的泥土地地上作业。在挖掘机和右侧停放的一辆红色卡车之间，可以看到三名工人。一道蓝色护栏与卡车平行延伸，在背景中，有建筑物和电力线。

text: The image shows a construction site with three excavators in the foreground. The excavators are stationary and there are no visible operators. In the background, there are piles of earth and some vegetation. The sky is clear, and there are buildings in the far background.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，前景中有三名挖掘机。挖掘机处于静止状态，且没有可见操作人员。背景中有土堆和一些植被。天空晴朗，远处背景中有一些建筑物。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with various activities and equipment. In the center, there is a green mobile crane next to a stockpile of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, some of which are covered with tarps. To the right, workers in safety gear are active around a tall, partially constructed structure with scaffolding.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角，现场有各种活动和设备。画面中央，一台绿色移动式起重机正吊运一堆建筑材料，其中包括钢筋和木模板，其中一些上面覆盖着塑料布。右侧，身着安全防护装备的工人正围绕着一座高大的、部分已搭建的、带有脚手架的建筑忙碌作业。

err.en: next to a stockpile of construction mate

text: The image shows a large construction site with various activities in progress. In the foreground, two dump trucks are visible, one with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading soil. In the middle ground, there is a wheel loader and several construction workers. Multiple pile drivers are operating in the background, and there is an array of construction materials, including red pipes, scattered across the site. The environment is dusty, and the ground is uneven with visible tracks from construction vehicles.
zh: 画面显示一个大型建筑工地，各项作业正在推进。前景中可见两辆自卸卡车，其中一辆车斗已升起，表明其正在卸载泥土料。中景处有一台轮式装载机及多名建筑工人。背景中有多台钻机载车正在作业，且现场散布着各类建筑材料，包括红色管材。环境显得尘土大，地面平坦，可见施工车辆留下的车辙。

text: The image shows one worker wearing an orange shirt and a white hard hat sitting on the edge of an excavated area. To the right, there is a yellow excavator positioned at the top of the excavation. The ground is uneven with visible rocks and soil, and the excavation appears to be in a rural setting with greenery in the far background.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿橙色上衣、头戴白色安全帽，坐在开挖区域的边缘。右侧有一台黄色挖掘机停放在开挖处上方。地面平整，可见岩石与泥土，开挖处似位于乡村环境，背景中有绿色植被。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a section of a construction site. There are two black cars parked on the left side. On the right, there is construction material, including stacks of wooden planks and metal scaffolding. A blue portable toilet is visible near the material stockpile. Red and yellow barriers are set up around the site to demarcate the area, and there is a section of green fencing above the red barriers.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的俯瞰视角。左侧停放着两辆黑色轿车。右侧有建筑材料，包括成堆的木托盘和金属脚手架。在材料堆附近可以看到一台蓝色便携式厕所。红黄相的围栏被设置在工地周围以划分区域，并且在红色围栏上方有一段绿色围栏。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple pieces of heavy equipment in operation. In the foreground, there is an excavator on the left and concrete pipes on the ground. A concrete pump truck with an extended boom is in the center, pouring concrete into a structure. To the right, there is a cement mixer truck connected to the pump truck. In the background, there are two tower cranes above a large building covered with green scaffolding netting.
zh: 画面显示一个正在进行施工作的大型建筑工地。前景左侧有一台挖掘机，地面上有混凝土管道。中间是一辆混凝土泵车，正在向结构输送混凝土。右侧有一辆水泥搅拌车与泵车相连。背景中，两栋塔式起重机位于一栋被绿色安全网覆盖的大型建筑上方。

text: The image shows a construction site with extensive scaffolding covering the majority of the area. A large yellow tower crane is positioned to the left, running vertically through the image. The construction site appears to be in the process of building a multi-story structure, as indicated by the concrete slabs and the network of scaffolding. There are several construction materials scattered across the site, including wooden planks and various construction debris.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，大面积脚手架覆盖了大部分区域。一台大型黄色塔式起重机位于画面左侧，垂直贯穿整个图像。该工地似乎处于多层建筑施工过程中，如混凝土试块和脚手架网络所示。现场散落着多种建筑材料，包括木托盘和各种建筑废料。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. On the right, several workers wearing red hard hats are on scaffolding, working on the side of a building with exposed rebar. In the center, a worker in a pink shirt and yellow hard hat is walking across a temporary walkway. On the left, another worker in a yellow hard hat is near a blue barrel and a pile of materials, including more wooden planks and rebar. The site appears organized, with designated areas for materials and clear access paths.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在进行各种作业。右侧，几名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在脚手架上作业，位于一栋露出钢筋的建筑的一侧。中间，一名身穿粉色上衣、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正穿过一条临时通道。左侧，另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人靠近一根蓝色钢管和一堆材料，其中包括更多木方木和钢筋。该工地显得井然有序，设有材料堆放区和清晰的通行路径。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators operating in an area that appears to be undergoing significant earthmoving activities. The excavator in the foreground is stationary and has a number "2" on its side, while the excavator in the background is actively digging. There are large piles of excavated soil and standing water in the dug-out areas. In the distance, there is a body of water and a blurred background with structures that suggest an urban environment.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有两台挖掘机正在一个看似进行大量土方作业的区域作业。前景的挖掘机处于静止状态，其侧面标有数字“2”，而背景的中的挖掘机正在积极挖掘。有大型挖掘土堆和积水位于挖出的区域。远处有一台挖掘机和一个模糊化背景，暗示一个城市环境。

err.en: there is a body of water and a blurred b
err.zh: 有一台挖掘机和一个模糊化背景

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. Behind the bulldozer, there is a red truck partially visible. The ground is uneven with mounds of dirt, indicating excavation or earthmoving activities. Trees and power lines can be seen in the background, suggesting the site is near an established area.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中心有一台推土机正在积极作业。推土机后方，有一辆红色卡车部分可见。地面平整，周围有土堆，表明正在进行挖掘或土方方作业。背景中可以看到树木和电线，表明该工地位于一个已建成区域附近。

text: The image shows two excavators on a construction site with uneven dirt terrain. The excavator on the left is teal and branded "KOBELCO," while the one on the right is yellow and branded "KOMATSU." Both excavators are stationary and positioned facing each other, with their booms extended and buckets close to the ground.
zh: 图像显示，在平整的土方地形上，有两个挖掘机在建筑工地上。左边的的是青绿色，品牌为“KOBEL co.”，而右边的是黄色，品牌为“komatsu.”两个挖掘机都是静止的，并且位置相互面对，他们的铲斗和斗桶靠近地面。

text: The image shows a large construction site with multiple levels of activity. In the foreground, a worker wearing an orange safety vest is walking along a dirt ramp. A yellow tower crane is positioned centrally, with its boom extending towards the upper right of the frame. There are several unfinished concrete structures, with one prominently on the right side of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，有多层活动。在前景中，一名身穿橙色安全背心的的工人正沿着一条泥土坡行走。一台黄色塔式起重机位于画面中央，其吊臂向画面右上方延伸。画面右侧有几座已完工的结构，其中一座尤为醒目。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, three workers wearing safety vests and hard hats are handling rebar materials. There is a yellow and blue formwork structure in the center, and scattered materials, including rebars, wooden planks, and covered stockpiles. The perimeter is enclosed by a green fence, and there are several temporary shelters and storage areas with blue tarp coverings.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种作业。前景处，三名身穿安全背心、头戴安全帽的工人正在搬运钢筋材料。中央有一处黄蓝相的工棚，周围散落着各种材料，包括钢筋、木托盘以及成堆的覆盖物。周边由绿色围栏网围合，并设有若干临时工棚及用蓝色篷布覆盖的仓储区。

text: The image shows an excavator in the center, digging or demolishing, with dust and debris around its bucket. In the background, there are several pieces of construction equipment, including a crane with a red boom. The construction site has various materials and equipment scattered around, such as metal barrels, concrete structures, and piles of earth.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，正在进行挖掘或拆除作业，其铲斗周围尘土屑飞扬。背景中可见数台施工设备，包括一台吊臂，其吊臂上带有红色吊斗。施工现场周围散落着各种材料与设备，例如金属桶、混凝土构造以及成堆的泥土料。

err.en: a crane with a red boom
err.zh: 一台吊臂，其吊臂上带有红色吊斗

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow wheel loader in the center, actively moving red soil. The terrain is uneven with visible tracks and mounds of soil, and there are several puddles of water scattered across the site. In the background, there is lush greenery and a building with red roofing.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台黄色轮式装载机正在搬运红色土壤。地形平坦，可见车辙和土堆，现场散布着几处水洼。背景中有茂盛的植被和一栋红顶建筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, its arm extended towards a large, rusted metal bucket. There are three workers in the vicinity of the excavator, two standing close to each other to the left and one to the right, all wearing safety gear. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and mounds of earth, indicating recent excavation or construction activity.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心有一台挖掘机，其臂伸向一个大型锈蚀迹斑斑的金属桶。挖掘机附近有三名工人，两人站在左侧彼此靠近，另一人在右侧，均佩戴安全装备。地面平整，可见轨道及泥土堆，表明近期有挖掘或施工活动。

text: The image shows a large, open field with uneven terrain and scattered vegetation. Two excavators are visible in the distance, one towards the center and another towards the right side of the image, engaged in earthmoving activities. In the background, there are buildings, suggesting the proximity of a developed area.
zh: 图像显示一片开阔的田野，地势平坦，植被零散分布。远处可见两台挖掘机，一台朝向画面中央，另一台朝向画面右侧，正在进行土方作业。背景中可见建筑物，暗示该区域较为发达。

text: The image shows a blue water truck parked on a dirt ground, actively discharging water from its rear spout, creating a wet area on the ground. In the background, there is a green scaffolding structure.
zh: 一辆蓝色水车停放在泥地上，正从后部出水口向地面积极注水，在地面上形成一片湿区。背景中有一个绿色折叠结构。

text: The image shows a large construction site with extensive rebar frameworks in place, indicating preparation for concrete pouring. Approximately 20 workers wearing orange safety gear are dispersed across the site, engaged in various construction activities. Some workers are on the ground level, while others are positioned on the rebar framework. Multiple stockpiles of construction materials, such as rebars and pipes, are visible throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，现场布置了密集的的重钢架，表明正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。大约二十名身穿橙色安全装备的工人分散在工地各处，从事各种施工作业。部分工人在地面作业，而另一些工人则位于重钢架上。多堆建筑材料，如钢筋和管道，在工地各处可见。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large multi-story concrete building. In the foreground, there is a bulldozer on the left and blue protective tarps covering the ground. There are several construction workers visible; two are near the center of the image working on scaffolding, and one is on the right side, possibly engaged in a task near some construction materials.
zh: 图像显示一个大型多层混凝土建筑的的建设工地。前景左侧有一台压路机，地面覆盖着蓝色防护网。可以看到几名建筑工人；其中两人位于画面中心附近，正在脚手架上作业，另一人位于右侧，可能正在处理某些建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers in the foreground, one of whom is operating a concrete pump truck with an extended boom. In the background, there are multiple high-rise buildings under construction, covered with green scaffolding netting. Tower cranes are visible atop the buildings.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有两名工人，其中一人正在操作一辆混凝土泵车，车上装有伸缩式卸料斗。背景中有多栋在建的高层建筑，覆盖着绿色脚手架网架。建筑顶部可见塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large dump truck in the center, positioned on a dirt road with its bed raised, suggesting it is either unloading or has recently unloaded material. To the right of the dump truck, there are several large concrete pipes lined up on the ground. The background features a mound of earth, and the sky is overcast.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央停着一辆大型自卸卡车，位于一条土路面上，其车斗架被抬高，表明它要么处于未装载状态，要么最近刚卸载完材料。在自卸卡车的右侧，地面上排列着几根大型混凝土管道。背景中有一堆泥土，天空呈现阴沉云密布的状态。

err.en: either unloading or has recently unloade
err.zh: 要么处于未装载状态，要么最近刚卸载完材料

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers wearing yellow hard hats. Two workers are on an elevated platform made of bamboo scaffolding, while four are on the ground level. The workers on the ground are engaged in activities related to concrete work, with one pushing a wheelbarrow and others handling tools and materials. The site has a foundation with rebar laid out, and there's a structure with vertical bamboo supports and green netting in the background.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有六名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。其中两名工人站在由竹材搭建的高台上，另外四名工人在地面层。地面层的上的的人员正从事与混凝土作业相关的的工作，其中一人正在推运钢筋笼，另一人则操作工具及材料。该工地设有基础钢筋铺设，背景中可见垂直竹支撑及绿色防护网。

err.zh: 另一人则操作工具及材料

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of blue and red construction materials, possibly steel beams and pipes, organized in several piles, some of which are covered with blue tarpaulins. A mobile crane with a green boom is extended towards a concrete structure. There are various vehicles, including a white dump truck, a flatbed truck with materials, and two smaller orange vehicles, one of which is spraying water on the ground. There are at least six individuals visible, wearing safety gear, scattered across the site, with one person walking near the dump truck and others standing or moving around the materials and vehicles.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，现场堆放着大量蓝色和红色的建筑材料，可能是钢梁和管道，被组织成几堆，其中一些覆盖着蓝色防水布。一台绿色吊臂的移动起重机伸向一个混凝土结构。现场有各种车辆，包括一辆白色自卸卡车、一辆装载着材料的料的平板卡车，以及两辆较小的橙色车辆，其中一辆正在向地面喷水。现场至少有六名可见人员，穿着安全防护装备，散布在工地各处，其中一人正走向自卸卡车附近，其他人则站在或移动在材料料和车辆周围。

err.zh: 一辆装载着材料的料的平板卡车

text: The image shows a construction site with a muddy foreground and standing water. In the center, there is an excavator with its arm extended over a low brick wall. To the right of the excavator, a truck is parked with a cylindrical tank on its bed. Various construction materials and debris are scattered across the site. In the background, there are white and green barriers, and beyond them, several structures and cranes are visible, indicating ongoing construction activity.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景泥泞地积水。画面中央有一台挖掘机，其臂架在一堵低矮砖墙上方。挖掘机右侧停着一辆卡车，车斗上载有一个圆柱形储罐。各种建筑材料和碎屑散落在工地各处。背景中可见白色和绿色屏障，越过它们，几处结构和线缆清晰可见，表明施工活动正在进行中。

text: The image shows a construction site where six workers are engaged in various activities related to cladding installation on a building with a steel frame and partial brickwork. Two workers on the left are positioning a large cladding panel against the building's frame, while a third worker is observing them. Another worker is standing on the scaffolding at the first-floor level, and two additional workers are handling or preparing cladding panels on the ground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，六名工人正从事与混凝土安装相关的的工作，建筑带有钢架结构，并伴有部分砌砖作业。左侧两名工人正将一块大型混凝土板对准建筑框架，同时第三名工人在旁观察他们。另一名工人站在首层脚手架上，还有两名工人正在地面搬运或准备混凝土板。

text: The image shows a construction site with two yellow excavators at work in a muddy terrain. The excavator on the left is stationary, while the one on the right is actively digging and moving soil. In the background, there are power lines and some construction-related structures, possibly site offices or storage. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, and there are puddles of water indicating recent activity or rainfall.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，两台黄色挖掘机正在泥泞地作业。左侧的挖掘机处于静止状态，而右侧的一台正在积极挖掘并移动泥土。背景中可见电力线路及一些施工相关结构，可能是现场办公室或仓储。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹，并有水洼，表明近期有活动或降雨。

text: The image shows a construction site where two workers in red overalls and yellow hard hats are working on a black waterproofing membrane laid out on the ground. One worker is kneeling and appears to be smoothing or adhering the membrane to the surface, while the other is standing and assisting. There are wooden planks, a bundle of rebar, and a green netting material nearby on the ground.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，两名头戴红色安全帽、身穿黄色反光背心的的工人正在地面上铺设黑色防水卷材。一名工人跪在地上，似乎正在对卷材表面进行抹平或粘贴作业，另一名工人站立并予以协助。地面上还放有木方垫块、一叠钢筋以及附近有一张绿色防护网。

err.en: two workers in red overalls and yellow h
err.zh: 两名头戴红色安全帽、身穿黄色反光背心的的工人

text: The image shows a yellow excavator on a site with broken concrete slabs and debris. The excavator is positioned on top of the uneven surface created by the fragmented slabs. There are no visible workers or other equipment in the immediate vicinity of the excavator. The background includes a green fence and some greenery, with a structure visible in the far background.
zh: 图像显示一台黄色挖掘机位于一个工地上，地面有破碎的混凝土板和碎屑。挖掘机停在由破碎板形成的平整表面的之上。挖掘机附近没有可见工人或其他其他设备。背景包括绿色围栏和一些绿色植物，在远处背景中可见。

text: The image shows three individuals at a construction site. The person on the left is bending over to examine something on the ground, holding what appears to be a circular object. The individual in the center is also looking down at the ground, seemingly engaged in a discussion with the person on the left. Behind them, there is an excavator and a fenced-off area with vegetation. The ground is uneven with visible dirt and rocks.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地上有三个人。左侧的人正弯腰检查地面上的某物，手中拿着看似一个圆形物体。中间的人同样低头看向地面，似乎正在与左侧的人交谈。在他们身后，有一台挖掘机和一片带植被的围栏网区域。地面平整，可见泥土和岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow dump truck in the foreground, positioned on a road with a pile of rocks in its bed. Two workers are visible on the left side of the image, standing on the rubble and using a hose to spray water. In the background, there is construction machinery, including what appears to be a blue crane or lifting device.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景处有一辆黄色渣土车，停在一处岩石堆的河上。画面左侧可见两名工人，站在碎石上，正使用软管喷水。背景中有一些施工机械，包括看起来像一台蓝色起重机或升降设备。

err.en: positioned on a road with a pile of rock
err.zh: 停在一处岩石堆的河上

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and red safety vests. Two workers are standing near a pile of rebars on the left, while three workers are engaged in an activity involving a wheelbarrow and construction material on the right.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，五名工人戴着黄色安全帽和红色安全背心。两名工人站在左侧的一堆钢筋旁，而三名工人正在参与右侧涉及轮轴和建筑材料的的活动。

text: The image shows an indoor construction site with two workers. One worker, wearing an orange shirt and a hard hat, is standing on the left side, holding a long pole that is touching the ceiling. The other worker, in a light-colored long-sleeve shirt and a hard hat, is standing on the right side, looking towards the outside. In the foreground, there is a wheelbarrow, a drum, and construction materials scattered on the floor.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，有两名工人。一名工人身穿橙色上衣，头戴安全帽，站在左侧，手持一根长杆，正触碰着墙面。另一名工人身穿浅色长袖衬衫，头戴安全帽，站在右侧，目光望向外侧。前景处有一根钢筋、一个鼓以及散落在地板上的的一些建筑材料。

text: The image shows a dump truck at night with its bed raised, indicating that it is in the process of offloading material. The truck is illuminated by its own lights, which cast a bright glow on the ground beneath it. The surrounding area is dark, and the ground appears to be uneven and possibly muddy.
zh: 夜间，一辆自卸货卡车正处在上卸物料，其车斗被抬起。卡车由自身灯光照明，在其下方地面投射出明亮的光晕。周围区域昏暗，地面看似平整且可能泥泞滑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the center, equipped with a blade and a ripper, positioned on a dirt surface with visible tracks indicating recent movement. Two individuals are present; one is standing near the top right corner of the image, and the other is seated on the ground towards the right edge, both at a considerable distance from the bulldozer.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中央有一台单斗轮挖掘机，配备刀片和刮刀，停在一处泥土地表面上，可见的轨迹表明其近期有移动。现场有两个人；一人站在图像右上角附近，另一人坐在靠近右边缘的地面上，两人均距离单斗轮挖掘机相当远。

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests. They are standing within a network of steel reinforcement bars, which are part of an ongoing construction for a concrete structure. There are multiple wooden planks and steel bars scattered around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人戴着黄色安全帽和安全背心。他们站在钢筋网架内，这些钢筋是混凝土结构施工的一部分。现场周围散落着多个木托盘和钢筋。

text: In the image, two workers are engaged in construction activities involving concrete. The worker in the foreground, wearing a yellow hard hat, is using a shovel, while the other worker, in a blue hard hat, is handling a hose that is discharging concrete. They are working amidst a field of scattered rocks and construction debris. A large concrete pipe segment lies on the ground to the right, and in the background, there is a rocky hillside with what appears to be a tarp-covered structure.
zh: 画面中两名工人正在进行涉及混凝土的施工作业。前景处戴黄色安全帽的工人正使用铁锹，而另一位戴蓝色安全帽的工人则握持一根正在向混凝土输送浆液的的水带。他们在一处遍布碎石与建筑碎屑的场地中劳作。右侧地面上横放着一段大型混凝土管，背景中则可见一座岩壁山坡，其上似覆盖着防水布。

err.en: a hose that is discharging concrete
err.zh: 一根正在向混凝土输送浆液的的水带

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground wearing a red hard hat and a green jacket. In the background, there are two tower cranes, one of which is in operation. A mobile crane is positioned on the right side of the image. There is an unfinished building with scaffolding, and various construction materials are scattered around the site.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景中有一名工人，头戴红色安全帽，身穿绿色夹克。背景中有两台塔式起重机，其中一台正在作业。画面右侧有一台移动式起重机。还有一栋已完工的大楼，搭有脚手架，工地周围散落着各种建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow front loader in the process of moving soil. The front loader is positioned under a structure with multiple steel columns and beams, indicating an unfinished building or a structure with multiple levels. The ground appears to be muddy, and there are piles of soil around the area where the front loader is operating.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一台黄色前装载机正在进行移土作业。前装载机位于多根钢柱和梁下方，表明一栋已完工建筑或一个多层结构。地面看起来是泥泞的，且在前装载机作业区域周围有土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation area. There are two excavators at work, one on the right side of the image digging into the earth and another on the left side near a crane. A mobile crane with its boom extended is positioned on the left side of the site. There is one worker visible near the center of the image, standing next to some construction materials.
zh: 图像显示一个大型土方方开挖的施工现场。有两名挖掘机正在作业，一台位于画面右侧，正在向土体挖掘；另一台位于画面左侧，靠近一台起重机。一台移动起重机，其吊臂伸展，位于场地的左侧。画面中心附近可见一名工人，站立在一些建筑材料旁边。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests engaged in various activities. In the foreground, there are excavated areas covered with green tarps, and concrete formwork is visible. A tower crane stands prominently on the right side of the image. The ground is uneven with visible sand piles, and construction materials are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人戴着黄色安全帽和反光背心，从事各种活动。前景中，有被挖掘的区域覆盖着绿色防尘网，并且可以看到混凝土模板。一台塔式起重机显著地矗立在图像的右侧。地面是平整的，可见沙堆，并且建筑材料散布在整个工地中。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator in the middle of a cleared area with visible tracks in the soil, indicating recent movement. The excavator's arm is extended, and its bucket is raised above the ground. Vegetation is uprooted around the machine, suggesting land clearing activity. There are trees and greenery in the background, which remain untouched by the excavation work.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色挖掘机，位于一片开阔区域，泥土中可见其履带，表明近期有移动迹象。挖掘机的臂部伸展，其铲斗位于地面之上。植被环绕机器生长，暗示土地清理活动。背景中有树木和绿植，未受挖掘作业影响。

err.en: Vegetation is uprooted around the machin

text: The image shows a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth on a construction site with a large expanse of disturbed soil in the foreground. The background features a relatively flat landscape with some vegetation and structures in the far distance.
zh: 画面中央是一台正在作业的的路面的铣土机，前景是大片被翻动的土堆。背景是相对平坦的地形，远处有一些植被和结构。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers in the middle ground, all wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests. One worker is operating a surveying instrument on a tripod, another is pushing a wheelbarrow, and the third is walking towards the right. In the background, there are two excavators and large mounds covered with blue and striped tarps.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，地面上有三名工人，均佩戴安全帽并穿着高能见度反光背心。其中一名工人正在三脚架上操作测量仪器，另一名工人正在推一辆轮式压路机，第三名工人正朝右侧行走。背景中可见两台挖掘机以及大型土堆，覆盖着蓝色与条纹状的防护网。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers engaged in activities around a formwork structure made of wooden planks and metal scaffolding. The formwork is reinforced with vertical and horizontal rebar. One worker is bending over the formwork, another is handling materials on the formwork, and the third is standing inside the structure.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，三名工人正在围绕由木方木和金属脚手架搭建的模板结构进行作业。该模板结构用竖向和水平钢筋进行加固。一名工人正跨越模板结构，另一名在模板结构上处理材料，第三名则站在结构内部。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom to pour concrete, likely into a formwork or area not visible in the image. In the background, there are multiple tower cranes adjacent to buildings covered with green scaffolding netting. In the foreground, there are several concrete pipes lined up on the ground.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一辆混凝土泵车正将料斗车的料斗车向某处倾倒混凝土，该处可能位于画面之外的。背景中，有多座塔式起重机紧邻被绿色脚手架网覆盖的建筑。前景中，地面上排列着几根混凝土管道。

err.en: extending its boom to pour concrete
err.zh: 正将料斗车的料斗车向某处倾倒混凝土

err.en: likely into a formwork or area not visib
err.zh: 该处可能位于画面之外的

text: The image shows a tower crane against a clear sky. The crane's horizontal jib extends across the frame, with a trolley and a hook hanging from it. The operator's cab and the counterweights are visible at the far end of the jib. The vertical mast of the crane, which provides support, is also visible.
zh: 图中展示了一台塔式起重机，背景为晴朗的天空。起重机的臂横跨画面，其上悬挂着小车和吊钩。操作室和配重块在臂的远端清晰可见。起重机的臂的垂直桅杆，提供支撑，同样清晰可见。

err.en: The vertical mast of the crane
err.zh: 起重机的臂的垂直桅杆

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and tread marks indicating recent work.
zh: 图中展示了一个施工现场，中央有一台黄色色推土机，正在积极地进行土方作业。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹和胎面标记，表明近期有作业活动。

text: The image shows three workers wearing red hard hats and casual clothing. One worker is operating a yellow bulldozer, which is moving a pile of aggregate material. Another worker is walking in the foreground, while the third is standing near a temporary structure with white walls and a series of flags on poles.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴红色安全帽、身着便服的工人。其中一名工人正在操作一台黄色压路机，该设备正在移动一堆骨料料。另一名工人在前景处行走，而第三名则站在临时构造物附近，该构造物带有白色墙体以及一系列插在杆上的旗子。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red shirt, white hard hat, and face mask, standing in the foreground and using a smartphone. A mobile crane is positioned in the middle, with its boom extended upwards and hook visible. There are multiple construction vehicles, including a red crane and yellow dump trucks, parked in the background.
zh: 画面中，一名工人身穿红色上衣，头戴白色安全帽，佩戴面罩，站在前景，正使用一部智能手机。一台移动式起重机位于画面中部，其吊臂向上延伸，吊钩清晰可见。背景中停放着多台施工车辆，包括一台红色起重机和一辆黄色泵车。

text: Three workers wearing hard hats are standing on a concrete foundation, examining or discussing work in front of a vertical rebar structure. The rebar structure has yellow safety caps on the protruding ends.
zh: 三名头戴安全帽的工人站在混凝土基础上，检查或讨论位于一根竖直钢筋前方的工作。该钢筋结构上带有黄色安全帽的突出端部。

text: The image shows a construction site with two yellow Hyundai excavators. One excavator is on the left with a worker standing beside it, while the other is actively digging on the right. The ground is uneven with visible piles of dug-up earth.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两台黄色的现代挖掘机。其中一台位于左侧，旁边站着一名工人，另一台正在右侧积极挖掘。地面平整，可见堆起的挖出的泥土。

text: The image shows a construction site with a mobile crane positioned on a platform covered with brown material, possibly mud or dirt. A green safety netting surrounds the construction area. A blue banner with white and red text stands prominently in the foreground.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，一台移动起重机停放在一个平台上，该平台覆盖着棕色材料，可能是泥土或泥土。一个绿色安全网围绕着施工区域。一个带有白色和红色文字的的绿色横幅在前景中显著地竖立着。

text: The workers on the formwork are not wearing hard hats.
zh: 该工人在形式作业中未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a freshly laid concrete path. One worker in an orange safety suit is using a tool to smooth the surface of the concrete. The path is adjacent to a dirt road, and there is a building on the left side of the photo. A green mesh barrier and construction debris are visible on the right side, along with a wheelbarrow near the worker.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，有一条新铺设的混凝土道路。一名身穿橙色安全服的工人正在使用工具对混凝土表面进行抹平处理。该道路紧邻一条土路，照片左侧有一栋建筑物。右侧可见绿色网状围栏和建筑废料，工人附近还有一辆轮式挖掘机。

text: The image shows a large construction site with multiple tower cranes erected throughout the area. There are several construction vehicles, including excavators and dump trucks, scattered across the site. Various materials, such as wooden planks and metal structures, are also visible on the ground. The background features a partially constructed building and some residential structures in the distance.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，整个区域内竖立着多台塔式起重机。现场散布着多台施工车辆，包括挖掘机和自卸卡车。地面上还可见各种材料，如木托盘和金属结构件。背景中有一栋部分建成的建筑以及远处的一些住宅结构。

text: The image shows four individuals on a paved area with greenery and a curb to the left. Three of the individuals are wearing red hard hats, while the fourth, on the left, is not wearing a hard hat. Two of the hard-hat-wearing individuals appear to be engaged in a discussion, with one holding a pen and a small notepad. In the background, there are high-rise buildings under construction, a concrete mixer truck on the road, and a fenced-off construction area to the right.
zh: 画面显示，在左侧有一片绿植草和路缘的铺装区域，有四个人。其中三人戴着红色安全帽，而左侧第四人没有戴安全帽。两个戴安全帽的人似乎正在参与讨论，其中一人拿着一支笔和一个小型记事本。在背景中，有正在施工的高楼，一辆混凝土搅拌车在路上，以及右侧有一个围栏起来的的不施工区域。

err.en: a fenced-off construction area to the ri
err.zh: 右侧有一个围栏起来的的不施工区域

text: The image shows a construction site with a beige dump truck in the center, its bed raised, indicating it is either unloading or has unloaded its contents. To the left of the dump truck, there is a smaller gray utility vehicle with various items and equipment stored in the back. On the right side of the image, a white sedan is parked on the road.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，中央停着一辆米色自卸卡车，其车厢已升起，表明它要么尚未装载，要么已卸完货物。在自卸卡车左侧，有一辆较小的灰色工具车，后部存放着各种物品和设备。在画面右侧，一辆黑色轿车停靠在路边。

err.en: either unloading or has unloaded its con
err.zh: 要么尚未装载，要么已卸完货物

text: The image shows a construction site with a large multi-story building in the background. In the foreground, there is an excavated area with exposed soil and a section of paved surface at the bottom. There are two pieces of construction equipment: an excavator and a backhoe, both located towards the center of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，背景中有一栋大型多层建筑。前景处有一片开挖区域，露出土壤，底部有一块铺装路面。有两件施工设备：一台挖掘机和一把铁锹，均位于画面中央。

text: In the image, there is one worker wearing a white hard hat and a white shirt, standing in the center and using surveying equipment. To the left, there is an excavator with a blue and yellow body. Several large concrete pipes are laid out on the ground, with some standing upright and others lying horizontally.
zh: 图中有一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿白色上衣的工人，站在画面中央，正在使用测量设备。左侧有一名身穿蓝黄相间工作服的挖掘机操作员。地面上铺设着多根大型混凝土管道，其中一些竖直放置，另一些则水平放置。

err.en: an excavator with a blue and yellow body
err.zh: 一名身穿蓝黄相间工作服的挖掘机操作员

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of rebar laid out on the ground, forming the reinforcement for a concrete structure. There are at least five workers visible, wearing orange safety vests and hard hats, engaged in various activities on the site. Some workers are standing on the rebar mat, while others are near the formwork, which is supported by vertical and diagonal wooden braces.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面上铺设着大面积的钢筋，构成混凝土结构的体的。现场至少有五名工人，身穿橙色安全背心，头戴安全帽，正在从事各种作业。部分工人站在钢筋垫上，而另一些工人则靠近模板，该模板由竖直及斜向木支撑架支撑。

err.en: forming the reinforcement for a concrete
err.zh: 构成混凝土结构的体的

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers standing on the edge of a concrete structure. An orange excavator is operating adjacent to them, with its bucket in the air, containing soil or debris. The workers are wearing blue hard hats, and the terrain around the site appears to be uneven with visible soil and rock.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，七名工人站在混凝土结构边缘。一台橙色挖掘机正在他们旁边作业，其铲斗内装有泥土或碎石。工人头戴蓝色安全帽，工地周围地形看起来平坦，可见泥土和岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in operation. The excavator in the foreground is being operated by a worker visible in the cabin, actively digging into the muddy ground. The second excavator is positioned in the background to the right, with its arm extended and another worker visible in the cabin. The ground is uneven and muddy with visible tire tracks, and there are puddles of water scattered around.
zh: 图中显示一个施工场地，有两台挖掘机正在作业。前景处的的一台挖掘机由一名在驾驶室内可见的工作人员操作，正在向泥泞地积极挖掘。第二台挖掘机位于背景右侧，其臂架伸出，另一名在驾驶室内可见工作人员。地面平坦且泥泞滑，可见轮胎轨迹，周围散落着水洼。

err.en: The ground is uneven and muddy

err.zh: 前景处的的一台挖掘机

text: The image shows a construction excavator positioned on an elevated mound of earth, with its boom and bucket extended towards the ground. In the background, there is a vehicle on a dirt road. In the foreground, there is a large pipe running horizontally across the image, and to the right, there are red corrugated pipes stacked. The excavator appears to be engaged in earthmoving activities.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机位于隆起的土堆上，其动臂和铲斗朝向地面伸出。背景中，有一辆车辆行驶在土路上。前景中，有一根大型管道横贯整个画面，右侧，堆放着红色波纹状管道。挖掘机似乎正在进行土方方作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single articulated dump truck in the foreground, operated by two individuals wearing hard hats. The ground appears to be dry and uneven with tire tracks and small debris scattered around.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一辆铰接式自卸卡车，由两名头戴安全帽的人员操作。地面看起来干燥且平整，周围散落着轮胎印迹和少量碎屑。

text: The image shows a yellow Hyundai excavator operating on a construction site with overgrown vegetation. The excavator's arm is extended towards the ground, suggesting it is engaged in digging or clearing activities. In the background, there is a body of water and a building with a blue structure on top.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色现代挖掘机正在一处植被茂密的、地面裸露的施工现场上作业。挖掘臂伸向地面，表明其正在进行挖掘或清理作业。背景中可见一片水域以及一栋顶部带有蓝色结构的物的。

err.zh: 植被茂密的、地面裸露的

err.en: a building with a blue structure on top
err.zh: 一栋顶部带有蓝色结构的物的

text: The image shows a construction site with a steel structure framework in place. Several pieces of heavy machinery, including a crane and a telescopic handler, are positioned around the site. Various construction materials, such as steel beams and plates, are scattered throughout the area. The ground appears muddy with visible tire tracks, indicating recent movement of vehicles or machinery.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，钢架结构已就位。几台重型机械，包括一台起重机和一台摊铺路机，分布在场地周围。各种建筑材料，如钢梁和钢板，散落在整个区域。地面显得泥泞湿，可见轮胎痕迹，表明车辆或机械近期有移动。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators. One excavator is positioned on the left, loading or unloading soil into or from a red dump truck. The second excavator is on the right, with its arm extended and its bucket touching the ground, possibly engaged in digging or moving soil. The ground is uneven and covered with mounds of soil, indicating ongoing earthmoving activities.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有两台挖掘机。左侧的挖掘机正在将泥土装载或卸载到一辆红色自卸卡车中。右侧的挖掘机伸出其臂，其铲斗接触地面，可能正在进行挖掘或移动泥土。地面平整，覆盖着成堆的泥土，表明正在进行土方作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete structure in the center. A crane hook is visible at the top of the image, suggesting lifting operations are in progress. Two workers, one wearing a red hard hat and the other in a blue hard hat, are standing near the concrete structure, possibly coordinating or waiting for a lift.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中心有一大型混凝土结构。图像顶部可见一个起重机吊钩，表明吊装作业正在进行进行。两名工人，一人戴着红色安全帽，另一人戴着蓝色安全帽，正站在混凝土结构附近，可能在协调或等待吊装运。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing safety gear, including hard hats and high-visibility vests. The ground appears to be uneven with mounds of earth, and there is a mesh-like material covering the soil.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人佩戴安全装备，包括安全帽和高能见度背心。地面看起来是平整的，有泥土堆，并且有一个类似网格的材料覆盖土壤。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing hard hats and engaged in various activities. In the foreground, two workers are near a trench filled with water, with one of them standing inside the trench. In the middle ground, a worker is operating a concrete pump hose, while another is guiding the hose. The fifth worker is walking across the concrete surface.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，五名头戴安全帽的工人正在从事各种作业。前景处，两名工人靠近一条注满水的的水的水沟，其中一人站在沟内。中景处，一名工人正在操作混凝土泵管，另一名工人正在引导软管。第五名工人正行走在混凝土表面上。

err.zh: 一条注满水的的水的水沟

text: The image shows a construction site with two prominent tower cranes. One crane is lifting a bucket of construction material, while the other is stationary. There is a large building under construction in the background, with extensive scaffolding covering its exterior. A sign with "6H" is visible on the scaffolding, indicating a possible location or level marker on the site.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有两台显眼的可见的塔式起重机。其中一台起重机正吊运一斗车施工材料，另一台则处于静止状态。背景中有一栋正在施工的大型建筑，其内部被大量脚手架所覆盖。脚手架上可见一块标有“6H”字样，表明该工地上可能存在的位置或标高。

err.zh: 其内部被大量脚手架所覆盖

err.en: indicating a possible location or level
err.zh: 表明该工地上可能存在的位置或标高

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow soil compactor in the foreground, actively compacting the red soil. In the background, there is a large building structure with scaffolding, and several tower cranes are visible in the distance.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中一名身着黄色土作业服的工人正在积极压实红色土壤。背景中有一栋大型建筑，搭设有脚手架，远处可见数台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, beige dump truck in the center, positioned on a dirt road with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading or has unloaded material. The terrain is predominantly dirt with various mounds and dug-out areas, indicative of earthmoving activities.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央停放着一辆大型米色自卸卡车，位于一条土路之上，其车厢板已升起，表明其处于未装载或已卸载物料状态。地形以泥土为主，伴有多处凹陷及挖掘区域，指示存在土方方作业活动。

text: The image shows a mountainous construction site with three pieces of heavy machinery: a motor grader in the foreground, a bulldozer in the middle, and a dump truck in the background. Two workers are visible; one is walking near the motor grader, and the other is standing by the bulldozer. The terrain appears to be rough with loose soil and rocks, and the site is flanked by forested slopes.
zh: 图像显示一个山地施工现场，现场有三台重型型机械：前景处有一台电动机驱动器，中部有一台推土机，背景处有一台泵送卡车。可见两名工人；其中一人正步行在电机驱动器附近，另一人则站立于推土机旁。地形看似崎岖不平，伴有松散的土壤与岩石，且该场地被森林状的斜坡面所夹持。

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain. In the center, there is a large drilling rig mounted on tracks, actively engaged in drilling operations. To the right of the drilling rig, there is a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a dark-colored jacket, standing and looking towards the rig. Behind the drilling rig, there are two yellow mobile cranes parked side by side. In the foreground, there are scattered wooden planks.
zh: 图像显示一个泥泞土地质的施工现场。画面中央有一台大型钻机架安装在轨道上，正在进行钻井作业。钻机架右侧有一名工人戴着黄色安全帽和深色夹克，站立并望向钻机架。机架后方有两台黄色移动起重机并排停放。前景散落着木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with several vertical columns and rebar frameworks in place, suggesting the construction of a large structure. There are four workers visible, wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests; three of them are gathered near the center, while one is standing to the right. Bundles of rebars are scattered in the foreground, and there is a large concrete retaining wall on the left with Chinese characters on banners.
zh: 图中显示一处建筑工地，设有若干垂直立柱及钢筋框架，表明正在建造大型结构。可见四名工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身着高能见度反光背心；其中三人站在右侧，另外三人聚集在中心附近。钢筋束散落在前景，左侧有一堵大型混凝土挡土墙，上面带有中文标语。

err.en: three of them are gathered near the cent
err.zh: 其中三人站在右侧，另外三人聚集在中心附近

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven terrain and multiple dirt mounds, some of which are covered with blue-green tarps. In the center, there is an excavator, and scattered throughout the site are several workers wearing high-visibility vests.
zh: 图像显示一个地形平坦的施工现场，有多处土堆，其中一些覆盖着蓝绿色防尘网。场地中央有一台挖掘机，整个场地散布着多名身穿高能见度背心的的工人。

text: The worker in the middle is not wearing a hard hat and is wearing a pair of shorts.
zh: 中间的工人没有戴硬帽，而是戴着一副耳套。

text: The image shows a construction site with two pieces of heavy machinery operating on a field of reddish-brown soil. On the left, there is a yellow soil compactor, and towards the center, there is a black bulldozer. Both machines are actively engaged in earthmoving tasks. There are several mounds of soil around the machines, indicating ongoing ground preparation or leveling work.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，两台重型机械正在一片红褐色土场上作业。左侧是一台黄色土机械，靠近中央处是一台黑色推土机。两台机械均处于土方搬运作业状态。机械周围有多堆土，表明正在进行场地平整场或整平作业。

err.zh: 场地平整场或整平作业

text: The image shows a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth in a large, open area with disturbed soil. The ground is uneven with various piles of soil and debris scattered throughout the site.
zh: 画面中央是一台正在作业的的路拌机，正在一片开阔且地面不平整、遍布扰动土的区域进行挖作业。地面较为平整，但各处散落着大小不一的土堆和碎石。

text: The worker is near a bucket and appears to be applying or smoothing a substance along the edge of a concrete slab. In the background, there are stacks of construction materials, including what looks like tiles or curbing stones arranged in a curved pattern, and some rebar structures. Scattered around the site are wooden planks and small debris.
zh: 工人靠近一个料斗，似乎正在沿混凝土板边缘涂抹布或抹平某种物质。背景中堆放着建筑材料，包括看似瓷砖块或卵石排列成弧形图案，以及一些钢筋结构。工地周围散落着木托盘和碎屑。

text: The image shows a bulldozer in the center, with its blade engaged in the soil, suggesting earthmoving activity. The operator is visible inside the cabin. In the background, multiple tower cranes are visible, indicating an active construction area.
zh: 画面中央是一台推土机，其刀片头正切入泥土中，表明正在进行土方方作业。操作员在驾驶室内清晰可见。背景中可见多台塔式起重机，显示该区域正在进行施工。

text: The image shows a construction site with one individual visible, standing near the center and facing away from the camera. There is a red dump truck in the middle of the frame with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading or has unloaded material. To the left of the dump truck, there is a bulldozer and a wheel loader, both with yellow bodies, positioned close to each other. In the background, a high-rise building under construction is visible with a tower crane erected beside it.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一名工人位于画面中央附近，背对镜头。画面中央有一辆红色自卸卡车，其货箱处于升起状态，表明其未装载或已卸载货物。自卸卡车左侧，有一台路面铣刨机和一台轮式装载机，两者均呈黄色车身，彼此靠近。背景中，可见一栋在建高层建筑，其旁竖立着一台塔式起重机。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker visible at the top left, appearing to be engaged in an activity on the ground. There is a concrete foundation with protruding rebar in the foreground. Piles of construction materials, including wooden planks and black rolled materials, are placed on the foundation.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，左上方可见一名工人，似乎正在地面上从事某项作业。前景中有一处混凝土基础，上面伸出钢筋。基础之上堆放着成堆的建筑材料，包括木托盘和黑色卷状材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavated area in the foreground. A yellow wheel loader is positioned on the left side of the trench, and there are multiple construction vehicles in the background, including a bulldozer and trucks. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, and the excavation appears extensive.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，前景处有一大片大面积的开挖区域。一台黄色轮式装载机位于沟槽的左侧，背景中有多台施工车辆，包括一台推土机和卡车。地面平整，可见轮胎痕迹，开挖显得范围广泛。

text: The image shows an indoor construction site where three workers are engaged in manual labor. Two workers, wearing blue and yellow hard hats, are kneeling and working within a trench, while the third worker, wearing a red hard hat, is standing and digging with a shovel. There is a wheelbarrow positioned near the trench, and construction debris is visible around the area.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，三名工人正在进行体力劳动。两名头戴蓝色和黄色安全帽的工人蹲在沟槽内作业，而第三名头戴红色安全帽的工人站立着，正用铁锹挖掘。沟槽附近有一个轮挡，该区域周围可见建筑废料。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers. In the foreground, one worker in a dark jacket and yellow hard hat is standing near various lengths of metal scaffolding poles and rusted components on the ground. In the midground, three workers in orange safety gear are handling wooden planks on a concrete structure. To the right, one worker in a brown jacket and yellow hard hat is leaning over the edge of an excavation site with water pooled at the bottom.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，共有六名工人。前景处，一名身穿深色夹克、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正站在各种长度的不一的金属脚手架杆及锈蚀构件旁。中景处，三名身着橙色安全装备的工人正在处理一块混凝土结构。右侧，一名身穿棕色夹克、头戴黄色安全帽的工人正倚靠在开挖场地的边缘，底部积有积水。

err.en: three workers in orange safety gear are
err.zh: 三名身着橙色安全装备的工人正在处理一块混凝土结构

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. In the background, there are multiple residential buildings and a line of trees. The ground appears to be muddy with several mounds of dirt, and there are red markers placed at various points across the site.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台单斗轮挖掘机正在进行土方作业。背景中可见多栋住宅建筑以及一排树木。地面看起来泥泞湿，散落着几堆泥土，并且场地上在不同位置放置着红色标记。

text: The image shows an excavator in the process of loading or digging soil into the back of a dump truck. The excavator is positioned to the right of the truck, with its bucket in the pile of soil. There is a large, exposed earth embankment in the background, and the ground in the foreground appears to be paved.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正在将泥土装载或挖掘至一辆自卸卡车的后部。挖掘机位于卡车的右侧，其铲斗位于土堆中。背景中有一个大型、裸露出的土工程，前景中的地面似乎已铺设。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground wearing a yellow hard hat and handling a shovel. There are multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including bags stacked on pallets, a mound of earth, and various piles of construction blocks and pipes. In the background, there are high-rise buildings and two tower cranes, one of which has its jib extended across the image.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景处有一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，手持铁锹。现场有多堆建筑材料，包括码放在托盘上的的一袋袋、一堆土堆，以及各种建筑砌块和管道。背景中可见高层建筑和高楼，其中一座塔楼横跨整个画面。

err.en: two tower cranes, one of which has its j
err.zh: 其中一座塔楼横跨整个画面

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a raincoat, walking among multiple rows of rebar grids that are laid out on the ground. Yellow pipes run parallel to the rebar grids.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一名工人头戴黄色安全帽、身穿雨衣，在多排铺设于地面的、与钢筋网格平行的延伸的黄色管道之间行走。

err.en: walking among multiple rows of rebar gri
err.zh: 在多排铺设于地面的、与钢筋网格平行的延伸的黄色管道之间行走

err.en: Yellow pipes run parallel to the rebar g
err.zh: 与钢筋网格平行的延伸的黄色管道

text: The image shows a construction site elevated above a green area, possibly a valley, supported by a steel girder bridge structure. There are two yellow mobile cranes on site, one of which is in operation. A yellow dump truck is visible, and there are multiple steel rebar cages assembled on the site, with some covered by green mesh. There are at least two workers visible, wearing safety gear, and they appear to be involved in construction activities.
zh: 图像显示一处位于绿色区域上方的建筑工地，该区域可能是一处山谷，由一座钢桁架桥结构支撑。现场有两台黄色移动起重机，其中一台正在作业。可见一辆黄色泵车，现场还有多个钢制钢筋笼，部分被绿色网罩覆盖。至少可见两名工人，佩戴安全防护装备，他们似乎正参与施工活动。

text: In the image, an excavator is positioned in the center, on what appears to be an excavation site with mounds of earth and trenches. To the right, there are stockpiles of construction materials, including pipes and rebars, sheltered under makeshift structures. Various construction-related items such as buckets, a generator, and metal containers are scattered around the foreground.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其右侧似乎是一处土方与沟渠的挖掘现场。右侧堆放着建筑材料，包括管道和钢筋，被临时结构所遮蔽。前景周围散落着各种施工相关物品，如桶、发电机以及金属容器。

err.en: on what appears to be an excavation site
err.zh: 其右侧似乎是一处土方与沟渠的挖掘现场

text: The worker in the middle next to the mobile crane is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 中间的工人正走向移动式起重机，未佩戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of workers spread across an area with exposed rebar and formwork, indicating concrete work in progress. The workers are wearing safety gear, including hard hats. There are stacks of construction materials, such as wooden planks and supports, distributed around the site. Yellow safety railings are visible around the perimeter of the work area, and green safety netting is installed along one edge.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，大量工人分散在一片区域内，裸露着钢筋和模板，表明混凝土作业正在进行进行。工人佩戴着安全装备，包括安全帽。有堆放的建筑材料，如木托盘和支撑，分布在场地周围。黄色安全栏杆可见于作业区域周边，绿色安全网安装在一侧边缘。

err.zh: 混凝土作业正在进行进行

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers visible. In the foreground, one worker wearing a yellow hard hat is kneeling and working on paving blocks near a pile of similar blocks. Another worker is standing near the center, and a third is in the background, both also wearing yellow hard hats. There are piles of construction materials, including wooden planks, metal pieces, and bricks scattered around. A wheelbarrow is positioned near the center worker, and there are black cables coiled to the right.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见三名工人。前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在地上，在一堆类似砌块的建材旁作业。另一名工人站在画面中央附近，第三名则位于背景中，两人同样头戴黄色安全帽。周围散落着成堆的施工材料，包括木托盘、金属碎片以及砖块。一名工人附近放置着一台轮式起重机，右侧盘绕着黑色线缆。

text: The image shows a multi-level steel structure under construction with two workers visible on different floors. In the foreground, there are piles of construction materials, including covered and uncovered steel sections and wooden planks.
zh: 画面显示一栋在建多层钢结构建筑，两名工人出现在不同楼层。前景处堆放着成堆的建筑材料，包括已覆盖和未覆盖的钢构件以及木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers. One worker is standing on a rebar framework, seemingly inspecting or working on it. Another worker is walking on the ground level past some construction debris. There are multiple wooden and concrete structures around the workers, indicative of formwork for concrete casting. A concrete mixer truck is partially visible in the background.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人。一名工人站在钢筋框架上，似乎正在检查或对其进行作业。另一名工人在一些建筑废料上行走。工人周围有多个木质和混凝土结构，表明正在进行混凝土浇筑作业。背景中部分可见一辆混凝土搅拌车。

err.en: walking on the ground level past some co
err.zh: 在一些建筑废料上行走

text: The image shows a construction site with one individual standing on the back of a yellow wheel loader in the center. In the foreground, there is a black pipe lying on the ground. To the left, another yellow wheel loader is visible, and in the background, residential buildings can be seen. The ground appears to be muddy and there are piles of dirt around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，画面中央有一台黄色轮装载机，其后方站着一名工人。前景处有一根黑色管道横放在地面上。左侧可见另一台黄色轮装载机，背景中可以看到住宅建筑。地面看起来泥泞滑，工地周围有土堆。

err.en: standing on the back of a yellow wheel l

text: The image shows a yellow wheel loader in the foreground with its bucket raised and full of soil, indicating that it is engaged in earthmoving activities. Behind the wheel loader, there is an excavator with a yellow arm, partially visible, which appears to be digging or moving soil. The background includes a construction site with temporary structures and vegetation in the distance. The ground is uneven and covered with reddish-brown soil, typical of an active construction site.
zh: 前景中有一台黄色轮式装载机，其铲斗已抬起且装满泥土，表明其正在进行土方作业。轮式装载机后方有一台黄色臂式挖掘机，部分可见，似乎正在挖掘或搬运泥土。背景中包括一处带有临时结构和植被的施工现场。地面平整，覆盖着红褐色土壤，是典型的活动施工现场的特征。

text: The image shows a construction site with an orange excavator in the center, actively digging into the earth. Behind the excavator, there is a red barrier fencing off an area with visible construction activity beyond it. There are two individuals visible in the background, one near the center and another towards the right, both wearing bright-colored clothing, likely for safety purposes. The terrain is uneven with mounds of dug-up soil, and the overall scene suggests excavation work in progress.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台橙色挖掘机正在向地面挖掘。挖掘机后方设有红色围挡，围挡外可见施工活动。背景中有两人，一人靠近中央，另一人偏向右侧，两人都穿着亮色衣物，可能出于安全目的。地形平坦，伴有堆起的挖出的泥土，整体场景暗示挖掘作业正在进行推进。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer equipped with a front blade in the center. The ground around the bulldozer is uneven and muddy with visible tire tracks, suggesting recent activity.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，中央有一台配备前铲刀的的单斗式装载机。装载机周围地面平整且泥泞湿，可见轮胎印迹，表明近期有作业活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, multi-story steel structure in the background. In the foreground, there is a red dump truck on the right, with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading or has unloaded material. The ground is covered with red soil, and tire tracks are visible, indicating recent movement of vehicles.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，背景中矗立着一座大型多层钢结构建筑。前景右侧有一辆红色自卸卡车，其货箱处于升起状态，表明其未装载或已卸载货物。地面覆盖着红色泥土，且轮胎轨迹清晰可见，表明车辆近期有移动。

err.en: it is unloading or has unloaded material
err.zh: 表明其未装载或已卸载货物

text: The image shows a single worker in a light-colored hard hat and safety gear standing inside a large tunnel structure with exposed rebar on the walls. The worker appears to be measuring or inspecting the ground with a tool. The tunnel has a curved ceiling and is well-lit, with the end of the tunnel fading into darkness.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴浅色安全帽、身着防护装备的工人，正站在一个大型隧道内，对裸露在墙面上的的一根钢筋进行测量或检查。该隧道顶部呈弧形面，照明条件良好，隧道尽头逐渐隐入黑暗之中。

err.zh: 裸露在墙面上的的一根钢筋

err.en: measuring or inspecting the ground with
err.zh: 对裸露在墙面上的的一根钢筋进行测量或检查

text: The image shows a large, open construction site with extensive earthwork. There are two workers visible: one near the center and another towards the left side of the image, both appearing to be engaged in ground preparation activities. A red truck is parked on the left, and there is a building in the distant background. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, suggesting recent movement of heavy machinery.
zh: 图像显示一个大型、开放的施工现场，正在进行大规模的土方工作业。画面中可见两名工人：一名位于画面中央附近，另一名位于画面左侧，两人似乎都在从事场地平整备工作。一辆红色卡车停放在左侧，远处背景中有一栋建筑物。地面平整，可见轮胎印迹，暗示重型机械近期有移动。

text: The image shows an overturned orange excavator on a slope at a construction site. The excavator's arm is extended, and it is resting on its side. The surrounding area is a mix of dirt and vegetation, with a fence running along the perimeter and a road visible in the upper right corner.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机停在一处施工场地的斜坡面上。挖掘机的臂部伸出长，并侧向停放。周围区域是泥土和植被的混合，沿周边设有围栏，右上角可见一条道路。

text: The image shows a concrete pouring operation at a construction site. A worker is standing on a concrete wall, guiding the concrete chute from a mixer truck to pour concrete into a foundation or pit. The concrete is visibly accumulating at the bottom of the structure, with a support pole extending vertically from the center of the poured area.
zh: 图像显示一处建筑工地的混凝土浇筑作业。一名工人站在混凝土墙面上，引导混凝土搅拌车中的混凝土料，将混凝土浇筑入基础或坑中。混凝土明显在浇筑区域底部积聚，并自中心垂直延伸。

err.en: with a support pole extending vertically

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the foreground, its bucket raised and containing soil. Behind the excavator, there is a pile-driving machine with its hammer positioned high. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and dug-up soil. The background features an expanse of cleared land with no distinct structures.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景有一台挖掘机，其铲斗扬起并装有泥土。挖掘机后方有一台打桩机，其锤头位置偏高。地面平整，可见车辙和挖起的土。背景呈现一片开阔的空地，无显著结构。

text: The image shows an interior construction site with three workers. Two workers are on a scaffold, engaged in construction activities near a brick wall, while the third worker is on the ground, observing or supervising. Structural steel columns and beams are visible throughout the space. Construction materials, including pipes and wooden planks, are scattered across the floor.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，有三名工人。两名工人站在脚手架上，正在砖墙附近从事施工作业，而第三名名工人站在地面上，正在观察或监督。结构钢柱和梁在整个空间内清晰可见。施工材料，包括管道和木托盘，散落在地板上。

text: The image shows a blue excavator in the center, positioned on a mound of earth and appears to be engaged in digging or moving soil. There are large piles of earth in the foreground and background, suggesting excavation work is taking place. The environment is dusty, and the ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, indicating recent activity by heavy machinery.
zh: 画面中央是一台蓝色挖掘机，停在一堆土堆上，似乎正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土。前景和背景中都有大堆的土堆，表明正在进行进行挖掘作业。环境显得尘土飞扬，地面平坦且可见轮胎印迹，表明重型机械近期有活动。

err.zh: 正在进行进行挖掘作业

text: The image shows a yellow Volvo excavator operating on a slope with its bucket digging into the earth. A worker wearing a hard hat is visible in the cab of the excavator. Another worker, also with a hard hat, is standing on the ground beside the excavator, holding onto a blue barrel.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色沃尔沃挖掘机正在斜坡面上作业，其铲斗挖着泥土。一名戴着硬帽的工人在挖掘机的驾驶室里可见。另一名工人，也戴着硬帽，站在挖掘机旁边的地面上，拿着一条蓝色管道。

text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being poured. A concrete pump with an extended boom is visible, and a concrete mixer truck is positioned near it. There are at least seven workers in the area, some of whom are monitoring the pouring process, while others are engaged in different tasks on the site. In the foreground, there is a stack of wooden formworks, and steel reinforcement bars are laid out across the floor, with some vertical rebar structures in place.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，混凝土正在浇筑。可见一台混凝土泵，带增压装置，旁边停着一辆混凝土搅拌运输车。现场至少有七名工人，其中一些人在监控浇筑过程，另一些人则在工地上从事不同的任务。前景处有一堆木质模板，钢筋被铺设在楼板上，并有一些竖向钢筋结构就位。

text: The image shows a construction site with a mobile crane in the center, its boom extended diagonally across the frame. Multiple bundles of rebar are visible, organized in different areas on the site. There are at least four workers; two are near the base of the crane, one is walking along the edge of the site, and another is in the area with blue fencing. Construction materials and equipment are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中心位置有一台移动式起重机，其吊臂斜向横跨整个画面。多组钢筋可见，分散在工地的不同区域。现场至少有四名工人；其中两人靠近起重机底部，一人沿工地边缘行走，另一人位于设有蓝色围栏网的片的区。建筑材料和设备散布在整个工地各处。

err.en: in the area with blue fencing
err.zh: 位于设有蓝色围栏网的片的区

text: The image shows a blue excavator at work on a construction site, with its bucket engaged in digging or moving debris, which consists mainly of broken bricks and concrete. The excavator is positioned on the left side of the image, and there is a field with green crops in the background.
zh: 图中显示一台蓝色挖掘机正在建筑工地上作业，其铲斗正进行挖掘或搬运碎屑，该碎屑主要由碎砖和混凝土组成。挖掘机位于图像的左侧，背景中有一片长着绿色作物的物的。

err.zh: 一片长着绿色作物的物的

text: The image shows an excavator in the center, engaged in digging or moving earth within an excavation site. To the left of the excavator, there is one individual wearing a red top, squatting on the ground. The ground appears to be uneven with exposed earth, suggesting ongoing excavation or construction work.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土。挖掘机左侧有一个人，身穿红色上衣，蹲在地面上。地面看起来是平整的，露出泥土，表明正在进行持续的挖掘或施工作业。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the foreground, its bucket resting on the ground. To the right, there is pile driving equipment with its boom extended upwards and a bucket attached to cables at the end. Behind the pile driver, a partially covered structure is visible. The ground is uneven with visible tracks and scattered debris, indicative of recent construction activity.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台挖掘机，其铲斗停放在地面上。右侧有一台钻机载设备，其吊臂向上伸展，末端通过缆绳连接着一个铲斗。在装载机后方，可见一处部分被遮盖的结构。地面平整，带有可见轨道和散落的碎屑，表明近期有施工活动。

text: The aerial image shows a construction site with various elements distributed across the scene. In the center, there is a white vehicle parked next to a structure with multiple openings, possibly a building under construction. To the right of the vehicle, there is a green tarp covering an area, and nearby, a backhoe is positioned next to a pile of materials. On the left side of the image, there is a large black tarp with materials underneath and a white truck parked beside it. Several stockpiles of construction materials, such as wooden planks and rebars, are visible around the site.
zh: 航拍图像显示一个建筑工地，各种元素分布在整个场景中中。画面中央，有一辆白色车辆停放在一座带有多个开口的、可能正在施工的建筑旁边。在车辆的右侧，有一块绿色防水布覆盖着一片区域，附近，一把铁锹位于一堆材料旁边。在图像左侧，有一块大型黑色防水布，其下方有材料，旁边停着一辆白色卡车。工地周围可见多堆建筑材料，例如木托盘和钢筋。

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor at a construction site with muddy terrain in the foreground. In the background, there are multiple tower cranes and an unfinished building with exposed rebar.
zh: 画面中，一名身着黄色土方的施工员站在建筑工地上，前景是泥泞土地。背景中，有多台塔式起重机和一座未完工的建筑，其钢筋外露在外。

err.zh: 身着黄色土方的施工员

err.en: The image shows a yellow soil compactor
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土方的施工员站在建筑工地上

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility vests. Two workers are standing—one observing the site and the other seemingly overseeing the work. Three workers are engaged in tasks: one is operating a yellow excavator, another is kneeling and working on the ground, and the third is walking across the site. The ground is uneven with visible trenches and covered with large green tarps, some of which are folded or piled up.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，五名工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度背心。两名工人站立——一名在观察工地，另一名似乎在监督工作。三名工人正在从事任务：一名在操作黄色挖掘机，另一名跪在地上工作，第三名在工地上行走。地面是均匀的，带有可见沟槽，覆盖着大绿色草，其中一些是折叠或堆叠起来。

text: The image shows a construction site with two dump trucks in the foreground, one orange and one red. The ground is uneven and covered with debris and dug-up earth. In the background, there is a blue excavator and a pile of earth.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景有两辆自卸卡车，一辆橙色，一辆红色。地面平整，覆盖着碎屑和挖出的来的土。背景中有一台蓝色挖掘机和一堆土。

text: The image shows a construction site with red-brown soil in the foreground. There are two yellow excavators; one on the left and another towards the center with its arm extended upwards. A black crane is positioned in the center with its boom raised. In the far background, high-rise buildings with construction cranes can be seen under a hazy sky.
zh: 画面前景是红褐色土壤。现场有两台黄色挖掘机，一台位于左侧，另一台靠近中央，其吊臂向上伸展。一台黑色起重机位于中央，其吊臂向上抬起。在遥远的背景中，高层建筑与施工吊篮可在朦胧天空下被看见。

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain and several pieces of heavy equipment. In the center, there is a yellow excavator at work, with another stationary excavator to its right. On the left side of the image, there is a bulldozer facing away from the camera. Multiple large concrete pipes are scattered across the site, with one lying horizontally in the foreground.
zh: 画面显示一处施工场地，地形泥泞湿，散落着几件重型型设备。画面中央有一台黄色挖掘机正在作业，其右侧停着另一台静止的挖掘机。画面左侧有一台推土机，背向镜头。多根大型混凝土管道散布于场地各处，其中一根横卧于前景。

err.en: muddy terrain and several pieces of heav
err.zh: 地形泥泞湿，散落着几件重型型设备

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers in the foreground, one walking and the other operating a concrete pump truck with an extended boom. In the background, there are two large buildings with scaffolding.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，前景有两名工人，其中一人正在行走，另一人操作着一辆混凝土泵车，车上装有伸缩式卸料斗。背景中可见两栋大型建筑，搭设有脚手架。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large pile of broken concrete in the foreground. A yellow dump truck is being loaded with debris by a wheel loader, which is positioned to the right of the truck. In the background, an excavator is visible, and there are scattered construction materials and equipment throughout the site.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景有一大堆破碎的混凝土。一辆黄色色自卸卡车正在被一台轮式装载机装载废料，该装载机位于卡车的右侧。背景中可见一台挖掘机，整个工地现场散落着建筑材料和设备。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom over a series of freshly poured concrete foundations covered with a blue curing blanket. Two individuals are standing on the concrete foundation, while another person is walking along a dirt road adjacent to the site. A red excavator is positioned to the right of the concrete pump truck, and there are various construction materials and debris scattered around the area.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一辆混凝土泵车正将料斗篷覆盖在一排新浇筑的混凝土基础之上。两人站在混凝土基础上，另一人正沿着紧邻工地的的一条土路行走。一台红色挖掘机位于混凝土泵车右侧，该区域周围散落着各种建筑材料和碎屑。

err.en: extending its boom over a series of fres
err.zh: 正将料斗篷覆盖在一排新浇筑的混凝土基础之上

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of materials and equipment. In the foreground, there is a yellow mobile crane and a yellow dump truck. Various construction materials, such as metal rebars and wooden planks, are scattered across the site. A single worker wearing a blue shirt is visible on the right side of the image, walking near the materials.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，现场有各种材料和设备。前景中有一台黄色色移动起重机和一辆黄色色泵车。各种建筑材料，如金属钢筋和木托盘，散落在工地各处。图像右侧可见一名身穿蓝色衬衫的工人，正走在材料附近。

text: The image shows a construction site with one individual standing near the center, facing away from the camera, and appearing to observe the area. There are several pieces of heavy machinery, including two bulldozers in the middle ground and a dump truck on the right. Large black pipes are stacked in the middle ground, and there is a sedan in the foreground.
