text: The image shows seven workers wearing red and yellow hard hats and safety vests engaged in various activities at a construction site. Two workers are sitting on the ground, while another is crouching near a pile of rubble. One worker is standing by a wheelbarrow, and three others are walking across the site. A green safety net is partially visible, and construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, are scattered around the area. The background features a concrete structure with scaffolding.
zh: 图像显示七名头戴红黄安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人在建筑工地从事各种活动。两名工人坐在地面上，另一名工人在碎石堆附近大声呼喊。一名工人站在轮轴旁，另外三名工人在工地上行走。绿色安全网部分可见，建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘，散落在周围区域。背景中带有脚手架的混凝土结构。

text: The excavator is engaged in digging or moving mud, with its arm extended and bucket inserted into the ground. The ground appears muddy and uneven with tire tracks, indicating recent activity. Trees and brush have been cleared in the area, and a pile of debris is noticeable in the background.
zh: 挖掘机正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土，其臂架和斗桶插入地面。地面显得泥泞滑且平整，带有轮胎痕迹，表明近期有活动。树木和灌木丛已被清理过，背景中可见一堆碎屑物。

err.en: The ground appears muddy and uneven
err.zh: 地面显得泥泞滑且平整

text: A red dump truck is tilted to unload its contents at a construction site with muddy tire tracks in the foreground. Behind the truck, a row of high-rise residential buildings is visible.
zh: 一辆红色自卸卡车倾斜着，正在一处建筑工地上卸载货物，前景中可见其轮胎陷入泥泞中。卡车后方，一排高层住宅楼清晰可见。

err.en: muddy tire tracks in the foreground
err.zh: 前景中可见其轮胎陷入泥泞中

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a white hard hat is operating a yellow dump truck, which is being loaded with a large pile of rocks by an excavator. Another worker in a red hard hat is taking photographs, while a third worker in a yellow hard hat is near the truck. There are several large orange pipes on the ground, and a forklift is positioned next to a hopper.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴白色安全帽的工人正在操作一辆黄色自卸卡车，该卡车正被一台挖掘机装载着一大堆岩石。另一名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在拍照，而第三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人则靠近卡车。地面上有几根大型橙色管道，一台塔式起重机正位于一台搅拌机的旁。

err.en: a forklift is positioned next to a hoppe
err.zh: 一台塔式起重机正位于一台搅拌机的旁

text: The image shows a construction site with two pile drivers actively engaged in work, surrounded by debris and scattered construction materials. Various construction vehicles, including excavators and trucks, are visible in the background, where multiple tower cranes dot the skyline, indicating extensive construction activity.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，两名桩工正在积极作业，周围散落着碎屑和散落的建筑材料。背景中可见多种施工车辆，包括挖掘机和卡车，其中多座塔楼点缀着天际线，表明广泛的施工活动。

text: The image shows a pile driver in the foreground, with its boom extended vertically. A yellow excavator is partially visible to the left, and another piece of construction machinery is seen in the background to the right.
zh: 前景中有一堆司机，其吊臂垂直延伸。左侧部分可见一台黄色挖掘机，右侧背景中还能看到另一台建筑机械。

text: The image shows multiple bundles of rebars placed alongside an orange barrier, with loose bricks and construction debris scattered around. A water-filled trench runs parallel to the rebar stockpile, with concrete reinforcements visible inside it. A worker wearing a red hard hat and a high-visibility vest is standing near the trench. Electrical pylons extend into the distance, and a partially obscured building with a pixelated facade is visible in the background.
zh: 画面中可见多组钢筋堆放在橙色围挡墙旁，周围散落着松散的砖块和建筑废料。一条注满水的的水的水沟与钢筋堆平行延伸，其内部可见混凝土加固结构。一名头戴红色安全帽、身着高能见度背心的的工人正站在沟渠附近。电力线缆延伸至远方，背景中可见一栋部分被遮挡、带有像素化立面的建筑。

err.zh: 一条注满水的的水的水沟
高能见度背心的的工人

text: Two workers wearing safety helmets are standing on a large grid of rebar at a construction site, likely preparing or inspecting the steel reinforcement for a concrete pour. The rebar grid is extensive, covering the entire visible area, and is supported by numerous vertical rebar stakes.
zh: 两名头戴安全帽的工人站在大型钢筋网格上，位于一处建筑工地，可能正在准备或检查混凝土浇筑用的钢筋。该钢筋网格范围广泛，覆盖整个可见区域，并由众多竖向钢筋牌支撑。

text: Two excavators are operating at a night-time construction site, with one positioned on an elevated mound of earth and the other at a lower level, both with their booms extended and lights on.
zh: 两名挖掘机在夜间施工现场作业，一台位于较高的土堆上，另一台位于较低处，两台均配备有斗轮并开启照明。

text: Six individuals are gathered at a construction site, with five wearing red hard hats and one without a hard hat. They appear to be engaged in a discussion, with some looking at documents. The terrain around them is uneven and dug up, with exposed earth and no visible construction equipment or materials. Trees surround the area, suggesting a location that is not densely urban.
zh: 六名人员聚集在一处建筑工地，其中五人佩戴红色安全帽，另一人未佩戴安全帽。他们似乎正在参与讨论，部分人正在查看文件。周围地形平坦且经过挖掘，露出泥土，未见明显的施工设备或材料。树木环绕该区域，表明该地点并非密集集成都市。

err.en: The terrain around them is uneven and du
err.zh: 周围地形平坦且经过挖掘

text: Three workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are present at a construction excavation site; one is operating a yellow Komatsu PC 240 excavator, another is standing near the edge of the excavation, and the third is walking along the bottom of the dug-out area. Striped blue and white tarps are draped over the edges of the excavation, and there are blue tarps and mounds of earth in the background.
zh: 三名工人身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽，出现在一处施工开挖现场；其中一人正在操作一台黄色小松PC-240型挖掘机，另一人站在开挖边缘处，第三人则沿着开挖区域底部行走。蓝白相的防护栏悬挂于开挖边缘，背景中还有蓝色防护栏及泥土堆。

text: Two dump trucks are parked on a dirt road with their beds raised, indicating the unloading of materials. A large pile of white material, possibly sand or gravel, is adjacent to the trucks.
zh: 两辆自卸卡车停放在土路上，车斗架起，表明未装载物料。旁边有一大堆白色物料，可能是沙或碎石。

text: Two workers are present at a rocky construction site; one is standing amidst large rocks and rubble, looking towards the ground, while the other is seated operating a surveying instrument on a tripod. A patterned cloth is partially covering some of the ground to the left, and various construction materials, including pipes and rebars, are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 两名工人出现在一处岩石施工现场；一人站在大块岩石和碎石之间，面向地面，另一人坐着操作三脚架上的的一台测量仪器。一块带图案的衣服部分遮盖着左侧的地面，各种建筑材料，包括管道和钢筋，散落在整个工地现场。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat walking while carrying a tool. Two workers are engaged in construction activities, one kneeling and arranging materials, while the other is standing and appears to be inspecting or preparing to lift materials. The site is scattered with construction materials, including bricks, wooden planks, and green tiles.
zh: 图中显示一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正搬运着一件工具。两名工人正在从事施工作业，其中一人跪在地上整理材料，另一人站立着，似乎正在检查或准备吊装运材料。现场散落着建筑材料，包括砖块、木托盘以及绿色瓷砖。

text: Approximately 20 workers wearing yellow hard hats and reflective vests are spread across a construction site with dense rebar frameworks on the ground. Some workers are bending over the rebar, possibly tying or adjusting it, while others are walking or standing, observing the work. Construction materials, including wooden planks and foam blocks, are scattered around the site.
zh: 约20名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿反光背心的的工人分散在密集钢筋框架的地面上。一些工人正弯身跨越钢筋，可能系紧或调整它，而另一些工人则行走或站立，观察着施工。建筑材料，包括木托盘和泡沫块，散落在场地周围。

text: The image shows a multi-story steel structure under construction with visible cross bracing and floor beams. A crane with an extended boom is positioned to the left, and construction materials are scattered across the site. Two workers are visible on the structure, one on an upper level and another on a lower level, both engaged in construction activities.
zh: 图像显示一栋在建多层钢结构建筑，可见交叉的桁架和楼面梁。一台起重机吊着一根长杆位于左侧，建筑材料散落在工地各处。可见两名工人，一人在上层，另一人在下层，两人均从事施工作业。

text: Two individuals are present on a construction site with a grid of rebar laid out on the floor, likely in preparation for a concrete pour. The person on the left is walking across the rebar, while the individual on the right, wearing a white hard hat, is standing and looking at a device in their hands. The structure has multiple floors with steel columns and open walls, indicating an early phase of construction.
zh: 两名人员出现在一处施工现场，现场地面铺设着钢筋网架，可能是在为混凝土浇筑做准备。左侧的人员正跨过钢筋网架行走，而右侧人员头戴白色安全帽，站立着，正注视着自己手中拿着的设备。现场有多处地面与钢柱及敞开墙体，表明处于施工早期阶段。

text: Three workers wearing hard hats and safety vests are engaged in various activities on a paved path lined with trees. Two workers are handling and organizing red and brown metal forms on the ground, while the third is standing and appears to be inspecting or preparing another form. Behind them, there are large stacks of yellow and blue metal forms, and to the right, a collection of wooden planks and metal rods is scattered on the ground.
zh: 三名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在铺有树木的路面上从事各种活动。其中两名工人正在地面整理和整理红色与棕色金属形态，而第三名人站立着，似乎正在检查或准备另一种形态。在他们身后，有大型黄色与蓝色金属形态堆叠，并且右侧，一堆木质托盘子和金属杆散落在地面。

text: In the foreground, a large pile of wooden planks is scattered across the ground. A yellow excavator is positioned in the center, with mounds of red-brown earth behind it. To the right, a tall yellow tower crane stands erect with its jib extending horizontally across the frame. In the distance, a city skyline is faintly visible against the hazy sky.
zh: 前景中，一大堆木托盘散落在地面上。一台黄色挖掘机位于画面中央，其后方堆着红褐色泥土。右侧，一台黄色塔式起重机矗立着，其吊臂横向延伸横跨画面。远处，城市天际线在朦胧的天空下隐约可见。

text: A road roller is compacting the surface of a newly laid asphalt road with two other rollers waiting behind it. Excavated earth is piled up along the left side of the road, and construction barriers are visible in the distance.
zh: 一台压路机正在压实新铺设的沥青路面，其后方有两台压路机待命。激进的土堆在道路左侧，施工围栏在远处可见。

text: A yellow dump truck is positioned in the foreground with its bed raised, indicating the unloading of materials. A worker is visible on a pile of rocks, operating a hose. In the background, construction activity is suggested by the presence of a blue crane and other structures amidst a mountainous terrain.
zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车停在前景，其货箱升起，表明材料尚未卸载。一名工人可见于一堆岩石上，操作着一根软管。背景中，由一台蓝色起重机及其他结构的存在所暗示的施工活动，位于多山地形之中。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator actively digging and moving muddy soil, with its bucket in mid-air holding a large clump of earth. Behind it, another excavator appears stationary. Construction activity is evident with disturbed soil and tracks near an embankment. Power lines and industrial structures can be seen in the far background under a cloudy sky.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机正在积极挖掘并搬运泥泞土，其铲斗在空中悬停，夹着一大团泥土块。在它身后，另一台挖掘机似乎处于静止状态。施工活动明显可见，伴有被扰动的土壤和轨道，靠近一个嵌入物。电力线路和工业结构可在远处背景中看到，位于多云天空之下。

text: Eight workers are visible on a scaffold structure attached to a building with gray exterior walls. They are engaged in various activities, some are standing and appear to be handling materials or tools, while others are in different postures that suggest active work on the building's facade.
zh: 八名工人可见于附着在建筑上的的一座脚手架，其灰色外墙内部。他们正从事各种活动，一些人站着，似乎正在处理材料或工具，而另一些人则处于不同的姿态，暗示着在建筑立面上进行积极作业。

text: A red dump truck is positioned on a construction site with uneven terrain and scattered debris, including bricks, rocks, and soil. The area appears to be in the early stages of site preparation or clearing. In the background, there are structures that suggest nearby development or habitation.
zh: 一辆红色自卸卡车停放在一处地形平坦、散落着砖块、岩石和土壤的建筑工地上。该区域似乎处于场地准备或清理的早期阶段。背景中，有结构暗示附近的发展或棚子。

text: Four workers wearing hard hats are engaged in activities on a concrete slab reinforced with steel rebar. Two workers in the foreground are operating a power trowel to smooth the concrete surface, while two others in the background are manually spreading concrete using hand tools. Behind them, a vertical rebar structure is visible, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 四名头戴安全帽的工人正在一块用钢筋配筋的混凝土板上进行作业。前景中的两名工人正在操作一台混凝土泵，以抹平混凝土表面，而背景中的另外两名工人则正用手工工具摊铺展混凝土。在他们身后，可见一根竖直钢筋，表明施工工作仍在持续进行。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on the left side of a dirt road, with its arm extended towards the ground. Two workers are visible further down the road, with one closer to the center and another near the right edge. Several large concrete pipes are scattered on both sides of the road, with a concentration of these materials on the right. The terrain on either side of the road appears to be excavated, creating embankments. In the distance, a skyline with multiple buildings can be seen under a clear blue sky.
zh: 画面左侧，一台挖掘机停靠在土路一侧，其臂架伸向地面。道路更远处可见两名工人，其中一人靠近中央，另一人靠近右侧边缘。道路两侧散落着若干大型混凝土管道，右侧这些材料分布较为集中。道路两侧地形似乎经过挖掘，形成凹陷。远处，晴朗蓝天之下可见多栋建筑的天际线。

text: A dump truck is tilted to unload its contents onto a pile, with one worker visible beneath the raised bed of the truck, likely monitoring or assisting with the unloading process.
zh: 一辆自卸卡车倾斜着，以便将其上的货物卸到一堆上，一名工人在升起的的车床下可见，很可能正在监控或协助卸过程。

text: The image shows a large yellow tower crane standing adjacent to an unfinished concrete structure with exposed rebar. Approximately nine workers with hard hats are visible on various levels of the structure, engaged in construction activities. The surrounding area is densely forested, and the construction site appears to be in a remote or less developed area.
zh: 画面中有一台大型黄色塔式起重机，停靠在已完工但钢筋外露的混凝土结构旁。大约九名头戴安全帽的工人分布在不同高度的，正从事施工作业。周边区域树木茂密，施工现场似乎位于偏远或开发程度较低的区域。

err.zh: 已完工但钢筋外露的混凝土结构

text: The worker next to the truck is not wearing a hard hat.
zh: 该工人接下来要登上卡车，没有戴安全帽。

text: The image shows a construction site with a worker bending over a network of rebar, while another worker observes or assists. Four additional workers are in the midground, engaged in various tasks around the rebar framework. They are all wearing safety helmets, and the site is characterized by a dense arrangement of vertical and horizontal rebars, with some wooden formwork visible.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一名工人正弯腰检查一个钢筋网架，另一名工人在旁观察或协助。另外四名工人位于地面中部，正围绕钢筋框架从事各项任务。他们均佩戴安全帽，该工地以纵横交错的钢筋密集排列为特征，并可见部分木工作业。

text: Five workers wearing hard hats and reflective vests are present at a construction site, with two working on reinforcing steel bars (rebars) for a foundation or wall structure, and three others walking in the background. Construction machinery, including a concrete pump truck with its boom extended over the rebar framework, is visible.
zh: 五名头戴安全帽、身穿反光背心的的工人出现在施工现场，其中两人在钢筋上作业，另外三人在背景中行走。施工机械，包括一辆混凝土泵车，其轰鸣声在钢筋框架上可见。

err.en: with its boom extended over the rebar fr
err.zh: 其轰鸣声在钢筋框架上可见

text: In the foreground, a yellow soil compactor with a front blade is centered on a reddish-brown dirt road. In the background, multiple vehicles are visible, including a white pickup truck to the left and another construction vehicle to the right.
zh: 前景中，一名身着黄色土作业服的工人手持前铲，位于一条红褐色土路的中央。背景中可见多辆车辆，包括左侧的一辆白色皮卡卡车和右侧另一辆施工车辆。

err.en: a yellow soil compactor with a front bla
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土作业服的工人手持前铲

err.en: a yellow soil compactor with a front bla
err.zh: 一名身着黄色土作业服的工人

text: The image shows three workers attending to an overturned cart among large rocks, with an excavator operating in the midground. Approximately 14 workers are visible throughout the site, engaged in various activities such as carrying materials and working on the construction.
zh: 画面显示，三名工人正在处理一块翻倒的大型岩石，旁边有一台挖掘机在场地中部作业。整个工地现场可见约十四名工人，正从事着搬运材料、施工作业等各类活动。

err.en: attending to an overturned cart among la
err.zh: 正在处理一块翻倒的大型岩石

text: The image shows a large crawler crane operating, with its boom extended upwards and a pile driver attached at the end. A worker is walking past a stack of red pipes laid on the ground, with a bulldozer behind. A water truck is parked next to a pile of large black pipes. In the background, another tower crane can be seen in the distance, amidst a backdrop of buildings under construction. The ground appears to be a dirt construction site with tire tracks and mounds of earth.
zh: 画面中有一台大型履带起重机正在作业，其吊臂向上伸展，末端挂着一名桩机。一名工人正走过一堆放置在地面上的、呈红色的色的状的管道，其后方有一台推土机。一辆水罐车停靠在一大堆黑色管道旁。背景中，远处还能看到另一台履带起重机，置身于正在施工的建筑群的之间。地面看起来像一个泥土质施工场地，带有轮胎印迹和泥土堆。

err.en: a pile driver attached at the end
a stack of red pipes laid on the ground
err.zh: 一堆放置在地面上的、呈红色的色的状的管道

text: The image shows two workers wearing safety vests on a construction platform with various building materials, including rebars and wooden planks.
zh: 图像显示两名工人在建筑平台上穿着安全背心，周围有各种建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。

text: Two dump trucks are in the foreground, one with its bed raised, unloading soil. A worker is standing between the trucks. In the midground, a yellow excavator is operating, with its arm extended towards a stack of red pipes.
zh: 前景中有两辆自卸车，其中一辆车斗已升起，未装载泥土料。一名工人站在两车之间。中景处有一台黄色挖掘机正在作业，其臂伸向一堆红色管道。

text: Five workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in activities near a large retaining wall with exposed rebar and formwork. Two workers are standing on the ground level handling some materials, while three workers are on the slope behind the wall, with one appearing to be climbing up. Construction materials, including a blue tarp, are visible on the ground, and a green safety netting is installed at the foreground.
zh: 五名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色硬帽的工人正在大型挡土墙附近进行作业，墙体上有外露出的钢筋和模板。两名工人站在地面上处理一些材料，而三名工人在墙后方的，其中一人似乎正在攀爬上去。建筑材料包括一块蓝色防水布，可见于地面，并且一块绿色安全网正在前景处安装。

err.en: Five workers in orange overalls and yell
err.zh: 五名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色硬帽的工人

err.en: three workers are on the slope behind th

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is loading dirt into the bed of a green dump truck. To the left, there is a large pile of wooden planks and scaffolding materials, while on the right, neatly stacked bundles of rebar are visible. In the background, a tower crane stands beside an under-construction building with scaffolding and formwork in place.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机正将泥土装载到一辆绿色自卸卡车的车斗中。左侧堆放着一大堆木方材和脚手架材料，右侧则整齐码放着成束钢筋。背景中，一台塔式起重机矗立在一座正在施工的建筑旁，该建筑搭有脚手架，现场有工人在作业。

err.en: with scaffolding and formwork in place

text: Two workers wearing yellow hard hats are present at a construction site with a large rebar structure in the center. One worker is standing within the rebar framework, while the other is outside it. In the foreground, there are scattered rebars and a dirt path leading towards the rebar structure.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人出现在一处大型施工现场，场地中央有一大型钢筋结构。其中一名工人站在钢筋结构内部，另一名则位于其外部。前景处散落着散乱的钢筋以及一条通向该结构的的地面。

err.zh: 一条通向该结构的的地面

text: The image shows an excavator with its bucket raised over a pile of excavated earth. The ground appears muddy and uneven with scattered debris.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起，位于一堆挖掘出的泥土之上。地面看起来泥泞滑且平坦，散落着零碎的屑。

text: The image shows a yellow road roller with the brand "SHANTUI" parked on a dirt road, facing the camera. To the left, there is a green construction fence and scaffolding around an unfinished structure. In the distance, a crane is partially visible. The ground shows tire tracks and footprints, indicating recent activity.
zh: 画面中，一辆印有“SHANTUI”品牌的标识的黄色道路压路机停放在土路上，正对着镜头。左侧可见一道绿色施工围栏及脚手架环绕着一处已完工的结构。远处隐约可见一台起重机。地面上留有轮胎印迹和脚印，表明近期有活动。

text: Over two dozen workers wearing safety vests and hard hats are dispersed across a large area of rebar mesh, working on what appears to be the foundation of a structure. In the center, a tower crane stands with its base surrounded by barriers, and various construction materials are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 两百多名工人身着安全背心和硬帽分散在大型钢筋网架区域，从事看似基础结构的工作。在中心，一台塔式起重机矗立着，其基座被屏障环绕，各种建筑材料散布在整个工地。

text: Two individuals are present on a construction site with uneven, rocky terrain. The person on the left is wearing a yellow hard hat, orange gloves, and a soiled orange coverall, and appears to be gesturing towards the ground. The individual on the right is holding a device with wires attached to the ground, possibly conducting some form of testing or measurement.
zh: 两人出现在一处地形平坦、岩石裸露的施工现场。左侧的人头戴黄色安全帽，手戴橙色手套，身着橙色连体工作服，似乎正朝向地面保持警惕姿态。右侧的人手持连接着线缆的设备，可能正在进行某种检测或测量作业。

err.zh: 朝向地面保持警惕姿态

text: The image shows a large excavated trench revealing underground concrete structures, with a worker in a white hard hat and blue long-sleeve shirt walking along the edge. An orange bulldozer is stationed on the trench's rim, and multiple construction vehicles and equipment are visible in the background, amidst a landscape of ongoing construction activity.
zh: 图像显示一条大型开挖沟槽，露出地下混凝土结构，一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿蓝色长袖衬衫的工人正沿着边缘行走。一台橙色压路机停靠在沟槽边缘，背景中可见多辆施工车辆和设备，处于持续施工活动的所构成的的一片景观地之中。

text: The image shows a construction site with large stockpiles of materials, including rebars and wooden planks. A worker is operating a surveying instrument, while another is walking past. Several workers are engaged around a steel rebar structure, with one welding. In the background, high-rise buildings are visible, and the site is bordered by a green fence.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，堆放着大量材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。一名工人正在操作测量仪器，另一名工人正走过场。几名工人正围着一根钢筋作业，其中一人正在焊接。背景中可见高层建筑，且该工地被一道绿色围栏所环绕。

text: In the foreground, a yellow soil compactor with the label "XCMG" is visible, positioned on a dirt surface with its roller facing the camera. Behind the compactor, a red truck with a visible cab is partially seen, parked on the same dirt surface.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿黄色土作业服的演员清晰可见，其身上标有“X-CM-G”字样，正站在一片泥土地面上，其滚筒朝向摄像机方向。在该演员身后，一辆红色卡车清晰可见，其驾驶室部分可见，停放在同一片泥土地面上。

err.en: a yellow soil compactor with the label "
err.zh: 一名身穿黄色土作业服的演员清晰可见，其身上标有“X-CM-G”字样
其滚筒朝向摄像机方向

err.en: a red truck with a visible cab is partia
err.zh: 一辆红色卡车清晰可见，其驾驶室部分可见

text: Five workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in activities on a large grid of rebar at a construction site. Two workers are standing on the rebar grid, one is walking along it, and two are bending over, possibly tying rebar or conducting measurements. The site is surrounded by a retaining wall with soil exposed beyond it, and there are several blue containers and construction materials scattered around the area.
zh: 五名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人正在大型钢筋网格施工现场进行作业。两名工人站在钢筋网格上，一人沿其行走，另外两人正弯腰越过，可能绑扎钢筋或进行测量。该场地被一道露出土方的挡土墙所环绕，周围散落着若干蓝色容器和建筑材料。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and yellow hard
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: A yellow Komatsu excavator is positioned on an earthen mound with its arm extended upwards. Behind the excavator, a partially obscured structure with various colors is visible. The surrounding area is characterized by uneven terrain with exposed soil and some vegetation.
zh: 一台黄色小松挖掘机停在一座土丘上，其臂向上伸展。在挖掘机后方，一个部分被遮挡的结构，呈现出多种颜色。周围区域以平坦地形为特征，伴有裸露出的土壤和一些植被。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with multiple construction vehicles at work, including two excavators and a bulldozer. There are at least four workers in the area, with two near the center of the site and two more in the distance. A green tent-like structure is set up on the left, and various materials are scattered around, including blue containers and piles of construction debris.
zh: 图中显示一个大型土方方开挖施工现场，有多台施工车辆正在作业，包括两台挖掘机和一台推土机。现场至少有四名工人，其中两人靠近场地中心，另外两人在远处。左侧搭建了一个绿色帐篷状结构，周围散落着各种材料，包括蓝色容器和一堆施工废料。

err.zh: 大型土方方开挖施工现场

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor compacting the ground, with its drum visible and soil being displaced. To the right, a section of the construction site is sectioned off with scaffolding and covered with blue tarpaulin, while various construction materials are scattered around the area.
zh: 图中显示一名黄色土压工正在压实地面，其鼓可见，土壤被挤压。右侧，施工现场的一个区域被脚手架覆盖，并铺有蓝色防水布，同时各种建筑材料散落在该区域周围。

text: In the foreground, a yellow wheel loader is carrying large rocks with its bucket raised, positioned near an open excavation area with reinforced concrete structures. Three individuals, likely construction workers, are standing to the left of the wheel loader, observing or discussing. Behind them, a yellow dump truck is parked. Various construction materials, including timber planks and metal rods, are scattered around the site.
zh: 前景中，一辆黄色轮式装载机正用其铲斗装载着一大块大岩石，停放在一处敞口开挖区域附近，该区域设有钢筋混凝土结构。三名人员，很可能是建筑工人，站在轮式装载机左侧，正在观察或讨论。在他们身后，一辆黄色泵送卡车停放着。各种建筑材料，包括木材托盘和金属杆，散落在工地周围。

text: In a dug-out area, a worker wearing a high-visibility orange jacket and white hard hat is kneeling while handling what appears to be sacks. The surrounding ground is uneven with visible vegetation, and there are some blue materials partially visible at the top of the trench.
zh: 在开挖区域，一名身穿高能见度橙色夹克和白色安全帽的工人正跪着处理看似袋子的。周围地面平整，可见植被，且沟槽顶部部分可见一些蓝色材料。

text: Four workers are visible at a construction site during nighttime operations. In the foreground, one worker is bending over, handling some construction material, while another is standing and appears to be working with a tool or material. Two additional workers are in the background; one is standing and working within a framework of vertical rebars, and the other is kneeling and applying a substance to the ground or a structure. The site is cluttered with wooden planks and construction debris, and there is a structure with vertical rebars suggesting the formation of walls or columns.
zh: 夜间施工期间，现场可见四名工人。前景中，一名工人正弯腰搬运某些建筑材料，另一名工人站立着，似乎正在使用某种工具或材料。背景中有另外两名工人；一名工人站立着，正在一个由竖直栏杆构成的框架内作业，另一名工人则跪着，正在向地面或结构施加涂某种物质。现场杂乱乱，堆放着木托盘和建筑垃圾废料，且存在由竖直栏杆构成的，暗示着墙体或立柱的形成。

err.en: The site is cluttered with wooden planks
err.zh: 现场杂乱乱，堆放着木托盘和建筑垃圾废料

err.en: there is a structure with vertical rebar
err.zh: 且存在由竖直栏杆构成的，暗示着墙体或立柱的形成

text: Two workers wearing hard hats are present at a construction site with a large, rectangular concrete structure. One worker is standing inside the structure, while the other is applying a waterproofing material to the exterior wall. There is a pile of soil adjacent to the structure, and a partially visible blue tarp is placed on the ground.
zh: 两名头戴安全帽的工人出现在一处大型矩形混凝土结构施工现场。一名工人站在结构内部，另一名工人正在向内墙面施涂防水材料。结构旁有一堆泥土，地面上铺着一块部分可见蓝色防水布。

text: The image shows a concrete pump truck with an extended boom over a construction site. A worker wearing a safety vest is standing near a pile of rebars. Blue fencing surrounds the perimeter of the site, and trees are visible in the background. The ground is uneven with visible debris and soil.
zh: 图中显示一辆混凝土泵车，其伸缩臂横跨在一处建筑工地上方。一名身穿安全背心的的工人站在成堆的钢筋旁。蓝色围栏网围绕工地的周边，树木在背景中可见。地面是均匀的，带有可见碎屑和土壤。

text: The image shows a worker operating a crane with a bright green boom over a stockpile of red and brown metal beams. Another worker is walking near the crane, and multiple stacks of construction materials, including metal scaffolding and beams, are organized throughout the site.
zh: 图中显示一名工人正在操作一台起重机，吊钩上方有一团明亮的绿色的光晕，下方是一堆红褐色金属梁的料堆。另一名工人正走向起重机附近，现场各处还堆放着多组建筑材料，包括金属脚手架和梁。

err.zh: 吊钩上方有一团明亮的绿色的光晕

text: The two workers on the left are at the back and within the operation radius of the excavator.
zh: 左侧的两名工人位于挖掘机作业半径的后部。

err.en: at the back and within the operation rad
err.zh: 位于挖掘机作业半径的后部

text: The image shows a pile of rocks with a green net partially covering the ground behind it. Three individuals are present towards the right side of the netted area, appearing to be engaged in spreading or adjusting the net. A white perimeter wall with scaffolding is visible in the background, and beyond the wall, there are structures and vegetation.
zh: 画面中有一堆岩石，一张绿色网部分覆盖在岩石后方。三个人位于带网区域右侧，似乎正在展开或调整这张网。背景中可见一面白色围墙，带有脚手架结构，墙外还有植被。

err.en: and beyond the wall, there are structure

text: Two workers wearing yellow hard hats and high-visibility orange vests are standing on scaffolding over a muddy excavation site. One worker is holding a long tool, possibly for measurement or leveling, while the other appears to be working on the scaffolding or adjusting something at his feet. The excavation site has water pooled in areas, and the ground is uneven with visible trenches.
zh: 两名工人头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度橙色背心，站在泥泞地开挖场上方的脚手架上。其中一名工人手持一件长工具，可能用于测量或找平，另一名工人似乎正在脚手架上作业，或调整其脚边的某物。开挖场地有积水积存于区域内，且地面平整，可见沟槽。

text: In the center of the image, a scaffolding structure is being erected by three workers wearing hard hats. Surrounding the scaffolding is uneven, excavated terrain with visible footprints and scattered construction materials, including rebars and plastic-wrapped items.
zh: 画面中央，三名头戴安全帽的工人正在搭建脚手架。脚手架周围是平整的、被挖掘过的且留有明显脚印痕的地面，散落着建筑材料，包括钢筋和塑料包裹的物品。

text: The image shows an excavated area with wet and dry soil, a worker in orange attire standing in the trench, holding a tool, and two excavators on either side of the trench.
zh: 图像显示一个开挖区域，内有湿土和干土，一名身穿橙色工作服的工人站在沟槽中，手持工具，沟槽两侧各有一名挖掘机手。

text: Two workers are present, one actively bending rebar using a bending machine, and the other overseeing the operation. The worker operating the machine is wearing a red hard hat, while the supervisor is wearing a yellow hard hat. Bundles of rebar and loose pieces are scattered around the work area.
zh: 两名工人在场，其中一人正使用弯曲机对钢筋进行弯曲加工，另一人负责监督作业。操作机器的人员头戴红色安全帽，而监督人员头戴黄色安全帽。钢筋端头及松散碎屑散落在作业区域周围。

err.en: Bundles of rebar and loose pieces

text: An orange excavator is positioned on a dirt surface with its boom extended and bucket open, suggesting recent activity. The equipment is set against a large, sloped earthen backdrop, which appears to have been excavated. The ground in the foreground shows signs of vehicle movement, indicated by tracks.
zh: 一台橙色挖掘机停放在泥地上，其履带和铲斗敞开，暗示着近期活动。该设备被安置在一个大型、倾斜的泥质背景前，看起来似乎已被挖掘过。前景地面显示出车辆移动的迹象，由车辙标示。

text: An excavator is engaged in digging operations, with its bucket deep in the earth amidst a large pile of reddish-brown soil. The equipment is positioned on a relatively flat area with additional mounds of soil in the background.
zh: 一台挖掘机正在进行挖掘作业，其铲斗深深插入泥土中，周围是一大堆红褐色土壤。该设备停在一处相对平坦的区域上，背景中还有数吨泥土。

text: A dump truck is tilted to unload its contents onto a pile, with its bed raised at a steep angle. In the foreground, there is a stack of wooden planks and some metal beams on the ground. The background is a barren landscape with a hill.
zh: 一辆自卸卡车倾斜着，正将货物卸到一堆货物上，其车厢斗以陡峭的角度抬起。前景处有一堆木托盘和地面上的一些金属梁。背景是一片荒芜凉的山丘。

err.en: a barren landscape with a hill

text: In the center of the image, a dirt road leads through the construction site with stockpiles of construction materials on either side, including bundles of rebar and wooden planks. Three tower cranes dominate the skyline, with one in the foreground to the left and two others in the distance. On the right, a large, partially constructed building with scaffolding is visible, and there are more materials scattered around its base.
zh: 画面中央，一条土路穿过施工场地，两侧堆放着建筑材料，其中包括成束的钢筋和木托盘。三座塔式起重机主导着天际线，其中一台位于左侧前景，另外两台在远处。右侧，一栋大型、部分建成的建筑可见脚手架，并且其基周围散落着更多材料。

text: In the foreground, a group of workers wearing safety vests and helmets are engaged in various activities near a stockpile of construction materials, including wooden planks and steel rebars. A yellow excavator is positioned to the left, while in the central area, more workers operate around what appears to be a foundation or formwork structure. Behind them, an extensive excavation site is visible with additional construction machinery. The background features a residential area with red-roofed houses.
zh: 前景中，一群身穿安全背心、头戴安全帽的工人正在一堆建筑材料附近从事各种作业，其中包括木托盘和钢条。一台黄色挖掘机位于左侧，而在中心区域，更多工人正在围绕看似基础或结构工程作业进行作业。在他们身后，可见一处大型开挖场地，并配有更多施工机械。背景中呈现一片住宅区，带有红色屋顶的房屋。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on a mound of earth, with its arm extended towards the right. The ground is uneven and covered with debris, including bricks and soil. Wooden planks are laid out to form a makeshift path.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机停在一堆土堆上，其臂向右伸出。地面平整，覆盖着碎屑，包括砖块和泥土。木板被铺设成一条临时通道。

text: Four workers are visible on a construction site with industrial equipment. Two workers wearing red hard hats are engaged in tasks on the left side, with one operating a hose near a large cylindrical structure. Another worker in a white hard hat is descending a set of temporary stairs, while the fourth worker, also in a white hard hat, is standing on a lower level. The environment includes concrete structures and metal scaffolding, with various cables and construction materials present.
zh: 四名工人可见于一处配备工业设备的建筑工地上。两名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在左侧从事作业，其中一人正在操作一根靠近大型圆柱形结构的物的附近的的水带。另一名头戴白色安全帽的工人正沿一组临时楼梯向下行走，而第四名工人，同样头戴白色安全帽，正站立于较低层面。该环境包含混凝土结构及金属脚手架，并存在各种电缆线与建筑材料。

err.en: a hose near a large cylindrical structur
err.zh: 一根靠近大型圆柱形结构的物的附近的的水带

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is kneeling and examining a document next to some rebars on a red cloth. Surrounding this worker, five individuals with hard hats in various colors are standing and engaged in a discussion, with one of them holding a document. The construction site includes an excavated area with mounds of earth and additional construction materials scattered around.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪着身子查看一份文件，旁边有一些红色布料上的栏杆。围绕这名工人，五名头戴各色安全帽的人正站着并参与一场讨论，其中一人手里拿着一份文件。施工现场包含一片开挖区域，周围堆着泥土和散落的的其他建筑材料。

text: The image shows five workers within a large, dimly lit area with extensive rebar frameworks. The rebar frameworks are arranged in various layers and patterns, suggesting a complex construction design.
zh: 图像显示，在一个大型、昏暗照明区域内，有五个工人处于一个庞大的且复杂的的重力的框架内。该重力的框架以各种层次和模式排列，暗示着复杂的的设计。

text: In the center of the image, a yellow excavator is positioned next to a pile of rocks, with its arm extended towards a red dump truck that is partially loaded with rocks. In the background, a second yellow excavator is visible, working on a separate pile of rocks. The foreground shows a rocky terrain leading up to the excavation area, and beyond the construction activity, a green landscape with trees and a water body can be seen.
zh: 画面中央，一台黄色挖掘机正驶向一堆岩石，其机械臂伸向一辆红色自卸卡车，该卡车已部分装载岩石。背景中，可见另一台黄色挖掘机正在单独处理另一堆岩石。前景显示一片岩石地形，一直延伸到挖掘区域，而在施工活动之外，可以看到一片绿色景观，带有树木和一片水域。

err.en: is positioned next to a pile of rocks

text: The image shows a worker wearing an orange safety vest and a yellow hard hat standing near various construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks. Behind this worker, a multi-story building under construction is visible, with green netting around its exterior and bamboo scaffolding.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿橙色安全背心，头戴黄色安全帽，站在各种建筑材料附近，包括钢筋和木托盘。在这名工人身后，可见一栋在建多层建筑，其内部周围设有绿色防护网和竹脚手架。

text: Aerial view of a construction site with large areas covered by blue tarps. A red and white pile driver is erected near the center, and multiple tower cranes are visible in the distance. An excavator and a bulldozer are operating on the ground, while a concrete pump truck is parked on a dirt road.
zh: 航拍视角下，一处大型在建工地被蓝色防尘网覆盖。中心附近竖立着一座红白相的司机楼，远处可见多座塔吊。一台挖掘机和一台推土机正在地面作业，同时一辆混凝土泵车停靠在一条土路上。

text: The image shows three workers wearing high-visibility vests walking next to a white truck, while another worker is standing by the truck's rear. Various construction materials, including stacks of metal scaffolding, wooden planks, and multiple bundles of construction rods, are organized around the site. A yellow crane is positioned to the left, and a brown truck is visible on the right. The background features a green area that borders the construction site.
zh: 三名身穿高能见度背心的工人正走向一辆白色卡车，另一名工人站在卡车后方。现场周围堆放着各种建筑材料，包括成堆的金属脚手架、木托盘以及多组建筑钢筋。一台黄色起重机位于左侧，右侧可见一辆棕色卡车。背景中有一片绿色区域环绕着施工场地。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers engaged in activities near steel reinforcement bars laid out for a foundation or structure. A crane is operating in the background, and multiple tower cranes are visible in the distance against the backdrop of high-rise buildings. The site is scattered with construction materials, including covered and uncovered piles of rebar, and the ground is uneven with dug-out areas.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事与钢筋铺设相关的的基础或结构的活动。一台起重机在背景中运行，远处可见多台塔式起重机，映衬着高层建筑。现场散落着建筑材料，包括覆盖和未覆盖的钢筋堆，地面平整，带有挖掘区域。

text: Two workers wearing hard hats are engaged with an electrical distribution panel; one is facing the panel, possibly adjusting or inspecting the controls, while the other's head is turned away from the camera. In the background, large concrete pipes are visible, along with a variety of construction materials and equipment, including gloves, a fire extinguisher, and ropes.
zh: 两名工人佩戴安全帽，正在操作一块电气配电盘；其中一人面向配电盘，可能正在调节或检查控制装置，而另一人的头部背对摄像机。背景中可见大型混凝土管道，以及多种建筑材料和设备，包括手套子、灭火器和绳索。

text: Three workers wearing hard hats are engaged in concrete spreading activities within a foundation structure bordered by concrete walls and metal fencing. One worker is operating a bulldozer equipped with a leveling blade to distribute the concrete, while another is guiding the process on foot, and the third is standing by the edge of the structure overseeing the operation. Nearby buildings with yellow doors and windows are visible in the background.
zh: 三名头戴安全帽的工人正在进行混凝土摊铺平作业，该基础结构由混凝土墙体和金属围栏界定。其中一名工人操作一台配备整平刀的头的部的混凝土摊铺平机，另一名工人在脚边引导该流程，第三名工人站在结构边缘监督作业。背景中可见带有黄色门和窗户的建筑物。

err.en: a bulldozer equipped with a leveling bla
err.zh: 一台配备整平刀的头的部的混凝土摊铺平机

text: The worker wearing a dark jacket is standing near various construction materials, including cables and metal elements. A large pile of dirt is in the center, with a wheel loader moving material on top of the pile. Behind the pile, another worker is visible near a light stand.
zh: 一名身穿深色夹克的工人站在各种建筑材料附近，其中包括电缆和金属构件。画面中央有一大堆泥土，一台轮式装载机正将物料搬运至土堆顶部。土堆后方，另一名工人隐约可见，靠近一台电焊机。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is positioned on an elevated dirt platform, with its arm extended towards the ground. To the right, a pile driver stands with its boom extended vertically into the air. The foreground features uneven, excavated earth with some exposed flat metal sheets.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机停放在抬高的土台上，其臂向地面伸出。右侧，一台打桩机竖立着，其桩锤垂直伸向空中。前景呈现平整的、已开挖的泥土，并露出一些平整的金属板。

text: Three workers are in the center of the image, with two carrying a large bag and one guiding a wheelbarrow. They are wearing safety helmets and high-visibility jackets. To the left, an excavator is positioned on a mound of earth.
zh: 画面中央有三名工人，其中两人抬着一个大袋子，另一人扶着一根杆子。他们头戴安全帽，身穿高能见度工作服。左侧有一台挖掘机停在一堆土堆上。

text: The construction site beyond features multiple tower cranes, with at least five visible in the image. An excavator is positioned centrally, and various construction materials, including wood planks and metal structures, are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 该建筑场地具备多塔式起重机特征，图中至少可见五台。一台挖掘机位于场地中央，各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属结构件，散落在整个场地各处。

text: In the foreground, an excavator with its bucket raised is positioned next to a concrete mixer truck with its chute extended towards a foundation area. A worker stands on the foundation, guiding the chute for a concrete pour.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机抬起其铲斗，正驶向一台混凝土搅拌车，该搅拌车正将料斗伸向一个基础区域。一名工人站在基础上，引导料斗进行混凝土浇筑。

text: Eight workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in various activities at a construction site with a focus on reinforcing steel bars and concrete forms. Two workers are handling a long piece of timber, while others are positioned around the steel reinforcement, with one appearing to be tying rebar. Concrete forms are visible, indicating preparation for a pour, and there's a body of water and piles of rocks in the background.
zh: 八名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳的工人正在一处施工现场从事各项作业，现场重点在于钢筋与混凝土模板。其中两名工人正处理一根长木料，另一组人则围绕钢筋进行定位，有一人似乎正在绑扎钢筋。混凝土模板清晰可见，表明正在为浇筑做准备，背景中可见一具水及一堆岩石。

泥泞污，夹杂着红色土壤

err.en: and a body of water with greenery is vis

Surrounding the area, there are multiple vertical and horizontal steel bars, some of which are grouped together, forming part of the construction framework. A blue staircase with railings provides access to the elevated platform, and dense green foliage is visible in the background.

err.en: wearing red overalls and yellow hard hat

text: In the center of the image, a red dump truck is positioned with its bed raised, indicating the unloading of material. To the right, a yellow vibratory soil compactor is actively compacting the soil, evidenced by the dust around its wheels. The background features a partially visible multistory building with red and beige exteriors. Two blue flags are planted in the foreground, and various colored markers are scattered across the site, likely indicating different areas or aspects of the construction project.
zh: 画面中央，一辆红色自卸卡车停在那里，车斗架升起，表明材料尚未卸载。右侧，一台黄色振动压实机正在积极压实土壤，其车轮周围扬起的尘土为证。背景中，一栋部分可见多层建筑，带有红色和米色内饰。前景中，插着两面蓝色旗帜，并且各种彩色标记散布在整个场地上，可能表明施工项目的不同的区域或方面。

text: In the foreground, a large pile of rocks and boulders is present, with a yellow excavator positioned to the right, its arm extended over the pile. Behind the pile, a rocky cliff face serves as the backdrop, with red banners displaying Chinese characters strung across it.

zh: 前景中，一辆压路车停在一处混凝土路面上，紧邻一道设有白色和红色警戒带护栏的弯道。在路面之外，一道蓝色施工围栏由金属支架支撑着该区域。

text: In the foreground, there is a large expanse of uneven terrain with scattered debris and several puddles reflecting sunlight. Toward the center, an excavator is operating adjacent to a pile of earth. On the right, a truck is parked next to another excavator with its bucket raised.
zh: 前景中，有一片地势平坦开阔的地带，散落着碎石瓦砾，几处水洼反射着阳光。中部，一台挖掘机正在一堆泥土堆旁作业。右侧，一辆卡车停靠在另一台挖掘机旁，其挖斗已升起。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a white hard hat and a maroon jacket stands on a concrete slab holding a tool. Behind him, there is a pile of bricks and several stacks of construction materials. Another worker in a yellow hard hat is visible in the background, near a collection of black pipes and yellow machinery.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴白色安全帽，身穿蓝色夹克，站在混凝土板上，手持一件工具。在他身后，有一堆砖块和几堆建筑材料。另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人在背景中可见，靠近一堆黑色管道和黄色机械。

text: The image shows multiple stacks of colorfully wrapped construction materials, possibly steel beams, arranged on the ground, secured with blue and pink tarpaulins. A wheel loader is positioned to the left, near an uncovered dirt area with scattered wooden planks and debris.
zh: 画面中可见多堆色彩鲜艳的、包裹严密的、堆叠整齐的建筑用材，可能为钢梁，放置于地面，用蓝色与粉色防水布加以固定。一台轮式装载机位于左侧，靠近一片未覆盖的泥土地区，散落着木托盘与碎屑。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is tipping over while dumping soil on a raised area of the construction site. The surrounding area consists of uneven terrain with patches of vegetation and some standing water. There are power lines running across the top left corner and a few structures can be seen in the far background.
zh: 图像中央，一台挖掘机正在翻倒，将泥土倾倒在建筑工地的抬升区域上。周围区域由平坦地形组成，夹杂着植被斑块和一些积水。左上角有一条电力线横穿，远处背景中可以看到几处结构。

text: A mobile crane is positioned on a road, partially visible due to the angle of the photograph. The crane is mounted on a yellow truck chassis with multiple axles, indicating heavy-duty capacity. The crane's boom is retracted and resting in a horizontal position atop the vehicle, with its red color contrasting against the truck's yellow. The surrounding area appears to be an overpass or bridge structure, with other vehicles, including a black SUV in the foreground, sharing the road space.
zh: 一辆移动起重机停靠在路边，由于拍摄角度的，仅部分可见。起重机安装在一辆黄色卡车底盘架上，具有多轴，表明其重载能力。起重机的臂被拉出，并水平地停在车辆顶部，其红色与卡车的黄色形成对比。周围区域似乎是一个过路或桥梁结构，与其他车辆共享道路空间，包括前景中一辆黑色SUV。

text: The image shows a blue water truck parked on a dirt road, with a hose connected to the rear, possibly engaged in dust control or delivering water. To the right, two pile drivers are positioned with their booms extended vertically. In the background, additional construction equipment is visible, including a bulldozer and a crane with a red boom. Foreground shows covered construction materials and debris scattered across the site.
zh: 一辆蓝色水罐车停靠在土路上，车尾端连接着一根软管，可能正在进行抑尘作业或供水。右侧，两名桩工正以垂直姿态就位。背景中可见其他施工设备，包括一台推土机和一台吊臂呈红色吊臂的起重机。地面散落着覆盖施工材料和碎屑，遍布整个场地。

Multiple workers wearing safety gear are visible around the excavator, with some on the trench's edge and others at the bottom. Construction debris, including wood planks and concrete blocks, is scattered around the site.

Behind him, two workers are engaged in an activity involving long steel sections near the base of a multi-story steel structure with green netting on the sides. Further back, two more individuals appear to be collaborating on a task.
zh: 前景中，一名工人正在检查或作业于堆放在地面上的的一根钢梁。在他身后，两名工人正从事一项涉及长钢段的活动，该结构位于多层钢结构建筑的基础附近，侧面设有绿色防护网。更远处，另外两名人员似乎正在协作完成一项任务。

err.en: steel beams that are stacked on the grou
err.zh: 堆放在地面上的的一根钢梁

text: The image shows a red truck parked on a dirt surface with its bed raised, suggesting the unloading of materials. Behind the truck, a large construction site is visible, featuring extensive scaffolding that covers a multi-story structure. A tower crane is erected adjacent to the building, with its jib extending across the image. The construction site is enclosed by a temporary barrier with visible signage.
zh: 画面中，一辆红色卡车停放在一片泥土地面上，其货厢处于升起状态，暗示材料尚未卸载。在卡车后方，可见一处大型建筑工地，拥有覆盖多层结构的的大面积脚手架。一台塔式起重机竖立在建筑物旁，其吊臂横跨画面延伸。该建筑工地被一道带有可见标识的临时围挡所围。

text: The image shows a group of workers engaged in activities on a large grid of rebar, with some bending over and others handling materials. In the midground, additional construction is visible with several columns and partially constructed walls.
zh: 画面显示一群工人在大型钢筋网格上进行作业，部分钢筋弯曲，另一些则正在搬运材料。在场地中部，可见额外的施工，带有若干列，以及部分已建成的墙体。

text: Four workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in maintenance or landscaping activities alongside a paved road. They are using tools that appear to be shovels or hoes. In the background, there is a green area with trees and a utility pole, and further back, a city skyline is visible.
zh: 四名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬帽的工人正在铺装路面旁从事维护或园林作业。他们使用的看似是电钻或锤子的。背景中有一片绿树成荫的绿地与公用极，更远处可见城市天际线。

err.en: orange overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬帽

text: In the center of the image, a yellow and black soil compactor is operating on reddish-brown soil with visible tire tracks. Behind the compactor, there is a large mound of similar soil and some greenery.
zh: 画面中央，一名身着黄黑相间服装的演员正在红褐色泥土上作业，其轮胎痕迹清晰可见。演员身后，有一大堆类似的泥土及些许绿色植物。

err.en: a yellow and black soil compactor
err.zh: 一名身着黄黑相间服装的演员

text: Three workers are present in a large space with a grid of rebar laid out on the floor, likely in preparation for a concrete pour. The worker on the left is near a stack of construction materials, while the other two are walking across the rebar grid. The area is covered by a structure with multiple columns and beams, and the background shows an exterior environment with additional construction elements visible.
zh: 三名工人出现在一大空间内，地面铺设着钢筋网架，很可能是在为混凝土浇筑做准备。左侧的工人靠近一堆建筑材料，另外两名工人正穿过钢筋网架。该区域由多根立柱和梁覆盖，背景显示出一个内部环境，可见额外的施工元素。

text: The image shows two tall pile drivers with red booms, a tower crane with a horizontal jib, and various construction vehicles, including a green tank truck and a yellow bulldozer.
zh: 图中显示两堆高耸的红色干料堆，一台带水平臂架的塔式起重机，以及多种施工车辆，包括一辆绿色罐式卡车和一台黄色平地机。

err.en: two tall pile drivers with red booms
err.zh: 两堆高耸的红色干料堆

text: A worker wearing a yellow hard hat and a high-visibility vest is walking across a construction site with extensive rebar frameworks visible, indicating ongoing work on concrete structures. The ground is partially covered with blue tarpaulin, which is torn in places, and there are wooden planks and metal frames scattered around the area.
zh: 一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人正行走在施工现场，现场可见大量钢筋框架，表明混凝土结构施工正在进行中。地面部分被蓝色防水布覆盖，该防水布多处撕裂，周围散落着木托盘和金属框架。

text: Four workers wearing blue uniforms and yellow hard hats are spreading concrete on the ground with rakes and shovels. A concrete delivery hose suspended from above is dispensing concrete onto the surface. The construction area is bordered by wooden planks, and there is a field with crops in the background.
zh: 四名身着蓝色工装服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人分散在地面上，周围有碎石和铁锹。一根混凝土输送软管从上方悬吊着，正将混凝土浇筑到地面上。施工区域由木挡板围护，背景中有一片农田地。

err.en: spreading concrete on the ground with ra
err.zh: 分散在地面上，周围有碎石和铁锹

text: In the foreground, a large, muddy construction area is visible with tire tracks crisscrossing the surface. A single worker is seen in the center, walking across the site. To the left, a soil compactor is parked, while an excavator operates further back.
zh: 前景中可见一大片泥泞污的施工区域，轮胎痕迹横贯整个表面。画面中央可见一名工人正横穿工地。左侧停放着一台土机，而一台挖掘机正在后方作业。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat walking across a construction floor with rebar frameworks laid out. Various construction materials, including wooden planks and additional rebar sections, are scattered around the area. The floor appears to be sectioned off into different areas by the rebar frameworks, suggesting preparation for concrete pouring or other construction activities.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴黄色安全帽，行走在铺设有钢筋框架的楼板上。各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和额外的钢筋段，散落在该区域周围。楼板似乎被钢筋框架分隔成不同区域，暗示为混凝土浇筑或其他其他施工活动做准备。

text: A red concrete pump with an extended boom is positioned to the left of a dirt road leading towards a construction area enclosed by a green fence. The view is from the interior of a vehicle, with the dashboard visible in the foreground. There are electrical poles and lines running parallel to the road, and the sky is clear.
zh: 一辆红色混凝土泵车停靠在一条土路左侧，朝向一个被绿色围栏围起来的、由施工区域。视角来自车辆内部，仪表盘在前景中可见。有电线杆和电线与道路平行延伸，天空晴朗。

err.en: leading towards a construction area encl
err.zh: 朝向一个被绿色围栏围起来的、由施工区域

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete slab partially covered by a white tarp. A stockpile of rebars is visible to the left, and a green mesh fence runs along the perimeter of the site. Behind the fence, a sheet pile wall is installed to retain earth. In the distance, a building with multiple floors can be seen.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，一块大型混凝土板部分被白色土工布覆盖。左侧可见一根钢筋笼，沿场地周边设有绿色网状围栏。围栏后安装有一面挡土墙。远处可见一栋多层建筑。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is positioned with its bucket raised above the ground, while a person stands nearby, observing or directing the work. Behind the excavator, a pile driver is visible, with its tall structure extending upwards. In the background, there are various construction materials stockpiled, including piles of gravel and sand.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机正将铲斗举过头顶于地面之上，而一名人员正站在其附近，观察或指挥着作业。在挖掘机后方，可见一堆驾驶员，其结构向上延伸。在背景中，存在着各种建筑材料堆叠，包括成堆的碎石与沙。

text: A bulldozer is in the center of the image, engaged in earthmoving activities on a construction site with uneven, muddy terrain. Piles of soil and debris, including tree branches and roots, are visible around the bulldozer.
zh: 一台推土机位于画面中央，正在一处地形平坦、泥泞滑的建筑工地上进行土方作业。推土机周围可见成堆的泥土和碎屑，其中包括树枝和树根。

err.zh: 地形平坦、泥泞滑的建筑工地

text: Three individuals are present within a construction site featuring extensive scaffolding. One worker, elevated on the scaffolding, is engaged in an activity, while two others on the ground appear to be observing or discussing. The ground is scattered with construction materials, including sandbags and pipes.
zh: 三名人员位于设有大量脚手架的施工现场内。其中一名工人站在脚手架上，正在进行作业；另外两名人员站在地面上，似乎正在观察或讨论。地面上散落着建筑材料，包括沙袋和管道子。

text: In the foreground, a large concrete pipe is laid across a trench with construction work in progress. An excavator is positioned to the right, with its bucket raised above the trench, possibly engaged in digging or moving materials. Behind the excavator, a bulldozer is visible on a dirt road that runs parallel to the trench.
zh: 前景中，一根大型混凝土管道横跨沟渠铺设，施工工作正在推进。一台挖掘机位于右侧，其铲斗举高于沟渠之上，可能正在进行挖掘或搬运物料。挖掘机后方，一台推土机可见于一条与沟渠平行的的小径的土路上。

err.en: a dirt road that runs parallel to the tr
err.zh: 一条与沟渠平行的的小径的土路上

text: The image shows a worker leveling the ground in a dug-out area with a long-handled tool. Two individuals are standing at the edge of the excavation, with one observing the work and the other giving instructions. A blue truck is partially visible on the left, with an excavator's arm and body visible behind it. The ground is muddy with visible tire tracks, and the excavation shows signs of recent activity with loose soil and uneven surfaces.
zh: 画面中，一名工人正在用长柄工具平整挖方区域的地面。两名人员站在挖掘坑的边缘，其中一人正在观察作业，另一人正在下达指示。左侧部分可见一辆蓝色卡车，其挖掘臂和车身位于其后方。地面泥泞滑，可见轮胎痕迹，且挖掘坑显示出近期活动的迹象，伴有松散土壤和均匀表面。

text: A worker wearing a yellow hard hat is seated and tying rebar at a construction site with exposed steel beams and concrete structures around him. The worker is surrounded by construction materials, including wooden planks, steel rods, and various tools.
zh: 一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正坐在施工现场的钢筋桁架旁，周围环绕着施工材料，包括木方木、钢棒以及各类工具。

err.zh: 坐在施工现场的钢筋桁架旁

err.en: with exposed steel beams and concrete st

text: Five workers wearing orange safety gear are present at a subterranean construction site with extensive rebar installation in progress. The site is surrounded by wooden and metal supports, and the ground is partially concreted, with various construction materials scattered around.
zh: 五名佩戴橙色安全防护装备的工人出现在一处地下施工现场，该处正在进行大规模的钢筋安装作业，施工进展顺利。现场四周被木质及金属支撑物环绕护，地面部分已浇筑混凝土，周边散落着各类建筑材料。

err.en: with extensive rebar installation in pro
err.zh: 该处正在进行大规模的钢筋安装作业，施工进展顺利

text: Two workers wearing yellow hard hats are maneuvering a wheelbarrow through a muddy construction site. One worker is pushing the wheelbarrow, while the other appears to be guiding or pulling it. Scattered around them are several pieces of rebar and hoses, with a large scaffolding structure in the background against an excavated dirt wall.
zh: 两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在泥泞滑的建筑工地上操作一根钢筋。一名工人正在推那根钢筋，而另一名工人似乎正在引导或拉动它。他们周围散落着几段钢筋和软管，背景中矗立着一座大型脚手架，紧贴着一面开挖的土墙。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a grey shirt and dark pants is using a shovel near a Komatsu excavator that is positioned on a mound of dirt. Several large concrete pipes are laid out on the ground, with additional pipes and black corrugated tubes scattered around the area.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿灰色上衣、深色长裤的工人正使用铁锹，靠近一台位于土堆上的、处于土堆上的位置的的大和挖机。地面上铺设着几根大型混凝土管道，周围还散落着额外的管道和黑色波纹管。

err.en: positioned on a mound of dirt
err.zh: 位于土堆上的、处于土堆上的位置的

text: The image shows a construction site with a worker in a yellow hard hat kneeling and working on a foundation with various building materials around, including rebars and wooden planks. To the left, another worker is standing and appears to be handling materials under a blue tarp. In the midground, two workers are engaged in tasks near an area covered with green netting, with one standing and the other bending over. Multiple tower cranes are visible in the background, along with a concrete mixing slide on the left and a partially constructed building with scaffolding.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正跪在基础施工面上作业，周围堆放着各种建筑材料，包括钢筋和木模板。左侧，另一名工人站立着，似乎正在处理一块蓝色防水布下的方的材料。地面中部，两名工人正在从事靠近绿色防护网覆盖区域的任务，其中一人站立，另一人弯腰俯身。背景中可见多座塔吊，左侧有一台混凝土搅拌车，以及一栋部分已建成、带有脚手架的建筑。

text: The image shows an excavator in a rural setting, surrounded by piles of earth. A person stands to the left, facing the excavator, and another individual is visible in the distance to the right. Vegetation is scattered throughout the area, with a patch of cabbages in the foreground and various shrubs and trees around.
zh: 画面显示一台挖掘机位于乡村环境中，周围堆着土堆。一个人站在左侧，面向挖掘机，另一个人影在右侧远处可见。植被散布在整个区域，前景有一块裸露土，周围还有各种灌木丛和树木。

text: In the foreground, an excavator is positioned on an earthen ramp, its bucket raised and appears to be in the process of excavation or loading. A dump truck is parked to the left of the excavator, with its bed raised, suggesting it is either being loaded or has just been unloaded. The terrain is uneven with visible tracks and dug-up soil, indicative of ongoing groundworks.
zh: 前景中，一台挖掘机停在一处土坡道旁，其铲斗已升起，似正在进行挖掘或装载作业。一台自卸卡车停放在挖掘机左侧，其车斗已升起，表明它要么正在装载，要么刚刚完成卸载货。地形平坦，可见车辙与挖出的之土，暗示着持续的地面作业。

text: The image shows a yellow SHANTUI excavator positioned on a mound of earth, with a blue SANY excavator to its left. Both machines appear idle. A third, smaller yellow SANY excavator is visible in the background, also stationary. In the distance, a body of water and a built-up area with multiple buildings can be seen.
zh: 画面中，一台黄色山推土挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其左侧有一台蓝色山推土挖掘机。两台机器均处于闲置置状态。背景中可见第三台较小的黄色山推土挖掘机，同样处于静止状态。远处可见一片水域及一片建有众多建筑物的区域。

err.zh: 较小的黄色山推土挖掘机

text: In the center of the image, two pile drivers are mounted on trucks, positioned side by side, with their booms extended vertically. A green dump truck is parked in front of the pile drivers, while another is located to the right, both appear to be carrying soil. A silver sedan is parked in the foreground.
zh: 画面中央，两辆压路车并排安装在卡车上，呈垂直状态。一辆绿色泵车停在压路车堆的前方，另一辆位于右侧，两者似乎都装载着泥土。一辆银色轿车停在前景。

text: The image shows a construction site with muddy terrain. One person, wearing a white hard hat, stands near the center, facing a large pile of earth. Another person, in dark clothing, walks towards the right where the truck is parked. The third individual, in lighter attire, is positioned to the left, observing the area. The truck is angled away from the viewer, suggesting unloading or preparation to do so.
zh: 图像显示一个泥泞土地质的施工现场。一名头戴白色安全帽的人员站在画面中央附近，面向一大堆泥土。另一名身着深色衣物的人员朝右侧走去，那里停着一辆卡车。第三名身着浅色服装的人员位于左侧，正在观察该区域。卡车背向观众，暗示尚未装载或正在准备作业。

err.en: suggesting unloading or preparation to d
err.zh: 暗示尚未装载或正在准备作业

text: The image shows a group of workers wearing yellow hard hats engaged in construction activities on a site with rocky terrain. Some workers are spreading or compacting material on the ground, which is partially covered with a black sheet.
zh: 图片显示一群头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一处岩石地形的工地上从事建筑活动。一些工人分散或紧凑地堆放着材料，地面部分被一张黑色板材覆盖。

err.zh: 分散或紧凑地堆放着材料

text: In the center of the image, a concrete pump with an extended boom is positioned above a construction site where a large rebar framework is laid out on the ground. Seven workers wearing safety helmets are seen around the rebar framework, with some engaged in tasks related to the construction. In the background, there is a blue fence with signage and scaffolding, indicating an active construction area.
zh: 图像中央，一台混凝土泵上方放置着一个延伸的吊臂，下方是一处施工现场，那里铺设着一个大型钢筋框架。七名头戴安全帽的工人分布在钢筋框架周围，其中一些正从事与施工相关的的工作。背景中，有一道蓝色围栏，上面有标牌和脚手架，表明这是一个正在施工的区域。

err.en: a concrete pump with an extended boom is
err.zh: 一台混凝土泵上方放置着一个延伸的吊臂，下方是一处施工现场

text: The image shows an orange excavator digging operations, with its bucket in the soil. In the midground, two yellow excavators are positioned on mounds of earth. The terrain is uneven and muddy with visible tire tracks, and there are piles of excavated soil throughout the site.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机正在进行挖掘作业，其铲斗位于泥土中。在地面中部，两台黄色挖掘机位于地面边缘。地形平坦且泥泞湿，可见轮胎痕迹，并且整个场地散布着挖掘出的土的堆。

text: A wheel loader is positioned in the foreground, with its bucket resting on the ground. Behind the loader, there is a stack of flat construction materials and a pile of wooden planks. The background features an excavated area with exposed earth.
zh: 轮式装载机位于前景，其料斗放置在地面上。装载机后方有一堆平整的建筑用材和一堆木托盘。背景中有一处开挖区域，露出泥土体。

text: The image shows six workers wearing safety vests and hard hats spread across a large area of rebar framework, part of a foundation or floor under construction. The workers appear to be inspecting or installing the rebar.
zh: 图像显示六名工人身穿安全背心，头戴安全帽，分散在大型钢筋框架内，位于建筑基础或地面施工下方。工人似乎正在检查或安装钢筋。

err.en: part of a foundation or floor under cons
err.zh: 位于建筑基础或地面施工下方

text: The image shows two workers wearing yellow hard hats and gloves tying rebar on a construction site with black waterproofing material on the ground.
zh: 图中显示两名工人头戴黄色安全帽，手戴手套，正在建筑工地上铺设黑色防水材料。

text: Five workers wearing orange overalls and safety helmets are engaged in concrete pouring activities at a construction site. A large hose is being used to pour concrete onto a reinforced floor area. In the background, there is a structure with scaffolding, and in the foreground, construction materials such as wooden planks and steel bars are scattered around the site.
zh: 五名头戴橙色安全帽和安全帽的工人正在建筑工地上进行混凝土浇筑作业。一根大软管正被用来将混凝土浇筑到加固地面区域。背景中可见脚手架结构，前景中诸如木托盘和钢筋等建筑材料散落在工地周围。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and safety helme
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽和安全帽

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a white hard hat and red jacket stands near an excavator, appearing to be inspecting or overseeing work. Another individual is visible in the distance, walking away along the dirt road that cuts through the excavation site. The terrain on either side of the road is uneven and shows signs of extensive digging and earthmoving.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿红色上衣的工人站在挖掘机旁，似乎正在检查或监督作业。远处可见另一人正沿着贯穿工地的土路行走。道路两侧的的地形平坦，显示出大规模挖掘和土方方的迹象。

err.en: The terrain on either side of the road i
err.zh: 道路两侧的的地形平坦

text: An excavator is positioned on a dirt surface with its bucket resting on a mound of soil. Behind the excavator, a white sedan is parked on a flat area with a sloped dirt embankment in the background.
zh: 一台挖掘机停在一处土堆上，其铲斗放置在一堆泥土上。在挖掘机后方，一辆白色轿车停在一处平坦区域，背景中有一处倾斜的泥土质嵌入物。

text: In the foreground, a Komatsu hydraulic excavator is operated by an individual, with its arm extended and bucket resting on the ground. Behind it, another excavator is visible, partially obscured by the first. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and some scattered debris, including a black pipe. Trees and structures can be seen in the distance, suggesting the site is near a developed area.
zh: 前景中，一台小松液压挖掘机由一名个人操作，其臂和斗杆停在地面上。在其后方，另一台挖掘机可见，部分被第一台遮挡。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹和一些散落的杂物，包括一根黑色管道。树木和结构可见于远处，暗示该场地靠近一个已开发区域。

text: In the foreground, a concrete structure with steel scaffolding is under construction, with wooden planks and steel rods on the surface. Five workers, wearing safety helmets, are engaged in various tasks on and around the structure.
zh: 前景中，一栋混凝土建筑正在施工，其表面铺设着木质跳板和钢杆。五名工人，佩戴安全帽，正从事着各种任务。

text: The worker wearing a blue shirt, safety vest, and yellow hard hat is handling yellow construction tubes, with several piles of wooden planks surrounding the area. To the left, there is a trench with metal framing and more construction materials are visible throughout the site. In the background, additional construction work is taking place with visible scaffolding and partially constructed structures.
zh: 穿蓝色衬衫、安全背心和黄色安全帽的工人正在处理黄色管材，周围堆放着几堆木托盘。左侧有一条带金属框架的沟槽，整个工地现场可见更多建筑材料。背景中，其他施工作业正在进行进行，可见脚手架和部分已建成的结构。

text: The worker next to the truck is not wearing a hard hat.

text: The image shows two dump trucks, one stationary and one in motion, with a bulldozer actively engaged in earthmoving activities between them. zh: 画面中有两辆自卸卡车，一辆静止，另一辆正在行驶，其间有一台推土机正在进行土方作业。一台履带起重机位于两车之间，其吊臂向上伸展。背景中似乎正在进行施工，可见各种结构和起重机。

text: In the center of the image, two workers wearing high-visibility vests are carrying a large blue tarpaulin across a concrete floor. Various construction materials, including bundles of rebar and wooden planks, are organized throughout the site.
zh: 画面中央，两名身穿高能见度背心的的工人正搬运着一大块大型蓝色防水布，横跨混凝土地面。右侧，一栋多层建筑正在施工中，周围环绕着绿色脚手架。各种建筑材料，包括成束的钢筋和木托盘，遍布整个工地现场。

err.zh: 两名身穿高能见度背心的的工人

text: A yellow wheel loader is positioned in the center of the frame on a concrete surface, with its bucket resting on the ground.
