A pile driver with its boom raised is visible to the left, and a worker is engaged in an activity near some bags on the ground. Various construction materials, including metal plates and pipes, are scattered throughout the site.
zh: 一台挖掘机停放在抬高的土台上，其臂伸向地面。左侧可见一堆带有爆炸声的司机，一名工人正在地面上的一些袋子附近从事活动。各种建筑材料，包括金属板和管道，散落在整个工地现场。

err.en: A pile driver with its boom raised
err.zh: 一堆带有爆炸声的司机

text: A paved road runs parallel to a line of trees on the right, with a yellow excavator positioned on the left side, near a pile of sand. Two wheelbarrows are in the foreground, one of which is being pushed by an individual.
zh: 一条铺装好的的人行道与右侧的一排树木平行延伸，左侧有一台黄色挖掘机，靠近一堆沙。前景中有两排轮式压路机，其中一台正被一个人推动。

text: Two workers wearing hard hats are present on a concrete surface, one standing and the other sitting, with a wheelbarrow nearby. In the background, a green mesh fence partially encloses the area, and beyond the fence, there are blurred structures and trees.
zh: 两名头戴安全帽的工人出现在混凝土表面上，一人站立，另一人坐着，旁边有一根钢筋。背景中，绿色网状围栏部分遮挡了该区域，围栏外可见模糊化的结构与树木。

text: A concrete mixer truck is positioned near an area with reinforced steel bars, where foundational work appears to be in progress. The chute of the mixer is extended towards a network of rebar, suggesting that concrete is being poured to form a structure.
zh: 混凝土搅拌车停靠在有钢筋的区域附近，基础工作似乎正在推进。搅拌车的料斗朝向钢筋网络延伸，暗示混凝土正在浇筑以形成结构。

text: An excavator bucket is filled with mud at the edge of a water-filled excavation site. Vegetation is visible around the area, and the ground appears wet and muddy, indicating recent digging or waterlogging.
zh: 挖掘机斗坑内积满泥浆水，位于水淹没的开挖场地边缘。植被在周边可见，且地面显得潮湿而泥泞滑，表明近期有挖掘或排水作业。

err.en: An excavator bucket is filled with mud
err.zh: 挖掘机斗坑内积满泥浆水

text: The image shows two workers standing near a truck and an excavator, with another excavator operating to the right. Three trucks are parked in the background, with two having their beds tilted to unload material. The ground is uneven and littered with debris, and there are puddles of water scattered throughout the site.
zh: 画面中有两名工人站在一辆卡车和一台挖掘机旁，右侧还有另一台挖掘机正在作业。背景中停放着三辆卡车，其中两辆的货厢倾斜着以卸载物料。地面平整且散落着碎屑，整个场地散布着水洼。

text: The image shows a concrete pump truck parked on a muddy surface with its boom retracted and resting on the truck. Behind it, large coils of rebar are visible, resting on and beside a rusted metal stand. A tower crane is operating in the midground, with its jib extended towards the top right corner of the image. The construction site appears active, with various materials and equipment scattered around, and the background features a partially obscured multistory building.
zh: 一辆混凝土泵车停放在泥泞地上，其软管被抽出并搭在卡车上。在它后面，大型钢筋线圈可见，搭着并靠在一个生锈迹金属支架旁。一台塔式起重机在中间地面上运行着，其吊臂伸向图像的右上角。建筑工地似乎活跃着，各种材料和设备散落在周围，背景特征是一栋部分被遮挡的多层建筑。

err.en: with its boom retracted and resting on t
err.zh: 其软管被抽出并搭在卡车上

text: The image shows a large reinforced steel mat with several vertical rebar supports in place. Three workers wearing orange safety vests and helmets are working on the rebar structure, with one standing on the mat and two others bending rebar over it. A concrete pump with a red boom extends into the frame from the top, suggesting ongoing concrete pouring activities.
zh: 图像显示一块大型钢筋垫，上面有几根垂直的钢筋支撑。三名穿着橙色安全背心和头盔的工人在钢筋结构上工作，其中一人站在垫上，另外两人将钢筋弯曲覆盖在上面。一台混凝土泵，带有红色喇叭，从顶部延伸到框架内，暗示着持续的混凝土浇筑活动。

text: In the center of the image, a red dump truck is parked on a dirt road with piles of soil on either side. Debris and rubble are scattered in the foreground. In the background, multistory buildings in various stages of construction can be seen, with an orange excavator visible to the right.
zh: 画面中央，一辆红色自卸卡车停靠在一条土路上，两侧堆着土堆。前景散落着树枝和碎石。背景中，可以看到多栋处于不同施工阶段的历史建筑，右侧可见一台橙色挖掘机。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is operating on a mound of dirt within an excavation area. To the left, a blue vertical structure, possibly a silo or tank, stands adjacent to a crane tower. Various lengths of pipes are visible in the background, and the ground is muddy with tire tracks and scattered wooden planks.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机正在一处土堆上作业，位于一个开挖区域内。左侧，一个蓝色竖直结构，可能是一台绞车或储罐，矗立在一座起重机塔旁边。背景中可见多根管道，地面泥泞污，带有轮胎印迹和散落的着的木块。

err.zh: 可能是一台绞车或储罐

err.en: muddy with tire tracks and scattered woo
err.zh: 泥泞污，带有轮胎印迹和散落的着的木块

text: Five workers wearing hard hats are installing rebar on a large grid at a construction site. One worker in orange overalls is positioned on the left side, while the others in blue overalls are spread across the grid.
zh: 五名头戴安全帽的工人在大型建筑工地的大型网格上安装栏杆。其中一名穿橙色上衣的工人位于网格左侧，而另外四名穿蓝色上衣的工人则分散在网格各处。

text: In the foreground, a yellow mobile crane with the branding "XCMG" is visible, its boom extended horizontally across the frame. A tree is supported by wooden stakes directly in front of the crane. Behind the crane, a construction site with green scaffolding and an unfinished building is apparent. A tower crane stands in the background, and a blue construction site fence is noticeable.
zh: 前景中，一台黄色移动起重机上可见“XCMG”品牌标识，其吊臂横向横跨画面延伸。一台树木由木桩直接支撑在起重机前方。起重机后方，一处带有绿色脚手架的施工现场以及一栋已完工建筑清晰可见。一台塔式起重机矗立在背景中，一道蓝色施工围栏清晰可辨。

text: A cement mixer truck is parked on a dirt road with piles of red-brown earth on either side. In the foreground, broken bricks and debris line the edge of the road, and a metal barrier runs parallel to the road. The background features greenery and construction structures, with no visible workers or other equipment in the immediate vicinity.
zh: 一辆水泥搅拌车停靠在一条土路上，道路两侧堆放着红褐色的土堆。前景中，破碎的砖块和碎屑沿着路边排列，一道金属护栏与道路平行延伸。背景中可见绿植丛和施工构造，但附近没有可见工人或其他其他设备。

text: A worker in the middle is wearing a pair of shorts.
zh: 一名工人正中间戴着一副短筒。

text: A worker in the middle is wearing a pair of shorts.
zh: 一名工人正中间戴着一副短筒。

text: In the foreground, a concrete foundation with protruding rebar is visible, alongside wooden planks and formwork used to shape the concrete. A Volvo mini excavator is positioned to the left, engaged in digging or grading work near an excavated area.
zh: 前景中，可见一块带有外露钢筋的混凝土基础，旁边是木模板，用于成型混凝土。一台沃尔沃小型挖掘机位于左侧，正在挖掘或修整平作业区附近进行挖掘或整平作业。

err.en: engaged in digging or grading work near
err.zh: 正在挖掘或修整平作业区附近进行挖掘或整平作业

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is positioned within a large excavation area with mounds of earth around it. Two workers, one wearing a red hard hat and the other in a green jacket, are standing at the edge of a water-filled trench, with one holding a measuring tape.
zh: 图像中央，一台挖掘机停放在一片大型开挖区域内，周围环绕着土堆。两名工人，一人戴着红色安全帽，另一人穿着绿色夹克，正站在一条注满水的的水的水沟的边缘，其中一人手持卷尺。

text: Eight workers wearing orange overalls and yellow hard hats are spread across a large concrete slab, with some attending to the surface and others walking across it. Along the edges of the slab, reinforcement bars are partially assembled into frameworks. A temporary retaining wall supports the excavated earth on both sides of the slab, and in the distance, industrial structures are visible beyond the construction site.
zh: 八名工人头戴橙色安全帽，脚穿黄色硬帽，分散在一块大型混凝土板上，部分人照料表面，另一些人则横穿其上。沿板边缘，钢筋条部分组装成框架。临时挡土墙支撑着两侧开挖的土方，而在远处，工业结构清晰可见于施工场地之外。

err.en: wearing orange overalls and yellow hard
err.zh: 头戴橙色安全帽，脚穿黄色硬帽

text: In the foreground, two dump trucks are positioned on an uneven dirt surface, one of which is being loaded by an excavator. The excavator, situated on a mound of earth, is in the process of transferring soil into the bed of the nearest truck.
zh: 前景中，两辆自卸卡车停放在一片平整的泥土地面上，其中一辆正被一台挖掘机装载。该挖掘机位于一堆土丘上，正处于将泥土转移至最近一辆卡车的货厢内。

text: Two workers are present inside a building under construction with exposed concrete columns and floors. One worker is using a shovel to move debris, while another worker is standing and observing or waiting. There is a pile of wood planks on the right side of the floor, and the area is lit by natural light coming through the windows.
zh: 两名工人身处一栋在建建筑内部，现场有外露的混凝土立柱和楼板。一名工人正用铁锹搬运碎屑，另一名工人则站立着，正在观察或等待。地板右侧有一堆木托盘，该区域由透过窗户射入的自然光照而照亮。

text: A mobile crane is positioned in the foreground with its stabilizing outriggers extended and a red telescopic boom partially visible. The crane is on a dirt surface with visible tire tracks, and there are mounds of excavated earth in the background.
zh: 前景处有一台移动式起重机，其稳定支腿已伸出，一台红色塔式起重机部分可见。起重机位于一片泥土地面上，可见轮胎轨迹，背景中有挖掘出的泥土堆。

text: Two dump trucks are positioned on a dirt road with their beds facing opposite directions; one appears to be unloading soil. A worker in dark clothing stands near the rear of one truck, seemingly overseeing the process. In the background, several large concrete pipes are stacked, and a group of individuals is gathered around construction machinery. The backdrop features a row of multi-story residential buildings.
zh: 两辆自卸卡车停在土路上，车斗朝向相反方向；其中一辆似乎未装载泥土料。一名身穿深色衣物的工人站在其中一辆卡车后部附近，似在监督作业过程。背景中堆叠着若干根大型混凝土管道，并且一群人员聚集在施工机械周围。远景处是一排多层住宅建筑。

err.en: one appears to be unloading soil
err.zh: 其中一辆似乎未装载泥土料

text: The image shows a dense network of scaffolding in the center, surrounded by construction materials, including wood planks and metal rods. A yellow tower crane stands to the right, and the perimeter is lined with green safety netting. Multiple workers are scattered throughout the site, engaged in different tasks related to construction.
zh: 图像显示中心处有一个密集的脚手架网络，周围环绕着建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属杆。右侧立着一台黄色塔式起重机，周边则铺设着绿色安全防护网。多名工人散布在整个工地现场，正从事与施工相关的的不同任务。

text: Inside a large building under construction with exposed steel beams and columns, a worker wearing a red hard hat and white shirt is operating a piece of machinery. Bundles of red pipes are laid out on the floor, and various construction materials and tools are scattered around the area. Red fire sprinkler pipes are installed overhead, and scaffolding is visible in the background, indicating ongoing work.
zh: 在一栋大型在建建筑内部，裸露着钢梁和立柱，一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿白色衬衫的工人正在操作一台机械设备。地面上铺设着成束红色管道，周围散落着各种建筑材料和工具。头顶棚上安装着红色消防喷淋管，背景中可见脚手架，表明施工正在进行持续进行。

err.zh: 表明施工正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows multiple workers wearing hard hats, with some walking towards the right and others engaged in activities near the materials. Two tower cranes dominate the skyline, one of which is actively hoisting a load. In the background, a multi-story structure with scaffolding is visible, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 画面中有多名工人头戴安全帽，部分人正向右行走，另一些人则在材料附近从事作业。天际线上有两座塔吊起重机占据主导地位，其中一台正在吊装运货物。背景中可见一栋多层建筑搭设着脚手架，表明施工工作正在进行持续进行。

err.zh: 表明施工工作正在进行持续进行

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat, blue raincoat, and boots is using a shovel inside the bucket of a dump truck filled with wet concrete. Behind the dump truck, a construction vehicle is partially visible. The background features a rocky terrain with some vegetation.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿蓝色雨衣、脚蹬靴子的的工作人员，正使用铁锹，将湿混凝土装入一辆自卸车的的料斗中。自卸车后方，一辆施工车辆部分可见。背景为带有部分植被的岩石地形。

err.en: inside the bucket of a dump truck filled
err.zh: 将湿混凝土装入一辆自卸车的的料斗中

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers: one operating an excavator, another observing, and the third working on rebar reinforcement for a foundation or wall structure. The worker operating the excavator is wearing a red hard hat, while the other two are wearing yellow hard hats. Construction tools and materials are scattered around the site, including shovels and water bottles.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人：一人操作挖掘机，另一人正在观察，第三人在基础或墙体体的进行钢筋加固作业。操作挖掘机的的人戴着红色安全帽，另外两人戴着黄色安全帽。施工工具和材料散落在工地周围，包括铁锹和水杯。

err.en: for a foundation or wall structure
err.zh: 基础或墙体体的进行钢筋加固作业

text: An excavator is positioned next to a dump truck, both situated on a pile of debris or excavated material. The scene is illuminated by artificial lighting, highlighting the equipment and the surrounding area, which appears to be a large excavation site or a quarry.
zh: 一台挖掘机停在一辆自卸卡车旁，两者均位于一堆碎石或已开挖的物料之上。现场由人工照明照亮，突显出设备及周边区域，该区域看似一处大型采石场或采石场。

err.en: a large excavation site or a quarry
err.zh: 一处大型采石场或采石场

text: Five workers are engaged in concrete pouring activities at a construction site. They are standing on a rebar grid foundation, with one worker handling the concrete hose to distribute the mix. A vertical concrete structure with additional rebar reinforcement is visible to their left, and a sloped earth embankment is seen in the background.
zh: 五名工人正在建筑工地上进行混凝土浇筑作业。他们站在钢筋网格基础上，其中一名工人手持混凝土软管以分配混合料。其左侧可见竖向混凝土结构内附加的钢筋加固，背景中可见一处倾斜的土方体嵌入物。

err.zh: 一处倾斜的土方体嵌入物

text: A rear view of a raised dump truck bed is centered in the image, with a dirt-covered surface visible beneath it. To the right, partially visible vehicles include a white car and a black vehicle with an open door.
zh: 画面中央是一辆高栏式自卸卡车的后视图，其下方可见被泥土覆盖的表面。右侧部分可见车辆包括一辆白色汽车和一辆车门敞开的着的门的黑色车辆。

err.en: a black vehicle with an open door
err.zh: 一辆车门敞开的着的门的黑色车辆

text: In the foreground, a teal-colored excavator is operating, with its arm extended and bucket in the dirt, creating a dust cloud as it works. Behind it, a pile driver with a tall mast is visible. The ground appears muddy with tire tracks, and a piece of bent metal sheeting is lying in the immediate vicinity of the excavator.
zh: 前景中，一台青绿色的挖掘机正在作业，其臂架和铲斗伸入泥土中，作业时扬起一片尘云。在其后方，可见一堆驾驶员带高桅杆。地面显得泥泞滑，带有轮胎痕迹，并且一块弯曲的金属板平铺在挖掘机近旁。

err.en: a pile driver with a tall mast

text: In the center of the image, a dirt road is flanked by construction vehicles, including a roller on the left and a dump truck on the right. Two individuals are walking along the road, one near the roller and the other closer to the dump truck.
zh: 画面中央，一条土路被施工车辆所夹持，左侧有一台压路机，右侧有一辆泵送卡车。两人正沿着道路行走，其中一人靠近压路机，另一人则更靠近泵送卡车。

text: The image shows a large red concrete pump with its boom extended, with a construction worker in blue attire standing near its base. Behind the pump, a tower crane is erected amidst a structure covered in green safety netting, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 图中展示了一台大型红色混凝土泵，其泵体呈扩张状态，一名身着蓝色工作服的建筑工人站在泵体附近。在泵体后方，一台塔式起重机正在绿色安全防护网覆盖下的搭建，表明施工工作正在进行进行中。

err.zh: 施工工作正在进行进行中

text: Three workers wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats are present at a construction site with one operating an excavator digging into the earth, another observing the operation, and the third standing near a warning sign, possibly supervising or preparing for another task.
zh: 三名头戴红色安全帽、身穿黄色硬帽的工人出现在一处施工现场，其中一人正在操作挖掘机向地面挖掘，另一人正在观察该作业，第三人则站在一处警示标志牌附近，可能正在监督或为另一项任务做准备。

err.en: red overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 红色安全帽、身穿黄色硬帽

text: Three dump trucks are aligned on a dirt road. The terrain is uneven and there are large areas of exposed soil. In the background, there is a green field and a large building with a dark facade.
zh: 三辆自卸卡车停靠在一条土路上。地形平坦，有大片裸露出的土的区域。背景中有一片绿色田野和一座深色外墙面的大型建筑。

text: Three workers are present at a construction site with one arranging bricks or blocks in a line, another pushing a wheelbarrow, and the third appears to be walking across the site. A pile of bricks, some construction tools, and a mound of soil are visible. The site is bordered by a large concrete structure, possibly a bridge or overpass, with the ground beneath showing signs of excavation or grading.
zh: 三名工人出现在一处建筑工地上，其中一人正在码放砖块或砌砌砖块，另一人正在推动一辆手推车，第三人似乎正步行穿过工地现场。现场可见一堆砖块、一些建筑工具以及一堆泥土堆。该场地被一道大型混凝土结构物包围，可能是一座桥梁或高架桥，其下方地面显示出挖掘或分级迹象象。

err.en: arranging bricks or blocks in a line

text: Three workers are engaged in manual labor at a construction excavation site, with two of them using shovels to move earth. An excavator is positioned to their left, its bucket raised above the ground. The workers are wearing safety helmets, and one of them is in an orange suit. Behind them, there are wooden planks and construction debris scattered around the area.
zh: 三名工人正在一处建筑挖掘工地进行体力劳动，其中两人使用铁锹搬运泥土。一台挖掘机位于他们左侧，其铲斗举过地面。工人佩戴安全帽，其中一人穿着橙色工作服。在他们身后，有木托盘和建筑废料散落在周围区域。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a high-visibility vest and a hard hat is walking across a construction area with various wooden planks and black construction materials spread out on the ground. Behind the worker, there is a section with scaffolding and construction barriers, indicating an area with ongoing work.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿高能见度反光背心、头戴安全帽的工人正行走在施工区域，地面上散落着各种木托盘和黑色建筑材料。工人身后，可见一处设有脚手架和施工围挡，表明该区域正在进行持续作业。

text: A dump truck is tilted to unload a pile of rocks onto the ground, with its bed raised at an angle. The pile of rocks is large, consisting of various sizes, and spreads from the back of the truck onto the ground.
zh: 一辆自卸车倾斜着，将其一堆积石倾倒在车斗底下，车斗底面抬升成一个角度。这堆石头很大，由各种尺寸组成，从车斗后部倾倒在车斗底下。

text: Three workers wearing yellow hard hats are on a site with a large grid of rebar laid out, preparing for concrete placement. One worker is walking along the rebar grid, another is bending over possibly tying rebar, and the third is operating a yellow machine. Various construction materials, such as white pipes and wooden planks, are scattered across the site. The edge of a concrete structure is visible in the foreground.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一处铺设大型钢筋网的片的区的作业，为混凝土浇筑做准备。一名工人正沿着钢筋网行走，另一名工人正弯腰可能正在绑扎钢筋，第三名工人则在操作一台黄色机械。各类建筑材料，如白色管材和木托盘，散落在工地各处。前景中可见一处混凝土结构的边缘。

err.en: on a site with a large grid of rebar lai
err.zh: 正在一处铺设大型钢筋网的片的区的作业

text: Five workers wearing yellow hard hats are engaged in concrete work at a construction site, with one individual leveling the concrete while the others are spreading it. The site features wooden formwork and rebar reinforcement in place, and the surrounding area includes a body of water and vegetation.
zh: 五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在一处建筑工地进行混凝土作业，其中一人正在对混凝土进行振捣，其余人则分散作业。现场设有木质模板和钢筋加固，周边区域包含水体和植被。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a hard hat and camouflage clothing standing on a large concrete pipe, with an excavator bucket positioned above and to the left of the pipe.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴安全帽，身穿迷彩服，站在大型混凝土管道上，其上方偏左位置有一台挖掘机。

text: Two workers are visible on a scaffolding structure against a concrete building; one is in the center wearing a red hard hat and handling a red flag, while the other is on the right, partially obscured. The scaffolding is made of yellow poles and there are white insulation panels on the building's exterior.
zh: 两名工人出现在混凝土建筑旁的的一处脚手架结构上；其中一人位于中央，头戴红色安全帽，手持一面红色旗帜，而另一人位于右侧，部分被遮挡。该脚手架由黄色杆件构成，建筑内部可见白色绝缘板。

text: In the foreground, a wheel loader is carrying a load of dirt, with its bucket raised, moving from left to right. The ground is muddy with visible tire tracks. Further back, two other pieces of heavy machinery are operating: another wheel loader and a compactor, both facing away from the viewpoint.
zh: 前景中，一台轮式装载机正载着一斗土，其铲斗由左向右移动。地面泥泞湿，可见轮胎印痕。更远处，另外两台重型机械正在作业：另一台轮式装载机及一名操作人员，二者均背向远离视点。

text: The construction site features a deep trench lined with retaining walls on either side, and a large building under construction is visible in the distance. Materials and tools are scattered throughout the site, indicating ongoing work.
zh: 施工现场设有一条深沟，两侧均设有挡土墙，远处可见一栋在建的大型建筑。材料、机具具有分散于整个场地，表明施工正在进行。

err.en: Materials and tools are scattered throug
err.zh: 材料、机具具有分散于整个场地

text: Eight workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in various activities along a trench at a construction site. Two workers are on the left side, one standing on the ground and the other on a temporary wooden platform, while six are within the trench itself, handling construction materials and working on the reinforcement bars.
zh: 八名头戴橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人正在一处建筑工地的沟槽内从事各项作业。其中两名工人位于左侧，一人站在地面上，另一人站在临时木质平台上，其余六人则在沟槽内部处理建筑材料并从事钢筋作业。

err.en: orange overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: In the foreground, a mobile crane is parked on a dirt surface with its outriggers extended, and a worker in an orange jacket is visible beneath the crane, possibly performing maintenance or inspection. Behind the crane, an excavator with a blue arm is positioned, appearing to be in operation or ready for use.
zh: 前景中，一台移动式起重机停放在泥土地面上，其吊臂已伸出，起重机下方可见一名身穿橙色夹克的工人，可能正在进行维护或检查。起重机后方，一台挖掘机伸出蓝色吊臂，处于作业状态或待命状态。

text: Aerial view of a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom over a foundation with several compartments. There are six workers dispersed around the site, some interacting with the pump truck hose. The ground is marked with grid lines, and there is a small structure or pit at the bottom center.
zh: 航拍视角显示一处混凝土施工现场，一辆混凝土泵车将其料斗篷覆盖在一处带有多个隔舱的基础之上。现场周围分布着六名工人，部分工人与泵车软管进行互动。地面标有网格线，且底部中心处有一个小型结构或坑洞。

err.en: extending its boom over a foundation
err.zh: 将其料斗篷覆盖在一处带有多个隔舱的基础之上

In the foreground, there is a pile of bricks and debris, and in the background, a body of water and vegetation can be seen, along with a modern building.

The background features a hazy skyline with indistinct buildings, and there are no visible workers in the immediate area.

orange overalls and yellow hard hats

text: The image shows a construction site with approximately nine workers engaged in various activities on a construction site with a large steel structure overhead. Some workers are on the ground level, while others are elevated on the formwork and scaffolding. The site is cluttered with construction materials, including wooden planks, metal rods, and formwork panels.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，约有九名工人在大型钢结构顶棚下从事各种作业。部分工人位于地面层，而另一些工人则在高处作业及脚手架上。现场杂乱地堆放着建筑材料，包括木托盘、金属杆及模板面板板。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers scattered across the area; a few are walking while others appear to be engaged in various tasks. A large yellow crane stands on the right, and multiple bundles of construction materials, such as wooden planks and rebars, are placed around the site. Concrete structures at various stages of completion can be seen throughout the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，多名工人散布在区域内；几名正在行走，而另一些人似乎正从事各种任务。一台大型黄色起重机矗立在右侧，并且多捆绑的建筑材料，诸如木板和钢筋，被放置在工地周围。不同完成阶段的的具体结构可见于整个图像中。

text: The three workers on the left are wearing shorts, slippers, not wearing clothes properly, and not wearing hard hats.
zh: 左侧的三名工人穿着短裤，戴着护目镜，未正确穿戴衣物，也未佩戴安全帽。

text: Three workers are present in the foreground, one of whom is pushing a wheelbarrow. A concrete mixer truck is positioned behind them, with its drum facing the camera. To the right, a concrete pump truck with its boom extended horizontally is visible.
zh: 前景中有三名工人，其中一人正在推一辆手推车。他们身后停着一辆混凝土搅拌车，其搅拌鼓正对着镜头。右侧，一辆混凝土泵车水平可见，其搅拌鼓延伸开来。

text: Eleven workers wearing hard hats and safety vests are engaged in activities on a rebar framework, with one bending over and another appearing to be instructing or communicating with colleagues. The background features a soil embankment with exposed reinforcement bars, and the overall setting suggests preparation for a concrete pour or similar construction phase.
zh: 七名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在钢筋框架上进行作业，其中一人正弯腰，另一人似乎正在向同事进行指导或交流。背景中可见带有外露出钢筋的土体嵌件，整体环境表明正处于混凝土浇筑或类似施工阶段。

text: In the foreground, a person stands observing the site, with a dump truck tilted to unload its contents to the right. Multiple construction vehicles, including bulldozers and excavators, are scattered across the site, some appearing to be in operation while others are stationary. Large blue pipes are visible on the ground, and in the background, two high-rise buildings under construction are flanked by tower cranes.
zh: 前景中，一人站立观察工地，一辆自卸卡车向右倾斜以卸载其内容。多台施工车辆，包括推土机和挖掘机，散布于工地各处，一些看似正在作业，另一些则处于静止状态。地面上可见大型蓝色管道，背景中，两栋在建的高层建筑被塔吊臂架起。

text: The image shows a Hyundai excavator operated by a person engaged in digging activities at a construction site. Behind the excavator, there are piles of dirt and construction materials, including what appears to be white packaged goods, possibly construction supplies.
zh: 图中显示一台由人员操作的挖掘机，正在进行一处建筑工地的挖掘作业。在挖掘机后方，有土堆和建筑材料，包括看似黑色包装货物，可能是建筑物资。

text: In the foreground, a green dump truck is loaded with dirt, positioned on a muddy surface. Behind it, a worker is walking towards a yellow soil compactor that is in operation.
zh: 前景中，一辆绿色自卸卡车装载着泥土，停在一处泥泞地表面上。在它后方，一名工人正走向一台处于运行状态的下的黄色土压裂器。

text: The construction worker wearing a pink shirt and white hard hat is standing next to a pile of wooden planks and three concrete cylinders. Surrounding this area are various construction materials, including stacks of wooden planks, metal scaffolding, and blue tarps.
zh: 一名身穿粉色上衣、头戴白色安全帽的建筑工人，正站在一堆木托盘和三个混凝土圆柱体旁。该区域周围堆放着各种建筑材料，包括成摞的木托盘、金属脚手架以及蓝色图纸纸。

text: Three workers wearing red hard hats are engaged in activities around a concrete well ring on a dirt surface. One worker is operating a handheld auger, another is holding the auger steady, and the third is manipulating a hose or cable. The background includes a perimeter fence and excavated earth.
zh: 三名头戴红色安全帽的工人正在混凝土井环周围的进行作业。一名工人正在操作手持打磨机，另一名工人稳稳地握着打磨机，第三名工人正在操作软管或电缆。背景中包括周边围栏和挖掘出的泥土。

text: Two workers wearing hard hats are operating machinery inside an industrial facility. The worker on the left, wearing a yellow hard hat, is adjusting a large hopper that is dispensing material into a mold or formwork. The worker on the right, in a blue hard hat, is overseeing the process and holding a long tool, possibly for guiding or leveling the material.
zh: 两名头戴安全帽的工人正在工业厂房内操作机械。左侧头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在将材料调整至大型旋转器中，该旋转器用于将材料分散至模具或成型作业。右侧头戴蓝色安全帽的工人正在监督生产过程，并手持一件长工具，可能用于引导或找平材料。

err.en: adjusting a large hopper that is dispens
err.zh: 正在将材料调整至大型旋转器中，该旋转器用于将材料分散至模具或成型作业

text: Two excavators are positioned on an elevated dirt area with their booms extended towards the ground. Four individuals are seated together on the edge of the excavation area, facing a body of water.
zh: 两名挖掘机手将铲斗伸向地面，位于一个抬高的土地区域。四个人一起坐在挖掘区域的边缘，面对一个水体。

text: In the center of the image, a bulldozer is engaged in earthmoving activities, with a pile of uprooted trees and debris in front of it. To the left, a person is sitting on the ground observing the work. The background features a rural landscape with buildings, trees, and a clear sky.
zh: 画面中央，一台推土机正在进行土方作业，其前方堆放着一堆连根带和碎石。左侧，一人坐在地上观察着作业。背景呈现乡村景色，有房屋、树木和晴朗的天空。

err.en: a pile of uprooted trees and debris

text: The image shows a yellow telescopic boom lift positioned near a steel structure under construction, with several vertical and horizontal steel beams visible. The steel framework appears to be part of a larger complex, as additional similar structures can be seen in the background.
zh: 图像显示，一台黄色塔式起重机位于正在施工中的钢结构附近，可见多根垂直和水平钢梁。该钢框架似乎是更大、更复杂结构的一部分，背景中可以看到更多类似结构。

text: The image shows a group of five workers gathered, with one operating a surveying equipment and others standing or walking nearby. A mobile crane with an extended boom is positioned to the left, while an orange excavator is situated to the right, with its arm and bucket resting on the ground. The construction site appears to be in the early stages of development, with cleared land and piles of earth visible.
zh: 画面显示五名工人聚集在一起，其中一人操作着测量设备，另一人站立或行走在附近。一台移动式起重机位于左侧，而一台橙色挖掘机位于右侧，其吊臂和铲斗停放在地面上。该建筑工地似乎处于开发初期阶段，有着裸露的土地和可见土堆。

err.zh: 另一人站立或行走在附近

text: In the foreground, a wheel loader and a bulldozer are positioned on either side of an excavator, which is centered in the image. A group of workers is gathered near the excavator, engaged in activity that is not distinctly visible. The background features an industrial setting with structures and what appears to be a power plant with multiple chimneys.
zh: 前景中，一台轮式装载机和一台铣刨机分别位于一台挖掘机的两侧，该挖掘机位于画面中央。一组工人聚集在挖掘机附近，从事的活动并不清晰可见。背景呈现工业场景，具有结构和看似一座拥有多个烟囱的发电厂。

text: In the foreground, a worker in a high-visibility vest operates a bulldozer on a surface covered with blue tarp, while another worker stands nearby. A multi-story concrete building structure with marked floors is central in the image, with scaffolding erected around a section of the first floor.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿高能见度背心的的工人正在操作一台路面铣刨机，该机器覆盖着蓝色防水布，另一名工人站在附近。画面中央是一栋多层混凝土建筑，其首层楼板上标有标记，周围搭设有脚手架。

err.en: a surface covered with blue tarp
err.zh: 该机器覆盖着蓝色防水布

text: Five workers wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in activities along a large, reinforced concrete foundation with vertical rebar walls. Two workers are on the left side of the foundation, one is walking, and the other is adjusting or inspecting the rebar. Three workers are on the right side, with one standing on the foundation floor and two others working on the rebar wall.
zh: 五名头戴红色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人正在沿着一面大型钢筋混凝土基础墙进行作业，该基础墙带有竖向钢筋。两名工人位于基础墙的左侧，其中一人正在行走，另一人正在调整或检查钢筋。三名工人位于右侧，其中一人站在基础墙地面上，另外两人正在钢筋墙上作业。

err.en: red overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 红色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: Three workers wearing yellow hard hats are engaged in concrete pouring activities at a construction site. They are handling a large hose to direct the flow of concrete onto a reinforced steel structure. The steel reinforcement is laid out in a grid pattern, and the concrete is being poured to form a slab or foundation.
zh: 三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正在建筑工地上进行混凝土浇筑作业。他们操作一根大软管，将混凝土直接输送至钢筋结构。钢筋按网格状铺设，混凝土正被浇筑以形成楼板板或基础。

text: Five workers wearing hard hats are spread across a construction site with a concrete floor, where several vertical rebars are protruding. Two of the workers are walking, one is operating a machine, and construction materials are scattered around the site, including what appears to be a wheelbarrow and some buckets.
zh: 五名头戴安全帽的工人分散在一处混凝土楼板的建筑工地上，该处有几根垂直钢筋外露在外。其中两名工人在走动，一人正在操作一台机器，建筑材料散落在工地各处，包括看似一根钢筋和几个桶。

err.en: what appears to be a wheelbarrow and som
err.zh: 看似一根钢筋和几个桶

text: In the center of the image, an orange Hyundai excavator is operating in a muddy excavation area with water pooling around its tracks. The surrounding terrain is uneven with mounds of dirt and excavation pits.
zh: 画面中央，一台橙色的现代挖掘机正在泥泞地开挖区域作业，其履带周围环绕着积水坑。周边地形平坦，伴有土堆和开挖坑洼。

zh: 夜间环境下，三名身穿安全背心、头戴安全帽的工人正在一处地面覆盖着碎石的建筑工地上进行作业。其中两名工人站在轮式挖掘机旁，一人手持铁锹，另一人则操作着一台带有明亮显示屏的机器。

text: In a dimly lit environment, two large trucks are positioned towards the center and right side of the area, with their headlights on, illuminating the space. A backhoe loader is visible on the left side, partially lit by artificial lighting. The ground is uneven and rocky, suggesting recent excavation or construction work.
zh: 昏暗环境中，两辆大型卡车停靠在场地中央及右侧，车灯开启，照亮着空间。左侧可见一台装载机，部分由人工照明照亮。地面平整且多岩石，暗示近期有挖掘或施工活动。

err.en: The ground is uneven and rocky

text: The image shows bundles of rebars partially covered with blue tarps in the foreground. A bulldozer is positioned in the middle ground, with a multi-story building under construction behind it, featuring exposed concrete and scaffolding. A tower crane is visible in the distance to the right, adjacent to another high-rise building enveloped in green safety netting.
zh: 画面前景中，一丛芦苇部分被蓝色鸢尾草覆盖。一台推土机位于画面中央，其后方是一栋正在施工中的多层建筑，露出混凝土和脚手架。右侧远处可见一台塔式起重机，毗邻另一栋被绿色安全网包裹的高层建筑。

text: The image shows multiple construction materials organized in piles, including rebars, pipes, and wooden planks. Four workers wearing red hard hats and safety vests are engaged in various activities near the materials. Scaffoldings are erected on the right side, and in the background, a green tarp covers a mound of earth adjacent to a densely vegetated area.
zh: 图中显示多堆建筑材料，包括钢筋、管材和木托盘。四名头戴红色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在材料附近从事各种活动。脚手架在右侧搭建，背景中一块绿色防水布覆盖着紧邻茂密植被区域的的一堆泥土。

err.en: wearing red hard hats and safety vests a
err.zh: 身穿安全背心的的工人

text: Three workers wearing hard hats are engaged in activities near the center of the image; two are crouched by a large metal object, and another is standing by an excavator. A front loader is actively moving material in the foreground, while another excavator is positioned behind it. Large piles of rocks dominate the background, with various construction vehicles and equipment scattered throughout the site.
zh: 三名头戴安全帽的工人正在图像中央附近从事作业；其中两人被一个大型金属物体包围，另一人则站在一台挖掘机旁。一台装载机正在前景积极搬运物料，而另一台挖掘机则停在其后方。背景中堆满了大堆的岩石，整个工地现场散布着各种施工车辆与设备。

err.en: two are crouched by a large metal object
err.zh: 其中两人被一个大型金属物体包围

text: The image shows a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and safety vest pushing a wheelbarrow, while another is bending over near a pile of sand. Multiple workers are scattered across the site, with some standing on a green net-covered area and others walking or engaging in various tasks. Two tower cranes loom in the background, and there are piles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, throughout the site.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在推动一辆轮式压路机，而另一名工人正弯腰靠近一堆沙。多名工人分散在工地各处，其中一些站在绿色网覆盖的区域上，另一些则行走或从事各种任务。背景中有两座塔式起重机，并且到处都有建筑材料堆，包括钢筋和木托盘。

text: The image shows an orange electrical distribution box with cables running across the wet concrete floor. Bundles of construction materials, possibly rebars, are scattered around the area. Two tower cranes are visible in the background, with one extending across the top of the image. High-rise buildings under construction are also present in the background, and the sky appears overcast.
zh: 画面中可见一个橙色配电箱，电缆横跨潮湿混凝土地面延伸。成束建筑材料，可能是钢筋，散落在该区域周围。背景中可见两台塔式起重机，其中一台横跨画面顶部。背景中还有在建的高层建筑，天空呈现于上方。

text: Five workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in concrete pouring activities on a reinforced steel structure. They are using a concrete hose that is suspended from above. In the background, there are piles of dirt and blue tarp-covered materials. Vegetation and a clear sky are visible in the distance.
zh: 五名头戴橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳的工人正在钢筋混凝土结构上进行混凝土浇筑作业。他们使用一根从上方悬吊下来的混凝土软管。背景中可见成堆的泥土料以及蓝色防水布覆盖的材料。植被与晴朗的天空在远处清晰可见。

err.en: orange overalls and yellow hard hats
err.zh: 橙色安全帽、身穿黄色硬壳

text: In the foreground, a yellow soil compactor with the brand "SANY" is visible, operated by a driver inside the cabin. Behind it, another piece of construction equipment is partially visible. The background features a row of multistory residential buildings, and on the right side, large concrete pipes are stacked. The ground appears to be an active construction site with exposed earth and tracks from construction vehicles.
zh: 前景中，一名身着黄色土作业服的施工人员清晰可见，正由一名司机在驾驶室内操作。其后方，另一台施工设备部分可见。背景中，一排多层住宅建筑矗立，右侧，大型混凝土管道堆叠放置。地面看似为一处正在施工的的作业的工地，裸露出泥土体及来自施工车辆的的车辙印迹。

err.zh: 一名身着黄色土作业服的施工人员

err.zh: 一处正在施工的的作业的工地，裸露出泥土体
来自施工车辆的的车辙印迹

text: Four workers wearing blue overalls and yellow hard hats are engaged in activities near a formwork structure at a construction site. They appear to be handling or maneuvering a large orange pipe. Behind them, a steep excavation face is visible with two suspended red platforms, and various construction materials are scattered around the site, including wooden planks and metal rods.
zh: 四名头戴蓝色安全帽和黄色安全帽的工人正在一处建筑工地附近从事作业。他们似乎正在搬运或移动一根大型橙色管道。在他们身后，可见一个陡峭深的开挖面，上面悬挂着两个红色平台，工地周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属杆。

err.en: wearing blue overalls and yellow hard ha
err.zh: 头戴蓝色安全帽和黄色安全帽

text: In the foreground, there is a rocky embankment leading down to a turbulent river. Two pieces of heavy construction equipment, a bulldozer and an excavator, are positioned on the embankment further back, seemingly engaged in earthmoving activities.
zh: 前景中，一处岩石突出部向下延伸至湍急的河流。两台重型型施工设备，一台推土机和一台挖掘机，位于突出部更靠后，似乎正从事土方方作业活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers engaged in activities. Two motorcycles are parked centrally, and one worker appears to be handling construction material while another is bending over the planks.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人正在从事活动。两辆摩托车停放在中央，一名工人似乎正在搬运建筑材料，另一名工人正弯腰越过托盘架。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red hard hat and safety vest standing next to a bundle of rebars. To the right, scaffolding with green netting is visible, and a worker in a red hard hat is seen at the base of the scaffolding. Various construction materials, including wooden planks and metal sheets, are scattered around the site. A partially constructed concrete structure with exposed steel bars is present in the background.
zh: 画面中，一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正站在成排的钢筋旁。右侧可见带有绿色网架的脚手架，在脚手架底部还有一名头戴红色安全帽的工人。现场周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属板。背景中可见一处部分建成的混凝土结构，露出钢筋。

text: The image shows a worker sweeping the concrete floor of a large trench-like construction area, while another worker is handling a hose attached to a crane-mounted concrete pump, pouring concrete into the formwork. Along the sides of the trench, vertical rebar structures are in place, likely for wall reinforcement. Various construction materials, such as buckets, a wheelbarrow, and wooden planks, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图中显示一名工人正在清扫大型基坑状施工区域的的地面，与此同时，另一名工人正操作着连接在起重机吊装的混凝土泵上的软管，将混凝土浇筑入模板作业中。沿基坑侧壁，竖直钢筋结构已就位，很可能用于墙体加固。各类施工材料，诸如料斗、轮盘、木托盘等，散落在工地周围。

err.en: buckets, a wheelbarrow, and wooden plank

text: The image shows a multi-level structure with scaffolding, with a worker in a yellow hard hat visible on one of the upper levels. A tower crane is positioned to the right of the structure, extending upwards and out of frame. On the ground, various construction materials, including stacks of rebars and wooden planks, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个多层结构，带有脚手架，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于其中一个上层。一台塔式起重机位于结构的右侧，向上并超出框架。地面上，各种建筑材料，包括成堆的钢筋和木托盘，散落在场地周围。

text: The image shows a white dump truck positioned on uneven terrain, with its bed raised slightly, indicating it may be in the process of unloading or waiting to do so. To the right, an excavator is situated on an earth mound, with its arm extended and the bucket in the soil, suggesting excavation work.

A pile driver is installed to the left, with its boom extended upwards. The background reveals a large expanse of cleared land with various mounds of earth and construction materials. Electrical poles run parallel to the site, and a road with a vehicle is visible in the far background.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机停放在泥泞地上，周围有积水，表明近期有降雨或水流。挖掘机左侧有一堆司机，其吊臂向上伸展。背景展现出一片开阔的清晰土地，上面有各种土堆和建筑材料。电力杆平行于工地，远处背景中可见一条道路和一辆车辆。

err.en: A pile driver is installed to the left
err.zh: 挖掘机左侧有一堆司机

text: A green dump truck is in the process of tipping its bed to unload its contents on a construction site, with a sedan parked in the foreground. In the background, a tower crane is visible, indicating ongoing construction activities.
zh: 一辆绿色自卸卡车正在将其货箱倾斜以卸其内容，停在一处建筑工地上，前景中停着一辆轿车。背景中可见一台塔式起重机，表明施工活动正在进行进行。

err.zh: 表明施工活动正在进行进行

text: The image shows an excavator on muddy terrain, engaged in digging or earthmoving activities. A worker is standing to the right, observing or directing the excavator's operation.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正在泥泞土地上进行挖掘或土方方作业。一名工人站在右侧，正在观察或指挥挖掘机的器的作业。

text: The worker wearing a camouflage jacket and an orange hard hat is standing behind a wheelbarrow, facing a pile of red-brown earth. In the background, there are partially constructed buildings with exposed brickwork and window frames.
zh: 一名工人身穿迷彩服、头戴橙色安全帽，站在一根轮轴后方，面对一堆红褐色泥土。背景中可见部分在建的建筑物，露出砖砌体和窗框。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is positioned on a mound of earth, with its arm extended and bucket in contact with the ground, suggesting excavation work. The terrain is uneven and covered with rocks and soil.
zh: 图像中央，一台挖掘机停在一堆泥土上，其臂和铲斗与地面接触，表明正在进行挖掘作业。地形平坦，覆盖着岩石和土壤。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red bandana and blue jeans standing on a ladder and leaning into the back of a dump truck filled with asphalt. Behind the truck, another worker is partially visible, appearing to be stabilizing the ladder. The background features a stone wall and a building with blue windows.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿红色上衣和蓝色牛仔裤，站在梯子上，身体前倾向一辆装满沥青的自卸卡车后方。在卡车后面，另一名工人部分可见，似乎正在稳定梯子。背景中有一面石墙和一栋带有蓝色窗户的建筑。

text: In the center of the image, a bulldozer is positioned on a dirt mound, actively engaged in moving earth. The surrounding area is a mix of bare soil and scattered debris, with patches of standing water visible.
zh: 画面中央，一台推土机停在一堆土堆上，正在进行进行土方作业。周围区域是裸露土与散落碎屑的混合体，并可见积水斑块。

err.zh: 正在进行进行土方作业

text: A red dump truck is tilted to unload material, with its bed raised. Behind it, an excavator with a lit cabin is visible, possibly preparing to move the dumped material. The environment appears to be a large open space with a dark, rocky background, suggesting a quarry or mining operation.
zh: 一辆红色自卸卡车倾斜着，车斗架升起。在它后面，一台开着灯的罩的挖掘机可见，可能准备移动卸下的材料。环境看起来是一个大型开放空间，有着黑暗、岩石背景，暗示一个采石场或采矿作业。

err.en: an excavator with a lit cabin
err.zh: 一台开着灯的罩的挖掘机

text: An excavator is positioned in the center of a trench, with its boom and bucket extended towards the ground, indicating excavation work in progress. The trench runs along a dirt road with a manhole cover visible to the left. The surrounding area is characterized by a mix of soil and rocky terrain, and there is a slope with vegetation on the right side of the image.
zh: 挖掘机位于沟槽中央，其动臂和铲斗朝向地面伸出，表明挖掘作业正在进行进行。沟槽沿一条土路延伸，左侧可见一个孔洞。周边区域由土壤和岩石地形混合构成，图像右侧有一处带有植被的斜坡坡。

text: Two excavators are engaged in earthmoving activities on a mound of reddish-brown soil. The excavator on the left, colored yellow and labeled "Hybrid," is positioned higher on the mound, while the orange excavator on the right, with the brand "DOOSAN," is located lower on the slope. Both machines have their booms extended and are actively digging into the soil.
zh: 两台挖掘机正在一堆红褐色土堆上进行土方方作业。左侧那台黄色挖掘机，标有“Hybrid”字样，位置较高；右侧那台橙色挖掘机，带有“do.osan”品牌标识，位于坡面较低处。两台机器均伸出其挖斗，正在积极挖掘泥土体。

text: In the foreground, a worker in green overalls is walking across a concrete floor scattered with wooden planks and metal rods. Towards the center, another worker is operating a machine, possibly a power trowel, to smooth the concrete surface. In the background, there are several puddles on the concrete and a yellow construction crane is visible. Various construction materials, including bundles of rods and wooden boards, are placed around the site.
zh: 前景中，一名身穿绿色防护服的工人正行走在布满木托盘和金属杆的混凝土地面上。画面中央，另一名工人正在操作一台机器，可能是一台混凝土搅拌车，以抹平混凝土表面。背景中，混凝土上散落着几处水坑，一台黄色建筑起重机清晰可见。各种建筑材料，包括成束的钢筋和木质板材，被放置在场地周围。

text: The image shows a worker pushing a wheelbarrow along a dirt path, while several rebars and wooden planks are scattered around. Seven workers wearing yellow hard hats are engaged in construction activities around a concrete structure with steel reinforcement visible.
zh: 图中显示一名工人正沿一条土路推动一辆钢筋车，周围散落着几根钢筋和木托盘。七名戴着黄色安全帽的工人正在围绕着一座带有可见钢筋加强的化的混凝土结构进行施工活动。

err.zh: 带有可见钢筋加强的化的混凝土结构

text: The image shows a yellow bulldozer positioned on a dirt surface with visible tracks behind it, indicating recent movement. The surrounding area is characterized by uneven terrain with various piles of dirt and some scattered debris, including branches and small pieces of trash. The overall scene suggests land clearing or leveling activity in preparation for further construction or development.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色推土机停在一处泥土地表面上，其后方可见车辙印迹，表明其近期有移动。周围区域地形较为平坦，分布着若干堆泥土堆以及部分散落的杂物，包括树枝和一些小件垃圾渣。整体场景暗示着土地平整或水平作业活动，为后续施工或发展做准备。

text: The image shows a construction site with nine workers wearing orange and white hard hats standing around exposed rebar structures. A concrete pump with a red boom is extended over the area, suggesting ongoing concrete pouring activities. The terrain is uneven with visible earthwork, and there are wooden planks scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，九名头戴橙白相间安全帽的工人站在裸露的钢筋结构旁。一台带有红色泵的混凝土泵横跨该区域，暗示正在进行混凝土浇筑作业。地形平坦，可见土方工作业，现场周围散落着木托盘。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and safety vest is standing on a concrete surface with a shovel in hand, appearing to work on a pile of construction material. Behind the worker, there is a large area covered with green rebar support chairs, indicating preparation for a concrete pour.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正站在混凝土表面上，手持铁锹，似乎正在对一堆建筑材料进行作业。在工人身后，有一大片被绿色防护栏围起来的区域，表明正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。

text: A worker in camouflage pants and a green jacket is using a jackhammer to break a large rock. The worker is wearing a black helmet and is bent over the task, with the tool pressed against the rock surface. Dust and debris are visible around the impact area, indicating active work.
zh: 一名工人身穿迷彩裤和绿色夹克，头戴黑色头盔，正弯腰用力，用一把大锤敲击一块巨石。撞击区域周围可见尘土和碎屑，表明正在进行作业。

text: In the foreground, uneven and muddy terrain is visible with scattered debris and construction materials. A multi-level steel structure occupies the central and background areas, with no visible workers or active construction equipment. The structure features multiple floors with steel beams and columns.
zh: 前景中可见平坦而泥泞滑的地形，散落着碎石与建筑材料。多层钢结构占据中央及背景区域，未见明显工人或施工设备。结构特征为多层楼面，配有钢梁与立柱。

err.en: no visible workers or active constructio
err.zh: 未见明显工人或施工设备

text: In the foreground, a mini excavator is digging up soil, operated by a driver. Four workers wearing hard hats are engaged in activities around the excavator, with one handling a long pipe on the ground. To the right, another worker is standing by a barricaded area under an overpass.
zh: 前景中，一台小型挖掘机正在挖掘泥土，由一名司机操作。四名头戴安全帽的工人正在挖掘机周围从事作业，其中一人手持一根长管在地面上。右侧，另一名工人正站在一个围栏护区域下方，上方有一辆过路车辆。

text: In the foreground, three yellow construction vehicles, specifically two compactors and one bulldozer, are operating on a site with reddish-brown soil. A stack of concrete pipes is visible on the left side.
zh: 前景中，三台黄色施工车辆，具体为两台挖掘机和一台路面铣刨机，正在一片红褐色土质的场地上作业。左侧可见一堆混凝土管道。

err.zh: 两台挖掘机和一台路面铣刨机

text: The image shows a large pile-driving machine mounted on a crawler base, with its boom extended vertically into the sky. A yellow mobile crane is positioned to the right, with its boom and jib extended horizontally.
zh: 图中显示一台大型履带式起重机安装在履带底盘上，其吊臂垂直向上延伸至天空。一台黄色移动式起重机位于右侧，其吊臂和吊钩水平向外延伸。

text: A water truck is in the center, spraying water on the ground, likely for dust control. In the background, multiple tower cranes are visible, and there are several construction vehicles, including what appear to be excavators and possibly a crane, scattered across the site. The terrain is uneven with visible dirt piles, and the sky is clear.
zh: 一辆洒水车停在场地中央，正在向地面洒水，可能用于降尘。背景中可见多台塔式起重机，现场还有数台施工车辆，包括看似挖掘机的以及可能有一台起重机，散布在场地各处。地形平坦，可见土堆，天空晴朗。

text: The image shows a concrete structure resembling a large underground entrance, with several steel formworks placed on top. Two workers in orange overalls and yellow hard hats are inside the structure, one standing on the lower level and the other on a ledge, both appearing to be engaged in construction activities.
zh: 图像显示一个类似大型地下入口的混凝土结构，顶部放置着几件钢制脚手架。两名身穿橙色工作服、头戴黄色安全帽的工人位于该结构内部，一人站在较低处，另一人站在脚手架上，两人似乎都在从事施工作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a wet concrete foundation. Three workers wearing reflective vests and hard hats are present, including one operating a long boom concrete pump. The site is surrounded by high-rise buildings and is illuminated by artificial lighting, with wooden formworks and steel reinforcements laid out across the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，设有湿混凝土基础。三名工人身穿反光背心和安全帽，其中一人正在操作一台长臂混凝土泵。该场地被高层建筑环绕立，并由人工照明照亮，场地上铺设着木质模板和钢筋。

text: In the center of the image, a mobile crane is extended over a construction site with its boom and hook visible. To the right, an excavator is positioned near a body of water, with its arm and bucket extended towards the ground. Various construction materials, including wood planks and metal pieces, are scattered around the site.
zh: 画面中央，一台移动式起重机将其吊臂和吊钩伸向一处建筑工地。右侧，一台挖掘机靠近一处水塘，其臂和铲斗伸向地面。各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属碎片，散落在工地周围。

text: Three workers are engaged in construction activities involving concrete. One worker is handling a hose to pour concrete, another is assisting by holding the hose, and the third is observing the process. They are surrounded by an uneven surface of fresh concrete with embedded rocks.
zh: 三名工人正在从事涉及混凝土的施工作业。一名工人手持软管进行混凝土浇筑，另一名工人协助持握软管，第三名工人正在观察作业过程。他们被一层平整面的新浇筑混凝土所环绕，其中嵌有岩石。

err.en: an uneven surface of fresh concrete
err.zh: 一层平整面的新浇筑混凝土

text: The image shows an excavator engaged in earthmoving activities, with two bulldozers and a compactor positioned nearby on a cleared area with loose soil.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机正在进行土方作业，旁边停着两台推土机和一名工作人员，位于一片土质松散的空地上。

text: In the center of the image, a yellow bulldozer is operating on a reddish-brown dirt surface, with visible tire tracks indicating recent movement. There is a stockpile of black pipes and white concrete structures, possibly culverts, arranged in a line. Trees and a building with a tower structure are visible in the far background, suggesting the site is near a developed area.
zh: 画面中央，一台黄色压路机正在红褐色泥土地表面上作业，可见轮胎轨迹表明其近期有移动。有一堆黑色管道和白色混凝土结构，可能是竖井，排列成一条线。远处背景中可见树木和一栋带塔的建筑，暗示该场地靠近一个已开发区域。

text: An excavator is positioned to the right, actively loading soil into the bed of a dump truck that is parked on an incline. The excavator's boom is extended over the truck, indicating ongoing work. A pile of soil is visible in front of the excavator, and there are no visible workers or other equipment in the immediate vicinity.
zh: 挖掘机位于右侧，正将泥土装载到停靠在一条直线上的的一辆自卸卡车上。挖掘机的的大臂越过卡车，表明作业正在进行进行。挖掘机前方可见一堆土，且附近没有可见工人或其他其他设备。

err.zh: 表明作业正在进行进行

err.en: no visible workers or other equipment
err.zh: 没有可见工人或其他其他设备

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker wearing a yellow hard hat standing amidst an array of steel rebars laid out on the ground, which appears to be a floor with a grid of rebar for concrete reinforcement. Wooden planks and additional construction materials are scattered around the area.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在地面上，地面铺设有用于混凝土加固的钢筋网格。周围散落着木托盘及其他建筑材料。

text: The image shows a dump truck positioned on a dirt road with its bed raised, indicating the unloading of material. Two individuals are standing near a small structure with a white rooftop to the left. A second truck is parked behind the dump truck, and a third truck is located further to the left, all with their beds down.
zh: 一辆自卸卡车停在土路上，其货箱已升起，表明材料尚未卸载。两人站在左侧一栋带白色屋顶的小建筑附近。第二辆卡车停在自卸卡车后方，第三辆卡车位于更左侧，所有货箱均已放下。

text: Three workers are present on a large concrete structure with multiple levels. Two workers, equipped with safety vests and hard hats, are standing on the upper level, with one operating surveying equipment. The third worker is on a lower level, walking along the structure. Metal railings are installed along the walkways, and the background features a clear sky with an electrical pylon in the distance.
zh: 三名工人出现在多层大型混凝土结构上。两名工人佩戴安全背带和硬帽，站在较高处，其中一名操作着检查设备。第三名工人在较低处，沿着结构行走。金属栏杆安装于走道，并且背景呈现一片晴朗天空，远处有一个电气圆顶。

text: The image shows three workers wearing safety vests and hard hats standing on a partially constructed floor with exposed rebar, engaged in a discussion. Behind them, several other workers are involved in rebar work on the same floor. A large, yellow construction crane is visible to the left, and industrial structures and additional construction equipment can be seen in the background.
zh: 图片显示三名工人身穿安全背心、头戴安全帽，站在部分施工的地面上，地面裸露着钢筋，正在参与讨论。在他们身后，还有几名工人也在同一地面上从事钢筋作业。左侧可见一台大型黄色色建筑起重机，背景中还能看到工业结构以及额外的施工设备。

text: The image shows a blue Kobelco excavator positioned on an area of disturbed soil with visible tracks indicating recent movement. The background features urban buildings, and the foreground shows uneven terrain with mounds of earth, suggesting excavation work.
zh: 图中显示一台蓝色Kobelco挖掘机停放在一片扰动土区域上，可见履带表明近期有移动迹象。背景中可见城市建筑，前景显示平坦地形并伴有土堆，暗示正在进行挖掘作业。

text: The image shows three workers with yellow hard hats and safety vests working on a rebar framework, with one bending over a concrete surface. Wooden formworks are placed around the rebar structure. A large tower crane is visible in the midground, and another crane is partially seen on the right edge.
zh: 图中显示三名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人正在钢筋框架上作业，其中一人正跨越混凝土表面进行弯曲作业。木质模板被放置在钢筋结构周围。画面中部可见一台大型塔式起重机，右侧边缘还隐约可见另一台起重机。

err.zh: 跨越混凝土表面进行弯曲作业

text: In the foreground, a concrete pump with an extended boom is pouring concrete into a foundation with the assistance of two workers. A concrete mixer truck is positioned nearby, and another worker is walking towards the pump. The site is surrounded by multiple buildings at various stages of construction, with scaffolding visible on the structures in the background.
zh: 前景中，一台混凝土泵在两名工人的协助下向基础浇筑混凝土。一辆混凝土搅拌车停在附近，另一名工人正朝泵的方向走去。该场地被多栋处于不同施工阶段的、背景中可见脚手架的建筑所环绕。

text: Four workers are present at a construction site with a large water puddle in the foreground. Two workers, one in blue and the other in white, are standing on the left side of the puddle, while another worker in orange is standing in the water holding a hose. The fourth worker in white is standing on the right side of the puddle. Behind them, there is an unfinished concrete structure with multiple protruding rebars.
zh: 四名工人出现在一处施工现场，前景中有一个大水坑。两名工人站在坑的左侧，其中一人穿蓝色衣服，另一人穿白色衣服；另一名穿橙色衣服的的工人站在水中，手持一根水管。第四名穿白色衣服的的工人站在坑的右侧。在他们身后，有一处已完工的结构，带有多个外露出的钢筋。

text: A bulldozer is at the center of the image, engaged in earthmoving activities on a dirt terrain with visible tracks. The surrounding area is uneven with various mounds of soil and debris, including branches and vegetation, indicating recent land clearing or excavation work.
zh: 一台推土机位于画面中央，正在泥土地质地上进行土方方作业，地面可见车辙痕迹。周围区域平整，分布着不同高度的和碎屑的土壤，包括树枝和植被，表明近期土地清理或挖掘工作。

err.en: various mounds of soil and debris
err.zh: 不同高度的和碎屑的土壤

text: The image shows an excavator bucket depositing material into a formwork structure reinforced with steel bars, where a worker wearing a hat is standing. A large concrete pipe runs parallel to the formwork, and various construction materials, including wooden planks and metal sheets, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图中显示一名头戴安全帽的工人站在一个由钢架加固的挖掘机料斗坑旁，一个大型混凝土管道平行于该工地延伸，各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属板，散落在工地周围。

err.zh: 由钢架加固的挖掘机料斗坑旁

text: In the foreground, two excavators are positioned on mounds of earth, with one actively digging. A roller is visible to the left, while a utility vehicle is parked to the right. Two workers are seated on the ground near the center, and another is standing by the utility vehicle to the right.
zh: 前景中，两名挖掘机手位于地面之上，其中一人正在积极挖掘。一台滚轮可见于左侧，而一辆工程车停靠在右侧。两名工人坐在地面靠近中心处，另一人则站在工程车右侧。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a red hard hat and camouflage clothing is standing on uneven, rocky terrain, seemingly inspecting or working with thin vertical rods that are protruding from the ground. Behind the worker, there is a large concrete utility pole and a trench with exposed earth.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴红色安全帽、身着迷彩服的工人，正站在平坦而多岩石的地面上，似乎在检查或操作着从地面伸出的的一根根细长的垂直杆。在工人身后，有一个大型混凝土杆和一条露出泥土层的的地沟。

text: In the center of the image, an excavator is actively engaged in digging, with its bucket in the soil. Bundles of construction materials, possibly pipes, are partially covered with a white and blue tarp on the left side of the image. Behind the excavator, a retaining wall with sheet piling is visible, and industrial buildings can be seen in the background.
zh: 画面中央，一台挖掘机正忙于挖掘，其铲斗插入泥土中。建筑材料的，可能是管道，部分被白色和蓝色防水布覆盖，位于画面左侧。在挖掘机后方，可见一道带瓦楞的挡土墙，背景中可以看到工业建筑。

text: In the foreground, a blue excavator is positioned next to a red dump truck, with both situated on a dirt surface that appears to be part of a construction site. The excavator's bucket is raised and there are no visible operators in either vehicle.
zh: 前景中，一台蓝色挖掘机位于一辆红色自卸卡车的前方，两者均停放在看似属于建筑工地的泥土地面上。挖掘机的铲斗处于升起状态，且两辆车辆内均无可见操作人员。

text: The image shows a paved road in the foreground, with a yellow excavator digging into a mound of earth to the right. A dump truck is being loaded with soil adjacent to the excavator. Behind the machines, a steep, bare earth embankment rises, suggesting excavation work for a construction project.
zh: 前景为一条铺装路面，右侧一台黄色挖掘机正在向土堆挖掘。挖掘机旁，一辆自卸卡车正在装载泥土料。机械后方，陡峭立的裸露土边坡坡升起，暗示为某建设工程进行开挖作业。

err.en: a steep, bare earth embankment rises
err.zh: 陡峭立的裸露土边坡坡升起

text: The image shows a yellow excavator positioned on a mound of earth with its arm extended towards the center of the image. Another excavator is visible in the middle ground, partially obscured by the first. A third excavator is situated in the background, with all three machines appearing to be engaged in excavation work. The operator of the nearest excavator is visible through the cabin window. The excavation site is surrounded by piles of dirt and debris, and the background features construction barriers and green fencing, with partially visible structures and vegetation beyond.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机停在一堆土堆上，其臂伸向画面中心。另一台挖掘机在画面中部可见，部分被第一台遮挡。第三台挖掘机位于背景中，三台机器似乎都在进行挖掘作业。最近一台挖掘机的器的操作员透过驾驶室窗可见。挖掘现场被土堆和碎石堆包围，背景中可见施工围挡和绿色围栏，以及部分可见结构和植被。

err.en: The operator of the nearest excavator
err.zh: 最近一台挖掘机的器的操作员

text: The worker is pushing a wheelbarrow, while another is using a shovel near a pile of sand. A third worker is laying bricks on an unfinished wall that extends towards the background. All workers are wearing safety helmets. Various construction materials, such as bricks and wooden planks, are scattered around the site.
zh: 一名工人正在推运一根钢筋，另一名工人正使用铁锹靠近一堆沙子作业。第三名工人在向背景延伸的已完工墙体上砌砖。所有工人都佩戴着安全帽。各种建筑材料，如砖块和木托盘，散落在工地周围。

text: Two excavators are engaged in earthmoving activities at a construction site with a large mound of soil between them. The excavator on the left is digging into the mound, while the one on the right appears to be depositing soil. The site is surrounded by trees and a fence, with a partially constructed building visible in the background.
zh: 两台挖掘机正在进行土方作业，中间堆着一大堆土。左侧的挖掘机正在向土堆内挖掘，右侧的一台似乎在进行土方的。工地四周被树木和围栏所环绕，背景中可见一栋部分建成的建筑物。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on a dirt track, with its arm extended towards the ground, suggesting excavation or earth-moving activities. A series of wooden mats are laid out to the right of the excavator, creating a makeshift road. In the background, a bridge and several individuals are visible, with one person walking along the dirt track towards the excavator. The terrain appears to be uneven and cleared of vegetation, indicative of ongoing site preparation or construction work.
zh: 图中显示一台挖掘机停放在一条泥土路上，其臂部伸向地面，暗示正在进行挖掘或土方移动作业。挖掘机右侧摆放着一排木质垫板，形成一条简易通道。背景中可见一座桥梁及数人，其中一人正沿着土路朝挖掘机方向行走。地形看起来平坦且无植被覆盖，表明正在进行场地准备或施工作业。

text: A tower crane is in operation, hoisting a stack of wooden planks in the center of the image, with its boom extending towards the right. A mobile crane with an extended boom is also visible on the left, assisting in the lifting operation. In the background, there is a multi-story building under construction, surrounded by scaffolding.
zh: 塔式起重机正在作业中，吊起一摞木托盘，位于画面中央，其吊臂向右延伸。一台移动式起重机同样可见于左侧，辅助进行吊装作业。背景中有一栋多层建筑正在施工，周围环绕着脚手架。

text: In the foreground, a large expanse of rebar gridwork covers the ground, with several workers dispersed across it, bending or tying the rebars. All workers are wearing safety helmets, and some are visible in a crouched or seated position engaging with the rebar. A tower crane stands in the midground to the right, with its boom extended across the site. High-rise buildings under various stages of construction form the backdrop.
zh: 前景中，一片广阔的的建筑场地占据地面，多名工人分散其间，正在弯曲或绑扎钢筋。所有工人都佩戴安全帽，部分工人可见处于蹲姿或坐姿位，正在与钢筋作业。一台塔式起重机矗立于场地中右侧，其吊臂横跨整个场地。不同施工阶段的高层建筑构成背景。

err.en: a large expanse of rebar gridwork covers
err.zh: 一片广阔的的建筑场地占据地面

text: A yellow dump truck is positioned in front of a large tracked excavator with the "CAT" logo visible, indicating it is a Caterpillar brand machine. The excavator's bucket is resting on the ground, and it appears to be in the process of either loading or unloading soil into the back of the dump truck. The environment is dusty and indicative of earthmoving activities.
zh: 一辆黄色自卸卡车停在一台大型履带式挖掘机前方，挖掘机上清晰可见“CAT”标志，表明其为卡特彼勒品牌设备。挖掘机的铲斗停放在地面上，似乎正处于向自卸卡车后部装载或卸载泥土方的土的过程中。环境多尘土，显示出正在进行土方作业。

err.en: loading or unloading soil into the back
err.zh: 装载或卸载泥土方的土的过程中

text: In the excavation area, seven workers in orange overalls and hard hats are engaged in activities related to concrete pouring, with one worker guiding the concrete hose and others spreading the material. A pile driver is positioned on the left, and the site is bordered by a blue fence. The background features residential buildings and vegetation.
zh: 开挖区域内，七名身穿橙色反光背心和安全帽的工作人员正在进行与混凝土浇筑相关的作业，其中一名工人引导混凝土软管，其余人员铺展材料。一名司机位于左侧，现场由蓝色围栏围挡围护。背景中可见住宅建筑和植被。

text: In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat is visible among various construction materials, including bundles of rebars and wooden planks. A crane boom extends diagonally across the scene, and a dense area of green foliage provides the background.
zh: 前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人清晰可见，周围散布着各种建筑材料，包括成束的钢筋和木托盘。一台起重机吊臂斜向横跨整个场景，而一片茂密的绿色植被则构成了背景。

text: Two workers are engaged in construction activities within a foundation structure; one wearing an orange jacket is crouched and appears to be working on the surface, while the other, in darker clothing, is positioned lower and partially obscured from view. The site is strewn with construction materials, including rebars protruding from concrete sections, wooden planks, and a metal tray.
zh: 两名工人正在地基结构内进行施工作业；其中一名身穿橙色夹克的工人身体前倾，看似正在混凝土表面作业，另一名身着深色衣物的者位置较低且部分被视野遮挡。现场散布着建筑材料，包括从混凝土截面伸出的钢筋、木托盘以及一个金属托盘。

text: An excavator is positioned on a pile of rocks to the left, working on a site with exposed rebar frameworks on the ground. To the right, there is another piece of construction equipment, partially visible. The site appears to be in the early stages of construction with foundational work underway.
zh: 一台挖掘机停在一堆岩石的左侧，正在一处地面裸露钢筋框架的工地上作业。右侧，还有另一台施工设备，部分可见。该工地似乎处于施工早期阶段，基础工程正在进行进行。

text: Five individuals are present at a nighttime construction site, with one person standing on a raised platform to the right, working or supervising. The ground is uneven and partially covered with a wet substance, possibly concrete, which is spread across the site. In the background, there is a formwork structure with vertical supports and horizontal beams, indicating an area under construction or preparation for concrete pouring.
zh: 夜间施工现场有五人，其中一人站在右侧的高台上，正在作业或进行监督。地面平整，部分被一种湿物质覆盖，可能是混凝土，该物质遍布整个场地。背景中可见一种带有竖向支撑和水平梁的结构，表明该区域正处于混凝土浇筑施工或准备阶段。

text: The image shows a partially constructed building with extensive scaffolding. A tower crane stands tall in the center, with its jib extending outwards and a hook hanging down. The background features a building with a completed tiled roof.
zh: 图片显示一座正在施工的建筑，搭设着大量脚手架。一台塔式起重机矗立在中央，其吊臂向外伸出，吊钩垂于下方。背景中有一栋建筑，其屋顶铺设有完成的。

text: The image shows a water-filled trench being worked on by three workers, all wearing safety helmets. An excavator is stationed on the bank to the right, and a small brick structure with a pixelated section is visible on the left. The surrounding area has uneven terrain with some vegetation and a blue tarp on the ground.
zh: 画面显示一条注满水的渠，三名工人正在对其进行作业，均佩戴安全帽。一台挖掘机停靠在右侧渠岸，左侧可见一小砖结构，带像素化截面。周边区域地势平坦，伴有部分植被，地面上铺有一块蓝色防水布。

text: An excavator with the branding "ZOOMLION" is positioned amidst a pile of broken concrete debris, with its arm extended and bucket resting on the ground. The machine is situated near a large concrete structure with visible cylindrical columns.
zh: 一台品牌为“ZOOM LION”的挖掘机，其动臂和铲斗平放在地面上，停在一堆破碎混凝土瓦砾之中。该机械位于一根可见圆柱形混凝土立柱附近。

err.zh: 一根可见圆柱形混凝土立柱

text: The image shows covered bundles of construction materials in the foreground, likely rebars or similar long items, secured with white and brown tarpaulins. Two tower cranes dominate the middle ground, with their booms extended across the sky. Leafless trees and a few with autumn-colored foliage are interspersed between the cranes. To the right, a cylindrical concrete structure, possibly a silo or storage vessel, stands adjacent to a construction site with visible scaffolding, indicating ongoing work.
zh: 前景处可见一叠建筑材料的，疑似为长条状或类似长条的物品，以白色和棕色油毡布加以固定。两座塔楼占据画面中部，其鼓包横跨天空。无叶树木及若干带有秋色的叶片的交错分布于塔楼之间。右侧，一个圆柱形混凝土结构，可能为筒仓或储料船，矗立于可见脚手架的施工现场旁，表明施工正在进行。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large number of workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests. They are distributed across various levels of a structure with scaffolding. In the foreground, there are blue and orange construction materials covered with tarps. A tower crane is present on the left side of the image, and there are multiple construction elements such as pipes and beams visible.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有大量工人戴着黄色安全帽和安全背心。他们分布在带有脚手架的不同层级上。前景中，有蓝色和橙色建筑材料覆盖着塔普斯。一台塔式起重机出现在图片左侧，并且有多个建筑元素如管道和梁可见。

text: The image shows extensive scaffolding and rebar structures, indicative of an ongoing construction project. A pile driver is positioned to the right, operating near the edge of a large, semi-circular concrete structure.
zh: 图像显示大量脚手架和钢筋结构，表明一项正在进行的中的建筑工程。一堆钢筋位于右侧，靠近一个大型半圆形混凝土结构的边缘作业。

text: The image shows a single bulldozer operating in the center, moving across what appears to be a dirt surface with tire tracks and ridges. Two workers wearing yellow hard hats are visible; one is standing to the left of the bulldozer, and the other is further in the background to the right. There are multiple colored markers or flags placed in the ground throughout the site.
zh: 图片显示一台单斗轮挖掘机正在场地中央作业，地面看起来像是带有轮胎轨迹和沟槽的泥土。可以看到两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人；其中一人站在挖掘机的左侧，另一人则位于背景右侧更远处。地面上散布着多个彩色标记或旗帜。

text: The construction site appears to be in an excavation phase with uneven, dug-up ground visible. In the background, there are buildings and a cell tower, indicating the proximity to a developed area.
zh: 该施工现场似乎处于开挖阶段，可见平整的基坑。背景中可见建筑物和一座塔楼，表明其邻近一个已开发区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing hard hats and safety gear. One worker in a red hard hat is handling a long pipe, while another in a blue jacket is assisting. The ground is uneven with large rocks and some rebars protruding from the surface. Wooden supports and additional construction materials are visible around the workers.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有五名工人戴着安全帽和穿着安全装备。其中一名戴着红色安全帽的工人正在处理一根长管，另一名穿着蓝色夹克的工人正在协助。地面是平整的，带有大块岩石和一些从表面伸出的来的钢筋。在工人周围可见木制支撑和额外的建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, actively moving earth. In the foreground, there are steel reinforcement bars laid out, with some wooden planks and other construction materials scattered around. In the background, multiple tower cranes are visible, indicating a larger construction project. There is a small shelter-like structure to the right.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机正在作业，积极地进行土方挖掘。前景处铺设着钢筋，周围散落着一些木托盘及其他建筑材料。背景中可见多座塔楼，表明这是一个规模较大的规模的的建设施工项目。右侧有一处类似小型庇护所的结构。

err.zh: 规模较大的规模的的建设施工项目

text: The image shows a landscaping project in progress with numerous workers engaged in various tasks. In the foreground, several workers are laying sod on prepared soil, while others are handling plants and materials. A building with a brick facade and white windows is visible in the background, bordered by a fence and lined with leafless trees.
zh: 图片显示一个正在进行的中的景观项目，众多工人正从事各种任务。前景中，几名工人正将土壤铺设在准备好的好的土壤上，而其他人正在处理植物和材料。背景中可见一栋带有砖砌外墙和白色窗户的建筑，被一道栅栏围住，并排列着无叶树木。

err.zh: 将土壤铺设在准备好的好的土壤上

text: The image shows a construction site with a large stockpile of rebars. There are seven workers visible, all wearing hard hats and safety vests. Two workers are moving a wheelbarrow, one is bending over the rebars, and four are standing or walking among the rebars.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有一大堆钢筋。可见七名工人，均佩戴安全帽并穿着安全背心。两名工人正在搬运一根钢筋，一名工人正弯腰跨过钢筋，另外四名工人则在钢筋之间站立或行走。

text: The image shows a single excavator in the center, with its arm extended and bucket engaged in moving earth. The surrounding area appears to be a cleared construction site with exposed soil and some vegetation debris. In the background, power lines and vegetation can be seen, indicating the periphery of the site.
zh: 图像中央展示着一台单斗挖掘机，其动臂和铲斗正在进行土方方作业。周围区域看起来是一个清理过的施工场地，有裸露出的土壤和一些植被碎屑。背景中可见电力线和植被，表明该场地的界。

err.en: with its arm extended and bucket engaged
err.zh: 其动臂和铲斗正在进行

text: The image shows a construction site with a dirt road in the foreground leading towards the main area of activity. There is an orange excavator in the center, positioned next to a blue truck. The excavator appears to be in operation, possibly engaged in earthmoving tasks. In the background, there are several power lines running parallel to the site. The surrounding area is relatively flat with some vegetation and a body of water visible on the left side.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景有一条土路通向主要作业区。画面中央有一台橙色挖掘机，位于一辆蓝色卡车旁。该挖掘机似乎正在作业，可能从事土方方作业。背景中有多条电力线平行于现场。周边区域相对平坦，有一些植被，左侧可见一处水体。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and engaged in activities related to reinforcing steel bars (rebars) for a foundation or wall structure. The workers are spread out along the length of the structure, with some bending over the rebars and one standing. The construction area is surrounded by wooden and metal formwork.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，五名头戴黄色安全帽的工人正从事钢筋（钢筋）绑扎作业，用于基础或墙体结构。工人沿结构长度分散开，其中一些弯曲钢筋，一人站立。施工区域被木材和金属形式的工作所包围。

err.zh: 木材和金属形式的工作

text: The image shows a construction site with a prominent tower crane in the center, its boom extended across the frame. In the foreground, there are various construction materials, including yellow scaffolding components and wooden planks. To the left, there is a blue portable office and a blue storage container, with a SANY excavator visible behind them. The terrain is uneven, with mounds of earth and a partially cleared landscape surrounding the site.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台显眼的塔式起重机，其吊臂横跨整个画面。前景处有各种建筑材料，包括黄色脚手架和木托盘。左侧有一台蓝色移动办公和蓝色储物箱，其后方可见一台挖掘机。地形平坦，周围环绕着泥土堆和部分开阔的景观地。

text: The image shows a water truck in the center, actively spraying water on the ground, likely for dust control on the construction site. In the foreground, there is a wet, muddy surface, indicating recent water spraying activity. To the right, there is a pile of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks. In the background, there are multiple green portable toilets lined up, and beyond them, a clear sky.
zh: 画面中央是一辆洒水车，正在向地面喷水，很可能用于施工现场的降尘作业。前景是一片潮湿滑的泥地，表明近期有洒水活动。右侧堆放着一堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。背景中排列着多个绿色移动厕所，再往后方是一片晴朗的天空。

text: The image shows three individuals at a construction site with red soil. One person is kneeling and digging, another is observing, and the third is holding a clipboard and pen. The terrain is uneven with tire tracks, and there's a green net barrier in the background atop an excavated area.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有三个人，地面是红土。一人跪着在挖掘，另一人在观察，第三人拿着写字板和笔。地形是平坦的，有轮胎轨道，背景中有一个绿色网围栏在挖掘区域的上方。

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers visible among extensive scaffolding under a concrete structure. Two workers are interacting in the center, while others are dispersed across the scaffolding, either walking or standing. There is a large column on the left, and the foreground shows a stack of construction materials, including wooden planks and poles.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，在大面积脚手架下方可见六名工人。其中两名工人在画面中央互动，其余工人分散在脚手架各处，或行走或站立。左侧有一根大型立柱，前景显示一堆建筑材料，包括木托盘和杆。

text: The image shows an interior construction site with metal scaffolding in the center and two workers on the right side. The workers are wearing hard hats and are near a pile of construction materials. There are multiple bundles of rebars on the floor, some of which are red. The structure has several columns and beams with visible fireproofing material applied, and the ceiling is composed of metal decking.
zh: 图像显示一个内部施工现场，中央有金属脚手架，右侧有两名工人。工人戴着安全帽，靠近一堆建筑材料。地板上有几根钢筋，其中一些是红色的。结构上有几根柱子和梁，可见防火材料已应用，天花板由金属护板组成。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation supported by sheet piles. There are six workers visible; three are wearing orange safety vests and are positioned within the excavation, while the other three are wearing yellow hard hats and are located at different points around the site. An excavator is operating near the top edge of the excavation, and various construction materials, including wood planks and metal rebars, are scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个由钢板桩支撑的大型基坑的施工现场。可以看到六名工人；其中三名穿着橙色安全背心，位于基坑内部，另外三名戴着黄色安全帽，分布在工地的不同位置。一台挖掘机正在基坑上边缘附近作业，各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属钢筋，散落在工地周围。

text: The image shows a construction site where paving work is in progress. There are three workers visible; one is laying bricks on the ground, another is kneeling and appears to be preparing or adjusting the bricks, and the third is standing and holding a notepad or similar item. The ground is partially covered with laid bricks, and there are piles of bricks and sand scattered around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，铺路作业正在进行进行。可见三名工人；其中一人在地面上铺砖，另一人跪着，似乎正在准备或调整砖块，第三人站着，手里拿着一本记事本或类似物品。地面部分已被铺好的砖覆盖，现场周围散落着砖堆和沙堆。

err.zh: 铺路作业正在进行进行

text: The image shows a large dump truck in the center with its bed raised, indicating it is either unloading or has unloaded its contents. Two individuals are standing to the right of the truck, engaged in a discussion. On the left side of the truck, there are three smaller vehicles parked along the side of the road. In the background, large concrete pipes are stacked beside the road, and construction activity is suggested by the presence of structures and cranes in the far distance.
zh: 画面中央是一辆大型自卸卡车，其货箱处于升起状态，表明该车要么未装载货物，要么已卸其内容。卡车右侧有两人正站立交，似乎在讨论。卡车左侧路边停靠着停放着三辆小型车辆。背景中，大型混凝土管道堆放在路边，远处可见结构及起重机暗示着施工活动。

err.en: either unloading or has unloaded its con
err.zh: 要么未装载货物，要么已卸其内容

err.en: parked along the side of the road

text: The image shows a large excavation site with two excavators at work on the right side, one of which is actively digging. On the left, two workers are present; one is sitting on the ground while the other appears to be using surveying equipment. The site is bordered by a tall retaining wall made of vertical sheet piles.
zh: 图像显示一个大型开挖场地，右侧有两名挖掘机正在作业，其中一台正在积极挖掘。左侧有两名工人；一人坐在地上，另一人似乎正在使用测量设备。该场地由一道高大的挡土墙围护，该墙由竖直钢板桩构成。

text: The image shows a group of six individuals wearing hard hats and safety vests gathered on a construction site with a large black corrugated pipe in the background. The terrain appears to be uneven with visible soil and debris. In the background, a yellow excavator is partially visible behind the trees.
zh: 图像显示六个人戴着安全帽和反光背心，聚集在一个建筑工地上，背景中有一根大型黑色波纹管。地形看起来是平坦的，可见土壤和碎石。背景中，一台黄色挖掘机部分可见，位于树木后面。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the center, wearing a red hard hat and carrying a tool. There are large concrete blocks on the ground, with three of them placed on a raised platform made of metal beams. The ground is uneven with visible excavation work having been done.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中央有一名工人，头戴红色安全帽，肩扛着一件工具。地面上有大块混凝土，其中三块放置在由金属梁搭建的高台上。地面平整，可见挖掘工作已经完成。

text: The image shows a large construction site with multiple activities underway. There are two crawler cranes in operation, one in the center and one towards the right, with several workers around them. There are also two piling rigs in the middle and right of the site, with workers operating or supervising the equipment. The ground is muddy with standing water in several areas. Construction materials, such as piles and sheets, are visible on the site.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，有多项作业正在进行进行。有两台履带起重机正在作业，一台位于中央，另一台偏向右侧，周围有多名工人。工地中央和右侧还有两台打桩机，有工人正在操作或监督这些设备。地面泥泞湿，多处区域有积水。建筑材料，如堆料和板材，在工地上可见。

err.zh: 多项作业正在进行进行

text: The image shows a construction site with various heavy machinery in operation. In the foreground, there is a green dump truck filled with soil, and another similar truck is visible to the right. Between these trucks, a yellow bulldozer is actively moving earth. A blue crawler crane is positioned in the center background, with its boom extended upwards. In the far background, construction activity is evident with additional machinery and structures, including what appears to be a tower crane. The ground is uneven with mounds of soil, indicative of excavation or earthmoving activities.
zh: 画面显示一个正在进行施工作的大型机械施工现场。前景处有一辆装满泥土的绿色自卸卡车，右侧可见另一辆类似的卡车。在这些卡车之间，一台黄色推土机正在积极移动泥土。一台蓝色爬行者起重机位于背景中央，其吊臂向上延伸。在遥远的背景中，施工活动明显，包括似乎一台塔式起重机。地面是均匀的，带有土堆，指示挖掘或移土活动。

err.en: a construction site with various heavy m
err.zh: 一个正在进行施工作的大型机械施工现场

text: The image shows a multi-level construction site with scaffolding. There are three workers visible; two are on the scaffolding wearing red overalls and safety helmets, while one is on the ground level wearing a blue shirt and white helmet. A concrete pump with an extended boom is positioned on the right side of the image. There are various construction materials and equipment scattered around the site, including wood planks, a generator, and a portable toilet.
zh: 图像显示一个多层建筑施工现场，设有脚手架。画面中可见三名工人；其中两人位于脚手架上，身穿红色工装并佩戴安全帽，另一人则站在地面上，身着蓝色上衣并佩戴白色安全帽。一台混凝土泵，其顶部装有延伸管，位于画面右侧。现场周围散落着各种建筑材料与设备，包括木托盘、一台发电机以及一台便携式厕所。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers visible. One worker is standing on the ground near the center, wearing a yellow hard hat and is seemingly inspecting or supervising. Another worker is on the left, wearing a green jacket and a hard hat, working with a piece of construction material. The third worker is on the right, also wearing a hard hat, and is positioned on top of a structure with exposed rebar, appearing to be engaged in some activity related to the construction process. In the foreground, there are wooden planks and construction materials.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，可见三名工人。一名工人站在靠近中心的地面上，头戴黄色安全帽，似乎正在检查或监督。另一名工人位于左侧，身穿绿色外套，头戴安全帽，正在处理一块建筑材料。第三名工人位于右侧，同样头戴安全帽，站在一个露出钢筋的结构顶部，似乎正从事与施工过程相关的的活动。前景处有木托盘和建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction site where two workers are engaged in activities related to concrete reinforcement. The worker in the foreground, wearing a yellow hard hat and a high-visibility lime green shirt paired with orange pants and camouflage boots, is tying rebar with a tool. They are standing within a concrete structure with exposed rebar protruding vertically, indicating ongoing work on a foundation or wall. There are wooden formworks visible, and the ground around the work area is uneven and muddy.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，两名工人正在进行与混凝土钢筋相关的作业。前景处的工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿高能见度荧光绿上衣，搭配橙色长裤和迷彩靴，正用工具绑扎钢筋。他们站在一个混凝土结构内，外露的钢筋垂直伸出，表明正在进行基础或墙体面的施工。可见有木质模板，作业区域地面平整且泥泞滑。

err.en: the ground around the work area is uneve
err.zh: 作业区域地面平整且泥泞滑

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers engaged in activities. There are at least six workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats. They are spread across the site, working on what appears to be a foundation with steel reinforcement bars in place for concrete to be poured.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事作业。可见至少六名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽。他们分散在工地各处，正在对一处钢筋配筋的混凝土基础进行浇筑作业。

err.en: with steel reinforcement bars in place f
err.zh: 正在对一处钢筋配筋的混凝土基础进行浇筑作业

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers on a floor being prepared for concrete pouring, evident by the grid of rebar laid out. One worker is moving a wheelbarrow, while the other is bending over, possibly tying rebar or adjusting its position.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，两名工人正在为混凝土浇筑做准备，从铺设好的钢筋网的可以看出。一名工人正在搬运钢筋，另一名工人正弯腰，可能在绑扎钢筋或调整其位置。

text: The image shows a construction site with one visible front loader moving a pile of dirt. The operator is inside the cabin of the front loader, which is positioned in the center of the frame. The ground appears to be uneven with exposed earth, suggesting excavation or earthmoving activities.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，一台可见的前装载机正在搬运一堆泥土。操作员位于前装载机驾驶室内部，该驾驶室处于画面中央位置。地面看起来是平整的，露出泥土，表明正在进行挖掘或土方搬运作业。

err.en: The ground appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with a large excavation area. There are seven workers visible; four are on the left side working on or near a formwork structure with vertical and horizontal rebar in place, and three are on the right side, with one worker climbing a ladder out of the excavation. The site is surrounded by retaining walls, and there is a body of water in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一处大型开挖区域。可见七名工人；四名在左侧，正在或靠近一处带有竖向和水平钢筋的构造处作业，另外三名在右侧，其中一名工人正从开挖区域爬下梯子。该场地被挡土墙环绕，背景中有一处水体。

err.en: climbing a ladder out of the excavation
err.zh: 正从开挖区域爬下梯子

text: The image shows a construction site with earthmoving activities. There are three dump trucks in the foreground, with an excavator positioned to the left, actively loading soil into the central truck's open bed. The terrain is uneven and consists of exposed earth. In the background, another excavator is visible, working on a mound of soil.
zh: 图像显示一个正在进行土方作业的的建筑施工现场。前景中有三辆自卸卡车，左侧有一台挖掘机，正在将泥土装载到中间卡车的敞开的车厢内。地形平坦，由裸露出的土构成。背景中可见另一台挖掘机，正在一堆土丘上作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, actively digging or moving earth. There are at least five workers visible, with one operating the excavator, one standing close to the excavator's arm, and others scattered around the site. The ground is uneven with visible puddles of water and mud, and there are piles of construction materials and debris around the site.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台挖掘机正在积极挖掘或搬运泥土。可见至少五名工人，其中一人操作挖掘机，一人站在挖掘机臂旁，其余人分散在场地周围。地面平整，可见水坑和泥浆，场地周围有建筑材料和碎屑堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with scaffolding erected alongside a building under construction. There are two workers visible on the scaffolding; one is standing on an upper level, and the other is on a lower level. Both workers are wearing safety helmets. Below the scaffolding, there are various construction materials, including wooden planks and metal beams.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，脚手架搭建在一栋在建建筑旁。脚手架上有两名工人可见；一人站在较高处，另一人站在较低处。两名工人都戴着安全帽。脚手架下方，有各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属梁。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a worker in a purple vest and yellow hard hat is operating a bending machine to shape rebars. Several bundles of straight and bent rebars are laid out on the ground around the machine. In the middle of the image, a group of workers, all wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests, are handling and organizing rebar materials. A covered storage area with blue tarp and additional construction materials is visible in the background.
