zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种活动。前景中，一名身穿紫色背心心和黄色安全帽的工人正在操作一台弯曲机，以成型钢筋。几束直钢筋和弯钢筋被铺在机器周围的地面上。画面中部，一群工人，全都戴着黄色安全帽和安全背心，正在处理和整理钢筋材料。背景中可见一个用蓝色防水布覆盖的存储区域，以及额外的建筑材料。

text: The image shows a construction or excavation site with four workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, one worker is using a hose, possibly for water jetting, while another stands beside him holding a shovel. In the background, one worker is climbing a makeshift ladder, and another is standing on an elevated platform. The site is cluttered with rocks and debris, and there is a metal barrier or retaining structure in the background.
zh: 图像显示一个施工或挖掘现场，有四名工人正在从事各种活动。在前景中，一名工人正在使用软管，可能用于水射，而另一名工人站在他身旁，手持一把铁锹。在背景中，一名工人正在攀爬一架简易的梯子，而另一名工人则站在一个高架平台上。该现场杂乱乱，遍布着岩石和碎屑，并且在背景中有一道金属屏障或挡土墙。

err.en: The site is cluttered with rocks and deb

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving materials. In the foreground, there is a pile of construction debris, including bricks and wooden planks. To the left, there are temporary site buildings and stacked construction materials such as wood. In the background, there are high-rise buildings and a tower crane.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台推土机正在作业，积极搬运物料。前景处有一堆建筑废料，包括砖块和木托盘。左侧有临时工棚和堆放的建筑材料，如木材。背景处有高层建筑和塔吊。

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker in the foreground, standing on a scaffold and holding a tool. The worker is wearing a yellow hard hat, an orange safety vest, and gloves. In the background, there is an extensive network of rebar and formwork, indicating the preparation for concrete pouring.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，前景中有一名工人站在脚手架上，手持工具。该工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿橙色安全背心，并戴着手手套。背景中可见一个由钢筋和模板组成的的大网络，表明正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。

text: The image shows a large construction site with numerous workers engaged in various activities. Workers are scattered across the site, some are walking while others are bending or crouching, likely tying rebar or preparing formwork. In the background, there are several high-rise buildings under construction, and a large retaining wall is visible on the left side of the image. The construction site appears to be well-organized with designated pathways and work areas.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，众多工人正从事各种作业。工人分散在工地各处，有的正在行走，有的则在弯曲或呼喊，很可能是在绑扎钢筋或准备模板作业。背景中可见几栋正在施工的高层建筑，图像左侧有一面大型挡土墙。该建筑工地看起来组织有序，设有专门的通道和作业区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with various activities in progress. In the foreground, an excavator is loading dirt into the back of a dump truck. To the right, a crawler crane with a long boom is positioned, possibly preparing for a lift. In the background, another excavator is operating near a pile of dirt, and there are several construction vehicles, including a water truck and another dump truck. Buildings and trees can be seen in the far distance, indicating the proximity of the construction site to a developed area.
zh: 画面显示一个建设工地，各项作业正在推进。前景中，一台挖掘机正将泥土装载到一辆自卸卡车的后部。右侧，一台履带式起重机吊着一根长杆，位置可能正准备起吊作业。背景中，另一台挖掘机正在一堆泥土附近作业，并且有多辆施工车辆，包括一辆水罐车和另一辆自卸卡车。远处可以看到建筑物和树木，表明该建设工地邻近一个发达区域。

err.en: with a long boom is positioned

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. There is one operator visible inside the bulldozer's cabin. To the left of the bulldozer, there is one individual sitting on the ground, seemingly observing the work or taking a break. The surrounding area is characterized by uneven terrain with piles of dirt and debris, including tree branches and roots.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台正在进行土方作业的的工程推土机。推土机驾驶室内可见一名操作人员。推土机左侧，有一人坐在地面上，似乎正在观察作业或休息。周围区域地形平坦，伴有土堆和碎石，包括树枝和树根。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with two excavators positioned diagonally from each other. The ground appears to be uneven with various textures, possibly indicating different materials or stages of groundwork.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地的航拍视角，两台挖掘机呈对角相对位置。地面看起来较为平整，但具有不同的纹理，可能表明不同的材料或地基土处理阶段。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple levels of scaffolding and formwork. There are at least ten workers visible, wearing hard hats and safety vests, engaged in various construction activities on the scaffolding. Green safety netting is draped over parts of the structure to catch debris or tools. Construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, are scattered across the site. The background reveals the exterior wall of a building with incomplete masonry work.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多层脚手架和模板。可以看到至少十名工人，戴着安全帽和穿着安全背心，在脚手架上进行着各种建筑活动。绿色安全网被悬挂起在结构的一部分以捕捉碎片屑或工具。建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘，散落在工地各处。背景揭示了一栋建筑的的内墙，有着完整的砌砖工作。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the foreground, positioned on a dirt surface with its bucket raised. In the background, a pile driver is visible, standing vertically.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一台挖掘机停在一处土堆表面，其铲斗已抬起。背景中可见一摲驾驶员，垂直竖立。

err.en: a pile driver is visible, standing verti
err.zh: 可见一摲驾驶员，垂直竖立

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of activities and equipment. In the foreground, there are multiple piles of earth with two green dump trucks, one of which is unloading soil. A worker is visible in the center, standing near the earth piles. In the midground, there is a crawler crane positioned to the left, and several pieces of construction equipment, including an orange excavator, are scattered across the site. In the background, multiple tower cranes are visible, indicating ongoing construction.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有多种活动和设备。前景处有多个土堆，旁边有两辆绿色自卸卡车，其中一辆未装载泥土。一名工人可见于画面中央，站在土堆附近。中景处有一台履带起重机位于左侧，以及多件施工设备，包括一台橙色挖掘机，散落在工地各处。背景中可见多座塔楼，表明施工正在进行进行。

err.en: one of which is unloading soil

err.zh: 表明施工正在进行进行

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor operating on a dirt surface within a construction site, compacting the ground. There are four individuals visible; three are standing atop a concrete structure on the right side, while another person is on the ground level to the left of the compactor.
zh: 图中显示一名黄色土施工机械操作员正在建筑工地的表面上操作，压实地面。可见有四个人；其中三人站在右侧混凝土结构上，而另一人则位于机械操作员左侧的地面上。

err.zh: 黄色土施工机械操作员
操作员正在建筑工地的表面上操作

text: The image shows a construction site with two tower cranes in the center and background. Approximately 20 workers are visible, most of them concentrated around the central area where there is a structure with yellow railings. The workers are engaged in various activities, likely related to construction tasks. The ground is covered with blue tarps, and there are several construction materials and equipment scattered across the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中央有两台塔式起重机，背景为天空。画面中可见约二十名工人，其中大部分集中在中央区域，该区域设有黄色护栏。工人们在从事各种活动，很可能与施工任务相关。地面覆盖着蓝色防水布，现场散落着若干建筑材料和设备。

err.zh: 中央有两台塔式起重机，背景为天空

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in operation. The excavator on the right is yellow and fully visible, engaged in digging or moving earth. The ground is uneven with visible piles of dug-up soil.
zh: 图中显示一个施工场地，有两名挖掘机正在作业。右侧的挖掘机是黄色的，且完全可见，正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土。地面平整，可见堆着挖出的来的的一堆堆土。

err.zh: 挖出的来的的一堆堆土

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing raincoats and hard hats. They are spreading concrete over a rebar mesh on the floor. A tower crane is visible in the background, and there are various construction materials and equipment scattered around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，五名工人戴着安全帽和硬帽。他们正在将混凝土铺在地板上的钢筋网。背景中可见一台塔式起重机，现场周围散落着各种建筑材料和设备。

text: The image shows an excavator in the center with two workers nearby, one on each side of the excavator. Behind the excavator, there is a pile-driving machine with another worker beside it. In the background, there are several vertical elements that resemble piles or columns, and some construction sheds. The ground is uneven with visible earthwork, and there are piles of dirt throughout the site.
zh: 画面中央是一台挖掘机，其两侧各有一名工人。挖掘机后方是一台钻机，其旁也有一名工人。背景中可见若干垂直元素，形似土堆或立柱，还有一些施工棚。地面平整，可见土方工作业，且整个工地遍布着土堆。

text: The image shows five workers at a construction site, all wearing hard hats, with four of them focused on a task against a large concrete wall. There is a set of blueprints on a flat surface in the foreground, and the ground is scattered with small construction materials.
zh: 画面显示五名建筑工地的工人，全都戴着安全帽，其中四人正专注于对抗一面巨大的混凝土墙的任务。前景中有一组蓝图印，地面则散落着小型建筑材料。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with a single excavator in the center, positioned on a grey, uneven surface. Two workers wearing high-visibility clothing are visible towards the right edge of the image, standing near what seems to be a pile of construction materials.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角，画面中央有一台挖掘机，停放在灰色、平整的地面上。两名身穿高能见度服装的工人位于画面右侧边缘附近，站在看似一堆建筑材料旁。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, its arm extended and bucket touching the ground. There is a single operator visible inside the excavator's cabin. In the background, one worker is standing on the elevated dirt ground. The terrain appears muddy and uneven, with power lines and towers visible in the far background, along with some vegetation and a clear sky.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，其臂架和铲斗正接触着地面。驾驶室内可见一名操作人员。背景中，一名工人正站立在高起的的地面上。地形显得泥泞滑且平坦，远处可见电力线及塔楼，并伴有一些植被与晴朗的天空。

err.en: its arm extended and bucket touching the
err.zh: 其臂架和铲斗正接触着地面

text: The image shows a construction site with excavated earth and a clear sky. In the foreground, a yellow excavator is positioned on the left, with its boom and bucket resting on the ground. In the middle ground, there is another yellow excavator operating, with its boom extended and bucket raised. To the right, a white tanker truck is parked, and further back, a third excavator is visible with its arm extended upwards. The terrain is uneven with visible tire tracks, and there are piles of excavated soil throughout the site.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，有挖掘出的土和晴朗的天空。前景左侧有一台黄色挖掘机，其动臂和铲斗放置在地面上。中间地面上有另一台黄色挖掘机正在作业，其动臂伸展且铲斗抬起。右侧停着一辆白色罐车，更远处可见第三台挖掘机，其动臂向上伸展。地形平坦，可见轮胎轨迹，且整个场地散布着堆堆的挖掘土。

text: In the image, there is a teal-colored excavator positioned on an uneven dirt terrain, actively engaged in earthmoving operations, with visible dust around its bucket indicating recent activity. Behind the excavator, there is a slope with vegetation at the top. In the background, a white perimeter fence is visible, and beyond the fence, there are two large pipes laid on the ground parallel to each other. The foreground shows the excavated area with loose soil and rocks.
zh: 画面中，一台青绿色的挖掘机停放在平坦的泥土地地上，正在进行土方作业，铲斗周围可见扬尘，表明其近期处于活跃作业状态。挖掘机后方是一片长有植被的斜坡地。背景中可见一道白色周边围栏，围栏外有两根大管道平行铺设于地面。前景展示了开挖区域，伴有松散泥土与岩石。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow excavator positioned on a mound of earth in the center. There are no visible workers in the immediate vicinity of the excavator. The foreground is dominated by uneven, dug-up soil, and there is a black corrugated pipe partially buried in the dirt.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，一台黄色挖掘机停放在中央的一堆土堆上。挖掘机附近没有可见的工人。前景主要由平整的、挖掘过的泥土占据，还有一根黑色波纹状管道部分埋于泥土中。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single crawler drill rig positioned in the center, on a patch of dirt and mud. The drill rig appears to be idle, with no visible operator or ongoing activity. In the background, there is a bridge with an arched structure spanning over the site. The terrain around the drill rig is uneven and there are piles of excavated soil.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，中心位置有一台单钻机钻机架，放置在一片泥土和泥浆的补丁上。钻机架似乎处于闲置状态，没有可见操作人员或正在进行的活动。背景中有一座拱形桥梁横跨整个场地。钻机架周围的地形平坦，并且有堆挖出的土。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple levels of activity. On the left, there are three workers on a sloped roof covered with red panels; they appear to be installing or securing the panels. Below them, on a concrete platform, several workers are engaged in various tasks amidst construction materials and debris. A large yellow crane is positioned towards the center-right, extending over an unfinished structure where a group of workers is gathered on the top level.
zh: 画面显示一个施工工地，有多处作业活动。左侧有三名工人在倾斜的屋顶上，屋顶覆盖着红色面板；他们似乎正在安装或固定这些面板。在他们下方，在一个混凝土平台上，几名工人正忙于各种任务，周围是建筑材料和碎屑。一台大型黄色起重机位于中右方，伸向一个已完工的结构，那里有一组工人聚集在顶层。

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of equipment and materials. In the center, there is a large crawler crane with its boom extended upwards. To the left of the crane, there is a yellow bulldozer and a pile of orange construction tubes on the ground. In front of these tubes, there is a blue truck. To the right of the crane, there is a yellow excavator and a green dump truck facing the camera. There are also multiple piles of black and green pipes scattered across the site.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，现场有各种设备和材料。画面中央有一台大型履带起重机，其吊臂向上延伸。在起重机的左侧，有一台黄色推土机和一堆橙色施工管在地面上。在这些管子的前面，有一辆蓝色卡车。在起重机右侧，有一台黄色挖掘机和一辆绿色泵车面向镜头。现场还散落着多堆黑色和绿色管子。

text: The image shows a construction site with a dirt road in the foreground, characterized by tire marks. On the right side of the road, there is a green dump truck parked with its bed raised, suggesting it is unloading material. The background features a large, excavated slope with no visible vegetation.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景是一条土路，带有轮胎压痕。道路右侧停着一辆绿色自卸卡车，其车厢板升起，暗示其未装载物料。背景为一处大型开挖边坡坡，未见明显植被。

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of heavy machinery and vehicles. In the center, there is a large pile driver with its boom extended vertically. To the left, there are two green dump trucks, and behind them, a yellow excavator is visible. Another yellow excavator is located to the right of the pile driver, and further to the right, there is a sedan parked on the dirt ground. In the background, multiple tower cranes are present, indicating a large-scale construction project. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, and scattered debris can be seen across the site.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，现场分布着多种重型机械和车辆。画面中央有一大堆土方，其土堆垂直延伸。左侧停着两辆绿色自卸卡车，其后方可见一台黄色挖掘机。另一台黄色挖掘机位于土堆右侧，再往右，有一辆轿车停放在泥地上。背景中可见多台塔吊，表明这是一个大规模施工项目。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹，且散落着碎屑遍布整个工地。

err.en: large pile driver with its boom extended
err.zh: 一大堆土方，其土堆垂直延伸

text: The image shows a construction site with a dense backdrop of green foliage. In the foreground, there are construction materials, including blue plastic pallets, wooden planks, and rebars, some of which are covered with a blue tarp. Two workers wearing red hard hats are visible; one is standing near the edge of the site, while the other is slightly further back.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，背景是茂密的绿色植被。前景有建筑材料，包括蓝色塑料托盘、木托盘和钢筋，其中一些覆盖着蓝色防水布。可以看到两名戴着红色安全帽的工人；一名站在工地边缘附近，另一名则稍微靠后。

text: The image shows a single dump truck parked on a dirt road with its bed raised, indicating it may have been unloading material. Behind the truck is a large, excavated earthen area with a steep slope.
zh: 图像显示一辆单轴卡车停放在土路上，其货箱已升起，表明可能已卸载货物。卡车后方是一片大型开挖的露天区域，带有陡峭坡。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, actively digging or moving earth. There are three workers in orange safety gear near the center of the image, standing on the ground within a dug-out area that is enclosed by retaining walls. To the right, there is a yellow dump truck parked next to a stockpile of construction materials.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心有一台挖掘机正在积极挖掘或搬运泥土。在图像中心附近，有三名穿着橙色安全装备的工人，站在挖掘区域内，该区域由挡土墙围住。在右侧，有一辆黄色泵车停在一堆建筑材料旁。

text: The image shows an excavation site with a large yellow excavator operating on the right side, positioned on an elevated dirt mound and actively digging. Two individuals are present on the site; one is standing near the center, observing the work, and the other is on the right side, closer to the excavator. A concrete culvert section is visible in the foreground with water inside, and colorful flags are strung across the site.
zh: 图像显示一个挖掘现场，一台大型黄色挖掘机在右侧作业，停在一处较高的土堆上，正在积极挖掘。现场有两个人；一人站在靠近中心的位置，正在观察作业，另一人位于右侧，更靠近挖掘机。前景中可见一段混凝土立柱，内部有水，并且彩旗横跨整个场地飘扬。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing hard hats and safety vests; one is standing on a concrete surface holding a tool, while the other is working with equipment near a trench. In the foreground, there is a pile of construction materials including rebars, bricks, and wooden planks.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人戴着安全帽和反光背心；其中一人站在混凝土表面上，手里拿着一件工具，而另一人正在一个沟槽附近使用设备工作。在前景中，有一堆建筑材料，包括钢筋、砖块和木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large area of reinforced steel bars laid out on the ground, forming the foundation for a structure. There are seven workers visible, all wearing safety vests and hard hats; one is in the foreground working on the rebar, while three pairs of workers are engaged in discussions or overseeing the work at different points across the site. In the background, there is a covered slope with blue tarpaulin, and construction machinery is partially visible on the upper level, with an excavator at work.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面上铺设着大面积的钢筋，形成建筑物的基础。可见七名工人，均身着安全背心心和硬帽；其中一名在前景操作钢筋，同时三对工人在不同地点参与讨论或监督工作。背景中有一处覆盖着蓝色防水布的斜坡，并且施工机械部分可见于上层，带着一台挖掘机正在作业。

text: The image shows a water truck with a blue tank in the center, connected to a hose that is laid out across a large concrete surface. To the right of the water truck, there is a yellow vibratory soil compactor. The construction site appears to be in the process of surface preparation or curing, indicated by the water truck's presence and the pattern of moisture on the concrete.
zh: 图中显示一辆水罐车，其蓝色罐体位于中央，并连接着一根横跨大面积混凝土表面的铺设的软管。在水罐车的右侧，有一个黄色振动器土构件。该施工现场似乎处于表面准备或养护阶段，这由水罐车的在场以及混凝土上的湿气迹所表明。

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators in the center and right side of the frame, positioned near a body of water. In the foreground, there are various construction materials, including large concrete pipes, rectangular concrete blocks, and metal sheets lying on the ground. The terrain appears to be uneven with exposed earth, suggesting recent excavation work.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，画面中央和右侧各有一名挖掘机，靠近一处水体。前景处有各种建筑材料，包括大型混凝土管道、方形混凝土块以及平铺在地面上的的一些金属板。地形看起来较为平整，有裸露出的土，暗示近期进行过挖掘作业。

text: The image shows a construction worker wearing an orange shirt and a yellow hard hat tying rebar at a construction site. The worker is focused on assembling the steel reinforcement, which is laid out in a grid pattern on the ground.
zh: 图中显示一名建筑工人身穿橙色上衣，头戴黄色安全帽，正在建筑工地上按网格状铺设钢筋。

err.en: tying rebar at a construction site
err.zh: 正在建筑工地上按网格状铺设钢筋

err.en: The worker is focused on assembling the

text: The image shows a construction site with an orange excavator positioned in the center. The excavator is not currently in operation. In the foreground, there are scattered construction materials, including green pipes and white debris. The background features a partially obscured landscape with buildings and vegetation under an overcast sky.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一台橙色挖掘机位于画面中央。该挖掘机目前并未处于作业状态。前景处散落着建筑材料，包括绿色管道和黑色碎屑。背景中可见部分被遮挡的景观，有建筑物和植被，上方是阴沉的天色。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom over a foundation area. The truck is branded "SANY" on its rotating drum. There is a wet concrete surface indicating recent pouring activity, and various construction materials are scattered around the site. A tower crane is visible in the background, and the environment appears muddy, suggesting recent rain or ongoing work that has churned the soil.
zh: 图中显示一处混凝土施工现场，一辆混凝土泵车正将其料斗（boom）延伸至基础区域上方。该卡车旋转鼓上标有“Sany”字样。现场存在湿润的混凝土表面，表明近期有浇筑作业，且工地周边散落着各类建筑材料。背景中可见一台塔式起重机，环境显得泥泞污，暗示近期降雨或持续作业已搅动土壤。

text: The image shows a concrete mixer truck positioned next to a steel reinforcement structure, with its chute extended towards the rebar framework, suggesting that concrete is being poured. A worker wearing a red hard hat and blue shirt is standing within the rebar structure, likely monitoring or guiding the concrete pouring process.
zh: 一辆混凝土搅拌车正驶向钢筋结构，其料斗朝向钢筋框架，暗示混凝土正在浇筑。一名头戴红色安全帽、身穿蓝色上衣的工人正站在钢筋结构内，很可能在监控或引导混凝土浇筑过程。

text: The image shows a close-up view of a construction site where two workers are handling cylindrical concrete samples. The samples are placed on a wooden surface, and one of the workers is using a tool to work on a sample.
zh: 图片显示的是施工现场混凝土试块的特写视图。两个试块被放置在木质表面上，其中一个试块使用工具在试块上工作。

err.en: two workers are handling cylindrical con
err.zh: 两个试块被放置在木质表面上

err.en: one of the workers is using a tool to wo
err.zh: 其中一个试块使用工具在试块上工作

text: The image shows a teal-colored excavator on a construction site with its boom and bucket not visible in the frame. The excavator is positioned on a dirt surface with visible tracks indicating movement. In the background, there is a body of water and a flat expanse of land that appears to be part of the construction site.
zh: 画面中，一台青绿色的挖掘机停在一处建筑工地上，其履带和铲斗在画面中不可见。挖掘机位于一片可见车辙的泥土地壤表面上，表明其正在移动。背景中，有一片水域和一片平坦的土地区域，看起来是建筑工地的组成部分。

text: The image shows a construction site with two workers wearing hard hats and safety vests. One worker in the foreground is measuring or marking a concrete block, while the other, in the background, is handling a hose or cable. There are multiple construction materials scattered around, including bricks, concrete blocks, and metal rods. A tower crane is visible in the background, and there are several unfinished structures around the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有两名工人戴着安全帽和穿着安全背心。前景中的一名工人正在测量或标记一块混凝土块，而另一名在背景中正在处理一根软管或电缆。周围散落着多种建筑材料，包括砖块、混凝土块和金属杆。背景中可见一台塔式起重机，并且周围有几座已完工的结构。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a large construction site with multiple buildings at various stages of construction. In the center, there is a concrete pump truck with its boom extended over a foundation area where concrete is being poured. Several construction vehicles, including trucks and a concrete mixer, are visible on the site. The buildings appear to be multi-story structures with exposed frameworks, indicating ongoing work. The surrounding area is cleared and graded, with dirt roads and paths intersecting the site.
zh: 图像显示了一个大型建筑工地的鸟巢视图，多栋建筑处于不同的施工阶段。画面中央有一辆混凝土泵车，其卸料斗伸出正在浇筑混凝土的基础区域上方。现场可见多台施工车辆，包括卡车和混凝土搅拌车。建筑呈现多层结构，外露框架，表明施工正在进行中。周边区域平整实，有土路及路径与工地交叉。

text: The image shows a construction site viewed from above, with four workers visible. Three workers are walking across the site, while one is handling materials. There are multiple stacks of construction materials, including wooden planks and metal rods, organized in different areas. Scaffolding structures are erected in the center, and there's a large area covered with wire mesh on the bottom left.
zh: 画面显示从上方俯瞰的建筑工地的，可见四名工人。三名工人正横过工地，其中一人正在搬运材料。现场堆放着多堆建筑材料，包括木托盘和金属杆，分布在不同区域。脚手架结构搭建在中央，左下方有一大片被钢丝网覆盖的大面积。

err.en: Three workers are walking across the sit
err.zh: 三名工人正横过工地，其中一人正在搬运材料。

text: The image shows a construction site where a large group of workers, all wearing safety vests and hard hats, are engaged in activities related to rebar installation for a foundation or similar structure. The workers are spread out across the area, some bending over the rebar framework, while others are standing and appear to be coordinating or supervising the work. There are several stockpiles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, within the site.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，一大群工人均身着安全背心、头戴安全帽，正从事基础或类似结构的的重钢框架的安装作业。工人分散于整个区域，部分人弯腰跨越重钢框架，另一些人站立，似在协调或监督工作。现场存在若干堆建筑材料，包括钢筋与木托盘。

text: The image shows a large construction site with numerous cylindrical concrete foundations in the foreground, indicating preparation for a structure with multiple columns. There are several workers scattered across the site, engaged in various activities related to construction. The ground is uneven with visible earthwork, and there are green protective covers on some areas, possibly for erosion control or to cover materials.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，前景中有许多圆柱形混凝土基础，表明正在为多柱结构做准备。现场有多名工人分散在各处，从事与施工相关的活动。地面平整，可见土方工作业，部分区域覆盖有绿色防护布，可能用于防侵蚀或遮盖材料。

text: The image shows a yellow wheel loader in the center, actively engaged in moving earth. The loader is facing right, with its bucket partially submerged in a mound of soil, suggesting excavation or earth-moving activities. Large piles of reddish-brown soil dominate the background, while the foreground shows a muddy, uneven surface with some standing water.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色轮式装载机，正在进行土方作业。装载机朝向右侧，其铲斗部分浸入土堆中，表明正在进行挖掘或土方搬运作业。背景中占据主导地位的是大堆红褐色土壤，前景则显示泥泞滑、平整的表面，并伴有部分积水。

text: The image shows a construction or excavation site with one orange excavator operating in the center-right area. There are no visible workers in the immediate vicinity of the excavator. The foreground is characterized by uneven terrain with scattered vegetation and debris, including white materials that appear to be construction waste.
zh: 图像显示一处施工或挖掘场地，一台橙色挖掘机在右侧区域作业。挖掘机附近没有可见工人。前景地形平坦，散布着植被和碎屑，包括看似建筑废料的在内的。

err.en: including white materials that appear to
err.zh: 包括看似建筑废料的在内的

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers and various construction materials. Several workers are visible throughout the site; a few are walking across the site, while others are engaged in tasks near the rebars and materials. In the middle ground, there is a partially constructed building with scaffolding, and more workers can be seen on and around the structure.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人和多种建筑材料。几名工人在整个工地上可见；几名在工棚和材料附近从事任务。在中间地面上，有一栋部分建成的建筑，带有脚手架，并且更多工人可以在周围看到。

err.en: a few are walking across the site, while
err.zh: 几名在工棚和材料附近从事任务

text: The worker in the foreground is wearing a straw hat but not a hard hat.
zh: 前景中的工人戴着一顶草帽，而非硬草帽。

text: The image shows a piece of red construction equipment, possibly a pile driver, positioned in front of a large mound of earth. The ground is scattered with debris, including rocks and what appears to be construction waste. A small body of water is visible in the lower right corner, and the background is dominated by the earthen mound and green foliage.
zh: 图中显示一台红色施工设备，疑似一台挖掘机，停在一堆大型土堆前方。地面散落着碎石，包括岩石和看似建筑垃圾的杂物。右下角可见一小片积水，背景以土堆和绿色植被为主。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers engaged in various activities. Approximately nine workers, all wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests, are distributed across the site. Some are working on the steel reinforcement structures, while others are handling construction materials. There are multiple stacks of different types of rebars and construction materials laid out on the concrete floor. The site features a large area of steel reinforcement cages that are being assembled or are already in place for concrete pouring, indicating the construction of a foundation or a similar structure.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种活动。大约九名工人，均佩戴安全帽和高能见度背心，分布在工地各处。部分工人在钢筋结构上作业，而另一些工人则在搬运建筑材料。地面上摆放着多堆不同类型的不同的的钢筋和建筑材料。工地设有一大片大型钢筋笼，正在组装或已就位，准备进行混凝土浇筑，表明正在进行基础施工或类似结构。

err.en: multiple stacks of different types of re
err.zh: 多堆不同类型的不同的的钢筋

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, featuring a raised boom and a bucket partially submerged in the soil. There is a significant amount of churned-up earth and mud around the excavator, indicating recent activity. In the background, there are cleared areas with some vegetation and debris, as well as buildings that appear to be under construction, with visible scaffolding.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，中央有一台挖掘机，配备有升起的式吊斗和半浸在土中的料斗。挖掘机周围有大量翻起的来的泥土和泥浆，表明近期有活动。背景中有一些植被和碎屑的清晰区域，以及似乎处于施工中的建筑物，带有可见脚手架。

err.en: a raised boom and a bucket partially sub
err.zh: 升起的式吊斗和半浸在土中的料斗

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests. Two workers are kneeling and appear to be working on the rebar framework on the ground, while another two are standing and operating a long-handled tool on the concrete surface. There is an extensive scaffold structure with yellow poles and green netting on the left side and background. Multiple bundles of rebars are laid out on the ground, some organized in grids with spacers, and others loosely piled.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，五名工人头戴黄色安全帽，身穿安全背心。两名工人跪在地上，似乎正在钢筋框架上作业，另外两名工人站立，操作长柄工具在混凝土表面上。有一个大型脚手架，左侧有黄色杆和绿色网，背景为蓝色。多根钢筋被平铺在地上，一些组织成网格，带有间隔，其他则松散堆放。

err.en: green netting on the left side and backg
err.zh: 左侧有黄色杆和绿色网，背景为蓝色

text: The image shows a construction site with various activities in progress. In the foreground, there is a large pile of reddish-brown earth. A green dump truck is positioned in the center, with its bed raised, indicating the unloading of soil. To the left, an excavator with a yellow arm is actively digging or moving earth, and behind it stands a blue truck. There is one person visible wearing a red shirt, standing near the green dump truck in the center of the image. Other construction materials and equipment are scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，各项活动正在进行推进。前景处有一大堆红褐色泥土。一辆绿色自卸卡车位于中央，其车斗架升起，表明泥土未装载。左侧，一台挖掘机带黄色臂正在积极挖掘或移动泥土，其后方停着一辆蓝色卡车。可见一人穿着红色衬衫，站在图像中央绿色自卸卡车附近。其他建筑材料和设备散落在工地周围。

text: The image shows a lineup of four white concrete mixer trucks parked side by side on a construction site with clear skies above. The trucks are facing left, with the front of the trucks visible and the mixing drums located at the rear.
zh: 画面显示，在天空晴朗的建筑工地上，四辆黑色混凝土搅拌车并排停放。卡车朝左，卡车的前部可见，搅拌鼓位于后部。

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers and construction materials. There are at least nine workers wearing red shirts, with some of them walking and others performing tasks on the site. In the center, there is a concrete pump with a red boom extended across the site. To the right, there are various construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人和建筑材料。至少有九名工人穿着红色衬衫，其中一些人在走动，另一些人在工地上执行任务。在中心，有一个混凝土泵，带有红色喇叭，横跨整个工地。在右侧，有各种建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single excavator positioned in the center, engaged in earthmoving activities. The excavator is surrounded by piles of excavated soil. In the background, there is a partially visible structure with brickwork and a fence.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，一台挖掘机位于场地中央，正在进行土方作业。挖掘机周围堆放着挖掘出的来的的一堆堆土。背景中可见一处砖砌结构及一道围栏。

err.zh: 挖掘出的来的的一堆堆土

text: The worker appears to be engaged in an activity related to the rebar, possibly tying or inspecting it. There are several metal platforms laid across the rebar to allow for movement and access.
zh: 该工人似乎正在从事与重新酒吧台相关的的工作，可能系结或检查它。有几个金属平台横跨重新酒吧台，以便移动和访问。

text: The image shows a construction site with two large pieces of yellow construction equipment actively engaged in work. On the left, there is an excavator with a long arm extended, and on the right, a pile driver is positioned with its drilling apparatus inserted into the ground. The ground is uneven with mounds of red-brown earth, indicative of recent excavation or earthmoving activities.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，有两台大型黄色施工设备正在作业。左侧是一台长臂挖掘机，右侧是一台钻机，其钻探装置已插入地面。地面平整，周围有红褐色泥土，表明近期有挖掘或土方移动活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with a teal-colored Kobelco excavator in operation, positioned behind a yellow barrier. The excavator is digging or moving earth, evident by the dirt pile in front of it. In the background, there are multi-story residential buildings, and a power line tower is visible in the distance.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一台青绿色的凯贝尔（Kobel）公司挖掘机正在作业，其后方设有一道黄色围挡。挖掘机正在挖掘或搬运泥土，从其它前方的的一堆泥土可以看出这一点。背景中有多层住宅建筑，远处可见一条高压线。

err.zh: 其后方设有一道黄色围挡

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests. They are working on a large area of steel reinforcement bars laid out on the ground, which appears to be the foundation for a concrete structure. In the background, a large pile of earth is visible, partially covered by a blue tarpaulin. There are various construction materials scattered around the site, including wooden planks and pink insulation panels.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有三名工人戴着黄色安全帽和穿着安全背心。他们正在地面上铺设一大片钢筋，这似乎是一个混凝土结构的基础。在背景中，可以看到一大堆泥土，部分被蓝色防水布覆盖。在工地周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和粉色保温板。

text: The image shows three workers engaged in activities at a construction site. They are operating a vertical drilling rig that is positioned against a concrete wall. The site is equipped with wooden planks for footing, and various tools and construction materials are scattered around the area. The background reveals an exposed earth embankment.
zh: 图中显示三名工人在一处建筑工地上从事作业。他们正在操作一台垂直钻机，该钻机抵靠在一面混凝土墙边。该场地配备了木质垫板用于立足，并且各种工具和建筑材料散落在周围区域。背景揭示出一处裸露出的土埋设。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, partially constructed building with multiple floors and a green protective mesh on its exterior. In front of the building, there is a group of workers wearing safety helmets. A large mound of earth is visible in the foreground, with puddles of water and scattered debris around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一栋大型多层建筑正在施工中，其内部设有绿色防护网。建筑前方有一组工人佩戴安全帽。前景处可见一大堆泥土，周围伴有水坑和散落的物。

text: The image shows a yellow single-drum vibratory roller on a dirt surface with a focus on compaction work at a construction site. There is one person visible in the background, walking on the elevated dirt ground. The roller is positioned in the foreground, and there are no other pieces of construction equipment or material stockpiles visible in the immediate vicinity.
zh: 画面显示一台黄色单鼓振动辊在泥土地面上，聚焦于反应堆作业，位于一处建筑工地。背景中可见一人正行走在抬高的泥土地面上。振动辊位于前景，且在其直接周边没有其他施工设备或材料堆可见。

text: The image shows a high-rise construction site with a large scaffolding structure. There are at least ten workers visible, all wearing pink safety vests and white hard hats. They are distributed across various levels of the scaffolding, with some on the topmost visible level and others on lower levels. A tower crane is adjacent to the scaffolding, with its mast and jib extending above the structure. The workers appear to be engaged in various construction activities, with some standing and looking at different parts of the structure, while others are handling construction materials or tools. The scaffolding is equipped with safety netting and blue-green tarpaulins on some levels.
zh: 图中显示一个高层建筑施工场地，设有大型脚手架结构。可见至少十名工人，均身着粉色安全背心和白色安全帽。他们分布在脚手架的不同高度，部分位于最上层，其余位于较低层。一台塔式起重机紧邻脚手架，其桅杆和绞盘位于结构上方。工人似乎正从事各种施工作业，部分人站立并查看结构的不同部位，而另一些人则搬运建筑材料或工具。脚手架上装有安全网和蓝绿色防水布，位于某些高度。

text: The image shows a construction site with two dump trucks facing opposite directions, with their beds raised, indicating they are unloading or have unloaded material. Between the trucks, there is a visible pile of dirt or gravel on the ground. In the background, there is an excavator with its arm extended towards the ground. There are at least three individuals visible; one person is standing to the left of the excavator, and two others are standing to the right, near the rear of the truck on the right side of the image. The ground appears to be covered with gravel, and the sky is partly cloudy.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有两辆自卸车背向停放，车斗架起，表明它们处于未装载或已卸载物料的状态。两车之间，地面上有一堆可见泥土或碎石。背景中，有一台挖掘机，其臂伸向地面。画面中至少可见三个人；一人站在挖掘机左侧，另外两人站在右侧那辆车的后方，靠近画面右侧。地面似乎覆盖着碎石，天空部分多云。

err.en: indicating they are unloading or have un
err.zh: 表明它们处于未装载或已卸载物料的状态

text: The image shows two excavators on a construction site with reddish-brown soil. The excavator on the left is larger and yellow, while the one on the right is smaller and orange. Both machines are positioned on the ground with their booms extended and buckets close to the soil, suggesting excavation work.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，土壤呈红褐色。左侧的挖掘机较大且为黄色，右侧的较小且为橙色。两台机器均停在地面上，其履带和铲斗靠近土壤，表明正在进行挖掘作业。

err.en: with their booms extended and buckets cl
err.zh: 其履带和铲斗靠近土壤

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests engaged in activities related to reinforcing steel bars (rebars) for a concrete structure. In the foreground, one worker is bending over, handling the rebars, while another stands nearby. In the background, two workers are standing within the structure, one of whom is adjusting or inspecting the rebars. The structure appears to be a foundation or wall with steel formwork in place, ready for concrete to be poured.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，四名头戴安全帽、身穿高可视性背心的的工人正在从事与钢筋混凝土结构相关的的活动。前景中，一名工人正弯腰处理钢筋，另一名工人站在附近。背景中，两名工人站在结构内，其中一人正在调整或检查钢筋。该结构似乎是一个基础或墙体，配有钢筋模板，准备浇筑混凝土。

text: The image shows a nighttime construction scene with five workers wearing safety gear, including hard hats and high-visibility clothing. An excavator bucket is positioned above the rebar framework of what appears to be a bridge or similar structure. Two workers are on top of the structure, while three are at ground level. The construction site is illuminated by artificial lighting, and the surrounding area is dark, indicating excavation or tunneling work.
zh: 夜间施工现场，五名工人佩戴着安全防护装备，包括安全帽和高能见度服装。一台挖掘机位于看似桥梁或类似结构的的重架的上方。两名工人位于结构顶部，而三名则处于地面层面。施工现场由人工照明照亮，周边区域昏暗，表明正在进行挖掘或隧道作业。

err.en: An excavator bucket is positioned above
err.zh: 一台挖掘机位于看似桥梁或类似结构的的重架的上方

text: The image shows a dump truck with its bed raised, positioned on a metal ramp to facilitate unloading. The truck is located on a construction site with uneven, rocky terrain. There are no visible workers or other construction equipment in the immediate vicinity of the truck. The surrounding area includes vegetation, and there appears to be a body of water in the background.
zh: 图中显示一辆自卸卡车，其货箱已升起，停放在金属坡道上以便于卸货。该卡车位于一处地形平坦、多岩石的施工现场。卡车附近没有可见工人或其他其他施工设备。周围区域包括植被，背景中似乎有一处水体。

err.zh: 地形平坦、多岩石的施工现场

text: The image shows an excavator bucket positioned above an excavation site with freshly disturbed earth. There are some twisted metal rods or wires, possibly construction debris, on the ground.
zh: 图像显示一台挖掘机位于一个开挖场地上方，上方是新鲜扰动的土壤。地面上有一些扭曲的金属杆或电线，可能是建筑废料。

err.zh: 位于一个开挖场地上方

text: The image shows a yellow construction wheel loader with muddy tires, positioned centrally in the frame. The loader appears to be idle, with no visible operator or ongoing activity.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色色轮式装载机，轮胎沾满泥浆污，处于静止状态，未见操作人员或正在进行的的操作。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete pump truck extending its boom to pour concrete, likely into a formwork that is not visible in the image. The pump truck is positioned on the right side, with its drum visible and the boom extending diagonally across the image. In the background, there are multiple buildings under construction, covered with green scaffolding netting, and several tower cranes are erected around these structures.
zh: 画面中展示了一处建筑工地，一辆混凝土泵车正将其料斗篷向浇筑混凝土，很可能形成一种在画面中不可见的的工作。泵车位于右侧，其鼓可见，且斗篷斜向横跨画面。在背景中，有多栋建筑正在施工，覆盖着绿色脚手架网，并且几座塔楼被竖立于这些结构周围。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, red and white concrete pump truck in operation, its boom extended upwards and curving over towards the right side of the frame. The ground appears muddy with tire tracks, indicating recent activity. The background is obscured, but there are hints of construction activity with structures and materials partially visible.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，一辆大型红白相的混凝土泵车正在作业，其吊臂向上延伸并向画面右侧弯曲。地面显得泥泞污，带有轮胎印迹，表明近期有活动。背景模糊不清，但可见部分施工活动及材料的。

err.en: The ground appears muddy with tire track
err.zh: 地面显得泥泞污，带有轮胎印迹
但可见部分施工活动及材料的

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing safety vests and hard hats. Two workers are standing on a large rebar grid structure on the ground, with one of them holding a hose, possibly engaged in concrete curing or cleaning activities. There are multiple stockpiles of construction materials, including rebars and wooden planks, scattered around the site. The excavation site is surrounded by sheet piling, and there's standing water in various places. In the background, there are buildings and a blue fence, indicating the proximity of the construction site to a developed area.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，五名工人穿着安全背心和硬帽子。两个工人站在大型钢筋网格结构的地面上，其中一个拿着软管，可能从事混凝土养护或清洁活动。现场周围散落着多堆建筑材料，包括钢筋和木托盘。挖掘现场被板状物包围，并且到处都有站立水。在背景中，有建筑物和蓝色围栏，表明建筑工地靠近一个发达区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven terrain and scattered debris. In the center, there is a yellow bulldozer with tracks, actively engaged in earthmoving activities. The operator is visible inside the cabin.
zh: 图中显示一处地形平坦的施工现场，散落着碎石。画面中央有一台黄色轮式装载机，正在进行土方作业。操作手在驾驶室内可见。

text: The image shows a construction site with a bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth. There are six individuals visible on the site; three are clustered together to the right of the bulldozer, two are standing closer to the center, and one is off to the left side. The terrain is uneven with visible tire tracks and mounds of dirt.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台推土机正在作业。现场可见六名工人；其中三人聚集在推土机右侧，两人站在靠近中央的位置，一人位于左侧。地面平整，可见轮胎痕迹和泥土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a soil compactor in the foreground, actively compacting the ground. There are large concrete pipes on the left and in the background, suggesting ongoing underground infrastructure work.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，前景中有一名土工机械操作员正在积极夯实地面。左侧及背景中可见大型混凝土管道，暗示地下基础设施工程正在进行持续施工。

text: The image shows a construction site with two large pile drivers positioned on the left and right sides. In the center and background, there are multiple excavators and a crane. There are also several construction vehicles, including a crane truck and bulldozers. Material stockpiles, such as black wrapped bundles and uncovered gray tubes, are visible in the foreground.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，左右两侧各堆放着大型材料堆。画面中央及背景中有多名挖掘机和一台起重机。此外，还有数辆施工车辆，包括一辆吊车和推土机。前景处可见若干材料堆，例如黑色包裹的成束和未覆盖的灰色管材。

err.en: two large pile drivers positioned on the
err.zh: 左右两侧各堆放着大型材料堆

text: The image shows a single bulldozer with a visible operator inside, actively engaged in earthmoving work. The bulldozer is equipped with a front blade and is positioned on a dirt track, pushing soil to create or maintain the path. The surrounding area is characterized by uneven, dug-up terrain with various mounds of soil and debris.
zh: 图中显示一台单斗式推土机，操作员在驾驶室内清晰可见，正积极从事土方作业。该推土机配备有前铲刀，并位于一条泥土质路面上，正在推土以形成或保持路径。周围区域以平整、开挖的地形为特征，伴有各种高度的不同的土壤和碎屑。

text: The image shows a worker wearing an orange jumpsuit and a red hard hat, working with rebar or conducting an inspection within a formwork structure. The worker is standing in a section filled with water. The construction site includes wooden scaffolding, various pieces of rebar, and a concrete structure with openings.
zh: 图中显示一名工人身穿橙色连体服，头戴红色安全帽，正在钢筋或进行结构检查。该工人站在充满水的分的内。施工现场包括木质脚手架、各种钢筋部件以及带有开口的的水泥结构。

err.en: standing in a section filled with water

text: The image shows a construction site with a partially constructed building on the left, featuring scaffolding around its upper levels. A mobile crane is positioned next to a cement mixer truck in the center. Multiple workers are dispersed across the site, some on the ground level near the building and others on the sloped earthwork to the right, where a large white tarp is partially covering the ground. A bulldozer is visible on the upper right side of the image, on level ground with the construction site below. There are piles of construction materials, such as rebars, scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，左侧有一栋部分建成的建筑，其上层周围设有脚手架。一台移动式起重机位于画面中央，正对着一辆水泥搅拌车。多名工人分散在工地各处，一些在地面靠近建筑，另一些在右侧倾斜的土方工作业面上，那里有一块大型白色防水布部分覆盖着地面。一台推土机可见于画面右上方，位于工地下方。工地周围散落着成堆的建筑材料，例如钢筋。

err.en: on level ground with the construction si

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, there is a collection of construction materials, including bundles of rebars and wooden planks. A concrete pump with a long boom is extended over the workers in the center. Several workers in orange and yellow safety gear are distributed across the site, some interacting near the pump's hose.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在进行各种活动。前景处有一堆建筑材料，包括成束的钢筋和木托盘。一台混凝土泵，带长管横跨在中央的工人上方。几名身穿橙色和黄色安全装备的工人分布在整个工地，有些互动靠近泵的的水管附近。

text: The image shows a high-rise construction site with scaffolding and safety netting along the exterior. There are at least four workers visible; one is on the scaffolding at the top right, another is walking on the scaffolding at the bottom, and two more are on different levels of the scaffolding on the left side. The structure has multiple floors with exposed rebar and formwork. A section of a yellow tower crane is visible on the right edge of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个高层建筑施工场地，内部设有脚手架和安全网。可见至少四名工人；其中一人在右上方脚手架上，另一人在下方脚手架上行走，还有两人在左侧不同高度的层的级的脚手架上。该结构具有多层楼板，并露出钢筋和模板。图像右边缘可见一台黄色塔式起重机。

err.en: on different levels of the scaffolding o
err.zh: 在左侧不同高度的层的级的脚手架上

text: The image shows a construction site with one visible worker wearing a yellow hard hat and brown clothing, standing near the center-right of the frame, working with some bent metal rods. In the foreground, there are piles of construction materials, including rebars, wooden planks, and metal sheets. A concrete wall with vertical steel reinforcements is visible, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿棕色衣物的的人员站在画面中右侧，正使用一些弯曲的金属杆进行作业。前景处堆放着建筑材料堆，包括钢筋、木托盘以及金属板。可见一面混凝土墙体，上面带有竖向钢筋，表明施工工作正在进行持续进行。

err.zh: 表明施工工作正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests. Two workers in orange vests are handling materials on a raised platform with steel reinforcement bars visible, while another worker in a yellow vest is walking across the platform. A fourth worker in a striped shirt is moving wooden planks on the ground level.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人戴着安全帽和高能见度背心。两名穿橙色背心的的工人正在处理一个抬高的平台上的材料，钢制加强筋可见，而另一名穿黄色背心的的工人正在穿过平台。第四名穿条纹衬衫的工人正在地面上移动木托盘。

text: The image shows an excavator operating on a construction site, situated on the right side of a dirt excavation area. The excavator is digging or moving earth near the edge of the excavation. In the background, there is an elevated road structure with multiple columns extending to the left. The terrain appears to be uneven with exposed earth, and the background includes a city skyline with buildings silhouetted against the sky.
zh: 图中展示了一台挖掘机正在一处建筑工地上作业，位于土方开挖区域的右侧。该挖掘机正在挖掘或搬运靠近开挖边缘的土方。背景中可见一条高架道路结构，向左侧延伸出多根立柱。地形看起来较为平整，伴有裸露出的土，背景中包括城市天际线，建筑物轮廓映衬在天空之下。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with two excavators and two dump trucks. One excavator is actively loading soil into the bed of a dump truck, while the other excavator and truck appear to be stationary. The ground is uneven with mounds of soil, indicating excavation work is in progress.
zh: 图片显示一个施工现场，有两台挖掘机和两辆自卸卡车。一台挖掘机正在将泥土装载到自卸卡车的车斗中，而另一台挖掘机和卡车似乎处于静止状态。地面平整，周围有土堆，表明挖掘工作正在进行进行中。

text: The image shows a construction site with a concrete mixer truck and a red boom pump in the process of transferring concrete. There are at least four workers visible; one is operating the boom pump, and the others are near the scaffolding and rebar structures, likely coordinating the concrete pour or preparing for subsequent construction steps.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一辆混凝土搅拌车和一台红色泥浆泵，正在进行进行混凝土输送。画面中至少可见四名工人；其中一人正在操作泥浆泵，其余人位于脚手架和钢筋结构附近，很可能正在协调混凝土浇筑或为后续施工步骤做准备。

err.en: in the process of transferring concrete
err.zh: 正在进行进行混凝土输送

text: The image shows a large construction site with multiple levels of scaffolding and formwork indicating ongoing construction of a building or structure. There are at least four tower cranes erected within the site, facilitating the lifting and moving of materials. A group of workers, wearing red hard hats, are walking along a path bordered by green netting. Large black pipes are stockpiled to the left of the path, and there is a significant amount of construction materials, such as rebars, scattered throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个大型建筑工地，有多层脚手架和模板，表明正在进行进行建筑物或结构的施工。工地上至少竖立了四台塔式起重机，便于材料的物的料的和移动。一群工人，戴着红色安全帽，沿着由绿色网围成的路径行走。大型黑色管道堆放在路径左侧，并且现场有大量的建筑材料，例如钢筋，散落在工地各处。

err.en: facilitating the lifting and moving of m
err.zh: 便于材料的物的料的和移动

text: The image shows one worker wearing an orange jumpsuit and a yellow hard hat standing near the center. The worker appears to be observing or monitoring the area. To the right, there is a yellow excavator positioned on an elevated mound of earth. The ground is uneven with visible water flow and erosion, indicating recent excavation or water management activities. There are broken pipes and construction debris scattered across the site.
zh: 画面中有一名工人身穿橙色连体服、头戴黄色安全帽，站在画面中央附近，似乎正在观察或监控该区域。右侧有一台黄色挖掘机停在一处隆起的的小土丘上。地面较为平整，但可见水流流动及侵蚀痕迹，表明近期有挖掘或水利管理活动。现场散落着破损管及施工碎屑。

text: The image shows a rocky construction site with five workers wearing blue uniforms and yellow hard hats. Two workers are sweeping the ground, one is carrying a flat stone, and the other two are walking across the site. There is a large pile of rocks and boulders throughout the area, and in the background, there is an opening that appears to be an entrance to a tunnel or cave.
zh: 图中显示一个岩石施工现场，五名工人身穿蓝色制服，头戴黄色安全帽。两名工人正在清扫地面，一名工人正搬运一块扁平石块，另外两名工人正穿过工地。区域内遍布着大堆岩石和脚手架，背景中有一个开口，看起来像是隧道或洞穴的入口。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large scaffolding structure in the foreground, which is predominantly green with some red and white elements. There are at least five workers visible, wearing hard hats and safety gear, engaged in various activities on the scaffolding. Bundles of wooden planks are stacked on the scaffolding levels.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，前景中有一个大型脚手架结构，主体呈绿色，并带有一些红色和白色元素。脚手架上至少有五名工人可见，他们头戴安全帽，身着安全防护装备，正在脚手架上进行着各种作业。木托盘成堆地码放在脚手架层面上。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large red concrete pump truck extending its boom over a network of wooden formwork and steel reinforcement bars, indicating ongoing foundation or structural work. There is a concrete mixer truck positioned near the pump truck, likely preparing to deliver concrete. A motorbike is parked in the foreground, and various construction materials, such as wooden planks and debris, are scattered around the site. The background features greenery and buildings, suggesting an urban or suburban setting.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，一辆大型红色混凝土泵车正将其料斗篷覆盖在木质模板和钢筋之上，表明正在进行基础或结构施工。一辆混凝土搅拌车停在泵车附近，可能正准备运送混凝土。一辆摩托车停在前景，各种建筑材料，如木板和碎屑，散落在工地周围。背景中有绿植和建筑物，暗示为城市或郊区环境。

err.en: extending its boom over a network of woo
err.zh: 正将其料斗篷覆盖在木质模板和钢筋之上

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers and construction materials. In the foreground, a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and an orange safety vest is walking across steel plates laid on the ground. There are multiple steel reinforcing bars (rebars) scattered around the site. In the midground, two workers are visible; one is carrying a red bucket and the other is walking towards the right side of the frame. Both are wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人和建筑材料。前景中，一名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿橙色安全背心的的工人正行走在铺于地面的上的的一块钢板板上。现场周围散落着多根钢筋（钢筋）。中景处，可见两名工人；其中一人正搬运着一个红色水桶，另一人正朝画面右侧行走。两人都戴着黄色安全帽和安全背带。

err.zh: 铺于地面的上的的一块

text: The image shows a yellow soil compactor with a single drum roller at the forefront of a construction site. The ground appears muddy and there are tracks indicative of recent activity by construction vehicles. In the background, an excavator is visible on a raised area with reddish-brown soil.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色土方方，其前端配有一个单鼓轮滚筒，位于施工现场的前部。地面显得泥泞滑，并可见车辆行驶留下的车辙，表明近期有施工车辆活动。背景中，在一处抬高的区域可见一台挖掘机，该区域土壤呈红褐色。

err.en: with a single drum roller at the forefro
err.zh: 其前端配有一个单鼓轮滚筒，位于施工现场的前部

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, rectangular pit, surrounded by a complex framework of steel beams and scaffolding. There are at least ten workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats and red safety vests; they are positioned around the pit and on various levels of the scaffolding, seemingly engaged in different tasks related to the construction.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一个大型矩形基坑，周围环绕着由钢梁和脚手架组成的复杂的框架。可以看到至少十名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽和红色安全背心；他们分布在基坑周围及不同高度的层的级的脚手架上，似乎正从事与施工相关的的不同任务。

err.en: on various levels of the scaffolding
err.zh: 不同高度的层的级的脚手架上

text: The image shows a construction site with six workers visible. In the foreground, one worker is kneeling while another stands nearby, both wearing yellow hard hats. In the midground, three workers are engaged in activities involving construction materials, with two kneeling and one standing, all wearing hard hats. The site is scattered with numerous green construction materials, possibly supports or fixtures, laid out in an organized fashion on the ground. A perimeter of low walls or curbs outlines the area where the workers are active.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，可见六名工人。前景中，一名工人正坐着，另一名工人站在附近，两人都戴着黄色安全帽。中景处，三名工人正从事与建筑材料相关的的工作，其中两人坐着，一人站着，均佩戴安全帽。场地地面散落着大量绿色建材，可能是支撑件或固定装置，以有序方式铺展于地面。一道低矮围墙或围挡栏勾勒出工人正在作业的区域。

text: The image shows a worker wearing a red hard hat and camouflage clothing, operating a surveying instrument mounted on a yellow tripod. The worker is standing on a dirt ground with some loose soil and rocks around. Behind the worker, there is a pile of excavated earth, and in the background, there are trees and a utility pole with power lines.
zh: 图中显示一名工人头戴红色安全帽，身穿迷彩服，正在操作一台架设在黄色三脚架上的测量仪器。该工人站在一片泥地上，周围散落着一些松散的泥土和岩石。在工人身后，有一堆挖掘出的泥土，在背景中，有树木和一根带电力线的的高压杆。

err.en: a utility pole with power lines
err.zh: 一根带电力线的的高压杆

text: The image shows a blue flatbed truck loaded with wooden planks in the center, with one worker standing on the truck bed arranging or unloading the planks. Another worker wearing a yellow hard hat is standing to the right of the truck, near a large pile of wooden planks on the ground.
zh: 图中显示一辆蓝色平板货车，车厢中央装载着木托盘，一名工人站在货车厢上，正在整理或卸载木托盘。另一名头戴黄色安全帽的工人站在货车右侧，靠近地面上的一大堆木托盘。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, positioned on a mound of earth. To the right, there is a worker wearing a yellow hard hat and safety vest, standing near a wheelbarrow. Two large blue barrels are placed on the ground, one upright and the other lying on its side. In the foreground, there is a parked car, and scattered around the site are various construction materials, including bricks and what appears to be hoses or cables.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，中心位置有一台挖掘机，停在一堆土堆上。右侧有一名工人，头戴黄色安全帽，身穿安全背心，站在轮挡附近。地面上放置着两个大型蓝色桶，一个直立，另一个侧躺。前景处有一辆停放的汽车，工地周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括砖块以及看似软管或电缆线的。

text: The image shows an orange excavator positioned on a dirt surface, with its boom extended and bucket touching the ground. The excavator is situated in the foreground, and there is a sloped earth embankment in the background.
zh: 图中显示一台橙色挖掘机停放在泥土地表面上，其动臂和铲斗接触着地面。挖掘机位于前景，背景中有一处倾斜的土方方形。

err.en: with its boom extended and bucket touchi
err.zh: 其动臂和铲斗接触着地面

text: The image shows a construction site with multiple excavated pits and trenches with foundational structures made of masonry blocks. There are two excavators in operation in the background, with one on the left and the other on the right side of the image. The ground is covered with red soil, and there are piles of masonry blocks throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有多处开挖的基坑和沟槽，基础结构由砌石块构成。背景中有两名挖掘机正在作业，一台位于左侧，另一台位于图像右侧。地面覆盖着红土，并且整个场地散布着砌石块的堆。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site where an excavator is operating in a dug-out area with muddy surroundings. The ground is uneven with various tracks and marks indicating recent activity.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角，一台挖掘机正在一个挖掘区域内作业，周围是泥泞地。地面平整，带有各种车辙印和标记，表明近期有活动。

text: A worker wearing a yellow hard hat is using a tool to work on the edge of a concrete structure at a construction site. The worker is dressed in a dark long-sleeve top and camouflage pants. Behind the worker, there is a framework of vertical and horizontal rebar, suggesting the preparation for concrete pouring. The ground appears muddy and there are some construction materials scattered around, including a coil of wires next to the worker.
zh: 头戴黄色安全帽的工人正使用工具在混凝土结构施工现场的边缘作业。该工人身穿深色长袖上衣和迷彩裤。在工人身后，有纵横交错的钢筋框架，暗示着混凝土浇筑的准备。地面显得泥泞污，周围散落着一些建筑材料，包括靠近工人的的一卷电线。

err.en: a coil of wires next to the worker
err.zh: 靠近工人的的一卷电线

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers visible. One worker is operating a bar bending machine near the center, another is standing by a pile of construction materials to the right, and a third is walking towards the left side of the frame. There are several curved and straight precast concrete elements scattered across the site, along with piles of construction materials such as rebars and sand.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，可见三名工人。一名工人正在画面中央附近操作一台钢筋弯曲机，另一名站在右侧一堆建筑材料旁，第三名则朝画面左侧方向行走。工地上散落着若干弯曲及笔直的钢筋等预制混凝土构件，以及成堆的建筑材料，如钢筋和沙。

err.zh: 钢筋等预制混凝土构件

text: The image shows a yellow excavator operating on a slope with rocky debris and a pool of muddy water at the base. The excavator is positioned on an incline, with its arm extended towards the ground, suggesting excavation or clearing activities. The surrounding area is natural and rugged, with trees in the background, indicating that the site may be in a remote or less developed area.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机正在一处斜坡面上作业，坡面有碎石渣，底部有一汪泥水。挖掘机位于一条直线上，其臂部伸向地面，暗示正在进行挖掘或清理作业。周边区域自然且崎岖，背景中有树木，表明该场地可能处于偏远或开发程度较低的区域。

text: In the foreground, a green dump truck is tipping its bed to unload soil. In the midground, various construction vehicles, including wheel loaders and trucks, are active on the site, with some moving earth. In the background, multiple pile drivers are operating, and there are cranes visible in the far distance.
zh: 前景中，一辆绿色自卸卡车正将车斗倾斜以卸载泥土。中景中，各类施工车辆，包括轮式装载机和卡车，正在现场作业，并装运部分泥土。背景中，多台压路机正在运行，远处可见有沟槽。

text: The image shows an indoor construction site with a steel structure. There are at least seven workers visible; some are carrying bricks and others appear to be engaged in various tasks. Two wheelbarrows are in the foreground, one overturned and one upright. The ground is wet with puddles scattered around.
zh: 图像显示一个室内施工现场，设有钢结构。画面中至少可见七名工人；部分人正搬运砖块，其余人似乎在进行各种作业。前景处有两条轮式起重机，其中一台处于翻倒状态，另一台保持直立。地面潮湿，周围散落着水坑。

text: The image shows two workers at a construction site with a large, eroded dirt hill in the background. One worker, wearing a white hard hat and light-colored clothing, is standing and observing, while the other, in a green high-visibility shirt and dark pants, is actively working or adjusting something on the ground. There is a red pile-driving machine with a vertical beam and cables, and construction debris is scattered around the area, including some wooden planks and a large pipe segment.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，背景中有一座大型、侵蚀的土丘。一名工人头戴白色安全帽，身穿浅色衣物，正站立观察；另一名工人身穿绿色高能见度上衣和深色裤子，正在地面积极作业或调整某物。现场有一台红色施工机械，带有垂直光束和电缆线，施工废料散落在该区域周围，包括一些木质托盘板和一段大型管道。

text: The image shows a nighttime construction scene with six workers wearing yellow hard hats and orange safety overalls. They are working on a surface covered with gravel. Two workers are standing on the left, and four are standing on the right, with one of them appearing to be raking or spreading material on the ground.
zh: 夜间施工现场，六名头戴黄色安全帽、身穿橙色安全背心的的工人正在作业。他们正在处理覆盖着碎石的表面。两名工人站在左侧，四名站在右侧，其中一人似乎正在说话或在地面上铺展材料。

err.zh: 说话或在地面上铺展材料

text: The image shows a construction site with a large yellow tower crane in the center. Below the crane, there is a network of rebar laid out across the ground, with wooden formwork interspersed among the rebar. Approximately eight workers are dispersed across the site, engaged in various activities related to the construction process.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台大型黄色色塔式起重机。起重机下方，钢筋纵横交错地铺设在地面上，其间夹杂着木模板。大约八名工人分散在工地各处，正从事与施工过程相关的各项活动。

err.zh: 大型黄色色塔式起重机

text: The image shows a construction site under a structure with multiple concrete columns. A yellow skid-steer loader is positioned towards the right side of the frame, partially submerged in water, reflecting on the surface. Debris and rubble are scattered across the wet ground. The background features the underside of a concrete structure, possibly a bridge or an elevated roadway, with no apparent ongoing construction activity.
zh: 画面显示一处混凝土多柱结构的下的方的正在施工。一台黄色轮式装载机停靠在画面右侧，部分浸入水中，其倒影映于水面。湿地上散落着杂物与碎石。背景中可见混凝土结构的底部，可能是一座桥梁或高架道路，未见明显持续施工活动。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with various activities in progress. There are at least nine workers visible, most of whom are wearing safety vests and hard hats. On the left, two workers are near a vertical concrete wall, with one operating a jackhammer. In the center, a group of workers is spread out across an area with exposed rebar, where concrete has not yet been poured.
zh: 图像展示了一个建筑工地的空中视角，现场有多项作业正在进行推进。画面中至少可见九名工人，其中大多数人都穿着安全背心和硬帽。在左侧，有两名工人靠近一面垂直的混凝土墙，其中一人正在操作一把大锤。在中心，有一组工人分散在一个区域，该区域有外露出的钢筋，混凝土尚未被浇筑。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers engaged in various activities. In the foreground, there is a large amount of construction debris, including wooden planks and metal sheets. A worker in the center is standing on a platform, while another worker is visible in the background on the left side. Both are wearing hard hats. In the middle ground, there are multiple vertical supports in place, suggesting ongoing work on a foundation or framework.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人正在从事各种活动。前景处有大量建筑废料，包括木托盘和金属板。画面中央的一名工人站在平台上，而另一名工人在背景左侧可见。两人都戴着安全帽。中景处有多根垂直支撑物就位，暗示着对地基或框架的持续施工。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large concrete pump truck extending its boom across the scene. The pump truck is positioned on a dirt mound in the foreground. To the right, there is a significant amount of rebar reinforcement laid out, partially covered with green netting, indicating preparation for concrete pouring. Two workers are visible near the rebar structure, one standing on the structure and another on the ground level.
zh: 画面展示一处施工现场，一辆大型混凝土泵车正将料斗跨越场景倾倒。泵车停在前方的一个土堆上。右侧，有大量钢筋网架已铺设，部分覆盖着绿色防护网，表明正在为混凝土浇筑做准备。两名工人在钢筋结构附近可见，一人站立，另一人则处于地面高度。

err.en: extending its boom across the scene
err.zh: 正将料斗跨越场景倾倒

text: The image shows a construction site with four workers wearing safety vests and hard hats. Two workers are on the left side, one is standing on a platform with construction materials, and the other is slightly below him on the ground. On the right side, two workers are interacting with vertical rebar structures.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，有四名工人穿着安全背心和硬帽子。两名工人在左侧，一个站在有建筑材料的物的平台上，另一个略低于他在地面上。在右侧，两名工人与垂直重新结构互动。

text: The image shows a group of workers on a construction site engaged in groundwork activities. There are at least ten workers visible, wearing white and orange safety helmets and high-visibility vests. Some workers are using shovels, while others seem to be supervising or observing the work.
zh: 图像显示一群工人在建筑工地上从事土方方工作。可见至少有十名工人，身穿白色和橙色安全头盔和高能见度背心。一些工人使用铁锹，而另一些工人似乎在监督或观察工作。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers wearing yellow hard hats. One worker is walking towards the camera, while the other two are engaged in a discussion or observation of something off-camera. There is an overturned vehicle or container on the left, which appears to be repurposed as a storage or work area with various items hanging from it. In the background, there are multiple vertical rebars protruding from the ground, indicating ongoing construction work.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，有三名头戴黄色安全帽的工人。其中一名工人正朝摄像机方向走来，另外两名工人则背对镜头，似乎正在就某事宜或观察进行着讨论。左侧有一辆翻倒的机动车或容器，看起来像是被用作储存或作业区，上面挂着各种物品。背景中，有多根垂直的钢筋从地面伸出，表明施工正在进行持续进行。

err.en: the other two are engaged in a discussio
err.zh: 另外两名工人则背对镜头，似乎正在就某事宜或观察进行着讨论
表明施工正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, its bucket raised and carrying soil. In the foreground, there are several concrete blocks on the ground. The ground is uneven and appears to be in the process of being excavated or leveled. The sky is overcast, and the environment looks to be dusty, likely due to the ongoing work.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台挖掘机，其铲斗已抬起并装载着泥土。前景地面上堆放着若干混凝土砌块。地面平整，看起来正处于开挖或整平过程中。天空灰蒙蒙的，环境显得尘土飞扬，这很可能是由于持续的施工所致。

text: The image shows a construction site with a partially constructed building featuring exposed steel reinforcement bars and formwork. There are at least nine workers visible, all wearing red safety gear, with some on the ground level and others on the building's first level. A green tarp is spread out on the ground to the left, and construction materials are placed on the building's first level. The terrain surrounding the construction area is uneven and appears to be in the process of being excavated or graded.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，其中有一栋部分建成的建筑物，露出钢筋和模板。可见至少有九名工人，均佩戴红色安全防护装备，部分人员位于地面，其余人员位于建筑物首层。一块绿色防水布铺展在地面左侧，建筑材料被放置在建筑物首层。施工区域周围的地形平坦，似乎处于开挖或整平过程中。

err.zh: 施工区域周围的地形平坦

text: The image shows two yellow excavators in the middle of an excavation site with one operator visible in the cab of the excavator on the right. The excavator on the left is positioned on higher ground, while the one on the right is at a lower level, actively digging into the earth. There is a large, deep pit in the background with a vertical concrete wall, and the ground is uneven with various mounds of dirt.
zh: 画面显示两台黄色挖掘机位于一个挖掘场地的中部，右侧挖掘机的驾驶室内可见一名操作员。左侧的挖掘机位置较高，而右侧的一台处于较低位置，正在积极挖掘泥土。背景中有一个大而深的坑，带有垂直混凝土墙，地面平整，伴有各种土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, excavated area. An orange dump truck is parked in the foreground, with its bed facing a tall, vertical concrete wall. Atop the wall, there are at least four individuals; some are standing and appear to be observing or working, while others are crouched or sitting near materials covered with red and white striped tarps. Behind them, a steep, terraced hillside is visible with no visible construction activity.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一大片大型开挖区域。前景处停着一辆橙色自卸卡车，其车厢体朝向一堵高大、垂直的混凝土墙。墙体顶部至少有四个人；有些人站着，似乎正在观察或工作，而另一些人则蜷缩着或坐在用红白条纹覆盖的材料附近。在他们身后，可见一处陡峭峻、荒芜凉的山坡，没有任何可见施工活动。

text: The image shows a construction site with a green excavator in the center, positioned on a dirt surface with some vegetation debris nearby. There is a pathway with rectangular tiles to the right of the excavator. In the background, there are two structures that resemble bridges or culverts, and a person is visible walking in the distance on the right side of the image.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心位置有一台绿色挖掘机，停放在一片带有部分植被碎屑的泥土地表面上。在挖掘机的右侧，有一条由矩形瓷砖铺成的通道。在背景中，有两个类似桥梁或竖井的结构，并且有一个人影在图像右侧远处行走。

text: The image shows a group of five workers on a road next to a guardrail, overlooking an excavated area. Four workers are wearing hard hats, and one is wearing a camouflage patterned hat. They appear to be engaged in a discussion or assessment of the site.
zh: 画面显示，五名工人正沿着道路走向一道护栏，俯瞰着一处开挖区域。四名工人戴着安全帽，还有一人戴着迷彩图案帽。他们似乎正在参与对工地的讨论或评估。

err.en: on a road next to a guardrail
err.zh: 正沿着道路走向一道护栏

text: The image shows a pile of large rocks with varying sizes and shapes. Two individuals are visible; one is standing on the left side of the pile, wearing dark pants and shoes, and the other is seated on the right side, wearing a grey bottom and is bare-chested.
zh: 图中显示一堆大小和形状各异的大岩石。可以看到两个人；其中一人站在岩堆的左侧，穿着深色裤子和鞋子，另一人坐在右侧，穿着灰色打底裤，赤脚。

text: The image shows a construction site where a foundation or floor slab is being prepared. There are at least nine workers visible, all wearing yellow hard hats and orange safety vests. They are engaged in various activities such as bending over and working on the rebar framework that covers the majority of the visible area. In the foreground, there is a pile of bricks and a large metal toolbox. The site is surrounded by a green fence, and there are sheet piles along the perimeter.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，正在准备基础或楼板板。可见至少九名工人，均佩戴黄色安全帽和橙色安全背心。他们正从事各种活动，例如弯曲并工作在覆盖大部分可见区域的的重钢框架上。前景处有一堆砖块和一件大型金属工具。该工地被绿色围栏所环绕，沿周边还有板材堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with a single green excavator positioned in the center, working on a muddy terrain with visible tracks around it. The excavator is situated on a temporary road made of wooden planks, and there are piles of debris and soil nearby. In the background, there is a water body adjacent to the site, and beyond that, there are fields with different shades of green.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，一台绿色挖掘机位于场地中央，正在泥泞土地层上作业，其周围可见车辙印迹。挖掘机停放在一条由木板铺成的临时便道上，附近堆放着成堆的渣土与泥土。背景中，有一处水体紧邻该场地，再往远处，则是色调度各异的绿色的调度的不一的田块。

err.en: fields with different shades of green
err.zh: 色调度各异的绿色的调度的不一的田块

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow excavator on the left, positioned on a mound of earth and rubble. The excavator's arm is extended towards a white dump truck with "GENLYON" written on the front, which is located on the right side of the image. The truck is partially loaded with debris.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，左侧有一台黄色色的挖掘机，停在一堆泥土和碎石上。挖掘机的臂伸向右侧的一辆白色自卸卡车，卡车前部写有“gen ly on”字样，卡车部分装载有碎屑。

text: The image shows a multi-story building under construction with extensive scaffolding covering its exterior. In the foreground, there is an excavator arm, and the ground appears muddy with scattered construction debris.
zh: 图中展示了一栋正在施工中的多层建筑，其内部被大量脚手架所覆盖。在前景中，有一台挖掘机，地面显得泥泞污，并散落着施工废料。

text: The image shows a yellow front loader moving material near the center. To the left, a worker wearing a white hard hat and light-colored clothing is standing, observing the front loader's operation. There are several construction vehicles in the background, including a yellow dump truck and a blue truck.
zh: 画面中央附近有一台黄色装载机正在移动物料。左侧站着一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿浅色衣物的工人，正在观察前方装载机的器的作业。背景中有多台施工车辆，其中包括一辆黄色泵车以及一辆蓝色卡车。

err.zh: 观察前方装载机的器的作业

text: The image shows a white dump truck in the foreground, with its bed raised, indicating that it is either unloading or has unloaded its contents. The truck is equipped with a protective grille on the front and a sun visor above the windshield. Behind the truck, there is a pile of construction materials, and a green cloth is partially covering some items on the truck's bed. The ground appears to be muddy with tire tracks, suggesting recent activity.
zh: 画面前景处有一辆白色自卸卡车，其货箱处于升起状态，表明该车要么尚未装载，要么已卸其货物。卡车前部装有防护格栅，挡风风玻璃上方装有遮阳板。卡车后方有一堆建筑材料，一块绿色布料部分覆盖着卡车货箱上的一些物品。地面看起来泥泞污，带有轮胎轨迹，暗示着近期活动。

err.en: either unloading or has unloaded its con
err.zh: 要么尚未装载，要么已卸其货物

text: The image shows a construction site with a single front loader in operation, moving or organizing materials on the ground, which appears to be a mix of soil and rubble. The ground is uneven with tire tracks, indicating recent activity. There are piles of broken concrete and debris to the right side of the image, suggesting demolition or site clearing work.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，地面上有一台单斗轮装载机正在进行作业，或整理材料，地面看起来是泥土和碎石的混合物。地面平整，带有轮胎痕迹，表明近期有活动。图像右侧有破碎混凝土和瓦砾堆，暗示拆除或场地清理工作。

text: The image shows a construction site for an underground structure with three workers visible. One worker in an orange vest is standing on the left side, looking towards the structure, while another in a white shirt and yellow hard hat is working on the right side. The site is lined with vertical rebars on both sides, and there are wooden planks and construction materials scattered throughout. The structure appears to be in the early stages of construction with concrete work underway.
zh: 图像显示一个地下结构施工现场，可见三名工人。一名身穿橙色背心的的工人站在左侧，面向结构，另一名身穿白色衬衫、头戴黄色安全帽的工人在右侧作业。该结构两侧均设有竖向钢筋，且现场散落着木质托盘板及建筑材料。该结构似乎处于施工早期阶段，混凝土作业正在进行进行。

err.zh: 混凝土作业正在进行进行

text: The image shows a construction site with various heavy machinery in operation. In the foreground, a roller and a bulldozer are visible, with a worker standing nearby. Towards the center, an excavator is in the process of moving a bundle of red pipes. A crawler crane is positioned in the background to the right, and another piece of construction equipment is partially visible behind the red pipes.
zh: 画面显示一个正在进行施工作的大型建筑工地，现场有多台重型机械在运行。前景处可见一台压路机和一台推土机，旁边站着一名工人。画面中央，一台挖掘机正在搬运一管红色管道。背景右侧有一台履带起重机，红色管道后方还隐约可见另一台施工设备。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator in the process of loading or unloading large rocks into the bed of an orange dump truck. The excavator is positioned to the right side of the truck, with its arm extended over the truck's bed. A rocky hillside forms the background, indicating the location might be a quarry or a construction site with significant excavation work.
zh: 图中显示一台黄色挖掘机正在将或卸载大块岩石装入一辆橙色自卸卡车的货厢。挖掘机位于卡车的右侧，其臂架在卡车的厢上方。岩石山坡构成背景，表明该地点可能是一个采石场或一个具有显著挖掘工作的量的之施工场地。

err.en: a construction site with significant exc
err.zh: 一个具有显著挖掘工作的量的之施工场地

text: The image shows a construction site located at the base of a steep, rocky hillside. There are four individuals visible; two are standing together observing, one is walking with a long pipe over their shoulder, and another is walking away from the camera. A motor grader with a visible operator inside is positioned on a dirt road, actively moving soil.
zh: 图像显示一处位于陡峭岩石山脚部的下方的建筑工地。可见四个人；两人站在一起观察，一人肩上扛着一根长管，另一人正背对镜头走去。一名可见驾驶员的机械操作员位于一条土路上，正在积极移动泥土。

err.en: A motor grader with a visible operator i
err.zh: 一名可见驾驶员的机械操作员

text: The image shows a construction site with a single bulldozer in the center, actively moving earth or debris. There are several piles of soil and debris scattered around the site, with a mixture of wet and dry conditions indicated by standing water and varying soil colors. Vegetation debris is visible to the left of the bulldozer, and there are no visible workers or additional construction equipment in the immediate area.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台单斗轮挖掘机正在作业，正在搬运泥土或碎石。工地周围散落着几堆土和碎石，由积水和不同土色所指示的干湿混条件。挖掘机左侧可见植被碎石，且在该区域内没有可见工人或额外施工设备。

err.en: a mixture of wet and dry conditions

text: The image shows a construction site with earthmoving activities. In the center, there is an excavator with its arm extended towards a yellow dump truck, which is being loaded with soil. To the right of the excavator, there is a red dump truck filled with soil. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks, indicating recent movement of heavy vehicles. In the background, there is a mound of earth and some vegetation.
zh: 图像显示一个正在进行土方作业的的建筑施工现场。画面中央有一台挖掘机，其机械臂伸向一辆黄色自卸卡车，该卡车正在装载泥土。在挖掘机的右侧，有一辆红色自卸卡车，装满泥土。地面平整，可见轮胎轨迹，表明重型车辆近期活动。背景中有一堆土和一些植被。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavated area in the foreground where foundational work appears to be in progress. There are five workers visible; one is standing on the left side of the excavation, and four are working together on the right side, near a blue crane that is positioned on the edge of the excavation. The crane is extended over the workers, suggesting it may be used for lifting materials. In the background, there is a blue fence and beyond it, some buildings. The ground is uneven and there are various construction materials and debris scattered around the site.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，前景处有一片开挖区域，基础施工似乎正在进行中。可见五名工人；其中一人站在开挖区域的左侧，另外四人一起在右侧作业，靠近一台蓝色起重机，该起重机位于开挖区域边缘。起重机横跨在工人上方，暗示其可能用于吊装运材料。背景中有一道蓝色围栏，其外有一些建筑物。地面平整，周围散落着各种建筑材料和碎屑。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers. In the center and left of the image, there are at least six workers wearing hard hats and engaged in activities around the steel reinforcement bars of what appears to be the foundation or walls of a structure. There are two large concrete walls standing in the background. The ground is uneven with scattered debris, and there are multiple wooden planks and construction materials throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有多名工人。在图像的中心及左侧，至少有六名工人戴着安全帽，正忙于围绕看似是地基或墙体体的结构的中的钢筋进行作业。背景中有两面大型混凝土墙。地面平整，散落着碎屑，并且整个工地中散布着多块木板及建筑材料。

err.en: the foundation or walls of a structure
err.zh: 地基或墙体体的结构的

text: The image shows a multi-level steel structure with green safety netting attached to the exterior. One worker wearing a dark-colored outfit is visible on the structure, standing on a beam and holding onto another beam for support.
zh: 图像显示一个多层钢结构，其内部附有绿色安全网。一名身穿深色服装的工人可见于结构上，站在梁上并持握到另一根梁上以提供支撑。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large mobile crane in the foreground, featuring a red and yellow color scheme and multiple axles. Two workers are present; one is walking towards the right side of the frame, wearing a white hard hat, and the other is standing near the excavator, wearing an orange hard hat and a high-visibility vest. The ground is unpaved and appears to be compacted earth.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，前景中有一台大型移动式起重机，采用红黄配色方案并配备多组滑轮。现场有两名工人；其中一人正朝画面右侧行走，头戴白色安全帽，另一人则站在挖掘机旁，头戴橙色安全帽并身穿高能见度反光背心。地面未铺设，看起来像是压实的过的泥土。

text: The image shows an aerial view of a construction site with a variety of equipment and materials. In the center, there is a yellow dump truck with two individuals nearby, one of whom appears to be operating the truck. To the left, a crane with an extended boom is positioned over a pile of materials.
