zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，现场堆放着各种建筑材料。前景处有一大堆金属脚手架管材和一摞木托盘。背景中可见两名头戴黄色安全帽的工人；其中一人正背对镜头走去，另一人则站在黄色路障附近。

text: The image shows six workers in a dug-out area, with four actively using shovels to move dirt. They are wearing safety helmets, and one worker is wearing a bright pink jacket. In the background, two additional workers are standing, observing or waiting. There is a pile of wood planks and construction materials visible behind them. The ground is uneven and appears to be part of an excavation process.
zh: 画面显示六名工人在挖掘区域，其中四人正积极使用铁锹搬运泥土。他们佩戴着安全帽，一名工人穿着亮粉色夹克。背景中另有两名工人站立着，似乎在观察或等待。他们身后可见一堆木板和建筑材料。地面平整，看起来是挖掘过程的一部分。

text: The image shows a construction site with a prominent tower crane in the center, equipped with a jib and counter-jib, and a load suspended from its hook. The crane is positioned over an area with reddish-brown soil. In the foreground, there is a section of scaffolding and construction materials, including yellow vertical elements, possibly formwork or scaffolding components.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中央有一台显眼的塔式起重机，配备有吊钩和计数器吊钩，其吊钩上悬挂着一件负载物。起重机位于一片红褐色土壤区域上方。前景处有一片脚手架及建筑材料，包含黄色竖向构件，可能为脚手架或脚手架部件。

text: The image shows a blue dump truck parked under a large concrete structure supported by numerous wooden scaffolding poles. The ground beneath the structure is littered with various construction debris, including pieces of wood and rebar. The concrete structure appears to be part of an unfinished building or infrastructure project.
zh: 一辆蓝色自卸卡车停放在由众多木质脚手架杆支撑的大型混凝土结构下方。地面散落着各种建筑废料，包括木块和钢筋。该混凝土结构似乎是一个已完工建筑或基础设施项目的一部分。

text: The image features a large yellow tower crane with a horizontal jib, counterjib, and a red flag at the top. The crane's operator cabin is situated below the jib, and there are no visible workers or construction activities taking place. In the background, a city skyline with multiple buildings can be seen under an overcast sky.
zh: 画面中有一台大型黄色色塔式起重机，配有水平拉杆、配重及顶部红色旗帜。起重机操作室位于拉杆下方，现场未见有工人或施工活动。背景中，在阴沉天之下，可看到城市天际线及多栋建筑。

err.zh: 大型黄色色塔式起重机

text: The image shows a construction site with a single-story red building in the center. In front of the building, there is a yellow bulldozer working on the site. The ground is uneven with piles of earth and debris scattered throughout.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心有一栋单层的红色建筑。在建筑前方，有一台黄色压路机正在工地上作业。地面平整，到处散落着土堆和碎屑。

text: In the image, there are two workers wearing red hard hats and safety vests on a construction site with uneven, excavated ground. The worker on the left is holding a surveying rod, while the worker on the right is holding some papers and appears to be taking notes or reviewing documents. In the background, there are several multistory buildings with various construction stages and colors. Blue fencing is visible around the construction area, and there are no visible construction machines or equipment in use in the immediate vicinity of the workers.
zh: 图像中有两名头戴红色安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人，位于地面平整、经过开挖的施工现场。左侧的工人手持一根测量杆，而右侧的工人手持一些纸张，似乎正在记录或审阅文件。背景中可见几栋多层建筑，处于不同的施工阶段，颜色各异。施工区域周围可见蓝色围挡网，而在工人附近没有可见施工机械或设备在使用。

err.zh: 地面平整、经过开挖的施工现场

text: The image shows a Kobelco excavator at night, partially illuminated by artificial lighting, positioned on uneven terrain with visible tracks in the soil. The excavator's boom and bucket are resting on the ground, suggesting it is not in operation at the moment. The background is dark with a red glow in the sky, and there are some structures and vegetation faintly visible.
zh: 夜间，一台Kobelco挖掘机停放在地势平坦的地面上，部分被人工照明照亮，泥土中可见车辙痕迹。挖掘机的的大锤和铲斗停放在地面上，表明此刻它并未处于作业状态。背景昏暗，天空中泛着一片红光，一些结构和植被隐约可见。

text: The image shows a large excavation site with four yellow excavators actively engaged in digging and moving earth. The excavators are positioned within the site at various locations, with one on the left side, two in the center, and one on the right side of the image. The site is surrounded by mounds of excavated soil, and there is a concrete retaining wall on the left. In the background, there are trees, power lines, and a blue structure behind the green fencing that marks the boundary of the construction area.
zh: 图像显示一个大型土方方施工现场，四台黄色挖掘机正在进行挖掘和搬运泥土。挖掘机分布在工地的不同位置，其中一台位于左侧，两台位于中央，一台位于图像右侧。工地周围堆满了挖掘出的来的土，左侧有一堵混凝土挡土墙。背景中可见树木、电线，以及一道绿色围栏，标示着施工区域的边界。

err.en: a blue structure behind the green fencin

text: The image shows a construction site with a mobile crane with a green boom extended over a flatbed truck. To the left of the crane, two workers are engaged in a task near the truck. Multiple stacks of rebars are organized throughout the site.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，一台移动式起重机吊着一根绿色工字钢梁，横跨在一辆平板卡车上方。在起重机的左侧，两名工人正在卡车附近从事一项任务。多根钢筋棒在整个工地现场有序堆放。

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers wearing yellow hard hats and red overalls. They are working on a structure with multiple levels of scaffolding and formwork. The workers are engaged in various activities, some are bending over materials, and one appears to be moving or adjusting something on the floor. There are safety barriers around the perimeter of the working area, and several warning signs are visible on the fencing.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有七名工人戴着黄色安全帽和红色反光背心。他们正在多层脚手架和模板结构上作业。这些工人从事着各种活动，有些正在弯曲材料，还有一人似乎正在地面移动或调整某物。工作区域周围设有安全护栏，围栏上可见若干警示标志。

text: The image shows a construction site with a variety of heavy machinery and one visible worker. A green dump truck is loaded with soil in the foreground, while a crawler crane with a pile driver attachment is positioned in the center. To the right, a bulldozer is working on the soil, and several large black pipes are laid out nearby. The worker is standing near the bulldozer, wearing a dark-colored outfit.
zh: 画面显示一个施工现场，现场有多种重型机械，可见一名工人。前景处有一辆绿色自卸卡车，装载着泥土；中央位置有一台履带式起重机，吊挂着司机室附件。右侧，一台推土机正在作业，附近还铺设着几根大型黑色管道。该工人站在推土机附近，身穿深色服装。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, dense grid of vertical and horizontal rebars, indicating the preparation for a concrete structure. There are four workers visible: three are on the left side, wearing red overalls and yellow hard hats, and one is on the right side, wearing a pink vest and a yellow hard hat. The workers on the left appear to be working on or inspecting the rebar structure, while the worker on the right is standing beside a stack of horizontal rebars.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有密集布的纵横钢筋网架，表明正在进行混凝土结构施工准备。可见四名工人：左侧三人，身穿红色上衣，头戴黄色安全帽；右侧一人，身穿粉色背心心和黄色安全帽。左侧的工人似乎正在操作或检查钢筋网架，而右侧的工人正站在一堆水平钢筋旁。

text: The image shows a construction site with seven workers wearing hard hats and high-visibility vests. In the foreground, one worker is using a shovel near a wheelbarrow, while another is standing by a pile of bricks. In the midground, four workers are handling a large striped tarpaulin, and another worker is observing them. Behind them, an excavator is visible, and there are mounds of earth and covered materials.
zh: 图中显示一个建筑工地，有七名头戴安全帽、身穿高能见度背心的的工人。在前景中，一名工人正在使用铁锹靠近一个轮轴，而另一名工人则站在砖堆旁。在中景处，四名工人正在处理一块大型条纹状防水布，而另一名工人则在观察他们。在他们身后，一台挖掘机清晰可见，并且有土堆和覆盖材料。

text: The image shows six workers wearing hard hats and safety vests at a construction site with two excavators in the background. Four workers are standing together, observing or discussing, while one worker is operating a surveying instrument, and another is kneeling on the ground, seemingly taking measurements or marking the soil. The ground is uneven with visible excavation work, and there is a retaining wall in the background.
zh: 图像显示六名头戴安全帽、身穿安全背心的的工人在施工现场，背景中有两台挖掘机。四名工人站在一起，正在观察或讨论，而一名工人正在操作测量仪器，另一名工人跪在地上，似乎正在测量或标记土壤。地面平整，可见挖掘作业，背景中有一道挡土墙。

text: A bulldozer is in the center, actively engaged in moving earth or clearing debris. There are two individuals visible: one standing on the left side of the frame observing the area, and another seated on the ground to the right, seemingly taking a break or monitoring the work. The terrain appears to be a construction site with uneven, bare earth and a pile of brushwood in the background.
zh: 一台推土机位于场地中央，正在进行进行土方方或清除碎屑作业。可见两人：一人站在画面左侧观察该区域，另一人坐在右侧地面上，似乎在休息或监督工作。地形看起来像一个施工场地，地面平整、裸露着泥土，背景中有一堆木材。

err.en: actively engaged in moving earth or clea
err.zh: 正在进行进行土方方或清除碎屑作业

text: The image shows a construction site with numerous workers engaged in various activities. Approximately 20 workers are visible, all wearing safety gear including hard hats and high-visibility vests. They are distributed throughout the site, working among dense arrays of vertical and horizontal rebar structures that are being assembled for concrete reinforcement.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，众多工人正从事各种活动。大约可见20名工人，均佩戴安全帽和高能见度背心等安全防护装备。他们分布于整个工地，正在组装用于混凝土加强的化的作业的中的密集排布的竖向及水平钢筋结构。

err.en: working among dense arrays of vertical a
err.zh: 正在组装用于混凝土加强的化的作业的中的密集排布的竖向及水平钢筋结构

text: The image shows a construction site with a single yellow excavator operating in the center, moving earth or debris. In the foreground, there are scattered piles of bricks and rubble, as well as some wooden stakes protruding from the ground, possibly marking future work areas. In the background, there is a structure with a traditional architectural style, featuring a grey roof and red columns.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台黄色挖掘机正在搬运泥土或碎石。前景处散落着砖块和碎石的堆，还有一些木桩从地面伸出，可能标示着未来的施工区域。背景中有一栋传统建筑风格风格的建筑，带有灰色屋顶和红色立柱。

err.en: a structure with a traditional architect
err.zh: 一栋传统建筑风格风格的建筑

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow dump truck in the center, unloading large rocks. A yellow wheel loader is positioned to the right of the dump truck, facing a pile of debris.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，中心有一辆黄色自卸卡车，未装载大块岩石。一辆黄色轮式装载机位于自卸卡车的右侧，面对一堆碎石。

text: The image shows a construction site with several workers spread across the area. In the foreground, there is a black car parked facing the site. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and mounds of dirt. Workers are seen performing various tasks; some are standing while others appear to be measuring or surveying the land.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，多名工人分散在场地各处。前景中有一辆黑色轿车停放在工地前，车头朝向工地。地面平整，可见轮胎痕迹和泥土堆。工人们正在进行执行各种任务；有些人站着，另一些人似乎正在测量或勘察土地。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers wearing yellow hard hats and safety vests engaged in various activities. One worker is bending over to adjust or place green rebar spacers on a grid of rebars laid out on the ground, while another worker is carrying a similar spacer towards the grid. There is a wheelbarrow on the left side of the image, and piles of construction materials, including bricks and rebars, are scattered around the site. The ground appears wet in some areas, and there is a concrete curb or footing that outlines the work area.
zh: 图片显示一个建筑工地，五名工人戴着黄色安全帽和穿着安全背心，从事各种活动。一名工人正弯腰在调整或放置绿色钢筋保护层，而另一名工人正搬运类似的的分隔物朝向钢筋网格。图像左侧有一个轮轴，并且建筑材料的堆，包括砖块和钢筋，散落在工地周围。地面在某些区域显得潮湿，并且有一个混凝土路缘或脚线，勾勒出工作区域。

text: The image shows a construction site with five workers. In the foreground, one worker is welding on top of a rebar structure, with sparks visible from the welding process. Another worker is standing close by, observing the welding activity. The site is scattered with construction materials, including wooden planks, metal poles, and rebars.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，共有五名工人。前景中，一名工人正在对一根钢筋进行焊接，焊接过程中可见火花四散。另一名工人站在附近，正在观察焊接作业。工地上散落着建筑材料，包括木托盘、金属杆以及钢筋。

err.en: on top of a rebar structure

text: The image shows a large excavation site with various construction vehicles at work. There are two drilling rigs standing tall in the center and right background, and multiple excavators are distributed across the site, with one in the foreground on the left and others towards the center and right. A couple of dump trucks are visible on the left, and there is a large excavated pit area in the middle. The ground is uneven and muddy, with visible tire tracks. The background features a row of electricity pylons extending into the distance.
zh: 图中展示了一个大型土方方施工现场，有多台施工车辆正在作业。画面中央及右侧背景处竖立着两台钻机，多台挖掘机分布于整个场地，其中一台位于前景左侧，另一台朝向中央及右侧。左侧可见几辆泵车，中部有一大片大型开挖坑区域。地面平整且泥泞滑，可见轮胎印迹。背景中有一排电力塔向远处延伸。

text: The image shows a construction site with one excavator in the center, which appears to be stationary in a muddy area with tracks indicating recent movement. There is another piece of construction equipment in the background to the left, which seems to be a bulldozer. The ground is uneven with visible tire tracks and dug-up soil, suggesting recent excavation work.
zh: 图中显示一个施工现场，中央有一台挖掘机，似乎静止在泥泞地上，带有轮胎印迹表明其近期有移动。背景左侧还有另一台施工设备，看起来像一台推土机。地面平整，可见轮胎印迹和挖掘的泥土，表明近期有挖掘作业。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer in the center, positioned on a mound of dirt. The bulldozer is adjacent to a concrete structure with exposed rebar, suggesting ongoing construction work. In the background, there are industrial buildings, and overhead power lines are visible in the upper left corner.
zh: 画面显示一处建筑工地，中央有一台黄色色推土机，停在一堆泥土上。推土机紧邻一处混凝土结构，钢筋外露，表明施工正在进行中。背景中可见工业建筑，左上角上方有架空电线。

text: The image shows a construction site with a large, open excavation area. Two yellow tower cranes are positioned within the site, one on the left and one on the right. A group of approximately ten workers, all wearing safety vests and hard hats, are gathered at the bottom of the excavation, near the center of the image, where there is a network of rebar laid out on the ground.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，有一个大型、敞开的挖掘区域。两台黄色塔式起重机位于工地内，一台在左侧，另一台在右侧。大约十名工人，均穿着安全背心和硬帽，聚集在挖掘底部，靠近图像中心，那里有一张网络平铺在地面上。

text: The image shows a nighttime construction scene with three workers visible. One worker is in the foreground, operating machinery that appears to be laying or smoothing a surface. A large, extended boom pump is prominent in the scene, stretching across the image from left to right, likely being used to pour concrete. The construction site is well-lit by a bright light source in the background, and the surrounding area includes trees and a fence.
zh: 画面呈现夜间施工场景，可见三名工人。前景处有一名工人正在操作一台机器，该机器似乎用于摊铺平或整平某表面。一台大型离心泵在画面中十分醒目，横跨画面从左至右，很可能用于浇筑混凝土。施工现场被背景中一个明亮的光源自上良好照明，且周边区域包含树木和围栏。

text: The image shows a yellow excavator in the center, positioned on an area of disturbed soil with visible tire tracks. The excavator's arm is extended, and its bucket is filled with earth, suggesting excavation work is in progress.
zh: 画面中央是一台黄色色挖掘机，停放在一片被扰动的土地区域上，可见轮胎轨迹。挖掘机的臂部伸展，其铲斗装满泥土，表明挖掘作业正在进行中。

text: The image shows a construction site with a yellow bulldozer actively moving earth in the center. To the left, there is a dump truck with its bed raised, indicating it has recently offloaded material. The ground is uneven and appears to be recently disturbed soil with some gravel.
zh: 图中显示一处施工现场，一台黄色推土机正在中央作业，向地面推土。左侧有一辆自卸卡车，其车斗已升起，表明其近期已卸载物料。地面平整，看似为近期扰动过的之土，夹杂有砾石。

text: The image shows a construction site with three workers installing rebar on a floor that appears to be prepared for concrete pouring. The workers are spaced out across the area, with one near the center and two others towards the back of the space. The construction site is partially enclosed, with a roof structure supported by steel columns, and the perimeter is lined with brick walls that have openings for windows.
zh: 图像显示一个建筑工地，三名工人正在安装栏杆，地面似乎已准备好进行混凝土浇筑。工人分散在该区域内，其中一人靠近中心，另外两人位于空间后方。建筑工地部分被围护，由钢柱支撑屋顶，周边砌有窗户开口的砖墙。

text: In the image, there is one individual wearing a white cap, red gloves, a striped shirt, and dark pants, operating a large drill on a concrete wall near a body of water. An orange extension cord is connected to the drill, and a metal bucket with tools and materials is placed on the ground beside the worker.
zh: 图中有一名工人头戴白色帽子，手戴红色手套袖，身穿条纹衬衫，下身穿深色裤子，正在操作一台大型钻机钻，在混凝土墙附近，旁边有一台水。一根橙色延长线连接着钻机钻，并且一个金属桶，里面装着工具和材料，被放置在工人旁边的地面上。

err.en: operating a large drill on a concrete wa
err.zh: 正在操作一台大型钻机钻，在混凝土墙附近，旁边有一台水

text: In the image, there is one worker wearing a white hard hat and a red shirt standing on the left side, facing a yellow excavator that is positioned in the center. The excavator is on top of a dirt mound, and there are additional dirt mounds in the background.
zh: 图中有一名头戴白色安全帽、身穿红色上衣的工人站在左侧，正面对对着一台位于画面中央的黄色色挖掘机。该挖掘机停在一堆土堆的顶部，背景中还有其他的土堆。

text: In the image, there is an orange excavator positioned on an elevated dirt area, with a worker standing nearby on the ground. The excavator appears to be engaged in earthmoving activities. The terrain is uneven and there are piles of dirt throughout the site.
zh: 图中有一台橙色挖掘机停放在一处抬高的土地区域上，附近有一名工人站在地面上。挖掘机似乎正在进行土方作业。地形平坦，整个场地散布着土堆。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavated area. Three workers are present, each wearing a different colored hard hat. In the foreground, the workers are standing and kneeling, examining the soil. In the background, there is construction machinery, including a green truck. The ground is uneven with visible rocks and soil.
zh: 图像显示一个施工现场，有一片开挖区域。三名工人在场，每人戴着不同颜色的安全帽。前景中，工人站着和跪着，检查土壤。背景中，有施工机械，包括一辆绿色卡车。地面是平整的，带有可见岩石和土壤。

text: The image shows a construction site with an excavator in the center, positioned on a dirt mound near a body of water. The excavator is in the process of digging or moving earth. The terrain appears to be uneven with patches of water, and the sky is clear. The background features a wide expanse of water and a flat horizon.
zh: 画面显示一处施工现场，中心位置有一台挖掘机，停在一堆泥土旁，靠近一片水域。挖掘机正在进行挖掘或搬运泥土方的作业。地形看起来较为平坦，伴有水洼，天空晴朗。背景呈现一片广阔的水域及平坦的地平线。

err.en: The terrain appears to be uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with a dump truck in the process of unloading its cargo on the left side of the frame. In front of the dump truck, there is a white van with its side door open, and two people are visible, one inside the van and another standing by the open door. On the right side of the image, there are large concrete pipes lying on the ground.
zh: 画面显示一个建筑工地，一辆自卸卡车正在将货物卸到画面左侧。自卸卡车前方有一辆白色厢式货车，其侧门敞开，可以看到两个人，一人在厢式货车内，另一人站在敞开的门旁。画面右侧地面上放置着大型混凝土管道。

err.en: on the left side of the frame

text: The image shows a construction site with uneven terrain and several mounds of earth. Two workers wearing orange safety vests are visible; one is standing on a mound in the center, and the other is further back near the edge of the site. A red and white motorcycle is parked in the foreground on a flat area of dirt.
zh: 图像显示一个施工场地，地势平坦，有几堆土堆。可以看到两名工人穿着橙色安全背心；其中一人站在场地中央的一个土堆上，另一人站在场地边缘附近。一辆红白相的摩托车停放在前景一片平坦的泥地上。

text: The image shows an active construction site with an orange Hyundai excavator in the process of digging, located on the left side of the frame. In the center, there is a large concrete pipe partially buried underground, with a section of it exposed and supported by steel sheet piles. To the right of the pipe, there is a formwork structure for concrete, possibly for a foundation or a column, with reinforcing bars sticking out. Various construction materials, including wooden planks and a coil of orange cable, are scattered around the site.
zh: 画面显示一个正在施工的的建筑工地的场景，一台橙色的现代挖掘机正在进行挖掘作业，位于画面左侧。画面中央有一根大型混凝土管道，部分埋于地下，其截面外露出地面，并由钢板桩支撑。管道右侧有一处混凝土结构，可能用于基础或立柱，其中钢筋外露在外。工地周围散落着各种建筑材料，包括木托盘和一卷橙色电缆线。

text: The image shows a group of ten individuals at a construction site. Most of them are wearing white hard hats, and one person is holding a blue umbrella. They appear to be engaged in a discussion or observation, with some looking at documents. The ground is uneven with red soil, and there is vegetation in the background.
zh: 图片显示，在一处建筑工地有十个人。其中大多数人戴着白色安全帽，一人撑着一把蓝色雨伞。他们似乎正在进行讨论或观察，有些人正在查看文件。地面平整，呈红土色，背景中有植被。

err.en: The ground is uneven with red soil

text: The construction site has a large expanse of brown soil with tire tracks, indicating recent activity. In the background, there are various construction vehicles, including excavators and cranes, with some partially obscured by mounds of earth. A tower crane is visible in the distance, and there are multiple construction vehicles and equipment scattered across the site, suggesting a large-scale operation.
zh: 施工现场有大片褐色泥土，带有轮胎痕迹，表明近期有活动。背景中可见多种施工车辆，包括挖掘机和压路机，部分被土堆遮挡。远处可见一台塔式起重机，现场散布着多台施工车辆和设备，表明正在进行大规模作业。

text: The image shows an orange excavator in operation, with its bucket engaged in moving earth. The excavator is positioned on a surface that appears to be muddy and uneven, with loose soil and rocks around it. The operator's cabin is visible, and the machine is situated against a backdrop of a concrete wall with protruding reinforcement bars.

text: The image shows two workers engaged in construction activities at night. They are standing on a framework of metal rods above a rocky surface, with one worker holding onto a vertical pipe while the other appears to be working with the concrete or mortar that is spread unevenly across the area.
zh: 夜间，两名工人正在进行施工作业。他们站在金属杆搭建的框架上，位于岩石表面之上，其中一名工人手持一根竖直管道，另一名工人似乎正在使用混凝土或砂浆，将其均匀涂抹布于该区域。

text: The image shows an excavator positioned on a mound of earth in the center, with its boom extended towards the right. In the foreground, there are scattered construction materials, including wooden planks and broken pieces of concrete. Behind the excavator, a blue barrier is visible, and beyond that, there is greenery consisting of trees and shrubs.

text: The image shows a green truck parked on the left, carrying long white pipes. A pile driver with a yellow crane is operating in the center, with visible exhaust fumes. To the right of the pile driver, there is a yellow excavator. The ground is muddy with visible tire tracks, and there are scattered construction materials and equipment, including a red barrel and electrical cables.

text: The image shows an excavator in the center operated by a person, with its bucket positioned above a pile of rubble and earth. text: The image shows a construction site with two workers in orange overalls and safety helmets. There is a large stockpile of rebar on the right side of the trench. The ground around the trench is uneven and scattered with debris and construction materials.

err.en: The ground around the trench is uneven

text: The image shows a construction site with one worker handling or inspecting a bundle of vertical rebars. 表明与混凝土结构相关的的工作正在进行持续进行

text: The image shows a white dump truck with the logo "HYUNDAI" on the front, parked on an unpaved road with muddy conditions. text: The image shows a construction site where concrete is being poured and leveled. There are ten workers visible, wearing yellow hard hats and various colored clothing. Some of them are spreading and smoothing the concrete with long-handled tools. A concrete pump truck with a red boom is positioned to the left, extending over the area where the concrete is being poured. The site is surrounded by excavated earth walls, and there is a blue structure in the background to the right.

err.en: a large area of reinforced steel bars

text: The image shows a single yellow soil compactor with a drum roller at a construction site. There is one operator inside the cabin of the vehicle.
